-- section
section NormalizeFiniteMeasure

/-! ### Normalization of finite measures to probability measures

This section is about normalizing finite measures to probability measures.

The weak convergence of finite measures to nonzero limit measures is characterized by
the convergence of the total mass and the convergence of the normalized probability
measures.
-/

namespace FiniteMeasure

variable {Ω : Type*} [Nonempty Ω] {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} (μ : FiniteMeasure Ω)

/-- Normalize a finite measure so that it becomes a probability measure, i.e., divide by the
total mass. -/
def normalize : ProbabilityMeasure Ω :=
  if zero : μ.mass = 0 then ⟨Measure.dirac ‹Nonempty Ω›.some, Measure.dirac.isProbabilityMeasure⟩
  else
    { val := μ.mass⁻¹ • (μ : Measure Ω)
      property := by
        refine ⟨?_⟩
        simp only [Measure.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, Measure.nnreal_smul_coe_apply,
          ENNReal.coe_inv zero, ennreal_mass]
        rw [← Ne, ← ENNReal.coe_ne_zero, ennreal_mass] at zero
        exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel zero μ.prop.measure_univ_lt_top.ne }

@[simp]
theorem self_eq_mass_mul_normalize (s : Set Ω) : μ s = μ.mass * μ.normalize s := by
  obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  have mass_nonzero : μ.mass ≠ 0 := by rwa [μ.mass_nonzero_iff]
  simp only [normalize, dif_neg mass_nonzero]
  simp [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ mass_nonzero, coeFn_def]

theorem self_eq_mass_smul_normalize : μ = μ.mass • μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure := by
  apply eq_of_forall_apply_eq
  intro s _s_mble
  rw [μ.self_eq_mass_mul_normalize s, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ProbabilityMeasure.coeFn_comp_toFiniteMeasure_eq_coeFn]

theorem normalize_eq_of_nonzero (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (s : Set Ω) : μ.normalize s = μ.mass⁻¹ * μ s := by
  simp only [μ.self_eq_mass_mul_normalize, μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero, inv_mul_cancel_left₀,
    Ne, not_false_iff]

theorem normalize_eq_inv_mass_smul_of_nonzero (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure = μ.mass⁻¹ • μ := by
  nth_rw 3 [μ.self_eq_mass_smul_normalize]
  rw [← smul_assoc]
  simp only [μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀, Ne,
    not_false_iff, one_smul]

theorem toMeasure_normalize_eq_of_nonzero (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    (μ.normalize : Measure Ω) = μ.mass⁻¹ • μ := by
  ext1 s _s_mble
  rw [← μ.normalize.ennreal_coeFn_eq_coeFn_toMeasure s, μ.normalize_eq_of_nonzero nonzero s,
    ENNReal.coe_mul, ennreal_coeFn_eq_coeFn_toMeasure]
  exact Measure.coe_nnreal_smul_apply _ _ _

@[simp]
theorem _root_.ProbabilityMeasure.toFiniteMeasure_normalize_eq_self {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) : μ.toFiniteMeasure.normalize = μ := by
  apply ProbabilityMeasure.eq_of_forall_apply_eq
  intro s _s_mble
  rw [μ.toFiniteMeasure.normalize_eq_of_nonzero μ.toFiniteMeasure_nonzero s]
  simp only [ProbabilityMeasure.mass_toFiniteMeasure, inv_one, one_mul, μ.coeFn_toFiniteMeasure]

/-- Averaging with respect to a finite measure is the same as integrating against
`MeasureTheory.FiniteMeasure.normalize`. -/
theorem average_eq_integral_normalize {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (f : Ω → E) :
    average (μ : Measure Ω) f = ∫ ω, f ω ∂(μ.normalize : Measure Ω) := by
  rw [μ.toMeasure_normalize_eq_of_nonzero nonzero, average]
  congr
  simp [ENNReal.coe_inv (μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero), ennreal_mass]

variable [TopologicalSpace Ω]

theorem testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    μ.testAgainstNN f = μ.mass * μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f := by
  nth_rw 1 [μ.self_eq_mass_smul_normalize]
  rw [μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.smul_testAgainstNN_apply μ.mass f, smul_eq_mul]

theorem normalize_testAgainstNN (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f = μ.mass⁻¹ * μ.testAgainstNN f := by
  simp [μ.testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ <| μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero]

variable [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω]
variable {μ}

theorem tendsto_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass {γ : Type*}
    {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω}
    (μs_lim : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize) F (𝓝 μ.normalize))
    (mass_lim : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).mass) F (𝓝 μ.mass)) (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).testAgainstNN f) F (𝓝 (μ.testAgainstNN f)) := by
  by_cases h_mass : μ.mass = 0
  · simp only [μ.mass_zero_iff.mp h_mass, zero_testAgainstNN_apply, zero_mass] at mass_lim ⊢
    exact tendsto_zero_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_zero_mass mass_lim f
  simp_rw [fun i ↦ (μs i).testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul f, μ.testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul f]
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_nhds_iff_toFiniteMeasure_tendsto_nhds] at μs_lim
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto] at μs_lim
  have lim_pair :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (⟨(μs i).mass, (μs i).normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f⟩ : ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0))
      F (𝓝 ⟨μ.mass, μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f⟩) :=
    (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mpr ⟨mass_lim, μs_lim f⟩
  exact tendsto_mul.comp lim_pair

theorem tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ}
    {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} (μs_lim : Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ)) (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f) F
      (𝓝 (μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f)) := by
  have lim_mass := μs_lim.mass
  have aux : {(0 : ℝ≥0)}ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 μ.mass :=
    isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds (μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero)
  have eventually_nonzero : ∀ᶠ i in F, μs i ≠ 0 := by
    simp_rw [← mass_nonzero_iff]
    exact lim_mass aux
  have eve : ∀ᶠ i in F,
      (μs i).normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f =
        (μs i).mass⁻¹ * (μs i).testAgainstNN f := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_iff.mp eventually_nonzero]
    intro i hi
    apply normalize_testAgainstNN _ hi
  simp_rw [tendsto_congr' eve, μ.normalize_testAgainstNN nonzero]
  have lim_pair :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (⟨(μs i).mass⁻¹, (μs i).testAgainstNN f⟩ : ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0)) F
      (𝓝 ⟨μ.mass⁻¹, μ.testAgainstNN f⟩) := by
    refine (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (continuousOn_inv₀.continuousAt aux).tendsto.comp lim_mass
    · exact tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto.mp μs_lim f
  exact tendsto_mul.comp lim_pair

/-- If the normalized versions of finite measures converge weakly and their total masses
also converge, then the finite measures themselves converge weakly. -/
theorem tendsto_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ}
    {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} (μs_lim : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize) F (𝓝 μ.normalize))
    (mass_lim : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).mass) F (𝓝 μ.mass)) : Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ) := by
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto]
  exact fun f ↦
    tendsto_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass μs_lim mass_lim f

/-- If finite measures themselves converge weakly to a nonzero limit measure, then their
normalized versions also converge weakly. -/
theorem tendsto_normalize_of_tendsto {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω}
    (μs_lim : Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ)) (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize) F (𝓝 μ.normalize) := by
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_nhds_iff_toFiniteMeasure_tendsto_nhds,
    tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto]
  exact fun f ↦ tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto μs_lim nonzero f

/-- The weak convergence of finite measures to a nonzero limit can be characterized by the weak
convergence of both their normalized versions (probability measures) and their total masses. -/
theorem tendsto_normalize_iff_tendsto {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω}
    (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize) F (𝓝 μ.normalize) ∧
        Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).mass) F (𝓝 μ.mass) ↔
      Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨normalized_lim, mass_lim⟩
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass normalized_lim mass_lim
  · intro μs_lim
    exact ⟨tendsto_normalize_of_tendsto μs_lim nonzero, μs_lim.mass⟩

end FiniteMeasure --namespace

end NormalizeFiniteMeasure -- section

section map

variable {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']

namespace ProbabilityMeasure

/-- The push-forward of a probability measure by a measurable function. -/
noncomputable def map (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    ProbabilityMeasure Ω' :=
  ⟨(ν : Measure Ω).map f, (ν : Measure Ω).isProbabilityMeasure_map f_aemble⟩

@[simp] lemma toMeasure_map (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    (ν.map hf).toMeasure = ν.toMeasure.map f := rfl

/-- Note that this is an equality of elements of `ℝ≥0∞`. See also
`MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.map_apply` for the corresponding equality as elements of `ℝ≥0`. -/
lemma map_apply' (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν)
    {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    (ν.map f_aemble : Measure Ω') A = (ν : Measure Ω) (f ⁻¹' A) :=
  Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable f_aemble A_mble

lemma map_apply_of_aemeasurable (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'}
    (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν) {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    (ν.map f_aemble) A = ν (f ⁻¹' A) := by
  exact (ENNReal.toNNReal_eq_toNNReal_iff' (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)).mpr <|
    ν.map_apply' f_aemble A_mble

lemma map_apply (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν)
    {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    (ν.map f_aemble) A = ν (f ⁻¹' A) :=
  map_apply_of_aemeasurable ν f_aemble A_mble

variable [TopologicalSpace Ω] [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω]
variable [TopologicalSpace Ω'] [BorelSpace Ω']

/-- If `f : X → Y` is continuous and `Y` is equipped with the Borel sigma algebra, then
convergence (in distribution) of `ProbabilityMeasure`s on `X` implies convergence (in
distribution) of the push-forwards of these measures by `f`. -/
lemma tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous {ι : Type*} {L : Filter ι}
    (νs : ι → ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (lim : Tendsto νs L (𝓝 ν))
    {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_cont : Continuous f) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (νs i).map f_cont.measurable.aemeasurable) L
      (𝓝 (ν.map f_cont.measurable.aemeasurable)) := by
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto] at lim ⊢
  intro g
  convert! lim (g.compContinuous ⟨f, f_cont⟩) <;>
  · simp only [map, compContinuous_apply, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    refine lintegral_map ?_ f_cont.measurable
    exact (ENNReal.continuous_coe.comp g.continuous).measurable

/-- If `f : X → Y` is continuous and `Y` is equipped with the Borel sigma algebra, then
the push-forward of probability measures `f* : ProbabilityMeasure X → ProbabilityMeasure Y`
is continuous (in the topologies of convergence in distribution). -/
lemma continuous_map {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_cont : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun ν ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map ν f_cont.measurable.aemeasurable) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  exact fun _ ↦ tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous _ _ continuous_id.continuousAt f_cont

end ProbabilityMeasure -- namespace

end map -- section

section join_bind

theorem isProbabilityMeasure_join {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {m : Measure (Measure α)}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure m] (hm : ∀ᵐ μ ∂m, IsProbabilityMeasure μ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (m.join) := by
  simp only [isProbabilityMeasure_iff, MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.join_apply]
  simp_rw [isProbabilityMeasure_iff] at hm
  exact lintegral_eq_const hm

theorem isProbabilityMeasure_bind {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    {m : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure m] {f : α → Measure β} (hf₀ : AEMeasurable f m)
    (hf₁ : ∀ᵐ μ ∂m, IsProbabilityMeasure (f μ)) : IsProbabilityMeasure (m.bind f) := by
  simp only [isProbabilityMeasure_iff, MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.bind_apply _ hf₀]
  simp_rw [isProbabilityMeasure_iff] at hf₁
  exact lintegral_eq_const hf₁

end join_bind

import LatticeProb.Site

/-!
Finite wired square boxes, with individual exit edge copies and forbidden-subset
recurrence. The counting law below is on the literal allowed-height subtype;
its identification with Markov recurrence is a separate literature result.
-/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

open LatticeProb MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

abbrev Active (N : ℕ) := Fin 2 → Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)

def site {N : ℕ} (x : Active N) : Site 2 := fun i => (x i).val

theorem site_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@site N) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun h i)

def inBox (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) : Prop := ∀ i, -(N : ℤ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ N

def activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) : Active N :=
  fun i => ⟨x i, h i⟩

theorem site_activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) :
    site (activeOfSite N x h) = x := rfl

theorem inBox_iff (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) :
    inBox N x ↔ x ∈ box 2 N := by
  simp only [inBox, box, Set.mem_setOf_eq, abs_le]

abbrev Direction := Fin 2 × Bool

def step (d : Direction) : Site 2 := if d.2 then unit d.1 else -unit d.1

theorem step_injective : Function.Injective step := by
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals norm_num [step, unit, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two] at h
  all_goals rfl

abbrev InteriorEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Active N // ∃ i : Fin 2, site p.2 = site p.1 + unit i}

abbrev ExitEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Direction // ¬inBox N (site p.1 + step p.2)}

/-- Each internal edge occurs in its positive-coordinate orientation once.
An exit copy remembers both its active endpoint and its outward direction. -/
abbrev Edge (N : ℕ) := InteriorEdge N ⊕ ExitEdge N

abbrev Vertex (N : ℕ) := Option (Active N)

def endpoints {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) : Vertex N × Vertex N :=
  match e with
  | .inl e => (some e.val.1, some e.val.2)
  | .inr e => (some e.val.1, none)

def conductance {N : ℕ} (_e : Edge N) : ℝ := 1

theorem endpoints_ne {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) :
    (endpoints e).1 ≠ (endpoints e).2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl e =>
    intro h
    have he : e.val.1 = e.val.2 := Option.some.inj h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    have hh := congrFun hi i
    rw [he] at hh
    simp [unit, site] at hh
  | inr e => simp [endpoints]

abbrev Heights (N : ℕ) := Active N → Fin 4

def internalDegree {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) : ℕ :=
  (nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site).card

theorem mem_neighbors_iff (x y : Site 2) :
    y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ (lattice 2).Adj x y := by
  change y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩

theorem internalDegree_eq_adj_card {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) :
    internalDegree s x = (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).card := by
  classical
  have he : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site =
      (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).image site := by
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, mem_neighbors_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [internalDegree, he, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (site_injective N)]

def forbidden {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) (s : Finset (Active N)) : Prop :=
  s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, (η x).val < internalDegree s x

def recurrent {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) : Prop := ∀ s, ¬forbidden η s

def allThree (N : ℕ) : Heights N := fun _ => 3

private theorem card_neighbors (x : Site 2) : (nbrFinset x).card = 4 := by
  classical
  rw [nbrFinset, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 2, ({x + unit i, x - unit i} : Finset (Site 2)).card = 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_singleton]
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
      intro h
      have hi := congrFun h i
      simp only [unit, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] at hi
      omega
    simp [hc]
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro a (rfl | rfl) (h | h) <;>
      have h1 := congrFun h i <;>
      have h2 := congrFun h j <;>
      simp [unit, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_of_ne, hij] at h1 h2

theorem exists_boundary_vertex {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, internalDegree s x ≤ 3 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun x => site x 0) hs
  have hout : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∉ s.image site := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hle := hmax y hy
    have he0 := congrFun he 0
    simp [unit] at he0
    omega
  have hsub : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site ⊂ nbrFinset (site x) := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨Finset.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
    intro he
    have hm : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∈ nbrFinset (site x) := by
      simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    rw [← he] at hm
    exact hout (Finset.mem_inter.mp hm).2
  have hc := Finset.card_lt_card hsub
  rw [card_neighbors] at hc
  exact ⟨x, hx, by dsimp [internalDegree]; omega⟩

theorem allThree_recurrent (N : ℕ) : recurrent (allThree N) := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdeg⟩ := exists_boundary_vertex s hs.1
  have hlt := hs.2 x hx
  change 3 < internalDegree s x at hlt
  omega

abbrev Recurrent (N : ℕ) := {η : Heights N // recurrent η}

instance recurrentNonempty (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (Recurrent N) :=
  ⟨⟨allThree N, allThree_recurrent N⟩⟩

instance recurrentFintype (N : ℕ) : Fintype (Recurrent N) := Fintype.ofFinite _

instance recurrentMeasurableSpace (N : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Recurrent N) := ⊤

instance recurrentMeasurableSingletonClass (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (Recurrent N) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Normalized counting measure on all stable fields with no forbidden subset. -/
def law (N : ℕ) : Measure (Recurrent N) :=
  (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

theorem law_singleton (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) :
    law N {η} = (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  simp [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

instance lawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (law N) := by
  constructor
  simp only [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]
  simp [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem law_apply (N : ℕ) (s : Set (Recurrent N)) :
    law N s = s.encard / Fintype.card (Recurrent N) := by
  rw [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_apply s.toFinite.measurableSet]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

/-- Auxiliary zero extension of a finite input field, not an infinite-volume law. -/
def zeroExtend (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) : Site 2 → Fin 4 :=
  fun x => if h : inBox N x then η.val (activeOfSite N x h) else 0

theorem zeroExtend_site (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Active N) :
    zeroExtend N η (site x) = η.val x := by
  have h : inBox N (site x) := fun i => (x i).property
  rw [zeroExtend, dif_pos h]
  congr 1

theorem zeroExtend_outside (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Site 2)
    (h : ¬inBox N x) : zeroExtend N η x = 0 := by
  simp only [zeroExtend, dif_neg h]

theorem zeroExtend_measurable (N : ℕ) : Measurable (zeroExtend N) :=
  measurable_of_countable _

/-- Push-forward of the finite recurrent counting law by the specified zero extension. -/
def finiteFieldLaw (N : ℕ) : Measure (Site 2 → Fin 4) :=
  Measure.map (zeroExtend N) (law N)

instance finiteFieldLawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteFieldLaw N) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (zeroExtend_measurable N).aemeasurable




end

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

import LatticeProb.Sandpile.LeastAction

/-!
# Finite legal toppling lists

The definitions use the literal lattice toppling rule. Least action gives
uniqueness of the counts in a finite legal stabilization and finite determination
under agreement on the affected vertices and their neighbors.

These are deterministic ingredients for `th:main` and `dy:finite-determination`
in the manuscript, rather than statements of those probability theorems.
-/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile

abbrev Site2 := Site 2
abbrev StableField := Site2 → Fin 4
abbrev Counts := Site2 →₀ ℕ

def initial (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  (η x).val + (ξ x : ℤ)

noncomputable def listCounts (w : List Site2) : Counts :=
  (w : Multiset Site2).toFinsupp

theorem listCounts_apply (w : List Site2) (x : Site2) :
    listCounts w x = w.count x := by
  simp [listCounts]

theorem listCounts_support (w : List Site2) :
    (listCounts w).support = w.toFinset := rfl

theorem listCounts_total (w : List Site2) :
    (listCounts w).sum (fun _ n => n) = w.length := by
  simp [listCounts, Finsupp.sum]

def prefixCounts (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (x : Site2) : ℤ :=
  ((w.take k).count x : ℤ)

def LegalList (s : Site2 → ℤ) (w : List Site2) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < w.length), 4 ≤ s w[k] + lap (prefixCounts w k) w[k]

def Stabilizes (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (w : List Site2) : Prop :=
  LegalList (initial η ξ) w ∧
    ∀ x, 0 ≤ initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x ∧
      initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4

theorem prefix_zero (w : List Site2) : prefixCounts w 0 = 0 := by
  funext x
  simp [prefixCounts]

theorem prefix_succ (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < w.length) (x : Site2) :
    prefixCounts w (k + 1) x = prefixCounts w k x + if x = w[k] then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold prefixCounts
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hk, List.count_append]
  by_cases hx : x = w[k]
  · simp [hx]
  · simp [hx, Ne.symm hx]

theorem prefix_eq_terminal (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (hk : w.length ≤ k) :
    prefixCounts w k = fun x => (listCounts w x : ℤ) := by
  funext x
  simp [prefixCounts, List.take_of_length_le hk, listCounts_apply]

theorem prefix_succ_eq (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < w.length) :
    prefixCounts w (k + 1) = fun x => prefixCounts w k x + dirac w[k] x := by
  funext x
  simpa only [dirac] using prefix_succ w k hk x

theorem lap_add (u v : Site2 → ℤ) (x : Site2) :
    lap (fun y => u y + v y) x = lap u x + lap v x := by
  simp only [lap, nbrSumZ, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

theorem height_succ (s : Site2 → ℤ) (w : List Site2) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < w.length) (x : Site2) :
    s x + lap (prefixCounts w (k + 1)) x =
      s x + lap (prefixCounts w k) x + lap (dirac w[k]) x := by
  rw [prefix_succ_eq w k hk, lap_add]
  ring

theorem dirac_nonneg (z x : Site2) : 0 ≤ dirac z x := by
  simp only [dirac]
  split <;> norm_num

theorem lap_dirac_self (z : Site2) : lap (dirac z) z = -4 := by
  have hp (i : Fin 2) : dirac z (z + unit i) = 0 := by
    apply dirac_of_ne
    intro h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    simp [unit] at hi
  have hm (i : Fin 2) : dirac z (z - unit i) = 0 := by
    apply dirac_of_ne
    intro h
    have hi := congrFun h i
    simp [unit] at hi
  simp [lap, nbrSumZ, hp, hm]

theorem lap_dirac_nonneg {z x : Site2} (hx : x ≠ z) : 0 ≤ lap (dirac z) x := by
  rw [lap, dirac_of_ne hx]
  simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  exact add_nonneg (dirac_nonneg z _) (dirac_nonneg z _)

theorem LegalList.heights_nonneg {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (h : LegalList s w) (hs : ∀ x, 0 ≤ s x) :
    ∀ k x, 0 ≤ s x + lap (prefixCounts w k) x := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro x
    simpa [prefix_zero, lap, nbrSumZ] using hs x
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x
    by_cases hk : k < w.length
    · rw [height_succ s w k hk x]
      by_cases hx : x = w[k]
      · subst x
        rw [lap_dirac_self]
        have ht := h k hk
        omega
      · exact add_nonneg (ih x) (lap_dirac_nonneg hx)
    · have he : prefixCounts w (k + 1) = prefixCounts w k := by
        rw [prefix_eq_terminal w (k + 1) (by omega),
          prefix_eq_terminal w k (by omega)]
      rw [he]
      exact ih x

theorem LegalList.isLegalToppling {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2}
    (h : LegalList s w) : IsLegalToppling s (prefixCounts w) := by
  refine ⟨prefix_zero w, ?_⟩
  intro k x
  by_cases hk : k < w.length
  · rw [prefix_succ w k hk x]
    by_cases hx : x = w[k]
    · right
      subst x
      exact ⟨by simp, by simpa using h k hk⟩
    · left
      simp [hx]
  · left
    rw [prefix_eq_terminal w (k + 1) (by omega),
      prefix_eq_terminal w k (by omega)]

theorem initial_nonneg (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (x : Site2) :
    0 ≤ initial η ξ x := by
  dsimp [initial]
  positivity

theorem stabilizes_iff_legal_and_lt (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (w : List Site2) :
    Stabilizes η ξ w ↔ LegalList (initial η ξ) w ∧
      ∀ x, initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4 := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => ⟨h.1, fun x => (h.2 x).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hs⟩
    refine ⟨h, fun x => ⟨?_, hs x⟩⟩
    have hn := h.heights_nonneg (initial_nonneg η ξ) w.length x
    rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at hn
    exact hn

theorem stabilizes_nil_zero (η : StableField) : Stabilizes η 0 [] := by
  rw [stabilizes_iff_legal_and_lt]
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    simp at hk
  · intro x
    simp [initial, listCounts, lap, nbrSumZ]

theorem legalList_le {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2} (h : LegalList s w)
    (v : Counts) (hv : ∀ x, s x + lap (fun y => (v y : ℤ)) x < 4) :
    ∀ x, listCounts w x ≤ v x := by
  intro x
  have hb := le_of_isLegalToppling h.isLegalToppling
    (w := fun y => (v y : ℤ)) (fun y => by positivity)
    (by simpa using hv) w.length x
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at hb
  change (listCounts w x : ℤ) ≤ (v x : ℤ) at hb
  exact_mod_cast hb

theorem stabilizes_counts_unique {η : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w v : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w) (hv : Stabilizes η ξ v) : listCounts w = listCounts v := by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro x
  exact le_antisymm (legalList_le hw.1 (listCounts v) (fun y => (hv.2 y).2) x)
    (legalList_le hv.1 (listCounts w) (fun y => (hw.2 y).2) x)

theorem existsUnique_counts {η : StableField} {ξ : Counts}
    (h : ∃ w, Stabilizes η ξ w) :
    ∃! u : Counts, ∃ w, Stabilizes η ξ w ∧ listCounts w = u := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h
  refine ⟨listCounts w, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro u ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  exact stabilizes_counts_unique hv hw

def StabilizationDomain (ξ : Counts) := {η : StableField // ∃ w, Stabilizes η ξ w}

noncomputable def odometer (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) : Counts :=
  Classical.choose (existsUnique_counts η.property)

theorem odometer_spec (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) :
    ∃ w, Stabilizes η.val ξ w ∧ listCounts w = odometer ξ η :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (existsUnique_counts η.property)).1

theorem odometer_eq_counts (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ)
    {w : List Site2} (hw : Stabilizes η.val ξ w) : odometer ξ η = listCounts w := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := odometer_spec ξ η
  exact he.symm.trans (stabilizes_counts_unique hv hw)

theorem odometer_final_stable (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) (x : Site2) :
    0 ≤ initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x ∧
      initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x < 4 := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := odometer_spec ξ η
  rw [← he]
  exact hw.2 x

noncomputable def addition (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) : StableField :=
  fun x => ⟨(initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x).toNat,
    (Int.toNat_lt (odometer_final_stable ξ η x).1).mpr
      (odometer_final_stable ξ η x).2⟩

theorem addition_eq (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ) (x : Site2) :
    ((addition ξ η x).val : ℤ) =
      initial η.val ξ x + lap (fun y => (odometer ξ η y : ℤ)) x :=
  Int.toNat_of_nonneg (odometer_final_stable ξ η x).1

def affected (ξ u : Counts) : Finset Site2 :=
  ξ.support ∪ u.support ∪ u.support.biUnion nbrFinset

theorem mem_nbrFinset_iff_adj (x y : Site2) :
    y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ (lattice 2).Adj x y := by
  change y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩

theorem mem_affected_iff (ξ u : Counts) (x : Site2) :
    x ∈ affected ξ u ↔ ξ x ≠ 0 ∨ u x ≠ 0 ∨
      ∃ y, u y ≠ 0 ∧ (lattice 2).Adj y x := by
  simp only [affected, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finsupp.mem_support_iff,
    mem_nbrFinset_iff_adj, or_assoc]

theorem mem_affected_of_list {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2} {x : Site2}
    (hx : x ∈ w) : x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w) := by
  simp only [affected, listCounts_support, Finset.mem_union, List.mem_toFinset]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr hx)

theorem count_zero_outside_affected {ξ u : Counts} {x : Site2}
    (hx : x ∉ affected ξ u) : ξ x = 0 ∧ u x = 0 := by
  simp only [affected, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hx
  exact ⟨Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx.1.1,
    Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx.1.2⟩

theorem lap_zero_outside_affected {ξ u : Counts} {x : Site2}
    (hx : x ∉ affected ξ u) : lap (fun y => (u y : ℤ)) x = 0 := by
  have hux := (count_zero_outside_affected hx).2
  have hn : ∀ y ∈ nbrFinset x, u y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra h
    apply hx
    simp only [affected, Finset.mem_union]
    right
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨y, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h, ?_⟩
    simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := hy
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  have hp (i : Fin 2) : u (x + unit i) = 0 :=
    hn _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, by simp⟩)
  have hm (i : Fin 2) : u (x - unit i) = 0 :=
    hn _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, by simp⟩)
  simp [lap, nbrSumZ, hux, hp, hm]

theorem stabilizes_transfer {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x) :
    Stabilizes η' ξ w := by
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    have hx : w[k] ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w) :=
      mem_affected_of_list (List.getElem_mem hk)
    simpa [initial, heq _ hx] using hw.1 k hk
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w)
    · simpa [initial, heq x hx] using hw.2 x
    · have hz := count_zero_outside_affected hx
      rw [lap_zero_outside_affected hx]
      simp only [initial, hz.1, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
      exact ⟨by positivity, by exact_mod_cast (η' x).isLt⟩

theorem stabilizes_iff_of_agree {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x) :
    Stabilizes η' ξ w ↔ Stabilizes η ξ w :=
  ⟨fun h => stabilizes_transfer h (fun x hx => (heq x hx).symm),
    fun h => stabilizes_transfer h heq⟩

def WiredStabilizes (η : StableField) (ξ : Counts) (V : Finset Site2)
    (w : List Site2) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ V) ∧ LegalList (initial η ξ) w ∧
    ∀ x ∈ V, 0 ≤ initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x ∧
      initial η ξ x + lap (fun y => (listCounts w y : ℤ)) x < 4

theorem stabilizes_transfer_wired {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x)
    (V : Finset Site2) (hV : affected ξ (listCounts w) ⊆ V) :
    WiredStabilizes η' ξ V w := by
  have ht := stabilizes_transfer hw heq
  exact ⟨fun x hx => hV (mem_affected_of_list hx), ht.1, fun x _ => ht.2 x⟩

theorem prefix_zero_of_not_mem {w : List Site2} {x : Site2} (hx : x ∉ w) (k : ℕ) :
    prefixCounts w k x = 0 := by
  simp only [prefixCounts, Nat.cast_eq_zero]
  exact List.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem (fun h => hx (List.mem_of_mem_take h))

theorem wired_legalList_le {s : Site2 → ℤ} {w : List Site2} (h : LegalList s w)
    (V : Finset Site2) (hwV : ∀ x ∈ w, x ∈ V)
    (v : Counts) (hv : ∀ x ∈ V, s x + lap (fun y => (v y : ℤ)) x < 4) :
    ∀ k x, prefixCounts w k x ≤ (v x : ℤ) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro x; rw [prefix_zero]; exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x
    rcases h.isLegalToppling.2 k x with he | ⟨he, htop⟩
    · rw [he]; exact ih x
    · rw [he]
      have hxw : x ∈ w := by
        by_contra hxw
        have h0 := prefix_zero_of_not_mem hxw k
        have h1 := prefix_zero_of_not_mem hxw (k + 1)
        omega
      by_contra hlt
      have hx : prefixCounts w k x = (v x : ℤ) := le_antisymm (ih x) (by omega)
      have hl := lap_le_lap_of_le ih hx
      have hs := hv x (hwV x hxw)
      norm_num at htop
      omega

theorem wiredStabilizes_counts_unique {η : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {V : Finset Site2}
    {w v : List Site2} (hw : WiredStabilizes η ξ V w)
    (hv : WiredStabilizes η ξ V v) : listCounts w = listCounts v := by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro x
  have h1 := wired_legalList_le hw.2.1 V hw.1 (listCounts v)
    (fun y hy => (hv.2.2 y hy).2) w.length x
  have h2 := wired_legalList_le hv.2.1 V hv.1 (listCounts w)
    (fun y hy => (hw.2.2 y hy).2) v.length x
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal w w.length le_rfl] at h1
  rw [prefix_eq_terminal v v.length le_rfl] at h2
  change (listCounts w x : ℤ) ≤ (listCounts v x : ℤ) at h1
  change (listCounts v x : ℤ) ≤ (listCounts w x : ℤ) at h2
  exact_mod_cast le_antisymm h1 h2

theorem finite_determination_counts {η η' : StableField} {ξ : Counts} {w : List Site2}
    (hw : Stabilizes η ξ w)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (listCounts w), η' x = η x) :
    (Stabilizes η' ξ w ∧
      ∀ v, Stabilizes η' ξ v → listCounts v = listCounts w) ∧
    ∀ V : Finset Site2, affected ξ (listCounts w) ⊆ V →
      WiredStabilizes η' ξ V w ∧
        ∀ v, WiredStabilizes η' ξ V v → listCounts v = listCounts w := by
  have ht := stabilizes_transfer hw heq
  refine ⟨⟨ht, fun _ hv => stabilizes_counts_unique hv ht⟩, ?_⟩
  intro V hV
  have htV := stabilizes_transfer_wired hw heq V hV
  exact ⟨htV, fun _ hv => wiredStabilizes_counts_unique hv htV⟩

theorem exists_domain_odometer_eq (ξ : Counts) (η : StabilizationDomain ξ)
    (η' : StableField)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ affected ξ (odometer ξ η), η' x = η.val x) :
    ∃ ζ : StabilizationDomain ξ, ζ.val = η' ∧ odometer ξ ζ = odometer ξ η := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := odometer_spec ξ η
  have ht : Stabilizes η' ξ w :=
    stabilizes_transfer hw (by simpa [he] using heq)
  refine ⟨⟨η', w, ht⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact (odometer_eq_counts ξ ⟨η', w, ht⟩ ht).trans he


end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile

/-! Finite height patterns determine a measure and a local limit, when it exists. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Probability
open FiniteAvalanches FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal Classical
noncomputable section

/-- Finite-coordinate equality uses the literal height-field carrier. -/
theorem measure_eq_of_finite_patterns (μ ν : Measure StableField) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (h : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (p : F → Fin 4),
      μ {η | F.restrict η = p} = ν {η | F.restrict η = p}) : μ = ν := by
  have hm (F : Finset Site2) : Measure.map F.restrict μ = Measure.map F.restrict ν := by
    apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
    intro p
    have hf : Measurable (F.restrict : StableField → F → Fin 4) := measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun x => measurable_pi_apply x.val)
    rw [Measure.map_apply hf (measurableSet_singleton p),
      Measure.map_apply hf (measurableSet_singleton p)]
    exact h F p
  apply Measure.ext_of_generateFrom_of_iUnion
    (measurableCylinders (fun _ : Site2 => Fin 4)) (fun _ : ℕ => (Set.univ : Set StableField))
    generateFrom_measurableCylinders.symm isPiSystem_measurableCylinders
    (Set.iUnion_const _) (fun _ => univ_mem_measurableCylinders _) (fun _ => measure_ne_top μ _)
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨F, A, hA, rfl⟩ := (mem_measurableCylinders S).mp hS
  have hf : Measurable (F.restrict : StableField → F → Fin 4) := measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun x => measurable_pi_apply x.val)
  simpa only [Measure.map_apply hf hA, cylinder] using congrArg (fun m => m A) (hm F)

/-- The manuscript's full-field form of a finite pattern determines the same measure. -/
theorem measure_eq_of_field_cylinders (μ ν : Measure StableField) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (h : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (ζ : StableField),
      μ {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x} = ν {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x}) : μ = ν := by
  apply measure_eq_of_finite_patterns μ ν
  intro F p
  let ζ : StableField := fun x => if hx : x ∈ F then p ⟨x, hx⟩ else 0
  have he : {η : StableField | F.restrict η = p} = {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x} := by
    ext η
    constructor
    · intro hη x hx
      have hx' := congrFun hη ⟨x, hx⟩
      simpa only [Finset.restrict_def, ζ, dif_pos hx] using hx'
    · intro hη
      funext x
      simpa only [Finset.restrict_def, ζ, dif_pos x.property] using hη x.val x.property
  rw [he]
  exact h F ζ

/-- A limit of the literal finite recurrent counting laws is unique. -/
theorem local_limit_unique (μ ν : Measure StableField) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (ζ : StableField),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
        FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x})
        Filter.atTop (nhds (μ {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x})))
    (hν : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (ζ : StableField),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
        FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x})
        Filter.atTop (nhds (ν {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x}))) : μ = ν := by
  apply measure_eq_of_field_cylinders μ ν
  intro F ζ
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hμ F ζ) (hν F ζ)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Probability

/-! Literal radius events are finite-coordinate cylinders in the actual product
of four-height spaces. The finite pattern set is their image under restriction;
there is no chosen extension, default field, or substituted confinement event. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Probability
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem finite_coordinate_event_eq_cylinder (F : Finset Site2) (E : Set StableField)
    (hE : ∀ η η' : StableField, (∀ x ∈ F, η' x = η x) → (η' ∈ E ↔ η ∈ E)) :
    E = cylinder F (F.restrict '' E) := by
  ext η
  constructor
  · intro hη
    exact ⟨η, hη, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨η', hη', heq⟩
    exact (hE η' η (fun x hx => (congrFun heq ⟨x, hx⟩).symm)).mpr hη'

theorem isClopen_finite_coordinate_event (F : Finset Site2) (E : Set StableField)
    (hE : ∀ η η' : StableField, (∀ x ∈ F, η' x = η x) → (η' ∈ E ↔ η ∈ E)) :
    IsClopen E := by
  rw [finite_coordinate_event_eq_cylinder F E hE]
  exact (isClopen_discrete _).preimage
    (continuous_pi (fun x => continuous_apply x.val))

theorem radius_le_eq_cylinder (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    {η : StableField | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)} =
      cylinder (boxSites (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1))
        ((boxSites (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1)).restrict ''
          {η : StableField | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)}) :=
  finite_coordinate_event_eq_cylinder _ _ (fun _ _ => radius_le_iff_of_agree_box o R)

theorem isClopen_radius_le (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    IsClopen {η : StableField | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)} :=
  isClopen_finite_coordinate_event _ _ (fun _ _ => radius_le_iff_of_agree_box o R)

theorem isClopen_radius_gt (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    IsClopen {η : StableField | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} := by
  simpa only [Set.compl_setOf, not_le] using (isClopen_radius_le o R).compl

theorem measurableSet_radius_le_local (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)} :=
  (isClopen_radius_le o R).isClosed.measurableSet

theorem measurableSet_radius_gt_local (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} :=
  (isClopen_radius_gt o R).isClosed.measurableSet

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Probability

import FiniteAvalanches.Probability.Radius.Cylinders
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Portmanteau

/-! Supporting finite-to-infinite passage. Convergence hypotheses are explicit;
neither existence of a local limit nor any source tail estimate is asserted here.
Every approximating law is the actual zero extension of the original finite law. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Probability
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

/-- The actual finite field law, merely packaged with its proved mass-one certificate. -/
def finiteFieldProbability (N : ℕ) : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField :=
  ⟨FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N, inferInstance⟩

theorem finiteFieldProbability_toMeasure (N : ℕ) :
    (finiteFieldProbability N : Measure StableField) = FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N := rfl

theorem measure_finite_coordinate_event (μ : Measure StableField) (F : Finset Site2)
    (E : Set StableField)
    (hE : ∀ η η' : StableField, (∀ x ∈ F, η' x = η x) → (η' ∈ E ↔ η ∈ E)) :
    μ E = ∑ p ∈ (F.restrict '' E).toFinite.toFinset, μ {η | F.restrict η = p} := by
  have hf : Measurable (F.restrict : StableField → F → Fin 4) :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun x => measurable_pi_apply x.val)
  have hs := sum_measure_preimage_singleton (μ := μ) (F.restrict '' E).toFinite.toFinset
    (fun p _ => (measurableSet_singleton p).preimage hf)
  have hp (p : F → Fin 4) : (F.restrict : StableField → F → Fin 4) ⁻¹' {p} =
      {η : StableField | F.restrict η = p} := by
    ext η
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  simp_rw [hp] at hs
  rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] at hs
  exact (congrArg μ (finite_coordinate_event_eq_cylinder F E hE)).trans hs.symm

theorem tendsto_finite_coordinate_event (μ : Measure StableField) (F : Finset Site2)
    (E : Set StableField)
    (hE : ∀ η η' : StableField, (∀ x ∈ F, η' x = η x) → (η' ∈ E ↔ η ∈ E))
    (hμ : ∀ p : F → Fin 4, Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | F.restrict η = p})
      atTop (nhds (μ {η | F.restrict η = p}))) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N E) atTop (nhds (μ E)) := by
  simp_rw [measure_finite_coordinate_event _ F E hE]
  exact tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun p _ => hμ p)

theorem tendsto_radius_le_of_marginals (μ : Measure StableField)
    (hμ : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (p : F → Fin 4), Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | F.restrict η = p})
      atTop (nhds (μ {η | F.restrict η = p}))) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N
      {η | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)}) atTop
      (nhds (μ {η | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)})) :=
  tendsto_finite_coordinate_event μ _ _
    (fun _ _ => radius_le_iff_of_agree_box o R) (hμ _)

theorem tendsto_radius_gt_of_marginals (μ : Measure StableField)
    (hμ : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (p : F → Fin 4), Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | F.restrict η = p})
      atTop (nhds (μ {η | F.restrict η = p}))) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N
      {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o}) atTop
      (nhds (μ {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o})) := by
  apply tendsto_finite_coordinate_event μ (boxSites (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1)) _
  · intro η η' heq
    change (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η' o ↔ (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o
    simpa only [not_le] using not_congr (radius_le_iff_of_agree_box o R heq)
  · exact hμ _

theorem tendsto_radius_le_of_weak (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N
      {η | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)}) atTop
      (nhds ((μ : Measure StableField) {η | radius η o ≤ (R : WithTop ℕ)})) :=
  MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto' hμ
    (by rw [(isClopen_radius_le o R).frontier_eq]; exact measure_empty)

theorem tendsto_radius_gt_of_weak (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N
      {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o}) atTop
      (nhds ((μ : Measure StableField) {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o})) :=
  MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto' hμ
    (by rw [(isClopen_radius_gt o R).frontier_eq]; exact measure_empty)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Probability

import FiniteAvalanches.Probability.Radius.Limits

/-! Supporting transfer of independently established finite-field tail bounds.
The convergence and finite estimates are honest inputs, not claimed source
results. Vanishing tails give literal finite legal stabilization at every source
whose estimates are supplied; no translation invariance is silently assumed. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Probability
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

theorem radius_tail_le_of_marginals (μ : Measure StableField)
    (hμ : ∀ (F : Finset Site2) (p : F → Fin 4), Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | F.restrict η = p})
      atTop (nhds (μ {η | F.restrict η = p}))) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) (b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hB : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b) :
    μ {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b :=
  le_of_tendsto (tendsto_radius_gt_of_marginals μ hμ o R) hB

theorem radius_tail_le_of_weak (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) (b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hB : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b) :
    (μ : Measure StableField) {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b :=
  le_of_tendsto (tendsto_radius_gt_of_weak μ hμ o R) hB

theorem radius_tail_real_le_of_weak (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) (b : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N).real {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b) :
    (μ : Measure StableField).real {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b :=
  le_of_tendsto
    ((ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (measure_ne_top (μ : Measure StableField) _)).comp
      (tendsto_radius_gt_of_weak μ hμ o R)) hB

theorem ae_finiteStabilizable_of_radius_tail_bound (μ : Measure StableField) (o : Site2)
    (b : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (nhds 0))
    (hB : ∀ R : ℕ, μ {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b R) :
    ∀ᵐ η ∂μ, FiniteStabilizable η o := by
  rw [ae_iff]
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  apply ge_of_tendsto' hb
  intro R
  apply (measure_mono _).trans (hB R)
  intro η hη
  change ¬ FiniteStabilizable η o at hη
  change (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o
  rw [(radius_eq_top_iff η o).mpr hη]
  exact WithTop.coe_lt_top R

theorem ae_all_finiteStabilizable_of_radius_tail_bounds (μ : Measure StableField)
    (b : Site2 → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hb : ∀ o, Tendsto (b o) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hB : ∀ (o : Site2) (R : ℕ), μ {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b o R) :
    ∀ᵐ η ∂μ, ∀ o : Site2, FiniteStabilizable η o :=
  ae_all_iff.mpr (fun o => ae_finiteStabilizable_of_radius_tail_bound μ o (b o) (hb o) (hB o))

theorem ae_finiteStabilizable_of_weak_tail_bounds
    (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2)
    (b : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (nhds 0))
    (hB : ∀ R : ℕ, ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b R) :
    ∀ᵐ η ∂(μ : Measure StableField), FiniteStabilizable η o :=
  ae_finiteStabilizable_of_radius_tail_bound (μ : Measure StableField) o b hb
    (fun R => radius_tail_le_of_weak μ hμ o R (b R) (hB R))

theorem ae_all_finiteStabilizable_of_weak_tail_bounds
    (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ))
    (b : Site2 → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hb : ∀ o, Tendsto (b o) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hB : ∀ (o : Site2) (R : ℕ), ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b o R) :
    ∀ᵐ η ∂(μ : Measure StableField), ∀ o : Site2, FiniteStabilizable η o :=
  ae_all_iff.mpr (fun o => ae_finiteStabilizable_of_weak_tail_bounds μ hμ o (b o) (hb o) (hB o))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Probability

/-! Direct passage from the original normalized wired fired-support events to the
literal limit radius. Sources stay arbitrary; a cofinal volume sequence contains
all determining coordinates by construction. No translation law or finite bound
is supplied by these supporting results. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Probability
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Waves MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

theorem source_in_shifted_volume (o : Site2) (R k : ℕ) :
    FiniteWired.inBox (k + (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1)) o :=
  (mem_box_sites _ _).mp ((site_radius_zero_le_iff o _).mp (by omega))

theorem tendsto_wired_radius_tail_of_weak
    (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
      let N := k + (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1)
      let a := FiniteWired.activeOfSite N o (source_in_shifted_volume o R k)
      FiniteWired.law N {η | finiteAvalancheLeaves a
        ((boxSites R).image (fun y => y + o)) η}) atTop
      (nhds ((μ : Measure StableField) {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o})) := by
  have h := (tendsto_radius_gt_of_weak μ hμ o R).comp
    (tendsto_add_atTop_nat (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1))
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with k
  exact finiteFieldLaw_radius_tail_eq_wired
    (FiniteWired.activeOfSite _ o (source_in_shifted_volume o R k)) R (by
      rw [FiniteWired.site_activeOfSite]
      omega)

theorem radius_tail_le_of_wired_bounds
    (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (o : Site2) (R : ℕ) (b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hB : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      let N := k + (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1)
      let a := FiniteWired.activeOfSite N o (source_in_shifted_volume o R k)
      FiniteWired.law N {η | finiteAvalancheLeaves a
        ((boxSites R).image (fun y => y + o)) η} ≤ b) :
    (μ : Measure StableField) {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η o} ≤ b :=
  le_of_tendsto (tendsto_wired_radius_tail_of_weak μ hμ o R) hB

theorem ae_all_finiteStabilizable_of_wired_tail_bounds
    (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ))
    (b : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (nhds 0))
    (hB : ∀ (o : Site2) (R : ℕ), ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      let N := k + (siteRadius 0 o + R + 1)
      let a := FiniteWired.activeOfSite N o (source_in_shifted_volume o R k)
      FiniteWired.law N {η | finiteAvalancheLeaves a
        ((boxSites R).image (fun y => y + o)) η} ≤ b R) :
    ∀ᵐ η ∂(μ : Measure StableField), ∀ o : Site2, FiniteStabilizable η o :=
  ae_all_finiteStabilizable_of_radius_tail_bounds (μ : Measure StableField)
    (fun _ => b) (fun _ => hb) (fun o R => radius_tail_le_of_wired_bounds μ hμ o R (b R) (hB o R))

theorem tendsto_origin_wired_radius_tail_of_weak
    (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (R : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      let a : FiniteWired.Active N := fun _ => ⟨0, by constructor <;> omega⟩
      FiniteWired.law N {η | finiteAvalancheLeaves a (boxSites R) η}) atTop
      (nhds ((μ : Measure StableField) {η | (R : WithTop ℕ) < radius η 0})) := by
  apply (tendsto_radius_gt_of_weak μ hμ 0 R).congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (R + 1)] with N hN
  let a : FiniteWired.Active N := fun _ => ⟨0, by constructor <;> omega⟩
  have ha : FiniteWired.site a = 0 := rfl
  have hr0 : siteRadius 0 (FiniteWired.site a) = 0 := by
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
    rw [siteRadius_le_iff, ha]
    simp
  have he := finiteFieldLaw_radius_tail_eq_wired a R
    (by rw [hr0]; simpa only [zero_add] using hN)
  have hb : (boxSites R).image (fun y => y + FiniteWired.site a) = boxSites R := by
    simp [ha]
  rw [hb, ha] at he
  exact he

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Probability

/-! A genuine finite equivalence transports the entire uniform measure, not
only one event. Nonempty carriers are required before forming probability. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches
open MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

theorem uniform_measure_map_equiv {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (e : α ≃ β) :
    (uniformMeasure α).map e = uniformMeasure β := by
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro b
  rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_finite _) (measurableSet_singleton _),
    uniformMeasure_apply, uniformMeasure_apply, Nat.card_congr e]
  have he : e ⁻¹' ({b} : Set β) = {e.symm b} := by
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply]
  rw [he, Nat.card_unique (α := ({e.symm b} : Set α)),
    Nat.card_unique (α := ({b} : Set β))]

end
end FiniteAvalanches

/-! Extended observables retain infinity on nonstabilizing configurations. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches
open LatticeProb LatticeProb.Sandpile FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal Classical
noncomputable section

/-- Lattice translation of the entire stable height field. -/
def translate (z : Site2) (η : StableField) : StableField := fun x => η (x + z)

theorem measurable_translate (z : Site2) : Measurable (translate z) := by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro x
  exact measurable_pi_apply (x + z)

/-- The exact extended nonnegative value of a natural count, retaining infinity. -/
def extendedCount (n : WithTop ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  match n with
  | none => ⊤
  | some k => k

theorem extendedCount_top : extendedCount ⊤ = ⊤ := rfl

theorem extendedCount_coe (n : ℕ) : extendedCount (n : WithTop ℕ) = n := rfl

theorem ofReal_lt_extendedCount_coe (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal R < extendedCount (n : WithTop ℕ) ↔ R < (n : ℝ) := by
  simpa [extendedCount] using
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal hR (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top n))

theorem ofReal_lt_extendedCount_top (R : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal R < extendedCount ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

/-- The positive-power logarithmic moment integrand, with value infinity at infinity. -/
def logMomentIntegrand (p : {p : ℝ // 0 < p}) (n : WithTop ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  match n with
  | none => ⊤
  | some k => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (2 + (k : ℝ)) ^ p.val)

theorem logMomentIntegrand_top (p : {p : ℝ // 0 < p}) :
    logMomentIntegrand p ⊤ = ⊤ := rfl

theorem logMomentIntegrand_coe (p : {p : ℝ // 0 < p}) (n : ℕ) :
    logMomentIntegrand p (n : WithTop ℕ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (2 + (n : ℝ)) ^ p.val) := rfl

theorem measurable_extendedCount : Measurable extendedCount := measurable_of_countable _

theorem measurable_logMomentIntegrand (p : {p : ℝ // 0 < p}) :
    Measurable (logMomentIntegrand p) := measurable_of_countable _

theorem measurable_radius_extended (o : Site2) :
    Measurable (fun η : StableField => extendedCount (radius η o)) :=
  measurable_extendedCount.comp (measurable_radius o)

theorem measurable_totalTopplings_extended (o : Site2) :
    Measurable (fun η : StableField => extendedCount (totalTopplings η o)) :=
  measurable_extendedCount.comp (measurable_totalTopplings o)

theorem measurableSet_radius_tail (o : Site2) (R : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField | ENNReal.ofReal R < extendedCount (radius η o)} :=
  measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_radius_extended o)

theorem measurableSet_totalTopplings_tail (o : Site2) (R : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet {η : StableField |
      ENNReal.ofReal R < extendedCount (totalTopplings η o)} :=
  measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_totalTopplings_extended o)

theorem measurable_radius_logMoment (o : Site2) (p : {p : ℝ // 0 < p}) :
    Measurable (fun η : StableField => logMomentIntegrand p (radius η o)) :=
  (measurable_logMomentIntegrand p).comp (measurable_radius o)

theorem measurable_totalTopplings_logMoment (o : Site2) (p : {p : ℝ // 0 < p}) :
    Measurable (fun η : StableField => logMomentIntegrand p (totalTopplings η o)) :=
  (measurable_logMomentIntegrand p).comp
    (measurable_totalTopplings o)

end
end FiniteAvalanches

theorem tendsto_cylinder_of_tendsto_boxes (μ : ProbabilityMeasure StableField)
    (hμ : Tendsto finiteFieldProbability atTop (nhds μ)) (F : Finset Site2) (ζ : StableField) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N {η | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x}) atTop

  have hE : ∀ η η' : StableField, (∀ x ∈ F, η' x = η x) →
      (η' ∈ {η : StableField | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x} ↔ η ∈ {η : StableField | ∀ x ∈ F, η x = ζ x}) := by
    intro η η' h
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact forall₂_congr (fun x hx => by rw [h x hx])
  exact MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto' hμ

  Subtype.ext (local_limit_unique (μ : Measure StableField) (ν : Measure StableField)
    (tendsto_cylinder_of_tendsto_boxes μ hμ.tendsto_boxes)
    (tendsto_cylinder_of_tendsto_boxes ν hν.tendsto_boxes))

  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, -⟩ := exists_infiniteVolumeLaw

open LatticeProb MeasureTheory Filter FiniteAvalanches FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
  FiniteAvalanches.Probability
open scoped ENNReal Classical

noncomputable section

/-- Stable fields vanishing off `Λ` that have no forbidden subset of `Λ`. -/
def allowedFields (Λ : Finset Site2) : Set StableField :=
  {η | (∀ x, x ∉ Λ → η x = 0) ∧ Waves.allowed Λ (fun x => ((η x).val : ℤ))}

theorem allowedFields_finite (Λ : Finset Site2) : (allowedFields Λ).Finite := by
  have hf : (Set.range (fun p : Λ → Fin 4 =>
      fun x : Site2 => if h : x ∈ Λ then p ⟨x, h⟩ else (0 : Fin 4))).Finite :=
    Set.finite_range _
  refine hf.subset ?_
  intro η hη
  refine ⟨fun x => η x.val, ?_⟩
  funext x
  by_cases h : x ∈ Λ
  · simp only [dif_pos h]
  · simp only [dif_neg h]
    exact (hη.1 x h).symm

theorem allowedFields_nonempty (Λ : Finset Site2) : (allowedFields Λ).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, Λ ⊆ boxSites N :=
    ⟨Λ.sup (siteRadius 0), fun x hx =>
      (site_radius_zero_le_iff x _).mp (Finset.le_sup (f := siteRadius 0) hx)⟩
  let η0 : FiniteWired.Recurrent N := ⟨FiniteWired.allThree N, FiniteWired.allThree_recurrent N⟩
  have hbox : Waves.allowed (boxSites N) (fun x => ((FiniteWired.zeroExtend N η0 x).val : ℤ)) :=
    (Waves.recurrent_iff_allowed η0.val _
      (fun x => by simp only [FiniteWired.zeroExtend_site])).mp η0.property
  refine ⟨fun x => if x ∈ Λ then FiniteWired.zeroExtend N η0 x else 0,
    fun x hx => if_neg hx, ?_⟩
  intro A hA hf
  apply hbox A (hA.trans hN)
  refine ⟨hf.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hf.2 x hx
  simp only [if_pos (hA hx)] at h1
  exact h1

instance (Λ : Finset Site2) : Fintype (allowedFields Λ) := (allowedFields_finite Λ).fintype
instance (Λ : Finset Site2) : Nonempty (allowedFields Λ) := (allowedFields_nonempty Λ).to_subtype

/-- Uniform probability on the allowed fields of the wired volume `Λ` (zero outside `Λ`). -/
def finiteFieldLawOn (Λ : Finset Site2) : Measure StableField :=
  Measure.map (Subtype.val : allowedFields Λ → StableField) (uniformMeasure (allowedFields Λ))

instance finiteFieldLawOn_probability (Λ : Finset Site2) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteFieldLawOn Λ) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable

def finiteFieldProbabilityOn (Λ : Finset Site2) : ProbabilityMeasure StableField :=
  ⟨finiteFieldLawOn Λ, inferInstance⟩

theorem zeroExtend_mem_allowedFields (N : ℕ) (η : FiniteWired.Recurrent N) :
    FiniteWired.zeroExtend N η ∈ allowedFields (boxSites N) :=
  ⟨fun x hx => FiniteWired.zeroExtend_outside N η x (fun h => hx ((mem_box_sites N x).mpr h)),
    (Waves.recurrent_iff_allowed η.val (fun x => ((FiniteWired.zeroExtend N η x).val : ℤ))
      (fun x => by simp only [FiniteWired.zeroExtend_site])).mp η.property⟩

/-- Zero extension identifies the recurrent heights of the wired box with its allowed fields. -/
def boxRecurrentEquiv (N : ℕ) : FiniteWired.Recurrent N ≃ allowedFields (boxSites N) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun η => ⟨FiniteWired.zeroExtend N η, zeroExtend_mem_allowedFields N η⟩)
    ⟨by
      intro η η' h
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext x
      have hx := congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) (FiniteWired.site x)
      simpa only [FiniteWired.zeroExtend_site] using hx,
     by
      intro ζ
      have hrec : FiniteWired.recurrent
          (fun x : FiniteWired.Active N => ζ.val (FiniteWired.site x)) :=
        (Waves.recurrent_iff_allowed (fun x => ζ.val (FiniteWired.site x))
          (fun x => ((ζ.val x).val : ℤ)) (fun x => rfl)).mpr ζ.property.2
      refine ⟨⟨fun x => ζ.val (FiniteWired.site x), hrec⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      funext x
      by_cases hx : FiniteWired.inBox N x
      · change (if h : FiniteWired.inBox N x then
          ζ.val (FiniteWired.site (FiniteWired.activeOfSite N x h)) else 0) = ζ.val x
        rw [dif_pos hx]
        rfl
      · change (if h : FiniteWired.inBox N x then
          ζ.val (FiniteWired.site (FiniteWired.activeOfSite N x h)) else 0) = ζ.val x
        rw [dif_neg hx]
        exact (ζ.property.1 x (fun h => hx ((mem_box_sites N x).mp h))).symm⟩

/-- On boxes this is the repo's actual forbidden-subset finite law. -/
theorem finiteFieldLawOn_boxSites (N : ℕ) :
    finiteFieldLawOn (boxSites N) = FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw N := by
  have hl : FiniteWired.law N = uniformMeasure (FiniteWired.Recurrent N) := by
    simp only [FiniteWired.law, uniformMeasure, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hf : ((Subtype.val : allowedFields (boxSites N) → StableField) ∘ boxRecurrentEquiv N) =
      FiniteWired.zeroExtend N := rfl
  rw [finiteFieldLawOn, FiniteWired.finiteFieldLaw, hl,
    ← uniform_measure_map_equiv (boxRecurrentEquiv N),
    Measure.map_map measurable_subtype_coe (measurable_of_finite _), hf]

theorem finiteFieldProbabilityOn_boxSites (N : ℕ) :
    finiteFieldProbabilityOn (boxSites N) = finiteFieldProbability N :=
  Subtype.ext (finiteFieldLawOn_boxSites N)

end

/-- Finite volumes exhausting `ℤ²`: every finite set is eventually contained. -/
def IsExhaustion (Λ : ℕ → Finset Site2) : Prop :=
  ∀ F : Finset Site2, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, F ⊆ Λ n

theorem isExhaustion_boxSites : IsExhaustion (fun n => boxSites n) := by
  intro F
  refine eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨F.sup (siteRadius 0), fun n hn x hx => ?_⟩
  exact (site_radius_zero_le_iff x n).mp ((Finset.le_sup (f := siteRadius 0) hx).trans hn)

/-- `μ` is the weak limit of the finite wired recurrent laws along every exhaustion. -/
def IsInfiniteVolumeLaw (μ : ProbabilityMeasure StableField) : Prop :=
  ∀ Λ : ℕ → Finset Site2, IsExhaustion Λ →
    Tendsto (fun n => finiteFieldProbabilityOn (Λ n)) atTop (nhds μ)

def IsTranslationInvariant (μ : ProbabilityMeasure StableField) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : Site2, (μ : Measure StableField).map (_root_.translate z) = (μ : Measure StableField)

end
