/-! Normalize a spanning query list to the classical ordering of distinct
nonroot vertices. Removing skipped entries preserves the entire first-unretained
protocol pointwise, including all complete histories and failure arrays. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E) (ι : E ↪ I)

theorem classicalExplore_filter (p : V → Bool) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (hp : ∀ v, p v = false → v ∈ s.roots) (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) :
    classicalExplore G ι s (order.filter p) ω = classicalExplore G ι s order ω := by
  induction order generalizing s ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases hx : p x with
    | false =>
      have hr := hp x hx
      simp only [List.filter_cons, hx, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, classicalExplore, if_pos hr]
      exact ih s hp ω
    | true =>
      simp only [List.filter_cons, hx, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hr : x ∈ s.roots
      · simp only [classicalExplore, if_pos hr]
        exact ih s hp ω
      · simp only [classicalExplore, if_neg hr]
        cases he : query G ι s x (ω 0) with
        | none => rfl
        | some t =>
          simp only [Option.bind_some]
          exact ih t (fun v hv => query_roots_mono G ι s t x (ω 0) he (hp v hv)) _

variable [BEq V] [LawfulBEq V]

theorem classicalExplore_eraseDups (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) :
    classicalExplore G ι s order.eraseDups ω = classicalExplore G ι s order ω := by
  have main : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ order : List V, order.length = n →
      ∀ s ω, classicalExplore G ι s order.eraseDups ω = classicalExplore G ι s order ω := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro order hn s ω
      cases order with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons x xs =>
        let p : V → Bool := fun v => !v == x
        have hl : (xs.filter p).length < n := by
          have hf := List.length_filter_le p xs
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hn
          omega
        rw [List.eraseDups_cons]
        change classicalExplore G ι s (x :: (xs.filter p).eraseDups) ω = _
        by_cases hx : x ∈ s.roots
        · simp only [classicalExplore, if_pos hx]
          rw [ih _ hl _ rfl]
          apply classicalExplore_filter
          intro v hv
          have he : v = x := by simpa [p, bne] using hv
          exact he ▸ hx
        · simp only [classicalExplore, if_neg hx]
          cases he : query G ι s x (ω 0) with
          | none => rfl
          | some t =>
            simp only [Option.bind_some]
            rw [ih _ hl _ rfl]
            apply classicalExplore_filter
            intro v hv
            have heq : v = x := by simpa [p, bne] using hv
            exact heq ▸ query_start_mem G ι s t x (ω 0) he
  exact main order.length order rfl s ω

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem nodup_eraseDups (order : List V) : order.eraseDups.Nodup := by
  have main : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ order : List V, order.length = n → order.eraseDups.Nodup := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro order hn
      cases order with
      | nil => simp
      | cons x xs =>
        rw [List.eraseDups_cons]
        apply List.nodup_cons.mpr
        constructor
        · simp
        · apply ih _ _ _ rfl
          have hf := List.length_filter_le (fun v => !v == x) xs
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hn
          omega
  exact main order.length order rfl

def classicalOrder (r : V) (order : List V) : List V :=
  order.eraseDups.filter (fun v => decide (v ≠ r))

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem classicalOrder_nodup (r : V) (order : List V) : (classicalOrder r order).Nodup :=
  (nodup_eraseDups order).filter _

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem mem_classicalOrder (r v : V) (order : List V) :
    v ∈ classicalOrder r order ↔ v ∈ order ∧ v ≠ r := by simp [classicalOrder]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem classicalOrder_spanning (r : V) (order : List V) (horder : ∀ v, v = r ∨ v ∈ order) :
    ∀ v, v ∈ classicalOrder r order ↔ v ≠ r := by
  intro v
  rw [mem_classicalOrder]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨(horder v).resolve_left hv, hv⟩

theorem classicalExplore_normalize (r : V) (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) :
    classicalExplore G ι (initialState ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩) (classicalOrder r order) ω =
      classicalExplore G ι (initialState ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩) order ω := by
  rw [classicalOrder, classicalExplore_filter G ι _ _ (fun v hv => by
    have he : v = r := by simpa using hv
    exact he ▸ Set.mem_singleton r)]
  exact classicalExplore_eraseDups G ι _ order ω

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.StoppedLaw
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.FreshRows

/-! The classical first-unretained list protocol uses a row only for an actual
walk. The slot protocol discards a fresh row at a skip. Their complete output
laws agree, including histories and nontermination. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E) (ι : E ↪ I)

def classicalExplore (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :
    List V → (ℕ → Driver G) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
  | [], _ => some s
  | x :: xs, ω => if x ∈ s.roots then classicalExplore s xs ω
      else (query G ι s x (ω 0)).bind (fun t => classicalExplore t xs (fun i => ω (i + 1)))

theorem classicalExplore_skip_prefix (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (skips order : List V) (hs : ∀ x ∈ skips, x ∈ s.roots) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) :
    classicalExplore G ι s (skips ++ order) ω = classicalExplore G ι s order ω := by
  induction skips with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, classicalExplore, if_pos (hs x (by simp))]
    exact ih (fun v hv => hs v (by simp [hv]))

theorem classicalExplore_all_roots (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (hs : s.roots = Set.univ) (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) :
    classicalExplore G ι s order ω = some s := by
  induction order with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ∈ s.roots := hs ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [classicalExplore, if_pos hx]
    exact ih

variable [Countable I] [Nonempty (Letter G)]

theorem measurable_classicalExplore (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    Measurable (classicalExplore G ι s order) := by
  induction order generalizing s with
  | nil => exact measurable_const
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s.roots
    · simpa only [classicalExplore, if_pos hx] using ih s
    · have hb : Measurable (fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
          p.1.bind (fun t => classicalExplore G ι t xs p.2)) := by
        apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
        intro o
        cases o with
        | none => exact measurable_const
        | some t => exact ih t
      simp only [classicalExplore, if_neg hx]
      exact hb.comp (((measurable_query G ι s x).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).prodMk
          (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (i + 1))))

variable (μ : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

theorem query_tail_joint_law (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) :
    (driversLaw G μ).map (fun ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0), rowsAfter G 1 ω)) =
      ((driverLaw G μ).map (query G ι s x)).prod (driversLaw G μ) := by
  have hi : IndepFun (fun ω : ℕ → Driver G => ω 0) (rowsAfter G 1) (driversLaw G μ) :=
    (rowsBefore_indep_tail G μ 1).comp
      (measurable_pi_apply (⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 0⟩ : Fin 1)) measurable_id
  have hq := hi.comp (measurable_query G ι s x) measurable_id
  have ht : Measurable (rowsAfter G 1) := measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (1 + i))
  have hh := hq.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    ((measurable_query G ι s x).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).aemeasurable ht.aemeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hh
  rw [hh, rowsAfter_law]
  rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_query G ι s x) (measurable_pi_apply 0)]
  rw [show (driversLaw G μ).map (fun ω => ω 0) = driverLaw G μ from Measure.infinitePi_map_eval _ 0]

omit [Nonempty (Letter G)] in
private theorem map_bind_prod_eq (ξ : Measure (Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))))
    (M M' : Measure (ℕ → Driver G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure M] [IsProbabilityMeasure M']
    (f g : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) → (ℕ → Driver G) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)))
    (hf : ∀ t, Measurable (f t)) (hg : ∀ t, Measurable (g t))
    (he : ∀ t, M.map (f t) = M'.map (g t)) :
    (ξ.prod M).map (fun p => p.1.bind (fun t => f t p.2)) =
      (ξ.prod M').map (fun p => p.1.bind (fun t => g t p.2)) := by
  have hmf : Measurable (fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
      p.1.bind (fun t => f t p.2)) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro o; cases o with
    | none => exact measurable_const
    | some t => exact hf t
  have hmg : Measurable (fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
      p.1.bind (fun t => g t p.2)) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro o; cases o with
    | none => exact measurable_const
    | some t => exact hg t
  ext U hU
  rw [Measure.map_apply hmf hU, Measure.map_apply hmg hU,
    Measure.prod_apply (hmf hU), Measure.prod_apply (hmg hU)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro o
  cases o with
  | none =>
    change M {ω | none ∈ U} = M' {ω | none ∈ U}
    by_cases hu : none ∈ U
    · simp [hu]
    · simp [hu]
  | some t =>
    have hs : (Prod.mk (some t) ⁻¹' (fun p => p.1.bind (fun t => f t p.2)) ⁻¹' U) = f t ⁻¹' U := by
      ext ω; rfl
    have hs' : (Prod.mk (some t) ⁻¹' (fun p => p.1.bind (fun t => g t p.2)) ⁻¹' U) = g t ⁻¹' U := by
      ext ω; rfl
    rw [hs, hs', ← Measure.map_apply (hf t) hU, ← Measure.map_apply (hg t) hU, he t]

theorem explorationLaw_eq_classical (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    explorationLaw G ι μ s order = (driversLaw G μ).map (classicalExplore G ι s order) := by
  induction order generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s.roots
    · have he : explore G ι s (x :: xs) = explore G ι s xs ∘ rowsAfter G 1 := by
        funext ω
        simp only [explore, query, if_pos hx, Option.bind_some, Function.comp_apply]
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact congrArg ω (Nat.add_comm i 1)
      rw [explorationLaw, he, ← Measure.map_map (measurable_explore G ι s xs)
        (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (1 + i))), rowsAfter_law]
      simpa only [explorationLaw, classicalExplore, if_pos hx] using ih s
    · let b := fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
          p.1.bind (fun t => explore G ι t xs p.2)
      let c := fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
          p.1.bind (fun t => classicalExplore G ι t xs p.2)
      have hb : Measurable b := by
        apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
        intro o; cases o with
        | none => exact measurable_const
        | some t => exact measurable_explore G ι t xs
      have hc : Measurable c := by
        apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
        intro o; cases o with
        | none => exact measurable_const
        | some t => exact measurable_classicalExplore G ι t xs
      have hq : Measurable (fun ω : ℕ → Driver G => (query G ι s x (ω 0), rowsAfter G 1 ω)) :=
        ((measurable_query G ι s x).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).prodMk
          (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (1 + i)))
      have he : explore G ι s (x :: xs) = b ∘ (fun ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0), rowsAfter G 1 ω)) := by
        funext ω
        simp only [explore, b, Function.comp_apply]
        rw [show (fun i => ω (i + 1)) = rowsAfter G 1 ω from
          funext (fun i => congrArg ω (Nat.add_comm i 1))]
      have he' : classicalExplore G ι s (x :: xs) = c ∘ (fun ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0), rowsAfter G 1 ω)) := by
        funext ω
        simp only [classicalExplore, if_neg hx, c, Function.comp_apply]
        rw [show (fun i => ω (i + 1)) = rowsAfter G 1 ω from
          funext (fun i => congrArg ω (Nat.add_comm i 1))]
      rw [explorationLaw, he, he', ← Measure.map_map hb hq, ← Measure.map_map hc hq, query_tail_joint_law]
      exact map_bind_prod_eq G _ _ _ _ _ (fun t => measurable_explore G ι t xs)
        (fun t => measurable_classicalExplore G ι t xs) (fun t => ih t)

variable [∀ v : V, MeasurableSpace (Incident G v)] [∀ v : V, MeasurableSingletonClass (Incident G v)]
variable (ν : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

theorem explorationLaw_eq_of_incident_marginals
    (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    explorationLaw G ι μ s order = explorationLaw G ι ν s order := by
  induction order generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [explorationLaw, explore]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    let b := fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
      p.1.bind (fun t => explore G ι t xs p.2)
    have hb : Measurable b := by
      apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
      intro o; cases o with
      | none => exact measurable_const
      | some t => exact measurable_explore G ι t xs
    have hq : Measurable (fun ω : ℕ → Driver G => (query G ι s x (ω 0), rowsAfter G 1 ω)) :=
      ((measurable_query G ι s x).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).prodMk
        (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (1 + i)))
    have he : explore G ι s (x :: xs) = b ∘ (fun ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0), rowsAfter G 1 ω)) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [explore, b, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [show (fun i => ω (i + 1)) = rowsAfter G 1 ω from
        funext (fun i => congrArg ω (Nat.add_comm i 1))]
    rw [explorationLaw, explorationLaw, he, ← Measure.map_map hb hq, ← Measure.map_map hb hq,
      query_tail_joint_law, query_tail_joint_law, query_law_eq G μ ν ι h]
    exact map_bind_prod_eq G _ _ _ _ _ (fun t => measurable_explore G ι t xs)
      (fun t => measurable_explore G ι t xs) (fun t => ih t)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.ClassicalProtocol
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.SpanningTrees

/-! Successful outputs of the actual first-unretained copied protocol are
genuine trees. A tree is constructed only from a successful spanning run. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E) (ι : E ↪ I)

theorem classicalExplore_is_tree (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (hs : G.is_tree s.roots s.edges) (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G)
    (h : classicalExplore G ι s order ω = some t) : G.is_tree t.roots t.edges := by
  induction order generalizing s ω with
  | nil => cases h; exact hs
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s.roots
    · simp only [classicalExplore, if_pos hx] at h
      exact ih s hs ω h
    · simp only [classicalExplore, if_neg hx] at h
      cases he : query G ι s x (ω 0) with
      | none => simp only [he, Option.bind_none] at h; cases h
      | some u =>
        simp only [he, Option.bind_some] at h
        exact ih u (query_is_tree G ι s u hs x (ω 0) he) _ h

theorem classicalExplore_covers (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) (h : classicalExplore G ι s order ω = some t) :
    s.roots ⊆ t.roots ∧ ∀ v ∈ order, v ∈ t.roots := by
  induction order generalizing s ω with
  | nil => cases h; exact ⟨Set.Subset.refl _, by simp⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s.roots
    · simp only [classicalExplore, if_pos hx] at h
      obtain ⟨hm, hc⟩ := ih s ω h
      refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
      intro v hv
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv
      · exact hm hx
      · exact hc v hv
    · simp only [classicalExplore, if_neg hx] at h
      cases he : query G ι s x (ω 0) with
      | none => simp only [he, Option.bind_none] at h; cases h
      | some u =>
        simp only [he, Option.bind_some] at h
        obtain ⟨hm, hc⟩ := ih u _ h
        refine ⟨(query_roots_mono G ι s u x (ω 0) he).trans hm, ?_⟩
        intro v hv
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with hvx | hv
        · subst v
          exact hm (query_start_mem G ι s u x (ω 0) he)
        · exact hc v hv

theorem classical_spanning_output_is_tree (r : V) (order : List V)
    (horder : ∀ v, v = r ∨ v ∈ order) (ω : ℕ → Driver G)
    (t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (h : classicalExplore G ι (initialState ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩) order ω = some t) :
    t.roots = Set.univ ∧ G.is_tree Set.univ t.edges := by
  obtain ⟨hm, hc⟩ := classicalExplore_covers G ι _ t order ω h
  have hr : t.roots = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun v => by
    rcases horder v with rfl | hv
    · exact hm (by simp [initialState])
    · exact hc v hv)
  refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
  have ht := classicalExplore_is_tree G ι _ t (G.is_tree_singleton_empty r) order ω h
  rwa [hr] at ht

def classicalTreeAtSuccess (r : V) (order : List V) (horder : ∀ v, v = r ∨ v ∈ order)
    (ω : ℕ → Driver G) (t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (h : classicalExplore G ι (initialState ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩) order ω = some t) :
    G.ComponentTree Set.univ := ⟨t.edges, (classical_spanning_output_is_tree G ι r order horder ω t h).2⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.LoopErasure
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Joining
import Mathlib.Probability.Independence.InfinitePi
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform

/-! Wilson exploration on individual copies of a finite loopless multigraph.
The walk continues by legal ordinary transitions at every vertex. Only first-hit
paths are attached, and complete paths remain separate from erased branches. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open Quiver MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

abbrev Incident (v : V) := {e : E // G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v}
abbrev Letter := (v : V) → Incident G v
abbrev Driver := ℕ → Letter G

instance incidentFintype (v : V) : Fintype (Incident G v) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype {e : E // G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v})
instance letterFintype : Fintype (Letter G) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype ((v : V) → Incident G v))
instance letterMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (Letter G) := ⊤
instance letterMeasurableSingletonClass : MeasurableSingletonClass (Letter G) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

def other (v : V) (e : Incident G v) : V :=
  if G.left e.val = v then G.right e.val else G.left e.val

theorem other_spec (v : V) (e : Incident G v) :
    (G.left e.val = v ∧ G.right e.val = other G v e) ∨
      (G.right e.val = v ∧ G.left e.val = other G v e) := by
  by_cases h : G.left e.val = v
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h, by simp [other, h]⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨e.property.resolve_left h, by simp [other, h]⟩

abbrev pathQuiver : Quiver (ULift.{0} V) :=
  copiedQuiver (fun e : E => (ULift.up (G.left e), ULift.up (G.right e)))
abbrev Trace (a b : V) := @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up a) (ULift.up b)

def arrow (v : V) (a : Letter G) :
    @Quiver.Hom (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up v) (ULift.up (other G v (a v))) :=
  ⟨(a v).val, by
    rcases other_spec G v (a v) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.1) (congrArg ULift.up h.2))
    · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.2) (congrArg ULift.up h.1))⟩

def position (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : ℕ → V
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => other G (position x ω n) (ω n (position x ω n))

def walkPath (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : (n : ℕ) → Trace G x (position G x ω n) :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun n => match n with
  | 0 => .nil
  | n + 1 => (walkPath x ω n).cons (arrow G (position G x ω n) (ω n))

def packedPath (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : Σ b : V, Trace G x b :=
  ⟨position G x ω n, walkPath G x ω n⟩

def pathCopies {a : ULift.{0} V} : {b : ULift.{0} V} → @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) a b → Finset E :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun p => match p with
  | .nil => ∅
  | .cons p e => insert e.val (pathCopies p)

def pathCopyList {a : ULift.{0} V} : {b : ULift.{0} V} → @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) a b → List E :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun p => match p with
  | .nil => []
  | .cons p e => pathCopyList p ++ [e.val]

variable {I : Type}

abbrev Record := V × List V × List I
structure State where
  roots : Set V
  roots_nonempty : roots.Nonempty
  edges : Finset E
  history : List (Record (V := V) (I := I))

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
@[ext] theorem State.ext {s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)}
    (hr : s.roots = t.roots) (he : s.edges = t.edges) (hh : s.history = t.history) : s = t := by
  cases s; cases t; cases hr; cases he; cases hh; rfl

abbrev Roots := {R : Set V // R.Nonempty}

def initialState (R : Roots (V := V)) : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  ⟨R.val, R.property, ∅, []⟩

def hits (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : Prop := ∃ n, position G x ω n ∈ B

def attachAt (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  let p := packedPath G x ω n
  { roots := s.roots ∪ {v | ULift.up v ∈ (loopErase p.2).vertices}
    roots_nonempty := s.roots_nonempty.mono Set.subset_union_left
    edges := s.edges ∪ pathCopies G (loopErase p.2)
    history := s.history ++ [(x, p.2.vertices.map ULift.down, (pathCopyList G p.2).map ι)] }

def query (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :=
  if x ∈ s.roots then some s
  else if h : hits G s.roots x ω then some (attachAt G ι s x ω (Nat.find h)) else none

/-- Skips and repeated queries consume their own row, just as successful queries do. -/
def explore (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :
    List V → (ℕ → Driver G) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
  | [], _ => some s
  | x :: xs, ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0)).bind (fun t => explore ι t xs (fun i => ω (i + 1)))

/-- No walk alphabet or probability kernel is formed in the all-root case. -/
def allRootResult [Nonempty V] : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  initialState ⟨Set.univ, by obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›; exact ⟨v, Set.mem_univ v⟩⟩

theorem explore_all_roots (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (hs : s.roots = Set.univ)
    (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) : explore G ι s order ω = some s := by
  induction order generalizing ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ∈ s.roots := hs ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [explore, query, if_pos hx, Option.bind_some]
    exact ih _

theorem incident_nonempty [Nontrivial V]
    (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (v : V) : Nonempty (Incident G v) := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne v
  rcases (hconn v w).cases_head with he | ⟨z, hz, _⟩
  · exact False.elim (hw he.symm)
  · obtain ⟨e, _, h | h⟩ := hz
    · exact ⟨⟨e, Or.inl h.1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨e, Or.inr h.1⟩⟩

/-- Each vertex receives an independent uniform incident-copy choice. Existence is
proved from connectedness and nontriviality before forming the uniform PMF. -/
def uniformLetterLaw [Nontrivial V] (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) : Measure (Letter G) := by
  letI (v : V) : Nonempty (Incident G v) := incident_nonempty G hconn v
  exact (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Letter G)).toMeasure

/-- IID rows of IID legal letters. The letter law is explicit data; it is not a tree law. -/
def driversLaw (μ : Measure (Letter G)) : Measure (ℕ → Driver G) :=
  Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Markov

/-! A full unused IID-driver tail remains fresh after a literal finite copied
exploration. Every query slot is consumed, even when its start is already retained. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory MeasurableSpace FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Countable I]
variable (G : Multigraph V E) (ι : E ↪ I) [Nonempty (Letter G)]

def prefixExplore (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :
    (order : List V) → (Fin order.length → Driver G) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
  | [], _ => some s
  | x :: xs, ω => (query G ι s x (ω ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩)).bind
      (fun t => prefixExplore t xs (fun i => ω ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩))

def rowsBefore (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) : Fin n → Driver G := fun i => ω i
def rowsAfter (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) : ℕ → Driver G := fun i => ω (n + i)

omit [Countable I] [Nonempty (Letter G)] in
theorem explore_eq_prefix (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) :
    explore G ι s order ω = prefixExplore G ι s order (rowsBefore G order.length ω) := by
  induction order generalizing s ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [explore, prefixExplore, rowsBefore]
    cases query G ι s x (ω 0) with
    | none => rfl
    | some t => exact ih t (fun i => ω (i + 1))

theorem measurable_prefixExplore (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    Measurable (prefixExplore G ι s order) := by
  induction order generalizing s with
  | nil => exact measurable_const
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hb : Measurable (fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (Fin xs.length → Driver G) =>
        p.1.bind (fun t => prefixExplore G ι t xs p.2)) := by
      apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
      intro o
      cases o with
      | none => exact measurable_const
      | some t => exact ih t
    exact hb.comp (((measurable_query G ι s x).comp (measurable_pi_apply (⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩ : Fin (x :: xs).length))).prodMk
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i : Fin xs.length => measurable_pi_apply (⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩ : Fin (x :: xs).length))))

variable (μ : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

instance driversLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure (driversLaw G μ) := by unfold driversLaw; infer_instance

omit [Countable I] [Nonempty (Letter G)] in
theorem rowsAfter_law (n : ℕ) : (driversLaw G μ).map (rowsAfter G n) = driversLaw G μ :=
  Measure.map_infinitePi_infinitePi_of_inj (P := fun _ : ℕ => driverLaw G μ)
    (fun _ _ h => Nat.add_left_cancel h)

omit [Countable I] [Nonempty (Letter G)] in
theorem rowsBefore_indep_tail (n : ℕ) : IndepFun (rowsBefore G n) (rowsAfter G n) (driversLaw G μ) := by
  let m : ℕ → MeasurableSpace (ℕ → Driver G) := fun i =>
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Driver G)).comap (fun ω => ω i)
  have hm : ∀ i, m i ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ℕ → Driver G)) := fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).comap_le
  have hi : iIndep m (driversLaw G μ) :=
    (iIndepFun_infinitePi (X := fun _ a => a) (P := fun _ : ℕ => driverLaw G μ) (fun _ => measurable_id)).iIndep
  have hd : Disjoint {i : ℕ | i < n} {i : ℕ | n ≤ i} :=
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun i hi hj => Nat.not_lt_of_ge hj hi)
  have h := indep_iSup_of_disjoint hm hi hd
  change Indep ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin n → Driver G)).comap (rowsBefore G n))
    ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ℕ → Driver G)).comap (rowsAfter G n)) (driversLaw G μ)
  apply indep_of_indep_of_le h
  · rw [MeasurableSpace.pi, MeasurableSpace.comap_iSup]
    apply iSup_le
    intro i
    rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le i.val i.isLt le_rfl
  · rw [MeasurableSpace.pi, MeasurableSpace.comap_iSup]
    apply iSup_le
    intro i
    rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le (n + i) (Nat.le_add_right n i) le_rfl

theorem explore_indep_tail (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    IndepFun (explore G ι s order) (rowsAfter G order.length) (driversLaw G μ) := by
  have h := (rowsBefore_indep_tail G μ order.length).comp (measurable_prefixExplore G ι s order) measurable_id
  have he : explore G ι s order = prefixExplore G ι s order ∘ rowsBefore G order.length := by
    funext ω
    exact explore_eq_prefix G ι s order ω
  rw [he]
  exact h

/-- Full state and full unused rows factor, including null histories and failure. -/
theorem explore_tail_joint_law (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    (driversLaw G μ).map (fun ω => (explore G ι s order ω, rowsAfter G order.length ω)) =
      ((driversLaw G μ).map (explore G ι s order)).prod (driversLaw G μ) := by
  have hm : Measurable (rowsAfter G order.length) :=
    measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (order.length + i))
  rw [(explore_indep_tail G ι μ s order).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    (measurable_explore G ι s order).aemeasurable hm.aemeasurable, rowsAfter_law]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedWalk
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Basic

/-! Ordinary unit-copy transitions on a connected nontrivial finite network.
Conductance to an endpoint is the number of distinct incident copies. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E) [Nontrivial V]
variable (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y)

def unitCopyPMF (v : V) : PMF (Incident G v) := by
  letI := incident_nonempty G hconn v
  exact PMF.uniformOfFintype _

theorem unitCopyPMF_apply (v : V) (e : Incident G v) :
    unitCopyPMF G hconn v e = (Fintype.card (Incident G v) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  letI := incident_nonempty G hconn v
  exact PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply e

def unitStepPMF (v : V) : PMF V := (unitCopyPMF G hconn v).map (other G v)

theorem unitStepPMF_apply (v w : V) :
    unitStepPMF G hconn v w =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Incident G v => other G v e = w)).card : ℝ≥0∞) /
        Fintype.card (Incident G v) := by
  unfold unitStepPMF
  rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype]
  simp only [unitCopyPMF_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  simp [eq_comm, div_eq_mul_inv]

variable [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSingletonClass V]

def unitKernel : Kernel V V where
  toFun v := (unitStepPMF G hconn v).toMeasure
  measurable' := measurable_of_countable _

instance unitKernel_markov : IsMarkovKernel (unitKernel G hconn) where
  isProbabilityMeasure v := by change IsProbabilityMeasure (unitStepPMF G hconn v).toMeasure; infer_instance

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import Mathlib.Combinatorics.Quiver.Path.Vertices
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Chronological loop erasure on endpoint-indexed walks. Quiver arrows are
retained, so a surviving edge keeps its original copy, even for parallel edges. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson

open Quiver

variable {V : Type*} [Quiver V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Truncate at the last occurrence of a vertex. On a simple retained path
this is its unique occurrence. The output retains the original arrows. -/
def prefixTo {a : V} : {b : V} → (p : Path a b) → (v : V) → v ∈ p.vertices → Path a v
  | _, .nil, v, hv => by
      have h : v = a := by simpa using hv
      subst v
      exact .nil
  | b, .cons p e, v, hv =>
      if h : b = v then h ▸ p.cons e
      else prefixTo p v ((Quiver.Path.mem_vertices_cons p e).mp hv |>.resolve_right (Ne.symm h))

/-- Online chronological loop erasure: visit vertices in their original order,
retain new arrows, and erase the retained suffix whenever a vertex is revisited. -/
def loopErase {a : V} : {b : V} → Path a b → Path a b
  | _, .nil => .nil
  | b, .cons p e =>
      let q := loopErase p
      if h : b ∈ q.vertices then prefixTo q b h else q.cons e

theorem prefixTo_vertices_sublist {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    (prefixTo p v hv).vertices.Sublist p.vertices := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      have h : v = a := by simpa using hv
      subst v
      simp [prefixTo]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c = v
      · subst v
        simp [prefixTo]
      · simp only [prefixTo, dif_neg h]
        exact (ih _).trans (by simp [Quiver.Path.vertices_cons])

theorem prefixTo_vertices_nodup {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices)
    (hp : p.vertices.Nodup) : (prefixTo p v hv).vertices.Nodup :=
  hp.sublist (prefixTo_vertices_sublist p v hv)

theorem loopErase_vertices_sublist {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.Sublist p.vertices := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [loopErase]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c ∈ (loopErase p).vertices
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_pos h]
        exact (prefixTo_vertices_sublist _ _ h).trans
          (ih.trans (by simp [Quiver.Path.vertices_cons]))
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_neg h, Quiver.Path.vertices_cons, List.concat_eq_append]
        exact ih.append (List.Sublist.refl [c])

theorem loopErase_vertices_nodup {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : (loopErase p).vertices.Nodup := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [loopErase]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c ∈ (loopErase p).vertices
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_pos h]
        exact prefixTo_vertices_nodup _ _ h ih
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_neg h, Quiver.Path.vertices_cons]
        exact ih.concat h

theorem loopErase_eq_self {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (hp : p.vertices.Nodup) : loopErase p = p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      have hpair : c ∉ p.vertices ∧ p.vertices.Nodup :=
        (List.nodup_concat p.vertices c).mp hp
      rw [loopErase, ih hpair.2, dif_neg hpair.1]


@[simp] theorem loopErase_head {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.head? = some a := Quiver.Path.vertices_head? _

@[simp] theorem loopErase_terminal {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.getLast (Quiver.Path.vertices_ne_nil _) = b :=
  Quiver.Path.vertices_getLast _ _

theorem loopErase_length_le {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : (loopErase p).length ≤ p.length := by
  have h := (loopErase_vertices_sublist p).length_le
  simp only [Quiver.Path.vertices_length] at h
  omega

/-- The quiver of individual unoriented edge copies with their actual endpoints. -/
abbrev copiedQuiver {E : Type*} (ends : E → V × V) : Quiver V where
  Hom x y := {e : E // (ends e = (x, y)) ∨ (ends e = (y, x))}

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Measurability
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Basic

/-! Integrated Markov transitions derived from IID legal-copy letters. No
positive-history ratio or independence assumption is supplied by the caller. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory MeasurableSpace FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
variable [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSingletonClass V]
variable (μ : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

def driverLaw : Measure (Driver G) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ)
instance driverLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure (driverLaw G μ) := by unfold driverLaw; infer_instance

def letterKernel : Kernel V V where
  toFun v := μ.map (fun a => other G v (a v))
  measurable' := measurable_of_countable _

instance letterKernel_markov : IsMarkovKernel (letterKernel G μ) where
  isProbabilityMeasure _ := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (measurable_of_countable _).aemeasurable

abbrev pastSpace (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Driver G) :=
  ⨆ k ∈ {k : ℕ | k < n}, (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)).comap (fun ω => ω k)

private theorem measurable_position_of_eval (x : V) (n : ℕ) (m : MeasurableSpace (Driver G))
    (h : ∀ k < n, @Measurable _ _ m (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)) (fun ω => ω k)) :
    @Measurable _ _ m (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace V) (fun ω => position G x ω n) := by
  letI := m
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (measurable_of_countable (fun p : V × Letter G => other G p.1 (p.2 p.1))).comp
      ((ih (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))).prodMk (h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))

theorem measurable_position_past (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    @Measurable _ _ (pastSpace G n) (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace V) (fun ω => position G x ω n) := by
  apply measurable_position_of_eval
  intro k hk
  exact measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (le_iSup₂_of_le k hk le_rfl)

omit [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSingletonClass V] in
theorem past_indep_next (n : ℕ) :
    Indep (pastSpace G n) ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)).comap
      (fun ω : Driver G => ω n)) (driverLaw G μ) := by
  let m : ℕ → MeasurableSpace (Driver G) := fun i =>
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)).comap (fun ω => ω i)
  have hm : ∀ i, m i ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Driver G)) := fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).comap_le
  have hi : iIndepFun (fun i (ω : Driver G) => ω i) (driverLaw G μ) :=
    iIndepFun_infinitePi (X := fun _ a => a) (fun _ => measurable_id)
  have hd : Disjoint {i : ℕ | i < n} {n} := Set.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr (Nat.lt_irrefl n)
  have h := indep_iSup_of_disjoint hm hi.iIndep hd
  simpa only [pastSpace, Set.mem_singleton_iff, iSup_iSup_eq_left] using h

private theorem fixed_step_law (n : ℕ) (v : V) (U : Set V) :
    driverLaw G μ {ω | other G v (ω n v) ∈ U} = letterKernel G μ v U := by
  have hU := (Set.to_countable U).measurableSet
  calc
    _ = ((driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => ω n)) ((fun a => other G v (a v)) ⁻¹' U) :=
      (Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply n) ((measurable_of_countable _) hU)).symm
    _ = letterKernel G μ v U := by
      rw [show (driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => ω n) = μ from Measure.infinitePi_map_eval _ n]
      exact (Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_countable (fun a : Letter G => other G v (a v))) hU).symm

theorem transition_given_past (x : V) (n : ℕ) (H : Set (Driver G))
    (hH : MeasurableSet[pastSpace G n] H) (v : V) (U : Set V) :
    driverLaw G μ {ω | ω ∈ H ∧ position G x ω n = v ∧ position G x ω (n + 1) ∈ U} =
      driverLaw G μ {ω | ω ∈ H ∧ position G x ω n = v} * letterKernel G μ v U := by
  let A : Set (Driver G) := {ω | ω ∈ H ∧ position G x ω n = v}
  let B : Set (Driver G) := {ω | other G v (ω n v) ∈ U}
  have hA : MeasurableSet[pastSpace G n] A :=
    hH.inter ((measurable_position_past G x n) (measurableSet_singleton v))
  have hU := (Set.to_countable U).measurableSet
  have hev : @Measurable _ _ ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)).comap
      (fun ω : Driver G => ω n)) (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)) (fun ω : Driver G => ω n) :=
    measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hB : MeasurableSet[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)).comap
      (fun ω : Driver G => ω n)] B :=
    ((measurable_of_countable (fun a : Letter G => other G v (a v))) hU).preimage hev
  have hi := (Indep_iff _ _ _).mp (past_indep_next G μ n) A B hA hB
  have he : {ω : Driver G | ω ∈ H ∧ position G x ω n = v ∧ position G x ω (n + 1) ∈ U} = A ∩ B := by
    ext ω
    simp only [A, B, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, position]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hH, hv, hU⟩
      subst v
      exact ⟨⟨hH, rfl⟩, hU⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hH, hv⟩, hU⟩
      subst v
      exact ⟨hH, rfl, hU⟩
  rw [he, hi]
  change _ = _
  rw [fixed_step_law]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedWalk

/-! Measurability of copied first-hit exploration, including unbounded complete
histories and failure. Finite prefixes determine the finite stopped operations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open Quiver MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Countable I] (G : Multigraph V E)

instance stateCountable : Countable (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :=
  Function.Injective.countable (f := fun s : State (V := V) (E := E) => (s.roots, s.edges, s.history))
    (fun _ _ h => State.ext (congrArg (fun p => p.1) h)
      (congrArg (fun p => p.2.1) h) (congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) h))
instance stateMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) := ⊤
instance stateMeasurableSingletonClass : MeasurableSingletonClass (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :=
  ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩
instance outcomeMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))) := ⊤
instance outcomeMeasurableSingletonClass : MeasurableSingletonClass (Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))) :=
  ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

private def extendPacked {x : V} (p : Σ b : V, Trace G x b) (a : Letter G) : Σ b : V, Trace G x b :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  ⟨other G p.1 (a p.1), p.2.cons (arrow G p.1 a)⟩

omit [Countable I] in
theorem packedPath_eq_of_prefix (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ k < n, ω k = η k) : packedPath G x ω n = packedPath G x η n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change extendPacked G (packedPath G x ω n) (ω n) = extendPacked G (packedPath G x η n) (η n)
    rw [ih (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk)), h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

variable (ι : E ↪ I)

omit [Countable I] in
theorem attachAt_eq_of_prefix (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω η : Driver G)
    (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ k < n, ω k = η k) : attachAt G ι s x ω n = attachAt G ι s x η n := by
  apply State.ext
  all_goals dsimp only [attachAt]; rw [packedPath_eq_of_prefix G x ω η n h]

variable [Nonempty (Letter G)]

private def extendPrefix (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Letter G) : Driver G :=
  fun k => if h : k < n then f ⟨k, h⟩ else Classical.ofNonempty

omit [Countable I] in
theorem measurable_attachAt (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : Driver G => attachAt G ι s x ω n) := by
  have hm : Measurable (fun ω : Driver G => attachAt G ι s x (extendPrefix G n (fun i => ω i)) n) :=
    (measurable_of_countable (fun f : Fin n → Letter G => attachAt G ι s x (extendPrefix G n f) n)).comp
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.val))
  have he : (fun ω : Driver G => attachAt G ι s x ω n) =
      (fun ω => attachAt G ι s x (extendPrefix G n (fun i => ω i)) n) := by
    funext ω
    apply attachAt_eq_of_prefix
    intro k hk
    simp [extendPrefix, hk]
  rw [he]
  exact hm

omit [Nonempty (Letter G)] in
omit [Countable I] in
theorem measurable_position (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    @Measurable _ _ _ (⊤ : MeasurableSpace V) (fun ω : Driver G => position G x ω n) := by
  letI : MeasurableSpace V := ⊤
  letI : MeasurableSingletonClass V := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (measurable_of_countable (fun p : V × Letter G => other G p.1 (p.2 p.1))).comp
      (ih.prodMk (measurable_pi_apply n))

omit [Nonempty (Letter G)] in
omit [Countable I] in
theorem measurableSet_hits (B : Set V) (x : V) : MeasurableSet {ω : Driver G | hits G B x ω} := by
  letI : MeasurableSpace V := ⊤
  have he : {ω : Driver G | hits G B x ω} = ⋃ n : ℕ, {ω | position G x ω n ∈ B} := by
    ext ω; simp [hits]
  rw [he]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n => (measurable_position G x n) (show MeasurableSet B from trivial))

omit [Countable I] in
theorem measurable_attach (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) :
    Measurable (fun ω : {ω : Driver G // hits G s.roots x ω} => attachAt G ι s x ω.val (Nat.find ω.property)) := by
  letI : MeasurableSpace V := ⊤
  exact Measurable.find (fun n => (measurable_attachAt G ι s x n).comp measurable_subtype_coe)
    (fun n => ((measurable_position G x n) (show MeasurableSet s.roots from trivial)).preimage
      measurable_subtype_coe) (fun ω => ω.property)

theorem measurable_query (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) : Measurable (query G ι s x) := by
  unfold query
  split
  · exact measurable_const
  · exact ((measurable_of_countable (some : State (V := V) (E := E) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)))).comp
      (measurable_attach G ι s x)).dite measurable_const (measurableSet_hits G s.roots x)

theorem measurable_explore (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    Measurable (explore G ι s order) := by
  induction order generalizing s with
  | nil => exact measurable_const
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hb : Measurable (fun p : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) × (ℕ → Driver G) =>
        p.1.bind (fun t => explore G ι t xs p.2)) := by
      apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
      intro o
      cases o with
      | none => exact measurable_const
      | some t => exact ih t
    exact hb.comp (((measurable_query G ι s x).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).prodMk
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply (i + 1))))

/-- This is the actual algorithm's push-forward, with nontermination retained as `none`. -/
def explorationLaw (μ : Measure (Letter G)) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    Measure (Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))) := (driversLaw G μ).map (explore G ι s order)

instance explorationLaw_probability (μ : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) : IsProbabilityMeasure (explorationLaw G ι μ s order) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (driversLaw G μ) := by unfold driversLaw; infer_instance
  exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (measurable_explore G ι s order).aemeasurable

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Markov

/-! A copied walk sees one vertex coordinate of each fresh letter. Consequently
its complete finite copied prefixes depend only on the incident-copy marginals,
even when coordinates within one letter are correlated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory MeasurableSpace FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Terminal and ordered destination/copy data. This record type is not a legal-path
carrier; actual walk records are compared with genuine endpoint-indexed paths below. -/
def PrefixRecord := V × List (V × E)

instance prefixRecordCountable : Countable (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Countable (V × List (V × E)))
instance prefixRecordMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) := ⊤
instance prefixRecordMeasurableSingletonClass : MeasurableSingletonClass (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) :=
  ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

def prefixStep (p : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) (a : Letter G) : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E) :=
  let e := a p.1
  let w := other G p.1 e
  (w, p.2 ++ [(w, e.val)])

def walkPrefix (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : ℕ → PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)
  | 0 => (x, [])
  | n + 1 => prefixStep G (walkPrefix x ω n) (ω n)

theorem walkPrefix_terminal (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) :
    (walkPrefix G x ω n).1 = position G x ω n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    dsimp only [walkPrefix, prefixStep, position]
    rw [ih]

private theorem measurable_walkPrefix_of_eval (x : V) (n : ℕ) (m : MeasurableSpace (Driver G))
    (h : ∀ k < n, @Measurable _ _ m (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Letter G)) (fun ω => ω k)) :
    @Measurable _ _ m (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)))
      (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) := by
  letI := m
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (measurable_of_countable (fun p : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E) × Letter G => prefixStep G p.1 p.2)).comp
      ((ih (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))).prodMk (h n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))

theorem measurable_walkPrefix (x : V) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) :=
  measurable_walkPrefix_of_eval G x n _ (fun _ _ => measurable_pi_apply _)

theorem measurable_walkPrefix_past (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    @Measurable _ _ (pastSpace G n) (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)))
      (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) := by
  apply measurable_walkPrefix_of_eval
  intro k hk
  exact measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (le_iSup₂_of_le k hk le_rfl)

variable (μ ν : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

theorem walkPrefix_indep_next (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    IndepFun (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) (fun ω : Driver G => ω n) (driverLaw G μ) :=
  indep_of_indep_of_le (past_indep_next G μ n) (measurable_walkPrefix_past G x n).comap_le le_rfl

theorem walkPrefix_joint_law (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    (driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => (walkPrefix G x ω n, ω n)) =
      ((driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n)).prod μ := by
  rw [(walkPrefix_indep_next G μ x n).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    (measurable_walkPrefix G x n).aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply n).aemeasurable]
  rw [show (driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => ω n) = μ from Measure.infinitePi_map_eval _ n]

variable [∀ v : V, MeasurableSpace (Incident G v)] [∀ v : V, MeasurableSingletonClass (Incident G v)]

omit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] in
/-- Identical incident-copy marginals suffice; equality of whole letter laws is unnecessary. -/
theorem prefixStep_law_eq (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (p : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) :
    μ.map (prefixStep G p) = ν.map (prefixStep G p) := by
  let f : Incident G p.1 → PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E) :=
    fun e => (other G p.1 e, p.2 ++ [(other G p.1 e, e.val)])
  have hf : Measurable f := measurable_of_countable _
  calc
    _ = (μ.map (fun a => a p.1)).map f := (Measure.map_map hf (measurable_of_countable _)).symm
    _ = (ν.map (fun a => a p.1)).map f := by rw [h p.1]
    _ = _ := Measure.map_map hf (measurable_of_countable _)

omit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] in
theorem prefixStep_prod_law_eq (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (ξ : Measure (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E))) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] :
    (ξ.prod μ).map (fun p => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) =
      (ξ.prod ν).map (fun p => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) := by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E) × Letter G => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) :=
    measurable_of_countable _
  ext U hU
  rw [Measure.map_apply hm hU, Measure.map_apply hm hU, Measure.prod_apply (hm hU), Measure.prod_apply (hm hU)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro p
  have he := congrArg (fun m : Measure (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) => m U)
    (prefixStep_law_eq G μ ν h p)
  have hs : Prod.mk p ⁻¹' (fun p : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E) × Letter G => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) ⁻¹' U =
      prefixStep G p ⁻¹' U := by ext a; rfl
  rw [hs]
  simpa only [Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_countable (prefixStep G p)) hU] using he

theorem walkPrefix_law_eq (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (x : V) (n : ℕ) :
    (driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) =
      (driverLaw G ν).map (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [walkPrefix]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hm : Measurable (fun p : PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E) × Letter G => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) :=
      measurable_of_countable _
    calc
      _ = ((driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => (walkPrefix G x ω n, ω n))).map
          (fun p => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) :=
        (Measure.map_map hm ((measurable_walkPrefix G x n).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply n))).symm
      _ = (((driverLaw G μ).map (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n)).prod μ).map
          (fun p => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) := by rw [walkPrefix_joint_law]
      _ = (((driverLaw G ν).map (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n)).prod ν).map
          (fun p => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) := by rw [ih]; exact prefixStep_prod_law_eq G μ ν h _
      _ = ((driverLaw G ν).map (fun ω => (walkPrefix G x ω n, ω n))).map
          (fun p => prefixStep G p.1 p.2) := by rw [walkPrefix_joint_law]
      _ = _ := Measure.map_map hm ((measurable_walkPrefix G x n).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply n))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.PrefixLaw

/-! Complete copied prefixes determine chronological path erasure and first-hit
operations. No representative driver is chosen for an unrealizable prefix. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open Quiver MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem walkPrefix_length (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) :
    (walkPrefix G x ω n).2.length = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [walkPrefix, prefixStep, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, ih]

theorem walkPrefix_eq_of_steps_eq (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (walkPrefix G x ω n).2 = (walkPrefix G x η n).2) :
    walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n := by
  apply Prod.ext _ h
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n =>
    have he := congrArg (fun l : List (V × E) => l.getLast?.map Prod.fst) h
    simpa [walkPrefix, prefixStep] using he

theorem walkPrefix_prev (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) (n : ℕ)
    (h : walkPrefix G x ω (n + 1) = walkPrefix G x η (n + 1)) :
    walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n := by
  apply walkPrefix_eq_of_steps_eq
  apply List.append_inj_left (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  rw [walkPrefix_length, walkPrefix_length]

theorem walkPrefix_eq_of_le (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) {n : ℕ}
    (h : walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    walkPrefix G x ω k = walkPrefix G x η k := by
  induction n with
  | zero => have he : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk; subst k; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hk with he | hl
    · exact he ▸ h
    · exact ih (walkPrefix_prev G x ω η n h) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hl)

private def incidentArrow (v : V) (e : Incident G v) :
    @Quiver.Hom (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up v) (ULift.up (other G v e)) :=
  ⟨e.val, by
    rcases other_spec G v e with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.1) (congrArg ULift.up h.2))
    · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.2) (congrArg ULift.up h.1))⟩

private def extendPath {x : V} (p : Σ b : V, Trace G x b) (e : Incident G p.1) : Σ b : V, Trace G x b :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  ⟨other G p.1 e, p.2.cons (incidentArrow G p.1 e)⟩

theorem packedPath_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) (n : ℕ)
    (h : walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n) : packedPath G x ω n = packedPath G x η n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hp := walkPrefix_prev G x ω η n h
    have hv : position G x ω n = position G x η n := by
      simpa only [walkPrefix_terminal] using congrArg Prod.fst hp
    have hc := List.append_inj_right (congrArg Prod.snd h)
      (by rw [walkPrefix_length, walkPrefix_length])
    have he : (ω n (position G x ω n)).val = (η n (position G x ω n)).val := by
      have he' := congrArg (fun l : List (V × E) => l.head?.map Prod.snd) hc
      dsimp only [prefixStep, List.head?_cons, Option.map_some] at he'
      rw [walkPrefix_terminal, walkPrefix_terminal, ← hv] at he'
      exact Option.some.inj he'
    change extendPath G (packedPath G x ω n) (ω n (packedPath G x ω n).1) =
      extendPath G (packedPath G x η n) (η n (packedPath G x η n).1)
    rw [ih hp]
    apply congrArg (extendPath G (packedPath G x η n))
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (ω n (position G x η n)).val = (η n (position G x η n)).val
    rw [← hv]
    exact he


variable {I : Type} (ι : E ↪ I)

theorem attachAt_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) (n : ℕ) (h : walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n) :
    attachAt G ι s x ω n = attachAt G ι s x η n := by
  apply State.ext
  all_goals dsimp only [attachAt]; rw [packedPath_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq G x ω η n h]

def firstHitAt (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  position G x ω n ∈ B ∧ ∀ k < n, position G x ω k ∉ B

theorem firstHitAt_unique (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) {n m : ℕ}
    (hn : firstHitAt G B x ω n) (hm : firstHitAt G B x ω m) : n = m := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy n m with h | h | h
  · exact False.elim (hm.2 n h hn.1)
  · exact h
  · exact False.elim (hn.2 m h hm.1)

theorem firstHitAt_iff_find (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) :
    firstHitAt G B x ω n ↔ ∃ h : hits G B x ω, Nat.find h = n := by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    have hh : hits G B x ω := ⟨n, hn.1⟩
    exact ⟨hh, (Nat.find_eq_iff hh).mpr ⟨hn.1, hn.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hh, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Nat.find_spec hh, fun k hk => Nat.find_min hh hk⟩

theorem firstHitAt_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω η : Driver G) (n : ℕ)
    (h : walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n) :
    firstHitAt G B x ω n ↔ firstHitAt G B x η n := by
  have hv (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : position G x ω k = position G x η k := by
    simpa only [walkPrefix_terminal] using congrArg Prod.fst (walkPrefix_eq_of_le G x ω η h k hk)
  simp only [firstHitAt, hv n le_rfl]
  exact and_congr_right (fun _ => forall_congr' fun k => forall_congr' fun hk => by rw [hv k hk.le])

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Branches

/-! Successful spanning queries from one root yield an actual copied spanning
tree. This is structural correctness, with no distributional identification. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open Quiver FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E) (ι : E ↪ I)

theorem walk_vertex_has_time (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) (v : ULift.{0} V)
    (hv : v ∈ @Path.vertices _ (pathQuiver G) _ _ (walkPath G x ω n)) :
    ∃ k ≤ n, position G x ω k = v.down := by
  letI := pathQuiver G
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have he : v = ULift.up x := by simpa [walkPath, Path.vertices] using hv
    exact ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 0, congrArg ULift.down he.symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases (Path.mem_vertices_cons _ _).mp hv with hv | hv
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := ih hv
      exact ⟨k, hk.trans (Nat.le_succ n), he⟩
    · exact ⟨n + 1, Nat.le_refl _, congrArg ULift.down hv.symm⟩

theorem attach_is_tree (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (hs : G.is_tree s.roots s.edges)
    (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (h : hits G s.roots x ω) :
    G.is_tree (attachAt G ι s x ω (Nat.find h)).roots (attachAt G ι s x ω (Nat.find h)).edges := by
  letI := pathQuiver G
  apply is_tree_attach_path G _ (loopErase_vertices_nodup _) s.roots s.edges hs (Nat.find_spec h)
  intro v hv hvr
  obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := walk_vertex_has_time G x ω (Nat.find h) v
    ((loopErase_vertices_sublist _).subset hv)
  have heq : k = Nat.find h := by
    by_contra hn
    exact Nat.find_min h (lt_of_le_of_ne hk hn) (he.symm ▸ hvr)
  apply ULift.ext_iff.mpr
  simpa only [heq] using he.symm

theorem query_is_tree (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (hs : G.is_tree s.roots s.edges) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (h : query G ι s x ω = some t) :
    G.is_tree t.roots t.edges := by
  unfold query at h
  split at h
  · cases h; exact hs
  · split at h
    · cases h; exact attach_is_tree G ι s hs x ω ‹_›
    · cases h

theorem query_roots_mono (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G)
    (h : query G ι s x ω = some t) : s.roots ⊆ t.roots := by
  unfold query at h
  split at h
  · cases h; exact Set.Subset.refl _
  · split at h
    · cases h; exact Set.subset_union_left
    · cases h

theorem query_start_mem (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G)
    (h : query G ι s x ω = some t) : x ∈ t.roots := by
  letI := pathQuiver G
  unfold query at h
  split at h
  · cases h; assumption
  · split at h
    · cases h; exact Or.inr (Path.start_mem_vertices _)
    · cases h

theorem explore_is_tree (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (hs : G.is_tree s.roots s.edges)
    (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) (h : explore G ι s order ω = some t) : G.is_tree t.roots t.edges := by
  induction order generalizing s ω with
  | nil => cases h; exact hs
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [explore] at h
    cases he : query G ι s x (ω 0) with
    | none => simp only [he, Option.bind_none] at h; cases h
    | some u =>
      simp only [he, Option.bind_some] at h
      exact ih u (query_is_tree G ι s u hs x (ω 0) he) _ h

theorem explore_covers (s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G)
    (h : explore G ι s order ω = some t) : s.roots ⊆ t.roots ∧ ∀ v ∈ order, v ∈ t.roots := by
  induction order generalizing s ω with
  | nil => cases h; exact ⟨Set.Subset.refl _, by simp⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [explore] at h
    cases he : query G ι s x (ω 0) with
    | none => simp only [he, Option.bind_none] at h; cases h
    | some u =>
      simp only [he, Option.bind_some] at h
      obtain ⟨hmono, hxs⟩ := ih u _ h
      refine ⟨(query_roots_mono G ι s u x (ω 0) he).trans hmono, ?_⟩
      intro v hv
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with hvx | hv
      · subst v
        exact hmono (query_start_mem G ι s u x (ω 0) he)
      · exact hxs v hv

/-- An arbitrary spanning order, including skips and repetitions, yields a genuine
canonical copied tree on success. No random-walk or tree-law conclusion is a premise. -/
theorem spanning_output_is_tree (r : V) (order : List V) (horder : ∀ v, v = r ∨ v ∈ order)
    (ω : ℕ → Driver G) (t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
    (h : explore G ι (initialState ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩) order ω = some t) :
    t.roots = Set.univ ∧ G.is_tree Set.univ t.edges := by
  have hs : G.is_tree (initialState (E := E) (I := I) ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩).roots
      (initialState (E := E) (I := I) ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩).edges := G.is_tree_singleton_empty r
  obtain ⟨hm, hc⟩ := explore_covers G ι _ t order ω h
  have hr : t.roots = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun v => by
    rcases horder v with rfl | hv
    · exact hm (by simp [initialState])
    · exact hc v hv)
  refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
  have ht := explore_is_tree G ι _ t hs order ω h
  rwa [hr] at ht

theorem single_vertex_empty_tree [Subsingleton V] (r : V) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (∅ : Finset E) := by
  have he : ({r} : Set V) = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun v => Subsingleton.elim v r)
  simpa only [he] using G.is_tree_singleton_empty r

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.PrefixTransport

/-! First-hit observables have a realization-independent law, with genuine
nontermination retained. Complete prefixes determine the actual stopped path;
chronological erasure is applied only afterwards. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

private theorem prefix_event (x : V) (n : ℕ) (P : Driver G → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ ω η, walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n → (P ω ↔ P η)) :
    ∃ U : Set (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)), MeasurableSet U ∧
      {ω | P ω} = (fun ω => walkPrefix G x ω n) ⁻¹' U := by
  let U : Set (PrefixRecord (V := V) (E := E)) := {p | ∀ ω, walkPrefix G x ω n = p → P ω}
  refine ⟨U, trivial, ?_⟩
  ext ω
  constructor
  · intro hp η he
    exact (hP ω η he.symm).mp hp
  · intro hu
    exact hu ω rfl

variable [∀ v : V, MeasurableSpace (Incident G v)] [∀ v : V, MeasurableSingletonClass (Incident G v)]
variable (μ ν : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

private theorem prefix_event_measure_eq
    (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (x : V) (n : ℕ) (P : Driver G → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ ω η, walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n → (P ω ↔ P η)) :
    driverLaw G μ {ω | P ω} = driverLaw G ν {ω | P ω} := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, he⟩ := prefix_event G x n P hP
  rw [he, ← Measure.map_apply (measurable_walkPrefix G x n) hU,
    ← Measure.map_apply (measurable_walkPrefix G x n) hU, walkPrefix_law_eq G μ ν h]

private theorem first_hit_event_measure_eq
    (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (B : Set V) (x : V) (P : Driver G → ℕ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ n ω η, walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n → (P ω n ↔ P η n)) :
    driverLaw G μ {ω | ∃ n, firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ P ω n} =
      driverLaw G ν {ω | ∃ n, firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ P ω n} := by
  let A : ℕ → Set (Driver G) := fun n => {ω | firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ P ω n}
  have hm (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (A n) := by
    obtain ⟨U, hU, he⟩ := prefix_event G x n (fun ω => firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ P ω n)
      (fun ω η hh => and_congr (firstHitAt_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq G B x ω η n hh) (hP n ω η hh))
    change MeasurableSet {ω | firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ P ω n}
    rw [he]
    exact (measurable_walkPrefix G x n) hU
  have hd : Pairwise (fun n m => Disjoint (A n) (A m)) := by
    intro n m hnm
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun ω hn hm => hnm (firstHitAt_unique G B x ω hn.1 hm.1))
  have he : {ω : Driver G | ∃ n, firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ P ω n} = ⋃ n, A n := by ext ω; simp [A]
  rw [he, measure_iUnion hd hm, measure_iUnion hd hm]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  exact prefix_event_measure_eq G μ ν h x n _
    (fun ω η hh => and_congr (firstHitAt_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq G B x ω η n hh) (hP n ω η hh))

theorem hits_measure_eq
    (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v)) (B : Set V) (x : V) :
    driverLaw G μ {ω | hits G B x ω} = driverLaw G ν {ω | hits G B x ω} := by
  have he : {ω : Driver G | hits G B x ω} = {ω | ∃ n, firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ True} := by
    ext ω
    constructor
    · intro hh
      exact ⟨Nat.find hh, (firstHitAt_iff_find G B x ω _).mpr ⟨hh, rfl⟩, trivial⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, _⟩
      exact ⟨n, hn.1⟩
  rw [he]
  exact first_hit_event_measure_eq G μ ν h B x (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ _ _ _ => Iff.rfl)

variable {O : Type} [Countable O] [MeasurableSpace O] [MeasurableSingletonClass O]
variable [MeasurableSpace (Option O)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Option O)]

/-- An observable of the actual least hit; none records the absence of a finite hit. -/
def firstHitOutput (B : Set V) (x : V) (f : Driver G → ℕ → O) (ω : Driver G) : Option O :=
  if h : hits G B x ω then some (f ω (Nat.find h)) else none

omit [∀ v : V, MeasurableSpace (Incident G v)] [∀ v : V, MeasurableSingletonClass (Incident G v)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Option O)] in
theorem measurable_firstHitOutput (B : Set V) (x : V) (f : Driver G → ℕ → O)
    (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (fun ω => f ω n)) : Measurable (firstHitOutput G B x f) := by
  letI : MeasurableSpace V := ⊤
  have hs : Measurable (fun ω : {ω : Driver G // hits G B x ω} => f ω.val (Nat.find ω.property)) :=
    Measurable.find (fun n => (hf n).comp measurable_subtype_coe)
      (fun n => ((measurable_position G x n) (show MeasurableSet B from trivial)).preimage measurable_subtype_coe)
      (fun ω => ω.property)
  exact ((measurable_of_countable (some : O → Option O)).comp hs).dite measurable_const (measurableSet_hits G B x)

omit [∀ v : V, MeasurableSpace (Incident G v)] [∀ v : V, MeasurableSingletonClass (Incident G v)] [Countable O] [MeasurableSpace O]
  [MeasurableSingletonClass O] [MeasurableSpace (Option O)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Option O)] in
theorem firstHitOutput_eq_some_iff (B : Set V) (x : V) (f : Driver G → ℕ → O)
    (ω : Driver G) (o : O) :
    firstHitOutput G B x f ω = some o ↔ ∃ n, firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ f ω n = o := by
  unfold firstHitOutput
  split
  · rename_i hh
    constructor
    · intro he
      exact ⟨Nat.find hh, (firstHitAt_iff_find G B x ω _).mpr ⟨hh, rfl⟩, Option.some.inj he⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, he⟩
      obtain ⟨h', hn'⟩ := (firstHitAt_iff_find G B x ω n).mp hn
      simpa only [hn'] using congrArg some he
  · rename_i hh
    constructor
    · intro he; cases he
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, _⟩; exact False.elim (hh ⟨n, hn.1⟩)

theorem firstHitOutput_law_eq
    (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (B : Set V) (x : V) (f : Driver G → ℕ → O) (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (fun ω => f ω n))
    (hfp : ∀ n ω η, walkPrefix G x ω n = walkPrefix G x η n → f ω n = f η n) :
    (driverLaw G μ).map (firstHitOutput G B x f) =
      (driverLaw G ν).map (firstHitOutput G B x f) := by
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro o
  rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_firstHitOutput G B x f hf) (measurableSet_singleton o),
    Measure.map_apply (measurable_firstHitOutput G B x f hf) (measurableSet_singleton o)]
  cases o with
  | some o =>
    have he : firstHitOutput G B x f ⁻¹' {some o} =
        {ω | ∃ n, firstHitAt G B x ω n ∧ f ω n = o} := by
      ext ω; exact firstHitOutput_eq_some_iff G B x f ω o
    rw [he]
    exact first_hit_event_measure_eq G μ ν h B x (fun ω n => f ω n = o)
      (fun n ω η hh => by rw [hfp n ω η hh])
  | none =>
    have he : firstHitOutput G B x f ⁻¹' {none} = {ω | hits G B x ω}ᶜ := by
      ext ω; simp [firstHitOutput]
    rw [he, measure_compl (measurableSet_hits G B x) (measure_ne_top _ _),
      measure_compl (measurableSet_hits G B x) (measure_ne_top _ _), measure_univ, measure_univ,
      hits_measure_eq G μ ν h]

variable {I : Type} [Countable I] (ι : E ↪ I) [Nonempty (Letter G)]

theorem query_law_eq
    (h : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = ν.map (fun a => a v))
    (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) :
    (driverLaw G μ).map (query G ι s x) = (driverLaw G ν).map (query G ι s x) := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s.roots
  · have he : query G ι s x = fun _ => some s := by funext ω; simp only [query, if_pos hx]
    rw [he]
    simp
  · have he : query G ι s x = firstHitOutput G s.roots x (fun ω n => attachAt G ι s x ω n) := by
      funext ω; simp only [query, if_neg hx, firstHitOutput]
    rw [he]
    exact firstHitOutput_law_eq G μ ν h s.roots x _ (measurable_attachAt G ι s x)
      (fun n ω η hh => attachAt_eq_of_walkPrefix_eq G ι s x ω η n hh)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

/-! Independent uniform legal-letter vectors have the same incident-copy
marginals as ordinary unit-copy walks. This is a comparison of observed walk
laws, not an equality with correlated full-letter realizations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E) [Nontrivial V]
variable (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y)
variable [∀ v : V, MeasurableSpace (Incident G v)] [∀ v : V, MeasurableSingletonClass (Incident G v)]

instance uniformLetterLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformLetterLaw G hconn) := by
  unfold uniformLetterLaw
  infer_instance

theorem uniformLetterLaw_eval (v : V) :
    (uniformLetterLaw G hconn).map (fun a => a v) = (unitCopyPMF G hconn v).toMeasure := by
  letI (w : V) : Nonempty (Incident G w) := incident_nonempty G hconn w
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro e
  rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_countable _) (measurableSet_singleton e)]
  let Rest := (w : {w : V // w ≠ v}) → Incident G w.val
  let split : Letter G ≃ Incident G v × Rest := Equiv.piSplitAt v (Incident G)
  let fiber : {a : Letter G // a v = e} ≃ Rest :=
    { toFun := fun a w => a.val w.val
      invFun := fun f => ⟨split.symm (e, f), congrArg Prod.fst (split.apply_symm_apply (e, f))⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro a
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply split.injective
        rw [split.apply_symm_apply]
        apply Prod.ext
        · exact a.property.symm
        · rfl
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        have he := congrArg Prod.snd (split.apply_symm_apply (e, f))
        exact he }
  have hf : Fintype.card {a : Letter G // a v = e} = Fintype.card Rest := Fintype.card_congr fiber
  have hc : Fintype.card (Letter G) = Fintype.card (Incident G v) * Fintype.card Rest := by
    rw [Fintype.card_congr split, Fintype.card_prod]
  have hr : (Fintype.card Rest : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card Rest ≠ 0)
  change (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Letter G)).toMeasure {a | a v = e} = _
  rw [PMF.toMeasure_uniformOfFintype_apply {a : Letter G | a v = e} (show MeasurableSet {a : Letter G | a v = e} from trivial)]
  change (Fintype.card {a : Letter G // a v = e} : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card (Letter G) = _
  rw [hf, hc]
  rw [(unitCopyPMF G hconn v).toMeasure_apply_singleton e (measurableSet_singleton e), unitCopyPMF_apply, Nat.cast_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)) (Or.inl (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))]
  calc
    _ = (Fintype.card (Incident G v) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ *
        ((Fintype.card Rest : ℝ≥0∞) * (Fintype.card Rest : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) := by ac_rfl
    _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)]; exact mul_one _

variable {I : Type} [Countable I] (ι : E ↪ I)
variable (μ : Measure (Letter G)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

/-- The whole history/output law is unchanged by the canonical uniform-letter realization. -/
theorem explorationLaw_eq_uniform_classical
    (hμ : ∀ v : V, μ.map (fun a => a v) = (unitCopyPMF G hconn v).toMeasure)
    (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (order : List V) :
    explorationLaw G ι μ s order =
      (driversLaw G (uniformLetterLaw G hconn)).map (classicalExplore G ι s order) := by
  letI : Nonempty (Letter G) := ⟨fun v => @Classical.ofNonempty _ (incident_nonempty G hconn v)⟩
  rw [explorationLaw_eq_of_incident_marginals G ι μ (uniformLetterLaw G hconn)
    (fun v => (hμ v).trans (uniformLetterLaw_eval G hconn v).symm)]
  exact explorationLaw_eq_classical G ι (uniformLetterLaw G hconn) s order

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
