@[expose] public section

/-! Nonroot ancestors have a real counted outgoing copy, so the reciprocal lies in [0,1]. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem admissibleEdges_nonempty_of_ancestor_ne_root (r : V) (S : Set V)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (u : G.SpanningTree) (hne : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r) :
    (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS)) (G.span u S)).Nonempty := by
  let a := G.ancestorOf u r S hS
  let p := G.ancestorCut r S hS ⟨u, hne⟩
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec u r a hne
  have hC : a ∈ G.descendants u r a := ancestor_refl _ r a
  have hK : a ∈ G.span u S := commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree _ r S hS
  have hc := p.property.2.2.1
  have hadm : G.admissible (G.descendants u r a) (G.span u S) p.val.2 := by
    rcases he.2 with hl | hr
    · have hl' : G.left p.val.2 = a := hl.1
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hl' ▸ hC, hl' ▸ hK⟩, hc.2⟩
      · exact (hc.1 (hl' ▸ hC)).elim
    · have hr' : G.right p.val.2 = a := hr.1
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · exact (hc.2 (hr' ▸ hC)).elim
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hr' ▸ hC, hr' ▸ hK⟩, hc.1⟩
  exact ⟨p.val.2, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hadm⟩⟩

theorem reciprocalWeight_eq_inv_past (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.SpanningTree) (hne : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r) :
    G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u =
      ((G.admissibleEdges (G.past u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) hne) (G.span u S)).card : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  rw [G.past_eq_descendants]
  simp [reciprocalWeight, hne, one_div]

theorem reciprocalWeight_eq_zero_of_ancestor_eq_root (r : V) (S : Set V)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (u : G.SpanningTree) (h : G.ancestorOf u r S hS = r) :
    G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u = 0 := by simp [reciprocalWeight, h]

theorem reciprocalWeight_one_nonneg_le_one (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (u : G.SpanningTree) :
    0 ≤ G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u ∧ G.reciprocalWeight r S hS 1 u ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases h : G.ancestorOf u r S hS ≠ r
  · rw [reciprocalWeight, if_pos h]
    have hc : (1 : ℝ) ≤
        (G.admissibleEdges (G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS)) (G.span u S)).card := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.one_le_card.mpr (G.admissibleEdges_nonempty_of_ancestor_ne_root r S hS u h)
    constructor
    · positivity
    · apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hc)).mpr
      simpa using hc
  · simp [reciprocalWeight, h]

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Joining

/-! Deterministic component-color comparison for actual rooted copied forests.
The edge inclusions are local coupling inputs, not distributional conclusions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- An actual copied forest: acyclic individual copies and exactly one prescribed
root in every component, including isolated vertices. -/
def is_rooted_forest (R : Set V) (F : Finset E) : Prop :=
  G.is_forest F ∧ ∀ x, ∃ r ∈ R, G.reaches F x r ∧
    ∀ r' ∈ R, G.reaches F x r' → r' = r

abbrev RootedForest (R : Set V) := {F : Finset E // G.is_rooted_forest R F}

/-- Vertices connected by selected copies to `C`. On a rooted forest whose
roots contain `C`, these are precisely the vertices of roots labeled one. -/
def oneVertices (F : Finset E) (C : Set V) : Set V :=
  {v | ∃ r ∈ C, G.reaches F v r}

/-- The shared one roots and literal copied-edge inclusion suffice for this
deterministic step; no stochastic domination is assumed or concluded. -/
theorem oneVertices_subset_of_edges_subset (A A' C : Set V)
    (F : G.RootedForest (A ∪ C)) (F' : G.RootedForest (A' ∪ C)) (hF : F'.val ⊆ F.val) :
    G.oneVertices F'.val C ⊆ G.oneVertices F.val C := by
  rintro v ⟨r, hr, hvr⟩
  exact ⟨r, hr, G.reaches_mono hF hvr⟩

/-- Removing one roots reverses the copied-edge inclusion. The original zero
root in an old zero component stays a root of its containing new component. -/
theorem oneVertices_subset_of_one_roots_removed (A C C' : Set V) (hAC : Disjoint A C)
    (hC : C' ⊆ C) (F : G.RootedForest (A ∪ C)) (F' : G.RootedForest (A ∪ C'))
    (hF : F.val ⊆ F'.val) : G.oneVertices F'.val C' ⊆ G.oneVertices F.val C := by
  rintro v ⟨c, hc, hvc⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hvr, _⟩ := F.property.2 v
  rcases hr with hr | hr
  · obtain ⟨a, _, _, hu⟩ := F'.property.2 v
    have hra : r = a := hu r (Or.inl hr) (G.reaches_mono hF hvr)
    have hca : c = a := hu c (Or.inr hc) hvc
    have hrc : r = c := hra.trans hca.symm
    have hrC : r ∈ C := by rw [hrc]; exact hC hc
    exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hAC hr hrC)
  · exact ⟨r, hr, hvr⟩

theorem rootedForest_univ_empty (F : G.RootedForest Set.univ) : F.val = ∅ := by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨r, _, _, hu⟩ := F.property.2 (G.left e)
  have hl : G.left e = r := hu _ (Set.mem_univ _) Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hr : G.right e = r := hu _ (Set.mem_univ _)
    (Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  exact G.loopless e (hl.trans hr.symm)

/-- Parallel copies remain different: the two-copy circuit violates the actual
acyclicity predicate even though its underlying support graph has one edge. -/
theorem parallel_pair_not_rooted_forest (R : Set V) (e f : E) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (hl : G.left e = G.left f) (hr : G.right e = G.right f) :
    ¬G.is_rooted_forest R ({e, f} : Finset E) := by
  intro h
  apply h.1 e (by simp)
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨f, by simp [hef.symm], Or.inl ⟨hl.symm, hr.symm⟩⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-! Unique paths, actual connecting subtrees, and lowest common ancestors in finite trees. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V : Type*} {T : SimpleGraph V} (hT : T.IsTree)

/-- The unique simple path; its existence and uniqueness precede this choice. -/
noncomputable def path (x y : V) : T.Walk x y := (hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose

theorem path_isPath (x y : V) : (path hT x y).IsPath :=
  (hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose_spec.1

theorem path_eq {x y : V} (p : T.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) : path hT x y = p :=
  ((hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose_spec.2 p hp).symm

theorem path_reverse (x y : V) : path hT x y = (path hT y x).reverse :=
  path_eq hT _ (path_isPath hT y x).reverse

theorem path_takeUntil {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT r a = (path hT r x).takeUntil a ha :=
  path_eq hT _ ((path_isPath hT r x).takeUntil ha)

theorem path_dropUntil {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT a x = (path hT r x).dropUntil a ha :=
  path_eq hT _ ((path_isPath hT r x).dropUntil ha)

theorem path_split {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT r x = (path hT r a).append (path hT a x) := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha, path_dropUntil hT ha]
  exact ((path hT r x).take_spec ha).symm

/-- a is on the unique path from the root r to x. -/
def ancestor (r a x : V) : Prop := a ∈ (path hT r x).support

theorem ancestor_refl (r x : V) : ancestor hT r x x := (path hT r x).end_mem_support

theorem ancestor_root (r x : V) : ancestor hT r r x := (path hT r x).start_mem_support

theorem ancestor_trans {r a b x : V} (hab : ancestor hT r a b)
    (hbx : ancestor hT r b x) : ancestor hT r a x := by
  have h := (path hT r x).support_takeUntil_subset_support hbx
  rw [← path_takeUntil hT hbx] at h
  exact h hab

theorem ancestor_length_le {r a x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x) :
    (path hT r a).length ≤ (path hT r x).length := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
  exact (path hT r x).length_takeUntil_le_length ha

theorem ancestor_length_lt {r a x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x) (hne : a ≠ x) :
    (path hT r a).length < (path hT r x).length := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
  exact (path hT r x).length_takeUntil_lt_length ha hne

theorem ancestor_antisymm {r a b : V} (hab : ancestor hT r a b)
    (hba : ancestor hT r b a) : a = b := by
  by_contra hne
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (ancestor_length_le hT hba)) (ancestor_length_lt hT hab hne)

theorem ancestor_of_length_le {r a b x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hb : ancestor hT r b x) (hle : (path hT r a).length ≤ (path hT r b).length) :
    ancestor hT r a b := by
  have hget := (path hT r x).getVert_takeUntil hb
    (show (path hT r a).length ≤ ((path hT r x).takeUntil b hb).length by
      rwa [← path_takeUntil hT hb])
  have haeq : (path hT r x).getVert (path hT r a).length = a := by
    rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
    exact (path hT r x).getVert_length_takeUntil ha
  unfold ancestor
  rw [path_takeUntil hT hb]
  rw [← haeq, ← hget]
  exact ((path hT r x).takeUntil b hb).getVert_mem_support _

theorem ancestor_comparable {r a b x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hb : ancestor hT r b x) : ancestor hT r a b ∨ ancestor hT r b a := by
  rcases le_total (path hT r a).length (path hT r b).length with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (ancestor_of_length_le hT ha hb h)
  · exact Or.inr (ancestor_of_length_le hT hb ha h)

/-- The lowest common ancestor, characterized entirely by actual rooted paths. -/
def is_common_ancestor (r : V) (S : Set V) (a : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) ∧
    ∀ b, (∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r b x) → ancestor hT r b a

theorem existsUnique_common_ancestor [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃! a, is_common_ancestor hT r S a := by
  let A : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter fun a => ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x
  have hA : A.Nonempty := ⟨r, by simp [A, ancestor_root]⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmax⟩ := A.exists_max_image (fun a => (path hT r a).length) hA
  have hac : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  have hca : is_common_ancestor hT r S a := by
    refine ⟨hac, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    exact ancestor_of_length_le hT (hb x hx) (hac x hx) (hmax b (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb⟩))
  refine ⟨a, hca, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  exact ancestor_antisymm hT (hca.2 b hb.1) (hb.2 a hac)

/-- The unique lowest common ancestor; no root or ancestor witness is supplied as input. -/
noncomputable def commonAncestor [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) : V :=
  (existsUnique_common_ancestor hT r S hS).choose

theorem commonAncestor_spec [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    is_common_ancestor hT r S (commonAncestor hT r S hS) :=
  (existsUnique_common_ancestor hT r S hS).choose_spec.1

/-- The actual connecting subtree: the union of unique paths between marked vertices. -/
def connectingSubtree (S : Set V) : Set V :=
  {a | ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, a ∈ (path hT x y).support}

theorem subset_connectingSubtree (S : Set V) : S ⊆ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨x, hx, x, hx, (path hT x x).start_mem_support⟩

theorem path_subset_union (x y a : V) :
    ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ (path hT x y).support →
      z ∈ (path hT x a).support ∨ z ∈ (path hT a y).support := by
  let w := (path hT x a).append (path hT a y)
  have he := path_eq hT w.toPath.val w.toPath.property
  rw [he]
  intro z hz
  have hz' := w.support_toPath_subset_support hz
  simpa only [w, SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff] using hz'

theorem ancestor_on_suffix {r a x z : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hz : z ∈ (path hT a x).support) : ancestor hT r a z := by
  have hsplit := path_split hT ha
  have hzx : ancestor hT r z x := by
    unfold ancestor
    rw [hsplit]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hz
  rcases ancestor_comparable hT ha hzx with h | h
  · exact h
  · by_cases hza : z = a
    · subst z; exact ancestor_refl hT r a
    · have hp : ((path hT r a).append (path hT a x)).IsPath :=
        hsplit ▸ path_isPath hT r x
      exact (hp.ne_of_mem_support_of_append hza h hz rfl).elim

theorem connectingSubtree_subset_descendants (r : V) (S : Set V) {a : V}
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) :
    connectingSubtree hT S ⊆ {z | ancestor hT r a z} := by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
  rcases path_subset_union hT x y a hz with hz | hz
  · have hz' : z ∈ (path hT a x).support := by
      rw [path_reverse hT x a, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at hz
      exact List.mem_reverse.mp hz
    exact ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha x hx) hz'
  · exact ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha y hy) hz

/-- Path convexity is the connected-subtree condition in a tree. -/
def is_path_convex (C : Set V) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ (path hT x y).support, z ∈ C

theorem connectingSubtree_minimal (S C : Set V) (hC : is_path_convex hT C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    connectingSubtree hT S ⊆ C := by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
  exact hC x (hSC hx) y (hSC hy) z hz

theorem path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree {S : Set V} {b x : V} (hb : b ∈ S)
    (hx : x ∈ connectingSubtree hT S) :
    ∀ z ∈ (path hT b x).support, z ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hxuv⟩ := hx
  have hcase := path_subset_union hT u v b hxuv
  have hx' : (∃ y ∈ S, x ∈ (path hT b y).support) := by
    rcases hcase with h | h
    · refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      rw [path_reverse hT u b, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at h
      exact List.mem_reverse.mp h
    · exact ⟨v, hv, h⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx'
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z ∈ (path hT b y).support := by
    rw [path_takeUntil hT hxy] at hz
    exact (path hT b y).support_takeUntil_subset_support hxy hz
  exact ⟨b, hb, y, hy, hz'⟩

theorem connectingSubtree_convex (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    is_path_convex hT (connectingSubtree hT S) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hS
  intro x hx y hy z hz
  rcases path_subset_union hT x y b hz with h | h
  · rw [path_reverse hT x b, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at h
    exact path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree hT hb hx z (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  · exact path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree hT hb hy z h

theorem connectingSubtree_connected (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (T.induce (connectingSubtree hT S)).Connected := by
  have hconv := connectingSubtree_convex hT S hS
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  letI : Nonempty (connectingSubtree hT S) := ⟨⟨x, subset_connectingSubtree hT S hx⟩⟩
  refine SimpleGraph.Connected.mk ?_
  intro x y
  exact ⟨((path hT x.val y.val).induce (connectingSubtree hT S)
    (fun z hz => hconv
      x.val x.property y.val y.property z hz)).copy (Subtype.ext rfl) (Subtype.ext rfl)⟩

theorem common_ancestor_mem_connectingSubtree {r : V} {S : Set V} (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {a : V} (ha : is_common_ancestor hT r S a) : a ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  have hax : a ≠ x := fun h => hnot (h ▸ subset_connectingSubtree hT S hx)
  obtain ⟨b, hab, q, hp⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hax (path hT a x)
  have hq : q.IsPath ∧ a ∉ q.support := by
    have h := path_isPath hT a x
    rw [hp, SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at h
    exact h
  have hba : b ∈ (path hT a x).support := by
    rw [hp]
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ q.start_mem_support
  have hab' := ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha.1 x hx) hba
  have hbcommon : ∀ y ∈ S, ancestor hT r b y := by
    intro y hy
    let w := q.append (path hT x y)
    have haw : a ∉ w.support := by
      intro h
      rcases (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff _ _).mp h with h | h
      · exact hq.2 h
      · exact hnot ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h⟩
    have han : a ∉ w.toPath.val.support :=
      fun h => haw (w.support_toPath_subset_support h)
    have hpy : path hT a y = SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab w.toPath.val :=
      path_eq hT _ (w.toPath.property.cons han)
    have hby : b ∈ (path hT a y).support := by
      rw [hpy]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ w.toPath.val.start_mem_support
    unfold ancestor
    rw [path_split hT (ha.1 y hy)]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hby
  exact hab.ne (ancestor_antisymm hT hab' (ha.2 b hbcommon))

theorem commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    commonAncestor hT r S hS ∈ connectingSubtree hT S :=
  common_ancestor_mem_connectingSubtree hT hS (commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS)

/-- A common ancestor equals the lowest common ancestor exactly when it lies in the
actual minimal connecting subtree; no arbitrary joining set is supplied. -/
theorem commonAncestor_eq_iff_mem_connectingSubtree [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {a : V} (ha : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) :
    commonAncestor hT r S hS = a ↔ a ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h ▸ commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree hT r S hS
  · intro h
    have hc := commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS
    exact ancestor_antisymm hT
      (connectingSubtree_subset_descendants hT r S hc.1 h) (hc.2 a ha)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.LoopErasure
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Joining
import Mathlib.Probability.Independence.InfinitePi
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform

/-! Wilson exploration on individual copies of a finite loopless multigraph.
The walk continues by legal ordinary transitions at every vertex. Only first-hit
paths are attached, and complete paths remain separate from erased branches. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open Quiver MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

abbrev Incident (v : V) := {e : E // G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v}
abbrev Letter := (v : V) → Incident G v
abbrev Driver := ℕ → Letter G

instance incidentFintype (v : V) : Fintype (Incident G v) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype {e : E // G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v})
instance letterFintype : Fintype (Letter G) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype ((v : V) → Incident G v))
instance letterMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (Letter G) := ⊤
instance letterMeasurableSingletonClass : MeasurableSingletonClass (Letter G) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

def other (v : V) (e : Incident G v) : V :=
  if G.left e.val = v then G.right e.val else G.left e.val

theorem other_spec (v : V) (e : Incident G v) :
    (G.left e.val = v ∧ G.right e.val = other G v e) ∨
      (G.right e.val = v ∧ G.left e.val = other G v e) := by
  by_cases h : G.left e.val = v
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h, by simp [other, h]⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨e.property.resolve_left h, by simp [other, h]⟩

abbrev pathQuiver : Quiver (ULift.{0} V) :=
  copiedQuiver (fun e : E => (ULift.up (G.left e), ULift.up (G.right e)))
abbrev Trace (a b : V) := @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up a) (ULift.up b)

def arrow (v : V) (a : Letter G) :
    @Quiver.Hom (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up v) (ULift.up (other G v (a v))) :=
  ⟨(a v).val, by
    rcases other_spec G v (a v) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.1) (congrArg ULift.up h.2))
    · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.2) (congrArg ULift.up h.1))⟩

def position (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : ℕ → V
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => other G (position x ω n) (ω n (position x ω n))

def walkPath (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : (n : ℕ) → Trace G x (position G x ω n) :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun n => match n with
  | 0 => .nil
  | n + 1 => (walkPath x ω n).cons (arrow G (position G x ω n) (ω n))

def packedPath (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : Σ b : V, Trace G x b :=
  ⟨position G x ω n, walkPath G x ω n⟩

def pathCopies {a : ULift.{0} V} : {b : ULift.{0} V} → @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) a b → Finset E :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun p => match p with
  | .nil => ∅
  | .cons p e => insert e.val (pathCopies p)

def pathCopyList {a : ULift.{0} V} : {b : ULift.{0} V} → @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) a b → List E :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun p => match p with
  | .nil => []
  | .cons p e => pathCopyList p ++ [e.val]

variable {I : Type}

abbrev Record := V × List V × List I
structure State where
  roots : Set V
  roots_nonempty : roots.Nonempty
  edges : Finset E
  history : List (Record (V := V) (I := I))

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
@[ext] theorem State.ext {s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)}
    (hr : s.roots = t.roots) (he : s.edges = t.edges) (hh : s.history = t.history) : s = t := by
  cases s; cases t; cases hr; cases he; cases hh; rfl

abbrev Roots := {R : Set V // R.Nonempty}

def initialState (R : Roots (V := V)) : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  ⟨R.val, R.property, ∅, []⟩

def hits (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : Prop := ∃ n, position G x ω n ∈ B

def attachAt (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  let p := packedPath G x ω n
  { roots := s.roots ∪ {v | ULift.up v ∈ (loopErase p.2).vertices}
    roots_nonempty := s.roots_nonempty.mono Set.subset_union_left
    edges := s.edges ∪ pathCopies G (loopErase p.2)
    history := s.history ++ [(x, p.2.vertices.map ULift.down, (pathCopyList G p.2).map ι)] }

def query (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :=
  if x ∈ s.roots then some s
  else if h : hits G s.roots x ω then some (attachAt G ι s x ω (Nat.find h)) else none

/-- Skips and repeated queries consume their own row, just as successful queries do. -/
def explore (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :
    List V → (ℕ → Driver G) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
  | [], _ => some s
  | x :: xs, ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0)).bind (fun t => explore ι t xs (fun i => ω (i + 1)))

/-- No walk alphabet or probability kernel is formed in the all-root case. -/
def allRootResult [Nonempty V] : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  initialState ⟨Set.univ, by obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›; exact ⟨v, Set.mem_univ v⟩⟩

theorem explore_all_roots (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (hs : s.roots = Set.univ)
    (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) : explore G ι s order ω = some s := by
  induction order generalizing ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ∈ s.roots := hs ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [explore, query, if_pos hx, Option.bind_some]
    exact ih _

theorem incident_nonempty [Nontrivial V]
    (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (v : V) : Nonempty (Incident G v) := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne v
  rcases (hconn v w).cases_head with he | ⟨z, hz, _⟩
  · exact False.elim (hw he.symm)
  · obtain ⟨e, _, h | h⟩ := hz
    · exact ⟨⟨e, Or.inl h.1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨e, Or.inr h.1⟩⟩

/-- Each vertex receives an independent uniform incident-copy choice. Existence is
proved from connectedness and nontriviality before forming the uniform PMF. -/
def uniformLetterLaw [Nontrivial V] (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) : Measure (Letter G) := by
  letI (v : V) : Nonempty (Incident G v) := incident_nonempty G hconn v
  exact (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Letter G)).toMeasure

/-- IID rows of IID legal letters. The letter law is explicit data; it is not a tree law. -/
def driversLaw (μ : Measure (Letter G)) : Measure (ℕ → Driver G) :=
  Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Topology
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw

/-! Literal two-color rooted lattice forests. All vertices and all unordered
nearest-neighbor edges are retained. No probability law is selected. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The source's two disjoint nonempty sets, retaining every root separately. -/
structure RootPair where
  zero : Set (Site 2)
  one : Set (Site 2)
  disjoint : Disjoint zero one
  zero_nonempty : zero.Nonempty
  one_nonempty : one.Nonempty

abbrev ColorField := Site 2 → Bool
abbrev ForestField := EdgeField × ColorField

/-- Acyclic on all sites, with exactly one original root in each component. -/
def is_rooted_forest (R : RootPair) (f : EdgeField) : Prop :=
  (toGraph f).IsAcyclic ∧ ∀ x, ∃ r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one,
    (toGraph f).Reachable x r ∧
      ∀ r' ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one, (toGraph f).Reachable x r' → r' = r

abbrev RootedForest (R : RootPair) := {f : EdgeField // is_rooted_forest R f}

def oneVertices (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : Set (Site 2) :=
  {x | ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r}

theorem reachable_roots_eq (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R)
    {x r s : Site 2} (hr : r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one) (hs : s ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one)
    (hxr : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r) (hxs : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x s) : r = s := by
  obtain ⟨u, _, _, hu⟩ := f.property.2 x
  exact (hu r hr hxr).trans (hu s hs hxs).symm

/-- Component root colors, defined by literal reachability, without choosing a root. -/
def colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : ColorField :=
  fun x => decide (x ∈ oneVertices R f)

theorem colors_eq_true_iff (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (x : Site 2) :
    colors R f x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r := by
  simp only [colors, decide_eq_true_eq, oneVertices, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

theorem colors_of_one_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.one) : colors R f x = true :=
  (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mpr ⟨x, hx, .refl x⟩

theorem colors_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.zero) : colors R f x = false := by
  have hn : ¬colors R f x = true := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mp h
    have he := reachable_roots_eq R f (Or.inl hx) (Or.inr hr) (.refl x) hxr
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint hx (he.symm ▸ hr)
  cases h : colors R f x <;> simp_all

/-- Raw full product carrier; valid fields have precisely the original component colors. -/
def is_colored_forest (R : RootPair) (ω : ForestField) : Prop :=
  is_rooted_forest R ω.1 ∧ ∀ x,
    ω.2 x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph ω.1).Reachable x r

theorem colored_iff_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (σ : ColorField) :
    is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) ↔ σ = colors R f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext x
    have he := (h.2 x).trans (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).symm
    cases hσ : σ x <;> cases hf : colors R f x <;> simp_all
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨f.property, colors_eq_true_iff R f⟩

theorem existsUnique_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) :
    ∃! σ : ColorField, is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) :=
  ⟨colors R f, (colored_iff_colors R f _).mpr rfl,
    fun σ hσ => (colored_iff_colors R f σ).mp hσ⟩

def colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) : Set ColorField :=
  {σ | F.restrict σ = p}

theorem isClopen_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    IsClopen (colorCylinder F p) :=
  (isClopen_discrete {p}).preimage (continuous_pi (fun x => continuous_apply x.val))

theorem measurableSet_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (colorCylinder F p) := (isClopen_colorCylinder F p).isClosed.measurableSet

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.SimpleWalk

/-! Literal first hitting times with top for a genuinely infinite avoiding path.
Their comparison agrees with the ordered source event, including time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def firstHit (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) : WithTop ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U then (Nat.find h : WithTop ℕ) else ⊤

theorem firstHit_eq_top_iff (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) :
    firstHit U p = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n, p n ∉ U := by
  by_cases h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U
  · simp [firstHit, h]
  · have hn : ∀ n, p n ∉ U := fun n hm => h ⟨n, hm⟩
    simp only [firstHit, dif_neg h, eq_self, true_iff]
    exact hn

theorem firstHit_eq_zero_iff (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) :
    firstHit U p = 0 ↔ p 0 ∈ U := by
  by_cases h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U
  · rw [firstHit, dif_pos h]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.find_eq_zero h)
  · simp only [firstHit, dif_neg h, WithTop.top_ne_zero, false_iff]
    exact fun hp => h ⟨0, hp⟩

theorem hitBefore_iff_firstHit_lt (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) :
    d ∈ hitBefore A C x ↔ firstHit C (position x d) < firstHit A (position x d) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    have hC : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ C := ⟨n, hnC⟩
    by_cases hA : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ A
    · have hna : n < Nat.find hA := by
        by_contra h
        exact hnA (Nat.find hA) (Nat.le_of_not_gt h) (Nat.find_spec hA)
      have hl := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.find_min' hC hnC) hna
      simp only [firstHit, dif_pos hC, dif_pos hA]
      exact_mod_cast hl
    · simp [firstHit, hC, hA]
  · intro h
    have hC : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ C := by
      by_contra hC
      simp only [firstHit, dif_neg hC, not_top_lt] at h
    refine ⟨Nat.find hC, Nat.find_spec hC, ?_⟩
    intro m hm hmA
    have hA : ∃ n, position x d n ∈ A := ⟨m, hmA⟩
    have hl : Nat.find hC < Nat.find hA := by
      simp only [firstHit, dif_pos hC, dif_pos hA] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    have ha := Nat.find_min' hA hmA
    omega

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space

/-! Literal finite walks (including zero edges) and genuinely infinite walks/rays.
No finite list represents an infinite path or a failed stopping time. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb

structure FiniteWalk where
  length : ℕ
  vertex : Fin (length + 1) → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ i : Fin length, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex i.castSucc) (vertex i.succ)

structure InfiniteWalk where
  vertex : ℕ → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ n, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex n) (vertex (n + 1))

structure SimpleRay extends InfiniteWalk where
  injective : Function.Injective vertex

def FiniteWalk.start (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex 0
def FiniteWalk.finish (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex ⟨p.length, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
def FiniteWalk.vertices (p : FiniteWalk) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range p.vertex

def zeroWalk (x : Site 2) : FiniteWalk :=
  ⟨0, fun _ => x, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩

theorem zeroWalk_length (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).length = 0 := rfl
theorem zeroWalk_vertices (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).vertices = {x} := by
  ext y
  simp [FiniteWalk.vertices, zeroWalk]

/-- A stopped trace retains its complete finite word, or its genuinely infinite word. -/
inductive StoppedTrace (B : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) where
  | hit (walk : FiniteWalk) (start : walk.start = x) (finish : walk.finish ∈ B)
      (first : ∀ i : Fin walk.length, walk.vertex i.castSucc ∉ B)
  | escape (walk : InfiniteWalk) (start : walk.vertex 0 = x)
      (avoids : ∀ n, walk.vertex n ∉ B)

def SimpleRay.vertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range γ.vertex
def SimpleRay.tailVertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) :=
  Set.range (fun n => γ.vertex (n + 1))

theorem SimpleRay.vertices_infinite (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertices.Infinite :=
  Set.infinite_range_of_injective γ.injective

theorem SimpleRay.tail_nonempty (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.tailVertices.Nonempty :=
  ⟨γ.vertex 1, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩

theorem SimpleRay.start_not_mem_tail (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertex 0 ∉ γ.tailVertices := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have he := γ.injective hn
  omega

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.HittingTimes
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.WiredForestLaw

/-! Literal finite-query recurrent Wilson sampler. Partial colors retain unknown
values; complete stopped walks and their chronological erasures are distinguished. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The actual first T steps, including both endpoints and all nearest-neighbor steps. -/
def dirWalkFinite (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) : FiniteWalk where
  length := T
  vertex i := position x w i.val
  adjacent i := by simpa using position_adjacent x w i.val

/-- A least genuine hit, or none exactly when the complete infinite word avoids S. -/
def hitTime (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) : Option ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ n, position x w n ∈ S then some (Nat.find h) else none

theorem hitTime_eq_some_iff (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) :
    hitTime S x w = some T ↔ position x w T ∈ S ∧ ∀ n < T, position x w n ∉ S := by
  unfold hitTime
  by_cases h : ∃ n, position x w n ∈ S
  · rw [dif_pos h, Option.some.injEq]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Nat.find_spec h, fun n hn => Nat.find_min h hn⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact le_antisymm (Nat.find_min' h h1)
        (not_lt.mp fun hlt => h2 _ hlt (Nat.find_spec h))
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    constructor
    · intro hh; cases hh
    · rintro ⟨h1, _⟩
      exact (h ⟨T, h1⟩).elim

theorem hitTime_eq_none_iff (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) :
    hitTime S x w = none ↔ ∀ n, position x w n ∉ S := by
  unfold hitTime
  by_cases h : ∃ n, position x w n ∈ S
  · rw [dif_pos h]
    constructor
    · intro hh; cases hh
    · intro hn
      obtain ⟨n, hm⟩ := h
      exact (hn n hm).elim
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    exact ⟨fun _ n hn => h ⟨n, hn⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- Non-stopping retains its actual infinite walk, not a finite surrogate or default. -/
def stoppedTrace (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) : StoppedTrace S x :=
  match h : hitTime S x w with
  | some T => StoppedTrace.hit (dirWalkFinite x w T)
      (by simp [FiniteWalk.start, dirWalkFinite])
      ((hitTime_eq_some_iff S x w T).mp h).1
      (fun i => ((hitTime_eq_some_iff S x w T).mp h).2 i.val i.isLt)
  | none => StoppedTrace.escape (driverWalk x w) rfl ((hitTime_eq_none_iff S x w).mp h)

/-- Online chronological erasure: truncate at a revisited vertex, append a new one. -/
def eraseStep (acc : List (Site 2)) (v : Site 2) : List (Site 2) :=
  acc.takeWhile (fun u => decide (u ≠ v)) ++ [v]

/-- Chronological erasure of the COMPLETE stopped word X_0,...,X_T. -/
def walkErase (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) : List (Site 2) :=
  (List.range (T + 1)).foldl (fun acc n => eraseStep acc (position x w n)) []

/-- Consecutive unordered pairs. Actual NN walks give actual lattice branch edges. -/
def branchEdges (path : List (Site 2)) : Finset (Sym2 (Site 2)) :=
  ((path.zip path.tail).map fun p => s(p.1, p.2)).toFinset

/-- Partial colors and complete stopped histories. An unrevealed site has NO color. -/
structure SamplerState where
  colors : Site 2 → Option Bool
  edges : Finset (Sym2 (Site 2))
  history : List FiniteWalk

/-- Only the prescribed roots are colored initially, with their original colors. -/
def initialSampler (R : RootPair) : SamplerState where
  colors x := if x ∈ R.zero then some false else if x ∈ R.one then some true else none
  edges := ∅
  history := []

def SamplerState.covered (st : SamplerState) : Set (Site 2) :=
  {x | st.colors x ≠ none}

/-- A covered start consumes its row and changes nothing. A fresh start runs to the
FIRST actual hit and colors only the retained branch, excluding its old endpoint. -/
def samplerStep (st : SamplerState) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) : Option SamplerState :=
  if x ∈ st.covered then some st
  else match hitTime st.covered x w with
  | none => none
  | some T =>
    let branch := walkErase x w T
    some { colors := fun v => if v ∈ branch.dropLast then st.colors (position x w T) else st.colors v
           edges := st.edges ∪ branchEdges branch
           history := st.history ++ [dirWalkFinite x w T] }

/-- One independent row per slot, including repeated and already covered queries. -/
def samplerRun : SamplerState → List (Site 2) → (ℕ → WalkDriver) → Option SamplerState
  | st, [], _ => some st
  | st, x :: xs, ω => (samplerStep st x (ω 0)).bind fun st' =>
      samplerRun st' xs (fun i => ω (i + 1))

/-- Every row is an actual iid uniform four-direction infinite simple random walk. -/
def wilsonRows : Measure (ℕ → WalkDriver) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => walkLaw)
instance wilsonRows_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure wilsonRows := by
  unfold wilsonRows
  infer_instance

theorem samplerRun_of_covered (st : SamplerState) (L : List (Site 2))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ st.covered) (ω : ℕ → WalkDriver) : samplerRun st L ω = some st := by
  induction L generalizing ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ∈ st.covered := h x (by simp)
    simp only [samplerRun, samplerStep, if_pos hx, Option.bind_some]
    exact ih (fun y hy => h y (by simp [hy])) _

/-- The complete finite JOINT pattern, including absent as well as present edges. -/
def jointEvent (B : Finset LatticeEdge) (D : Finset (Site 2))
    (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool) : Set ForestField :=
  {ω | (∀ e ∈ B, ω.1 e = pe e) ∧ ∀ d ∈ D, ω.2 d = pc d}

/-- The same full joint query of a genuinely successful finite Wilson run.
Unknown colors do not satisfy either Boolean observation. -/
def samplerEvent (R : RootPair) (L : List (Site 2)) (B : Finset LatticeEdge)
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool) :
    Set (ℕ → WalkDriver) :=
  {ξ | ∃ st, samplerRun (initialSampler R) L ξ = some st ∧
    (∀ e ∈ B, decide (e.val ∈ st.edges) = pe e) ∧
    ∀ d ∈ D, st.colors d = some (pc d)}

/-- Every finite original lattice edge/color pattern is characterized JOINTLY.
Coverage says precisely that the observed sites and edge endpoints were queried. -/
def IsWilsonLaw (R : RootPair) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure ForestField) : Prop :=
  (∀ᵐ ω ∂(ν : Measure ForestField), is_colored_forest R ω) ∧
  ∀ (L : List (Site 2)) (B : Finset LatticeEdge) (D : Finset (Site 2))
    (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool),
    (∀ e ∈ B, ∀ x ∈ e.val, x ∈ L) → (∀ d ∈ D, d ∈ L) →
    (ν : Measure ForestField) (jointEvent B D pe pc) =
      wilsonRows (samplerEvent R L B D pe pc)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.Sampler

/-! Every successful finite Wilson exploration is locally constant in its actual
walk increments. Thus its full history and every finite joint observation are
measurable before any law is selected or any recurrence input is trusted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem continuous_position (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun w : WalkDriver => position x w n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact continuous_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ih.add ((continuous_of_discreteTopology (f := FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired.step)).comp
      (continuous_apply n))

theorem samplerStep_eq_of_positions (st : SamplerState) (x : Site 2)
    (w w' : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) (hT : hitTime st.covered x w = some T)
    (hp : ∀ n ≤ T, position x w' n = position x w n) :
    samplerStep st x w' = samplerStep st x w := by
  have hT' : hitTime st.covered x w' = some T := by
    apply (hitTime_eq_some_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    obtain ⟨hh, hf⟩ := (hitTime_eq_some_iff _ _ _ _).mp hT
    exact ⟨by rwa [hp T le_rfl], fun n hn => by
      rw [hp n (Nat.le_of_lt hn)]; exact hf n hn⟩
  have he : walkErase x w' T = walkErase x w T := by
    have hm : (List.range (T + 1)).map (position x w') =
        (List.range (T + 1)).map (position x w) :=
      List.map_congr_left (fun n hn => hp n (by
        have hn' : n < T + 1 := List.mem_range.mp hn
        omega))
    calc
      walkErase x w' T = ((List.range (T + 1)).map (position x w')).foldl eraseStep [] :=
        List.foldl_map.symm
      _ = ((List.range (T + 1)).map (position x w)).foldl eraseStep [] :=
        congrArg (fun l => l.foldl eraseStep []) hm
      _ = walkErase x w T := List.foldl_map
  have hw : dirWalkFinite x w' T = dirWalkFinite x w T := by
    unfold dirWalkFinite
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact hp i.val (by omega)
  simp only [samplerStep, hT, hT', he, hp T le_rfl, hw]

/-- No assumptions on termination: a given actual success has an open neighborhood
of drivers producing exactly the same complete state. -/
theorem samplerStep_eventually_eq_of_some (st out : SamplerState) (x : Site 2)
    (w : WalkDriver) (h : samplerStep st x w = some out) :
    ∀ᶠ w' in nhds w, samplerStep st x w' = some out := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ st.covered
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => by simpa [samplerStep, hx] using h)
  · cases hT : hitTime st.covered x w with
    | none => simp [samplerStep, hx, hT] at h
    | some T =>
      have hp : ∀ᶠ w' in nhds w, ∀ n : Fin (T + 1),
          position x w' n.val = position x w n.val :=
        eventually_all.mpr (fun n =>
          (continuous_position x n.val).continuousAt.eventually_mem
            ((isOpen_discrete ({position x w n.val} : Set (Site 2))).mem_nhds
              (Set.mem_singleton _)))
      filter_upwards [hp] with w' hw'
      exact (samplerStep_eq_of_positions st x w w' T hT
        (fun n hn => hw' ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn⟩)).trans h

/-- Repeated/covered queries and full stopped histories are retained exactly. -/
theorem samplerRun_eventually_eq_of_some (st out : SamplerState)
    (L : List (Site 2)) (ξ : ℕ → WalkDriver) (h : samplerRun st L ξ = some out) :
    ∀ᶠ ξ' in nhds ξ, samplerRun st L ξ' = some out := by
  induction L generalizing st out ξ with
  | nil => exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => h)
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases hs : samplerStep st x (ξ 0) with
    | none => simp [samplerRun, hs] at h
    | some mid =>
      have ht : samplerRun mid xs (fun i => ξ (i + 1)) = some out := by
        simpa only [samplerRun, hs, Option.bind_some] using h
      have hhead := (continuous_apply 0 : Continuous (fun ζ : ℕ → WalkDriver => ζ 0)).continuousAt.eventually (samplerStep_eventually_eq_of_some st mid x (ξ 0) hs)
      have htail := (continuous_pi (fun i => continuous_apply (i + 1)) :
        Continuous (fun ζ : ℕ → WalkDriver => fun i => ζ (i + 1))).continuousAt.eventually
          (ih mid out (fun i => ξ (i + 1)) ht)
      filter_upwards [hhead, htail] with ξ' hh ht'
      simpa only [samplerRun, hh, Option.bind_some] using ht'

theorem isOpen_samplerEvent (R : RootPair) (L : List (Site 2)) (B : Finset LatticeEdge)
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool) :
    IsOpen (samplerEvent R L B D pe pc) := by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  rintro ξ ⟨st, hs, hb, hd⟩
  filter_upwards [samplerRun_eventually_eq_of_some _ st L ξ hs] with ξ' h'
  exact ⟨st, h', hb, hd⟩

theorem isOpen_sampler_success (st : SamplerState) (L : List (Site 2)) :
    IsOpen {ξ : ℕ → WalkDriver | ∃ out, samplerRun st L ξ = some out} := by
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  rintro ξ ⟨out, h⟩
  filter_upwards [samplerRun_eventually_eq_of_some st out L ξ h] with ξ' h'
  exact ⟨out, h'⟩

theorem measurableSet_samplerEvent (R : RootPair) (L : List (Site 2))
    (B : Finset LatticeEdge) (D : Finset (Site 2))
    (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (samplerEvent R L B D pe pc) :=
  (isOpen_samplerEvent R L B D pe pc).measurableSet

theorem measurableSet_sampler_success (st : SamplerState) (L : List (Site 2)) :
    MeasurableSet {ξ : ℕ → WalkDriver | ∃ out, samplerRun st L ξ = some out} :=
  (isOpen_sampler_success st L).measurableSet

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.ColoredForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.Paths
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw
import Mathlib.Probability.ProductMeasure

/-! Literal simple random walk drivers and ordered hitting events. Independent
uniform choices of the four actual lattice directions, including hitting at time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

abbrev WalkDriver := ℕ → FiniteWired.Direction

def directionLaw : Measure FiniteWired.Direction :=
  FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction

instance directionLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure directionLaw :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction))

def walkLaw : Measure WalkDriver := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => directionLaw)
instance walkLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure walkLaw := by
  unfold walkLaw
  infer_instance

def position (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : ℕ → Site 2
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n)

@[simp] theorem position_zero (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : position x d 0 = x := rfl
@[simp] theorem position_succ (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n) := rfl

theorem position_adjacent (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    (lattice 2).Adj (position x d n) (position x d (n + 1)) := by
  change ∃ i, position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + unit i ∨
    position x d n = position x d (n + 1) + unit i
  refine ⟨(d n).1, ?_⟩
  cases h : (d n).2
  · right
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp
  · left
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp

def driverWalk (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : InfiniteWalk :=
  ⟨position x d, position_adjacent x d⟩

/-- tau_C < tau_A: some C visit precedes every A visit, including time zero. -/
def hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) : Set WalkDriver :=
  {d | ∃ n, position x d n ∈ C ∧ ∀ m ≤ n, position x d m ∉ A}

theorem measurable_position (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun d => position x d n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ih.add ((measurable_of_countable FiniteWired.step).comp (measurable_pi_apply n))

theorem measurableSet_hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    MeasurableSet (hitBefore A C x) := by
  have hC (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∈ C} :=
    (measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable C).measurableSet
  have hA (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∉ A} :=
    ((measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable A).measurableSet).compl
  simp only [hitBefore, Set.setOf_exists, Set.setOf_and, Set.setOf_forall]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n => (hC n).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter (fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ => hA m))))

theorem hitBefore_of_one_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.one) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = Set.univ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  refine ⟨0, hx, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  have he : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm
  subst m
  exact fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint h hx

theorem hitBefore_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.zero) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = ∅ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  rintro ⟨n, _, hn⟩
  exact hn 0 (Nat.zero_le n) hx

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.ColoredForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Equivalence
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Existence

/-! Actual uniform original-copy rooted forests in wired boxes, and their full
ambient indicator/color projections. The exterior is the actual one-colored sink.
No infinite measure is selected. The safe quotient input is ordinary proved infrastructure. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

/-- Original roots remain distinct; the wired exterior is an additional one root. -/
def wiredZero (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N)
  | none => False
  | some x => FiniteWired.site x ∈ R.zero

def wiredOne (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N)
  | none => True
  | some x => FiniteWired.site x ∈ R.one

theorem wired_roots_disjoint (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Disjoint (wiredZero R N) (wiredOne R N) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hz ho
  cases v with
  | none => exact hz
  | some x => exact Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint hz ho

def wiredRoots (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) :
    CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := FiniteWired.Vertex N) :=
  ⟨wiredZero R N ∪ wiredOne R N, ⟨none, Or.inr trivial⟩⟩

abbrev FiniteForest (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) := (WiredTrees.graph N).RootedForest (wiredRoots R N).val

/-- Existence from an actual connected quotient spanning tree, before any law. -/
theorem finiteForest_nonempty (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (FiniteForest R N) := by
  have hc : ∀ x y, (WiredTrees.graph N).reaches Finset.univ x y := by
    intro x y
    exact (WiredTrees.graph N).reaches_mono (Finset.subset_univ _)
      ((WiredTrees.rowTree N).property.2.2.1 x (Set.mem_univ x) y (Set.mem_univ y))
  have hq := FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient.graph_connected (WiredTrees.graph N) (wiredRoots R N) hc
  have hn := (FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient.graph (WiredTrees.graph N) (wiredRoots R N)).nonempty_spanning_tree hq
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := hn
  exact ⟨(FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient.rootContractionEquiv (WiredTrees.graph N) (wiredRoots R N)).symm t⟩

instance finiteForestNonempty (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (FiniteForest R N) :=
  finiteForest_nonempty R N

instance finiteForestMeasurableSpace (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (FiniteForest R N) := ⊤
instance finiteForestMeasurableSingletonClass (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (FiniteForest R N) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

def finiteForestCount (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.card (FiniteForest R N)

theorem finiteForestCount_pos (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : 0 < finiteForestCount R N := by
  exact Nat.card_pos

/-- This uniform law counts original E copies, not endpoint supports or color fields. -/
def finiteUniformLaw (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Measure (FiniteForest R N) :=
  FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure (FiniteForest R N)

instance finiteUniformLaw_probability (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteUniformLaw R N) := inferInstanceAs
      (IsProbabilityMeasure (FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure (FiniteForest R N)))

def finiteColors (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N) : FiniteWired.Vertex N → Bool :=
  fun v => decide (∃ r ∈ wiredOne R N, (WiredTrees.graph N).reaches F.val v r)

theorem finiteColors_one (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N)
    {v : FiniteWired.Vertex N} (hv : v ∈ wiredOne R N) : finiteColors R N F v = true := by
  simp only [finiteColors, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨v, hv, .refl⟩

theorem finiteColors_zero (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N)
    {v : FiniteWired.Vertex N} (hv : v ∈ wiredZero R N) : finiteColors R N F v = false := by
  have hn : ¬∃ r ∈ wiredOne R N, (WiredTrees.graph N).reaches F.val v r := by
    rintro ⟨r, hr, hvr⟩
    obtain ⟨u, _, _, hu⟩ := F.property.2 v
    have he : v = r := (hu v (Or.inl hv) .refl).trans (hu r (Or.inr hr) hvr).symm
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (wired_roots_disjoint R N) hv (he.symm ▸ hr)
  simp [finiteColors, hn]

/-- The literal site projection into the wired graph, including its exterior sink. -/
def wiredSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) : FiniteWired.Vertex N :=
  if h : FiniteWired.inBox N x then some (FiniteWired.activeOfSite N x h) else none

def finiteEdgeField (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N) : EdgeField :=
  fun e => decide (∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N, Sum.inl i ∈ F.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e)

def finiteForestField (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N) : ForestField :=
  (finiteEdgeField R N F, fun x => finiteColors R N F (wiredSite N x))

theorem finiteForestField_measurable (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) :
    Measurable (finiteForestField R N) := measurable_of_finite _

theorem finiteForestField_outside (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N)
    {x : Site 2} (hx : ¬FiniteWired.inBox N x) : (finiteForestField R N F).2 x = true := by
  change finiteColors R N F (wiredSite N x) = true
  rw [wiredSite, dif_neg hx]
  exact finiteColors_one R N F trivial

theorem finiteForestField_internal (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (F : FiniteForest R N)
    (i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) :
    (finiteForestField R N F).1 (interiorEdge i) = true ↔ Sum.inl i ∈ F.val := by
  simp only [finiteForestField, finiteEdgeField, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, he⟩
    exact (interiorEdge_injective N he) ▸ hj
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

def finiteForestLaw (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : Measure ForestField :=
  (finiteUniformLaw R N).map (finiteForestField R N)

instance finiteForestLaw_probability (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteForestLaw R N) :=
  (finiteUniformLaw R N).isProbabilityMeasure_map (finiteForestField_measurable R N).aemeasurable

def finiteForestProbability (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : ProbabilityMeasure ForestField :=
  ⟨finiteForestLaw R N, inferInstance⟩

theorem finiteForestLaw_mass_one (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) : finiteForestLaw R N Set.univ = 1 := measure_univ

theorem finiteForestLaw_count (R : RootPair) (N : ℕ) (S : Set ForestField) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    finiteForestLaw R N S =
      (Nat.card ({F : FiniteForest R N | finiteForestField R N F ∈ S} : Set (FiniteForest R N)) : ℝ≥0∞) /
        finiteForestCount R N := by
  rw [finiteForestLaw, Measure.map_apply (finiteForestField_measurable R N) hS]
  exact FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure_apply (FiniteForest R N) _

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import Mathlib.Combinatorics.Quiver.Path.Vertices
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Chronological loop erasure on endpoint-indexed walks. Quiver arrows are
retained, so a surviving edge keeps its original copy, even for parallel edges. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson

open Quiver

variable {V : Type*} [Quiver V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Truncate at the last occurrence of a vertex. On a simple retained path
this is its unique occurrence. The output retains the original arrows. -/
def prefixTo {a : V} : {b : V} → (p : Path a b) → (v : V) → v ∈ p.vertices → Path a v
  | _, .nil, v, hv => by
      have h : v = a := by simpa using hv
      subst v
      exact .nil
  | b, .cons p e, v, hv =>
      if h : b = v then h ▸ p.cons e
      else prefixTo p v ((Quiver.Path.mem_vertices_cons p e).mp hv |>.resolve_right (Ne.symm h))

/-- Online chronological loop erasure: visit vertices in their original order,
retain new arrows, and erase the retained suffix whenever a vertex is revisited. -/
def loopErase {a : V} : {b : V} → Path a b → Path a b
  | _, .nil => .nil
  | b, .cons p e =>
      let q := loopErase p
      if h : b ∈ q.vertices then prefixTo q b h else q.cons e

theorem prefixTo_vertices_sublist {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    (prefixTo p v hv).vertices.Sublist p.vertices := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      have h : v = a := by simpa using hv
      subst v
      simp [prefixTo]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c = v
      · subst v
        simp [prefixTo]
      · simp only [prefixTo, dif_neg h]
        exact (ih _).trans (by simp [Quiver.Path.vertices_cons])

theorem prefixTo_vertices_nodup {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices)
    (hp : p.vertices.Nodup) : (prefixTo p v hv).vertices.Nodup :=
  hp.sublist (prefixTo_vertices_sublist p v hv)

theorem loopErase_vertices_sublist {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.Sublist p.vertices := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [loopErase]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c ∈ (loopErase p).vertices
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_pos h]
        exact (prefixTo_vertices_sublist _ _ h).trans
          (ih.trans (by simp [Quiver.Path.vertices_cons]))
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_neg h, Quiver.Path.vertices_cons, List.concat_eq_append]
        exact ih.append (List.Sublist.refl [c])

theorem loopErase_vertices_nodup {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : (loopErase p).vertices.Nodup := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [loopErase]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c ∈ (loopErase p).vertices
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_pos h]
        exact prefixTo_vertices_nodup _ _ h ih
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_neg h, Quiver.Path.vertices_cons]
        exact ih.concat h

theorem loopErase_eq_self {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (hp : p.vertices.Nodup) : loopErase p = p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      have hpair : c ∉ p.vertices ∧ p.vertices.Nodup :=
        (List.nodup_concat p.vertices c).mp hp
      rw [loopErase, ih hpair.2, dif_neg hpair.1]


@[simp] theorem loopErase_head {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.head? = some a := Quiver.Path.vertices_head? _

@[simp] theorem loopErase_terminal {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.getLast (Quiver.Path.vertices_ne_nil _) = b :=
  Quiver.Path.vertices_getLast _ _

theorem loopErase_length_le {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : (loopErase p).length ≤ p.length := by
  have h := (loopErase_vertices_sublist p).length_le
  simp only [Quiver.Path.vertices_length] at h
  omega

/-- The quiver of individual unoriented edge copies with their actual endpoints. -/
abbrev copiedQuiver {E : Type*} (ends : E → V × V) : Quiver V where
  Hom x y := {e : E // (ends e = (x, y)) ∨ (ends e = (y, x))}

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedWalk

/-! Literal contraction of nonempty root sets on a copied multigraph. This
implementation imports no unrestricted empty-root quotient. Copies retain E IDs;
only copies whose endpoints become equal are removed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

abbrev Vertex (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) := Option {v : V // v ∉ R.val}

def project (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v : V) : Vertex R :=
  if h : v ∈ R.val then none else some ⟨v, h⟩

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem project_eq_none (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v : V) :
    project R v = none ↔ v ∈ R.val := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ R.val <;> simp [project, hv]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem project_eq_iff (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v w : V) :
    project R v = project R w ↔ v = w ∨ (v ∈ R.val ∧ w ∈ R.val) := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ R.val <;> by_cases hw : w ∈ R.val
  · simp [project, hv, hw]
  · simp [project, hv, hw, show v ≠ w from fun h => hw (h ▸ hv)]
  · simp [project, hv, hw, show v ≠ w from fun h => hv (h.symm ▸ hw)]
  · simp [project, hv, hw, Subtype.ext_iff]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem project_surjective (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) : Function.Surjective (project R) := by
  intro v
  cases v with
  | none => obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := R.property; exact ⟨r, (project_eq_none R r).mpr hr⟩
  | some v => exact ⟨v.val, by simp [project, v.property]⟩

def rootSetoid (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) : Setoid V := Setoid.ker (project R)

/-- A genuine equivalence quotient, with surjectivity proved before forming the equivalence. -/
def quotientEquiv (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) : Quotient (rootSetoid R) ≃ Vertex R :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (Quotient.lift (project R) (fun _ _ h => h)) (by
    constructor
    · intro a b h
      induction a using Quotient.inductionOn
      induction b using Quotient.inductionOn
      exact Quotient.sound h
    · intro v
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := project_surjective R v
      exact ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩)

omit [Fintype V] in
@[simp] theorem quotientEquiv_mk (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v : V) :
    quotientEquiv R (Quotient.mk _ v) = project R v := rfl

variable (G : Multigraph V E) (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

abbrev Copy := {e : E // project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e)}

instance vertexFintype : Fintype (Vertex R) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Option {v : V // v ∉ R.val}))
instance copyFintype : Fintype (Copy G R) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype {e : E // project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e)})

def copyID : Copy G R ↪ E := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.coe_injective⟩

def graph : Multigraph (Vertex R) (Copy G R) :=
  ⟨fun e => project R (G.left e.val), fun e => project R (G.right e.val), fun e => e.property⟩

theorem contracted_loop_iff (e : E) :
    project R (G.left e) = project R (G.right e) ↔ G.left e ∈ R.val ∧ G.right e ∈ R.val := by
  rw [project_eq_iff]
  simp only [G.loopless e, false_or]

theorem nonroot_incident_survives (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) (e : Incident G v) :
    project R (G.left e.val) ≠ project R (G.right e.val) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := (contracted_loop_iff G R e.val).mp h
  rcases e.property with he | he
  · exact hv (he ▸ hl)
  · exact hv (he ▸ hr)

def projectIncident (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) (e : Incident G v) :
    Incident (graph G R) (project R v) :=
  ⟨⟨e.val, nonroot_incident_survives G R v hv e⟩, by
    rcases e.property with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (congrArg (project R) h)
    · exact Or.inr (congrArg (project R) h)⟩

theorem projectIncident_bijective (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) :
    Function.Bijective (projectIncident G R v hv) := by
  constructor
  · intro e f h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun a => a.val.val) h)
  · intro e
    have hl : G.left e.val.val = v ∨ G.right e.val.val = v := by
      rcases e.property with h | h
      · rcases (project_eq_iff R _ v).mp h with he | he
        · exact Or.inl he
        · exact False.elim (hv he.2)
      · rcases (project_eq_iff R _ v).mp h with he | he
        · exact Or.inr he
        · exact False.elim (hv he.2)
    refine ⟨⟨e.val.val, hl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

/-- The incident-copy bijection exists before its bundled equivalence is formed. -/
def nonrootIncidentEquiv (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) :
    Incident G v ≃ Incident (graph G R) (project R v) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (projectIncident G R v hv) (projectIncident_bijective G R v hv)

@[simp] theorem nonrootIncidentEquiv_copy (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) (e : Incident G v) :
    (nonrootIncidentEquiv G R v hv e).val.val = e.val := rfl

theorem reaches_project {x y : V} (h : G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    (graph G R).reaches Finset.univ (project R x) (project R y) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail y z h he ih =>
    apply ih.trans
    by_cases hz : project R y = project R z
    · exact hz ▸ Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    · obtain ⟨e, _, he | he⟩ := he
      · have hs : project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e) := by rwa [he.1, he.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨⟨e, hs⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Or.inl
          ⟨congrArg (project R) he.1, congrArg (project R) he.2⟩⟩
      · have hs : project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e) := by
          rw [he.1, he.2]; exact Ne.symm hz
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨⟨e, hs⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Or.inr
          ⟨congrArg (project R) he.1, congrArg (project R) he.2⟩⟩

theorem graph_connected (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    ∀ x y, (graph G R).reaches Finset.univ x y := by
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := project_surjective R x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := project_surjective R y
  exact reaches_project G R (hconn a b)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem all_roots_vertex_subsingleton (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : Subsingleton (Vertex R) := by
  have hall : ∀ v : V, v ∈ R.val := fun v => hR.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ v
  refine ⟨fun v w => ?_⟩
  have hz (z : Vertex R) : z = none := by
    cases z with
    | none => rfl
    | some v => exact False.elim (v.property (hall v.val))
  exact (hz v).trans (hz w).symm

theorem all_roots_copy_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : IsEmpty (Copy G R) := by
  have hall : ∀ v : V, v ∈ R.val := fun v => hR.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ v
  refine ⟨fun e => e.property ?_⟩
  exact ((project_eq_none R _).mpr (hall (G.left e.val))).trans
    ((project_eq_none R _).mpr (hall (G.right e.val))).symm

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Trees

/-! Actual rooted copied forests are bijective with trees after simultaneous nonempty root contraction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

theorem rooted_forest_lift_iff_tree (t : Finset (Copy G R)) :
    G.is_rooted_forest R.val (liftCopies G R t) ↔ (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ t := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [project_lift_copies] using tree_of_rooted_forest G R h
  · exact rooted_forest_of_tree G R

/-- For unrestricted original subsets the inverse equation also records absence of deleted root-root copies. -/
theorem rooted_forest_iff_tree_and_lift_project (F : Finset E) :
    G.is_rooted_forest R.val F ↔
      (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ (projectCopies G R F) ∧
        liftCopies G R (projectCopies G R F) = F := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨tree_of_rooted_forest G R h, lift_project_forest G R h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, he⟩
    rw [← he]
    exact rooted_forest_of_tree G R ht

/-- A copied rooted forest retains its original subset; only the quotient endpoints change. -/
def rootContractionEquiv : G.RootedForest R.val ≃ (graph G R).ComponentTree Set.univ where
  toFun F := ⟨projectCopies G R F.val, tree_of_rooted_forest G R F.property⟩
  invFun t := ⟨liftCopies G R t.val, rooted_forest_of_tree G R t.property⟩
  left_inv F := Subtype.ext (lift_project_forest G R F.property)
  right_inv t := Subtype.ext (project_lift_copies G R t.val)

@[simp] theorem rootContractionEquiv_copies (F : G.RootedForest R.val) :
    (rootContractionEquiv G R F).val = projectCopies G R F.val := rfl

@[simp] theorem rootContractionEquiv_symm_copies (t : (graph G R).ComponentTree Set.univ) :
    ((rootContractionEquiv G R).symm t).val = liftCopies G R t.val := rfl

/-- Original root labels, including mixed colors, are recovered on the original vertex carrier. -/
theorem oneVertices_lift_project (F : G.RootedForest R.val) (C : Set V) :
    G.oneVertices (liftCopies G R (rootContractionEquiv G R F).val) C =
      G.oneVertices F.val C := by
  rw [rootContractionEquiv_copies, lift_project_forest G R F.property]

theorem all_roots_empty_forest (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : G.is_rooted_forest R.val ∅ := by
  rw [hR]
  refine ⟨by simp [Multigraph.is_forest], ?_⟩
  intro x
  refine ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, .refl, ?_⟩
  intro y _ h
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ he _ => obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := he; simp at he

theorem all_roots_tree_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ ∅ := by
  simpa [projectCopies, all_roots_copy_empty G R hR] using
    tree_of_rooted_forest G R (all_roots_empty_forest G R hR)

theorem all_roots_forests_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) (F : G.RootedForest R.val) : F.val = ∅ := by
  exact G.rootedForest_univ_empty ⟨F.val, hR ▸ F.property⟩

theorem all_roots_trees_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) (t : (graph G R).ComponentTree Set.univ) :
    t.val = ∅ := by
  letI := all_roots_copy_empty G R hR
  exact Finset.eq_empty_of_isEmpty t.val

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Subsets

/-! Simultaneous contraction sends an actual rooted copied forest to a copied tree. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

/-- The unique prescribed original root of the actual component. -/
def componentRoot {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (v : V) : V :=
  (hF.2 v).choose

theorem componentRoot_spec {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (v : V) :
    componentRoot G R hF v ∈ R.val ∧ G.reaches F v (componentRoot G R hF v) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ R.val, G.reaches F v r → r = componentRoot G R hF v := (hF.2 v).choose_spec

theorem componentRoot_eq_of_reachable {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F)
    {a b : V} (hab : G.reaches F a b) : componentRoot G R hF a = componentRoot G R hF b := by
  obtain ⟨hr, hb, _⟩ := componentRoot_spec G R hF b
  exact ((componentRoot_spec G R hF a).2.2 _ hr (hab.trans hb)).symm

theorem componentRoot_of_mem {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F)
    {r : V} (hr : r ∈ R.val) : componentRoot G R hF r = r :=
  ((componentRoot_spec G R hF r).2.2 r hr .refl).symm

/-- Retract the quotient to one original component; other components collapse to its root. -/
def componentRetract {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (r : V) : Vertex R → V
  | none => r
  | some v => if componentRoot G R hF v.val = r then v.val else r

theorem componentRetract_project {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (r v : V) :
    componentRetract G R hF r (project R v) =
      if componentRoot G R hF v = r then v else r := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ R.val
  · simp only [project, dif_pos hv, componentRetract, componentRoot_of_mem G R hF hv]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp_all
  · simp [project, hv, componentRetract]

theorem tree_of_rooted_forest {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) :
    (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ (projectCopies G R F) := by
  have hc (v : Vertex R) : (graph G R).reaches (projectCopies G R F) v none := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := project_surjective R v
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hx, _⟩ := hF.2 x
    have h := reaches_project_copies G R hx
    simpa only [(project_eq_none R r).mpr hr] using h
  refine ⟨⟨none, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (by intro e he; simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x _ y _
    exact (hc x).trans ((graph G R).reaches_symm (hc y))
  · intro e he halt
    let a := G.left e.val
    let b := G.right e.val
    let r := componentRoot G R hF a
    have heF : e.val ∈ F := (mem_projectCopies G R F e).mp he
    have hab : G.reaches F a b := .single ⟨e.val, heF, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    have hba : componentRoot G R hF b = r := (componentRoot_eq_of_reachable G R hF hab).symm
    have hlift : G.reaches (F.erase e.val)
        (componentRetract G R hF r ((graph G R).left e))
        (componentRetract G R hF r ((graph G R).right e)) := by
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (componentRetract G R hF r) (fun u v hf => ?_) _ _ halt
      obtain ⟨f, hf, h | h⟩ := hf
      all_goals
        have hfe : f.val ≠ e.val := fun hval => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1 (Subtype.ext hval)
        have hfF : f.val ∈ F := (mem_projectCopies G R F f).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2
        have hfab : G.reaches F (G.left f.val) (G.right f.val) :=
          .single ⟨f.val, hfF, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        have hroots := componentRoot_eq_of_reachable G R hF hfab
        change project R _ = u ∧ project R _ = v at h
        change G.reaches (F.erase e.val) (componentRetract G R hF r u) (componentRetract G R hF r v)
        rw [← h.1, ← h.2, componentRetract_project, componentRetract_project]
        by_cases hl : componentRoot G R hF (G.left f.val) = r
        · have hr := hroots.symm.trans hl
          simp only [hl, hr, ↓reduceIte]
          exact .single ⟨f.val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfe, hfF⟩, by
            first | exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        · have hr : componentRoot G R hF (G.right f.val) ≠ r := fun hh => hl (hroots.trans hh)
          simp only [hl, hr, ↓reduceIte]
          exact .refl
    apply hF.1 e.val heF
    simpa [graph, componentRetract_project, a, b, r, hba] using hlift

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.NonemptyQuotient
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Ancestors

/-! Literal copied-edge subset projection and lifting through a nonempty root quotient. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

/-- Select the surviving original copies in a prescribed family. -/
def projectCopies (F : Finset E) : Finset (Copy G R) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun e => e.val ∈ F)

/-- Lift copies by their individual original identities. -/
def liftCopies (t : Finset (Copy G R)) : Finset E := t.image Subtype.val

@[simp] theorem mem_projectCopies (F : Finset E) (e : Copy G R) :
    e ∈ projectCopies G R F ↔ e.val ∈ F := by simp [projectCopies]

@[simp] theorem mem_liftCopies (t : Finset (Copy G R)) (e : Copy G R) :
    e.val ∈ liftCopies G R t ↔ e ∈ t := by
  simp [liftCopies, Subtype.coe_injective.eq_iff]

@[simp] theorem project_lift_copies (t : Finset (Copy G R)) :
    projectCopies G R (liftCopies G R t) = t := by ext e; simp

theorem forest_copy_survives {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ F) : project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := (contracted_loop_iff G R e).mp h
  obtain ⟨r, _, _, hu⟩ := hF.2 (G.left e)
  have ha : G.left e = r := hu _ hl .refl
  have hb : G.right e = r := hu _ hr (.single ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  exact G.loopless e (ha.trans hb.symm)

theorem lift_project_forest {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) :
    liftCopies G R (projectCopies G R F) = F := by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    exact (mem_projectCopies G R F f).mp hf
  · intro he
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨e, forest_copy_survives G R hF e he⟩, by simpa using he, rfl⟩

theorem reaches_project_copies {F : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.reaches F x y) :
    (graph G R).reaches (projectCopies G R F) (project R x) (project R y) := by
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (project R) (fun u v he => ?_) _ _ h
  obtain ⟨e, he, h | h⟩ := he
  all_goals
    by_cases hs : project R (G.left e) = project R (G.right e)
    · have huv : project R u = project R v := by
        first
        | exact (congrArg (project R) h.1).symm.trans (hs.trans (congrArg (project R) h.2))
        | exact (congrArg (project R) h.1).symm.trans (hs.symm.trans (congrArg (project R) h.2))
      change (graph G R).reaches _ (project R u) (project R v)
      rw [huv]; exact .refl
    · exact .single ⟨⟨e, hs⟩, (mem_projectCopies G R F _).mpr he, by
        first
        | exact Or.inl ⟨congrArg (project R) h.1, congrArg (project R) h.2⟩
        | exact Or.inr ⟨congrArg (project R) h.1, congrArg (project R) h.2⟩⟩

theorem project_erase_lift_subset (t : Finset (Copy G R)) (e : Copy G R) :
    projectCopies G R ((liftCopies G R t).erase e.val) ⊆ t.erase e := by
  intro f hf
  have hm := (mem_projectCopies G R _ f).mp hf
  exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hm).1 (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    (mem_liftCopies G R t f).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hm).2⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Forests

/-! Lifting a copied quotient tree gives one prescribed original root per component. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

theorem root_cover_of_reaches (t : Finset (Copy G R)) {x : V}
    (h : (graph G R).reaches t (project R x) none) :
    ∃ r ∈ R.val, G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) x r := by
  have hall (z : Vertex R) (hz : (graph G R).reaches t none z) :
      ∀ v, project R v = z → ∃ r ∈ R.val, G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) v r := by
    induction hz with
    | refl =>
      intro v hv
      exact ⟨v, (project_eq_none R v).mp hv, .refl⟩
    | @tail a b _ he ih =>
      intro v hv
      by_cases hr : v ∈ R.val
      · exact ⟨v, hr, .refl⟩
      obtain ⟨e, he, h | h⟩ := he
      · have hva : v = G.right e.val :=
          ((project_eq_iff R v _).mp (hv.trans h.2.symm)).resolve_right (fun hh => hr hh.1)
        subst v
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := ih _ h.1
        have hstep : G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) (G.right e.val) (G.left e.val) :=
          .single ⟨e.val, (mem_liftCopies G R t e).mpr he, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, hstep.trans hp⟩
      · have hva : v = G.left e.val :=
          ((project_eq_iff R v _).mp (hv.trans h.2.symm)).resolve_right (fun hh => hr hh.1)
        subst v
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := ih _ h.1
        have hstep : G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) (G.left e.val) (G.right e.val) :=
          .single ⟨e.val, (mem_liftCopies G R t e).mpr he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, hstep.trans hp⟩
  exact hall _ ((graph G R).reaches_symm h) x rfl

theorem forest_of_quotient_forest {t : Finset (Copy G R)} (ht : (graph G R).is_forest t) :
    G.is_forest (liftCopies G R t) := by
  intro e he halt
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
  apply ht f hf
  exact (graph G R).reaches_mono (project_erase_lift_subset G R t f)
    (reaches_project_copies G R halt)

/-- Distinct prescribed roots cannot become connected when lifting a quotient forest. -/
theorem roots_eq_of_reaches {t : Finset (Copy G R)} (ht : (graph G R).is_forest t)
    {r s : V} (hr : r ∈ R.val) (hs : s ∈ R.val)
    (h : G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) r s) : r = s := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := (G.toSimple_reachable _ r s).mpr h
  have hp := p.toPath.property
  generalize hq : p.toPath.val = q at hp
  cases q with
  | nil => rfl
  | @cons r z s hadj q =>
    have hnot : r ∉ q.support := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hadj q).mp hp |>.2
    obtain ⟨e, he, h | h⟩ := hadj
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
      have heincident : G.left e = r ∨ G.right e = r := by
        first | exact Or.inl h.1 | exact Or.inr h.1
      have htail := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem heincident q hnot
      have hproject := (graph G R).reaches_mono (project_erase_lift_subset G R t f)
        (by simpa only [hfe] using reaches_project_copies G R htail)
      apply False.elim
      apply ht f hf
      have hrp := (project_eq_none R r).mpr hr
      have hsp := (project_eq_none R s).mpr hs
      first
      | exact (graph G R).reaches_symm (by
          simpa only [graph, hfe, h.1, h.2, hrp, hsp] using hproject)
      | exact (by simpa only [graph, hfe, h.1, h.2, hrp, hsp] using hproject)

theorem rooted_forest_of_tree {t : Finset (Copy G R)} (ht : (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ t) :
    G.is_rooted_forest R.val (liftCopies G R t) := by
  refine ⟨forest_of_quotient_forest G R ht.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := root_cover_of_reaches G R t
    (ht.2.2.1 _ (Set.mem_univ _) none (Set.mem_univ _))
  refine ⟨r, hr, hxr, ?_⟩
  intro s hs hxs
  exact roots_eq_of_reaches G R ht.2.2.2 hs hr ((G.reaches_symm hxs).trans hxr)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
