import LatticeProb.Site
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Ends.Defs
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic

/-! The literal infinite lattice-edge space. A coordinate is one unordered
nearest-neighbor edge, and a field records precisely its presence. Graph and end
predicates use all original lattice vertices. No infinite probability law is chosen. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical

/-- Each actual unordered nearest-neighbor lattice edge occurs once. -/
abbrev LatticeEdge := (lattice 2).edgeSet

/-- The product of two-point edge indicators, with its standard product structures. -/
abbrev EdgeField := LatticeEdge → Bool

/-- The selected graph on the entire original lattice vertex carrier. -/
def toGraph (ω : EdgeField) : SimpleGraph (Site 2) where
  Adj x y := ∃ h : (lattice 2).Adj x y, ω ⟨s(x, y), h⟩ = true
  symm := ⟨by
    rintro x y ⟨h, hω⟩
    refine ⟨h.symm, ?_⟩
    have he : (⟨s(y, x), h.symm⟩ : LatticeEdge) = ⟨s(x, y), h⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap
    rw [he]
    exact hω⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun x ⟨h, _⟩ => (lattice 2).loopless.irrefl x h⟩

theorem toGraph_le_lattice (ω : EdgeField) : toGraph ω ≤ lattice 2 :=
  fun _ _ h => h.choose

theorem toGraph_adj_iff (ω : EdgeField) {x y : Site 2} (h : (lattice 2).Adj x y) :
    (toGraph ω).Adj x y ↔ ω ⟨s(x, y), h⟩ = true := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hω⟩
    exact hω
  · intro hω
    exact ⟨h, hω⟩

/-- A spanning tree uses every lattice vertex and has no cycle. -/
def IsTree (ω : EdgeField) : Prop := (toGraph ω).IsTree

/-- Exactly one graph end, using Mathlib's sections of the finite-complement
component inverse system. The nonempty clause excludes zero-ended graphs. -/
def OneEnded (ω : EdgeField) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (toGraph ω).end ∧ Subsingleton (toGraph ω).end

/-- Finite-coordinate cylinders in the actual unordered edge indicator space. -/
def cylinder (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) : Set EdgeField :=
  {ω | F.restrict ω = p}

theorem isClopen_cylinder (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    IsClopen (cylinder F p) := by
  have hf : Continuous (F.restrict : EdgeField → F → Bool) :=
    continuous_pi (fun e => continuous_apply e.val)
  exact (isClopen_discrete {p}).preimage hf

theorem measurableSet_cylinder (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (cylinder F p) := (isClopen_cylinder F p).isClosed.measurableSet

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.FiniteWired
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Ends.Properties

/-! Full-carrier characterizations of the literal selected graph and its ends.
Local finiteness is derived from its actual lattice-neighbor set. These facts
supply the graph adapter for standard UST inputs without proving those inputs. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem toGraph_edgeSet (ω : EdgeField) :
    (toGraph ω).edgeSet = {e | ∃ h : e ∈ (lattice 2).edgeSet, ω ⟨e, h⟩ = true} := by
  ext e
  refine Sym2.inductionOn e ?_
  intro x y
  rfl

theorem edge_mem_toGraph_iff (ω : EdgeField) (e : LatticeEdge) :
    e.val ∈ (toGraph ω).edgeSet ↔ ω e = true := by
  rw [toGraph_edgeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hω⟩
    exact hω
  · intro hω
    exact ⟨e.property, hω⟩

theorem toGraph_injective : Function.Injective toGraph := by
  intro ω ω' h
  funext e
  have he : (ω e = true) ↔ ω' e = true := by
    rw [← edge_mem_toGraph_iff, ← edge_mem_toGraph_iff, h]
  cases hω : ω e <;> cases hω' : ω' e <;> simp_all

theorem neighborSet_subset_lattice_neighbors (ω : EdgeField) (x : Site 2) :
    (toGraph ω).neighborSet x ⊆ (nbrFinset x : Set (Site 2)) :=
  fun y hy => (FiniteWired.mem_neighbors_iff x y).mpr (toGraph_le_lattice ω hy)

theorem neighborSet_finite (ω : EdgeField) (x : Site 2) :
    ((toGraph ω).neighborSet x).Finite :=
  (nbrFinset x).finite_toSet.subset (neighborSet_subset_lattice_neighbors ω x)

instance toGraph_locallyFinite (ω : EdgeField) : (toGraph ω).LocallyFinite :=
  fun x => (neighborSet_finite ω x).fintype

theorem isTree_iff_connected_acyclic (ω : EdgeField) :
    IsTree ω ↔ (toGraph ω).Connected ∧ (toGraph ω).IsAcyclic :=
  SimpleGraph.isTree_iff (toGraph ω)

theorem oneEnded_iff_existsUnique_end (ω : EdgeField) :
    OneEnded ω ↔ ∃! _e : (toGraph ω).end, True := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, hsub⟩
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨e, trivial, fun f _ => hsub.elim f e⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, _, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨e⟩, ⟨fun f g => (hu f trivial).trans (hu g trivial).symm⟩⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Space

/-! Literal finite walks (including zero edges) and genuinely infinite walks/rays.
No finite list represents an infinite path or a failed stopping time. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb

structure FiniteWalk where
  length : ℕ
  vertex : Fin (length + 1) → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ i : Fin length, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex i.castSucc) (vertex i.succ)

structure InfiniteWalk where
  vertex : ℕ → Site 2
  adjacent : ∀ n, (lattice 2).Adj (vertex n) (vertex (n + 1))

structure SimpleRay extends InfiniteWalk where
  injective : Function.Injective vertex

def FiniteWalk.start (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex 0
def FiniteWalk.finish (p : FiniteWalk) : Site 2 := p.vertex ⟨p.length, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
def FiniteWalk.vertices (p : FiniteWalk) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range p.vertex

def zeroWalk (x : Site 2) : FiniteWalk :=
  ⟨0, fun _ => x, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩

theorem zeroWalk_length (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).length = 0 := rfl
theorem zeroWalk_vertices (x : Site 2) : (zeroWalk x).vertices = {x} := by
  ext y
  simp [FiniteWalk.vertices, zeroWalk]

/-- A stopped trace retains its complete finite word, or its genuinely infinite word. -/
inductive StoppedTrace (B : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) where
  | hit (walk : FiniteWalk) (start : walk.start = x) (finish : walk.finish ∈ B)
      (first : ∀ i : Fin walk.length, walk.vertex i.castSucc ∉ B)
  | escape (walk : InfiniteWalk) (start : walk.vertex 0 = x)
      (avoids : ∀ n, walk.vertex n ∉ B)

def SimpleRay.vertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) := Set.range γ.vertex
def SimpleRay.tailVertices (γ : SimpleRay) : Set (Site 2) :=
  Set.range (fun n => γ.vertex (n + 1))

theorem SimpleRay.vertices_infinite (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertices.Infinite :=
  Set.infinite_range_of_injective γ.injective

theorem SimpleRay.tail_nonempty (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.tailVertices.Nonempty :=
  ⟨γ.vertex 1, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩

theorem SimpleRay.start_not_mem_tail (γ : SimpleRay) : γ.vertex 0 ∉ γ.tailVertices := by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have he := γ.injective hn
  omega

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.Topology
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw

/-! Literal two-color rooted lattice forests. All vertices and all unordered
nearest-neighbor edges are retained. No probability law is selected. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The source's two disjoint nonempty sets, retaining every root separately. -/
structure RootPair where
  zero : Set (Site 2)
  one : Set (Site 2)
  disjoint : Disjoint zero one
  zero_nonempty : zero.Nonempty
  one_nonempty : one.Nonempty

abbrev ColorField := Site 2 → Bool
abbrev ForestField := EdgeField × ColorField

/-- Acyclic on all sites, with exactly one original root in each component. -/
def is_rooted_forest (R : RootPair) (f : EdgeField) : Prop :=
  (toGraph f).IsAcyclic ∧ ∀ x, ∃ r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one,
    (toGraph f).Reachable x r ∧
      ∀ r' ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one, (toGraph f).Reachable x r' → r' = r

abbrev RootedForest (R : RootPair) := {f : EdgeField // is_rooted_forest R f}

def oneVertices (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : Set (Site 2) :=
  {x | ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r}

theorem reachable_roots_eq (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R)
    {x r s : Site 2} (hr : r ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one) (hs : s ∈ R.zero ∪ R.one)
    (hxr : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r) (hxs : (toGraph f.val).Reachable x s) : r = s := by
  obtain ⟨u, _, _, hu⟩ := f.property.2 x
  exact (hu r hr hxr).trans (hu s hs hxs).symm

/-- Component root colors, defined by literal reachability, without choosing a root. -/
def colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) : ColorField :=
  fun x => decide (x ∈ oneVertices R f)

theorem colors_eq_true_iff (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (x : Site 2) :
    colors R f x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph f.val).Reachable x r := by
  simp only [colors, decide_eq_true_eq, oneVertices, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

theorem colors_of_one_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.one) : colors R f x = true :=
  (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mpr ⟨x, hx, .refl x⟩

theorem colors_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) {x : Site 2}
    (hx : x ∈ R.zero) : colors R f x = false := by
  have hn : ¬colors R f x = true := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).mp h
    have he := reachable_roots_eq R f (Or.inl hx) (Or.inr hr) (.refl x) hxr
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint hx (he.symm ▸ hr)
  cases h : colors R f x <;> simp_all

/-- Raw full product carrier; valid fields have precisely the original component colors. -/
def is_colored_forest (R : RootPair) (ω : ForestField) : Prop :=
  is_rooted_forest R ω.1 ∧ ∀ x,
    ω.2 x = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R.one, (toGraph ω.1).Reachable x r

theorem colored_iff_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) (σ : ColorField) :
    is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) ↔ σ = colors R f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext x
    have he := (h.2 x).trans (colors_eq_true_iff R f x).symm
    cases hσ : σ x <;> cases hf : colors R f x <;> simp_all
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨f.property, colors_eq_true_iff R f⟩

theorem existsUnique_colors (R : RootPair) (f : RootedForest R) :
    ∃! σ : ColorField, is_colored_forest R (f.val, σ) :=
  ⟨colors R f, (colored_iff_colors R f _).mpr rfl,
    fun σ hσ => (colored_iff_colors R f σ).mp hσ⟩

def colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) : Set ColorField :=
  {σ | F.restrict σ = p}

theorem isClopen_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    IsClopen (colorCylinder F p) :=
  (isClopen_discrete {p}).preimage (continuous_pi (fun x => continuous_apply x.val))

theorem measurableSet_colorCylinder (F : Finset (Site 2)) (p : F → Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (colorCylinder F p) := (isClopen_colorCylinder F p).isClosed.measurableSet

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.ColoredForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.Paths
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.WiredLaw
import Mathlib.Probability.ProductMeasure

/-! Literal simple random walk drivers and ordered hitting events. Independent
uniform choices of the four actual lattice directions, including hitting at time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

abbrev WalkDriver := ℕ → FiniteWired.Direction

def directionLaw : Measure FiniteWired.Direction :=
  FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction

instance directionLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure directionLaw :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (FiniteAvalanches.uniformMeasure FiniteWired.Direction))

def walkLaw : Measure WalkDriver := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => directionLaw)
instance walkLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure walkLaw := by
  unfold walkLaw
  infer_instance

def position (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : ℕ → Site 2
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n)

@[simp] theorem position_zero (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : position x d 0 = x := rfl
@[simp] theorem position_succ (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + FiniteWired.step (d n) := rfl

theorem position_adjacent (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) (n : ℕ) :
    (lattice 2).Adj (position x d n) (position x d (n + 1)) := by
  change ∃ i, position x d (n + 1) = position x d n + unit i ∨
    position x d n = position x d (n + 1) + unit i
  refine ⟨(d n).1, ?_⟩
  cases h : (d n).2
  · right
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp
  · left
    rw [position_succ, FiniteWired.step, h]
    simp

def driverWalk (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) : InfiniteWalk :=
  ⟨position x d, position_adjacent x d⟩

/-- tau_C < tau_A: some C visit precedes every A visit, including time zero. -/
def hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) : Set WalkDriver :=
  {d | ∃ n, position x d n ∈ C ∧ ∀ m ≤ n, position x d m ∉ A}

theorem measurable_position (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun d => position x d n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ih.add ((measurable_of_countable FiniteWired.step).comp (measurable_pi_apply n))

theorem measurableSet_hitBefore (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    MeasurableSet (hitBefore A C x) := by
  have hC (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∈ C} :=
    (measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable C).measurableSet
  have hA (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {d : WalkDriver | position x d n ∉ A} :=
    ((measurable_position x n) (Set.to_countable A).measurableSet).compl
  simp only [hitBefore, Set.setOf_exists, Set.setOf_and, Set.setOf_forall]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n => (hC n).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter (fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ => hA m))))

theorem hitBefore_of_one_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.one) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = Set.univ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  refine ⟨0, hx, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  have he : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm
  subst m
  exact fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp R.disjoint h hx

theorem hitBefore_of_zero_root (R : RootPair) {x : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ R.zero) :
    hitBefore R.zero R.one x = ∅ := by
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  rintro ⟨n, _, hn⟩
  exact hn 0 (Nat.zero_le n) hx

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.SimpleWalk

/-! Literal first hitting times with top for a genuinely infinite avoiding path.
Their comparison agrees with the ordered source event, including time zero. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def firstHit (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) : WithTop ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U then (Nat.find h : WithTop ℕ) else ⊤

theorem firstHit_eq_top_iff (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) :
    firstHit U p = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n, p n ∉ U := by
  by_cases h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U
  · simp [firstHit, h]
  · have hn : ∀ n, p n ∉ U := fun n hm => h ⟨n, hm⟩
    simp only [firstHit, dif_neg h, eq_self, true_iff]
    exact hn

theorem firstHit_eq_zero_iff (U : Set (Site 2)) (p : ℕ → Site 2) :
    firstHit U p = 0 ↔ p 0 ∈ U := by
  by_cases h : ∃ n, p n ∈ U
  · rw [firstHit, dif_pos h]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.find_eq_zero h)
  · simp only [firstHit, dif_neg h, WithTop.top_ne_zero, false_iff]
    exact fun hp => h ⟨0, hp⟩

theorem hitBefore_iff_firstHit_lt (A C : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (d : WalkDriver) :
    d ∈ hitBefore A C x ↔ firstHit C (position x d) < firstHit A (position x d) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hnC, hnA⟩
    have hC : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ C := ⟨n, hnC⟩
    by_cases hA : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ A
    · have hna : n < Nat.find hA := by
        by_contra h
        exact hnA (Nat.find hA) (Nat.le_of_not_gt h) (Nat.find_spec hA)
      have hl := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.find_min' hC hnC) hna
      simp only [firstHit, dif_pos hC, dif_pos hA]
      exact_mod_cast hl
    · simp [firstHit, hC, hA]
  · intro h
    have hC : ∃ m, position x d m ∈ C := by
      by_contra hC
      simp only [firstHit, dif_neg hC, not_top_lt] at h
    refine ⟨Nat.find hC, Nat.find_spec hC, ?_⟩
    intro m hm hmA
    have hA : ∃ n, position x d n ∈ A := ⟨m, hmA⟩
    have hl : Nat.find hC < Nat.find hA := by
      simp only [firstHit, dif_pos hC, dif_pos hA] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    have ha := Nat.find_min' hA hmA
    omega

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.HittingTimes
import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice.WiredForestLaw

/-! Literal finite-query recurrent Wilson sampler. Partial colors retain unknown
values; complete stopped walks and their chronological erasures are distinguished. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The actual first T steps, including both endpoints and all nearest-neighbor steps. -/
def dirWalkFinite (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) : FiniteWalk where
  length := T
  vertex i := position x w i.val
  adjacent i := by simpa using position_adjacent x w i.val

/-- A least genuine hit, or none exactly when the complete infinite word avoids S. -/
def hitTime (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) : Option ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ n, position x w n ∈ S then some (Nat.find h) else none

theorem hitTime_eq_some_iff (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) :
    hitTime S x w = some T ↔ position x w T ∈ S ∧ ∀ n < T, position x w n ∉ S := by
  unfold hitTime
  by_cases h : ∃ n, position x w n ∈ S
  · rw [dif_pos h, Option.some.injEq]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Nat.find_spec h, fun n hn => Nat.find_min h hn⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact le_antisymm (Nat.find_min' h h1)
        (not_lt.mp fun hlt => h2 _ hlt (Nat.find_spec h))
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    constructor
    · intro hh; cases hh
    · rintro ⟨h1, _⟩
      exact (h ⟨T, h1⟩).elim

theorem hitTime_eq_none_iff (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) :
    hitTime S x w = none ↔ ∀ n, position x w n ∉ S := by
  unfold hitTime
  by_cases h : ∃ n, position x w n ∈ S
  · rw [dif_pos h]
    constructor
    · intro hh; cases hh
    · intro hn
      obtain ⟨n, hm⟩ := h
      exact (hn n hm).elim
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    exact ⟨fun _ n hn => h ⟨n, hn⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- Non-stopping retains its actual infinite walk, not a finite surrogate or default. -/
def stoppedTrace (S : Set (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) : StoppedTrace S x :=
  match h : hitTime S x w with
  | some T => StoppedTrace.hit (dirWalkFinite x w T)
      (by simp [FiniteWalk.start, dirWalkFinite])
      ((hitTime_eq_some_iff S x w T).mp h).1
      (fun i => ((hitTime_eq_some_iff S x w T).mp h).2 i.val i.isLt)
  | none => StoppedTrace.escape (driverWalk x w) rfl ((hitTime_eq_none_iff S x w).mp h)

/-- Online chronological erasure: truncate at a revisited vertex, append a new one. -/
def eraseStep (acc : List (Site 2)) (v : Site 2) : List (Site 2) :=
  acc.takeWhile (fun u => decide (u ≠ v)) ++ [v]

/-- Chronological erasure of the COMPLETE stopped word X_0,...,X_T. -/
def walkErase (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) (T : ℕ) : List (Site 2) :=
  (List.range (T + 1)).foldl (fun acc n => eraseStep acc (position x w n)) []

/-- Consecutive unordered pairs. Actual NN walks give actual lattice branch edges. -/
def branchEdges (path : List (Site 2)) : Finset (Sym2 (Site 2)) :=
  ((path.zip path.tail).map fun p => s(p.1, p.2)).toFinset

/-- Partial colors and complete stopped histories. An unrevealed site has NO color. -/
structure SamplerState where
  colors : Site 2 → Option Bool
  edges : Finset (Sym2 (Site 2))
  history : List FiniteWalk

/-- Only the prescribed roots are colored initially, with their original colors. -/
def initialSampler (R : RootPair) : SamplerState where
  colors x := if x ∈ R.zero then some false else if x ∈ R.one then some true else none
  edges := ∅
  history := []

def SamplerState.covered (st : SamplerState) : Set (Site 2) :=
  {x | st.colors x ≠ none}

/-- A covered start consumes its row and changes nothing. A fresh start runs to the
FIRST actual hit and colors only the retained branch, excluding its old endpoint. -/
def samplerStep (st : SamplerState) (x : Site 2) (w : WalkDriver) : Option SamplerState :=
  if x ∈ st.covered then some st
  else match hitTime st.covered x w with
  | none => none
  | some T =>
    let branch := walkErase x w T
    some { colors := fun v => if v ∈ branch.dropLast then st.colors (position x w T) else st.colors v
           edges := st.edges ∪ branchEdges branch
           history := st.history ++ [dirWalkFinite x w T] }

/-- One independent row per slot, including repeated and already covered queries. -/
def samplerRun : SamplerState → List (Site 2) → (ℕ → WalkDriver) → Option SamplerState
  | st, [], _ => some st
  | st, x :: xs, ω => (samplerStep st x (ω 0)).bind fun st' =>
      samplerRun st' xs (fun i => ω (i + 1))

/-- Every row is an actual iid uniform four-direction infinite simple random walk. -/
def wilsonRows : Measure (ℕ → WalkDriver) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => walkLaw)
instance wilsonRows_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure wilsonRows := by
  unfold wilsonRows
  infer_instance

theorem samplerRun_of_covered (st : SamplerState) (L : List (Site 2))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ st.covered) (ω : ℕ → WalkDriver) : samplerRun st L ω = some st := by
  induction L generalizing ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ∈ st.covered := h x (by simp)
    simp only [samplerRun, samplerStep, if_pos hx, Option.bind_some]
    exact ih (fun y hy => h y (by simp [hy])) _

/-- The complete finite JOINT pattern, including absent as well as present edges. -/
def jointEvent (B : Finset LatticeEdge) (D : Finset (Site 2))
    (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool) : Set ForestField :=
  {ω | (∀ e ∈ B, ω.1 e = pe e) ∧ ∀ d ∈ D, ω.2 d = pc d}

/-- The same full joint query of a genuinely successful finite Wilson run.
Unknown colors do not satisfy either Boolean observation. -/
def samplerEvent (R : RootPair) (L : List (Site 2)) (B : Finset LatticeEdge)
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool) :
    Set (ℕ → WalkDriver) :=
  {ξ | ∃ st, samplerRun (initialSampler R) L ξ = some st ∧
    (∀ e ∈ B, decide (e.val ∈ st.edges) = pe e) ∧
    ∀ d ∈ D, st.colors d = some (pc d)}

/-- Every finite original lattice edge/color pattern is characterized JOINTLY.
Coverage says precisely that the observed sites and edge endpoints were queried. -/
def IsWilsonLaw (R : RootPair) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure ForestField) : Prop :=
  (∀ᵐ ω ∂(ν : Measure ForestField), is_colored_forest R ω) ∧
  ∀ (L : List (Site 2)) (B : Finset LatticeEdge) (D : Finset (Site 2))
    (pe : LatticeEdge → Bool) (pc : Site 2 → Bool),
    (∀ e ∈ B, ∀ x ∈ e.val, x ∈ L) → (∀ d ∈ D, d ∈ L) →
    (ν : Measure ForestField) (jointEvent B D pe pc) =
      wilsonRows (samplerEvent R L B D pe pc)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb SimpleGraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- An infinite simple path in the actual selected lattice graph, with prescribed start. -/
def IsSimpleRay (ω : EdgeField) (x : Site 2) (r : ℕ → Site 2) : Prop :=
  r 0 = x ∧ Function.Injective r ∧ ∀ n, (toGraph ω).Adj (r n) (r (n + 1))

/-- Iterate the uniquely characterized neighbor toward the infinite side. -/
def infiniteRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) : Site 2 := (infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd)^[n] x

theorem infiniteRay_zero (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x 0 = x := rfl

theorem infiniteRay_succ (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x (n + 1) =
      infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x n) :=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

private def rayPrefix (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : ∀ n : ℕ, (toGraph ω).Walk x (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x n)
  | 0 => .nil
  | n + 1 => ((rayPrefix ω hT hEnd x n).concat
      (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x n)).1).copy
        rfl (infiniteRay_succ ω hT hEnd x n).symm

private theorem rayPrefix_support (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) :
    (rayPrefix ω hT hEnd x n).support = (List.range (n + 1)).map (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [rayPrefix, Walk.support_copy, Walk.support_concat, ih,
      List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, infiniteRay_succ]

private theorem rayPrefix_isPath (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) : (rayPrefix ω hT hEnd x n).IsPath := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Walk.IsPath.nil
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [rayPrefix, Walk.isPath_copy]
    apply ih.concat _ (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x n)).1
    intro hmem
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      change infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x ∈ [x] at hmem
      exact (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd x).1.ne (List.mem_singleton.mp hmem).symm
    | succ k =>
      have heq := hT.isAcyclic.eq_penultimate_of_adj_end ih
        (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x (k + 1))).1 hmem
      have hp : (rayPrefix ω hT hEnd x (k + 1)).penultimate = infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x k := by
        simp only [rayPrefix, Walk.penultimate, Walk.length_copy, Walk.getVert_copy]
        exact Walk.penultimate_concat _ _
      rw [hp, infiniteRay_succ] at heq
      exact infiniteDirection_no_backtrack ω hT hEnd (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x k) heq

theorem infiniteRay_injective (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : Function.Injective (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x) := by
  intro m n heq
  have hnd := (rayPrefix_isPath ω hT hEnd x (max m n)).support_nodup
  rw [rayPrefix_support] at hnd
  exact (List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on List.nodup_range).mp hnd m
    (List.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_max_left _ _))) n
    (List.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_max_right _ _))) heq

theorem infiniteRay_isSimpleRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : IsSimpleRay ω x (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, infiniteRay_injective ω hT hEnd x, ?_⟩
  intro n
  rw [infiniteRay_succ]
  exact (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd (infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x n)).1

private theorem simpleRay_first_side_infinite (ω : EdgeField) (r : ℕ → Site 2)
    (hinj : Function.Injective r) (hadj : ∀ n, (toGraph ω).Adj (r n) (r (n + 1))) :
    (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(r 0, r 1)}).connectedComponentMk (r 1)).supp.Infinite := by
  have hreach : ∀ n, ((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(r 0, r 1)}).Reachable (r 1) (r (n + 1)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
    | succ n ih =>
      apply ih.trans
      apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      apply SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj.mpr
      refine ⟨hadj (n + 1), ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      intro heq
      rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq with h | h
      · have he := hinj h.1; omega
      · have he := hinj h.2; omega
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => r (n + 1)) := by
    intro m n he
    exact Nat.add_right_cancel (hinj he)
  apply (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hi).mono
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound (hreach n).symm

theorem simpleRay_step_direction (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (r : ℕ → Site 2) (hr : IsSimpleRay ω x r) (n : ℕ) :
    r (n + 1) = infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd (r n) := by
  apply (infiniteDirection_characterization ω hT hEnd (r n) (r (n + 1))).mpr
  refine ⟨hr.2.2 n, ?_⟩
  exact simpleRay_first_side_infinite ω (fun k => r (n + k))
    (fun a b h => Nat.add_left_cancel (hr.2.1 h))
    (fun k => by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hr.2.2 (n + k))

/-- Every infinite simple path from a vertex is the actual iterated outgoing ray. -/
theorem infiniteRay_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (r : ℕ → Site 2) : r = infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x ↔ IsSimpleRay ω x r := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact infiniteRay_isSimpleRay ω hT hEnd x
  · intro hr
    funext n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hr.1
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [simpleRay_step_direction ω hT hEnd x r hr n, ih, infiniteRay_succ]

theorem existsUnique_simpleRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : ∃! r : ℕ → Site 2, IsSimpleRay ω x r :=
  ⟨infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x, infiniteRay_isSimpleRay ω hT hEnd x,
    fun r hr => (infiniteRay_characterization ω hT hEnd x r).mpr hr⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

theorem simpleRay_eq_of_vertex_eq (r q : SimpleRay) (h : r.vertex = q.vertex) : r = q := by
  rcases r with ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, hi⟩
  rcases q with ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hj⟩
  change v = w at h
  cases h
  rfl

/-- The actual iterated ray, bundled as an infinite injective lattice path. -/
def bundledInfiniteRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : SimpleRay where
  vertex := infiniteRay ω hT hEnd x
  adjacent n := toGraph_le_lattice ω ((infiniteRay_isSimpleRay ω hT hEnd x).2.2 n)
  injective := infiniteRay_injective ω hT hEnd x

/-- Complete source characterization, for every literal SimpleRay. -/
theorem bundledInfiniteRay_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (r : SimpleRay) :
    r = bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x ↔
      r.vertex 0 = x ∧ ∀ n, (toGraph ω).Adj (r.vertex n) (r.vertex (n + 1)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨rfl, (infiniteRay_isSimpleRay ω hT hEnd x).2.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, ha⟩
    apply simpleRay_eq_of_vertex_eq
    exact (infiniteRay_characterization ω hT hEnd x r.vertex).mpr ⟨h0, r.injective, ha⟩

theorem existsUnique_bundledSimpleRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) :
    ∃! r : SimpleRay, r.vertex 0 = x ∧
      ∀ n, (toGraph ω).Adj (r.vertex n) (r.vertex (n + 1)) := by
  refine ⟨bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x,
    (bundledInfiniteRay_characterization ω hT hEnd x _).mp rfl, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  exact (bundledInfiniteRay_characterization ω hT hEnd x r).mpr hr

/-- No choice of the standing proof witnesses changes the oriented ray. -/
theorem bundledInfiniteRay_witness_independent (ω : EdgeField) (hT hT' : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd hEnd' : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x = bundledInfiniteRay ω hT' hEnd' x := by
  apply (bundledInfiniteRay_characterization ω hT' hEnd' x _).mpr
  exact (bundledInfiniteRay_characterization ω hT hEnd x _).mp rfl

/-- Selected adjacency means the indicator of each actual unordered ray edge is true. -/
theorem bundledInfiniteRay_indicators (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) :
    ω ⟨s((bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x).vertex n,
      (bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x).vertex (n + 1)),
      (bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x).adjacent n⟩ = true :=
  (toGraph_adj_iff ω ((bundledInfiniteRay ω hT hEnd x).adjacent n)).mp
    ((infiniteRay_isSimpleRay ω hT hEnd x).2.2 n)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

open LatticeProb SimpleGraph CategoryTheory FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice

noncomputable section

/-- In the actual locally finite connected graph, its unique end characterizes
exactly one infinite component after every finite vertex deletion. -/
theorem unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) :
    ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite := by
  let G := toGraph ω
  let F := G.componentComplFunctor
  letI : Fact G.Preconnected := ⟨hT.connected.preconnected⟩
  obtain ⟨e₀⟩ := hOne.1
  have hML : F.IsMittagLeffler :=
    F.isMittagLeffler_of_exists_finite_range (fun j => ⟨j, 𝟙 j, Set.toFinite _⟩)
  letI : ∀ j, Nonempty (F.toEventualRanges.obj j) := F.toEventualRanges_nonempty hML
  intro K
  refine ⟨e₀.val (Opposite.op K), G.end_componentCompl_infinite e₀ (Opposite.op K), ?_⟩
  intro C hC
  have hCev : C ∈ F.eventualRange (Opposite.op K) :=
    (G.infinite_iff_in_eventualRange C).mp hC
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := F.toEventualRanges.eval_section_surjective_of_surjective
    (F.surjective_toEventualRanges hML) (Opposite.op K) ⟨C, hCev⟩
  let e : G.end := F.toEventualRangesSectionsEquiv s
  have heC : e.val (Opposite.op K) = C := congrArg Subtype.val hs
  have he : e = e₀ := hOne.2.elim e e₀
  rw [he] at heC
  exact heC.symm

/-- The finite-complement and actual inverse-system definitions of one end agree. -/
theorem oneEnded_iff_unique_infinite_components (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω) :
    OneEnded ω ↔ ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite :=
  ⟨unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT, oneEnded_of_unique_infinite_components ω hT⟩

/-- The unique selected neighbor toward the actual tree end. -/
def towardEnd (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω) (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) : Site 2 :=
  infiniteDirection ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x

theorem towardEnd_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x y : Site 2) :
    y = towardEnd ω hT hOne x ↔ (toGraph ω).Adj x y ∧
      (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, y)}).connectedComponentMk y).supp.Infinite :=
  infiniteDirection_characterization ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x y

/-- The actual unique infinite simple ray oriented toward the tree end. -/
def orientedRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω) (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) : SimpleRay :=
  bundledInfiniteRay ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x

theorem orientedRay_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) (r : SimpleRay) :
    r = orientedRay ω hT hOne x ↔ r.vertex 0 = x ∧
      ∀ n, ω ⟨s(r.vertex n, r.vertex (n + 1)), r.adjacent n⟩ = true := by
  unfold orientedRay
  rw [bundledInfiniteRay_characterization]
  exact and_congr_right (fun _ => forall_congr' (fun n => toGraph_adj_iff ω (r.adjacent n)))

theorem existsUnique_orientedRay (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) :
    ∃! r : SimpleRay, r.vertex 0 = x ∧
      ∀ n, ω ⟨s(r.vertex n, r.vertex (n + 1)), r.adjacent n⟩ = true := by
  refine ⟨orientedRay ω hT hOne x, (orientedRay_characterization ω hT hOne x _).mp rfl, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  exact (orientedRay_characterization ω hT hOne x r).mpr hr

/-- The first vertex common to all rays from the actual finite nonempty source set. -/
def earliestCommonAncestor (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω) (hOne : OneEnded ω)
    (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) : Site 2 :=
  commonRayAncestor ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) S hS

theorem earliestCommonAncestor_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) (c : Site 2) :
    c = earliestCommonAncestor ω hT hOne S hS ↔
      (∀ x ∈ S, c ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne x).vertices) ∧
      ∀ d : Site 2, (∀ x ∈ S, d ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne x).vertices) →
        d ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne c).vertices :=
  commonRayAncestor_characterization ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) S hS c

theorem earliestCommonAncestor_unique (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃! c : Site 2,
      (∀ x ∈ S, c ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne x).vertices) ∧
      ∀ d : Site 2, (∀ x ∈ S, d ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne x).vertices) →
        d ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne c).vertices :=
  existsUnique_common_ray_ancestor ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) S hS

theorem earliestCommonAncestor_tails (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ,
      (orientedRay ω hT hOne x).vertex (n + k) =
        (orientedRay ω hT hOne (earliestCommonAncestor ω hT hOne S hS)).vertex k :=
  commonRayAncestor_tails ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) S hS

/-- The original selected lattice edge out of a vertex toward the unique end. -/
def outgoingEdge (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω) (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) : LatticeEdge :=
  outgoingLatticeEdge ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x

theorem outgoingEdge_selected (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) : ω (outgoingEdge ω hT hOne x) = true :=
  outgoingLatticeEdge_selected ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x

/-- The literal vertex component after deleting that vertex's actual outgoing edge. -/
def vertexPast (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω) (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) : Set (Site 2) :=
  rayPast ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x

theorem vertexPast_eq_cutComponent (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) :
    vertexPast ω hT hOne x = cutComponent ω (outgoingEdge ω hT hOne x) x := rfl

theorem vertexPast_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x z : Site 2) :
    z ∈ vertexPast ω hT hOne x ↔ x ∈ (orientedRay ω hT hOne z).vertices :=
  mem_rayPast_iff_ray_passes ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x z

theorem vertexPast_finite (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (x : Site 2) : (vertexPast ω hT hOne x).Finite :=
  rayPast_finite ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) x

theorem sources_mem_earliestCommonAncestor_past (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hOne : OneEnded ω) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (S : Set (Site 2)) ⊆ vertexPast ω hT hOne (earliestCommonAncestor ω hT hOne S hS) :=
  sources_mem_common_ancestor_past ω hT (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded ω hT hOne) S hS

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

/-- One actual UST support witness supplies all sources, ancestors and finite pasts. -/
theorem squareLatticeUST_source_objects :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField), ∃ hT : IsTree ω, ∃ hOne : OneEnded ω,
      (∀ x : Site 2, ∃! r : SimpleRay, r.vertex 0 = x ∧
        ∀ n, ω ⟨s(r.vertex n, r.vertex (n + 1)), r.adjacent n⟩ = true) ∧
      ∀ (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty),
        let c := earliestCommonAncestor ω hT hOne S hS
        let C := vertexPast ω hT hOne c
        C.Finite ∧ (S : Set (Site 2)) ⊆ C ∧ ω (outgoingEdge ω hT hOne c) = true ∧
          ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ,
            (orientedRay ω hT hOne x).vertex (n + k) = (orientedRay ω hT hOne c).vertex k := by
  filter_upwards [squareLatticeUST_ae_tree_oneEnded] with ω hω
  refine ⟨hω.1, hω.2, existsUnique_orientedRay ω hω.1 hω.2, ?_⟩
  intro S hS
  exact ⟨vertexPast_finite ω hω.1 hω.2 _, sources_mem_earliestCommonAncestor_past ω hω.1 hω.2 S hS,
    outgoingEdge_selected ω hω.1 hω.2 _, earliestCommonAncestor_tails ω hω.1 hω.2 S hS⟩

end

    `FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.vertexPast_eq_cutComponent,
    `FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.vertexPast_characterization,
    `FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.vertexPast_finite,
    `FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.sources_mem_earliestCommonAncestor_past]
  for name in pure do
    let axs ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    for ax in axs do
      unless primitives.contains ax do throwError "Nonprimitive {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"PURE_SOURCE_CLOSURE {name}: {axs.toList}"
  let name := `FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.SourceObjectConsumer.squareLatticeUST_source_objects
  let axs ← Lean.collectAxioms name
  for ax in axs do
    unless primitives.contains ax || registered.contains ax do throwError "Unregistered {ax} in {name}"
  logInfo m!"ACTUAL_UST_CONSUMER_CLOSURE {name}: {axs.toList}"

namespace TreeMeasurability11
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.Components

noncomputable section

/-- The full source carrier: actual connected one-ended selected spanning trees. -/
abbrev EndedTree := {ω : EdgeField // IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω}

private theorem ended_support_null :
    (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) {ω | ¬(IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω)} = 0 :=
  ae_iff.mp squareLatticeUST_ae_tree_oneEnded

private theorem ended_support_nullMeasurable :
    NullMeasurableSet {ω : EdgeField | IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω}
      (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) :=
  NullMeasurableSet.of_compl (NullMeasurableSet.of_null ended_support_null)

/-- Pullback of the registered actual law to its full conull source carrier. -/
def endedUST : Measure EndedTree :=
  (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField).comap Subtype.val

theorem endedUST_apply (A : Set EndedTree) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    endedUST A = (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) (Subtype.val '' A) :=
  Measure.comap_apply₀ _ _ Subtype.val_injective
    (fun _ h => MeasureTheory.Measure.MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe ended_support_nullMeasurable h)
    hA.nullMeasurableSet

instance endedUST_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure endedUST where
  measure_univ := by
    rw [endedUST_apply Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ]
    have h : (Subtype.val : EndedTree → EdgeField) '' Set.univ =
        {ω | IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω} := by ext ω; simp
    rw [h]
    have hmass := measure_add_measure_compl₀ ended_support_nullMeasurable
    change (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) {ω | IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω} +
      (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) {ω | ¬(IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω)} =
      (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) Set.univ at hmass
    rw [ended_support_null, add_zero, measure_univ] at hmass
    exact hmass

/-- No UST selection is changed by passing to the source carrier. -/
theorem endedUST_map : endedUST.map (Subtype.val : EndedTree → EdgeField) =
    (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) := by
  ext A hA
  rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_subtype_coe hA,
    endedUST_apply _ (measurable_subtype_coe hA), Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range]
  have hr : Set.range (Subtype.val : EndedTree → EdgeField) =
      {ω | IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω} := by ext ω; simp
  rw [hr]
  exact measure_inter_conull ended_support_null

/-- Every source is retained; a source outside the volume is not silently dropped. -/
def finiteMarks (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Site 2)) : Set (FiniteWired.Vertex N) :=
  some '' {x : FiniteWired.Active N | FiniteWired.site x ∈ S}

theorem finiteMarks_nonempty (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hN : ∀ x ∈ S, FiniteWired.inBox N x) : (finiteMarks N S).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  exact ⟨some (FiniteWired.activeOfSite N x (hN x hx)),
    ⟨FiniteWired.activeOfSite N x (hN x hx), hx, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Actual finite reciprocal, with the specified outside-volume zero extension. -/
def finiteZN (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) : ℝ :=
  if hN : ∀ x ∈ S, FiniteWired.inBox N x then
    WiredTrees.reciprocal N (finiteMarks N S) (finiteMarks_nonempty N S hS hN) t
  else 0

theorem finiteZN_outside (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hN : ¬∀ x ∈ S, FiniteWired.inBox N x) (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) :
    finiteZN N S hS t = 0 := by rw [finiteZN, dif_neg hN]

theorem finiteZN_inside (N : ℕ) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hN : ∀ x ∈ S, FiniteWired.inBox N x) (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) :
    finiteZN N S hS t =
      if (WiredTrees.graph N).ancestorOf t none (finiteMarks N S)
          (finiteMarks_nonempty N S hS hN) ≠ none then
        (1 : ℝ) / ((WiredTrees.graph N).admissibleEdges
          ((WiredTrees.graph N).descendants t none ((WiredTrees.graph N).ancestorOf t none
            (finiteMarks N S) (finiteMarks_nonempty N S hS hN)))
          ((WiredTrees.graph N).span t (finiteMarks N S))).card
      else 0 := by
  rw [finiteZN, dif_pos hN]
  unfold WiredTrees.reciprocal FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph.reciprocalWeight
  split <;> rfl

/-- Each original exit copy retains its own original lattice edge before wiring. -/
def originalCopyEdge {N : ℕ} : FiniteWired.Edge N → LatticeEdge
  | .inl e => interiorEdge e
  | .inr e => ⟨s(FiniteWired.site e.val.1,
      FiniteWired.site e.val.1 + FiniteWired.step e.val.2), by
      rcases e.val.2 with ⟨i, b⟩
      cases b
      · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by simp [FiniteWired.step])⟩
      · exact ⟨i, Or.inl (by simp [FiniteWired.step])⟩⟩

/-- The literal finite path/cut event, including copies crossing the wired boundary. -/
def finiteCutEscape (o : Site 2) (f : LatticeEdge) (M N : ℕ) :
    Set (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree :=
  {t | ∃ a : FiniteWired.Active N, FiniteWired.site a = o ∧
    ∃ e : FiniteWired.Edge N, originalCopyEdge e = f ∧
      e ∈ (WiredTrees.graph N).rootPathCopies t (some a) none ∧
      ¬cutSites a t e ⊆ boxSites M}

/-- Literal positive reciprocal on the full proper source-tree carrier. -/
def infiniteReciprocal (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) (T : EndedTree) : ℝ :=
  (sourceBoundaryCount T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS : ℝ)⁻¹

/-- Membership in the true infinite oriented ray and escape of the actual cut component. -/
def infiniteCutEscape (o : Site 2) (f : LatticeEdge) (M : ℕ) : Set EndedTree :=
  {T | (∃ n : ℕ, f.val = s((orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 o).vertex n,
      (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 o).vertex (n + 1))) ∧
    ¬cutComponent T.val f o ⊆ (boxSites M : Set (Site 2))}

theorem true_span_consumer (T : EndedTree) (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (connectingSites T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS : Set (Site 2)) =
      FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths.connectingSubtree T.property.1 S ∧
    (vertexPast T.val T.property.1 T.property.2
      (earliestCommonAncestor T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS)).Finite ∧
    1 ≤ sourceBoundaryCount T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS :=
  ⟨connectingSites_eq_span _ _ _ _ _, vertexPast_finite _ _ _ _,
    sourceBoundaryCount_ge_one _ _ _ _ _⟩

theorem outside_zero_box_consumer (t : (WiredTrees.graph 0).SpanningTree) :
    finiteZN 0 {unit (0 : Fin 2)} (Finset.singleton_nonempty _) t = 0 := by
  apply finiteZN_outside
  intro h
  have hx := h (unit (0 : Fin 2)) (Finset.mem_singleton_self _) (0 : Fin 2)
  norm_num [unit] at hx

theorem absent_source_cut_consumer (o : Site 2) (h : ¬FiniteWired.inBox 0 o)
    (f : LatticeEdge) (M : ℕ) : finiteCutEscape o f M 0 = ∅ := by
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  rintro t ⟨a, ha, _⟩
  apply h
  rw [← ha]
  exact fun i => (a i).property

theorem exit_copy_identity_consumer {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.ExitEdge N) :
    (originalCopyEdge (Sum.inr e)).val =
      s(FiniteWired.site e.val.1, FiniteWired.site e.val.1 + FiniteWired.step e.val.2) := rfl

theorem original_denominator_consumer (N : ℕ) (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) :
    WiredTrees.law N {t} = (WiredTrees.treeCount N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ :=
  WiredTrees.law_singleton N t

end

namespace TreeMeasurability11
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.Lattice SimpleGraph
noncomputable section

private theorem measurable_adj (x y : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField => (toGraph ω).Adj x y) := by
  by_cases h : (lattice 2).Adj x y
  · simp_rw [toGraph_adj_iff _ h]
    exact (measurable_pi_apply (⟨s(x,y), h⟩ : LatticeEdge) :
      Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField => ω ⟨s(x,y), h⟩)).eq_const true
  · have he : (fun ω : EdgeField => (toGraph ω).Adj x y) = fun _ => False := by
      funext ω; exact propext ⟨fun hx => h (toGraph_le_lattice _ hx), False.elim⟩
    rw [he]; exact measurable_const

private theorem measurable_cut_adj (e : Sym2 (Site 2)) (x y : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField => ((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {e}).Adj x y) := by
  simp_rw [SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  exact (measurable_adj x y).and measurable_const

private def lengthReach (G : SimpleGraph (Site 2)) : ℕ → Site 2 → Site 2 → Prop
  | 0, x, y => x = y
  | n + 1, x, y => ∃ z, G.Adj x z ∧ lengthReach G n z y

private theorem reachable_length (G : SimpleGraph (Site 2)) (x y : Site 2) :
    G.Reachable x y ↔ ∃ n, lengthReach G n x y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p⟩
    induction p with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | @cons x z y h p ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨n + 1, z, h, hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    induction n generalizing x with
    | zero =>
      change x = y at hn
      subst x
      exact .refl _
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨z, hxz, hz⟩ := hn
      exact hxz.reachable.trans (ih z hz)

private theorem measurable_cut_reachable (e : Sym2 (Site 2)) (x y : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField => ((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {e}).Reachable x y) := by
  simp_rw [reachable_length]
  apply Measurable.exists
  intro n
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    change Measurable (fun ω => ∃ z,
      ((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {e}).Adj x z ∧ lengthReach _ n z y)
    exact Measurable.exists (fun z => (measurable_cut_adj e x z).and (ih z))

private theorem component_infinite_iff (G : SimpleGraph (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    (G.connectedComponentMk x).supp.Infinite ↔
      ∀ F : Finset (Site 2), ∃ y, G.Reachable y x ∧ y ∉ F := by
  constructor
  · intro h F
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyF⟩ := h.exists_notMem_finset F
    exact ⟨y, ConnectedComponent.exact hy, hyF⟩
  · intro h hfin
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyF⟩ := h hfin.toFinset
    exact hyF (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr (ConnectedComponent.sound hy))

private theorem measurable_infinite_cut (e : Sym2 (Site 2)) (x : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField =>
      (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {e}).connectedComponentMk x).supp.Infinite) := by
  simp_rw [component_infinite_iff]
  exact Measurable.forall (fun F => Measurable.exists
    (fun y => (measurable_cut_reachable e y x).and measurable_const))

/-- The actual uniquely selected outgoing neighbor is a measurable site. -/
theorem measurable_towardEnd (x : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => towardEnd T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x) := by
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro y
  change MeasurableSet {T : EndedTree | towardEnd T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x = y}
  have hm : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => (toGraph T.val).Adj x y ∧
      (((toGraph T.val).deleteEdges {s(x,y)}).connectedComponentMk y).supp.Infinite) :=
    ((measurable_adj x y).and (measurable_infinite_cut s(x,y) y)).comp measurable_subtype_coe
  convert hm.setOf using 1
  ext T
  exact (eq_comm.trans (towardEnd_characterization T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x y))

/-- Every position on every genuine source ray is measurable, with no invalid-field extension. -/
theorem measurable_rayVertex (x : Site 2) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x).vertex n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    have hd : Measurable (fun p : EndedTree × Site 2 =>
        towardEnd p.1.val p.1.property.1 p.1.property.2 p.2) :=
      measurable_from_prod_countable_left (fun y => measurable_towardEnd y)
    convert hd.comp (measurable_id.prodMk ih) using 1
    funext T
    exact infiniteRay_succ T.val T.property.1
      (unique_infinite_components_of_oneEnded T.val T.property.1 T.property.2) x n

private theorem measurable_rayVisits (x z : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => z ∈ (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x).vertices) :=
  Measurable.exists (fun n => (measurable_rayVertex x n).eq_const z)

/-- Countable ray-visit characterizations make the actual first common ancestor measurable. -/
theorem measurable_earliestCommonAncestor (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => earliestCommonAncestor T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS) := by
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro c
  change MeasurableSet {T : EndedTree | earliestCommonAncestor T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS = c}
  have hcommon (d : Site 2) : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree =>
      ∀ x ∈ S, d ∈ (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x).vertices) :=
    Measurable.forall (fun x => measurable_const.imp (measurable_rayVisits x d))
  have hm := (hcommon c).and (Measurable.forall
    (fun d => (hcommon d).imp (measurable_rayVisits c d)))
  convert hm.setOf using 1
  ext T
  exact eq_comm.trans (earliestCommonAncestor_characterization T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS c)

private def selectedWalk (ω : EdgeField) {x y : Site 2} : (lattice 2).Walk x y → Prop
  | .nil => True
  | @Walk.cons _ _ x z y h p => ω ⟨s(x,z), h⟩ = true ∧ selectedWalk ω p

private theorem measurable_selectedWalk {x y : Site 2} (p : (lattice 2).Walk x y) :
    Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField => selectedWalk ω p) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact measurable_const
  | @cons x z y h p ih =>
    exact ((measurable_pi_apply (⟨s(x,z), h⟩ : LatticeEdge) :
      Measurable (fun ω : EdgeField => ω ⟨s(x,z), h⟩)).eq_const true).and ih

private def liftSelectedWalk (ω : EdgeField) {x y : Site 2}
    (p : (lattice 2).Walk x y) (h : selectedWalk ω p) : (toGraph ω).Walk x y :=
  match p with
  | .nil => .nil
  | @Walk.cons _ _ x _z y hAdj q => .cons ⟨hAdj, h.1⟩ (liftSelectedWalk ω q h.2)

private theorem liftSelectedWalk_support (ω : EdgeField) {x y : Site 2}
    (p : (lattice 2).Walk x y) (h : selectedWalk ω p) :
    (liftSelectedWalk ω p h).support = p.support := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ p ih => exact congrArg (List.cons _) (ih h.2)

private theorem selected_map {ω : EdgeField} {x y : Site 2} (p : (toGraph ω).Walk x y) :
    selectedWalk ω (p.mapLe (toGraph_le_lattice ω)) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => trivial
  | @cons x z y h p ih => exact ⟨(toGraph_adj_iff ω (toGraph_le_lattice ω h)).mp h, ih⟩

private theorem path_member_iff (T : EndedTree) (x y z : Site 2) :
    z ∈ (RootedPaths.path T.property.1 x y).support ↔
      ∃ p : (lattice 2).Path x y, selectedWalk T.val p.val ∧ z ∈ p.val.support := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    let p := RootedPaths.path T.property.1 x y
    refine ⟨⟨p.mapLe (toGraph_le_lattice T.val), ?_⟩, selected_map p, ?_⟩
    · exact (RootedPaths.path_isPath T.property.1 x y).mapLe _
    · simpa only [Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support] using hz
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hz⟩
    have hpath : (liftSelectedWalk T.val p.val hp).IsPath := by
      rw [Walk.isPath_def, liftSelectedWalk_support]
      exact p.property.support_nodup
    rw [RootedPaths.path_eq T.property.1 _ hpath, liftSelectedWalk_support]
    exact hz

private theorem measurable_path_member (x y z : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => z ∈ (RootedPaths.path T.property.1 x y).support) := by
  letI : Countable ((lattice 2).Walk x y) := Walk.support_injective.countable
  simp_rw [path_member_iff]
  exact Measurable.exists (fun p =>
    ((measurable_selectedWalk p.val).comp measurable_subtype_coe).and measurable_const)

/-- Measurability of the true minimal selected subtree, not its ancestor past. -/
theorem measurable_connectingSites (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => connectingSites T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS) := by
  rw [measurable_finset_iff]
  intro z
  have he : (fun T : EndedTree => z ∈ connectingSites T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS) =
      fun T => ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, z ∈ (RootedPaths.path T.property.1 x y).support := by
    funext T
    exact propext (show _ ↔ _ from by
      rw [← Finset.mem_coe, connectingSites_eq_span]
      rfl)
  rw [he]
  exact Measurable.exists (fun x => measurable_const.and (Measurable.exists
    (fun y => measurable_const.and (measurable_path_member x y z))))

private theorem measurable_past_member (x y : Site 2) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => y ∈ vertexPast T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 x) := by
  simp_rw [vertexPast_characterization]
  exact measurable_rayVisits y x

/-- The actual common-ancestor past's complement field is measurable. -/
theorem measurable_sourcePastComplement (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => sourcePastComplement T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS) := by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro y
  have hc := measurable_earliestCommonAncestor S hS
  have hp : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree =>
      y ∈ vertexPast T.val T.property.1 T.property.2
        (earliestCommonAncestor T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS)) := by
    have he : (fun T : EndedTree => y ∈ vertexPast T.val T.property.1 T.property.2
          (earliestCommonAncestor T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS)) =
        fun T => ∃ c : Site 2, earliestCommonAncestor T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS = c ∧
          y ∈ vertexPast T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 c := by
      funext T; exact propext (by simp)
    rw [he]
    exact Measurable.exists (fun c => (hc.eq_const c).and (measurable_past_member c y))
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro b
  cases b
  · convert hp.setOf using 1
    ext T
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      sourcePastComplement, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_not]
  · convert hp.not.setOf using 1
    ext T
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      sourcePastComplement, decide_eq_true_eq]

private theorem measurable_contacts_pair :
    Measurable (fun p : ColorField × Finset (Site 2) => contacts p.2 p.1) :=
  measurable_from_prod_countable_left (fun K => (continuous_contacts K).measurable)

private theorem measurable_contacts_composition
    (K : EndedTree → Finset (Site 2)) (σ : EndedTree → ColorField)
    (hK : Measurable K) (hσ : Measurable σ) :
    Measurable (fun T => contacts (K T) (σ T)) := by
  have hp : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => (σ T, K T)) := hσ.prodMk hK
  have hm := measurable_contacts_pair.comp hp
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hm

/-- The true random K and true random ancestor past are both consumed in this count. -/
theorem measurable_sourceBoundaryCount (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => sourceBoundaryCount T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS) := by
  unfold sourceBoundaryCount
  exact measurable_contacts_composition
    (fun T => connectingSites T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS)
    (fun T => sourcePastComplement T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS)
    (measurable_connectingSites S hS) (measurable_sourcePastComplement S hS)

theorem measurable_infiniteReciprocal (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Measurable (infiniteReciprocal S hS) := by
  unfold infiniteReciprocal
  exact ((measurable_of_countable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ))).comp
    (measurable_sourceBoundaryCount S hS)).inv

/-- Actual canonical UST reciprocal, with no measurability premise. -/
theorem aemeasurable_infiniteReciprocal (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    AEMeasurable (infiniteReciprocal S hS) endedUST :=
  (measurable_infiniteReciprocal S hS).aemeasurable

theorem infiniteReciprocal_bounds (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) (T : EndedTree) :
    0 ≤ infiniteReciprocal S hS T ∧ infiniteReciprocal S hS T ≤ 1 := by
  unfold infiniteReciprocal
  have hc : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (sourceBoundaryCount T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast sourceBoundaryCount_ge_one T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 S hS
  constructor
  · exact inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hc)
  · simpa only [one_div, inv_one] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hc

theorem integrable_infiniteReciprocal (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Integrable (infiniteReciprocal S hS) endedUST := by
  apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' (measurable_infiniteReciprocal S hS).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro T
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (infiniteReciprocal_bounds S hS T).1]
  exact (infiniteReciprocal_bounds S hS T).2

/-- Every fixed-source, fixed-edge, integer-threshold event uses the full actual ray. -/
theorem measurableSet_infiniteCutEscape (o : Site 2) (f : LatticeEdge) (M : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (infiniteCutEscape o f M) := by
  have hray : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => ∃ n : ℕ,
      f.val = s((orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 o).vertex n,
        (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 o).vertex (n + 1))) := by
    apply Measurable.exists
    intro n
    have hm : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => ∃ u v : Site 2,
        (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 o).vertex n = u ∧
        (orientedRay T.val T.property.1 T.property.2 o).vertex (n+1) = v ∧ f.val = s(u,v)) :=
      Measurable.exists (fun u => Measurable.exists (fun v =>
        (measurable_rayVertex o n).eq_const u |>.and
          ((measurable_rayVertex o (n+1)).eq_const v |>.and measurable_const)))
    convert hm using 1
    funext T
    exact propext (by simp)
  have hsubset : Measurable (fun T : EndedTree =>
      cutComponent T.val f o ⊆ (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.boxSites M : Set (Site 2))) := by
    change Measurable (fun T : EndedTree => ∀ y,
      y ∈ cutComponent T.val f o → y ∈ (FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.boxSites M : Set (Site 2)))
    simp_rw [mem_cutComponent_iff]
    exact Measurable.forall (fun y =>
      ((measurable_cut_reachable f.val y o).comp measurable_subtype_coe).imp measurable_const)
  exact (hray.and hsubset.not).setOf

theorem nullMeasurableSet_infiniteCutEscape (o : Site 2) (f : LatticeEdge) (M : ℕ) :
    NullMeasurableSet (infiniteCutEscape o f M) endedUST :=
  (measurableSet_infiniteCutEscape o f M).nullMeasurableSet

end
end TreeMeasurability11

theorem oneEnded_of_unique_infinite_components (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hK : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2), ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)),
      (SimpleGraph.ComponentCompl.supp C).Infinite) : OneEnded ω := by
  have hT' : (toGraph ω).IsTree := hT
  haveI : Fact (toGraph ω).Preconnected := ⟨hT'.connected.preconnected⟩
  haveI : Infinite (Site 2) := inferInstance
  refine ⟨Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mpr (SimpleGraph.nonempty_ends_of_infinite (toGraph ω)),
    ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext K
  exact (hK K.unop).unique (SimpleGraph.end_componentCompl_infinite _ a K)
    (SimpleGraph.end_componentCompl_infinite _ b K)

theorem squareLatticeUST_ae_tree_oneEnded :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField), IsTree ω ∧ OneEnded ω := by
  filter_upwards [square_lattice_wired_ust_one_tree_one_end squareLatticeUST
    squareLatticeUST_tendsto] with ω hω
  exact ⟨hω.1, oneEnded_of_unique_infinite_components ω hω.1 hω.2⟩

theorem squareLatticeUST_cylinder_tendsto (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (finiteProbability N : Measure EdgeField) (cylinder F p))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) (cylinder F p))) := by
  exact ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto'
    squareLatticeUST_tendsto (E := cylinder F p)
    (by rw [(isClopen_cylinder F p).frontier_eq]; exact measure_empty)

/-- Cylinder probabilities are limits of original copied-tree counts over `treeCount N`. -/
theorem squareLatticeUST_cylinder_count_limit (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ => (Nat.card ({t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree |
          F.restrict (wiredField t) = p} : Set (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) : ℝ≥0∞) /
        WiredTrees.treeCount N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) (cylinder F p))) := by
  apply Filter.Tendsto.congr _ (squareLatticeUST_cylinder_tendsto F p)
  intro N
  change finiteLaw N (cylinder F p) = _
  exact finiteLaw_original_count N (cylinder F p) (measurableSet_cylinder F p)

theorem squareLatticeUST_dual_law :
    (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField).map dualField = (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) :=
  square_lattice_ust_dual_law squareLatticeUST squareLatticeUST_tendsto

/-- `P[e ∈ T] = P[e† ∉ T]` in the face-lattice naming of dual edges. -/
theorem squareLatticeUST_edge_dual (p : Site 2 × Fin 2) :
    (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) {ω | ω (baseEdge p) = true} =
      (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField)
        {ω | ω (baseEdge (p.1 + unit p.2, 1 - p.2)) = false} := by
  have hm : MeasurableSet {ω : EdgeField | ω (baseEdge p) = true} :=
    by
      change MeasurableSet ((fun ω : EdgeField => ω (baseEdge p)) ⁻¹' ({true} : Set Bool))
      exact (measurableSet_singleton true).preimage (measurable_pi_apply _)
  have h := congrArg (fun m : Measure EdgeField => m {ω | ω (baseEdge p) = true})
    squareLatticeUST_dual_law
  simp only [Measure.map_apply measurable_dualField hm] at h
  rw [← h]
  congr 1
  ext ω
  simp [dualField_baseEdge]

theorem squareLatticeUST_edge_add_dual (p : Site 2 × Fin 2) :
    (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField) {ω | ω (baseEdge p) = true} +
      (squareLatticeUST : Measure EdgeField)
        {ω | ω (baseEdge (p.1 + unit p.2, 1 - p.2)) = true} = 1 := by
  have hm : MeasurableSet {ω : EdgeField | ω (baseEdge (p.1 + unit p.2, 1 - p.2)) = true} :=
    by
      change MeasurableSet ((fun ω : EdgeField => ω (baseEdge (p.1 + unit p.2, 1-p.2))) ⁻¹'
        ({true} : Set Bool))
      exact (measurableSet_singleton true).preimage (measurable_pi_apply _)
  have hc : {ω : EdgeField | ω (baseEdge (p.1 + unit p.2, 1 - p.2)) = false} =
      {ω : EdgeField | ω (baseEdge (p.1 + unit p.2, 1 - p.2)) = true}ᶜ := by
    ext ω; simp
  rw [squareLatticeUST_edge_dual p, hc, add_comm, measure_add_measure_compl hm]
  exact measure_univ

end

/-! Genuine finite wired trees mapped to their literal internal lattice-edge
indicators. Every original sink-exit copy is retained in the source law and has
no lattice-edge image. This is a finite law; no infinite UST law is selected. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile MeasureTheory
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section

/-- An original internal wired copy is its actual unordered lattice edge. -/
def interiorEdge {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) : LatticeEdge :=
  ⟨s(FiniteWired.site e.val.1, FiniteWired.site e.val.2),
    by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property; exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩⟩

theorem interiorEdge_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@interiorEdge N) := by
  intro e f h
  have hs := Sym2.eq_iff.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (FiniteWired.site_injective N hs.1)
      (FiniteWired.site_injective N hs.2))
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := f.property
    rw [hs.1, hs.2] at hi
    have hhi := congrFun hi i
    have hhj := congrFun hj i
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [unit] at hhi hhj <;> omega

/-- The finite-copy map is partial precisely at the contracted sink exits. -/
def copyEdge {N : ℕ} : FiniteWired.Edge N → Option LatticeEdge
  | .inl e => some (interiorEdge e)
  | .inr _ => none

theorem copyEdge_internal {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) :
    copyEdge (.inl e) = some (interiorEdge e) := rfl

theorem copyEdge_exit {N : ℕ} (e : FiniteWired.ExitEdge N) :
    copyEdge (.inr e) = none := rfl

/-- Presence means an actual internal original copy belongs to the wired tree.
Absent coordinates, including all edges without an internal representative, are false. -/
def wiredField {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) : EdgeField :=
  fun e => decide (∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N,
    Sum.inl i ∈ t.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e)

theorem wiredField_eq_true {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree)
    (e : LatticeEdge) : wiredField t e = true ↔
      ∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N, Sum.inl i ∈ t.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e := by
  simp only [wiredField, decide_eq_true_eq]

theorem wiredField_internal_iff {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree)
    (i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N) :
    wiredField t (interiorEdge i) = true ↔ Sum.inl i ∈ t.val := by
  rw [wiredField_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, he⟩
    exact (interiorEdge_injective N he) ▸ hj
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

theorem wiredField_eq_false_of_no_internal {N : ℕ} (t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree)
    (e : LatticeEdge) (he : ∀ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N, interiorEdge i ≠ e) :
    wiredField t e = false := by
  have hn : ¬ ∃ i : FiniteWired.InteriorEdge N,
      Sum.inl i ∈ t.val ∧ interiorEdge i = e := by
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact he i hi
  simp [wiredField, hn]

theorem wiredField_measurable (N : ℕ) :
    Measurable (@wiredField N) := measurable_of_finite _

/-- Pushforward of the original complete uniform copied-edge wired tree law. -/
def finiteLaw (N : ℕ) : Measure EdgeField :=
  Measure.map (@wiredField N) (WiredTrees.law N)

instance finiteLaw_probability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteLaw N) :=
  (WiredTrees.law N).isProbabilityMeasure_map (wiredField_measurable N).aemeasurable

theorem finiteLaw_mass_one (N : ℕ) : finiteLaw N Set.univ = 1 := measure_univ

/-- The same actual finite law as a probability-measure element, for weak convergence. -/
def finiteProbability (N : ℕ) : ProbabilityMeasure EdgeField := ⟨finiteLaw N, inferInstance⟩

theorem finiteLaw_apply (N : ℕ) (A : Set EdgeField) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    finiteLaw N A = WiredTrees.law N {t | wiredField t ∈ A} :=
  Measure.map_apply (wiredField_measurable N) hA

theorem finiteLaw_cylinder (N : ℕ) (F : Finset LatticeEdge) (p : F → Bool) :
    finiteLaw N (cylinder F p) = WiredTrees.law N {t | F.restrict (wiredField t) = p} :=
  finiteLaw_apply N _ (measurableSet_cylinder F p)

theorem finiteLaw_original_count (N : ℕ) (A : Set EdgeField) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    finiteLaw N A =
      (Nat.card ({t : (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree | wiredField t ∈ A} :
        Set (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree) : ℝ≥0∞) / WiredTrees.treeCount N := by
  rw [finiteLaw_apply N A hA]
  change uniformMeasure (WiredTrees.graph N).SpanningTree _ = _
  rw [uniformMeasure_apply]
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, WiredTrees.treeCount]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice

Return recurrence (LP Pólya theorem p.38) plus irreducibility gives this equivalent

Wiring removes loops and retains all multiple edges: LP p.26, BLPS p.16. -/

/-- The limit is almost surely a single tree with one end (Pemantle; Benjamini–Lyons–Peres–
Schramm; Lyons–Peres Theorems 10.30, 10.36, 10.41; BLPS Theorem12.4;
Járai Theorem3(i)). One end uses LP p.242's finite-complement component criterion.
It mathematically implies unique rays from each vertex in this locally finite tree
(LP Example7.1 p.236, ray definition p.364), but this input supplies only the
component criterion: the Lean ray/orientation bridge remains an internal proof. -/
axiom square_lattice_wired_ust_one_tree_one_end
    (ν : ProbabilityMeasure EdgeField)
    (hν : Filter.Tendsto finiteProbability Filter.atTop (nhds ν)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(ν : Measure EdgeField), IsTree ω ∧
      ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),

          (SimpleGraph.ComponentCompl.supp C).Infinite

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice.EdgeCuts

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Lattice
open LatticeProb SimpleGraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

private def vertexComplementToCut (ω : EdgeField) (x y : Site 2) :
    (toGraph ω).induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Site 2)) →g
      (toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, y)} where
  toFun := Subtype.val
  map_rel' := by
    intro a b hab
    apply SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj.mpr
    refine ⟨hab, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro heq
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp heq with h | h
    · exact a.property (by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h.1)
    · exact b.property (by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h.2)

/-- Beyond a selected tree edge, the edge-cut component is the component
obtained by deleting its starting vertex. -/
theorem adjacent_cut_component_eq_vertex_complement (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (x y : Site 2) (hxy : (toGraph ω).Adj x y) :
    (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, y)}).connectedComponentMk y).supp =
      ((toGraph ω).componentComplMk
        (show y ∉ ({x} : Set (Site 2)) from fun h => hxy.ne' (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h))).supp := by
  let G := toGraph ω
  let D := G.deleteEdges {s(x, y)}
  have hbr : ¬ D.Reachable x y :=
    (SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge.mp hT.isAcyclic) hxy
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hreach : D.Reachable y z := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact hz).symm
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hreach
    have havoid : ∀ a ∈ p.support, a ∈ ({x}ᶜ : Set (Site 2)) := by
      intro a ha hax
      have hax' : a = x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hax
      exact hbr ((hax' ▸ (p.takeUntil a ha).reachable).symm)
    let f : D.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Site 2)) →g G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Site 2)) :=
      ⟨id, fun h => h.1⟩
    have hp := ((p.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Site 2)) havoid).map f).reachable
    exact ⟨havoid z p.end_mem_support, SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound hp.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hzx, hz⟩
    have hp := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact hz
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound (hp.map (vertexComplementToCut ω x y))

private theorem adjacent_complement_injective (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (x y z : Site 2) (hxy : (toGraph ω).Adj x y) (hxz : (toGraph ω).Adj x z)
    (heq : (toGraph ω).componentComplMk
        (show y ∉ ({x} : Set (Site 2)) from fun h => hxy.ne' (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h)) =
      (toGraph ω).componentComplMk
        (show z ∉ ({x} : Set (Site 2)) from fun h => hxz.ne' (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h))) :
    y = z := by
  by_contra hyz
  have hp := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact heq).map (vertexComplementToCut ω x y)
  have hzx : ((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, y)}).Adj z x := by
    apply SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj.mpr
    refine ⟨hxz.symm, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro he
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp he with h | h
    · exact hxy.ne h.2
    · exact hyz h.1.symm
  exact ((SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge.mp hT.isAcyclic) hxy)
    (hp.trans hzx.reachable).symm

/-- Exactly one actual neighbor lies on the infinite side of its edge cut. -/
theorem existsUnique_infinite_direction (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) :
    ∃! y : Site 2, (toGraph ω).Adj x y ∧
      (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, y)}).connectedComponentMk y).supp.Infinite := by
  have hxEnd : ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl ({x} : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite :=
    by
      have h := hEnd ({x} : Finset (Site 2))
      rw [Finset.coe_singleton] at h
      exact h
  obtain ⟨C, hCinf, hCunique⟩ := hxEnd
  obtain ⟨⟨y, z⟩, hyC, hzx, hyz⟩ := C.exists_adj_boundary_pair
    hT.connected.preconnected (Set.singleton_nonempty x)
  have hzx' : z = x := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hzx
  subst z
  have hxy := hyz.symm
  have hyCeq : (toGraph ω).componentComplMk
      (show y ∉ ({x} : Set (Site 2)) from fun h => hxy.ne' (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h)) = C :=
    hyC.choose_spec
  refine ⟨y, ⟨hxy, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [adjacent_cut_component_eq_vertex_complement ω hT x y hxy, hyCeq]
    exact hCinf
  · rintro z ⟨hxz, hzinf⟩
    rw [adjacent_cut_component_eq_vertex_complement ω hT x z hxz] at hzinf
    have hzCeq := hCunique _ hzinf
    exact adjacent_complement_injective ω hT x z y hxz hxy (hzCeq.trans hyCeq.symm)

/-- The neighbor toward the unique end, selected from proved uniqueness. -/
def infiniteDirection (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) : Site 2 :=
  Classical.choose (existsUnique_infinite_direction ω hT hEnd x).exists

theorem infiniteDirection_spec (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) :
    (toGraph ω).Adj x (infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x) ∧
      (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x)}).connectedComponentMk
        (infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x)).supp.Infinite :=
  Classical.choose_spec (existsUnique_infinite_direction ω hT hEnd x).exists

theorem infiniteDirection_characterization (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x y : Site 2) :
    y = infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x ↔ (toGraph ω).Adj x y ∧
      (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, y)}).connectedComponentMk y).supp.Infinite := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd x
  · intro hy
    exact (existsUnique_infinite_direction ω hT hEnd x).unique hy
      (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd x)

/-- The starting side of the outgoing edge is finite. -/
theorem infiniteDirection_start_finite (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) :
    (((toGraph ω).deleteEdges {s(x, infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x)}).connectedComponentMk
      x).supp.Finite := by
  obtain ⟨hxy, hyinf⟩ := infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd x
  let e : LatticeEdge := ⟨s(x, infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x), toGraph_le_lattice ω hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, hu⟩ := cutGraph_existsUnique_infinite ω hT hEnd e
  by_contra hxinf
  have heq := (hu _ hxinf).trans (hu _ hyinf).symm
  exact ((SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge.mp hT.isAcyclic) hxy)
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact heq)

theorem infiniteDirection_no_backtrack (ω : EdgeField) (hT : IsTree ω)
    (hEnd : ∀ K : Finset (Site 2),
      ∃! C : (toGraph ω).ComponentCompl (K : Set (Site 2)), C.supp.Infinite)
    (x : Site 2) :
    infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd (infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x) ≠ x := by
  intro hback
  have hInf := (infiniteDirection_spec ω hT hEnd (infiniteDirection ω hT hEnd x)).2
  rw [hback, Sym2.eq_swap] at hInf
  exact hInf (infiniteDirection_start_finite ω hT hEnd x)

end
