/-! Literal boundary-angle order and finite crossing predicates.
Exact declaration bodies extracted from the independently checked private support;
this module constructs no boundary angles from a drawing. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-- The six specified points occur counterclockwise on the actual unit circle. -/
def cyclic_order {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}
    (drawing : Drawing J) (x : Fin 6 → V) : Prop :=
  ∃ θ : Fin 6 → ℝ, StrictMono θ ∧ θ 5 < θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    ∀ i, drawing.point (x i) = (Real.cos (θ i),Real.sin (θ i))
end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

/-- Two chords cross exactly when their endpoints alternate in the cyclic order. -/
def chords_cross (a b c d : Fin 6) : Prop :=
  (min a b < min c d ∧ min c d < max a b ∧ max a b < max c d) ∨
  (min c d < min a b ∧ min a b < max c d ∧ max c d < max a b)

/-- A bijection between two ordered triples gives three chords, none of which cross. -/
def triple_noncrossing (U W : Fin 3 → Fin 6) (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬chords_cross (U i) (W (p i)) (U j) (W (p j))
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Trees.GroveNoncrossing

/-! Circle order forces the directions and order of the actual copied tree contacts.
Circle-angle extraction from a simple boundary drawing is a separate geometric step. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

namespace CopiedGraph
variable (J : CopiedGraph V E)

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem reaches_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) {x y : V}
    (h : J.reaches s x y) : J.reaches t x y := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ h ih => exact ih.tail ⟨h.choose,hst h.choose_spec.1,h.choose_spec.2⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem reaches_insert_iff (F : Finset E) (e : E) (x y : V) :
    J.reaches (insert e F) x y ↔ J.reaches F x y ∨
      (J.reaches F x (J.left e) ∧ J.reaches F (J.right e) y) ∨
      (J.reaches F x (J.right e) ∧ J.reaches F (J.left e) y) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Or.inl .refl
    | @tail z y _ h ih =>
      obtain ⟨f,hf,hends⟩ := h
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with rfl | hf
      · rcases hends with hends | hends
        · rw [← hends.1] at ih
          rw [← hends.2]
          rcases ih with h | ⟨h,_⟩ | ⟨h,_⟩
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h,.refl⟩)
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h,.refl⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
        · rw [← hends.1] at ih
          rw [← hends.2]
          rcases ih with h | ⟨h,_⟩ | ⟨h,_⟩
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h,.refl⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h,.refl⟩)
      · have step : J.reaches F z y := .single ⟨f,hf,hends⟩
        exact ih.imp (fun h => h.trans step)
          (fun h => h.imp (fun h => ⟨h.1,h.2.trans step⟩) (fun h => ⟨h.1,h.2.trans step⟩))
  · intro h
    have mono {z w : V} (h : J.reaches F z w) : J.reaches (insert e F) z w :=
      J.reaches_mono (Finset.subset_insert _ _) h
    have step : J.reaches (insert e F) (J.left e) (J.right e) :=
      .single ⟨e,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩
    rcases h with h | ⟨h,k⟩ | ⟨h,k⟩
    · exact mono h
    · exact ((mono h).trans step).trans (mono k)
    · exact ((mono h).trans (J.grove_reaches_symm step)).trans (mono k)

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- Separation of source and ground gives exactly the two endpoint orientations. -/
theorem separating_pairings (T : J.SpanningTree) (e : E) (he : e ∈ T.val)
    (u v : V) (hsep : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v) :
    (J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e) ∧
      J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (J.right e) v) ∨
    (J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.right e) ∧
      J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (J.left e) v) := by
  have h := T.property.2.1 u v
  rw [← Finset.insert_erase he,J.reaches_insert_iff] at h
  exact h.resolve_left hsep

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- The three literal connections remaining after both original copies are erased. -/
theorem two_erased_pairings_of_cuts (T : J.SpanningTree) (u v : V) (e f : E)
    (hef : e ≠ f) (he : e ∈ T.val) (hf : f ∈ T.val)
    (hu : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e))
    (hv : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (J.right e) v)
    (hfu : J.reaches (T.val.erase f) u (J.left f))
    (hsepf : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase f) u v)
    (horder : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left f)) :
    J.reaches ((T.val.erase e).erase f) u (J.left e) ∧
    J.reaches ((T.val.erase e).erase f) (J.right e) (J.left f) ∧
    J.reaches ((T.val.erase e).erase f) (J.right f) v := by
  let F := (T.val.erase e).erase f
  have heq : T.val.erase e = insert f F :=
    (Finset.insert_erase (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hef.symm,hf⟩)).symm
  have mono {x y : V} (h : J.reaches F x y) : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) x y :=
    J.reaches_mono (Finset.erase_subset _ _) h
  have monoF {x y : V} (h : J.reaches F x y) : J.reaches (T.val.erase f) x y :=
    J.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp only [F,Finset.mem_erase] at ha ⊢; exact ⟨ha.1,ha.2.2⟩) h
  have step : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (J.left f) (J.right f) :=
    .single ⟨f,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hef.symm,hf⟩,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩
  have hua : J.reaches F u (J.left e) := by
    rw [heq,J.reaches_insert_iff] at hu
    rcases hu with hu | ⟨h,_⟩ | ⟨h,_⟩
    · exact hu
    · exact (horder (mono h)).elim
    · exact (horder ((mono h).trans (J.grove_reaches_symm step))).elim
  have hub : J.reaches (T.val.erase f) u (J.right e) :=
    (monoF hua).tail ⟨e,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hef,he⟩,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩
  rw [heq,J.reaches_insert_iff] at hv
  rcases hv with hv | ⟨hbc,hdv⟩ | ⟨_,hcv⟩
  · exact (hsepf (hub.trans (monoF hv))).elim
  · exact ⟨hua,hbc,hdv⟩
  · exact (hsepf (hfu.trans (monoF hcv))).elim

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- A simple boundary path uses distinct original copied identifiers, independently of storage orientation. -/
theorem boundary_copies_injective (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m+1) → V)
    (hsimple : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i,
      (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ)) :
    Function.Injective copies := by
  intro i j h
  obtain hi := hends i
  rw [h] at hi
  rcases hi with ⟨ai,bi⟩ | ⟨bi,ai⟩ <;> rcases hends j with ⟨aj,bj⟩ | ⟨bj,aj⟩
  · exact Fin.castSucc_injective m (hsimple (ai.symm.trans aj))
  · have ha := congrArg Fin.val (hsimple (ai.symm.trans aj))
    have hb := congrArg Fin.val (hsimple (bi.symm.trans bj))
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_succ] at ha hb
    omega
  · have ha := congrArg Fin.val (hsimple (bi.symm.trans bj))
    have hb := congrArg Fin.val (hsimple (ai.symm.trans aj))
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_succ] at ha hb
    omega
  · exact Fin.castSucc_injective m (hsimple (bi.symm.trans bj))

end CopiedGraph

namespace Drawing
variable {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : Drawing J)

/-- A source-ground tree path cannot use a boundary copy backwards.
The original storage orientation may be either direction. Endpoint coincidences are included. -/
theorem boundary_copy_forward (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, D.point x ∈ disk) (hedges : ∀ e t, D.curve e t ∈ disk)
    (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m+1) → V) (θ : Fin (m+1) → ℝ)
    (hθ : StrictMono θ) (hspan : θ (Fin.last m) < θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hpoint : ∀ k, D.point (p k) = (Real.cos (θ k),Real.sin (θ k)))
    (k : Fin m) (e : E)
    (hends : (J.left e = p k.castSucc ∧ J.right e = p k.succ) ∨
      (J.right e = p k.castSucc ∧ J.left e = p k.succ))
    (he : e ∈ T.val) (hhit : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p (Fin.last m))) :
    J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p k.castSucc) ∧
      J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p k.succ) (p (Fin.last m)) := by
  have hp : (J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p k.castSucc) ∧
      J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p k.succ) (p (Fin.last m))) ∨
      (J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p k.succ) ∧
      J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p k.castSucc) (p (Fin.last m))) := by
    have h := J.separating_pairings T e he (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) hhit
    rcases hends with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨hb,ha⟩
    · simpa only [ha,hb] using h
    · simpa only [ha,hb,or_comm] using h
  rcases hp with hp | ⟨hub,hav⟩
  · exact hp
  · by_cases hk0 : k.val = 0
    · have hk : k.castSucc = (0 : Fin (m+1)) := Fin.ext hk0
      rw [hk] at hav
      exact (hhit hav).elim
    by_cases hkm : k.succ = Fin.last m
    · rw [hkm] at hub
      exact (hhit hub).elim
    have h0k : (0 : Fin (m+1)) < k.castSucc := by change 0 < k.val; omega
    have hkl : k.castSucc < k.succ := by change k.val < k.val+1; omega
    have hlm : k.succ < Fin.last m := by
      have hn : k.val+1 ≠ m := fun h => hkm (Fin.ext h)
      change k.val+1 < m
      omega
    have hnot : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p k.castSucc) :=
      fun h => hhit (h.trans hav)
    exact (D.grove_alternating_walks_impossible
      (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p k.succ) (p k.castSucc) (p (Fin.last m))
      hub hav hnot hvertices hedges
      (θ 0) (θ k.castSucc) (θ k.succ) (θ (Fin.last m))
      (hθ h0k) (hθ hkl) (hθ hlm) hspan
      (hpoint 0) (hpoint k.succ) (hpoint k.castSucc) (hpoint (Fin.last m))).elim

/-- A later boundary copy lies beyond an earlier used copy's source component. -/
theorem boundary_copies_increasing (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, D.point x ∈ disk) (hedges : ∀ e t, D.curve e t ∈ disk)
    (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m+1) → V) (θ : Fin (m+1) → ℝ)
    (hθ : StrictMono θ) (hspan : θ (Fin.last m) < θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi)
    (hpoint : ∀ k, D.point (p k) = (Real.cos (θ k),Real.sin (θ k)))
    (i j : Fin m) (hij : i < j) (e f : E) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (hei : (J.left e = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right e = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right e = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left e = p i.succ))
    (hfj : (J.left f = p j.castSucc ∧ J.right f = p j.succ) ∨
      (J.right f = p j.castSucc ∧ J.left f = p j.succ))
    (he : e ∈ T.val) (hf : f ∈ T.val)
    (hhit : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p (Fin.last m))) :
    ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p j.castSucc) := by
  intro h
  have hv := (D.boundary_copy_forward T hvertices hedges m p θ hθ hspan hpoint i e hei he hhit).2
  have step : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p j.castSucc) (p j.succ) := by
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
    refine ⟨f,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hef.symm,hf⟩,?_⟩
    rcases hfj with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨hb,ha⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨ha,hb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hb,ha⟩
  have huf := h.trans step
  by_cases hjm : j.succ = Fin.last m
  · rw [hjm] at huf
    exact hhit huf
  have h0i : (0 : Fin (m+1)) < i.succ := by change 0 < i.val+1; omega
  have hij' : i.succ < j.succ := by change i.val+1 < j.val+1; exact Nat.add_lt_add_right hij 1
  have hjm' : j.succ < Fin.last m := by
    have hn : j.val+1 ≠ m := fun h => hjm (Fin.ext h)
    change j.val+1 < m
    omega
  have hn : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p i.succ) := fun h => hhit (h.trans hv)
  exact D.grove_alternating_walks_impossible
    (T.val.erase e) (p 0) (p j.succ) (p i.succ) (p (Fin.last m))
    huf hv hn hvertices hedges
    (θ 0) (θ i.succ) (θ j.succ) (θ (Fin.last m))
    (hθ h0i) (hθ hij') (hθ hjm') hspan
    (hpoint 0) (hpoint j.succ) (hpoint i.succ) (hpoint (Fin.last m))

end Drawing
end

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
noncomputable section

/-- Reflection changes the circle orientation while retaining all original graph copies. -/
def reflectPoint (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ := (z.1, -z.2)

theorem reflectPoint_injective : Function.Injective reflectPoint := by
  intro x y h
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa only [reflectPoint] using congrArg Prod.fst h
  · have := congrArg Prod.snd h
    simpa only [reflectPoint, neg_inj] using this

theorem reflectPoint_mem_disk (z : ℝ × ℝ) : reflectPoint z ∈ disk ↔ z ∈ disk := by
  simp [reflectPoint, disk]

theorem reflectPoint_mem_circle (z : ℝ × ℝ) : reflectPoint z ∈ circle ↔ z ∈ circle := by
  simp [reflectPoint, circle]

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The literal reflected drawing of the same copied graph. -/
def reflect (D : Drawing J) : Drawing J where
  point := fun v => reflectPoint (D.point v)
  point_injective := reflectPoint_injective.comp D.point_injective
  curve := fun e t => reflectPoint (D.curve e t)
  continuous := fun e => (D.continuous e).fst.prodMk (D.continuous e).snd.neg
  injective := fun e _s hs _t ht h => D.injective e hs ht (reflectPoint_injective h)
  start := fun e => congrArg reflectPoint (D.start e)
  finish := fun e => congrArg reflectPoint (D.finish e)
  avoids := fun e t ht0 ht1 v h => D.avoids e t ht0 ht1 v (reflectPoint_injective h)
  intersects := fun e f hef s t h => D.intersects e f hef s t (reflectPoint_injective h)

/-- The actual boundary path has increasing circle coordinates after at most a global reflection. -/
theorem boundary_path_ordered_angles (D : Drawing J) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hp : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i, (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ))
    (hboundary : ∀ i t, D.curve (copies i) t ∈ circle) :
    ∃ D' : Drawing J, (D' = D ∨ D' = D.reflect) ∧
      ∃ θ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ, StrictMono θ ∧
        θ (Fin.last m) < θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi ∧
        ∀ k, D'.point (p k) = (Real.cos (θ k), Real.sin (θ k)) := by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hspan, hpoint⟩ := D.boundary_path_angles m hm p hp copies hends hboundary
  rcases hθ with hθ | hθ
  · refine ⟨D, Or.inl rfl, θ, hθ, ?_, hpoint⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp hspan).2
    linarith
  · refine ⟨D.reflect, Or.inr rfl, fun k => -θ k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      exact neg_lt_neg (hθ hab)
    · have := (abs_lt.mp hspan).1
      dsimp
      linarith
    · intro k
      change reflectPoint (D.point (p k)) = _
      rw [hpoint k]
      simp [reflectPoint]

end Drawing
end

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Circle
import Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Lifting
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue

open Set unitInterval

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-- A simple circle path lifts to increasing or decreasing real angles within one turn. -/
theorem simple_circle_path_angles (f : C(I, Circle)) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ∃ θ : C(I, ℝ), (∀ t, Circle.exp (θ t) = f t) ∧
      (StrictMono θ ∨ StrictAnti θ) ∧ |θ 1 - θ 0| < 2 * Real.pi := by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, _⟩ := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.exists_path_lifts f
    (Complex.arg (f 0)) (Circle.exp_arg (f 0)).symm
  have heq (t : I) : Circle.exp (θ t) = f t := congrFun hθ t
  have hinj : Function.Injective θ := fun s t h => hf ((heq s).symm.trans
    ((congrArg Circle.exp h).trans (heq t)))
  refine ⟨θ, heq, θ.continuous.strictMono_of_inj hinj, ?_⟩
  have hupper : θ 1 - θ 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by
    by_contra hn
    have hle : θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi ≤ θ 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (0 : I) 1 θ.continuous
      (show θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi ∈ Set.Icc (θ 0) (θ 1) from
        ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], hle⟩)
    have hf0 : f t = f 0 := by
      rw [← heq t, ht, Circle.periodic_exp, heq]
    have ht0 := hf hf0
    rw [ht0] at ht
    linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hlower : -(2 * Real.pi) < θ 1 - θ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hle : θ 1 + 2 * Real.pi ≤ θ 0 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (1 : I) 0 θ.continuous
      (show θ 1 + 2 * Real.pi ∈ Set.Icc (θ 1) (θ 0) from
        ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], hle⟩)
    have hf1 : f t = f 1 := by
      rw [← heq t, ht, Circle.periodic_exp, heq]
    have ht1 := hf hf1
    rw [ht1] at ht
    linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨hlower, hupper⟩

#print axioms simple_circle_path_angles

This module proves no graph-to-disk construction or extraction of boundary angles. -/

/-- Two continua containing alternating circle points have a common point. -/
theorem alternating_continua_intersect (θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ θ₄ : ℝ)
    (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (h₂₃ : θ₂ < θ₃) (h₃₄ : θ₃ < θ₄)
    (h₄₁ : θ₄ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)
    (K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : IsConnected K)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hLc : IsConnected L) (hKd : K ⊆ disk) (hLd : L ⊆ disk)
    (h₁ : (Real.cos θ₁, Real.sin θ₁) ∈ K) (h₃ : (Real.cos θ₃, Real.sin θ₃) ∈ K)
    (h₂ : (Real.cos θ₂, Real.sin θ₂) ∈ L) (h₄ : (Real.cos θ₄, Real.sin θ₄) ∈ L) :
    (K ∩ L).Nonempty := by
  apply Set.not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter.mp
  intro hKL
  exact FiniteAvalanches.External.disk_alternation_impossible
    θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ θ₄ h₁₂ h₂₃ h₃₄ h₄₁ K L hK hKc hL hLc hKd hLd hKL h₁ h₃ h₂ h₄

/-- Horizontal and vertical terminal continua meet, even if the continua have no paths. -/
theorem quarter_circle_continua_intersect
    (K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : IsConnected K)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hLc : IsConnected L) (hKd : K ⊆ disk) (hLd : L ⊆ disk)
    (h₁ : (Real.cos 0, Real.sin 0) ∈ K)
    (h₃ : (Real.cos Real.pi, Real.sin Real.pi) ∈ K)
    (h₂ : (Real.cos (Real.pi / 2), Real.sin (Real.pi / 2)) ∈ L)
    (h₄ : (Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 2), Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 2)) ∈ L) :
    (K ∩ L).Nonempty := by
  exact alternating_continua_intersect 0 (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi (3 * Real.pi / 2)
    (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    K L hK hKc hL hLc hKd hLd h₁ h₃ h₂ h₄

/-- Literal copied walks construct the continua consumed by the registered pure input.
The whole-disk drawing and ordered angle equalities are supplied geometric data. -/
theorem alternating_walks_impossible {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : V) (hx : x₀ ∈ C) (hy : y₀ ∈ D)
    (hxx : J.reaches s x₀ x₁) (hyy : J.reaches t y₀ y₁)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk)
    (θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ θ₄ : ℝ)
    (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (h₂₃ : θ₂ < θ₃) (h₃₄ : θ₃ < θ₄)
    (h₄₁ : θ₄ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)
    (p₁ : drawing.point x₀ = (Real.cos θ₁, Real.sin θ₁))
    (p₃ : drawing.point x₁ = (Real.cos θ₃, Real.sin θ₃))
    (p₂ : drawing.point y₀ = (Real.cos θ₂, Real.sin θ₂))
    (p₄ : drawing.point y₁ = (Real.cos θ₄, Real.sin θ₄)) : False := by
  obtain ⟨K, L, hK, hKc, hL, hLc, hKd, hLd, hKL, hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩ :=
    drawing.disjoint_connecting_continua hCD hs ht x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ hx hy hxx hyy hvertices hedges
  exact FiniteAvalanches.External.disk_alternation_impossible
    θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ θ₄ h₁₂ h₂₃ h₃₄ h₄₁ K L hK hKc hL hLc hKd hLd hKL
    (p₁ ▸ hx₀) (p₃ ▸ hx₁) (p₂ ▸ hy₀) (p₄ ▸ hy₁)

No probabilistic or electrical conclusion is included in the drawing data. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
open Trees


/-- A copied graph retains every original ID, including self-loops. -/
structure CopiedGraph (V E : Type) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V

namespace CopiedGraph
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Literal finite copied-walk reachability, including length-zero walks. -/
def reaches (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : Finset E) : V → V → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y => ∃ e ∈ T,
    (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨ (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y))

/-- Ordinary trees on the full original vertex set and original copied IDs. -/
abbrev SpanningTree (J : CopiedGraph V E) := {T : Finset E //
  (Set.univ : Set V).Nonempty ∧ (∀ x y, J.reaches T x y) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, ¬J.reaches (T.erase e) (J.left e) (J.right e)}

/-- The literal separation characterization of original-copy membership on the tree path. -/
noncomputable def pathIndicator (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v then 1 else 0

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- An original loop remains a network copy and is excluded by the actual tree predicate. -/
theorem loop_not_mem (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (e : E) (hloop : J.left e = J.right e) : e ∉ T.val := by
  intro he
  apply T.property.2.2 e he
  rw [hloop]
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

end CopiedGraph

abbrev ArcParameter := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- An actual plane drawing of the copied graph by simple continuous arcs. -/
structure Drawing {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : CopiedGraph V E) where
  point : V → ℝ × ℝ
  point_injective : Function.Injective point
  curve : E → ArcParameter → ℝ × ℝ
  continuous : ∀ e, Continuous (curve e)
  injective : ∀ e, Set.InjOn (curve e) {t | t.val < 1}
  start : ∀ e, curve e ⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.left e)
  finish : ∀ e, curve e ⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.right e)
  avoids : ∀ e t, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → ∀ v, curve e t ≠ point v
  intersects : ∀ e f, e ≠ f → ∀ s t, curve e s = curve f t →
    (s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1)

/-- The Euclidean closed unit disk, in the literal two real coordinates. -/
def disk : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 ≤ 1}
def circle : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 = 1}

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E} (drawing : Drawing J)

/-- An edge curve hits an original vertex exactly at one of its prescribed endpoints. -/
theorem curve_vertex_iff (e : E) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V) :
    drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v ↔
    (t.val = 0 ∧ J.left e = v) ∨ (t.val = 1 ∧ J.right e = v) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ht0 : t.val = 0
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht0
      rw [he, drawing.start] at h
      exact Or.inl ⟨ht0, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    by_cases ht1 : t.val = 1
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht1
      rw [he, drawing.finish] at h
      exact Or.inr ⟨ht1, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    · exact (drawing.avoids e t (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm ht0))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht1) v h).elim
  · rintro (⟨ht, hv⟩ | ⟨ht, hv⟩)
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.start, hv]
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.finish, hv]

/-- Restricting to a nonloop edge turns the literal half-open simplicity into full simplicity. -/
theorem nonloop_curve_injective (e : E) (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Function.Injective (drawing.curve e) := by
  intro s t h
  by_cases hs : s.val = 1
  · have he : s = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hs
    have hv : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [← h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t _).mp hv with ⟨ht, hn⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact Subtype.ext (hs.trans ht.symm)
  by_cases ht : t.val = 1
  · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
    have hv : drawing.curve e s = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e s _).mp hv with ⟨_, hn⟩ | ⟨hs', _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact (hs hs').elim
  · exact drawing.injective e (lt_of_le_of_ne s.property.2 hs)
      (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht) h

/-- The literal geometric realization of a vertex set and its original copied edges. -/
def trace (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (drawing.point '' C) ∪ {z | ∃ e ∈ s, ∃ t, drawing.curve e t = z}

/-- Copied edges supported on C can hit only vertices in C. -/
theorem curve_vertex_mem {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ s) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V)
    (h : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v) : v ∈ C := by
  rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp h with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv⟩
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).1
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).2

/-- Distinct forest components have literally disjoint drawings, even with loops and parallels.
This supplies geometric disjointness to a Jordan argument; no no-crossing conclusion is assumed. -/
theorem traces_disjoint {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E} (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D) :
    Disjoint (drawing.trace C s) (drawing.trace D t) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzC hzD
  rcases hzC with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, he, q, hq⟩
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyx' := drawing.point_injective hyx
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (hyx' ▸ hy)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (drawing.curve_vertex_mem ht f hf r x hr)
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyC : y ∈ C := drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q y (hq.trans hyz.symm)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hyC hy
    · by_cases hef : e = f
      · subst f
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (hs e he).1 (ht e hf).1
      · have hqr := drawing.intersects e f hef q r (hq.trans hr.symm)
        rcases hqr.2 with hr0 | hr1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr0
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.left f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.start]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr1
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.right f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.finish]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).2

/-- A real finite copied walk supplies a compact connected geometric set in its component trace. -/
theorem reachable_continuum {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (_hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) (y : V) (hxy : J.reaches s x y) :
    ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K ⊆ drawing.trace C s ∧
      drawing.point x ∈ K ∧ drawing.point y ∈ K := by
  induction hxy with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨{drawing.point x}, isCompact_singleton, isConnected_singleton, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z = drawing.point x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    subst z
    exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hxK, hyK⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e, he, heyz⟩ := hyz
    let A := Set.range (drawing.curve e)
    have hyA : drawing.point y ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.1]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.1]⟩
    have hzA : drawing.point z ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.2]⟩
    refine ⟨K ∪ A, hKc.union (isCompact_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      hKconn.union ⟨drawing.point y, hyK, hyA⟩ (isConnected_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      ?_, Or.inl hxK, Or.inr hzA⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with hw | ⟨t, ht⟩
    · exact hKt hw
    · exact Or.inr ⟨e, he, t, ht⟩

/-- Two disjoint forest components give disjoint actual continua joining their terminals. -/
theorem disjoint_connecting_continua {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : V) (hx : x₀ ∈ C) (hy : y₀ ∈ D)
    (hxx : J.reaches s x₀ x₁) (hyy : J.reaches t y₀ y₁)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk) :
    ∃ K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ IsCompact L ∧ IsConnected L ∧
      K ⊆ disk ∧ L ⊆ disk ∧ Disjoint K L ∧
      drawing.point x₀ ∈ K ∧ drawing.point x₁ ∈ K ∧
      drawing.point y₀ ∈ L ∧ drawing.point y₁ ∈ L := by
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hx₀, hx₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum hs x₀ hx x₁ hxx
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLconn, hLt, hy₀, hy₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum ht y₀ hy y₁ hyy
  have htrace (A : Set V) (F : Finset E) : drawing.trace A F ⊆ disk := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, _, q, hq⟩
    · exact hvertices v
    · exact hq ▸ hedges e q
  exact ⟨K, L, hKc, hKconn, hLc, hLconn, hKt.trans (htrace C s),
    hLt.trans (htrace D t), (drawing.traces_disjoint hCD hs ht).mono hKt hLt,
    hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩

end Drawing
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open Set unitInterval
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

namespace Drawing

/-- Either storage direction gives an actual forward arc, with no fabricated curve. -/
theorem oriented_arc (D : Drawing J) (a b : V) (hab : a ≠ b) (e : E)
    (hends : (J.left e = a ∧ J.right e = b) ∨
      (J.right e = a ∧ J.left e = b)) :
    ∃ f : Path (D.point a) (D.point b), Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ t, ∃ s, f t = D.curve e s) ∧
      (∀ t v, f t = D.point v → t = 0 ∨ t = 1) := by
  have hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e := by
    rcases hends with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · simpa [ha, hb] using hab
    · simpa [ha, hb] using hab.symm
  let raw : Path (D.point (J.left e)) (D.point (J.right e)) :=
    ⟨⟨D.curve e, D.continuous e⟩, D.start e, D.finish e⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective raw := D.nonloop_curve_injective e hne
  rcases hends with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · let f := raw.cast (congrArg D.point ha.symm) (congrArg D.point hb.symm)
    refine ⟨f, hi, fun t => ⟨t, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro t v h
    rcases (D.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp h with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext ht)
    · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext ht)
  · let f := raw.symm.cast (congrArg D.point ha.symm) (congrArg D.point hb.symm)
    have hf : Function.Injective f := hi.comp (fun s t h =>
      unitInterval.symm_bijective.injective h)
    refine ⟨f, hf, fun t => ⟨unitInterval.symm t, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro t v h
    rcases (D.curve_vertex_iff e (unitInterval.symm t) v).mp h with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext (by change (t : ℝ) = 1; change 1 - (t : ℝ) = 0 at ht; linarith))
    · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext (by change (t : ℝ) = 0; change 1 - (t : ℝ) = 1 at ht; linarith))

/-- The IDs of a simple boundary path remain distinct even with reversed parallel copies. -/
theorem simple_path_copies_injective (_D : Drawing J) (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m + 1) → V)
    (hp : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i, (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ)) :
    Function.Injective copies := by
  intro i j h
  have hi := hends i
  rw [h] at hi
  rcases hi with ⟨ai, bi⟩ | ⟨bi, ai⟩ <;> rcases hends j with ⟨aj, bj⟩ | ⟨bj, aj⟩
  · exact Fin.castSucc_injective m (hp (ai.symm.trans aj))
  · have ha := congrArg Fin.val (hp (ai.symm.trans aj))
    have hb := congrArg Fin.val (hp (bi.symm.trans bj))
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at ha hb
    omega
  · have ha := congrArg Fin.val (hp (bi.symm.trans bj))
    have hb := congrArg Fin.val (hp (ai.symm.trans aj))
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at ha hb
    omega
  · exact Fin.castSucc_injective m (hp (bi.symm.trans bj))

/-- A nonempty simple boundary path is realized by its actual original curves, in path order. -/
theorem boundary_path_realization (D : Drawing J) (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 2) → V)
    (hp : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (hends : ∀ i, (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ)) :
    ∃ f : Path (D.point (p 0)) (D.point (p (Fin.last (n + 1)))),
      Function.Injective f ∧ ∃ τ : Fin (n + 2) → I,
      StrictMono τ ∧ τ 0 = 0 ∧ τ (Fin.last (n + 1)) = 1 ∧
      (∀ k, f (τ k) = D.point (p k)) ∧
      (∀ t, ∃ i s, f t = D.curve (copies i) s) := by
  have hex (i : Fin (n + 1)) := D.oriented_arc (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)
    (hp.ne (by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp at this)) (copies i) (hends i)
  choose arcs hi hr hv using hex
  have hc : Function.Injective copies := D.simple_path_copies_injective _ _ hp _ hends
  have hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ s t, arcs i s = arcs j t →
      (s = 0 ∨ s = 1) ∧ (t = 0 ∨ t = 1) := by
    intro i j hij s t h
    obtain ⟨s', hs⟩ := hr i s
    obtain ⟨t', ht⟩ := hr j t
    have he := D.intersects _ _ (hc.ne hij) s' t' (hs.symm.trans (h.trans ht))
    have hit (i : Fin (n + 1)) (q : I) (r : ArcParameter)
        (hq : arcs i q = D.curve (copies i) r) (he : r.val = 0 ∨ r.val = 1) : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by
      rcases he with he | he
      · have hr0 : r = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext he
        apply hv i q (J.left (copies i))
        rw [hq, hr0, D.start]
      · have hr1 : r = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext he
        apply hv i q (J.right (copies i))
        rw [hq, hr1, D.finish]
    exact ⟨hit i s s' hs he.1, hit j t t' ht he.2⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, τ, hτ, h0, h1, hvisit, hrange⟩ :=
    simple_chain_realization n (fun k => D.point (p k)) (D.point_injective.comp hp) arcs hi hcross
  refine ⟨f, hf, τ, hτ, h0, h1, hvisit, ?_⟩
  intro t
  obtain ⟨i, s, hs⟩ := hrange t
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hr i s
  exact ⟨i, r, hs.trans hr⟩

end Drawing
end

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DiskDrawing
import Mathlib.Topology.Path
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue

open Set unitInterval

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-- Joining simple paths at their only common point preserves simplicity. -/
theorem path_trans_injective {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {a b c : X}
    (f : Path a b) (g : Path b c) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) (hfg : ∀ s t, f s = g t → f s = b) :
    Function.Injective (f.trans g) := by
  intro s t h
  rw [Path.trans_apply, Path.trans_apply] at h
  split_ifs at h with hs ht ht
  · have hh := congrArg Subtype.val (hf h)
    exact Subtype.ext (by dsimp at hh; linarith)
  · have hb := hfg _ _ h
    have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val (hf (hb.trans f.target.symm))
    have h0 := congrArg Subtype.val (hg (h.symm.trans hb |>.trans g.source.symm))
    exact Subtype.ext (by dsimp at h1 h0; linarith)
  · have hb := hfg _ _ h.symm
    have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val (hf (hb.trans f.target.symm))
    have h0 := congrArg Subtype.val (hg (h.trans hb |>.trans g.source.symm))
    exact Subtype.ext (by dsimp at h1 h0; linarith)
  · have hh := congrArg Subtype.val (hg h)
    exact Subtype.ext (by dsimp at hh; linarith)

/-- A finite simple chain of arcs has a simple continuous realization with ordered visit times.
The hypotheses describe the individual arcs and their intersections, not a circle order. -/
theorem simple_chain_realization {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (n + 2) → X) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (arcs : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (hinj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (arcs i))
    (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ s t, arcs i s = arcs j t →
      (s = 0 ∨ s = 1) ∧ (t = 0 ∨ t = 1)) :
    ∃ f : Path (p 0) (p (Fin.last (n + 1))), Function.Injective f ∧
      ∃ τ : Fin (n + 2) → I, StrictMono τ ∧ τ 0 = 0 ∧ τ (Fin.last (n + 1)) = 1 ∧
        (∀ k, f (τ k) = p k) ∧ (∀ t, ∃ i s, f t = arcs i s) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨arcs 0, hinj 0, ![0, 1], ?_, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all
    · intro k
      fin_cases k
      · exact (arcs 0).source
      · exact (arcs 0).target
    · intro t
      exact ⟨0, t, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    let q : Fin (n + 2) → X := fun i => p i.succ
    let tail : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), Path (q i.castSucc) (q i.succ) := fun i => arcs i.succ
    obtain ⟨g, hg, τ, hτ, hτ0, hτ1, hvisit, hrange⟩ :=
      ih q (hp.comp (Fin.succ_injective (n + 2))) tail (fun i => hinj i.succ)
        (fun i j hij => hcross i.succ j.succ (fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective (n + 1) h)))
    let f := (arcs 0).trans g
    have hmeet : ∀ s t, arcs 0 s = g t → arcs 0 s = p (Fin.succ 0) := by
      intro s t h
      obtain ⟨i, r, hr⟩ := hrange t
      have hx := hcross 0 i.succ (by intro he; have := congrArg Fin.val he; simp at this)
        s r (h.trans hr)
      rcases hx.1 with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hx.2 with rfl | rfl
      · have he := hp ((arcs 0).source.symm.trans ((h.trans hr).trans (arcs i.succ).source))
        have := congrArg Fin.val he
        simp at this
      · have he := hp ((arcs 0).source.symm.trans ((h.trans hr).trans (arcs i.succ).target))
        have := congrArg Fin.val he
        simp at this
      · exact (arcs 0).target
      · exact (arcs 0).target
    let shift (t : I) : I :=
      ⟨((t : ℝ) + 1) / 2, by constructor <;> linarith [t.property.1, t.property.2]⟩
    let times : Fin (n + 3) → I := Fin.cons 0 (fun i => shift (τ i))
    refine ⟨f, path_trans_injective _ _ (hinj 0) hg hmeet, times, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      cases a using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
        cases b using Fin.cases with
        | zero => exact (lt_irrefl _ hab).elim
        | succ b =>
          change (0 : ℝ) < ((τ b : ℝ) + 1) / 2
          linarith [(τ b).property.1]
      | succ a =>
        cases b using Fin.cases with
        | zero => exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.zero_le _) hab).elim
        | succ b =>
          have ht := hτ (by change a.val < b.val; have hh : a.val + 1 < b.val + 1 := hab; omega)
          change ((τ a : ℝ) + 1) / 2 < ((τ b : ℝ) + 1) / 2
          have ht' : (τ a : ℝ) < τ b := ht
          linarith
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change ((τ (Fin.last (n + 1)) : ℝ) + 1) / 2 = 1
      rw [hτ1]
      norm_num
    · intro k
      cases k using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact f.source
      | succ k =>
        change f (shift (τ k)) = q k
        have hh : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (shift (τ k) : ℝ) := by
          change 1 / 2 ≤ ((τ k : ℝ) + 1) / 2
          linarith [(τ k).property.1]
        have hn : 2 * (shift (τ k) : ℝ) - 1 = (τ k : ℝ) := by
          change 2 * (((τ k : ℝ) + 1) / 2) - 1 = (τ k : ℝ)
          ring
        calc
          f (shift (τ k)) = f.extend (shift (τ k)) := (Path.extend_apply _ _).symm
          _ = g.extend (2 * (shift (τ k) : ℝ) - 1) :=
            Path.extend_trans_of_half_le _ _ hh
          _ = g (τ k) := by rw [hn, Path.extend_apply]
          _ = q k := hvisit k
    · intro t
      have ht : f t ∈ Set.range (arcs 0) ∪ Set.range g := by
        rw [← Path.trans_range]
        exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
      rcases ht with ⟨s, hs⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩
      · exact ⟨0, s, hs.symm⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, r, hr⟩ := hrange s
        exact ⟨i.succ, r, hs.symm.trans hr⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-! Unit injection and extraction for the actual grounded Green voltage. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- The grounded vertex extracts exactly one unit when the injection vertex is distinct. -/
theorem groundedGreen_laplacian_ground (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (u : V) (hu : u ≠ v) :
    laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc u) v = -1 := by
  have h : (∑ x, (laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc u) x-(if x = u then (1 : ℝ) else 0))) =
      laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc u) v := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single v]
    · rw [if_neg hu.symm,sub_zero]
    · intro x _ hx
      rw [groundedGreen_laplacian a b v hc u x hx,sub_self]
    · simp
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,sum_laplacian_eq_zero] at h
  simp at h
  exact h.symm

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef

/-! The grounded Green kernel of the actual positive copied Laplacian. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Arbitrary Poisson data have a unique zero-ground solution on a connected copied network. -/
theorem existsUnique_grounded_poisson (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) :
    ∃! f : V → ℝ, f v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b f x = r x := by
  let B : Finset V := {v}
  have hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y := fun x => ⟨v,by simp [B],hc x v⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB)
    (fun x => r x.val)
  have hspec : zeroExtend B u v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = r x := by
    constructor
    · simp [zeroExtend,B]
    · intro x hx
      exact congrFun hu ⟨x,by simpa [B] using hx⟩
  refine ⟨zeroExtend B u,hspec,?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hz : f-zeroExtend B u = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
    · intro x hx
      have h : x = v := by simpa [B] using hx
      subst x
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply,hf.1,hspec.1,sub_self]
    · intro x hx
      have h : x ≠ v := by simpa [B] using hx
      rw [laplacian_sub,hf.2 x h,hspec.2 x h,sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- Selected only after the Poisson existence and uniqueness theorem. -/
noncomputable def groundedPoisson (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose

theorem groundedPoisson_spec (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) :
    groundedPoisson a b v hc r v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b (groundedPoisson a b v hc r) x = r x :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose_spec.1

theorem groundedPoisson_eq (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : f v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b f x = r x) : f = groundedPoisson a b v hc r :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose_spec.2 f hf

/-- Unit injection at x and grounding at v; injection at v gives the identically zero row. -/
noncomputable def groundedGreen (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  groundedPoisson a b v hc (fun z => if z = x then 1 else 0) y

theorem groundedGreen_ground (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) : groundedGreen a b v hc x v = 0 :=
  (groundedPoisson_spec a b v hc _).1

theorem groundedGreen_laplacian (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) (hy : y ≠ v) :
    laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) y = if y = x then 1 else 0 :=
  (groundedPoisson_spec a b v hc _).2 y hy

theorem groundedGreen_ground_source (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) : groundedGreen a b v hc v = 0 := by
  apply (groundedPoisson_eq a b v hc _ 0 ?_).symm
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [if_neg hx]
  change laplacian a b (fun _ => 0) x = 0
  exact laplacian_const a b 0 x

/-- Pairing with a zero-ground function removes only the actual ground term. -/
theorem groundedGreen_pairing (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f v = 0) :
    (∑ y, f y*laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) y) = f x := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ y, f y*(if y = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      by_cases hy : y = v
      · subst y; rw [hf,zero_mul,zero_mul]
      · rw [groundedGreen_laplacian a b v hc x y hy]
    _ = f x := by simp

/-- Reciprocity follows from the literal copied-edge incidence pairing. -/
theorem groundedGreen_symm (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) :
    groundedGreen a b v hc x y = groundedGreen a b v hc y x := by
  have hxy := groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc x (groundedGreen a b v hc y) (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc y)
  have hyx := groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc y (groundedGreen a b v hc x) (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc x)
  rw [incidence_sum] at hxy hyx
  have hs : (∑ e, (groundedGreen a b v hc x (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc x (b e))*
      (groundedGreen a b v hc y (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc y (b e))) =
      ∑ e, (groundedGreen a b v hc y (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc y (b e))*
        (groundedGreen a b v hc x (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc x (b e)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    ring
  exact hyx.symm.trans (hs.symm.trans hxy)

/-- Unit-current energy equals the actual Green diagonal, with E counted once. -/
theorem energy_groundedGreen_eq (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) :
    energy a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) = groundedGreen a b v hc x x := by
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
  exact groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc x _ (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc x)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max

/-! Maximum principle on the finite edge-copy network. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem eq_of_laplacian_eq_zero_of_max (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) (x : V)
    (hh : laplacian a b f x = 0) (hm : ∀ y, f y ≤ f x)
    {y : V} (hxy : (supportGraph a b).Adj x y) : f y = f x := by
  have hn (e : E) : 0 ≤
      (if a e = x then f x - f (b e) else 0) +
      (if b e = x then f x - f (a e) else 0) := by
    split_ifs <;> linarith only [hm (a e), hm (b e)]
  have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun e _ => hn e)).mp hh
  obtain ⟨_, e, he⟩ := hxy
  have hez := hz e (Finset.mem_univ e)
  rcases he with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨hb, ha⟩
  · rw [if_pos ha] at hez
    split_ifs at hez <;> rw [hb] at hez <;> linarith only [hez, hm (a e), hm y]
  · rw [if_pos hb] at hez
    split_ifs at hez <;> rw [ha] at hez <;> linarith only [hez, hm (b e), hm y]

theorem le_of_harmonic (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (f : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hfB : ∀ x ∈ B, f x ≤ c)
    (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0) : ∀ x, f x ≤ c := by
  intro x
  by_contra hx
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset V).Nonempty := ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ x⟩
  obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ f hne
  have hm : ∀ y, f y ≤ f z := fun y => hz y (Finset.mem_univ y)
  have hzc : c < f z := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_not_ge hx) (hm x)
  have hprop {u v : V} (hu : f u = f z) (p : (supportGraph a b).Walk u v) :
      f v = f z := by
    induction p with
    | nil => exact hu
    | @cons u w v huw p ih =>
      have huB : u ∉ B := fun huB => (not_le_of_gt hzc) (hu ▸ hfB u huB)
      have huw' := eq_of_laplacian_eq_zero_of_max a b f u (hf u huB)
        (fun y => (hm y).trans_eq hu.symm) huw
      exact ih (huw'.trans hu)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ⟨p⟩⟩ := hB z
  exact (not_le_of_gt hzc) ((hprop rfl p) ▸ hfB y hy)

theorem harmonicExtension_nonneg (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (t : V → ℝ) (ht : ∀ x ∈ B, 0 ≤ t x) :
    ∀ x, 0 ≤ harmonicExtension a b B hB t x := by
  have hs := harmonicExtension_spec a b B hB t
  have hneg := le_of_harmonic a b B hB
    ((-1 : ℝ) • harmonicExtension a b B hB t) 0
    (fun x hx => by simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs.1 x hx]; linarith [ht x hx])
    (fun x hx => by rw [laplacian_smul, hs.2 x hx, mul_zero])
  intro x
  have hx := hneg x
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, neg_one_mul] at hx
  linarith only [hx]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy
import LatticeProb.Network.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-! Aggregating electrical quantities while retaining the original edge-copy index. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Supporting simple graph of the nonloop edge copies. -/
def supportGraph (a b : E → V) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e, (a e = x ∧ b e = y) ∨ (b e = x ∧ a e = y)
  symm := ⟨by
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := h
    exact ⟨Ne.symm hne, e, he.elim (fun h => Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      (fun h => Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro x h; exact h.1 rfl⟩

/-- Conductance equal to edge-copy multiplicity, with loops removed. -/
noncomputable def conductance (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  if x = y then 0 else ∑ e,
    ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then 1 else 0) +
     (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then 1 else 0))

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_nonneg (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : 0 ≤ conductance a b x y := by
  unfold conductance
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun e _ => add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_symm (a b : E → V) (x y : V) :
    conductance a b x y = conductance a b y x := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y; rfl
  simp only [conductance, if_neg hxy, if_neg (Ne.symm hxy)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [and_comm]
  ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem isCond_conductance (a b : E → V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.IsCond (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) := by
  refine ⟨conductance_symm a b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := hxy
    rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro e _
      exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    · refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ e, ?_⟩
      rcases he with he | he
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
  · intro x y hxy
    by_cases hne : x = y
    · simp only [conductance, if_pos hne]
    · rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
      have h1 : ¬ (a e = x ∧ b e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inl he⟩
      have h2 : ¬ (b e = x ∧ a e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inr he⟩
      simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x y : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    conductance a b x y * f y = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then f y else 0) +
       (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then f y else 0)) := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    simp only [conductance, hf, mul_zero, ite_self, add_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · rw [conductance, if_neg hxy, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    simp only [add_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]

theorem sum_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    (∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y) = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x then f (b e) else 0) +
       (if b e = x then f (a e) else 0)) := by
  simp_rw [conductance_mul a b x _ f hf]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_and, Finset.sum_ite_irrel,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem sum_neighbor_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ y ∈ (supportGraph a b).neighborFinset x, conductance a b x y * f y) =
      ∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y := by
  apply LatticeProb.Network.sum_neighborFinset_eq_sum x Finset.univ
  · intro y hxy
    rw [(isCond_conductance a b).zero_of_not_adj hxy, zero_mul]
  · intro y _ _
    exact Finset.mem_univ y

theorem netLaplacian_eq_neg_laplacian (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) h x =
      -laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian, sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
    sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => h y - h x) (sub_self _)]
  unfold laplacian
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

theorem energyOn_eq_two_mul_energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    LatticeProb.Network.energyOn (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) Finset.univ f =
      2 * energy a b f := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.energyOn_eq_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ e, ((if a e = x then (f x - f (b e)) ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if b e = x then (f x - f (a e)) ^ 2 else 0)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      rw [sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
        sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => (f x - f y) ^ 2) (by simp)]
    _ = 2 * energy a b f := ordered_incidence_energy a b f

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.MaximumPrinciple
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.VecNotation

/-! Three-terminal response energy derived from the finite Dirichlet problem. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- The three distinguished terminals, all retained as vertices. -/
noncomputable def terminalSet (r : Fin 3 → V) : Finset V := Finset.univ.image r

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem mem_terminalSet (r : Fin 3 → V) (i : Fin 3) : r i ∈ terminalSet r :=
  Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, rfl⟩

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem mem_terminalSet_iff (r : Fin 3 → V) (x : V) :
    x ∈ terminalSet r ↔ ∃ i, r i = x := by
  simp only [terminalSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

theorem sum_eq_terminal_sum (r : Fin 3 → V) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ terminalSet r → f x = 0) :
    (∑ x, f x) = ∑ i, f (r i) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ terminalSet r, f x :=
      (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun x _ hx => hf x hx)).symm
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ hij => hr hij)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_sum {I : Type*} (a b : E → V) (s : Finset I)
    (f : I → V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y) x = ∑ i ∈ s, laplacian a b (f i) x := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, laplacian_const]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    have h : (fun y => ∑ j ∈ insert i s, f j y) = f i + (fun y => ∑ j ∈ s, f j y) := by
      funext y; rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]; rfl
    rw [h, laplacian_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert hi]

theorem sum_laplacian_eq_zero (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, laplacian a b f x) = 0 := by
  have h := incidence_sum a b f (fun _ => 1)
  simpa only [one_mul, sub_self, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero] using h

/-- The unique harmonic potential for one unit terminal value and two zeros. -/
noncomputable def responseBasis (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (j : Fin 3) : V → ℝ :=
  harmonicExtension a b (terminalSet r) hB (fun x => if x = r j then 1 else 0)

/-- Positive-Laplacian terminal flux, before changing its off-diagonal sign. -/
noncomputable def responseEntry (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (i j : Fin 3) : ℝ := laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) (r i)

theorem responseBasis_terminal (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (i j : Fin 3) :
    responseBasis a b r hB j (r i) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold responseBasis
  rw [(harmonicExtension_spec a b (terminalSet r) hB _).1 _ (mem_terminalSet r i)]
  simp only [hr.eq_iff]

theorem responseBasis_harmonic (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (j : Fin 3) :
    ∀ x, x ∉ terminalSet r → laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) x = 0 :=
  (harmonicExtension_spec a b (terminalSet r) hB _).2

theorem sum_responseEntry_eq_zero (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (j : Fin 3) :
    (∑ i, responseEntry a b r hB i j) = 0 := by
  unfold responseEntry
  rw [← sum_eq_terminal_sum r hr _ (responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB j)]
  exact sum_laplacian_eq_zero a b _

theorem responseEntry_comm (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (i j : Fin 3) :
    responseEntry a b r hB i j = responseEntry a b r hB j i := by
  have hi (j i : Fin 3) :
      (∑ x, responseBasis a b r hB i x * laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) x) =
      responseEntry a b r hB i j := by
    rw [sum_eq_terminal_sum r hr _ (fun x hx => by
      rw [responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB j x hx, mul_zero])]
    simp_rw [responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true, responseEntry]
  rw [← hi j i, ← hi i j, incidence_sum, incidence_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => mul_comm _ _

theorem responseEntry_nonpos (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) : responseEntry a b r hB i j ≤ 0 := by
  have hn := harmonicExtension_nonneg a b (terminalSet r) hB
    (fun x => if x = r j then 1 else 0) (fun x _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  change ∀ x, 0 ≤ responseBasis a b r hB j x at hn
  unfold responseEntry laplacian
  rw [responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB, if_neg hij]
  apply Finset.sum_nonpos
  intro e _
  change (if a e = r i then 0 - responseBasis a b r hB j (b e) else 0) +
    (if b e = r i then 0 - responseBasis a b r hB j (a e) else 0) ≤ 0
  split_ifs <;> linarith only [hn (a e), hn (b e)]

/-- The energy of the proved harmonic extension, as a literal terminal quadratic form. -/
theorem harmonic_extension_energy_eq_response (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    let f : V → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x
    energy a b f = ∑ i, ∑ j, t i * responseEntry a b r hB i j * t j := by
  intro f
  have hf (i : Fin 3) : f (r i) = t i := by
    simp only [f, responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB]
    simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hl (x : V) : laplacian a b f x =
      ∑ j, t j * laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) x := by
    rw [laplacian_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => laplacian_smul a b (t j) _ x
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum, sum_eq_terminal_sum r hr _ (fun x hx => by
    rw [hl]; simp only [responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB _ x hx, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero])]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [hf, hl, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by unfold responseEntry; ring

/-- Once-counted response energy with no arbitrary normalization. -/
theorem three_terminal_response_energy (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x) =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 * (t 0 - t 1) ^ 2 +
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 * (t 0 - t 2) ^ 2 +
      -responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 * (t 1 - t 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [harmonic_extension_energy_eq_response a b r hr hB]
  have h0 := sum_responseEntry_eq_zero a b r hr hB 0
  have h1 := sum_responseEntry_eq_zero a b r hr hB 1
  have h2 := sum_responseEntry_eq_zero a b r hr hB 2
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
  have h10 := responseEntry_comm a b r hr hB 1 0
  have h20 := responseEntry_comm a b r hr hB 2 0
  have h21 := responseEntry_comm a b r hr hB 2 1
  simp only [h10, h20, h21] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
  have hd0 : responseEntry a b r hB 0 0 =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 - responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 := by linarith only [h0]
  have hd1 : responseEntry a b r hB 1 1 =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 - responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 := by linarith only [h1]
  have hd2 : responseEntry a b r hB 2 2 =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 - responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 := by linarith only [h2]
  rw [hd0, hd1, hd2]
  ring

theorem response_potential_spec (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    let h : V → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x
    (∀ i, h (r i) = t i) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ terminalSet r → laplacian a b h x = 0) := by
  intro h
  constructor
  · intro i
    simp only [h, responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB]
    simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  · intro x hx
    rw [laplacian_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    change laplacian a b (t j • responseBasis a b r hB j) x = 0
    rw [laplacian_smul a b (t j), responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB j x hx, mul_zero]

/-- The attained Dirichlet minimum, with no assumed response conclusion. -/
theorem three_terminal_response_minimum (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, f (r i) = t i) :
    -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 * (t 0 - t 1) ^ 2 +
    -responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 * (t 0 - t 2) ^ 2 +
    -responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 * (t 1 - t 2) ^ 2 ≤ energy a b f := by
  let h : V → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x
  have hs := response_potential_spec a b r hr hB t
  rw [← three_terminal_response_energy a b r hr hB t]
  change energy a b h ≤ energy a b f
  rw [energy_eq_add_energy_sub_of_harmonic a b (terminalSet r) f h
    (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      exact (hf i).trans (hs.1 i).symm) hs.2]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (energy_nonneg a b _)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- The signed observable is exactly the difference of the two oriented path indicators. -/
theorem signedPathTraversal_eq_difference (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) :
    J.signedPathTraversal T u v e =
      (if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v ∧
        J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
      (if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v ∧
        J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.right e) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
  by_cases hhit : e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v
  · have hlr : ¬(J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e) ∧
        J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.right e)) := by
      intro h
      have hp := J.separating_pairings T e hhit.1 u v hhit.2
      rcases hp with ⟨_,hrv⟩ | ⟨_,hlv⟩
      · exact hhit.2 (h.2.trans hrv)
      · exact hhit.2 (h.1.trans hlv)
    have hor : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e) ∨
        J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.right e) :=
      (J.separating_pairings T e hhit.1 u v hhit.2).imp And.left And.left
    rcases hor with hl | hr
    · have hn : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.right e) := fun hr => hlr ⟨hl,hr⟩
      simp [signedPathTraversal, hhit.1, hhit.2, hl, hn]
    · have hn : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e) := fun hl => hlr ⟨hl,hr⟩
      simp [signedPathTraversal, hhit.1, hhit.2, hr, hn]
  · have hfalse (P : Prop) : ¬(e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v ∧ P) :=
      fun h => hhit ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩
    simp only [signedPathTraversal, if_neg hhit, if_neg (hfalse _), sub_self]

end CopiedGraph

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Every contacted boundary copy is traversed forwards along the actual boundary path.
One reflection is used only to apply circle separation; stored copied IDs never change. -/
theorem boundary_signedPathTraversal (D : Drawing J) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, D.point x ∈ disk) (hedges : ∀ e t, D.curve e t ∈ disk)
    (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hp : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i, (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ))
    (hboundary : ∀ i t, D.curve (copies i) t ∈ circle) (i : Fin m) :
    J.signedPathTraversal T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i) =
      (if J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
        J.pathIndicator T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i) := by
  by_cases hhit : copies i ∈ T.val ∧
      ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase (copies i)) (p 0) (p (Fin.last m))
  · obtain ⟨D', hD, θ, hθ, hspan, hpoint⟩ :=
      D.boundary_path_ordered_angles m (by have := i.isLt; omega) p hp copies hends hboundary
    have hv : ∀ x, D'.point x ∈ disk := by
      rcases hD with rfl | rfl
      · exact hvertices
      · exact fun x => (reflectPoint_mem_disk _).mpr (hvertices x)
    have he : ∀ e t, D'.curve e t ∈ disk := by
      rcases hD with rfl | rfl
      · exact hedges
      · exact fun e t => (reflectPoint_mem_disk _).mpr (hedges e t)
    have hforward := D'.boundary_copy_forward T hv he m p θ hθ hspan hpoint
      i (copies i) (hends i) hhit.1 hhit.2
    have hne : p i.succ ≠ p i.castSucc := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val (hp h)
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at this
      omega
    rcases hends i with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hr, hl⟩
    · have hreach : J.reaches (T.val.erase (copies i)) (p 0) (J.left (copies i)) :=
        by simpa only [hl] using hforward.1
      rw [CopiedGraph.signedPathTraversal, if_pos hhit, if_pos hreach,
        CopiedGraph.pathIndicator, if_pos hhit]
      simp only [hl, ↓reduceIte, mul_one]
    · have hnot : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase (copies i)) (p 0) (J.left (copies i)) := by
        rw [hl]
        exact fun h => hhit.2 (h.trans hforward.2)
      rw [CopiedGraph.signedPathTraversal, if_pos hhit, if_neg hnot,
        CopiedGraph.pathIndicator, if_pos hhit]
      simp only [hl, if_neg hne, mul_one]
  · simp [CopiedGraph.signedPathTraversal, CopiedGraph.pathIndicator, hhit]

/-- Reorient the signed tree traversal before averaging on the full original tree carrier. -/
theorem boundary_pathIndicator_average_eq (D : Drawing J)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, D.point x ∈ disk) (hedges : ∀ e t, D.curve e t ∈ disk)
    (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hp : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i, (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ))
    (hboundary : ∀ i t, D.curve (copies i) t ∈ circle) (i : Fin m) :
    (∑ T : J.SpanningTree, J.pathIndicator T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i)) /
      (Fintype.card J.SpanningTree : ℝ) =
    (if J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
      ((∑ T : J.SpanningTree,
        J.signedPathTraversal T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i)) /
        (Fintype.card J.SpanningTree : ℝ)) := by
  have hsum : (∑ T : J.SpanningTree,
      J.signedPathTraversal T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i)) =
      (if J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
        (∑ T : J.SpanningTree, J.pathIndicator T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ =>
      D.boundary_signedPathTraversal T hvertices hedges m p hp copies hends hboundary i
  rw [hsum]
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- The source boundary mean is exactly the classical stored-current specialization.
This equivalence does not assume either mean identity. -/
theorem boundary_first_moment_iff (D : Drawing J)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, D.point x ∈ disk) (hedges : ∀ e t, D.curve e t ∈ disk)
    (m : ℕ) (p : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hp : Function.Injective p) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i, (J.left (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = p i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = p i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = p i.succ))
    (hboundary : ∀ i t, D.curve (copies i) t ∈ circle)
    (hc : (FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (i : Fin m) :
    ((∑ T : J.SpanningTree, J.pathIndicator T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i)) /
      (Fintype.card J.SpanningTree : ℝ) =
      FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.groundedGreen J.left J.right (p (Fin.last m)) hc (p 0)
        (p i.castSucc) -
      FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.groundedGreen J.left J.right (p (Fin.last m)) hc (p 0)
        (p i.succ)) ↔
    ((∑ T : J.SpanningTree, J.signedPathTraversal T (p 0) (p (Fin.last m)) (copies i)) /
      (Fintype.card J.SpanningTree : ℝ) =
      FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.groundedGreen J.left J.right (p (Fin.last m)) hc (p 0)
        (J.left (copies i)) -
      FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.groundedGreen J.left J.right (p (Fin.last m)) hc (p 0)
        (J.right (copies i))) := by
  have haverage := D.boundary_pathIndicator_average_eq hvertices hedges m p hp copies hends hboundary i
  have hcurrent := J.stored_current_reorient
    (FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.groundedGreen J.left J.right (p (Fin.last m)) hc (p 0))
    (copies i) (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ) (hends i)
  rw [haverage, ← hcurrent]
  split_ifs <;> constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

end Drawing

/-! Actual copied-grove noncrossing and crossing count zero in a closed disk.
The generic source section is copied byte for byte; whole-disk drawing and
literal six-angle cyclic order remain explicit geometric data. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

namespace CopiedGraph
variable {V E : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E)

/-- The actual component of a vertex in an original-copy edge subset. -/
def groveComponent (F : Finset E) (root : V) : Set V :=
  {x | J.reaches F root x}

/-- Keep the original IDs in the component, including their multiplicities. -/
def groveComponentCopies (F : Finset E) (root : V) : Finset E :=
  F.filter (fun e => J.left e ∈ J.groveComponent F root)

/-- Reversing an actual copied walk changes no copy IDs. -/
theorem grove_reaches_symm {F : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : J.reaches F x y) :
    J.reaches F y x := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, hends⟩ := hyz
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.head _ ih
    exact ⟨e, he, hends.elim (fun h => Or.inr ⟨h.2,h.1⟩)
      (fun h => Or.inl ⟨h.2,h.1⟩)⟩

/-- Component restriction retains both actual endpoints of every selected copy. -/
theorem grove_component_copies_supported (F : Finset E) (root : V) :
    ∀ e ∈ J.groveComponentCopies F root,
      J.left e ∈ J.groveComponent F root ∧ J.right e ∈ J.groveComponent F root := by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨hes, hl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp he
  exact ⟨hl, hl.tail ⟨e,hes,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩⟩

/-- The restriction retains every literal walk from its root. -/
theorem reaches_grove_component_copies {F : Finset E} {root y : V}
    (h : J.reaches F root y) : J.reaches (J.groveComponentCopies F root) root y := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, hends⟩ := hyz
    have hl : J.left e ∈ J.groveComponent F root := by
      rcases hends with hends | hends
      · exact hends.1 ▸ h
      · exact h.tail ⟨e,he,Or.inr ⟨hends.1,rfl⟩⟩
    exact ih.tail ⟨e,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he,hl⟩,hends⟩

/-- Component disjointness comes from the actual copied reachability relation. -/
theorem grove_components_disjoint {F : Finset E} {x y : V}
    (hxy : ¬J.reaches F x y) :
    Disjoint (J.groveComponent F x) (J.groveComponent F y) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hxz hyz
  exact hxy (hxz.trans (J.grove_reaches_symm hyz))
end CopiedGraph

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E} (drawing : Drawing J)

/-- Two separated actual copied components cannot join alternating disk terminals. -/
theorem grove_alternating_walks_impossible
    (F : Finset E) (a b c d : V)
    (hab : J.reaches F a b) (hcd : J.reaches F c d) (hac : ¬J.reaches F a c)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk)
    (θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ : ℝ)
    (h₀₁ : θ₀ < θ₁) (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (h₂₃ : θ₂ < θ₃)
    (h₃₀ : θ₃ < θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi)
    (pa : drawing.point a = (Real.cos θ₀,Real.sin θ₀))
    (pb : drawing.point b = (Real.cos θ₂,Real.sin θ₂))
    (pc : drawing.point c = (Real.cos θ₁,Real.sin θ₁))
    (pd : drawing.point d = (Real.cos θ₃,Real.sin θ₃)) : False := by
  exact drawing.alternating_walks_impossible (J.grove_components_disjoint hac)
    (J.grove_component_copies_supported F a) (J.grove_component_copies_supported F c)
    a b c d Relation.ReflTransGen.refl Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    (J.reaches_grove_component_copies hab) (J.reaches_grove_component_copies hcd)
    hvertices hedges θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ h₀₁ h₁₂ h₂₃ h₃₀ pa pb pc pd

/-- Every literal paired grove on six cyclically ordered disk terminals is noncrossing. -/
theorem pairing_grove_noncrossing (x : Fin 6 → V)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk)
    (horder : cyclic_order drawing x)
    (U W : Fin 3 → Fin 6) (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (F : J.PairingGrove (x ∘ U) (x ∘ W) p) : triple_noncrossing U W p := by
  obtain ⟨θ,hmono,hspan,hpoints⟩ := horder
  have hr (r : Fin 3) : J.reaches F.val (x (U r)) (x (W (p r))) :=
    (F.property.2.2.1 r (p r)).mpr rfl
  have hmin (r : Fin 3) : J.reaches F.val (x (U r)) (x (min (U r) (W (p r)))) := by
    by_cases h : U r ≤ W (p r)
    · rw [min_eq_left h]; exact .refl
    · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]; exact hr r
  have hmax (r : Fin 3) : J.reaches F.val (x (U r)) (x (max (U r) (W (p r)))) := by
    by_cases h : U r ≤ W (p r)
    · rw [max_eq_right h]; exact hr r
    · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge h)]; exact .refl
  have hh (r : Fin 3) : J.reaches F.val (x (min (U r) (W (p r))))
      (x (max (U r) (W (p r)))) := (J.grove_reaches_symm (hmin r)).trans (hmax r)
  have hsep (r s : Fin 3) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
      ¬J.reaches F.val (x (min (U r) (W (p r)))) (x (min (U s) (W (p s)))) := by
    intro h
    exact F.property.2.2.2 r s hrs ((hmin r).trans (h.trans (J.grove_reaches_symm (hmin s))))
  have hcontr (r s : Fin 3) (hrs : r ≠ s)
      (h₀₁ : min (U r) (W (p r)) < min (U s) (W (p s)))
      (h₁₂ : min (U s) (W (p s)) < max (U r) (W (p r)))
      (h₂₃ : max (U r) (W (p r)) < max (U s) (W (p s))) : False := by
    have hlast : θ (max (U s) (W (p s))) < θ (min (U r) (W (p r))) + 2 * Real.pi := by
      calc
        _ ≤ θ 5 := hmono.monotone
          (show max (U s) (W (p s)) ≤ (5 : Fin 6) by omega)
        _ < θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi := hspan
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (hmono.monotone
          (show (0 : Fin 6) ≤ min (U r) (W (p r)) by omega)) le_rfl
    exact drawing.grove_alternating_walks_impossible F.val _ _ _ _ (hh r) (hh s)
      (hsep r s hrs) hvertices hedges _ _ _ _
      (hmono h₀₁) (hmono h₁₂) (hmono h₂₃) hlast
      (hpoints _) (hpoints _) (hpoints _) (hpoints _)
  intro r s hrs hcross
  rcases hcross with ⟨h₀₁,h₁₂,h₂₃⟩ | ⟨h₀₁,h₁₂,h₂₃⟩
  · exact hcontr r s hrs h₀₁ h₁₂ h₂₃
  · exact hcontr s r hrs.symm h₀₁ h₁₂ h₂₃

/-- The actual paired-grove carrier is empty for a crossing matching. -/
theorem card_pairing_grove_eq_zero_of_crossing (x : Fin 6 → V)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk)
    (horder : cyclic_order drawing x)
    (U W : Fin 3 → Fin 6) (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (hcross : ¬triple_noncrossing U W p) :
    Nat.card (J.PairingGrove (x ∘ U) (x ∘ W) p) = 0 := by
  letI : IsEmpty (J.PairingGrove (x ∘ U) (x ∘ W) p) :=
    ⟨fun F => hcross (drawing.pairing_grove_noncrossing x hvertices hedges horder U W p F)⟩
  exact Nat.card_of_isEmpty
end Drawing
end

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.CopiedGraph

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (J : CopiedGraph V E)

/-- Spanning forest with the prescribed paired terminal components; every component
contains a terminal, and distinct `a` terminals lie in distinct components. -/
abbrev PairingGrove {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → V) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :=
  {F : Finset E //
    (∀ e ∈ F, ¬J.reaches (F.erase e) (J.left e) (J.right e)) ∧
    (∀ y, ∃ r, J.reaches F y (a r) ∨ J.reaches F y (b r)) ∧
    (∀ r s, J.reaches F (a r) (b s) ↔ s = π r) ∧
    (∀ r s, r ≠ s → ¬J.reaches F (a r) (a s))}

end

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.CopiedGraph
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Signed traversal of an original copy on the unique source-to-ground tree path.
The sign is positive in the stored left-to-right direction. -/
def signedPathTraversal (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v then
    if J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e) then 1 else -1
  else 0

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem signedPathTraversal_self (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u : V) (e : E) : J.signedPathTraversal T u u e = 0 := by
  simp only [signedPathTraversal, not_true_eq_false, and_false, ↓reduceIte,
    show J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u u from .refl]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem signedPathTraversal_loop (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) (he : J.left e = J.right e) :
    J.signedPathTraversal T u v e = 0 := by
  simp [signedPathTraversal, J.loop_not_mem T e he]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem abs_signedPathTraversal (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) :
    |J.signedPathTraversal T u v e| = J.pathIndicator T u v e := by
  unfold signedPathTraversal pathIndicator
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- The source component determines the orientation, without choosing a path. -/
theorem signedPathTraversal_eq_of_separates (J : CopiedGraph V E)
    (T : J.SpanningTree) (u v : V) (e : E) (he : e ∈ T.val)
    (hsep : ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v)
    (hl : J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u (J.left e)) :
    J.signedPathTraversal T u v e = 1 := by
  simp [signedPathTraversal, he, hsep, hl]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- Reversing storage reverses the current sign, including zero current and loops. -/
theorem stored_current_reorient (J : CopiedGraph V E) (f : V → ℝ)
    (e : E) (x y : V)
    (hends : (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨
      (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y)) :
    (if J.left e = x then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
      (f (J.left e) - f (J.right e)) = f x - f y := by
  rcases hends with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hr, hl⟩
  · simp [hl, hr]
  · by_cases hxy : y = x
    · simp [hl, hr, hxy]
    · simp [hl, hr, hxy]

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.CopiedGraph

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.CopiedGraph
open scoped Classical BigOperators
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Equal terminals give zero mean and zero electrical current, without a classical input. -/
theorem mean_signedPathTraversal_self (J : CopiedGraph V E) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (e : E) :
    (∑ T : J.SpanningTree, J.signedPathTraversal T v v e) /
      (Fintype.card J.SpanningTree : ℝ) =
      groundedGreen J.left J.right v hc v (J.left e) -
        groundedGreen J.left J.right v hc v (J.right e) := by
  simp [signedPathTraversal_self, groundedGreen_ground_source]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.CopiedGraph
