/-! Audited classical disk-alternation input.
This derived standard result is registered against Thomassen1992 Lemma2.1 and Lemma2.13,
with an independent derivation covering arbitrary compact connected continua.
The registered input is pure topology. It supplies no graph-to-disk construction,
boundary-angle extraction, or manuscript electrical estimate. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-- Classical crosscut corollary of Thomassen1992 Lemma2.1(p118) and Lemma2.13(pp122–123).
Compact connected sets, without a path-connected assumption, are reduced to disjoint
polygonal crosscuts by inward scaling, connected open neighborhoods, radial extension
and finite polygonal loop pruning. Lemma2.13 excludes alternating crosscut endpoints.
No graph, path law, rotation, Euler, response or paper estimate occurs in this input. -/
axiom disk_alternation_impossible (θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ θ₄ : ℝ)
    (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (h₂₃ : θ₂ < θ₃) (h₃₄ : θ₃ < θ₄)
    (h₄₁ : θ₄ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)
    (K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : IsConnected K)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hLc : IsConnected L) (hKd : K ⊆ disk) (hLd : L ⊆ disk)
    (hKL : Disjoint K L)
    (h₁ : (Real.cos θ₁, Real.sin θ₁) ∈ K) (h₃ : (Real.cos θ₃, Real.sin θ₃) ∈ K)
    (h₂ : (Real.cos θ₂, Real.sin θ₂) ∈ L) (h₄ : (Real.cos θ₄, Real.sin θ₄) ∈ L) : False

end FiniteAvalanches.External

@[expose] public section

/-! Rooted joining geometry on ordinary copied-edge spanning-tree subsets. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Ordinary spanning trees are actual subsets of the original edge-copy carrier. -/
abbrev SpanningTree := G.ComponentTree Set.univ

/-- Descendants, including the vertex itself, defined by the unique actual rooted path. -/
def descendants (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) : Set V :=
  {x | ancestor (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r a x}

/-- The actual lowest common ancestor of a nonempty marked set in an ordinary tree. -/
noncomputable def ancestorOf (t : G.SpanningTree) (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) : V :=
  commonAncestor (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r S hS

/-- The actual connecting subtree, independent of the root. -/
def span (t : G.SpanningTree) (S : Set V) : Set V :=
  connectingSubtree (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) S

theorem walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem {t : Finset E} {e : E} {a x y : V}
    (hae : G.left e = a ∨ G.right e = a) (p : (G.toSimple t).Walk x y)
    (ha : a ∉ p.support) : G.reaches (t.erase e) x y := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact .refl
  | @cons x z y hxz q ih =>
    have haq : a ∉ q.support := fun h => ha (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    have hax : a ≠ x := fun h => ha (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
    have haz : a ≠ z := fun h => haq (h ▸ q.start_mem_support)
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.head _ (ih haq)
    rcases hxz with ⟨f, hf, h | h⟩
    · refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, Or.inl h⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      rcases hae with hae | hae
      · exact hax (hae.symm.trans h.1)
      · exact haz (hae.symm.trans h.2)
    · refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, Or.inr h⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      rcases hae with hae | hae
      · exact haz (hae.symm.trans h.2)
      · exact hax (hae.symm.trans h.1)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem walk_mem_side {C : Set V} {t : Finset E}
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C)
    {x y : V} (p : (G.toSimple t).Walk x y) (hx : x ∈ C) :
    ∀ z ∈ p.support, z ∈ C := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro z hz; simpa using (List.mem_singleton.mp hz) ▸ hx
  | @cons x v y h q ih =>
    have hv : v ∈ C := (G.reaches_mem_iff ht (Relation.ReflTransGen.single h)).mp hx
    intro z hz
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
    · exact hx
    · exact ih hv z hz

/-- On a cut tree, the inside endpoint's descendants are exactly the cut component. -/
theorem descendants_eq_cut {C : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C) (r v : V)
    (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    G.descendants ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r v = C := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree p.property.1
  ext x
  change ancestor hT r v x ↔ x ∈ C
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hx
    have hd : G.reaches (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) r x := p.property.2.2.2.2.2 r hr x hx
    obtain ⟨q⟩ := (G.toSimple_reachable _ r x).mpr hd
    have hle : G.toSimple (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) ≤ G.toSimple p.val.1 := by
      intro a b hab
      rcases hab with ⟨e, he, h⟩
      exact ⟨e, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he, h⟩
    let q' : (G.toSimple p.val.1).Walk r x := q.mapLe hle
    have hqp : path hT r x = q'.toPath.val := path_eq hT _ q'.toPath.property
    unfold ancestor at h
    rw [hqp] at h
    have hqv : v ∈ q'.support := q'.support_toPath_subset_support h
    have hqv' : v ∈ q.support := by
      change v ∈ (q.mapLe hle).support at hqv
      rwa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support] at hqv
    have hside := G.walk_mem_side (C := Cᶜ) (fun e he => not_congr (p.property.2.2.2.1 e he)) q hr v hqv'
    exact hside hv
  · intro hx
    by_contra hnot
    have hreach := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem hve (path hT r x) hnot
    have hsame := G.reaches_mem_iff p.property.2.2.2.1 hreach
    exact hr (hsame.mpr hx)

/-- The common-ancestor descendant set equals the cut support exactly for joins at the
actual minimal connecting subtree. This is the missing joining geometry. -/
theorem ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff {C S : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C)
    (r v : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    G.descendants ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r
        (G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS) = C ↔
      v ∈ G.span ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ S := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree p.property.1
  have hvdesc := G.descendants_eq_cut p r v hr hv hve
  have hvcommon : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r v x := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ G.descendants t r v
    rw [hvdesc]
    exact hSC hx
  have hca := commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS
  have heq : G.descendants t r (G.ancestorOf t r S hS) = C ↔
      G.ancestorOf t r S hS = v := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hav : ancestor hT r (commonAncestor hT r S hS) v := by
        change v ∈ G.descendants t r (G.ancestorOf t r S hS)
        rw [h]
        exact hv
      exact ancestor_antisymm hT hav (hca.2 v hvcommon)
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      exact hvdesc
  exact heq.trans (commonAncestor_eq_iff_mem_connectingSubtree hT r S hS hvcommon)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Joining
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic

@[expose] public section

/-! Rooted geometry of literal copied-edge trees. -/
open scoped Classical

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Forget endpoints' orientation, while retaining the original copy in the domain. -/
def edge (e : E) : Sym2 V := s(G.left e, G.right e)

/-- The simple graph of an actual edge subset. Copy injectivity on forests is proved below. -/
def toSimple (t : Finset E) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj := G.adjacent t
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ h => G.adjacent_symm h⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun x h => by
    rcases h with ⟨e, _, h | h⟩
    · exact G.loopless e (h.1.trans h.2.symm)
    · exact G.loopless e (h.2.trans h.1.symm)⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem toSimple_reachable (t : Finset E) (x y : V) :
    (G.toSimple t).Reachable x y ↔ G.reaches t x y :=
  SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen _ _

theorem edge_injOn_of_is_forest {t : Finset E} (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    Set.InjOn G.edge (t : Set E) := by
  intro e he f hf hef
  by_contra hne
  apply ht e he
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
  refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, hf⟩, ?_⟩
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hef with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩

theorem toSimple_isAcyclic {t : Finset E} (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    (G.toSimple t).IsAcyclic := by
  rw [SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge]
  intro x y hxy
  rcases hxy with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
  all_goals
    rw [SimpleGraph.isBridge_iff]
    intro hr
    apply ht e he
    have hm : (G.toSimple t).deleteEdges {s(x,y)} ≤ G.toSimple (t.erase e) := by
      intro a b hab
      obtain ⟨⟨f, hf, hfab⟩, hne⟩ := hab
      refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, hfab⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      apply hne
      rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Sym2.eq_iff]
        aesop
      · rcases hfab with hfab | hfab
        · exact fun hab => G.loopless e (hfab.1.trans (hab.trans hfab.2.symm))
        · exact fun hab => G.loopless e (hfab.2.trans (hab.symm.trans hfab.1.symm))
    have hr' := (G.toSimple_reachable (t.erase e) x y).mp (hr.mono hm)
    first
    | simpa only [← h.1, ← h.2] using hr'
    | exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa only [← h.1, ← h.2] using hr')

theorem toSimple_isTree {t : Finset E} (ht : G.is_tree Set.univ t) :
    (G.toSimple t).IsTree := by
  have hne : Nonempty V := ⟨ht.1.choose⟩
  letI : Nonempty V := hne
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Connected.mk ?_, G.toSimple_isAcyclic ht.2.2.2⟩
  intro x y
  exact (G.toSimple_reachable t x y).mpr (ht.2.2.1 x (Set.mem_univ _) y (Set.mem_univ _))

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Past
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-! Fixed original-copy insertion and deletion across all source supports.
This is finite graph infrastructure, without a tree-tail assertion. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
/-- A finite copied path from the inside to the outside has a crossing copy. -/
theorem exists_crossing_of_reaches {F : Finset E} {C : Set V} {o y : V}
    (hp : G.reaches F o y) (ho : o ∈ C) (hy : y ∉ C) :
    ∃ f ∈ F, G.crosses C f := by
  by_contra hn
  have hs : ∀ f ∈ F, G.left f ∈ C ↔ G.right f ∈ C := by
    intro f hf
    have hc : ¬G.crosses C f := fun hc => hn ⟨f, hf, hc⟩
    constructor
    · intro hl
      by_contra hr
      exact hc (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩)
    · intro hr
      by_contra hl
      exact hc (Or.inr ⟨hl, hr⟩)
  exact hy ((G.reaches_mem_iff hs hp).mp ho)

/-- The literal deletion component recovers the complete designated support. -/
theorem componentAfter_eq_of_cut {C : Set V} {t : Finset E} {f : E} {o : V}
    (hc : G.cut_components C t f) (ho : o ∈ C) :
    G.componentAfter t f o = C := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (G.reaches_mem_iff hc.2.2.1 hx).mp ho
  · intro hx
    exact hc.2.2.2.1 o ho x hx

theorem cut_components_compl {C : Set V} {t : Finset E} {f : E}
    (hc : G.cut_components C t f) : G.cut_components Cᶜ t f := by
  refine ⟨hc.1, ?_, fun e he => not_congr (hc.2.2.1 e he), hc.2.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  · rcases hc.2.1 with h | h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] using h.1, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1, by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] using h.2⟩
  · simpa only [compl_compl] using hc.2.2.2.1

/-- Every actual tree copy has exactly two deletion components; the component
of any prescribed vertex is one of them, without selecting a new forest. -/
theorem cut_components_at_source (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val)
    (o : V) : G.cut_components (G.componentAfter t.val f o) t.val f := by
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val f (G.left f)
  have hc : G.cut_components C t.val f :=
    G.cut_components_componentAfter t f hf (G.left f) (G.right f) (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  by_cases ho : o ∈ C
  · rw [G.componentAfter_eq_of_cut hc ho]
    exact hc
  · have hd := G.cut_components_compl hc
    rw [G.componentAfter_eq_of_cut hd ho]
    exact hd

/-- All supports containing the source and excluding the sink, not only connected ones. -/
abbrev SourceCutSupport (o r : V) := {C : Set V // o ∈ C ∧ r ∉ C}

/-- Both actual component-tree subsets and a fixed original crossing copy. -/
abbrev FixedEdgeForest (o r : V) (f : E) :=
  (C : SourceCutSupport o r) ×
    {_p : G.ComponentTree C.val × G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ // G.crosses C.val f}

/-- Deletion separates source and sink. This is the literal tree-path edge criterion. -/
abbrev SeparatingTree (o r : V) (f : E) :=
  {t : G.SpanningTree // f ∈ t.val ∧ ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r}

def insertFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E) (p : G.FixedEdgeForest o r f) :
    G.SeparatingTree o r f := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨insert f (p.2.val.1.val ∪ p.2.val.2.val),
    G.is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses p.2.val.1.property p.2.val.2.property p.2.property⟩
  have hc := G.cut_components_insert_union p.2.val.1.property p.2.val.2.property p.2.property
  refine ⟨t, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact p.1.property.2 ((G.reaches_mem_iff hc.2.2.1 h).mp p.1.property.1)

theorem componentAfter_insertFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E)
    (p : G.FixedEdgeForest o r f) :
    G.componentAfter (G.insertFixedEdge o r f p).val.val f o = p.1.val :=
  G.componentAfter_eq_of_cut
    (G.cut_components_insert_union p.2.val.1.property p.2.val.2.property p.2.property)
    p.1.property.1

def deleteFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E) (t : G.SeparatingTree o r f) :
    G.FixedEdgeForest o r f := by
  let C : SourceCutSupport o r :=
    ⟨G.componentAfter t.val.val f o, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, t.property.2⟩
  let q : G.CutTree C.val := ⟨(t.val.val, f), t.val.property,
    G.cut_components_at_source t.val f t.property.1 o⟩
  let p := G.split C.val q
  exact ⟨C, ⟨(⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩, ⟨p.val.2.1, p.property.2.1⟩),
    p.property.2.2⟩⟩

theorem insertFixedEdge_injective (o r : V) (f : E) :
    Function.Injective (G.insertFixedEdge o r f) := by
  intro p q h
  have hC : p.1 = q.1 := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← G.componentAfter_insertFixedEdge o r f p,
      ← G.componentAfter_insertFixedEdge o r f q, h])
  rcases p with ⟨C, p⟩
  rcases q with ⟨D, q⟩
  dsimp only at hC
  subst D
  apply congrArg (Sigma.mk C)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hi := congrArg (fun t : G.SeparatingTree o r f => G.internalEdges C.val t.val.val) h
    simpa only [insertFixedEdge, G.internalEdges_insert_union
      p.val.1.property.2.1 p.val.2.property.2.1 p.property,
      G.internalEdges_insert_union q.val.1.property.2.1 q.val.2.property.2.1 q.property] using hi
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hi := congrArg (fun t : G.SeparatingTree o r f => G.internalEdges C.valᶜ t.val.val) h
    have hp : G.internalEdges C.valᶜ (insert f (p.val.1.val ∪ p.val.2.val)) = p.val.2.val := by
      rw [Finset.union_comm]
      exact G.internalEdges_insert_union p.val.2.property.2.1
        (by simpa only [compl_compl] using p.val.1.property.2.1)
        (G.cut_components_compl (G.cut_components_insert_union
          p.val.1.property p.val.2.property p.property)).2.1
    have hq : G.internalEdges C.valᶜ (insert f (q.val.1.val ∪ q.val.2.val)) = q.val.2.val := by
      rw [Finset.union_comm]
      exact G.internalEdges_insert_union q.val.2.property.2.1
        (by simpa only [compl_compl] using q.val.1.property.2.1)
        (G.cut_components_compl (G.cut_components_insert_union
          q.val.1.property q.val.2.property q.property)).2.1
    simpa only [insertFixedEdge, hp, hq] using hi

theorem insert_deleteFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E) (t : G.SeparatingTree o r f) :
    G.insertFixedEdge o r f (G.deleteFixedEdge o r f t) = t := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  change insert f (G.internalEdges (G.componentAfter t.val.val f o) (t.val.val.erase f) ∪
    G.internalEdges (G.componentAfter t.val.val f o)ᶜ (t.val.val.erase f)) = t.val.val
  rw [G.internalEdges_union_compl
    (G.cut_components_at_source t.val f t.property.1 o).2.2.1,
    Finset.insert_erase t.property.1]

/-- Insertion and literal deletion are global inverses, preserving both copied subsets. -/
def fixedEdgeForestEquiv (o r : V) (f : E) :
    G.FixedEdgeForest o r f ≃ G.SeparatingTree o r f where
  toFun := G.insertFixedEdge o r f
  invFun := G.deleteFixedEdge o r f
  left_inv _ := G.insertFixedEdge_injective o r f (G.insert_deleteFixedEdge o r f _)
  right_inv := G.insert_deleteFixedEdge o r f

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import Mathlib.Logic.Relation
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-!
Internal elementary infrastructure for copied-edge joining. Edges are elements of a finite
carrier, not endpoint pairs. A forest is an edge subset in which deleting any edge separates
its endpoints (the ordinary undirected forest criterion, including parallel-edge cycles).
No sandpile, burning, ancestor, or probability conclusion is assumed here.
-/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees

structure Multigraph (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V
  loopless : ∀ e, left e ≠ right e

/-- Adapter for a literal finite edge-copy carrier with ordered endpoint pairs. -/
def Multigraph.ofEndpoints {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (ends : E → V × V) (hne : ∀ e, (ends e).1 ≠ (ends e).2) : Multigraph V E :=
  ⟨fun e => (ends e).1, fun e => (ends e).2, hne⟩

open scoped Classical

namespace Multigraph

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Undirected adjacency with the individual witnessing edge copy retained. -/
def adjacent (s : Finset E) (x y : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ s, (G.left e = x ∧ G.right e = y) ∨ (G.right e = x ∧ G.left e = y)

/-- Actual finite-walk reachability, including the walk of length zero. -/
def reaches (s : Finset E) : V → V → Prop := Relation.ReflTransGen (G.adjacent s)

/-- All edges of the subset have both endpoints in the indicated support. -/
def supported (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C

/-- A forest has no edge whose endpoints remain connected after its deletion. -/
def is_forest (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ s, ¬G.reaches (s.erase e) (G.left e) (G.right e)

/-- A tree on exactly the nonempty vertex support C; isolated singleton trees are included. -/
def is_tree (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  C.Nonempty ∧ G.supported C s ∧
    (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches s x y) ∧ G.is_forest s

/-- The unique tree on a singleton support has no edges. -/
theorem is_tree_singleton_empty (a : V) : G.is_tree {a} ∅ := by
  refine ⟨⟨a, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [supported]
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
    subst x; subst y
    exact .refl
  · simp [is_forest]

theorem eq_empty_of_is_tree_singleton {a : V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : G.is_tree {a} s) : s = ∅ := by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro e he
  have h := hs.2.1 e he
  apply G.loopless e
  exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h.1).trans (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h.2).symm

/-- A crossing edge copy, in either orientation. -/
def crosses (C : Set V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  (G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.left e ∉ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem adjacent_symm {s : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.adjacent s x y) :
    G.adjacent s y x := by
  rcases h with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_symm {s : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.reaches s x y) :
    G.reaches s y x := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ h ih => exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (G.adjacent_symm h)).trans ih

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : G.reaches t x y := by
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ h => ?_) _ _ h
  rcases h with ⟨e, he, h⟩
  exact ⟨e, hst he, h⟩

theorem is_forest_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    G.is_forest s := by
  intro e he h
  apply ht e (hst he)
  exact G.reaches_mono (by intro f hf; simpa using
    (show f ≠ e ∧ f ∈ t from ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1, hst (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2⟩)) h

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_mem_iff {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : x ∈ C ↔ y ∈ C := by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ h ih =>
    rcases h with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
    · exact ih.trans (by simpa [← h.1, ← h.2] using hs e he)
    · exact ih.trans (by simpa [← h.1, ← h.2] using (hs e he).symm)

/-- The two internal edge subsets contain no crossing copies. -/
theorem supported_union_same_side {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) :
    ∀ e ∈ s ∪ t, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C := by
  intro e he
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp he with he | he
  · exact iff_of_true (hs e he).1 (hs e he).2
  · exact iff_of_false (ht e he).1 (ht e he).2

theorem crosses_not_mem {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) {e : E} (he : G.crosses C e) :
    e ∉ s ∪ t := by
  intro h
  have hside := G.supported_union_same_side hs ht e h
  rcases he with h | h
  · exact h.2 (hside.mp h.1)
  · exact h.1 (hside.mpr h.2)

/-- Collapse the opposite component to the endpoint of the joining edge. -/
noncomputable def retract (C : Set V) (a : V) (x : V) : V := if x ∈ C then x else a

theorem reaches_retract {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e f : E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ C) (hr : G.right e ∉ C) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches ((insert e (s ∪ t)).erase f) x y) :
    G.reaches (s.erase f) (retract C (G.left e) x) (retract C (G.left e) y) := by
  classical
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (retract C (G.left e)) (fun _ _ h => ?_) _ _ h
  rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hxy⟩
  have haf := (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).1
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).2 with rfl | ha
  · rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
    · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
      simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hl, if_neg hr]
      exact .refl
    · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
      simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hl, if_neg hr]
      exact .refl
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp ha with ha | ha
    · have hc := hs a ha
      rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hc.1, if_pos hc.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨haf, ha⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hc.1, if_pos hc.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨haf, ha⟩, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · have hc := ht a ha
      rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_neg hc.1, if_neg hc.2]
        exact .refl
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_neg hc.1, if_neg hc.2]
        exact .refl

/-- Joining two component trees with a crossing copy gives an ordinary spanning tree. -/
theorem is_tree_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ C) (hr : G.right e ∉ C) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (insert e (s ∪ t)) := by
  classical
  have he := G.crosses_not_mem hs.2.1 ht.2.1 (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩)
  have hcross : G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) (G.left e) (G.right e) :=
    Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have hleft (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) :
      G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) x (G.left e) :=
    G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (hs.2.2.1 x hx _ hl)
  have hright (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C) :
      G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) (G.right e) x :=
    G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (ht.2.2.1 _ hr x hx)
  refine ⟨⟨G.left e, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (by intro a ha; simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x _ y _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ C <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ C
    · exact G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (hs.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
    · exact ((hleft x hx).trans hcross).trans (hright y hy)
    · exact G.reaches_symm (((hleft y hy).trans hcross).trans (hright x hx))
    · exact G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (ht.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
  · intro f hf h
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with rfl | hf
    · have hm := G.reaches_mem_iff (G.supported_union_same_side hs.2.1 ht.2.1)
        (by simpa [Finset.erase_insert, he] using h)
      exact hr (hm.mp hl)
    · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hf with hf | hf
      · have h' := G.reaches_retract hs.2.1 ht.2.1 hl hr h
        have hc := hs.2.1 f hf
        apply hs.2.2.2 f hf
        simpa [retract, hc.1, hc.2] using h'
      · -- Reverse the chosen edge orientation and exchange the components.
        let G' : Multigraph V E := ⟨G.right, G.left, fun a => (G.loopless a).symm⟩
        have hadj (u : Finset E) : G'.adjacent u = G.adjacent u := by
          funext x y; apply propext; simp only [adjacent]; aesop
        have hreach (u : Finset E) : G'.reaches u = G.reaches u := by
          simp only [reaches, hadj]
        have hs' : G'.supported Cᶜ t := by intro a ha; exact ⟨(ht.2.1 a ha).2, (ht.2.1 a ha).1⟩
        have ht' : G'.supported (Cᶜ)ᶜ s := by
          intro a ha
          simpa [G'] using And.intro (hs.2.1 a ha).2 (hs.2.1 a ha).1
        have h' := G'.reaches_retract hs' ht' hr (by simpa using hl)
          (by simpa [hreach, Finset.union_comm] using G.reaches_symm h)
        have hc := ht.2.1 f hf
        apply ht.2.2.2 f hf
        have h'' : G.reaches (t.erase f) (G.right f) (G.left f) := by
          simpa [hreach, retract, hc.1, hc.2, G'] using h'
        exact G.reaches_symm h''

/-- Restrict an actual edge subset to the induced graph on C. -/
noncomputable def internalEdges (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Finset E :=
  s.filter (fun e => G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem supported_internalEdges (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) :
    G.supported C (G.internalEdges C s) := by
  intro e he
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_internalEdges {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ C)
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : G.reaches (G.internalEdges C s) x y := by
  have h' : y ∈ C ∧ G.reaches (G.internalEdges C s) x y := by
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨hx, .refl⟩
    | @tail z y _ h ih =>
      rcases h with ⟨e, he, hxy⟩
      have heC : G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C := by
        rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
        · have hl : G.left e ∈ C := hxy.1 ▸ ih.1
          exact ⟨hl, (hs e he).mp hl⟩
        · have hr : G.right e ∈ C := hxy.1 ▸ ih.1
          exact ⟨(hs e he).mpr hr, hr⟩
      have hy : y ∈ C := by rcases hxy with hxy | hxy; exact hxy.2 ▸ heC.2; exact hxy.2 ▸ heC.1
      exact ⟨hy, ih.2.tail ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, heC⟩, hxy⟩⟩
  exact h'.2

theorem is_tree_internalEdges {C : Set V} {s : Finset E} (hn : C.Nonempty)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches s x y) (hf : G.is_forest s) :
    G.is_tree C (G.internalEdges C s) := by
  refine ⟨hn, G.supported_internalEdges C s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact G.reaches_internalEdges hs hx (hc x hx y hy)
  · exact G.is_forest_mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hf

theorem internalEdges_union_compl {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) :
    G.internalEdges C s ∪ G.internalEdges Cᶜ s = s := by
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h) <;> exact h.1
  · intro he
    by_cases hl : G.left e ∈ C
    · exact Or.inl ⟨he, hl, (hs e he).mp hl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨he, hl, fun hr => hl ((hs e he).mpr hr)⟩

theorem internalEdges_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) :
    G.internalEdges C (s ∪ t) = s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf | hf, hl, _⟩
    · exact hf
    · exact ((ht f hf).1 hl).elim
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨Or.inl hf, hs f hf⟩

theorem internalEdges_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.internalEdges C (insert e (s ∪ t)) = s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hl, hr⟩
    rcases hf with rfl | hf | hf
    · rcases he with he | he
      · exact (he.2 hr).elim
      · exact (he.1 hl).elim
    · exact hf
    · exact ((ht f hf).1 hl).elim
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inl hf), hs f hf⟩

/-- Deleting the marked crossing copy leaves precisely the two indicated components.
The support separation and the two connectivity clauses are literal walk conditions. -/
def cut_components (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ s ∧ G.crosses C e ∧
    (∀ f ∈ s.erase e, G.left f ∈ C ↔ G.right f ∈ C) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches (s.erase e) x y) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Cᶜ, ∀ y ∈ Cᶜ, G.reaches (s.erase e) x y)

/-- Ordinary spanning trees with a marked cut whose components have supports C and Cᶜ. -/
abbrev CutTree (C : Set V) :=
  {p : Finset E × E // G.is_tree Set.univ p.1 ∧ G.cut_components C p.1 p.2}

/-- Component-tree subsets, together with an individual admissible crossing copy. -/
abbrev Joining (C : Set V) :=
  {p : Finset E × Finset E × E //
    G.is_tree C p.1 ∧ G.is_tree Cᶜ p.2.1 ∧ G.crosses C p.2.2}

theorem is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (insert e (s ∪ t)) := by
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact G.is_tree_insert_union hs ht he.1 he.2
  · rw [Finset.union_comm s t]
    exact G.is_tree_insert_union ht (by simpa using hs) he.1 (by simpa using he.2)

theorem cut_components_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.cut_components C (insert e (s ∪ t)) e := by
  have hnot := G.crosses_not_mem hs.2.1 ht.2.1 he
  have herase : (insert e (s ∪ t)).erase e = s ∪ t := by simp [hnot]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [herase] using G.supported_union_same_side hs.2.1 ht.2.1
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [herase]
    exact G.reaches_mono Finset.subset_union_left (hs.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [herase]
    exact G.reaches_mono Finset.subset_union_right (ht.2.2.1 x hx y hy)

/-- Literal insertion of the marked edge copy, with connectivity and acyclicity proved. -/
def join (C : Set V) (p : G.Joining C) : G.CutTree C :=
  ⟨(insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1), p.val.2.2),
    G.is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses p.property.1 p.property.2.1 p.property.2.2,
    G.cut_components_insert_union p.property.1 p.property.2.1 p.property.2.2⟩

/-- Delete the marked copy and recover the two induced component edge subsets. -/
noncomputable def split (C : Set V) (p : G.CutTree C) : G.Joining C := by
  let s := p.val.1.erase p.val.2
  have hs : G.is_forest s := G.is_forest_mono (Finset.erase_subset _ _) p.property.1.2.2.2
  have hside := p.property.2.2.2.1
  have hcross := p.property.2.2.1
  have hC : C.Nonempty := by
    rcases hcross with h | h
    · exact ⟨G.left p.val.2, h.1⟩
    · exact ⟨G.right p.val.2, h.2⟩
  have hD : Cᶜ.Nonempty := by
    rcases hcross with h | h
    · exact ⟨G.right p.val.2, h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨G.left p.val.2, h.1⟩
  exact ⟨(G.internalEdges C s, G.internalEdges Cᶜ s, p.val.2),
    G.is_tree_internalEdges hC hside p.property.2.2.2.2.1 hs,
    G.is_tree_internalEdges hD (fun e he => not_congr (hside e he))
      p.property.2.2.2.2.2 hs, hcross⟩

theorem split_join (C : Set V) (p : G.Joining C) : G.split C (G.join C p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := G.crosses_not_mem p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1 p.property.2.2
  change (G.internalEdges C ((insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2),
    G.internalEdges Cᶜ ((insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2), p.val.2.2) = p.val
  have herase : (insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2 =
      p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1 := by simp [he]
  have hC := G.internalEdges_union p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1
  have hD : G.internalEdges Cᶜ (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1) = p.val.2.1 := by
    rw [Finset.union_comm]
    exact G.internalEdges_union p.property.2.1.2.1 (by simpa using p.property.1.2.1)
  simp only [herase, hC, hD]

theorem join_split (C : Set V) (p : G.CutTree C) : G.join C (G.split C p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (insert p.val.2 (G.internalEdges C (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) ∪
    G.internalEdges Cᶜ (p.val.1.erase p.val.2)), p.val.2) = p.val
  rw [G.internalEdges_union_compl p.property.2.2.2.1,
    Finset.insert_erase p.property.2.1]

/-- A proved copied-edge joining equivalence, not a supplied tree-bijection hypothesis. -/
noncomputable def joiningEquiv (C : Set V) : G.Joining C ≃ G.CutTree C where
  toFun := G.join C
  invFun := G.split C
  left_inv := G.split_join C
  right_inv := G.join_split C

/-- Forgetting the mark is injective for a prescribed cut support C. -/
theorem cutTree_edges_injective (C : Set V) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : G.CutTree C => p.val.1) := by
  intro p q hpq
  change p.val.1 = q.val.1 at hpq
  have he : p.val.2 = q.val.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : q.val.2 ∈ p.val.1.erase p.val.2 :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, (by rw [hpq]; exact q.property.2.1)⟩
    have hside := p.property.2.2.2.1 _ hmem
    rcases q.property.2.2.1 with h | h
    · exact h.2 (hside.mp h.1)
    · exact h.1 (hside.mpr h.2)
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext hpq he

/-- A spanning-tree subset of the induced component graph, including singleton trees. -/
abbrev ComponentTree (C : Set V) := {s : Finset E // G.is_tree C s}

/-- The C endpoint of a crossing edge is in the specified joining set K. -/
def admissible (C K : Set V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  (G.left e ∈ C ∩ K ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e ∈ C ∩ K ∧ G.left e ∉ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem admissible_iff_of_subset {C K : Set V} (hK : K ⊆ C) (e : E) :
    G.admissible C K e ↔
      (G.left e ∈ K ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e ∈ K ∧ G.left e ∉ C) := by
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hK h.1, h.1⟩, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hK h.1, h.1⟩, h.2⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem admissible_implies_crosses {C K : Set V} {e : E}
    (he : G.admissible C K e) : G.crosses C e := by
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact Or.inl ⟨he.1.1, he.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he.2, he.1.1⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem crosses_of_admissible {C K : Set V} (hK : K ⊆ C) {e : E}
    (he : G.admissible C K e) : G.crosses C e := by
  rcases (G.admissible_iff_of_subset hK e).mp he with he | he
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hK he.1, he.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he.2, hK he.1⟩

abbrev FixedJoining (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {p : G.Joining C // p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2.2}

/-- Completed ordinary spanning trees with the prescribed inside restriction and a
cut-edge endpoint in K. The mark is unique by cutTree_edges_injective. -/
abbrev FixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {p : G.CutTree C // G.internalEdges C p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2}

noncomputable def fixedJoiningEquiv (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ × {e : E // G.admissible C K e}) ≃ G.FixedJoining C K t where
  toFun p := ⟨⟨(t.val, p.1.val, p.2.val), t.property, p.1.property,
    G.crosses_of_admissible hK p.2.property⟩, rfl, p.2.property⟩
  invFun p := (⟨p.val.val.2.1, p.val.property.2.1⟩, ⟨p.val.val.2.2, p.property.2⟩)
  left_inv p := by rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext p.property.1.symm rfl

noncomputable def fixedCutEquiv (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ × {e : E // G.admissible C K e}) ≃ G.FixedCutTree C K t :=
  (G.fixedJoiningEquiv C K t hK).trans
    ((G.joiningEquiv C).subtypeEquiv fun p => by
      have hi := G.internalEdges_insert_union p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1
        p.property.2.2
      change (p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2.2) ↔
        (G.internalEdges C (insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)) = t.val ∧
          G.admissible C K p.val.2.2)
      rw [hi])

section Finite

/-- All admissible copies, explicitly enumerated in the edge carrier. -/
noncomputable def admissibleEdges (C K : Set V) : Finset E :=
  Finset.univ.filter (G.admissible C K)

/-- All individual copies joining v to the opposite side of C. -/
noncomputable def crossingAt (C : Set V) (v : V) : Finset E :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun e =>
    v ∈ C ∧ ((G.left e = v ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e = v ∧ G.left e ∉ C))

theorem admissibleEdges_eq_biUnion (C K : Set V) :
    G.admissibleEdges C K = K.toFinset.biUnion (G.crossingAt C) := by
  ext e
  simp only [admissibleEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_biUnion, Set.mem_toFinset, crossingAt, admissible, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨G.left e, h.1.2, h.1.1, Or.inl ⟨rfl, h.2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨G.right e, h.1.2, h.1.1, Or.inr ⟨rfl, h.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvC, h | h⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨h.1 ▸ hvC, h.1 ▸ hv⟩, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h.1 ▸ hvC, h.1 ▸ hv⟩, h.2⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem admissible_empty (K : Set V) (e : E) :
    ¬G.admissible ∅ K e := by simp [admissible]

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem crossingAt_eq_empty_of_not_mem {C : Set V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ C) :
    G.crossingAt C v = ∅ := by simp [crossingAt, hv]

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem crossingAt_empty (v : V) : G.crossingAt ∅ v = ∅ := by
  simp [crossingAt]

/-- The literal edge-copy fiber size is the sum of opposite-side degrees over K. -/
theorem card_admissibleEdges (C K : Set V) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.admissibleEdges C K).card = ∑ v ∈ K.toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card := by
  classical
  rw [G.admissibleEdges_eq_biUnion]
  apply Finset.card_biUnion
  intro v hv w hw hvw
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro e hev hew
  have hvC := hK (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hv)
  have hwC := hK (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hw)
  have hve := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hev).2.2
  have hwe := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hew).2.2
  rcases hve with hve | hve <;> rcases hwe with hwe | hwe
  · exact hvw (hve.1.symm.trans hwe.1)
  · exact hwe.2 (hve.1 ▸ hvC)
  · exact hve.2 (hwe.1 ▸ hwC)
  · exact hvw (hve.1.symm.trans hwe.1)

/-- Exactly ell ordinary completions for each fixed pair of component trees. -/
theorem card_fixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    Fintype.card (G.FixedCutTree C K t) =
      Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) * (G.admissibleEdges C K).card := by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (G.fixedCutEquiv C K t hK), Fintype.card_prod]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.subtype_card _ (by intro e; simp)

/-- Reciprocal joining cancellation at fixed C and inside tree, retaining common mass c.
There are no completions when ell=0, so that branch contributes zero. -/
theorem reciprocal_fixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C)
    (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ _q : G.FixedCutTree C K t, c / (G.admissibleEdges C K).card) =
      if (G.admissibleEdges C K).Nonempty then c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, G.card_fixedCutTree C K t hK,
    Nat.cast_mul]
  by_cases h : (G.admissibleEdges C K).Nonempty
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hc : ((G.admissibleEdges C K).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr h
    field_simp
  · have hc : (G.admissibleEdges C K).card = 0 := Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
      (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h)
    simp [h, hc]

end Finite

end Multigraph

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Ancestors

@[expose] public section

/-! Every rooted descendant set is the actual component cut off by its outgoing edge copy. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- The literal connected component of a after deleting an individual edge copy. -/
def componentAfter (t : Finset E) (e : E) (a : V) : Set V :=
  {x | G.reaches (t.erase e) a x}

theorem cut_components_componentAfter (t : G.SpanningTree) (e : E) (he : e ∈ t.val)
    (a b : V) (hab : (G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = b) ∨
      (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = b)) :
    G.cut_components (G.componentAfter t.val e a) t.val e := by
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val e a
  have hsep : ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a b := by
    intro h
    apply t.property.2.2.2 e he
    rcases hab with hab | hab
    · simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using h
    · exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using h)
  have ha : a ∈ C := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hb : b ∉ C := hsep
  have hclass (x : V) : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a x ∨ G.reaches (t.val.erase e) b x := by
    have h := t.property.2.2.1 a (Set.mem_univ _) x (Set.mem_univ _)
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Or.inl .refl
    | @tail x y _ h ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hxy⟩ := h
      by_cases hfe : f = e
      · subst f
        rcases hxy with hxy | hxy <;> rcases hab with hab | hab
        · right; rw [← hxy.2, hab.2]; exact .refl
        · left; rw [← hxy.2, hab.1]; exact .refl
        · left; rw [← hxy.2, hab.1]; exact .refl
        · right; rw [← hxy.2, hab.2]; exact .refl
      · have hstep : G.adjacent (t.val.erase e) x y :=
          ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfe, hf⟩, hxy⟩
        exact ih.imp (fun h => h.tail hstep) (fun h => h.tail hstep)
  have hd (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C) : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) b x :=
    (hclass x).resolve_left hx
  refine ⟨he, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change G.crosses C e
    rcases hab with hab | hab
    · exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [hab.1]; exact ha, by rw [hab.2]; exact hb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [hab.2]; exact hb, by rw [hab.1]; exact ha⟩
  · intro f hf
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact h.tail ⟨f, hf, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · intro h
      exact h.tail ⟨f, hf, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (G.reaches_symm hx).trans hy
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (G.reaches_symm (hd x hx)).trans (hd y hy)

/-- A parent edge is an original tree copy from a to the next vertex on its root path. -/
def is_parent_edge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ t.val ∧
    ((G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) a r).snd) ∨
      (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) a r).snd))

theorem existsUnique_parent_edge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    ∃! e, G.is_parent_edge t r a e := by
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree t.property
  have hp : ¬(path hT a r).Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
  obtain ⟨e, he, hadj⟩ := (path hT a r).adj_snd hp
  have hep : G.is_parent_edge t r a e := ⟨he, hadj⟩
  refine ⟨e, hep, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  apply G.edge_injOn_of_is_forest t.property.2.2.2 hf.1 he
  have hedge {g : E} (hg : G.is_parent_edge t r a g) :
      G.edge g = s(a, (path hT a r).snd) := by
    rcases hg.2 with hg | hg
    · simp only [edge, hg.1, hg.2]
    · simp only [edge, hg.1, hg.2, Sym2.eq_swap]
  exact (hedge hf).trans (hedge hep).symm

/-- The unique outgoing original edge copy; chosen only after full uniqueness. -/
noncomputable def parentEdge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) : E :=
  (G.existsUnique_parent_edge t r a hne).choose

theorem parentEdge_spec (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    G.is_parent_edge t r a (G.parentEdge t r a hne) :=
  (G.existsUnique_parent_edge t r a hne).choose_spec.1

/-- The source past on its exact nonroot carrier: the component after the outgoing copy. -/
noncomputable def past (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) : Set V :=
  G.componentAfter t.val (G.parentEdge t r a hne) a

theorem past_eq_descendants (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    G.past t r a hne = G.descendants t r a := by
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree t.property
  let e := G.parentEdge t r a hne
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec t r a hne
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val e a
  have hcut := G.cut_components_componentAfter t e he.1 a (path hT a r).snd he.2
  have hr : r ∉ C := by
    obtain ⟨b, hab, q, hp⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hne (path hT a r)
    have hq : q.IsPath ∧ a ∉ q.support := by
      have h := path_isPath hT a r
      rw [hp, SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at h
      exact h
    have hsnd : (path hT a r).snd = b := by simp [hp]
    have heab : (G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = b) ∨ (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = b) := by
      simpa [hsnd] using he.2
    have hreach := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem
      (heab.imp (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1)) q hq.2
    intro h
    have hab' : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a b := h.trans (G.reaches_symm hreach)
    apply t.property.2.2.2 e he.1
    rcases heab with h | h
    · simpa [h.1, h.2] using hab'
    · exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa [h.1, h.2] using hab')
  exact (G.descendants_eq_cut ⟨(t.val, e), t.property, hcut⟩ r a hr
    Relation.ReflTransGen.refl (he.2.imp (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1))).symm

/-- Every nonroot vertex has exactly its paper-defined outgoing-edge past. -/
theorem past_ancestor_eq_cut_iff {C S : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C) (r v : V)
    (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    ∃ hne : G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS ≠ r,
      (G.past ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r
        (G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS) hne = C ↔
          v ∈ G.span ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ S) := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  have hd := G.descendants_eq_cut p r v hr hv hve
  have hca := commonAncestor_spec (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r S hS
  have hcav : G.ancestorOf t r S hS ∈ C := by
    rw [← hd]
    exact hca.2 v (fun x hx => by change x ∈ G.descendants t r v; rw [hd]; exact hSC hx)
  have hne : G.ancestorOf t r S hS ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hcav)
  refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
  rw [G.past_eq_descendants]
  exact G.ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff p r v hr hv hSC hS hve

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.CutComponents

/-! Deleting one original tree copy deletes exactly its simple edge, because
copy-to-edge is injective on an actual forest. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem toSimple_erase_tree (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val) :
    G.toSimple (t.val.erase f) = (G.toSimple t.val).deleteEdges {G.edge f} := by
  ext x y
  rw [SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, h⟩
    refine ⟨⟨e, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he, h⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro hxy
    have heq : G.edge e = G.edge f := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · simpa only [edge, h.1, h.2] using hxy
      · simpa only [edge, h.1, h.2, Sym2.eq_swap] using hxy
    exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp he).1
      (G.edge_injOn_of_is_forest t.property.2.2.2 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he) hf heq)
  · rintro ⟨⟨e, he, h⟩, hn⟩
    refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, he⟩, h⟩
    intro hef
    subst e
    apply hn
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rcases h with h | h
    · simp only [edge, h.1, h.2]
    · simp only [edge, h.1, h.2, Sym2.eq_swap]

/-- The full root-path dictionary retains original edge-copy membership explicitly. -/
theorem separates_iff_mem_path (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val)
    (o r : V) :
    ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r ↔
      G.edge f ∈ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges := by
  have hr : G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r ↔
      G.edge f ∉ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges := by
    rw [← G.toSimple_reachable, G.toSimple_erase_tree t f hf]
    change ((G.toSimple t.val).deleteEdges {s(G.left f, G.right f)}).Reachable o r ↔ _
    rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_deleteEdges_iff_exists_walk]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      have he := path_eq (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) p.toPath.val p.toPath.property
      rw [he]
      exact fun h => hp (p.edges_toPath_subset_edges h)
    · intro hp
      exact ⟨path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r, hp⟩
  exact (not_congr hr).trans not_not

/-- Literal original copies on the unique source-to-root path. -/
def rootPathCopies (t : G.SpanningTree) (o r : V) : Finset E :=
  t.val.filter fun f => G.edge f ∈ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges

theorem mem_rootPathCopies (t : G.SpanningTree) (o r : V) (f : E) :
    f ∈ G.rootPathCopies t o r ↔
      f ∈ t.val ∧ ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r := by
  simp only [rootPathCopies, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hf, (G.separates_iff_mem_path t f hf o r).mpr hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hf, (G.separates_iff_mem_path t f hf o r).mp hs⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
public import Mathlib.Tactic

@[expose] public section

/-! Unique paths, actual connecting subtrees, and lowest common ancestors in finite trees. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V : Type*} {T : SimpleGraph V} (hT : T.IsTree)

/-- The unique simple path; its existence and uniqueness precede this choice. -/
noncomputable def path (x y : V) : T.Walk x y := (hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose

theorem path_isPath (x y : V) : (path hT x y).IsPath :=
  (hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose_spec.1

theorem path_eq {x y : V} (p : T.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath) : path hT x y = p :=
  ((hT.existsUnique_path x y).choose_spec.2 p hp).symm

theorem path_reverse (x y : V) : path hT x y = (path hT y x).reverse :=
  path_eq hT _ (path_isPath hT y x).reverse

theorem path_takeUntil {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT r a = (path hT r x).takeUntil a ha :=
  path_eq hT _ ((path_isPath hT r x).takeUntil ha)

theorem path_dropUntil {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT a x = (path hT r x).dropUntil a ha :=
  path_eq hT _ ((path_isPath hT r x).dropUntil ha)

theorem path_split {r x a : V} (ha : a ∈ (path hT r x).support) :
    path hT r x = (path hT r a).append (path hT a x) := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha, path_dropUntil hT ha]
  exact ((path hT r x).take_spec ha).symm

/-- a is on the unique path from the root r to x. -/
def ancestor (r a x : V) : Prop := a ∈ (path hT r x).support

theorem ancestor_refl (r x : V) : ancestor hT r x x := (path hT r x).end_mem_support

theorem ancestor_root (r x : V) : ancestor hT r r x := (path hT r x).start_mem_support

theorem ancestor_trans {r a b x : V} (hab : ancestor hT r a b)
    (hbx : ancestor hT r b x) : ancestor hT r a x := by
  have h := (path hT r x).support_takeUntil_subset_support hbx
  rw [← path_takeUntil hT hbx] at h
  exact h hab

theorem ancestor_length_le {r a x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x) :
    (path hT r a).length ≤ (path hT r x).length := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
  exact (path hT r x).length_takeUntil_le_length ha

theorem ancestor_length_lt {r a x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x) (hne : a ≠ x) :
    (path hT r a).length < (path hT r x).length := by
  rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
  exact (path hT r x).length_takeUntil_lt_length ha hne

theorem ancestor_antisymm {r a b : V} (hab : ancestor hT r a b)
    (hba : ancestor hT r b a) : a = b := by
  by_contra hne
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (ancestor_length_le hT hba)) (ancestor_length_lt hT hab hne)

theorem ancestor_of_length_le {r a b x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hb : ancestor hT r b x) (hle : (path hT r a).length ≤ (path hT r b).length) :
    ancestor hT r a b := by
  have hget := (path hT r x).getVert_takeUntil hb
    (show (path hT r a).length ≤ ((path hT r x).takeUntil b hb).length by
      rwa [← path_takeUntil hT hb])
  have haeq : (path hT r x).getVert (path hT r a).length = a := by
    rw [path_takeUntil hT ha]
    exact (path hT r x).getVert_length_takeUntil ha
  unfold ancestor
  rw [path_takeUntil hT hb]
  rw [← haeq, ← hget]
  exact ((path hT r x).takeUntil b hb).getVert_mem_support _

theorem ancestor_comparable {r a b x : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hb : ancestor hT r b x) : ancestor hT r a b ∨ ancestor hT r b a := by
  rcases le_total (path hT r a).length (path hT r b).length with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (ancestor_of_length_le hT ha hb h)
  · exact Or.inr (ancestor_of_length_le hT hb ha h)

/-- The lowest common ancestor, characterized entirely by actual rooted paths. -/
def is_common_ancestor (r : V) (S : Set V) (a : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) ∧
    ∀ b, (∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r b x) → ancestor hT r b a

theorem existsUnique_common_ancestor [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃! a, is_common_ancestor hT r S a := by
  let A : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter fun a => ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x
  have hA : A.Nonempty := ⟨r, by simp [A, ancestor_root]⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmax⟩ := A.exists_max_image (fun a => (path hT r a).length) hA
  have hac : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  have hca : is_common_ancestor hT r S a := by
    refine ⟨hac, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    exact ancestor_of_length_le hT (hb x hx) (hac x hx) (hmax b (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb⟩))
  refine ⟨a, hca, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  exact ancestor_antisymm hT (hca.2 b hb.1) (hb.2 a hac)

/-- The unique lowest common ancestor; no root or ancestor witness is supplied as input. -/
noncomputable def commonAncestor [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) : V :=
  (existsUnique_common_ancestor hT r S hS).choose

theorem commonAncestor_spec [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    is_common_ancestor hT r S (commonAncestor hT r S hS) :=
  (existsUnique_common_ancestor hT r S hS).choose_spec.1

/-- The actual connecting subtree: the union of unique paths between marked vertices. -/
def connectingSubtree (S : Set V) : Set V :=
  {a | ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, a ∈ (path hT x y).support}

theorem subset_connectingSubtree (S : Set V) : S ⊆ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨x, hx, x, hx, (path hT x x).start_mem_support⟩

theorem path_subset_union (x y a : V) :
    ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ (path hT x y).support →
      z ∈ (path hT x a).support ∨ z ∈ (path hT a y).support := by
  let w := (path hT x a).append (path hT a y)
  have he := path_eq hT w.toPath.val w.toPath.property
  rw [he]
  intro z hz
  have hz' := w.support_toPath_subset_support hz
  simpa only [w, SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff] using hz'

theorem ancestor_on_suffix {r a x z : V} (ha : ancestor hT r a x)
    (hz : z ∈ (path hT a x).support) : ancestor hT r a z := by
  have hsplit := path_split hT ha
  have hzx : ancestor hT r z x := by
    unfold ancestor
    rw [hsplit]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hz
  rcases ancestor_comparable hT ha hzx with h | h
  · exact h
  · by_cases hza : z = a
    · subst z; exact ancestor_refl hT r a
    · have hp : ((path hT r a).append (path hT a x)).IsPath :=
        hsplit ▸ path_isPath hT r x
      exact (hp.ne_of_mem_support_of_append hza h hz rfl).elim

theorem connectingSubtree_subset_descendants (r : V) (S : Set V) {a : V}
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) :
    connectingSubtree hT S ⊆ {z | ancestor hT r a z} := by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
  rcases path_subset_union hT x y a hz with hz | hz
  · have hz' : z ∈ (path hT a x).support := by
      rw [path_reverse hT x a, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at hz
      exact List.mem_reverse.mp hz
    exact ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha x hx) hz'
  · exact ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha y hy) hz

/-- Path convexity is the connected-subtree condition in a tree. -/
def is_path_convex (C : Set V) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ (path hT x y).support, z ∈ C

theorem connectingSubtree_minimal (S C : Set V) (hC : is_path_convex hT C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    connectingSubtree hT S ⊆ C := by
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
  exact hC x (hSC hx) y (hSC hy) z hz

theorem path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree {S : Set V} {b x : V} (hb : b ∈ S)
    (hx : x ∈ connectingSubtree hT S) :
    ∀ z ∈ (path hT b x).support, z ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hxuv⟩ := hx
  have hcase := path_subset_union hT u v b hxuv
  have hx' : (∃ y ∈ S, x ∈ (path hT b y).support) := by
    rcases hcase with h | h
    · refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      rw [path_reverse hT u b, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at h
      exact List.mem_reverse.mp h
    · exact ⟨v, hv, h⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx'
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z ∈ (path hT b y).support := by
    rw [path_takeUntil hT hxy] at hz
    exact (path hT b y).support_takeUntil_subset_support hxy hz
  exact ⟨b, hb, y, hy, hz'⟩

theorem connectingSubtree_convex (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    is_path_convex hT (connectingSubtree hT S) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hS
  intro x hx y hy z hz
  rcases path_subset_union hT x y b hz with h | h
  · rw [path_reverse hT x b, SimpleGraph.Walk.support_reverse] at h
    exact path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree hT hb hx z (List.mem_reverse.mp h)
  · exact path_from_mark_subset_connectingSubtree hT hb hy z h

theorem connectingSubtree_connected (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (T.induce (connectingSubtree hT S)).Connected := by
  have hconv := connectingSubtree_convex hT S hS
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  letI : Nonempty (connectingSubtree hT S) := ⟨⟨x, subset_connectingSubtree hT S hx⟩⟩
  refine SimpleGraph.Connected.mk ?_
  intro x y
  exact ⟨((path hT x.val y.val).induce (connectingSubtree hT S)
    (fun z hz => hconv
      x.val x.property y.val y.property z hz)).copy (Subtype.ext rfl) (Subtype.ext rfl)⟩

theorem common_ancestor_mem_connectingSubtree {r : V} {S : Set V} (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {a : V} (ha : is_common_ancestor hT r S a) : a ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  have hax : a ≠ x := fun h => hnot (h ▸ subset_connectingSubtree hT S hx)
  obtain ⟨b, hab, q, hp⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hax (path hT a x)
  have hq : q.IsPath ∧ a ∉ q.support := by
    have h := path_isPath hT a x
    rw [hp, SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at h
    exact h
  have hba : b ∈ (path hT a x).support := by
    rw [hp]
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ q.start_mem_support
  have hab' := ancestor_on_suffix hT (ha.1 x hx) hba
  have hbcommon : ∀ y ∈ S, ancestor hT r b y := by
    intro y hy
    let w := q.append (path hT x y)
    have haw : a ∉ w.support := by
      intro h
      rcases (SimpleGraph.Walk.mem_support_append_iff _ _).mp h with h | h
      · exact hq.2 h
      · exact hnot ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h⟩
    have han : a ∉ w.toPath.val.support :=
      fun h => haw (w.support_toPath_subset_support h)
    have hpy : path hT a y = SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hab w.toPath.val :=
      path_eq hT _ (w.toPath.property.cons han)
    have hby : b ∈ (path hT a y).support := by
      rw [hpy]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ w.toPath.val.start_mem_support
    unfold ancestor
    rw [path_split hT (ha.1 y hy)]
    exact SimpleGraph.Walk.support_subset_support_append_right _ _ hby
  exact hab.ne (ancestor_antisymm hT hab' (ha.2 b hbcommon))

theorem commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    commonAncestor hT r S hS ∈ connectingSubtree hT S :=
  common_ancestor_mem_connectingSubtree hT hS (commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS)

/-- A common ancestor equals the lowest common ancestor exactly when it lies in the
actual minimal connecting subtree; no arbitrary joining set is supplied. -/
theorem commonAncestor_eq_iff_mem_connectingSubtree [Fintype V] (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    {a : V} (ha : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r a x) :
    commonAncestor hT r S hS = a ↔ a ∈ connectingSubtree hT S := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h ▸ commonAncestor_mem_connectingSubtree hT r S hS
  · intro h
    have hc := commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS
    exact ancestor_antisymm hT
      (connectingSubtree_subset_descendants hT r S hc.1 h) (hc.2 a ha)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.PathCopies
import Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Basic
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Green.Grounded

/-! Literal geometric disk drawings and exact boundary-path statement types.
No probabilistic or electrical conclusion is included in the drawing data. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
open Trees


/-- A copied graph retains every original ID, including self-loops. -/
structure CopiedGraph (V E : Type) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V

namespace CopiedGraph
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Literal finite copied-walk reachability, including length-zero walks. -/
def reaches (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : Finset E) : V → V → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y => ∃ e ∈ T,
    (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨ (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y))

/-- Ordinary trees on the full original vertex set and original copied IDs. -/
abbrev SpanningTree (J : CopiedGraph V E) := {T : Finset E //
  (Set.univ : Set V).Nonempty ∧ (∀ x y, J.reaches T x y) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, ¬J.reaches (T.erase e) (J.left e) (J.right e)}

/-- The literal separation characterization of original-copy membership on the tree path. -/
noncomputable def pathIndicator (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v then 1 else 0

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- An original loop remains a network copy and is excluded by the actual tree predicate. -/
theorem loop_not_mem (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (e : E) (hloop : J.left e = J.right e) : e ∉ T.val := by
  intro he
  apply T.property.2.2 e he
  rw [hloop]
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

end CopiedGraph

abbrev ArcParameter := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- An actual plane drawing of the copied graph by simple continuous arcs. -/
structure Drawing {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : CopiedGraph V E) where
  point : V → ℝ × ℝ
  point_injective : Function.Injective point
  curve : E → ArcParameter → ℝ × ℝ
  continuous : ∀ e, Continuous (curve e)
  injective : ∀ e, Set.InjOn (curve e) {t | t.val < 1}
  start : ∀ e, curve e ⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.left e)
  finish : ∀ e, curve e ⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.right e)
  avoids : ∀ e t, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → ∀ v, curve e t ≠ point v
  intersects : ∀ e f, e ≠ f → ∀ s t, curve e s = curve f t →
    (s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1)

/-- The Euclidean closed unit disk, in the literal two real coordinates. -/
def disk : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 ≤ 1}
def circle : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 = 1}

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E} (drawing : Drawing J)

/-- An edge curve hits an original vertex exactly at one of its prescribed endpoints. -/
theorem curve_vertex_iff (e : E) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V) :
    drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v ↔
    (t.val = 0 ∧ J.left e = v) ∨ (t.val = 1 ∧ J.right e = v) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ht0 : t.val = 0
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht0
      rw [he, drawing.start] at h
      exact Or.inl ⟨ht0, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    by_cases ht1 : t.val = 1
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht1
      rw [he, drawing.finish] at h
      exact Or.inr ⟨ht1, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    · exact (drawing.avoids e t (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm ht0))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht1) v h).elim
  · rintro (⟨ht, hv⟩ | ⟨ht, hv⟩)
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.start, hv]
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.finish, hv]

/-- Restricting to a nonloop edge turns the literal half-open simplicity into full simplicity. -/
theorem nonloop_curve_injective (e : E) (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Function.Injective (drawing.curve e) := by
  intro s t h
  by_cases hs : s.val = 1
  · have he : s = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hs
    have hv : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [← h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t _).mp hv with ⟨ht, hn⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact Subtype.ext (hs.trans ht.symm)
  by_cases ht : t.val = 1
  · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
    have hv : drawing.curve e s = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e s _).mp hv with ⟨_, hn⟩ | ⟨hs', _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact (hs hs').elim
  · exact drawing.injective e (lt_of_le_of_ne s.property.2 hs)
      (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht) h

/-- The literal geometric realization of a vertex set and its original copied edges. -/
def trace (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (drawing.point '' C) ∪ {z | ∃ e ∈ s, ∃ t, drawing.curve e t = z}

/-- Copied edges supported on C can hit only vertices in C. -/
theorem curve_vertex_mem {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ s) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V)
    (h : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v) : v ∈ C := by
  rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp h with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv⟩
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).1
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).2

/-- Distinct forest components have literally disjoint drawings, even with loops and parallels.
This supplies geometric disjointness to a Jordan argument; no no-crossing conclusion is assumed. -/
theorem traces_disjoint {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E} (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D) :
    Disjoint (drawing.trace C s) (drawing.trace D t) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzC hzD
  rcases hzC with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, he, q, hq⟩
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyx' := drawing.point_injective hyx
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (hyx' ▸ hy)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (drawing.curve_vertex_mem ht f hf r x hr)
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyC : y ∈ C := drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q y (hq.trans hyz.symm)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hyC hy
    · by_cases hef : e = f
      · subst f
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (hs e he).1 (ht e hf).1
      · have hqr := drawing.intersects e f hef q r (hq.trans hr.symm)
        rcases hqr.2 with hr0 | hr1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr0
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.left f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.start]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr1
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.right f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.finish]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).2

/-- A real finite copied walk supplies a compact connected geometric set in its component trace. -/
theorem reachable_continuum {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (_hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) (y : V) (hxy : J.reaches s x y) :
    ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K ⊆ drawing.trace C s ∧
      drawing.point x ∈ K ∧ drawing.point y ∈ K := by
  induction hxy with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨{drawing.point x}, isCompact_singleton, isConnected_singleton, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z = drawing.point x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    subst z
    exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hxK, hyK⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e, he, heyz⟩ := hyz
    let A := Set.range (drawing.curve e)
    have hyA : drawing.point y ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.1]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.1]⟩
    have hzA : drawing.point z ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.2]⟩
    refine ⟨K ∪ A, hKc.union (isCompact_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      hKconn.union ⟨drawing.point y, hyK, hyA⟩ (isConnected_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      ?_, Or.inl hxK, Or.inr hzA⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with hw | ⟨t, ht⟩
    · exact hKt hw
    · exact Or.inr ⟨e, he, t, ht⟩

/-- Two disjoint forest components give disjoint actual continua joining their terminals. -/
theorem disjoint_connecting_continua {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : V) (hx : x₀ ∈ C) (hy : y₀ ∈ D)
    (hxx : J.reaches s x₀ x₁) (hyy : J.reaches t y₀ y₁)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk) :
    ∃ K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ IsCompact L ∧ IsConnected L ∧
      K ⊆ disk ∧ L ⊆ disk ∧ Disjoint K L ∧
      drawing.point x₀ ∈ K ∧ drawing.point x₁ ∈ K ∧
      drawing.point y₀ ∈ L ∧ drawing.point y₁ ∈ L := by
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hx₀, hx₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum hs x₀ hx x₁ hxx
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLconn, hLt, hy₀, hy₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum ht y₀ hy y₁ hyy
  have htrace (A : Set V) (F : Finset E) : drawing.trace A F ⊆ disk := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, _, q, hq⟩
    · exact hvertices v
    · exact hq ▸ hedges e q
  exact ⟨K, L, hKc, hKconn, hLc, hLconn, hKt.trans (htrace C s),
    hLt.trans (htrace D t), (drawing.traces_disjoint hCD hs ht).mono hKt hLt,
    hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩

end Drawing
