import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet

/-! Signed copy incidence and its anchored divergence. No plane conclusions are assumed. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane
open scoped Classical BigOperators

/-- Signed outgoing incidence of a once-oriented copied flow. Loops cancel. -/
noncomputable def copyBoundary {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V)
    (j : E → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, ((if a e = x then j e else 0)-(if b e = x then j e else 0))

noncomputable def boundaryMap {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) :
    (E → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ) where
  toFun j := copyBoundary a b j
  map_add' j k := by
    funext x
    simp only [copyBoundary,Pi.add_apply,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring
  map_smul' r j := by
    funext x
    simp only [copyBoundary,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,RingHom.id_apply,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

/-- Restrict divergence to vertices other than the chosen root. -/
noncomputable def anchoredBoundary {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (root : V) :
    (E → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({x : V // x ≠ root} → ℝ) where
  toFun j x := copyBoundary a b j x.val
  map_add' j k := by funext x; exact congrFun ((boundaryMap a b).map_add j k) x
  map_smul' r j := by funext x; exact congrFun ((boundaryMap a b).map_smul r j) x

/-- Physical primal gradient, positive from the a endpoint to the b endpoint. -/
def copyGradient {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (q : V → ℝ) (e : E) : ℝ := q (a e)-q (b e)

theorem copyBoundary_gradient {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (q : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    copyBoundary a b (copyGradient a b q) x = laplacian a b q x := by
  unfold copyBoundary copyGradient laplacian
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  split_ifs with ha hb <;> simp_all

theorem sum_copyBoundary {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (j : E → ℝ) : (∑ x, copyBoundary a b j x) = 0 := by
  unfold copyBoundary
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,if_true,
    sub_self,Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Omitting the root loses no zero-divergence equation, since total divergence is zero. -/
theorem anchoredBoundary_eq_zero_iff {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (root : V) (j : E → ℝ) :
    anchoredBoundary a b root j = 0 ↔ ∀ x, copyBoundary a b j x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    have hz (y : V) (hy : y ≠ root) : copyBoundary a b j y = 0 := congrFun h ⟨y,hy⟩
    by_cases hx : x = root
    · subst x
      have hs := sum_copyBoundary a b j
      have ht : ∀ y, copyBoundary a b j y = if y = root then copyBoundary a b j root else 0 := by
        intro y
        by_cases hy : y = root
        · simp [hy]
        · simp [hy,hz y hy]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ht y)] at hs
      simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,if_true] at hs
      exact hs
    · exact hz x hx
  · intro h
    funext x
    exact h x.val

/-- Every nonroot divergence prescription is attained on a connected copied graph. -/
theorem anchoredBoundary_surjective {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (root : V) (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) :
    Function.Surjective (anchoredBoundary a b root) := by
  let B : Finset V := {root}
  have hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y :=
    fun x => ⟨root,Finset.mem_singleton_self root,hc x root⟩
  intro k
  let rhs : {x : V // x ∉ B} → ℝ := fun x => k ⟨x.val,by simpa only [B,Finset.mem_singleton] using x.property⟩
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB) rhs
  refine ⟨copyGradient a b (zeroExtend B q),?_⟩
  funext x
  change copyBoundary a b (copyGradient a b (zeroExtend B q)) x.val = k x
  rw [copyBoundary_gradient]
  exact congrFun hq ⟨x.val,by simpa only [B,Finset.mem_singleton] using x.property⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Model.FiniteWired
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.TerminalEnumeration

/-! Literal copied edges of a finite lattice domain with two contracted terminals.
The free incidence order uses the physical clockwise lattice directions. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice

open LatticeProb
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired (Direction step)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- Positive-coordinate orientation gives each physical lattice edge one ID. -/
abbrev OriginalCopy := Site 2 × Fin 2

def originalA (e : OriginalCopy) : Site 2 := e.1
def originalB (e : OriginalCopy) : Site 2 := e.1 + unit e.2

/-- The original edge ID incident to x in a specified physical direction. -/
def incidentID (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) : OriginalCopy :=
  (if d.2 then x else x - unit d.1, d.1)

def originalDart (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) : Dart OriginalCopy :=
  (incidentID x d, !d.2)

@[simp] theorem originalDart_tail (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) :
    tail originalA originalB (originalDart x d) = x := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [originalDart, incidentID, tail, originalA, originalB]

@[simp] theorem originalDart_head (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) :
    head originalA originalB (originalDart x d) = x + step d := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [originalDart, incidentID, head, reverse, tail,
    originalA, originalB, step, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- All original copies incident to D; there is no voltage-dependent deletion. -/
def domainCopies (D : Finset (Site 2)) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (D ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset Direction)).image (fun xd => incidentID xd.1 xd.2)

theorem mem_domainCopies (D : Finset (Site 2)) (e : OriginalCopy) :
    e ∈ domainCopies D ↔ originalA e ∈ D ∨ originalB e ∈ D := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨x,⟨i,b⟩⟩,hx,he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hD := (Finset.mem_product.mp hx).1
    cases b
    · right
      rw [← he]
      simpa [incidentID, originalB] using hD
    · left
      rw [← he]
      simpa [incidentID, originalA] using hD
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      exact ⟨(originalA e,(e.2,true)), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h,Finset.mem_univ _⟩,
        by rcases e with ⟨x,i⟩; rfl⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨(originalB e,(e.2,false)), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h,Finset.mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      rcases e with ⟨x,i⟩
      simp [incidentID, originalB]

abbrev OneSet (D : Finset (Site 2)) := {P : Finset D // P.Nonempty}

variable (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)

/-- Zero and one are distinct terminals; the other vertices are exactly D minus P. -/
abbrev Vertex := Bool ⊕ {x : D // x ∉ P.val}

def alpha : Vertex D P := .inl false
def beta : Vertex D P := .inl true

def project (x : Site 2) : Vertex D P :=
  if hx : x ∈ D then
    if hp : (⟨x,hx⟩ : D) ∈ P.val then .inl true else .inr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hp⟩
  else .inl false

@[simp] theorem project_free (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    project D P x.val.val = .inr x := by
  simp [project, x.val.property, x.property]

theorem project_eq_free_iff (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (y : Site 2) :
    project D P y = .inr x ↔ y = x.val.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold project at h
    split at h
    · split at h
      · cases h
      · exact congrArg (fun z : {x : D // x ∉ P.val} => z.val.val) (Sum.inr.inj h)
    · cases h
  · rintro rfl
    exact project_free D P x

theorem project_eq_alpha_iff (x : Site 2) :
    project D P x = alpha D P ↔ x ∉ D := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D
  · simp only [project,dif_pos hx,alpha]
    split <;> simp [hx]
  · simp [project,hx,alpha]

theorem project_eq_beta_iff (x : Site 2) :
    project D P x = beta D P ↔ x ∈ P.val.image Subtype.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold project at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hx
      split at h
      · rename_i hp
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hp,rfl⟩
      · cases h
    · cases h
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    simp [project,y.property,hy,beta]

/-- The distinguished copy really joins the zero set to the one set. -/
abbrev MarkedCopy := {e : OriginalCopy //
  (project D P (originalA e) = alpha D P ∧ project D P (originalB e) = beta D P) ∨
  (project D P (originalA e) = beta D P ∧ project D P (originalB e) = alpha D P)}

/-- Delete exactly the distinguished ID and the copies whose endpoints become equal. -/
def retainedCopies (marked : MarkedCopy D P) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
    project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e) ∧ e ≠ marked.val)

abbrev Copy (marked : MarkedCopy D P) := ↥(retainedCopies D P marked)

def copyA (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : Copy D P marked) : Vertex D P :=
  project D P (originalA e.val)

def copyB (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : Copy D P marked) : Vertex D P :=
  project D P (originalB e.val)

theorem mem_retainedCopies (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy) :
    e ∈ retainedCopies D P marked ↔
    (originalA e ∈ D ∨ originalB e ∈ D) ∧
      project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e) ∧ e ≠ marked.val := by
  simp only [retainedCopies, Finset.mem_filter, mem_domainCopies]

theorem copy_loopless (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : Copy D P marked) :
    copyA D P marked e ≠ copyB D P marked e :=
  (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).2.1

/-- The physical clockwise order is east, south, west, north. -/
def clockwise (d : Direction) : Direction :=
  if d.1 = 0 then (1, !d.2) else (0,d.2)

def counterclockwise (d : Direction) : Direction :=
  if d.1 = 0 then (1,d.2) else (0,!d.2)

def clockwisePerm : Equiv.Perm Direction where
  toFun := clockwise
  invFun := counterclockwise
  left_inv d := by rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩; fin_cases i <;> cases b <;> rfl
  right_inv d := by rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩; fin_cases i <;> cases b <;> rfl

theorem original_endpoints_ne (e : OriginalCopy) : originalA e ≠ originalB e := by
  intro h
  have hi := congrFun h e.2
  simp [originalA, originalB, unit] at hi

theorem free_incident_survives (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (he : originalA e = x.val.val ∨ originalB e = x.val.val) :
    project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e) ∧ e ≠ marked.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases he with he | he
    · rw [he, project_free] at h
      have hb := (project_eq_free_iff D P x _).mp h.symm
      exact original_endpoints_ne e (he.trans hb.symm)
    · rw [he, project_free] at h
      have ha := (project_eq_free_iff D P x _).mp h
      exact original_endpoints_ne e (ha.trans he.symm)
  · intro h
    subst e
    rcases marked.property with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨ha,hb⟩
    all_goals rcases he with he | he
    · rw [he, project_free] at ha; cases ha
    · rw [he, project_free] at hb; cases hb
    · rw [he, project_free] at ha; cases ha
    · rw [he, project_free] at hb; cases hb

theorem incidentID_retained (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    incidentID x.val.val d ∈ retainedCopies D P marked := by
  have he : originalA (incidentID x.val.val d) = x.val.val ∨
      originalB (incidentID x.val.val d) = x.val.val := by
    rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
    cases b
    · right; simp [incidentID,originalB]
    · left; rfl
  apply (mem_retainedCopies D P marked _).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, free_incident_survives D P marked x _ he⟩
  rcases he with he | he
  · left; rw [he]; exact x.val.property
  · right; rw [he]; exact x.val.property

/-- The actual copied outgoing dart at a free site; its original ID is preserved. -/
def freeDart (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    Dart (Copy D P marked) :=
  (⟨incidentID x.val.val d, incidentID_retained D P marked x d⟩, !d.2)

@[simp] theorem freeDart_original (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    ((freeDart D P marked x d).1.val, (freeDart D P marked x d).2) =
      originalDart x.val.val d := rfl

theorem copy_tail_project (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (d : Dart (Copy D P marked)) :
    tail (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) d =
      project D P (tail originalA originalB (d.1.val,d.2)) := by
  rcases d with ⟨e,b⟩
  cases b <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem freeDart_tail (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    tail (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d) = .inr x := by
  rw [copy_tail_project, freeDart_original, originalDart_tail, project_free]

@[simp] theorem freeDart_head (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    head (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d) =
      project D P (x.val.val + step d) := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [freeDart, head, reverse, tail, copyA, copyB,
    incidentID,originalA,originalB,step,sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem originalDart_injective (x : Site 2) : Function.Injective (originalDart x) := by
  intro d d' h
  have hi := congrArg (fun z : Dart OriginalCopy => (z.1.2,!z.2)) h
  simpa [originalDart, incidentID] using hi

theorem originalDart_reconstruct (d : Dart OriginalCopy) :
    originalDart (tail originalA originalB d) (d.1.2,!d.2) = d := by
  rcases d with ⟨⟨x,i⟩,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [originalDart, incidentID, tail, originalA,originalB]

/-- Physical clockwise successor on the full lattice's original copied darts. -/
def latticeNext (d : Dart OriginalCopy) : Dart OriginalCopy :=
  originalDart (tail originalA originalB d) (clockwise (d.1.2,!d.2))

@[simp] theorem latticeNext_originalDart (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) :
    latticeNext (originalDart x d) = originalDart x (clockwise d) := by
  unfold latticeNext
  rw [originalDart_tail]
  simp only [originalDart,incidentID,Bool.not_not]

/-- The full four-direction incidence equivalence, including parallel neighbor images. -/
def freeIncidenceEquiv (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    Direction ≃ Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun d => ⟨freeDart D P marked x d, freeDart_tail D P marked x d⟩) (by
    constructor
    · intro d d' h
      apply originalDart_injective x.val.val
      exact congrArg (fun z : Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) =>
        (z.val.1.val,z.val.2)) h
    · intro d
      have ht : tail originalA originalB (d.val.1.val,d.val.2) = x.val.val := by
        apply (project_eq_free_iff D P x _).mp
        rw [← copy_tail_project]
        exact d.property
      refine ⟨(d.val.1.val.2,!d.val.2), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext
        have hh := congrArg Prod.fst (originalDart_reconstruct (d.val.1.val,d.val.2))
        rw [ht] at hh
        exact hh
      · simp [freeDart])

/-- Clockwise successor on the exact post-contraction free incidence fiber. -/
def freeClockwise (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    Equiv.Perm (Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x)) :=
  ((freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).symm.trans clockwisePerm).trans
    (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x)

theorem freeClockwise_original (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    (freeClockwise D P marked x (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x d)).val =
      freeDart D P marked x (clockwise d) := by
  simp only [freeClockwise,Equiv.trans_apply,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

/-- Contraction and deletion retain the literal physical successor at every free vertex. -/
theorem freeClockwise_transport (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (d : Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x)) :
    ((freeClockwise D P marked x d).val.1.val,(freeClockwise D P marked x d).val.2) =
      latticeNext (d.val.1.val,d.val.2) := by
  obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).surjective d
  rw [freeClockwise_original]
  change originalDart x.val.val (clockwise c) = latticeNext (originalDart x.val.val c)
  exact (latticeNext_originalDart x.val.val c).symm

theorem free_incidenceCount (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    incidenceCount (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) = 4 := by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Vertex D P) := Classical.decEq _
  unfold incidenceCount
  have h := Fintype.card_congr (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x)
  simpa [Direction] using h.symm

/-- The source degree bound counts each original edge copy once. -/
theorem free_degree (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    Geometry.degree (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) = 4 := by
  rw [← incidenceCount_eq_degree, free_incidenceCount]
  norm_num

theorem source_free_degree_bound (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : Vertex D P)
    (ha : x ≠ alpha D P) (hb : x ≠ beta D P) :
    Geometry.degree (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) x ≤ 4 := by
  cases x with
  | inl b => cases b
             · exact (ha rfl).elim
             · exact (hb rfl).elim
  | inr x => exact (free_degree D P marked x).le

theorem clockwise_reaches (d d' : Direction) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n < 4 ∧ (clockwisePerm ^ n) d = d' := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  rcases d' with ⟨j,c⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals first
    | exact ⟨0, by decide, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨1, by decide, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨2, by decide, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨3, by decide, rfl⟩

theorem freeClockwise_pow (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (n : ℕ) (d : Direction) :
    (freeClockwise D P marked x ^ n) (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x d) =
      freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x ((clockwisePerm ^ n) d) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ih]
    simp [freeClockwise, Equiv.trans_apply]

/-- Every surviving free incidence lies on this one physical clockwise cycle. -/
theorem freeClockwise_cyclic (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (d d' : Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x)) :
    (freeClockwise D P marked x).SameCycle d d' := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).surjective d
  obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).surjective d'
  obtain ⟨n,_,hn⟩ := clockwise_reaches a b
  have h := freeClockwise_pow D P marked x n a
  rw [hn] at h
  rw [← h]
  simpa only [Equiv.Perm.sameCycle_pow_right] using
    Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.refl (freeClockwise D P marked x) (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x a)

/-- Coincident contracted neighbors cannot identify distinct physical copied darts. -/
theorem parallel_free_copies (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (d d' : Direction) (hne : d ≠ d')
    (hh : project D P (x.val.val + step d) = project D P (x.val.val + step d')) :
    freeDart D P marked x d ≠ freeDart D P marked x d' ∧
      head (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d) =
        head (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d') := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hne
    apply (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).injective
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · simpa only [freeDart_head] using hh

theorem root_copy_retained (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (hd : originalA e ∈ D ∨ originalB e ∈ D) (hne : e ≠ marked.val)
    (ha : project D P (originalA e) = alpha D P)
    (hb : project D P (originalB e) = beta D P) :
    e ∈ retainedCopies D P marked := by
  apply (mem_retainedCopies D P marked e).mpr
  refine ⟨hd, ?_, hne⟩
  rw [ha,hb]
  intro h
  cases h

namespace SquareConsumer

def xy (x y : ℤ) : Site 2 := fun i => if i = 0 then x else y

def domain : Finset (Site 2) := {xy 0 0, xy 0 1, xy 1 0, xy 1 1}

/-- The two vertices in the left column are the one terminal. -/
def one : OneSet domain :=
  ⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun x => x.val 0 = 0), by
    refine ⟨⟨xy 0 0,by simp [domain]⟩,?_⟩
    simp [xy]⟩

def lower : {x : domain // x ∉ one.val} :=
  ⟨⟨xy 1 0, by simp [domain]⟩,by simp [one,xy]⟩

def upper : {x : domain // x ∉ one.val} :=
  ⟨⟨xy 1 1, by simp [domain]⟩,by simp [one,xy]⟩

/-- The single deleted copy goes from (0,-1) to (0,0). -/
def marked : MarkedCopy domain one :=
  ⟨(xy 0 (-1),1),by
    left
    constructor
    · simp [project,alpha,domain,originalA,xy,funext_iff,Fin.forall_fin_two]
    · have he : originalB (xy 0 (-1),1) = xy 0 0 := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> norm_num [originalB,xy,unit]
      rw [he]
      unfold project
      rw [dif_pos (by simp [domain])]
      rw [dif_pos (by simp only [one,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]; rfl)]
      rfl⟩

/-- Two different original copies reach the same zero terminal after contraction. -/
theorem east_south_parallel :
    (freeDart domain one marked lower (0,true)).1 ≠
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,false)).1 ∧
    head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (0,true)) = alpha domain one ∧
    head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,false)) = alpha domain one := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun e : Copy domain one marked => e.val.2) h
    norm_num [freeDart,incidentID] at he
  · constructor <;>
      simp [freeDart_head,project,lower,alpha,domain,one,xy,step,unit,
        funext_iff,Fin.forall_fin_two] <;> rfl

def potential (x : Vertex domain one) : ℝ :=
  match x with
  | .inl false => 0
  | .inl true => 1
  | .inr _ => 1/3

/-- The vertical free-to-free copy survives, even when its current is zero. -/
theorem zero_current_copy :
    head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,true)) = .inr upper ∧
    current (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked) potential
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,true)) = 0 := by
  have h : head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,true)) = .inr upper := by
    rw [freeDart_head]
    have he : lower.val.val + step (1,true) = upper.val.val := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> norm_num [lower,upper,xy,step,unit]
    rw [he,project_free]
  refine ⟨h,?_⟩
  simp [current,freeDart_tail,h,potential]

theorem four_copied_incidents :
    incidenceCount (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked) (.inr lower) = 4 ∧
      Geometry.degree (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked) (.inr lower) = 4 :=
  ⟨free_incidenceCount domain one marked lower,free_degree domain one marked lower⟩

end SquareConsumer

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.StatementTypes
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-- The actual copied source multigraph, with its proved looplessness. -/
def graph (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Trees.Multigraph (Vertex D P) (Copy D P marked) :=
  ⟨copyA D P marked,copyB D P marked,copy_loopless D P marked⟩

-- Literal uniform averages over the actual rooted-forest sample carrier.
-- No theorem, axiom, measure replacement or second-moment premise is installed.
#check (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
  (_hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
  (_hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
  (_hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
  (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (phi : Vertex D P → ℝ)
  (_hp0 : phi (alpha D P) = 0) (_hp1 : phi (beta D P) = 1)
  (_hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha D P → x ≠ beta D P →
    laplacian (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) phi x = 0),
  let a := copyA D P marked
  let b := copyB D P marked
  let G := graph D P marked
  let F := G.RootedForest ({alpha D P,beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))
  let Y : F → ℝ := fun f => ∑ z : Dart (Copy D P marked),
    if tail a b z = alpha D P ∧ G.reaches f.val (head a b z) (beta D P) then 1 else 0
  let mean := (∑ f : F, Y f) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ)
  let variance := (∑ f : F, (Y f - mean)^2) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ)
  let M := energy a b phi
  let m := ((domainCopies D).filter fun e =>
    (originalA e ∈ D ∧ originalB e ∉ D) ∨
    (originalB e ∈ D ∧ originalA e ∉ D)).card - 1
  mean = M ∧ variance ≤ C * M * (1 + Real.log ((m : ℝ) * min 1 M / M)) : Prop)

#print axioms graph
end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.StatementTypes

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.Repair8
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-- A copy with both original endpoints in D cannot be the marked boundary copy. -/
theorem internal_ne_marked (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (ha : originalA e ∈ D) (hb : originalB e ∈ D) : e ≠ marked.val := by
  intro he
  subst e
  rcases marked.property with h | h
  · exact ((project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h.1) ha
  · exact ((project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h.2) hb

/-- An original interior edge yields a walk after contraction, including collapsed loops. -/
theorem internal_copy_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (ha : originalA e ∈ D) (hb : originalB e ∈ D) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ
      (project D P (originalA e)) (project D P (originalB e)) := by
  by_cases heq : project D P (originalA e) = project D P (originalB e)
  · rw [heq]
    exact .refl
  · let c : Copy D P marked := ⟨e, (mem_retainedCopies D P marked e).mpr
        ⟨Or.inl ha, heq, internal_ne_marked D P marked e ha hb⟩⟩
    exact .single ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ c, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Both orientations of a physical lattice edge transport to actual copied walks. -/
theorem internal_adj_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x y : Site 2) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hxy : (lattice 2).Adj x y) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ (project D P x) (project D P y) := by
  change ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i at hxy
  obtain ⟨i, h | h⟩ := hxy
  · subst y
    exact internal_copy_reaches D P marked (x, i) hx hy
  · subst x
    exact (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches_symm
      (internal_copy_reaches D P marked (y, i) hy hx)

/-- Connectedness of D gives complete actual copied walks between all its images. -/
theorem internal_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x y : D) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ
      (project D P x.val) (project D P y.val) := by
  have hr := (SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen x y).mp (hD x y)
  induction hr with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail u v _ huv ih =>
    exact ih.trans (internal_adj_reaches D P marked u.val v.val u.property v.property huv)

/-- Every D image reaches the actual one terminal without using the marked copy. -/
theorem internal_reaches_beta (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : D) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ (project D P x.val) (beta D P) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := P.property
  have hb : project D P p.val = beta D P :=
    (project_eq_beta_iff D P _).mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  simpa only [hb] using internal_reaches D P hD marked x p

/-- A perpendicular outward boundary copy survives deletion of the marked original ID. -/
theorem alpha_reaches_beta (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ (alpha D P) (beta D P) := by
  let j : Fin 2 := if marked.val.2 = 0 then 1 else 0
  have hj : j ≠ marked.val.2 := by
    have hi : marked.val.2 = 0 ∨ marked.val.2 = 1 := by omega
    rcases hi with hi | hi <;> simp [j, hi]
  obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := P.property
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := D.exists_max_image (fun x => x j) ⟨p.val, p.property⟩
  have hout : x + unit j ∉ D := by
    intro hy
    have hle := hmax (x + unit j) hy
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, unit, Pi.single_eq_same] at hle
    omega
  have houter : project D P (x + unit j) = alpha D P :=
    (project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mpr hout
  have hfree : project D P x ≠ alpha D P := by
    intro h
    exact ((project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h) hx
  have hmarked : (x, j) ≠ marked.val := by
    intro h
    exact hj (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  let c : Copy D P marked := ⟨(x, j), (mem_retainedCopies D P marked _).mpr
    ⟨Or.inl hx, by change project D P x ≠ project D P (x + unit j); rwa [houter], hmarked⟩⟩
  have hedge : (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ
      (project D P x) (alpha D P) :=
    .single ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ c, Or.inl ⟨rfl, houter⟩⟩
  exact ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches_symm hedge).trans
    (internal_reaches_beta D P hD marked ⟨x, hx⟩)

/-- Every actual terminal/free vertex reaches beta after deletion of one original copy. -/
theorem reaches_beta (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : Vertex D P) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ x (beta D P) := by
  cases x with
  | inl v => cases v with
    | false => exact alpha_reaches_beta D P hD marked
    | true => exact .refl
  | inr v => simpa only [project_free] using internal_reaches_beta D P hD marked v.val

/-- Full global copied connectivity, not a supplied reachability premise. -/
theorem graph_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x y : Vertex D P) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ x y :=
  (reaches_beta D P hD marked x).trans
    ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches_symm (reaches_beta D P hD marked y))

/-- The positive-Laplacian supporting graph is genuinely connected. -/
theorem graph_connected (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    (supportGraph (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked)).Connected := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Vertex D P) := ⟨alpha D P⟩
  exact ⟨(StatementTypes.graph D P marked).supportGraph_preconnected_of_reaches
    (graph_reaches D P hD marked)⟩

/-- The exact original two-rooted-forest carrier is inhabited on every admitted D. -/
theorem forest_nonempty (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Nonempty ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).RootedForest
      ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))) :=
  (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).nonempty_rootedForest _
    ⟨alpha D P, by simp⟩ (graph_reaches D P hD marked)

/-- The denominator is the positive FULL original two-rooted-forest count. -/
theorem forest_card_pos (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    0 < Fintype.card ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).RootedForest
      ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))) := by
  haveI := forest_nonempty D P hD marked
  exact Fintype.card_pos

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.Repair8

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Reference.Connected

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.Repair8
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-- The source zero/one voltage exists uniquely on every actual punctured lattice network. -/
theorem existsUnique_voltage (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃! phi : Vertex D P → ℝ,
      phi (alpha D P) = 0 ∧ phi (beta D P) = 1 ∧
        ∀ x, x ≠ alpha D P → x ≠ beta D P →
          laplacian (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) phi x = 0 := by
  have hne : alpha D P ≠ beta D P := by intro h; cases h
  have hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Finset (Vertex D P)),
      (supportGraph (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked)).Reachable x y :=
    fun x => ⟨alpha D P, by simp, (graph_connected D P hD marked).preconnected x _⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, huni⟩ := existsUnique_harmonic_extension
    (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) {alpha D P, beta D P} hB
    (fun x => if x = beta D P then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  refine ⟨f, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [if_neg hne] using hf.1 (alpha D P) (by simp)
  · simpa using hf.1 (beta D P) (by simp)
  · intro x ha hb
    exact hf.2 x (by simp [ha, hb])
  · intro g hg
    apply huni g
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · simpa only [if_neg hne] using hg.1
      · simpa using hg.2.1
    · intro x hx
      exact hg.2.2 x (by intro h; exact hx (by simp [h]))
        (by intro h; exact hx (by simp [h]))

/-- Choice is made only from the proved unique source voltage. -/
def voltage (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) : Vertex D P → ℝ :=
  (existsUnique_voltage D P hD marked).choose

/-- Complete source characterization, including every free vertex and both terminal values. -/
theorem voltage_spec (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    voltage D P hD marked (alpha D P) = 0 ∧
      voltage D P hD marked (beta D P) = 1 ∧
        ∀ x, x ≠ alpha D P → x ≠ beta D P →
          laplacian (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (voltage D P hD marked) x = 0 :=
  (existsUnique_voltage D P hD marked).choose_spec.1

/-- Every characterized field equals the actual source voltage; no extension value is arbitrary. -/
theorem voltage_unique (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (f : Vertex D P → ℝ)
    (hf : f (alpha D P) = 0 ∧ f (beta D P) = 1 ∧
      ∀ x, x ≠ alpha D P → x ≠ beta D P →
        laplacian (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) f x = 0) :
    f = voltage D P hD marked :=
  (existsUnique_voltage D P hD marked).choose_spec.2 f hf

/-- The literal once-per-copy source energy is strictly positive. -/
theorem voltage_energy_pos (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    0 < energy (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (voltage D P hD marked) := by
  have hs := voltage_spec D P hD marked
  have hn := energy_nonneg (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (voltage D P hD marked)
  by_contra hpos
  have hz : energy (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (voltage D P hD marked) = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) hn
  have heq := eq_of_reachable (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked)
    (voltage D P hD marked) ((energy_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mp hz)
    ((graph_connected D P hD marked).preconnected (alpha D P) (beta D P))
  rw [hs.1, hs.2.1] at heq
  norm_num at heq

/-- The full original forest-count denominator gives a genuine uniform probability mass. -/
theorem forest_uniform_mass_sum (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    (∑ _f : (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).RootedForest
      ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P)),
      (Fintype.card ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).RootedForest
        ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))) : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1 := by
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  apply mul_inv_cancel₀
  exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (forest_card_pos D P hD marked)

end

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.BSSTStream
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.Incidence

/-! Polar dual copies on the actual complementary regions of a given outer arc. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The full geometric dual has one original-ID copy, including the added arc,
from the actual physical right face to the actual physical left face. -/
def augmentedDual {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    CopiedGraph A.embedding.Face (E ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨A.embedding.rightFace, A.embedding.leftFace⟩

/-- Removing ONLY the distinguished dual copy retains every original wire, even
when its two geometric face endpoints coincide. No coordinate or edge is chosen. -/
def polarDual {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    CopiedGraph A.embedding.Face E :=
  ⟨fun e => A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e), fun e => A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e)⟩

/-- Zero stream ground is on the right of the actual alpha-to-beta outer arc. -/
def polarGround {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    A.embedding.Face := A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())

/-- Unit injection is on the left of the SAME actual outer arc. -/
def polarSource {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    A.embedding.Face := A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ())

/-- Both dual carriers preserve precisely the original E IDs and their incidence. -/
theorem polarDual_copy {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V}
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (e : E) :
    (polarDual A).left e = (augmentedDual A).left (.inl e) ∧
      (polarDual A).right e = (augmentedDual A).right (.inl e) := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

/-- The half-open Drawing's permissive loop carrier causes no extra hypothesis:
full source arc injectivity already excludes a loop in a PlaneEmbedding. -/
theorem PlaneEmbedding.endpoints_ne (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (e : E) : J.left e ≠ J.right e := by
  intro he
  have hc : D.drawing.curve e ⟨0,by norm_num⟩ = D.drawing.curve e ⟨1,by norm_num⟩ := by
    rw [D.drawing.start,D.drawing.finish,he]
  have ht := congrArg Subtype.val (D.edge_injective e hc)
  norm_num at ht

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.PolarDual
import FiniteAvalanches.External.BSST

/-! The registered intrinsic construction gives the literal source stream for
EVERY given physical outer arc, with original copied currents and ground. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open StatementGeometry BSST
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- No stream is selected until its complete existence and uniqueness are proved. -/
theorem existsUnique_polar_stream (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (alpha beta : V)
    (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    ∃! psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ,
      stream_spec D alpha beta A (voltage J alpha beta hc) psi := by
  let B := auxiliaryArcOfOuterArc D alpha beta A
  obtain ⟨_,h⟩ := FiniteAvalanches.External.bsst_square_tiling J D.drawing hc alpha beta hne
    A.face A.alpha_incident A.beta_incident A.unbounded
  obtain ⟨face0,face1,_,hcharts,hunique,_⟩ := h B
  have he (z : E ⊕ Unit) :
      A.embedding.rightFace z = face0 z ∧ A.embedding.leftFace z = face1 z :=
    hcharts z (A.embedding.edgeChart z)
  obtain ⟨psi,hpsi,huni⟩ := hunique
  refine ⟨psi,?_,?_⟩
  · exact source_stream_consumer J D alpha beta A face0 face1 psi _ hcharts
      hpsi.1 hpsi.2.1 hpsi.2.2
  · intro chi hchi
    apply huni chi
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro e
      simpa only [← (he (.inl e)).1,← (he (.inl e)).2] using hchi.1 e
    · simpa only [← (he (.inr ())).1] using hchi.2.2.1
    · simpa only [← (he (.inr ())).2] using hchi.2.2.2

/-- In the predetermined physical polar-dual orientation, stream INCREMENTS are
primal currents; dual unit-current gradients therefore have the opposite sign. -/
theorem polar_stream_copy (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (alpha beta : V) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) (hpsi : stream_spec D alpha beta A phi psi) (e : E) :
    psi ((polarDual A).right e) - psi ((polarDual A).left e) = phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e) ∧
      psi (polarGround A) = 0 ∧ psi (polarSource A) = mass J phi :=
  ⟨hpsi.1 e,hpsi.2.2.1,hpsi.2.2.2⟩

end

/-! Conditional consumption of the exact UNREGISTERED finite-plane topology
candidate. All electrical equalities below are proved from actual copied incidence,
Poisson uniqueness and REGISTERED BSST. No electrical identity is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open StatementGeometry Plane

noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

private theorem polar_poisson_of_cycle_law (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (alpha beta : V)
    (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta)
    [Fintype A.embedding.Face] (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ)
    (hpsi : stream_spec D alpha beta A (voltage J alpha beta hc) psi)
    (hcycle : ∀ F : A.embedding.Face,
      copyBoundary (augmentedDual A).left (augmentedDual A).right
        (copyGradient (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).left
          (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).right (voltage J alpha beta hc)) F = 0)
    (F : A.embedding.Face) (hF : F ≠ polarGround A) :
    laplacian (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right psi F =
      if F = polarSource A then 1 else 0 := by
  let phi := voltage J alpha beta hc
  let j : E → ℝ := copyGradient J.left J.right phi
  have hphi := voltage_spec J alpha beta hne hc
  have hunit : ∀ u : Unit, u = () := fun u => Subsingleton.elim u ()
  have hc0 : copyBoundary (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right j F +
      ((if polarGround A = F then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) -
       (if polarSource A = F then (-1 : ℝ) else 0)) = 0 := by
    convert hcycle F using 1
    simp [copyBoundary,Fintype.sum_sum_type,
        augmentedDual,polarDual,copyGradient,augmentedGraph,
        polarGround,polarSource,hunit,hphi.1,hphi.2.1,phi,j]
    ring_nf
  have hg : copyGradient (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right psi = -j := by
    funext e
    have hs := hpsi.1 e
    change psi ((polarDual A).right e) - psi ((polarDual A).left e) = j e at hs
    change psi ((polarDual A).left e) - psi ((polarDual A).right e) = -(j e)
    linarith
  rw [← copyBoundary_gradient,hg]
  have hn := congrFun ((boundaryMap (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).map_neg j) F
  change copyBoundary (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right (-j) F =
      -copyBoundary (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right j F at hn
  rw [hn]
  by_cases hv : F = polarSource A
  · simp only [if_neg hF.symm,if_pos hv.symm,sub_neg_eq_add,zero_add] at hc0
    rw [if_pos hv]
    linarith
  · simp only [if_neg hF.symm,if_neg (Ne.symm hv),sub_self,add_zero] at hc0
    rw [if_neg hv,hc0,neg_zero]

/-- Complete polar Green/current/once-copy-energy correspondence. Only the exact
classical topology theorem is conditional; no requested electrical law or paper
estimate appears in that binder. The full actual face carrier is retained. -/
theorem polar_electrical_duality_of_classical
    (hclassical : ∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (_hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (_hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta),
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype A.embedding.Face,
      letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
      polarGround A ≠ polarSource A ∧
      (supportGraph (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).Preconnected ∧
      (∀ T : Finset (E ⊕ Unit),
        (∃ t : (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).SpanningTree, t.val = T) ↔
        (∃ t : (augmentedDual A).SpanningTree, t.val = Finset.univ \ T)) ∧
      (∀ (q : V → ℝ) (F : A.embedding.Face),
        copyBoundary (augmentedDual A).left (augmentedDual A).right
          (copyGradient (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).left
            (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).right q) F = 0))
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (alpha beta : V)
    (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype A.embedding.Face,
      letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
      polarGround A ≠ polarSource A ∧
      ∃ hd : (supportGraph (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).Preconnected,
        (∀ T : Finset (E ⊕ Unit),
          (∃ t : (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).SpanningTree, t.val = T) ↔
          (∃ t : (augmentedDual A).SpanningTree, t.val = Finset.univ \ T)) ∧
        let g := groundedGreen (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right
          (polarGround A) hd (polarSource A)
        stream_spec D alpha beta A (voltage J alpha beta hc) g ∧
        g (polarSource A) = mass J (voltage J alpha beta hc) ∧
        (∀ e, g ((polarDual A).right e)-g ((polarDual A).left e) =
          voltage J alpha beta hc (J.left e)-voltage J alpha beta hc (J.right e)) ∧
        energy (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right g = mass J (voltage J alpha beta hc) := by
  obtain ⟨finiteFaces,hp,hd,htrees,hcycle⟩ := hclassical J D hc alpha beta hne A
  letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
  obtain ⟨psi,hpsi,_⟩ := existsUnique_polar_stream J D hc alpha beta hne A
  have hg : psi = groundedGreen (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right
      (polarGround A) hd (polarSource A) := by
    exact groundedPoisson_eq (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right
      (polarGround A) hd (fun F => if F = polarSource A then 1 else 0) psi
      ⟨hpsi.2.2.1,fun F hF =>
      polar_poisson_of_cycle_law J D hc alpha beta hne A psi hpsi
        (hcycle (voltage J alpha beta hc)) F hF⟩
  refine ⟨finiteFaces,hp,hd,htrees,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [← hg]; exact hpsi
  · rw [← hg]; exact hpsi.2.2.2
  · intro e; rw [← hg]; exact hpsi.1 e
  · rw [energy_groundedGreen_eq,← hg]; exact hpsi.2.2.2


end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DiskDrawing
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Clopen
import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Proper plane drawings, actual complement faces, and oriented local edge charts. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
abbrev Plane := ℝ × ℝ

/-- An orientation-preserving plane chart, with its orientation witnessed by an isotopy. -/
structure OrientedChart where
  map : Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  isotopy : ArcParameter → Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => isotopy p.1 p.2)
  inverse_continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => (isotopy p.1).symm p.2)
  start : isotopy ⟨0,by norm_num⟩ = Homeomorph.refl Plane
  finish : isotopy ⟨1,by norm_num⟩ = map

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The whole embedded graph, retaining every original copied arc. -/
def drawingTrace (D : Drawing J) : Set Plane :=
  Set.range D.point ∪ ⋃ e, Set.range (D.curve e)

/-- A regular oriented neighborhood of an interior point of the actual edge arc. -/
structure EdgeChart (D : Drawing J) (e : E) where
  chart : OrientedChart
  radius : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < radius
  radius_small : radius < 1/4
  straight : ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val-1/2| < radius →
    chart.map (D.curve e t) = (t.val,0)
  trace_box : ∀ z : Plane, |z.1-1/2| < radius → |z.2| < radius →
    (chart.map.symm z ∈ drawingTrace D ↔ z.2 = 0)

/-- A finite proper plane embedding by simple arcs, with oriented regular edge charts.
All geometry concerns the actual curves; no rotation, face count or Euler identity is supplied. -/
structure PlaneEmbedding (J : CopiedGraph V E) where
  drawing : Drawing J
  edge_injective : ∀ e, Function.Injective (drawing.curve e)
  edgeChart : ∀ e, EdgeChart drawing e

namespace PlaneEmbedding
variable (D : PlaneEmbedding J)

/-- Faces are actual connected components of the complement of the embedded graph. -/
abbrev Face := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}

def faceRegion (F : D.Face) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}) = F}

private theorem side_off_trace (e : E) (positive : Bool) :
    (D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm
      (1/2,if positive then (D.edgeChart e).radius/2 else -((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)) ∉
        drawingTrace D.drawing := by
  let c := D.edgeChart e
  have hr := c.radius_pos
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using hr
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hn : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hp
  cases positive
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
    change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hn).mp h)
  · change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual face immediately to the left of the original oriented edge copy. -/
def leftFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,(D.edgeChart e).radius/2),D.side_off_trace e true⟩

/-- The actual face immediately to the right; bridges may have the same face on both sides. -/
def rightFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,-((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)),D.side_off_trace e false⟩

/-- Literal geometric incidence, including repeated visits of a face at a vertex. -/
def incident (x : V) (F : D.Face) : Prop := D.drawing.point x ∈ closure (D.faceRegion F)
end PlaneEmbedding

/-- The auxiliary alpha-to-beta arc retains every original edge copy. -/
def augmentedGraph (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) : CopiedGraph V (E ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨Sum.elim J.left (fun _ => alpha),Sum.elim J.right (fun _ => beta)⟩

/-- An actual arc in the chosen common outer face, not a combinatorial face assumption. -/
structure OuterArc (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V) where
  face : D.Face
  alpha_incident : D.incident alpha face
  beta_incident : D.incident beta face
  unbounded : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (D.faceRegion face)
  embedding : PlaneEmbedding (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : embedding.drawing.point = D.drawing.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, embedding.drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.drawing.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    embedding.drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ D.faceRegion face

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.PathCopies
import Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Basic
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Green.Grounded

/-! Literal geometric disk drawings and exact boundary-path statement types.
No probabilistic or electrical conclusion is included in the drawing data. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
open Trees


/-- A copied graph retains every original ID, including self-loops. -/
structure CopiedGraph (V E : Type) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V

namespace CopiedGraph
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Literal finite copied-walk reachability, including length-zero walks. -/
def reaches (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : Finset E) : V → V → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y => ∃ e ∈ T,
    (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨ (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y))

/-- Ordinary trees on the full original vertex set and original copied IDs. -/
abbrev SpanningTree (J : CopiedGraph V E) := {T : Finset E //
  (Set.univ : Set V).Nonempty ∧ (∀ x y, J.reaches T x y) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, ¬J.reaches (T.erase e) (J.left e) (J.right e)}

/-- The literal separation characterization of original-copy membership on the tree path. -/
noncomputable def pathIndicator (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v then 1 else 0

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- An original loop remains a network copy and is excluded by the actual tree predicate. -/
theorem loop_not_mem (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (e : E) (hloop : J.left e = J.right e) : e ∉ T.val := by
  intro he
  apply T.property.2.2 e he
  rw [hloop]
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

end CopiedGraph

abbrev ArcParameter := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- An actual plane drawing of the copied graph by simple continuous arcs. -/
structure Drawing {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : CopiedGraph V E) where
  point : V → ℝ × ℝ
  point_injective : Function.Injective point
  curve : E → ArcParameter → ℝ × ℝ
  continuous : ∀ e, Continuous (curve e)
  injective : ∀ e, Set.InjOn (curve e) {t | t.val < 1}
  start : ∀ e, curve e ⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.left e)
  finish : ∀ e, curve e ⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.right e)
  avoids : ∀ e t, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → ∀ v, curve e t ≠ point v
  intersects : ∀ e f, e ≠ f → ∀ s t, curve e s = curve f t →
    (s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1)

/-- The Euclidean closed unit disk, in the literal two real coordinates. -/
def disk : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 ≤ 1}
def circle : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 = 1}

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E} (drawing : Drawing J)

/-- An edge curve hits an original vertex exactly at one of its prescribed endpoints. -/
theorem curve_vertex_iff (e : E) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V) :
    drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v ↔
    (t.val = 0 ∧ J.left e = v) ∨ (t.val = 1 ∧ J.right e = v) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ht0 : t.val = 0
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht0
      rw [he, drawing.start] at h
      exact Or.inl ⟨ht0, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    by_cases ht1 : t.val = 1
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht1
      rw [he, drawing.finish] at h
      exact Or.inr ⟨ht1, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    · exact (drawing.avoids e t (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm ht0))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht1) v h).elim
  · rintro (⟨ht, hv⟩ | ⟨ht, hv⟩)
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.start, hv]
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.finish, hv]

/-- Restricting to a nonloop edge turns the literal half-open simplicity into full simplicity. -/
theorem nonloop_curve_injective (e : E) (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Function.Injective (drawing.curve e) := by
  intro s t h
  by_cases hs : s.val = 1
  · have he : s = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hs
    have hv : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [← h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t _).mp hv with ⟨ht, hn⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact Subtype.ext (hs.trans ht.symm)
  by_cases ht : t.val = 1
  · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
    have hv : drawing.curve e s = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e s _).mp hv with ⟨_, hn⟩ | ⟨hs', _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact (hs hs').elim
  · exact drawing.injective e (lt_of_le_of_ne s.property.2 hs)
      (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht) h

/-- The literal geometric realization of a vertex set and its original copied edges. -/
def trace (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (drawing.point '' C) ∪ {z | ∃ e ∈ s, ∃ t, drawing.curve e t = z}

/-- Copied edges supported on C can hit only vertices in C. -/
theorem curve_vertex_mem {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ s) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V)
    (h : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v) : v ∈ C := by
  rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp h with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv⟩
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).1
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).2

/-- Distinct forest components have literally disjoint drawings, even with loops and parallels.
This supplies geometric disjointness to a Jordan argument; no no-crossing conclusion is assumed. -/
theorem traces_disjoint {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E} (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D) :
    Disjoint (drawing.trace C s) (drawing.trace D t) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzC hzD
  rcases hzC with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, he, q, hq⟩
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyx' := drawing.point_injective hyx
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (hyx' ▸ hy)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (drawing.curve_vertex_mem ht f hf r x hr)
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyC : y ∈ C := drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q y (hq.trans hyz.symm)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hyC hy
    · by_cases hef : e = f
      · subst f
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (hs e he).1 (ht e hf).1
      · have hqr := drawing.intersects e f hef q r (hq.trans hr.symm)
        rcases hqr.2 with hr0 | hr1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr0
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.left f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.start]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr1
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.right f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.finish]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).2

/-- A real finite copied walk supplies a compact connected geometric set in its component trace. -/
theorem reachable_continuum {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (_hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) (y : V) (hxy : J.reaches s x y) :
    ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K ⊆ drawing.trace C s ∧
      drawing.point x ∈ K ∧ drawing.point y ∈ K := by
  induction hxy with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨{drawing.point x}, isCompact_singleton, isConnected_singleton, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z = drawing.point x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    subst z
    exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hxK, hyK⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e, he, heyz⟩ := hyz
    let A := Set.range (drawing.curve e)
    have hyA : drawing.point y ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.1]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.1]⟩
    have hzA : drawing.point z ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.2]⟩
    refine ⟨K ∪ A, hKc.union (isCompact_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      hKconn.union ⟨drawing.point y, hyK, hyA⟩ (isConnected_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      ?_, Or.inl hxK, Or.inr hzA⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with hw | ⟨t, ht⟩
    · exact hKt hw
    · exact Or.inr ⟨e, he, t, ht⟩

/-- Two disjoint forest components give disjoint actual continua joining their terminals. -/
theorem disjoint_connecting_continua {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : V) (hx : x₀ ∈ C) (hy : y₀ ∈ D)
    (hxx : J.reaches s x₀ x₁) (hyy : J.reaches t y₀ y₁)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk) :
    ∃ K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ IsCompact L ∧ IsConnected L ∧
      K ⊆ disk ∧ L ⊆ disk ∧ Disjoint K L ∧
      drawing.point x₀ ∈ K ∧ drawing.point x₁ ∈ K ∧
      drawing.point y₀ ∈ L ∧ drawing.point y₁ ∈ L := by
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hx₀, hx₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum hs x₀ hx x₁ hxx
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLconn, hLt, hy₀, hy₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum ht y₀ hy y₁ hyy
  have htrace (A : Set V) (F : Finset E) : drawing.trace A F ⊆ disk := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, _, q, hq⟩
    · exact hvertices v
    · exact hq ▸ hedges e q
  exact ⟨K, L, hKc, hKconn, hLc, hLconn, hKt.trans (htrace C s),
    hLt.trans (htrace D t), (drawing.traces_disjoint hCD hs ht).mono hKt hLt,
    hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩

end Drawing
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-! Uncharted proper drawings, their literal complement faces, and original-copy coordinates. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source (Plane drawingTrace augmentedGraph voltage mass)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Actual connected components of the complement of the full original drawn trace. -/
abbrev Face (D : Drawing J) := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D}

/-- The actual plane region represented by a complement component. -/
def faceRegion (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D}) = F}

/-- Literal geometric vertex incidence, including repeated visits of the same face. -/
def incident (D : Drawing J) (x : V) (F : Face D) : Prop :=
  D.point x ∈ closure (faceRegion D F)

/-- Actual faces whose closed boundary contains the whole original copied edge arc. -/
def edgeFaces (D : Drawing J) (e : E) : Set (Face D) :=
  {F | Set.range (D.curve e) ⊆ closure (faceRegion D F)}

/-- A genuine auxiliary arc in the chosen face, retaining every original point and curve. -/
structure AuxiliaryArc (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V) where
  drawing : Drawing (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : drawing.point = D.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ faceRegion D F

/-- The source zero/one-voltage interval crossed with the actual dual-face voltage interval. -/
def copiedSquare (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    {W : Type} (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e)))
    (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
  Set.Icc (min (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))
    (max (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))

/-- The literal positive-Laplacian Dirichlet characterization on the polar dual.
The dual retains the original E; the added arc determines its two boundary faces only. -/
def dualVoltageSpec {W : Type} (face0 face1 : E → W) (pole0 pole1 : W)
    (M : ℝ) (psi : W → ℝ) : Prop :=
  psi pole0 = 0 ∧ psi pole1 = M ∧
    ∀ F, F ≠ pole0 → F ≠ pole1 → laplacian face0 face1 psi F = 0

/-- All actual incident-face voltages, without a finite orbit or default extremum. -/
def incidentValues (D : Drawing J) (psi : Face D → ℝ) (x : V) : Set ℝ :=
  {y | ∃ F, incident D x F ∧ psi F = y}

/-- The source vertical segment with explicitly attained lower and upper face values. -/
def vertexSegment (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) (lo hi : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
  {phi x} ×ˢ Set.Icc lo hi

/-- Whole-arc face incidence includes each prescribed endpoint, without charts. -/
theorem edgeFaces_endpoints (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (F : Face D)
    (hF : F ∈ edgeFaces D e) :
    incident D (J.left e) F ∧ incident D (J.right e) F := by
  constructor
  · exact hF ⟨⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.start e⟩
  · exact hF ⟨⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.finish e⟩

/-- Erasing chart witnesses changes neither the actual complement nor vertex incidence. -/
theorem charted_incident_eq (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (x : V) (F : D.Face) :
    incident D.drawing x F ↔ D.incident x F := Iff.rfl

/-- An existing physical outer arc supplies the uncharted auxiliary-arc data. -/
def auxiliaryArcOfOuterArc (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : Source.OuterArc D alpha beta) : AuxiliaryArc D.drawing A.face alpha beta where
  drawing := A.embedding.drawing
  point_eq := A.point_eq
  curve_eq := A.curve_eq
  interior_in_face := A.interior_in_face

/-- The actual augmented trace adds precisely one curve to the full original trace. -/
theorem auxiliary_trace (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) :
    drawingTrace A.drawing = drawingTrace D ∪ Set.range (A.drawing.curve (.inr ())) := by
  ext z
  simp only [drawingTrace,Set.mem_union,Set.mem_range,Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩)
    · cases e with
      | inl e => exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩)
      | inr e => cases e; exact Or.inr ⟨t,ht⟩
  · rintro ((⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩) | ⟨t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr (),t,ht⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- A zero-current original copy becomes its actual common voltage/dual-voltage point. -/
theorem zero_current_square {W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E)
    (hp : phi (J.left e) = phi (J.right e))
    (hdual : |psi (face0 e)-psi (face1 e)| = |phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)|) :
    copiedSquare J phi psi face0 face1 e = {(phi (J.left e),psi (face0 e))} := by
  have hpsi : psi (face0 e) = psi (face1 e) := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply abs_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [hp,sub_self,abs_zero] using hdual
  simp only [copiedSquare,hp,hpsi,min_self,max_self,Set.Icc_self,
    Set.singleton_prod_singleton]


/-- A chart's positive side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem positive_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- A chart's negative side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem negative_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_neg,abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's positive side point. -/
def positiveChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2),
    positive_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's negative side point. -/
def negativeChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)),
    negative_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

namespace FiniteAvalanches.External

/-- Classical intrinsic stream/square corollary of Brooks–Smith–Stone–Tutte (1940),
§§3.3 and 4.1–4.3, printed pp319–322, on the actual complement faces and original
copied wires. Auxiliary existence, every auxiliary arc, physical given-chart side
compatibility, unique signed-current stream, and original closed-square coverage
are included. No chart or cyclic-order existence, vertex-range bound, split,
logarithmic or moment conclusion is trusted. -/
axiom bsst_square_tiling :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (_hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (F : Face D) (_ha : incident D alpha F) (_hb : incident D beta F)
    (_houter : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (faceRegion D F)),
    let phi := voltage J alpha beta hc
    let M := mass J phi
    Nonempty (AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) ∧
    ∀ A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta,
    ∃ face0 face1 : E ⊕ Unit → Face A.drawing,
      (∀ z, edgeFaces A.drawing z = {face0 z,face1 z}) ∧
      (∀ z (c : Source.EdgeChart A.drawing z),
        negativeChartFace A.drawing z c = face0 z ∧
        positiveChartFace A.drawing z c = face1 z) ∧
      (∃! psi : Face A.drawing → ℝ,
        (∀ e, psi (face1 (.inl e))-psi (face0 (.inl e)) =
          phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
        psi (face0 (.inr ())) = 0 ∧ psi (face1 (.inr ())) = M) ∧
      ∀ psi : Face A.drawing → ℝ,
        ((∀ e, psi (face1 (.inl e))-psi (face0 (.inl e)) =
          phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
          psi (face0 (.inr ())) = 0 ∧ psi (face1 (.inr ())) = M) →
        (∀ F, 0 ≤ psi F ∧ psi F ≤ M) ∧
        (∀ e f : E, e ≠ f → Disjoint
          (interior (copiedSquare J phi psi (fun e => face0 (.inl e))
            (fun e => face1 (.inl e)) e))
          (interior (copiedSquare J phi psi (fun e => face0 (.inl e))
            (fun e => face1 (.inl e)) f))) ∧
        (⋃ e : E, copiedSquare J phi psi (fun e => face0 (.inl e))
          (fun e => face1 (.inl e)) e) = Set.Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 M

end FiniteAvalanches.External

/-- Pure finite plane vertex-star topology on actual complement-component faces. -/
axiom plane_vertex_face_star : ∀ (V E : Type) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J),
    (∀ u v, J.reaches Finset.univ u v) →
    ∀ x : V,
      {F : Face D | incident D x F}.Nonempty ∧
      {F : Face D | incident D x F}.Finite ∧
      (∀ F : Face D, incident D x F ↔
        ∃ e : E, (J.left e = x ∨ J.right e = x) ∧ F ∈ edgeFaces D e) ∧
      (∀ F G : Face D, incident D x F → incident D x G →
        Relation.ReflTransGen
          (fun A B : Face D => ∃ e : E,
            (J.left e = x ∨ J.right e = x) ∧
            A ∈ edgeFaces D e ∧ B ∈ edgeFaces D e) F G)

end FiniteAvalanches.External

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy
import LatticeProb.Network.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-! Aggregating electrical quantities while retaining the original edge-copy index. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Supporting simple graph of the nonloop edge copies. -/
def supportGraph (a b : E → V) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e, (a e = x ∧ b e = y) ∨ (b e = x ∧ a e = y)
  symm := ⟨by
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := h
    exact ⟨Ne.symm hne, e, he.elim (fun h => Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      (fun h => Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro x h; exact h.1 rfl⟩

/-- Conductance equal to edge-copy multiplicity, with loops removed. -/
noncomputable def conductance (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  if x = y then 0 else ∑ e,
    ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then 1 else 0) +
     (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then 1 else 0))

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_nonneg (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : 0 ≤ conductance a b x y := by
  unfold conductance
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun e _ => add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_symm (a b : E → V) (x y : V) :
    conductance a b x y = conductance a b y x := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y; rfl
  simp only [conductance, if_neg hxy, if_neg (Ne.symm hxy)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [and_comm]
  ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem isCond_conductance (a b : E → V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.IsCond (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) := by
  refine ⟨conductance_symm a b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := hxy
    rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro e _
      exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    · refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ e, ?_⟩
      rcases he with he | he
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
  · intro x y hxy
    by_cases hne : x = y
    · simp only [conductance, if_pos hne]
    · rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
      have h1 : ¬ (a e = x ∧ b e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inl he⟩
      have h2 : ¬ (b e = x ∧ a e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inr he⟩
      simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x y : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    conductance a b x y * f y = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then f y else 0) +
       (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then f y else 0)) := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    simp only [conductance, hf, mul_zero, ite_self, add_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · rw [conductance, if_neg hxy, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    simp only [add_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]

theorem sum_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    (∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y) = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x then f (b e) else 0) +
       (if b e = x then f (a e) else 0)) := by
  simp_rw [conductance_mul a b x _ f hf]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_and, Finset.sum_ite_irrel,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem sum_neighbor_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ y ∈ (supportGraph a b).neighborFinset x, conductance a b x y * f y) =
      ∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y := by
  apply LatticeProb.Network.sum_neighborFinset_eq_sum x Finset.univ
  · intro y hxy
    rw [(isCond_conductance a b).zero_of_not_adj hxy, zero_mul]
  · intro y _ _
    exact Finset.mem_univ y

theorem netLaplacian_eq_neg_laplacian (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) h x =
      -laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian, sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
    sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => h y - h x) (sub_self _)]
  unfold laplacian
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

theorem energyOn_eq_two_mul_energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    LatticeProb.Network.energyOn (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) Finset.univ f =
      2 * energy a b f := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.energyOn_eq_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ e, ((if a e = x then (f x - f (b e)) ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if b e = x then (f x - f (a e)) ^ 2 else 0)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      rw [sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
        sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => (f x - f y) ^ 2) (by simp)]
    _ = 2 * energy a b f := ordered_incidence_energy a b f

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
