namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ChartExistence
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Ordinary compact separation supplies every trace-box field once an actual
parametrized arc has been straightened. No graph-topology result is assumed. -/
theorem edgeChart_of_straightening (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : OrientedChart)
    (hs : ∀ t : ArcParameter, c.map (D.curve e t) = (t.val, 0)) :
    Nonempty (EdgeChart D e) := by
  let tmid : ArcParameter := ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  let K : Set Plane := Set.range D.point ∪
    ⋃ f : {f : E // f ≠ e}, Set.range (D.curve f.val)
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    (Set.finite_range D.point).isCompact.union
      (isCompact_iUnion fun f : {f : E // f ≠ e} => isCompact_range (D.continuous f.val))
  have hmid : D.curve e tmid ∉ K := by
    rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | h)
    · exact D.avoids e tmid (by norm_num [tmid]) (by norm_num [tmid]) v hv.symm
    · obtain ⟨f, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
      have hi := (D.intersects e f.val (Ne.symm f.property) tmid t ht.symm).1
      norm_num [tmid] at hi
  have hq : (1/2, 0) ∉ c.map '' K := by
    rintro ⟨z, hz, he⟩
    apply hmid
    have heq : z = D.curve e tmid := c.map.injective (he.trans (hs tmid).symm)
    exact heq ▸ hz
  have hopen : IsOpen (c.map '' K)ᶜ := (hK.image c.map.continuous).isClosed.isOpen_compl
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen (1/2, 0) hq
  let r : ℝ := min (epsilon / 2) (1/8)
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (half_pos hepsilon) (by norm_num)
  have hsmall : r < 1/4 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
  have hrepsilon : r < epsilon := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨⟨c, r, hr, hsmall, fun t _ => hs t, ?_⟩⟩
  intro z hx hy
  have hzball : z ∈ Metric.ball (1/2, 0) epsilon := by
    change dist z (1/2, 0) < epsilon
    have hd : dist z (1/2, 0) < r := by
      simpa only [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using max_lt hx hy
    exact lt_trans hd hrepsilon
  have hzK : c.map.symm z ∉ K := by
    intro hz
    exact hball hzball ⟨c.map.symm z, hz, c.map.apply_symm_apply z⟩
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | h)
    · exact (hzK (Or.inl ⟨v, hv⟩)).elim
    · obtain ⟨f, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
      by_cases hfe : f = e
      · subst f
        have he : z = (t.val, 0) := by
          rw [← hs t, ht, c.map.apply_symm_apply]
        exact congrArg Prod.snd he
      · exact (hzK (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨f, hfe⟩, t, ht⟩))).elim
  · intro hz
    have ht : z.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have h := abs_lt.mp hx
      constructor <;> linarith [hsmall]
    let t : ArcParameter := ⟨z.1, ht⟩
    have he : D.curve e t = c.map.symm z := by
      apply c.map.injective
      rw [hs t, c.map.apply_symm_apply]
      exact Prod.ext rfl hz.symm
    exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, t, he⟩)

/-- Same original drawing and copy IDs; this packages EXISTING edge charts only. -/
def planeEmbeddingOfCharts (D : Drawing J) (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e)
    (charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart D e) : PlaneEmbedding J where
  drawing := D
  edge_injective := fun e => D.nonloop_curve_injective e (hloop e)
  edgeChart := charts

/-- Exact intended application of the proposed PURE parametrized-arc standard.
This is conditional on that unregistered standard, not source chart existence. -/
theorem consume_arc_straightening
    (straighten : ∀ gamma : ArcParameter → Plane,
      Continuous gamma → Function.Injective gamma →
        ∃ c : OrientedChart, ∀ t : ArcParameter, c.map (gamma t) = (t.val, 0))
    (D : Drawing J) (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Nonempty (∀ e, EdgeChart D e) := by
  have h : ∀ e, Nonempty (EdgeChart D e) := by
    intro e
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := straighten (D.curve e) (D.continuous e)
      (D.nonloop_curve_injective e (hloop e))
    exact edgeChart_of_straightening D e c hc
  exact ⟨fun e => Classical.choice (h e)⟩

/-- The same single pure standard applies to the ACTUAL auxiliary drawing,
including all original copies and the new alpha-to-beta arc. -/
theorem consume_auxiliary_straightening
    (straighten : ∀ gamma : ArcParameter → Plane,
      Continuous gamma → Function.Injective gamma →
        ∃ c : OrientedChart, ∀ t : ArcParameter, c.map (gamma t) = (t.val, 0))
    (D : Drawing J) (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e)
    (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (F : BSST.Face D)
    (A : BSST.AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) :
    Nonempty (∀ z : E ⊕ Unit, EdgeChart A.drawing z) := by
  apply consume_arc_straightening straighten A.drawing
  intro z
  cases z with
  | inl e => exact hloop e
  | inr _ => exact hne

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ChartExistence

/-- Exact ordinary successor: supply the audited pure standard internally.
The actual chosen face remains unbounded; no face redrawing is asserted. -/
theorem source_outer_arc_of_unbounded_face
    {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (F : BSST.Face D)
    (ha : BSST.incident D alpha F) (hb : BSST.incident D beta F)
    (hu : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (BSST.faceRegion D F)) :
    ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart D e,
      ∃ O : OuterArc (planeEmbeddingOfCharts D hloop charts) alpha beta, O.face = F := by
  obtain ⟨charts⟩ := consume_arc_straightening FiniteAvalanches.External.parametrized_plane_arc_straightening D hloop
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := (FiniteAvalanches.External.bsst_square_tiling J D hc alpha beta hne F ha hb hu).1
  obtain ⟨augCharts⟩ := consume_auxiliary_straightening FiniteAvalanches.External.parametrized_plane_arc_straightening D hloop alpha beta hne F A
  let P := planeEmbeddingOfCharts D hloop charts
  let Q := planeEmbeddingOfCharts A.drawing (by
    intro z
    cases z with
    | inl e => exact hloop e
    | inr _ => exact hne) augCharts
  let O : OuterArc P alpha beta := {
    face := F
    alpha_incident := ha
    beta_incident := hb
    unbounded := hu
    embedding := Q
    point_eq := A.point_eq
    curve_eq := A.curve_eq
    interior_in_face := A.interior_in_face }
  exact ⟨charts, O, rfl⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ChartExistence

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DiskDrawing
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Clopen
import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Proper plane drawings, actual complement faces, and oriented local edge charts. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
abbrev Plane := ℝ × ℝ

/-- An orientation-preserving plane chart, with its orientation witnessed by an isotopy. -/
structure OrientedChart where
  map : Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  isotopy : ArcParameter → Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => isotopy p.1 p.2)
  inverse_continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => (isotopy p.1).symm p.2)
  start : isotopy ⟨0,by norm_num⟩ = Homeomorph.refl Plane
  finish : isotopy ⟨1,by norm_num⟩ = map

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The whole embedded graph, retaining every original copied arc. -/
def drawingTrace (D : Drawing J) : Set Plane :=
  Set.range D.point ∪ ⋃ e, Set.range (D.curve e)

/-- A regular oriented neighborhood of an interior point of the actual edge arc. -/
structure EdgeChart (D : Drawing J) (e : E) where
  chart : OrientedChart
  radius : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < radius
  radius_small : radius < 1/4
  straight : ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val-1/2| < radius →
    chart.map (D.curve e t) = (t.val,0)
  trace_box : ∀ z : Plane, |z.1-1/2| < radius → |z.2| < radius →
    (chart.map.symm z ∈ drawingTrace D ↔ z.2 = 0)

/-- A finite proper plane embedding by simple arcs, with oriented regular edge charts.
All geometry concerns the actual curves; no rotation, face count or Euler identity is supplied. -/
structure PlaneEmbedding (J : CopiedGraph V E) where
  drawing : Drawing J
  edge_injective : ∀ e, Function.Injective (drawing.curve e)
  edgeChart : ∀ e, EdgeChart drawing e

namespace PlaneEmbedding
variable (D : PlaneEmbedding J)

/-- Faces are actual connected components of the complement of the embedded graph. -/
abbrev Face := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}

def faceRegion (F : D.Face) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}) = F}

private theorem side_off_trace (e : E) (positive : Bool) :
    (D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm
      (1/2,if positive then (D.edgeChart e).radius/2 else -((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)) ∉
        drawingTrace D.drawing := by
  let c := D.edgeChart e
  have hr := c.radius_pos
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using hr
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hn : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hp
  cases positive
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
    change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hn).mp h)
  · change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual face immediately to the left of the original oriented edge copy. -/
def leftFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,(D.edgeChart e).radius/2),D.side_off_trace e true⟩

/-- The actual face immediately to the right; bridges may have the same face on both sides. -/
def rightFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,-((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)),D.side_off_trace e false⟩

/-- Literal geometric incidence, including repeated visits of a face at a vertex. -/
def incident (x : V) (F : D.Face) : Prop := D.drawing.point x ∈ closure (D.faceRegion F)
end PlaneEmbedding

/-- The auxiliary alpha-to-beta arc retains every original edge copy. -/
def augmentedGraph (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) : CopiedGraph V (E ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨Sum.elim J.left (fun _ => alpha),Sum.elim J.right (fun _ => beta)⟩

/-- An actual arc in the chosen common outer face, not a combinatorial face assumption. -/
structure OuterArc (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V) where
  face : D.Face
  alpha_incident : D.incident alpha face
  beta_incident : D.incident beta face
  unbounded : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (D.faceRegion face)
  embedding : PlaneEmbedding (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : embedding.drawing.point = D.drawing.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, embedding.drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.drawing.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    embedding.drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ D.faceRegion face

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy
import LatticeProb.Network.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-! Aggregating electrical quantities while retaining the original edge-copy index. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Supporting simple graph of the nonloop edge copies. -/
def supportGraph (a b : E → V) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e, (a e = x ∧ b e = y) ∨ (b e = x ∧ a e = y)
  symm := ⟨by
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := h
    exact ⟨Ne.symm hne, e, he.elim (fun h => Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      (fun h => Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro x h; exact h.1 rfl⟩

/-- Conductance equal to edge-copy multiplicity, with loops removed. -/
noncomputable def conductance (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  if x = y then 0 else ∑ e,
    ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then 1 else 0) +
     (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then 1 else 0))

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_nonneg (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : 0 ≤ conductance a b x y := by
  unfold conductance
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun e _ => add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_symm (a b : E → V) (x y : V) :
    conductance a b x y = conductance a b y x := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y; rfl
  simp only [conductance, if_neg hxy, if_neg (Ne.symm hxy)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [and_comm]
  ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem isCond_conductance (a b : E → V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.IsCond (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) := by
  refine ⟨conductance_symm a b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := hxy
    rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro e _
      exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    · refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ e, ?_⟩
      rcases he with he | he
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
  · intro x y hxy
    by_cases hne : x = y
    · simp only [conductance, if_pos hne]
    · rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
      have h1 : ¬ (a e = x ∧ b e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inl he⟩
      have h2 : ¬ (b e = x ∧ a e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inr he⟩
      simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x y : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    conductance a b x y * f y = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then f y else 0) +
       (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then f y else 0)) := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    simp only [conductance, hf, mul_zero, ite_self, add_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · rw [conductance, if_neg hxy, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    simp only [add_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]

theorem sum_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    (∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y) = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x then f (b e) else 0) +
       (if b e = x then f (a e) else 0)) := by
  simp_rw [conductance_mul a b x _ f hf]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_and, Finset.sum_ite_irrel,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem sum_neighbor_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ y ∈ (supportGraph a b).neighborFinset x, conductance a b x y * f y) =
      ∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y := by
  apply LatticeProb.Network.sum_neighborFinset_eq_sum x Finset.univ
  · intro y hxy
    rw [(isCond_conductance a b).zero_of_not_adj hxy, zero_mul]
  · intro y _ _
    exact Finset.mem_univ y

theorem netLaplacian_eq_neg_laplacian (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) h x =
      -laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian, sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
    sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => h y - h x) (sub_self _)]
  unfold laplacian
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

theorem energyOn_eq_two_mul_energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    LatticeProb.Network.energyOn (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) Finset.univ f =
      2 * energy a b f := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.energyOn_eq_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ e, ((if a e = x then (f x - f (b e)) ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if b e = x then (f x - f (a e)) ^ 2 else 0)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      rw [sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
        sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => (f x - f y) ^ 2) (by simp)]
    _ = 2 * energy a b f := ordered_incidence_energy a b f

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.OrientedDrawing
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- Connectedness supplies the Dirichlet boundary condition before voltage choice. -/
theorem two_terminal_reachable (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) :
    ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ ({alpha,beta} : Finset V), (supportGraph J.left J.right).Reachable x y :=
  fun x => ⟨alpha,by simp,hc x alpha⟩

/-- The actual unique zero/one Dirichlet voltage of the original copied network. -/
def voltage (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) : V → ℝ :=
  harmonicExtension J.left J.right {alpha,beta} (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc)
    (fun x => if x = beta then 1 else 0)

theorem voltage_spec (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) :
    voltage J alpha beta hc alpha = 0 ∧ voltage J alpha beta hc beta = 1 ∧
      ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian J.left J.right (voltage J alpha beta hc) x = 0 := by
  have h := harmonicExtension_spec J.left J.right {alpha,beta}
    (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc) (fun x => if x = beta then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [voltage,if_neg hne] using h.1 alpha (by simp)
  · simpa [voltage] using h.1 beta (by simp)
  · intro x ha hb
    exact h.2 x (by simp [ha,hb])

/-- The full source characterization uniquely determines the chosen voltage. -/
theorem voltage_unique (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (f : V → ℝ)
    (ha : f alpha = 0) (hb : f beta = 1)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian J.left J.right f x = 0) :
    f = voltage J alpha beta hc := by
  apply harmonicExtension_eq J.left J.right {alpha,beta}
    (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc) (fun x => if x = beta then 1 else 0)
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · rw [ha,if_neg hne]
    · rw [hb,if_pos rfl]
  · intro x hx
    have h : x ≠ alpha ∧ x ≠ beta := by simpa only
      [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] using hx
    exact hh x h.1 h.2

def mass (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ) : ℝ := energy J.left J.right phi

/-- Physical original-edge currents and closing-arc current +M; the arc is not an energy edge. -/
def stream_spec {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ) (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e, psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))-psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e)) =
    phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
  psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ()))-psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())) = mass J phi ∧
  psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())) = 0 ∧
  psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ())) = mass J phi

/-- Each original copy's closed voltage/stream rectangle; zero-current copies are points. -/
def edgeSquare {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ) (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
    Set.Icc (min (psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))) (psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e))))
      (max (psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))) (psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e))))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef

/-! The grounded Green kernel of the actual positive copied Laplacian. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Arbitrary Poisson data have a unique zero-ground solution on a connected copied network. -/
theorem existsUnique_grounded_poisson (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) :
    ∃! f : V → ℝ, f v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b f x = r x := by
  let B : Finset V := {v}
  have hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y := fun x => ⟨v,by simp [B],hc x v⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB)
    (fun x => r x.val)
  have hspec : zeroExtend B u v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = r x := by
    constructor
    · simp [zeroExtend,B]
    · intro x hx
      exact congrFun hu ⟨x,by simpa [B] using hx⟩
  refine ⟨zeroExtend B u,hspec,?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hz : f-zeroExtend B u = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
    · intro x hx
      have h : x = v := by simpa [B] using hx
      subst x
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply,hf.1,hspec.1,sub_self]
    · intro x hx
      have h : x ≠ v := by simpa [B] using hx
      rw [laplacian_sub,hf.2 x h,hspec.2 x h,sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- Selected only after the Poisson existence and uniqueness theorem. -/
noncomputable def groundedPoisson (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose

theorem groundedPoisson_spec (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) :
    groundedPoisson a b v hc r v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b (groundedPoisson a b v hc r) x = r x :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose_spec.1

theorem groundedPoisson_eq (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : f v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b f x = r x) : f = groundedPoisson a b v hc r :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose_spec.2 f hf

/-- Unit injection at x and grounding at v; injection at v gives the identically zero row. -/
noncomputable def groundedGreen (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  groundedPoisson a b v hc (fun z => if z = x then 1 else 0) y

theorem groundedGreen_ground (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) : groundedGreen a b v hc x v = 0 :=
  (groundedPoisson_spec a b v hc _).1

theorem groundedGreen_laplacian (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) (hy : y ≠ v) :
    laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) y = if y = x then 1 else 0 :=
  (groundedPoisson_spec a b v hc _).2 y hy

theorem groundedGreen_ground_source (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) : groundedGreen a b v hc v = 0 := by
  apply (groundedPoisson_eq a b v hc _ 0 ?_).symm
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [if_neg hx]
  change laplacian a b (fun _ => 0) x = 0
  exact laplacian_const a b 0 x

/-- Pairing with a zero-ground function removes only the actual ground term. -/
theorem groundedGreen_pairing (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f v = 0) :
    (∑ y, f y*laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) y) = f x := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ y, f y*(if y = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      by_cases hy : y = v
      · subst y; rw [hf,zero_mul,zero_mul]
      · rw [groundedGreen_laplacian a b v hc x y hy]
    _ = f x := by simp

/-- Reciprocity follows from the literal copied-edge incidence pairing. -/
theorem groundedGreen_symm (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) :
    groundedGreen a b v hc x y = groundedGreen a b v hc y x := by
  have hxy := groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc x (groundedGreen a b v hc y) (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc y)
  have hyx := groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc y (groundedGreen a b v hc x) (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc x)
  rw [incidence_sum] at hxy hyx
  have hs : (∑ e, (groundedGreen a b v hc x (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc x (b e))*
      (groundedGreen a b v hc y (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc y (b e))) =
      ∑ e, (groundedGreen a b v hc y (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc y (b e))*
        (groundedGreen a b v hc x (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc x (b e)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    ring
  exact hyx.symm.trans (hs.symm.trans hxy)

/-- Unit-current energy equals the actual Green diagonal, with E counted once. -/
theorem energy_groundedGreen_eq (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) :
    energy a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) = groundedGreen a b v hc x x := by
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
  exact groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc x _ (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc x)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-- The full drawn finite graph is compact, including every copied arc and vertex. -/
theorem drawingTrace_isCompact (D : Drawing J) : IsCompact (drawingTrace D) :=
  (Set.finite_range D.point).isCompact.union
    (isCompact_iUnion fun e => isCompact_range (D.continuous e))

/-- The actual face carrier is the complement of a closed embedded graph. -/
theorem drawingTrace_isClosed (D : Drawing J) : IsClosed (drawingTrace D) :=
  (drawingTrace_isCompact D).isClosed

/-! Uncharted proper drawings, their literal complement faces, and original-copy coordinates. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source (Plane drawingTrace augmentedGraph voltage mass)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Actual connected components of the complement of the full original drawn trace. -/
abbrev Face (D : Drawing J) := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D}

/-- The actual plane region represented by a complement component. -/
def faceRegion (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D}) = F}

/-- Literal geometric vertex incidence, including repeated visits of the same face. -/
def incident (D : Drawing J) (x : V) (F : Face D) : Prop :=
  D.point x ∈ closure (faceRegion D F)

/-- Actual faces whose closed boundary contains the whole original copied edge arc. -/
def edgeFaces (D : Drawing J) (e : E) : Set (Face D) :=
  {F | Set.range (D.curve e) ⊆ closure (faceRegion D F)}

/-- A genuine auxiliary arc in the chosen face, retaining every original point and curve. -/
structure AuxiliaryArc (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V) where
  drawing : Drawing (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : drawing.point = D.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ faceRegion D F

/-- The source zero/one-voltage interval crossed with the actual dual-face voltage interval. -/
def copiedSquare (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    {W : Type} (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e)))
    (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
  Set.Icc (min (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))
    (max (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))

/-- The literal positive-Laplacian Dirichlet characterization on the polar dual.
The dual retains the original E; the added arc determines its two boundary faces only. -/
def dualVoltageSpec {W : Type} (face0 face1 : E → W) (pole0 pole1 : W)
    (M : ℝ) (psi : W → ℝ) : Prop :=
  psi pole0 = 0 ∧ psi pole1 = M ∧
    ∀ F, F ≠ pole0 → F ≠ pole1 → laplacian face0 face1 psi F = 0

/-- All actual incident-face voltages, without a finite orbit or default extremum. -/
def incidentValues (D : Drawing J) (psi : Face D → ℝ) (x : V) : Set ℝ :=
  {y | ∃ F, incident D x F ∧ psi F = y}

/-- The source vertical segment with explicitly attained lower and upper face values. -/
def vertexSegment (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) (lo hi : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
  {phi x} ×ˢ Set.Icc lo hi

/-- Whole-arc face incidence includes each prescribed endpoint, without charts. -/
theorem edgeFaces_endpoints (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (F : Face D)
    (hF : F ∈ edgeFaces D e) :
    incident D (J.left e) F ∧ incident D (J.right e) F := by
  constructor
  · exact hF ⟨⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.start e⟩
  · exact hF ⟨⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.finish e⟩

/-- Erasing chart witnesses changes neither the actual complement nor vertex incidence. -/
theorem charted_incident_eq (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (x : V) (F : D.Face) :
    incident D.drawing x F ↔ D.incident x F := Iff.rfl

/-- An existing physical outer arc supplies the uncharted auxiliary-arc data. -/
def auxiliaryArcOfOuterArc (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : Source.OuterArc D alpha beta) : AuxiliaryArc D.drawing A.face alpha beta where
  drawing := A.embedding.drawing
  point_eq := A.point_eq
  curve_eq := A.curve_eq
  interior_in_face := A.interior_in_face

/-- The actual augmented trace adds precisely one curve to the full original trace. -/
theorem auxiliary_trace (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) :
    drawingTrace A.drawing = drawingTrace D ∪ Set.range (A.drawing.curve (.inr ())) := by
  ext z
  simp only [drawingTrace,Set.mem_union,Set.mem_range,Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩)
    · cases e with
      | inl e => exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩)
      | inr e => cases e; exact Or.inr ⟨t,ht⟩
  · rintro ((⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩) | ⟨t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr (),t,ht⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- A zero-current original copy becomes its actual common voltage/dual-voltage point. -/
theorem zero_current_square {W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E)
    (hp : phi (J.left e) = phi (J.right e))
    (hdual : |psi (face0 e)-psi (face1 e)| = |phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)|) :
    copiedSquare J phi psi face0 face1 e = {(phi (J.left e),psi (face0 e))} := by
  have hpsi : psi (face0 e) = psi (face1 e) := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply abs_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [hp,sub_self,abs_zero] using hdual
  simp only [copiedSquare,hp,hpsi,min_self,max_self,Set.Icc_self,
    Set.singleton_prod_singleton]


/-- A chart's positive side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem positive_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- A chart's negative side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem negative_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_neg,abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's positive side point. -/
def positiveChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2),
    positive_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's negative side point. -/
def negativeChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)),
    negative_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

/-! Deleting one original tree copy deletes exactly its simple edge, because
copy-to-edge is injective on an actual forest. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem toSimple_erase_tree (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val) :
    G.toSimple (t.val.erase f) = (G.toSimple t.val).deleteEdges {G.edge f} := by
  ext x y
  rw [SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, h⟩
    refine ⟨⟨e, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he, h⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro hxy
    have heq : G.edge e = G.edge f := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · simpa only [edge, h.1, h.2] using hxy
      · simpa only [edge, h.1, h.2, Sym2.eq_swap] using hxy
    exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp he).1
      (G.edge_injOn_of_is_forest t.property.2.2.2 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he) hf heq)
  · rintro ⟨⟨e, he, h⟩, hn⟩
    refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, he⟩, h⟩
    intro hef
    subst e
    apply hn
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rcases h with h | h
    · simp only [edge, h.1, h.2]
    · simp only [edge, h.1, h.2, Sym2.eq_swap]

/-- The full root-path dictionary retains original edge-copy membership explicitly. -/
theorem separates_iff_mem_path (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val)
    (o r : V) :
    ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r ↔
      G.edge f ∈ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges := by
  have hr : G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r ↔
      G.edge f ∉ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges := by
    rw [← G.toSimple_reachable, G.toSimple_erase_tree t f hf]
    change ((G.toSimple t.val).deleteEdges {s(G.left f, G.right f)}).Reachable o r ↔ _
    rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_deleteEdges_iff_exists_walk]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      have he := path_eq (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) p.toPath.val p.toPath.property
      rw [he]
      exact fun h => hp (p.edges_toPath_subset_edges h)
    · intro hp
      exact ⟨path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r, hp⟩
  exact (not_congr hr).trans not_not

/-- Literal original copies on the unique source-to-root path. -/
def rootPathCopies (t : G.SpanningTree) (o r : V) : Finset E :=
  t.val.filter fun f => G.edge f ∈ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges

theorem mem_rootPathCopies (t : G.SpanningTree) (o r : V) (f : E) :
    f ∈ G.rootPathCopies t o r ↔
      f ∈ t.val ∧ ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r := by
  simp only [rootPathCopies, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hf, (G.separates_iff_mem_path t f hf o r).mpr hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hf, (G.separates_iff_mem_path t f hf o r).mp hs⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.PathCopies
import Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Basic
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Green.Grounded

/-! Literal geometric disk drawings and exact boundary-path statement types.
No probabilistic or electrical conclusion is included in the drawing data. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
open Trees


/-- A copied graph retains every original ID, including self-loops. -/
structure CopiedGraph (V E : Type) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V

namespace CopiedGraph
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Literal finite copied-walk reachability, including length-zero walks. -/
def reaches (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : Finset E) : V → V → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y => ∃ e ∈ T,
    (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨ (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y))

/-- Ordinary trees on the full original vertex set and original copied IDs. -/
abbrev SpanningTree (J : CopiedGraph V E) := {T : Finset E //
  (Set.univ : Set V).Nonempty ∧ (∀ x y, J.reaches T x y) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, ¬J.reaches (T.erase e) (J.left e) (J.right e)}

/-- The literal separation characterization of original-copy membership on the tree path. -/
noncomputable def pathIndicator (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v then 1 else 0

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- An original loop remains a network copy and is excluded by the actual tree predicate. -/
theorem loop_not_mem (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (e : E) (hloop : J.left e = J.right e) : e ∉ T.val := by
  intro he
  apply T.property.2.2 e he
  rw [hloop]
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

end CopiedGraph

abbrev ArcParameter := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- An actual plane drawing of the copied graph by simple continuous arcs. -/
structure Drawing {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : CopiedGraph V E) where
  point : V → ℝ × ℝ
  point_injective : Function.Injective point
  curve : E → ArcParameter → ℝ × ℝ
  continuous : ∀ e, Continuous (curve e)
  injective : ∀ e, Set.InjOn (curve e) {t | t.val < 1}
  start : ∀ e, curve e ⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.left e)
  finish : ∀ e, curve e ⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.right e)
  avoids : ∀ e t, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → ∀ v, curve e t ≠ point v
  intersects : ∀ e f, e ≠ f → ∀ s t, curve e s = curve f t →
    (s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1)

/-- The Euclidean closed unit disk, in the literal two real coordinates. -/
def disk : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 ≤ 1}
def circle : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 = 1}

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E} (drawing : Drawing J)

/-- An edge curve hits an original vertex exactly at one of its prescribed endpoints. -/
theorem curve_vertex_iff (e : E) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V) :
    drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v ↔
    (t.val = 0 ∧ J.left e = v) ∨ (t.val = 1 ∧ J.right e = v) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ht0 : t.val = 0
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht0
      rw [he, drawing.start] at h
      exact Or.inl ⟨ht0, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    by_cases ht1 : t.val = 1
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht1
      rw [he, drawing.finish] at h
      exact Or.inr ⟨ht1, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    · exact (drawing.avoids e t (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm ht0))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht1) v h).elim
  · rintro (⟨ht, hv⟩ | ⟨ht, hv⟩)
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.start, hv]
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.finish, hv]

/-- Restricting to a nonloop edge turns the literal half-open simplicity into full simplicity. -/
theorem nonloop_curve_injective (e : E) (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Function.Injective (drawing.curve e) := by
  intro s t h
  by_cases hs : s.val = 1
  · have he : s = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hs
    have hv : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [← h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t _).mp hv with ⟨ht, hn⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact Subtype.ext (hs.trans ht.symm)
  by_cases ht : t.val = 1
  · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
    have hv : drawing.curve e s = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e s _).mp hv with ⟨_, hn⟩ | ⟨hs', _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact (hs hs').elim
  · exact drawing.injective e (lt_of_le_of_ne s.property.2 hs)
      (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht) h

/-- The literal geometric realization of a vertex set and its original copied edges. -/
def trace (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (drawing.point '' C) ∪ {z | ∃ e ∈ s, ∃ t, drawing.curve e t = z}

/-- Copied edges supported on C can hit only vertices in C. -/
theorem curve_vertex_mem {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ s) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V)
    (h : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v) : v ∈ C := by
  rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp h with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv⟩
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).1
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).2

/-- Distinct forest components have literally disjoint drawings, even with loops and parallels.
This supplies geometric disjointness to a Jordan argument; no no-crossing conclusion is assumed. -/
theorem traces_disjoint {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E} (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D) :
    Disjoint (drawing.trace C s) (drawing.trace D t) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzC hzD
  rcases hzC with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, he, q, hq⟩
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyx' := drawing.point_injective hyx
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (hyx' ▸ hy)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (drawing.curve_vertex_mem ht f hf r x hr)
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyC : y ∈ C := drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q y (hq.trans hyz.symm)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hyC hy
    · by_cases hef : e = f
      · subst f
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (hs e he).1 (ht e hf).1
      · have hqr := drawing.intersects e f hef q r (hq.trans hr.symm)
        rcases hqr.2 with hr0 | hr1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr0
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.left f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.start]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr1
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.right f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.finish]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).2

/-- A real finite copied walk supplies a compact connected geometric set in its component trace. -/
theorem reachable_continuum {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (_hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) (y : V) (hxy : J.reaches s x y) :
    ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K ⊆ drawing.trace C s ∧
      drawing.point x ∈ K ∧ drawing.point y ∈ K := by
  induction hxy with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨{drawing.point x}, isCompact_singleton, isConnected_singleton, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z = drawing.point x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    subst z
    exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hxK, hyK⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e, he, heyz⟩ := hyz
    let A := Set.range (drawing.curve e)
    have hyA : drawing.point y ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.1]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.1]⟩
    have hzA : drawing.point z ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.2]⟩
    refine ⟨K ∪ A, hKc.union (isCompact_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      hKconn.union ⟨drawing.point y, hyK, hyA⟩ (isConnected_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      ?_, Or.inl hxK, Or.inr hzA⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with hw | ⟨t, ht⟩
    · exact hKt hw
    · exact Or.inr ⟨e, he, t, ht⟩

/-- Two disjoint forest components give disjoint actual continua joining their terminals. -/
theorem disjoint_connecting_continua {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : V) (hx : x₀ ∈ C) (hy : y₀ ∈ D)
    (hxx : J.reaches s x₀ x₁) (hyy : J.reaches t y₀ y₁)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk) :
    ∃ K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ IsCompact L ∧ IsConnected L ∧
      K ⊆ disk ∧ L ⊆ disk ∧ Disjoint K L ∧
      drawing.point x₀ ∈ K ∧ drawing.point x₁ ∈ K ∧
      drawing.point y₀ ∈ L ∧ drawing.point y₁ ∈ L := by
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hx₀, hx₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum hs x₀ hx x₁ hxx
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLconn, hLt, hy₀, hy₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum ht y₀ hy y₁ hyy
  have htrace (A : Set V) (F : Finset E) : drawing.trace A F ⊆ disk := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, _, q, hq⟩
    · exact hvertices v
    · exact hq ▸ hedges e q
  exact ⟨K, L, hKc, hKconn, hLc, hLconn, hKt.trans (htrace C s),
    hLt.trans (htrace D t), (drawing.traces_disjoint hCD hs ht).mono hKt hLt,
    hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩

end Drawing
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.BSST
import FiniteAvalanches.External.TwoPoleTopology

/-! Classical geometric duality for finite connected plane multigraph drawings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open scoped Classical

/-- The dual retains every original edge copy, crosses it once, and its faces
correspond to the original vertices with reversed double-dual orientation. -/
axiom finite_plane_geometric_dual :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, Source.EdgeChart D e)
    (_hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected),
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype (Face D),
      letI : Fintype (Face D) := finiteFaces
      let dualGraph : CopiedGraph (Face D) E :=
        ⟨fun e => negativeChartFace D e (charts e),
          fun e => positiveChartFace D e (charts e)⟩
      ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing dualGraph,
      ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e : E, Source.EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
      ∃ vertexFaces : V ≃ Face dualDrawing,
        (∀ F : Face D, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion D F) ∧
        (∀ v : V, D.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
        (∀ (e f : E) (s t : ArcParameter),
          D.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
            e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
        (∀ (e : E) (t : ArcParameter),
          (t.val < 1 / 2 →
            dualDrawing.curve e t ∈ faceRegion D (dualGraph.left e)) ∧
          (1 / 2 < t.val →
            dualDrawing.curve e t ∈ faceRegion D (dualGraph.right e))) ∧
        (∀ e : E, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧ radius < (charts e).radius ∧
          ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
            (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
        (∀ e : E,
          positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces (J.left e) ∧
          negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces (J.right e))

end FiniteAvalanches.External

inputs.scope: Generic genuine finite connected plane multigraph Drawing with supplied oriented midpoint charts and nonempty copied edge type; actual finite complement faces and a same-copy dual Drawing with unique midpoint crossings, face half-arcs and reversed double-dual endpoint cells. Loops, bridges, parallel copies and repeated face occurrences admitted. No electrical or paper-specific premise or conclusion.

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DiskDrawing
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Clopen
import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Proper plane drawings, actual complement faces, and oriented local edge charts. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
abbrev Plane := ℝ × ℝ

/-- An orientation-preserving plane chart, with its orientation witnessed by an isotopy. -/
structure OrientedChart where
  map : Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  isotopy : ArcParameter → Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => isotopy p.1 p.2)
  inverse_continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => (isotopy p.1).symm p.2)
  start : isotopy ⟨0,by norm_num⟩ = Homeomorph.refl Plane
  finish : isotopy ⟨1,by norm_num⟩ = map

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The whole embedded graph, retaining every original copied arc. -/
def drawingTrace (D : Drawing J) : Set Plane :=
  Set.range D.point ∪ ⋃ e, Set.range (D.curve e)

/-- A regular oriented neighborhood of an interior point of the actual edge arc. -/
structure EdgeChart (D : Drawing J) (e : E) where
  chart : OrientedChart
  radius : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < radius
  radius_small : radius < 1/4
  straight : ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val-1/2| < radius →
    chart.map (D.curve e t) = (t.val,0)
  trace_box : ∀ z : Plane, |z.1-1/2| < radius → |z.2| < radius →
    (chart.map.symm z ∈ drawingTrace D ↔ z.2 = 0)

/-- A finite proper plane embedding by simple arcs, with oriented regular edge charts.
All geometry concerns the actual curves; no rotation, face count or Euler identity is supplied. -/
structure PlaneEmbedding (J : CopiedGraph V E) where
  drawing : Drawing J
  edge_injective : ∀ e, Function.Injective (drawing.curve e)
  edgeChart : ∀ e, EdgeChart drawing e

namespace PlaneEmbedding
variable (D : PlaneEmbedding J)

/-- Faces are actual connected components of the complement of the embedded graph. -/
abbrev Face := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}

def faceRegion (F : D.Face) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}) = F}

private theorem side_off_trace (e : E) (positive : Bool) :
    (D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm
      (1/2,if positive then (D.edgeChart e).radius/2 else -((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)) ∉
        drawingTrace D.drawing := by
  let c := D.edgeChart e
  have hr := c.radius_pos
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using hr
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hn : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hp
  cases positive
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
    change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hn).mp h)
  · change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual face immediately to the left of the original oriented edge copy. -/
def leftFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,(D.edgeChart e).radius/2),D.side_off_trace e true⟩

/-- The actual face immediately to the right; bridges may have the same face on both sides. -/
def rightFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,-((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)),D.side_off_trace e false⟩

/-- Literal geometric incidence, including repeated visits of a face at a vertex. -/
def incident (x : V) (F : D.Face) : Prop := D.drawing.point x ∈ closure (D.faceRegion F)
end PlaneEmbedding

/-- The auxiliary alpha-to-beta arc retains every original edge copy. -/
def augmentedGraph (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) : CopiedGraph V (E ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨Sum.elim J.left (fun _ => alpha),Sum.elim J.right (fun _ => beta)⟩

/-- An actual arc in the chosen common outer face, not a combinatorial face assumption. -/
structure OuterArc (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V) where
  face : D.Face
  alpha_incident : D.incident alpha face
  beta_incident : D.incident beta face
  unbounded : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (D.faceRegion face)
  embedding : PlaneEmbedding (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : embedding.drawing.point = D.drawing.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, embedding.drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.drawing.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    embedding.drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ D.faceRegion face

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.OrientedDrawing
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- Connectedness supplies the Dirichlet boundary condition before voltage choice. -/
theorem two_terminal_reachable (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) :
    ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ ({alpha,beta} : Finset V), (supportGraph J.left J.right).Reachable x y :=
  fun x => ⟨alpha,by simp,hc x alpha⟩

/-- The actual unique zero/one Dirichlet voltage of the original copied network. -/
def voltage (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) : V → ℝ :=
  harmonicExtension J.left J.right {alpha,beta} (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc)
    (fun x => if x = beta then 1 else 0)

theorem voltage_spec (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) :
    voltage J alpha beta hc alpha = 0 ∧ voltage J alpha beta hc beta = 1 ∧
      ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian J.left J.right (voltage J alpha beta hc) x = 0 := by
  have h := harmonicExtension_spec J.left J.right {alpha,beta}
    (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc) (fun x => if x = beta then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [voltage,if_neg hne] using h.1 alpha (by simp)
  · simpa [voltage] using h.1 beta (by simp)
  · intro x ha hb
    exact h.2 x (by simp [ha,hb])

/-- The full source characterization uniquely determines the chosen voltage. -/
theorem voltage_unique (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (f : V → ℝ)
    (ha : f alpha = 0) (hb : f beta = 1)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian J.left J.right f x = 0) :
    f = voltage J alpha beta hc := by
  apply harmonicExtension_eq J.left J.right {alpha,beta}
    (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc) (fun x => if x = beta then 1 else 0)
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · rw [ha,if_neg hne]
    · rw [hb,if_pos rfl]
  · intro x hx
    have h : x ≠ alpha ∧ x ≠ beta := by simpa only
      [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] using hx
    exact hh x h.1 h.2

def mass (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ) : ℝ := energy J.left J.right phi

/-- Physical original-edge currents and closing-arc current +M; the arc is not an energy edge. -/
def stream_spec {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ) (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e, psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))-psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e)) =
    phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
  psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ()))-psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())) = mass J phi ∧
  psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())) = 0 ∧
  psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ())) = mass J phi

/-- Each original copy's closed voltage/stream rectangle; zero-current copies are points. -/
def edgeSquare {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ) (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
    Set.Icc (min (psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))) (psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e))))
      (max (psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))) (psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e))))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The full drawn finite graph is compact, including every copied arc and vertex. -/
theorem drawingTrace_isCompact (D : Drawing J) : IsCompact (drawingTrace D) :=
  (Set.finite_range D.point).isCompact.union
    (isCompact_iUnion fun e => isCompact_range (D.continuous e))

/-- The actual face carrier is the complement of a closed embedded graph. -/
theorem drawingTrace_isClosed (D : Drawing J) : IsClosed (drawingTrace D) :=
  (drawingTrace_isCompact D).isClosed

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.SourceVoltage
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DrawingProperness
import Lean

/-! Uncharted proper drawings, their literal complement faces, and original-copy coordinates. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source (Plane drawingTrace augmentedGraph voltage mass)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Actual connected components of the complement of the full original drawn trace. -/
abbrev Face (D : Drawing J) := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D}

/-- The actual plane region represented by a complement component. -/
def faceRegion (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D}) = F}

/-- Literal geometric vertex incidence, including repeated visits of the same face. -/
def incident (D : Drawing J) (x : V) (F : Face D) : Prop :=
  D.point x ∈ closure (faceRegion D F)

/-- Actual faces whose closed boundary contains the whole original copied edge arc. -/
def edgeFaces (D : Drawing J) (e : E) : Set (Face D) :=
  {F | Set.range (D.curve e) ⊆ closure (faceRegion D F)}

/-- A genuine auxiliary arc in the chosen face, retaining every original point and curve. -/
structure AuxiliaryArc (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V) where
  drawing : Drawing (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : drawing.point = D.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ faceRegion D F

/-- The source zero/one-voltage interval crossed with the actual dual-face voltage interval. -/
def copiedSquare (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    {W : Type} (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e)))
    (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
  Set.Icc (min (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))
    (max (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))

/-- The literal positive-Laplacian Dirichlet characterization on the polar dual.
The dual retains the original E; the added arc determines its two boundary faces only. -/
def dualVoltageSpec {W : Type} (face0 face1 : E → W) (pole0 pole1 : W)
    (M : ℝ) (psi : W → ℝ) : Prop :=
  psi pole0 = 0 ∧ psi pole1 = M ∧
    ∀ F, F ≠ pole0 → F ≠ pole1 → laplacian face0 face1 psi F = 0

/-- All actual incident-face voltages, without a finite orbit or default extremum. -/
def incidentValues (D : Drawing J) (psi : Face D → ℝ) (x : V) : Set ℝ :=
  {y | ∃ F, incident D x F ∧ psi F = y}

/-- The source vertical segment with explicitly attained lower and upper face values. -/
def vertexSegment (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) (lo hi : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
  {phi x} ×ˢ Set.Icc lo hi

/-- Whole-arc face incidence includes each prescribed endpoint, without charts. -/
theorem edgeFaces_endpoints (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (F : Face D)
    (hF : F ∈ edgeFaces D e) :
    incident D (J.left e) F ∧ incident D (J.right e) F := by
  constructor
  · exact hF ⟨⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.start e⟩
  · exact hF ⟨⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.finish e⟩

/-- Erasing chart witnesses changes neither the actual complement nor vertex incidence. -/
theorem charted_incident_eq (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (x : V) (F : D.Face) :
    incident D.drawing x F ↔ D.incident x F := Iff.rfl

/-- An existing physical outer arc supplies the uncharted auxiliary-arc data. -/
def auxiliaryArcOfOuterArc (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : Source.OuterArc D alpha beta) : AuxiliaryArc D.drawing A.face alpha beta where
  drawing := A.embedding.drawing
  point_eq := A.point_eq
  curve_eq := A.curve_eq
  interior_in_face := A.interior_in_face

/-- The actual augmented trace adds precisely one curve to the full original trace. -/
theorem auxiliary_trace (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) :
    drawingTrace A.drawing = drawingTrace D ∪ Set.range (A.drawing.curve (.inr ())) := by
  ext z
  simp only [drawingTrace,Set.mem_union,Set.mem_range,Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩)
    · cases e with
      | inl e => exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩)
      | inr e => cases e; exact Or.inr ⟨t,ht⟩
  · rintro ((⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩) | ⟨t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr (),t,ht⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- A zero-current original copy becomes its actual common voltage/dual-voltage point. -/
theorem zero_current_square {W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E)
    (hp : phi (J.left e) = phi (J.right e))
    (hdual : |psi (face0 e)-psi (face1 e)| = |phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)|) :
    copiedSquare J phi psi face0 face1 e = {(phi (J.left e),psi (face0 e))} := by
  have hpsi : psi (face0 e) = psi (face1 e) := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply abs_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [hp,sub_self,abs_zero] using hdual
  simp only [copiedSquare,hp,hpsi,min_self,max_self,Set.Icc_self,
    Set.singleton_prod_singleton]


/-- A chart's positive side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem positive_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- A chart's negative side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem negative_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_neg,abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's positive side point. -/
def positiveChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2),
    positive_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's negative side point. -/
def negativeChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)),
    negative_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
