/-! Once-counted original alpha incidences between consecutive returns to the auxiliary dart. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane
open scoped BigOperators Classical

/-- The actual outgoing incidence fiber, preserving the edge-copy index. -/
abbrev Incidences {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (x : V) := {d : Dart E // tail a b d = x}
noncomputable def incidenceCount {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (x : V) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (Incidences a b x)

theorem incidenceCount_eq_degree {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (x : V) :
    (incidenceCount a b x : ℝ) = FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.degree a b x := by
  simp only [incidenceCount,Fintype.card_subtype,Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,Finset.sum_filter,
    Nat.cast_sum,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_bool,
    tail,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
  unfold FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.degree
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  by_cases ha : a e = x <;> by_cases hb : b e = x <;> norm_num [ha,hb]

/-- The augmented alpha orbit consists exactly of its original incidences and the one arc dart. -/
noncomputable def alphaOrbitEquiv {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) :
    (Incidences a b alpha ⊕ Unit) ≃
      {d : ArcDart E // (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle (.inr false) d} :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun z => match z with
    | .inl d => ⟨.inl d.val,(insertArcRotation_sameCycle_iff R alpha beta hne da db ha hb _ _).mpr d.property.symm⟩
    | .inr _ => ⟨.inr false,.refl _ _⟩) (by
    constructor
    · intro z w h
      have he := congrArg Subtype.val h
      cases z with
      | inl z => cases w with
        | inl w => exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext (Sum.inl_injective he))
        | inr w => cases he
      | inr z => cases w with
        | inl w => cases he
        | inr w => exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subsingleton.elim z w)
    · intro d
      have ht := (insertArcRotation_sameCycle_iff R alpha beta hne da db ha hb _ _).mp d.property
      cases he : d.val with
      | inl x =>
        have hx : tail a b x = alpha := by simpa only [he,arcTail] using ht.symm
        exact ⟨.inl ⟨x,hx⟩,Subtype.ext he.symm⟩
      | inr c => cases c with
        | false => exact ⟨.inr (),Subtype.ext he.symm⟩
        | true => exact (hne (by simpa only [he,arcTail] using ht)).elim)

theorem alpha_orbit_card {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) :
    (cyclePoints (insertArcRotation R da db) (.inr false)).card = incidenceCount a b alpha+1 := by
  have h1 := Fintype.card_congr (alphaOrbitEquiv R alpha beta hne da db ha hb)
  have h2 := Fintype.card_congr (orbitEquiv (insertArcRotation R da db) (.inr false))
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum,Fintype.card_unit,Fintype.card_fin] at h1 h2
  exact h2.trans h1.symm

/-- There is exactly one original incidence at each position 1,...,degree(alpha). -/
theorem existsUnique_alpha_position {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (i : Fin (incidenceCount a b alpha)) :
    ∃! d : Incidences a b alpha, .inl d.val = ((insertArcRotation R da db)^(i.val+1)) (.inr false) := by
  let T := insertArcRotation R da db
  let u : ArcDart E := .inr false
  have hc := alpha_orbit_card R alpha beta hne da db ha hb
  have hi : i.val+1 < (cyclePoints T u).card := by dsimp [T,u]; rw [hc]; omega
  have h0 : 0 < (cyclePoints T u).card := (cyclePoints_nonempty T u).card_pos
  have hp : T.SameCycle u ((T^(i.val+1)) u) := by
    simpa only [Equiv.Perm.sameCycle_pow_right] using Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.refl T u
  have ht := (insertArcRotation_sameCycle_iff R alpha beta hne da db ha hb _ _).mp hp
  cases he : ((T^(i.val+1)) u) with
  | inl d =>
    have hd : tail a b d = alpha := by simpa only [he,u,arcTail] using ht.symm
    refine ⟨⟨d,hd⟩,rfl,?_⟩
    intro d' h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Sum.inl_injective h
  | inr c => cases c with
    | false =>
      have hn := orbit_pow_inj T u hi h0 (show (T^(i.val+1)) u = (T^0) u from he)
      omega
    | true => exact (hne (by simpa only [he,u,arcTail] using ht)).elim

/-- The actual incidence in its unique position after the auxiliary alpha dart. -/
noncomputable def alphaDart {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (i : Fin (incidenceCount a b alpha)) :
    Incidences a b alpha := (existsUnique_alpha_position R alpha beta hne da db ha hb i).choose

theorem alphaDart_spec {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (i : Fin (incidenceCount a b alpha)) :
    .inl (alphaDart R alpha beta hne da db ha hb i).val =
      ((insertArcRotation R da db)^(i.val+1)) (.inr false) :=
  (existsUnique_alpha_position R alpha beta hne da db ha hb i).choose_spec.1

/-- Every original alpha incidence occurs once and only once, in the actual rotation order. -/
noncomputable def alphaEnumeration {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) :
    Fin (incidenceCount a b alpha) ≃ Incidences a b alpha :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (alphaDart R alpha beta hne da db ha hb) (by
    have hc := alpha_orbit_card R alpha beta hne da db ha hb
    constructor
    · intro i j h
      have hp := congrArg (fun d : Incidences a b alpha => Sum.inl d.val : Incidences a b alpha → ArcDart E) h
      rw [alphaDart_spec,alphaDart_spec] at hp
      have he := orbit_pow_inj (insertArcRotation R da db) (.inr false)
        (by rw [hc]; omega) (by rw [hc]; omega) hp
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
    · intro d
      have hd : (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle (.inr false) (.inl d.val) :=
        (insertArcRotation_sameCycle_iff R alpha beta hne da db ha hb (.inr false) (.inl d.val)).mpr d.property.symm
      obtain ⟨n,hn,he⟩ := (isCycleOn_cyclePoints (insertArcRotation R da db) (.inr false)).exists_pow_eq
        ((mem_cyclePoints _ _ _).mpr (.refl _ _)) ((mem_cyclePoints _ _ _).mpr hd)
      have hn0 : 0 < n := by
        by_contra h
        have h0 : n = 0 := by omega
        rw [h0,pow_zero,Equiv.Perm.one_apply] at he
        cases he
      let i : Fin (incidenceCount a b alpha) := ⟨n-1,by rw [hc] at hn; omega⟩
      refine ⟨i,?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Sum.inl_injective (β := Bool)
      rw [alphaDart_spec]
      have hi : i.val+1 = n := by dsimp [i]; omega
      rwa [hi])

@[simp] theorem alphaEnumeration_spec {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (i : Fin (incidenceCount a b alpha)) :
    .inl (alphaEnumeration R alpha beta hne da db ha hb i).val =
      ((insertArcRotation R da db)^(i.val+1)) (.inr false) :=
  alphaDart_spec R alpha beta hne da db ha hb i

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.Darts
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin

/-! Actual finite permutation orbits, including fixed-point orbits. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane
open scoped Classical

/-- All points in one actual permutation orbit; fixed points are not discarded. -/
noncomputable def cyclePoints {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X) : Finset X :=
  Finset.univ.filter (f.SameCycle x)

@[simp] theorem mem_cyclePoints {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x y : X) :
    y ∈ cyclePoints f x ↔ f.SameCycle x y := by simp [cyclePoints]

theorem cyclePoints_nonempty {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X) :
    (cyclePoints f x).Nonempty := ⟨x,(mem_cyclePoints f x x).mpr (.refl f x)⟩

theorem isCycleOn_cyclePoints {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X) :
    f.IsCycleOn (cyclePoints f x) := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨?_,f.injective.injOn,?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      simpa using hy
    · intro y hy
      refine ⟨f.symm y,?_,f.apply_symm_apply y⟩
      simpa using hy
  · intro y hy z hz
    exact ((mem_cyclePoints f x y).mp hy).symm.trans ((mem_cyclePoints f x z).mp hz)

/-- The orbit is enumerated once, starting at x, in the actual permutation order. -/
noncomputable def orbitEquiv {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X) :
    Fin (cyclePoints f x).card ≃ {y : X // f.SameCycle x y} :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun i => ⟨(f^i.val) x,by simpa only [Equiv.Perm.sameCycle_pow_right] using Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.refl f x⟩) (by
    constructor
    · intro i j h
      have hp := (isCycleOn_cyclePoints f x).pow_apply_eq_pow_apply (m := i.val) (n := j.val)
        ((mem_cyclePoints f x x).mpr (.refl f x))
      have hm := hp.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h)
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa only [Nat.ModEq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.isLt,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt] using hm
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨n,hn,he⟩ := (isCycleOn_cyclePoints f x).exists_pow_eq
        ((mem_cyclePoints f x x).mpr (.refl f x)) ((mem_cyclePoints f x y).mpr y.property)
      exact ⟨⟨n,hn⟩,Subtype.ext he⟩)

@[simp] theorem orbitEquiv_apply {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X)
    (i : Fin (cyclePoints f x).card) : (orbitEquiv f x i).val = (f^i.val) x := rfl

theorem pow_cyclePoints_card {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X) :
    (f^(cyclePoints f x).card) x = x :=
  (isCycleOn_cyclePoints f x).pow_card_apply ((mem_cyclePoints f x x).mpr (.refl f x))

theorem orbit_pow_inj {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < (cyclePoints f x).card) (hj : j < (cyclePoints f x).card)
    (h : (f^i) x = (f^j) x) : i = j := by
  have he := (orbitEquiv f x).injective (show orbitEquiv f x ⟨i,hi⟩ = orbitEquiv f x ⟨j,hj⟩ from Subtype.ext h)
  exact congrArg Fin.val he

/-- The unique position of a point on its actual finite orbit. -/
noncomputable def orbitIndex {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x y : X)
    (h : f.SameCycle x y) : Fin (cyclePoints f x).card :=
  (orbitEquiv f x).symm ⟨y,h⟩

theorem orbitIndex_spec {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x y : X)
    (h : f.SameCycle x y) : (f^(orbitIndex f x y h).val) x = y :=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((orbitEquiv f x).apply_symm_apply ⟨y,h⟩)

theorem orbitIndex_pow {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : Equiv.Perm X) (x : X)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (cyclePoints f x).card) (h : f.SameCycle x ((f^i) x)) :
    (orbitIndex f x ((f^i) x) h).val = i :=
  orbit_pow_inj f x (orbitIndex f x _ h).isLt hi (orbitIndex_spec f x _ h)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Cycle.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Quotient
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Sum

/-! Individually indexed darts and actual rotation-face orbits.
A rotation system is not, by itself, a genus-zero embedding. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

open scoped BigOperators Classical

/-- Each original edge copy has two orientations. False runs from a to b. -/
abbrev Dart (E : Type*) := E × Bool

def tail {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (d : Dart E) : V :=
  if d.2 then b d.1 else a d.1

/-- Reversal retains the original edge index, including parallel copies. -/
def reverse (E : Type*) : Equiv.Perm (Dart E) where
  toFun d := (d.1,!d.2)
  invFun d := (d.1,!d.2)
  left_inv d := by rcases d with ⟨e,h⟩; cases h <;> rfl
  right_inv d := by rcases d with ⟨e,h⟩; cases h <;> rfl

def head {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (d : Dart E) : V := tail a b (reverse E d)

@[simp] theorem reverse_reverse {E : Type*} (d : Dart E) : reverse E (reverse E d) = d := by
  rcases d with ⟨e,h⟩; cases h <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem tail_reverse {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (d : Dart E) :
    tail a b (reverse E d) = head a b d := rfl

@[simp] theorem head_reverse {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (d : Dart E) :
    head a b (reverse E d) = tail a b d := by simp [head]

/-- Physical signed current: positive from higher to lower voltage. -/
def current {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (d : Dart E) : ℝ :=
  phi (tail a b d)-phi (head a b d)

@[simp] theorem current_reverse {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (d : Dart E) :
    current a b phi (reverse E d) = -current a b phi d := by simp [current]

/-- Clockwise cyclic order at each vertex, expressed on the actual incidence fiber. -/
structure EdgeRotation {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) where
  next : Equiv.Perm (Dart E)
  cycles : ∀ d d', next.SameCycle d d' ↔ tail a b d = tail a b d'

theorem EdgeRotation.tail_next {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b)
    (d : Dart E) : tail a b (R.next d) = tail a b d := by
  apply ((R.cycles d (R.next d)).mp _).symm
  exact ⟨1,by simp⟩

/-- Walk along the left face: reverse at the head, then take its clockwise successor. -/
def EdgeRotation.faceNext {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) :
    Equiv.Perm (Dart E) := (reverse E).trans R.next

/-- Faces are actual orbits of the face-walk permutation. -/
abbrev EdgeRotation.Face {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) :=
  Quotient (Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.setoid R.faceNext)

noncomputable instance {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) :
    Fintype R.Face := Fintype.ofFinite _

def EdgeRotation.leftFace {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) (d : Dart E) :
    R.Face := Quotient.mk _ d

def EdgeRotation.rightFace {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) (d : Dart E) :
    R.Face := R.leftFace (reverse E d)

theorem EdgeRotation.leftFace_faceNext {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b)
    (d : Dart E) : R.leftFace (R.faceNext d) = R.leftFace d := by
  apply Quotient.sound
  exact (show R.faceNext.SameCycle d (R.faceNext d) from ⟨1,by simp⟩).symm

theorem EdgeRotation.leftFace_next {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b)
    (d : Dart E) : R.leftFace (R.next d) = R.rightFace d := by
  have h := R.leftFace_faceNext (reverse E d)
  simpa only [EdgeRotation.faceNext, Equiv.trans_apply, reverse_reverse,
    EdgeRotation.rightFace] using h

/-- Outgoing incidence sum, with every original copy retained. -/
noncomputable def divergence {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V)
    (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d : Dart E, if tail a b d = x then current a b phi d else 0

theorem divergence_eq_laplacian {V E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    divergence a b phi x = FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.laplacian a b phi x := by
  simp only [divergence, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool, current, head,
    reverse, tail, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  unfold FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.laplacian
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  split <;> split <;> simp_all

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.AuxiliaryArc

/-! The auxiliary insertion has exactly the intended vertex cycles. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

open scoped Classical

theorem insertArcRotation_old_step {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) (hne : da ≠ db) (d : Dart E) :
    (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle (.inl d) (.inl (R.next d)) := by
  have step (x : ArcDart E) : (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle x (insertArcRotation R da db x) :=
    ⟨1,by simp⟩
  by_cases ha : d = da
  · subst d
    have h1 := step (.inl da)
    have h2 := step (.inr false)
    rw [insertArcRotation_alpha] at h1
    rw [insertArcRotation_arc_false R da db hne] at h2
    exact h1.trans h2
  by_cases hb : d = db
  · subst d
    have h1 := step (.inl db)
    have h2 := step (.inr true)
    rw [insertArcRotation_beta R da db hne.symm] at h1
    rw [insertArcRotation_arc_true] at h2
    exact h1.trans h2
  · simpa only [insertArcRotation_other R da db d ha hb] using step (.inl d)

theorem insertArcRotation_lift_sameCycle {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) (hne : da ≠ db) {d d' : Dart E}
    (h : R.next.SameCycle d d') : (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle (.inl d) (.inl d') := by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
  have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle (.inl d) (.inl ((R.next^n) d)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ',Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      exact ih.trans (insertArcRotation_old_step R da db hne ((R.next^n) d))
  simpa only [hn] using hp n

/-- Erasing an auxiliary incidence returns the old incidence where it was inserted. -/
def arcAnchor {E : Type*} (da db : Dart E) : ArcDart E → Dart E
  | .inl d => d
  | .inr false => da
  | .inr true => db

theorem insertArcRotation_sameCycle_anchor {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) (hne : da ≠ db) (d : ArcDart E) :
    (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle d (.inl (arcAnchor da db d)) := by
  have step (x : ArcDart E) : (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle x (insertArcRotation R da db x) :=
    ⟨1,by simp⟩
  cases d with
  | inl d => exact Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _
  | inr d => cases d with
    | false =>
      have h := step (.inl da)
      rw [insertArcRotation_alpha] at h
      exact h.symm
    | true =>
      have h := step (.inl db)
      rw [insertArcRotation_beta R da db hne.symm] at h
      exact h.symm

theorem arcTail_eq_tail_anchor {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (alpha beta : V)
    (da db : Dart E) (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (d : ArcDart E) :
    arcTail a b alpha beta d = tail a b (arcAnchor da db d) := by
  cases d with
  | inl d => rfl
  | inr d => cases d <;> simp [arcTail,arcAnchor,ha,hb]

/-- All actual augmented incidences at a vertex lie on one cycle, and no cycle mixes vertices. -/
theorem insertArcRotation_sameCycle_iff {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (d d' : ArcDart E) :
    (insertArcRotation R da db).SameCycle d d' ↔
      arcTail a b alpha beta d = arcTail a b alpha beta d' := by
  have hdab : da ≠ db := by intro h; rw [h,hb] at ha; exact hne ha.symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := h.exists_nat_pow_eq
    have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, arcTail a b alpha beta (((insertArcRotation R da db)^n) d) = arcTail a b alpha beta d := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ',Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,arcTail_insertArcRotation R alpha beta hne da db ha hb]
        exact ih
    have htail := hp n
    rw [hn] at htail
    exact htail.symm
  · intro h
    have htail : tail a b (arcAnchor da db d) = tail a b (arcAnchor da db d') := by
      simpa only [arcTail_eq_tail_anchor a b alpha beta da db ha hb] using h
    have hcycle := (R.cycles _ _).mpr htail
    exact (insertArcRotation_sameCycle_anchor R da db hdab d).trans
      ((insertArcRotation_lift_sameCycle R da db hdab hcycle).trans
        (insertArcRotation_sameCycle_anchor R da db hdab d').symm)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.Darts
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Response

/-! The auxiliary outer-face arc as a geometric dart pair, not an energy edge. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

open scoped BigOperators Classical

/-- Original darts are unchanged; the two new darts belong only to the auxiliary arc. -/
abbrev ArcDart (E : Type*) := Dart E ⊕ Bool

def arcTail {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (alpha beta : V) : ArcDart E → V
  | .inl d => tail a b d
  | .inr false => alpha
  | .inr true => beta

def arcReverse (E : Type*) : Equiv.Perm (ArcDart E) :=
  Equiv.sumCongr (reverse E) (Equiv.swap false true)

/-- Insert alpha's and beta's arc darts after the indicated outgoing incidences. -/
noncomputable def insertArcRotation {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) : Equiv.Perm (ArcDart E) :=
  ((Equiv.swap (.inl da) (.inr false)).trans (Equiv.swap (.inl db) (.inr true))).trans
    (Equiv.sumCongr R.next (Equiv.refl Bool))

theorem insertArcRotation_alpha {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) :
    insertArcRotation R da db (.inl da) = .inr false := by
  simp [insertArcRotation, Equiv.swap_apply_def]

theorem insertArcRotation_beta {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) (hne : db ≠ da) :
    insertArcRotation R da db (.inl db) = .inr true := by
  simp [insertArcRotation, Equiv.swap_apply_def,hne]

theorem insertArcRotation_arc_false {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) (hne : da ≠ db) :
    insertArcRotation R da db (.inr false) = .inl (R.next da) := by
  simp [insertArcRotation, Equiv.swap_apply_def,hne]

theorem insertArcRotation_arc_true {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) :
    insertArcRotation R da db (.inr true) = .inl (R.next db) := by
  simp [insertArcRotation, Equiv.swap_apply_def]

theorem insertArcRotation_other {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db d : Dart E) (ha : d ≠ da) (hb : d ≠ db) :
    insertArcRotation R da db (.inl d) = .inl (R.next d) := by
  simp [insertArcRotation,Equiv.swap_apply_def,ha,hb]

theorem arcTail_insertArcRotation {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (da db : Dart E)
    (ha : tail a b da = alpha) (hb : tail a b db = beta) (d : ArcDart E) :
    arcTail a b alpha beta (insertArcRotation R da db d) = arcTail a b alpha beta d := by
  have hdab : da ≠ db := by intro h; rw [h,hb] at ha; exact hne ha.symm
  cases d with
  | inl d =>
    by_cases hda : d = da
    · subst d; rw [insertArcRotation_alpha]; exact ha.symm
    by_cases hdb : d = db
    · subst d; rw [insertArcRotation_beta R da db hdab.symm]; exact hb.symm
    · rw [insertArcRotation_other R da db d hda hdb]
      exact R.tail_next d
  | inr d => cases d with
    | false => rw [insertArcRotation_arc_false R da db hdab]; exact (R.tail_next da).trans ha
    | true => rw [insertArcRotation_arc_true]; exact (R.tail_next db).trans hb

noncomputable def arcFaceNext {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) :
    Equiv.Perm (ArcDart E) := (arcReverse E).trans (insertArcRotation R da db)

/-- Actual augmented face orbits, before any genus-zero or distinct-exterior-face theorem. -/
abbrev ArcFace {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) :=
  Quotient (Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.setoid (arcFaceNext R da db))

noncomputable instance {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] {a b : E → V}
    (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E) : Fintype (ArcFace R da db) := Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable def arcLeftFace {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E)
    (d : ArcDart E) : ArcFace R da db := Quotient.mk _ d

noncomputable def arcRightFace {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b) (da db : Dart E)
    (d : ArcDart E) : ArcFace R da db := arcLeftFace R da db (arcReverse E d)

theorem arcReverse_arcReverse {E : Type*} (d : ArcDart E) : arcReverse E (arcReverse E d) = d := by
  cases d with
  | inl d => simp [arcReverse]
  | inr d => simp [arcReverse]

theorem arcLeftFace_next {V E : Type*} {a b : E → V} (R : EdgeRotation a b)
    (da db : Dart E) (d : ArcDart E) :
    arcLeftFace R da db (insertArcRotation R da db d) = arcRightFace R da db d := by
  have h : arcLeftFace R da db (arcFaceNext R da db (arcReverse E d)) =
      arcLeftFace R da db (arcReverse E d) := by
    apply Quotient.sound
    exact (show (arcFaceNext R da db).SameCycle (arcReverse E d)
      (arcFaceNext R da db (arcReverse E d)) from ⟨1,by simp⟩).symm
  simpa only [arcFaceNext,Equiv.trans_apply,arcReverse_arcReverse,arcRightFace] using h

/-- The arc closes the flow. Its assigned current is not a voltage-gradient conductance. -/
def arcCurrent {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (M : ℝ) : ArcDart E → ℝ
  | .inl d => current a b phi d
  | .inr false => M
  | .inr true => -M

theorem arcCurrent_reverse {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (d : ArcDart E) : arcCurrent a b phi M (arcReverse E d) = -arcCurrent a b phi M d := by
  cases d with
  | inl d => simp [arcReverse,arcCurrent]
  | inr d => cases d <;> simp [arcReverse,arcCurrent]

noncomputable def arcDivergence {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V)
    (alpha beta : V) (phi : V → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d : ArcDart E, if arcTail a b alpha beta d = x then arcCurrent a b phi M d else 0

theorem arcDivergence_eq {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V)
    (alpha beta : V) (phi : V → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (x : V) :
    arcDivergence a b alpha beta phi M x =
      laplacian a b phi x + (if alpha = x then M else 0)+(if beta = x then -M else 0) := by
  simp only [arcDivergence,Fintype.sum_sum_type,Fintype.sum_bool,arcTail,arcCurrent]
  rw [← divergence_eq_laplacian]
  unfold divergence
  ring

/-- Terminal flux is derived from the literal original energy, with its positive Laplacian sign. -/
theorem terminal_flux_eq_energy {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (ha : phi alpha = 0) (hb : phi beta = 1)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b phi x = 0) :
    laplacian a b phi alpha = -energy a b phi ∧ laplacian a b phi beta = energy a b phi := by
  have hpoint : ∀ x, phi x*laplacian a b phi x = if x = beta then laplacian a b phi beta else 0 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxb : x = beta
    · subst x; simp [hb]
    by_cases hxa : x = alpha
    · subst x; simp [ha,hne]
    · simp [hh x hxa hxb,hxb]
  have henergy := energy_eq_incidence_sum a b phi
  simp only [hpoint,Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,if_true] at henergy
  have hpoint' : ∀ x, laplacian a b phi x =
      (if x = alpha then laplacian a b phi alpha else 0)+(if x = beta then laplacian a b phi beta else 0) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxa : x = alpha
    · subst x; simp [hne]
    by_cases hxb : x = beta
    · subst x; simp [hne.symm]
    · simp [hh x hxa hxb,hxa,hxb]
  have hsum := sum_laplacian_eq_zero a b phi
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hpoint' x),Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,if_true] at hsum
  exact ⟨by linarith only [henergy,hsum],henergy.symm⟩

/-- Every augmented vertex is balanced; no response or stream conclusion is assumed. -/
theorem arcDivergence_eq_zero {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (ha : phi alpha = 0) (hb : phi beta = 1)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b phi x = 0) (x : V) :
    arcDivergence a b alpha beta phi (energy a b phi) x = 0 := by
  rw [arcDivergence_eq]
  have hf := terminal_flux_eq_energy a b phi alpha beta hne ha hb hh
  by_cases hxa : x = alpha
  · subst x; simp [hf.1,hne.symm]
  by_cases hxb : x = beta
  · subst x; simp [hf.2,hne]
  · simp [hh x hxa hxb,Ne.symm hxa,Ne.symm hxb]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.MaximumPrinciple
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.VecNotation

/-! Three-terminal response energy derived from the finite Dirichlet problem. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- The three distinguished terminals, all retained as vertices. -/
noncomputable def terminalSet (r : Fin 3 → V) : Finset V := Finset.univ.image r

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem mem_terminalSet (r : Fin 3 → V) (i : Fin 3) : r i ∈ terminalSet r :=
  Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, rfl⟩

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem mem_terminalSet_iff (r : Fin 3 → V) (x : V) :
    x ∈ terminalSet r ↔ ∃ i, r i = x := by
  simp only [terminalSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

theorem sum_eq_terminal_sum (r : Fin 3 → V) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ terminalSet r → f x = 0) :
    (∑ x, f x) = ∑ i, f (r i) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ terminalSet r, f x :=
      (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun x _ hx => hf x hx)).symm
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ hij => hr hij)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_sum {I : Type*} (a b : E → V) (s : Finset I)
    (f : I → V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y) x = ∑ i ∈ s, laplacian a b (f i) x := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, laplacian_const]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    have h : (fun y => ∑ j ∈ insert i s, f j y) = f i + (fun y => ∑ j ∈ s, f j y) := by
      funext y; rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]; rfl
    rw [h, laplacian_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert hi]

theorem sum_laplacian_eq_zero (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, laplacian a b f x) = 0 := by
  have h := incidence_sum a b f (fun _ => 1)
  simpa only [one_mul, sub_self, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero] using h

/-- The unique harmonic potential for one unit terminal value and two zeros. -/
noncomputable def responseBasis (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (j : Fin 3) : V → ℝ :=
  harmonicExtension a b (terminalSet r) hB (fun x => if x = r j then 1 else 0)

/-- Positive-Laplacian terminal flux, before changing its off-diagonal sign. -/
noncomputable def responseEntry (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (i j : Fin 3) : ℝ := laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) (r i)

theorem responseBasis_terminal (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (i j : Fin 3) :
    responseBasis a b r hB j (r i) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold responseBasis
  rw [(harmonicExtension_spec a b (terminalSet r) hB _).1 _ (mem_terminalSet r i)]
  simp only [hr.eq_iff]

theorem responseBasis_harmonic (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (j : Fin 3) :
    ∀ x, x ∉ terminalSet r → laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) x = 0 :=
  (harmonicExtension_spec a b (terminalSet r) hB _).2

theorem sum_responseEntry_eq_zero (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (j : Fin 3) :
    (∑ i, responseEntry a b r hB i j) = 0 := by
  unfold responseEntry
  rw [← sum_eq_terminal_sum r hr _ (responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB j)]
  exact sum_laplacian_eq_zero a b _

theorem responseEntry_comm (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (i j : Fin 3) :
    responseEntry a b r hB i j = responseEntry a b r hB j i := by
  have hi (j i : Fin 3) :
      (∑ x, responseBasis a b r hB i x * laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) x) =
      responseEntry a b r hB i j := by
    rw [sum_eq_terminal_sum r hr _ (fun x hx => by
      rw [responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB j x hx, mul_zero])]
    simp_rw [responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true, responseEntry]
  rw [← hi j i, ← hi i j, incidence_sum, incidence_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => mul_comm _ _

theorem responseEntry_nonpos (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) : responseEntry a b r hB i j ≤ 0 := by
  have hn := harmonicExtension_nonneg a b (terminalSet r) hB
    (fun x => if x = r j then 1 else 0) (fun x _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  change ∀ x, 0 ≤ responseBasis a b r hB j x at hn
  unfold responseEntry laplacian
  rw [responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB, if_neg hij]
  apply Finset.sum_nonpos
  intro e _
  change (if a e = r i then 0 - responseBasis a b r hB j (b e) else 0) +
    (if b e = r i then 0 - responseBasis a b r hB j (a e) else 0) ≤ 0
  split_ifs <;> linarith only [hn (a e), hn (b e)]

/-- The energy of the proved harmonic extension, as a literal terminal quadratic form. -/
theorem harmonic_extension_energy_eq_response (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    let f : V → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x
    energy a b f = ∑ i, ∑ j, t i * responseEntry a b r hB i j * t j := by
  intro f
  have hf (i : Fin 3) : f (r i) = t i := by
    simp only [f, responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB]
    simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hl (x : V) : laplacian a b f x =
      ∑ j, t j * laplacian a b (responseBasis a b r hB j) x := by
    rw [laplacian_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => laplacian_smul a b (t j) _ x
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum, sum_eq_terminal_sum r hr _ (fun x hx => by
    rw [hl]; simp only [responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB _ x hx, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero])]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [hf, hl, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by unfold responseEntry; ring

/-- Once-counted response energy with no arbitrary normalization. -/
theorem three_terminal_response_energy (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x) =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 * (t 0 - t 1) ^ 2 +
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 * (t 0 - t 2) ^ 2 +
      -responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 * (t 1 - t 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [harmonic_extension_energy_eq_response a b r hr hB]
  have h0 := sum_responseEntry_eq_zero a b r hr hB 0
  have h1 := sum_responseEntry_eq_zero a b r hr hB 1
  have h2 := sum_responseEntry_eq_zero a b r hr hB 2
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
  have h10 := responseEntry_comm a b r hr hB 1 0
  have h20 := responseEntry_comm a b r hr hB 2 0
  have h21 := responseEntry_comm a b r hr hB 2 1
  simp only [h10, h20, h21] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
  have hd0 : responseEntry a b r hB 0 0 =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 - responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 := by linarith only [h0]
  have hd1 : responseEntry a b r hB 1 1 =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 - responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 := by linarith only [h1]
  have hd2 : responseEntry a b r hB 2 2 =
      -responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 - responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 := by linarith only [h2]
  rw [hd0, hd1, hd2]
  ring

theorem response_potential_spec (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    let h : V → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x
    (∀ i, h (r i) = t i) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ terminalSet r → laplacian a b h x = 0) := by
  intro h
  constructor
  · intro i
    simp only [h, responseBasis_terminal a b r hr hB]
    simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  · intro x hx
    rw [laplacian_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    change laplacian a b (t j • responseBasis a b r hB j) x = 0
    rw [laplacian_smul a b (t j), responseBasis_harmonic a b r hB j x hx, mul_zero]

/-- The attained Dirichlet minimum, with no assumed response conclusion. -/
theorem three_terminal_response_minimum (a b : E → V) (r : Fin 3 → V)
    (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ terminalSet r, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, f (r i) = t i) :
    -responseEntry a b r hB 0 1 * (t 0 - t 1) ^ 2 +
    -responseEntry a b r hB 0 2 * (t 0 - t 2) ^ 2 +
    -responseEntry a b r hB 1 2 * (t 1 - t 2) ^ 2 ≤ energy a b f := by
  let h : V → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, t j * responseBasis a b r hB j x
  have hs := response_potential_spec a b r hr hB t
  rw [← three_terminal_response_energy a b r hr hB t]
  change energy a b h ≤ energy a b f
  rw [energy_eq_add_energy_sub_of_harmonic a b (terminalSet r) f h
    (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      exact (hf i).trans (hs.1 i).symm) hs.2]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (energy_nonneg a b _)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem eq_of_laplacian_eq_zero_of_max (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) (x : V)
    (hh : laplacian a b f x = 0) (hm : ∀ y, f y ≤ f x)
    {y : V} (hxy : (supportGraph a b).Adj x y) : f y = f x := by
  have hn (e : E) : 0 ≤
      (if a e = x then f x - f (b e) else 0) +
      (if b e = x then f x - f (a e) else 0) := by
    split_ifs <;> linarith only [hm (a e), hm (b e)]
  have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun e _ => hn e)).mp hh
  obtain ⟨_, e, he⟩ := hxy
  have hez := hz e (Finset.mem_univ e)
  rcases he with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨hb, ha⟩
  · rw [if_pos ha] at hez
    split_ifs at hez <;> rw [hb] at hez <;> linarith only [hez, hm (a e), hm y]
  · rw [if_pos hb] at hez
    split_ifs at hez <;> rw [ha] at hez <;> linarith only [hez, hm (b e), hm y]

theorem le_of_harmonic (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (f : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hfB : ∀ x ∈ B, f x ≤ c)
    (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0) : ∀ x, f x ≤ c := by
  intro x
  by_contra hx
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset V).Nonempty := ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ x⟩
  obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ f hne
  have hm : ∀ y, f y ≤ f z := fun y => hz y (Finset.mem_univ y)
  have hzc : c < f z := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_not_ge hx) (hm x)
  have hprop {u v : V} (hu : f u = f z) (p : (supportGraph a b).Walk u v) :
      f v = f z := by
    induction p with
    | nil => exact hu
    | @cons u w v huw p ih =>
      have huB : u ∉ B := fun huB => (not_le_of_gt hzc) (hu ▸ hfB u huB)
      have huw' := eq_of_laplacian_eq_zero_of_max a b f u (hf u huB)
        (fun y => (hm y).trans_eq hu.symm) huw
      exact ih (huw'.trans hu)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ⟨p⟩⟩ := hB z
  exact (not_le_of_gt hzc) ((hprop rfl p) ▸ hfB y hy)

theorem harmonicExtension_nonneg (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (t : V → ℝ) (ht : ∀ x ∈ B, 0 ≤ t x) :
    ∀ x, 0 ≤ harmonicExtension a b B hB t x := by
  have hs := harmonicExtension_spec a b B hB t
  have hneg := le_of_harmonic a b B hB
    ((-1 : ℝ) • harmonicExtension a b B hB t) 0
    (fun x hx => by simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hs.1 x hx]; linarith [ht x hx])
    (fun x hx => by rw [laplacian_smul, hs.2 x hx, mul_zero])
  intro x
  have hx := hneg x
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, neg_one_mul] at hx
  linarith only [hx]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

/-! Dirichlet charging on literal finite edge copies, including parallel copies. -/

@[expose] public section

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry

open scoped BigOperators Classical

noncomputable def selectedCharge {V E : Type*} (q : V → Option E) (B : E → ℝ) (v : V) : ℝ :=
  (q v).elim 0 B

noncomputable def degree {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (v : V) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, ((if a e = v then 1 else 0) + (if b e = v then 1 else 0))

theorem sum_degree_mul {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (A : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ v, degree a b v * A v) = ∑ e, (A (a e)+A (b e)) := by
  simp only [degree, Finset.sum_mul, add_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1 <;> rw [Finset.sum_comm] <;> simp

theorem sum_selectedCharge_le {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (q : V → Option E) (B : E → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ e, 0 ≤ B e) (hq : ∀ v e, q v = some e → v = a e ∨ v = b e) :
    (∑ v, selectedCharge q B v) ≤ 2*∑ e, B e := by
  have h : ∀ v, selectedCharge q B v ≤
      ∑ e, ((if a e = v then B e else 0)+(if b e = v then B e else 0)) := by
    intro v
    have hn : ∀ e, 0 ≤ (if a e = v then B e else 0)+(if b e = v then B e else 0) := by
      intro e
      exact add_nonneg (by split <;> simp_all) (by split <;> simp_all)
    cases heq : q v with
    | none => simpa [selectedCharge, heq] using Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => hn e)
    | some e =>
      have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun e _ => hn e) (Finset.mem_univ e)
      have hi := hq v e heq
      have hle : B e ≤ (if a e = v then B e else 0)+(if b e = v then B e else 0) := by
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl
        · simp only [ite_true]; split <;> linarith [hB e]
        · simp only [ite_true]; split <;> linarith [hB e]
      simpa [selectedCharge, heq] using hle.trans hsingle
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ v, ∑ e, ((if a e = v then B e else 0)+(if b e = v then B e else 0)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v _ => h v)
    _ = 2*∑ e, B e := by rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, two_mul]

theorem sum_endpoint_charge_le {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (q : V → Option E) (B : E → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hB : ∀ e, 0 ≤ B e) (hq : ∀ v e, q v = some e → v = a e ∨ v = b e)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, q v ≠ none → degree a b v ≤ d) :
    (∑ e, (selectedCharge q B (a e)+selectedCharge q B (b e))) ≤ 2*d*∑ e, B e := by
  have hn : ∀ v, 0 ≤ selectedCharge q B v := by
    intro v; unfold selectedCharge; cases q v <;> simp_all
  calc
    _ = ∑ v, degree a b v * selectedCharge q B v := (sum_degree_mul a b _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ v, d*selectedCharge q B v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      by_cases h : q v = none
      · simp [selectedCharge, h]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdeg v h) (hn v)
    _ = d*∑ v, selectedCharge q B v := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm
    _ ≤ d*(2*∑ e, B e) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_selectedCharge_le a b q B hB hq) hd
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- The three actual comparison increments obey the elementary square bound. -/
theorem sum_three_sq_le (u v w : ℝ) :
    (u+v+w)^2 ≤ 3*(u^2+v^2+w^2) := by
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u-v), sq_nonneg (u-w), sq_nonneg (v-w)]

/-- Pointwise geometric input to the charging rule. No summed energy estimate is a premise. -/
theorem angular_comparison_sq_le {V E : Type*} (Q : E → Square) (q : V → Option E)
    (epsilon y0 lambda : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon) (hl : 1 ≤ lambda)
    (f : V → ℝ) (p : V → ℝ × ℝ) (v w : V) (e : E) (z t : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hz : z ∈ ((Q e).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier)
    (ht : t ∈ ((Q e).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier)
    (hv : match q v with
      | none => f v = angular epsilon y0 z
      | some i => f v = angular epsilon y0 (p v) ∧
        p v ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier ∧
        z ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier)
    (hw : match q w with
      | none => f w = angular epsilon y0 t
      | some i => f w = angular epsilon y0 (p w) ∧
        p w ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier ∧
        t ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier) :
    (f v-f w)^2 ≤ 3*(((Q e).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2 +
      selectedCharge q (fun i => ((Q i).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2) v +
      selectedCharge q (fun i => ((Q i).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2) w) := by
  have osc {i : E} {z t : ℝ × ℝ}
      (hz : z ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier)
      (ht : t ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier) :
      (angular epsilon y0 z-angular epsilon y0 t)^2 ≤ ((Q i).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2 := by
    have h := abs_sub_le_oscillation hz ht ⟨1,fun z _ w _ => angular_sub_le_one epsilon y0 he z w⟩
    have hn := ((Q i).angularOsc_bounds epsilon y0 lambda he hl).1
    have hh := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hn).mpr h
    simpa only [sq_abs] using hh
  have hv' : (f v-angular epsilon y0 z)^2 ≤
      selectedCharge q (fun i => ((Q i).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2) v := by
    cases hq : q v with
    | none => simp [hq] at hv; simp [selectedCharge, hq, hv]
    | some i => simp only [hq] at hv; simpa [selectedCharge,hq,hv.1] using osc hv.2.1 hv.2.2
  have hw' : (angular epsilon y0 t-f w)^2 ≤
      selectedCharge q (fun i => ((Q i).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2) w := by
    cases hq : q w with
    | none => simp [hq] at hw; simp [selectedCharge, hq, hw]
    | some i => simp only [hq] at hw; simpa [selectedCharge,hq,hw.1] using osc hw.2.2 hw.2.1
  have hm := osc hz ht
  have h3 := sum_three_sq_le (f v-angular epsilon y0 z)
    (angular epsilon y0 z-angular epsilon y0 t) (angular epsilon y0 t-f w)
  have heq : f v-angular epsilon y0 z+(angular epsilon y0 z-angular epsilon y0 t)+
      (angular epsilon y0 t-f w) = f v-f w := by ring
  rw [heq] at h3
  linarith only [h3, hv', hw', hm]

/-- Literal endpoint comparison data, with no selected square at a terminal or zero-current vertex. -/
def endpointFits {V E : Type*} (Q : E → Square) (q : V → Option E)
    (epsilon y0 lambda : ℝ) (hl : 1 ≤ lambda) (f : V → ℝ) (p : V → ℝ × ℝ)
    (v : V) (z : ℝ × ℝ) : Prop :=
  match q v with
  | none => f v = angular epsilon y0 z
  | some i => f v = angular epsilon y0 (p v) ∧
    p v ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier ∧
    z ∈ ((Q i).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier

/-- Once-per-copy weighted Dirichlet charging, with an actual finite exceptional set. -/
theorem dirichlet_charging_le {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (Q : E → Square) (q : V → Option E)
    (epsilon y0 lambda d : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon) (hl : 1 ≤ lambda) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (f weight : V → ℝ) (p : V → ℝ × ℝ) (z t : E → ℝ × ℝ) (bad : Finset E)
    (hf : ∀ e ∈ bad, 0 ≤ f (a e) ∧ f (a e) ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ f (b e) ∧ f (b e) ≤ 1)
    (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ weight v ∧ weight v ≤ 1)
    (hq : ∀ v e, q v = some e → v = a e ∨ v = b e)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, q v ≠ none → degree a b v ≤ d)
    (hz : ∀ e, e ∉ bad → weight (a e)*weight (b e) ≠ 0 →
      z e ∈ ((Q e).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier ∧
      t e ∈ ((Q e).dilate lambda (by linarith)).carrier)
    (ha : ∀ e, e ∉ bad → weight (a e)*weight (b e) ≠ 0 →
      endpointFits Q q epsilon y0 lambda hl f p (a e) (z e))
    (hb : ∀ e, e ∉ bad → weight (a e)*weight (b e) ≠ 0 →
      endpointFits Q q epsilon y0 lambda hl f p (b e) (t e)) :
    (∑ e, weight (a e)*weight (b e)*(f (a e)-f (b e))^2) ≤
      (bad.card : ℝ) + 3*(1+2*d)*∑ e, ((Q e).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2 := by
  let B := fun e => ((Q e).angularOsc epsilon y0 lambda hl he)^2
  have hB : ∀ e, 0 ≤ B e := fun e => sq_nonneg _
  have hA : ∀ v, 0 ≤ selectedCharge q B v := by
    intro v; unfold selectedCharge; cases q v <;> simp_all
  have hterm : ∀ e, weight (a e)*weight (b e)*(f (a e)-f (b e))^2 ≤
      (if e ∈ bad then 1 else 0) + 3*(B e+selectedCharge q B (a e)+selectedCharge q B (b e)) := by
    intro e
    have hweight1 : weight (a e)*weight (b e) ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [(hw (a e)).1, (hw (a e)).2, (hw (b e)).1, (hw (b e)).2]
    have henergy : weight (a e)*weight (b e)*(f (a e)-f (b e))^2 ≤ (f (a e)-f (b e))^2 := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight1 (sq_nonneg _)
    have hn : 0 ≤ 3*(B e+selectedCharge q B (a e)+selectedCharge q B (b e)) :=
      mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (hB e) (hA (a e))) (hA (b e)))
    by_cases heBad : e ∈ bad
    · have hdiff : (f (a e)-f (b e))^2 ≤ 1 := by
        have h := hf e heBad
        nlinarith [h.1,h.2.1,h.2.2.1,h.2.2.2]
      simp only [if_pos heBad]
      linarith only [henergy, hdiff, hn]
    · simp only [if_neg heBad, zero_add]
      by_cases hzero : weight (a e)*weight (b e) = 0
      · simpa only [hzero, zero_mul] using hn
      · exact henergy.trans (angular_comparison_sq_le Q q epsilon y0 lambda he hl f p
          (a e) (b e) e (z e) (t e) (hz e heBad hzero).1 (hz e heBad hzero).2
          (ha e heBad hzero) (hb e heBad hzero))
  have hend := sum_endpoint_charge_le a b q B d hd hB hq hdeg
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ e, ((if e ∈ bad then 1 else 0) + 3*(B e+selectedCharge q B (a e)+selectedCharge q B (b e))) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e _ => hterm e)
    _ = (bad.card : ℝ) + 3*((∑ e, B e) + ∑ e, (selectedCharge q B (a e)+selectedCharge q B (b e))) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have heq : (∑ e : E, if e ∈ bad then (1:ℝ) else 0) = (bad.card : ℝ) := by simp
      rw [heq]
      ring
    _ ≤ (bad.card : ℝ) + 3*((∑ e, B e) + 2*d*∑ e, B e) := by linarith only [hend]
    _ = _ := by dsimp [B]; ring

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry

theorem walk_reaches_within {X : Type} (G : SimpleGraph X) (S : Set X) (C : Finset X)
    {x y : S} (w : (G.induce S).Walk x y)
    (hC : ∀ v ∈ w.support, v.val ∈ C) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => a ∈ C ∧ b ∈ C ∧ G.Adj a b) x.val y.val := by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact .refl
  | @cons x z y h w ih =>
    have hC' : ∀ v ∈ w.support, v.val ∈ C := by
      intro v hv
      exact hC v (by simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_cons, List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr hv)
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.trans _ (ih hC')
    exact .single ⟨hC x (by simp), hC z (by simp), h⟩

theorem finite_connected_span {X : Type} (G : SimpleGraph X) (S : Set X)
    (hc : (G.induce S).Connected) (T : Finset X) (hTS : (↑T : Set X) ⊆ S)
    (r : X) (hr : r ∈ S) :
    ∃ C : Finset X, T ⊆ C ∧ (↑C : Set X) ⊆ S ∧ r ∈ C ∧
      ∀ x ∈ C, Relation.ReflTransGen
        (fun a b => a ∈ C ∧ b ∈ C ∧ G.Adj a b) r x := by
  let w (t : T) : (G.induce S).Walk ⟨r, hr⟩ ⟨t.val, hTS t.property⟩ :=
    Classical.choice (hc ⟨r, hr⟩ ⟨t.val, hTS t.property⟩)
  let sites (t : T) : Finset X := (w t).support.toFinset.image Subtype.val
  let C : Finset X := {r} ∪ T.attach.biUnion sites
  have hrC : r ∈ C := Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  have sites_subset (t : T) : sites t ⊆ C := by
    intro x hx
    exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t, Finset.mem_attach _ _, hx⟩)
  have hs (t : T) (v : S) (hv : v ∈ (w t).support) : v.val ∈ C :=
    sites_subset t (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, hrC, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact hs ⟨t, ht⟩ _ (w ⟨t, ht⟩).end_mem_support
  · intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx ▸ hr
    · obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
      exact hv ▸ v.property
  · intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx ▸ Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    · obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
      have hv' : v ∈ (w t).support := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
      exact walk_reaches_within G S C ((w t).takeUntil v hv')
        (fun u hu => hs t u ((w t).support_takeUntil_subset_support hv' hu))

end

/-- Exact ordinary successor: supply the audited pure standard internally.
The actual chosen face remains unbounded; no face redrawing is asserted. -/
theorem source_outer_arc_of_unbounded_face
    {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (F : BSST.Face D)
    (ha : BSST.incident D alpha F) (hb : BSST.incident D beta F)
    (hu : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (BSST.faceRegion D F)) :
    ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart D e,
      ∃ O : OuterArc (planeEmbeddingOfCharts D hloop charts) alpha beta, O.face = F := by
  obtain ⟨charts⟩ := consume_arc_straightening FiniteAvalanches.External.parametrized_plane_arc_straightening D hloop
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := (FiniteAvalanches.External.bsst_square_tiling J D hc alpha beta hne F ha hb hu).1
  obtain ⟨augCharts⟩ := consume_auxiliary_straightening FiniteAvalanches.External.parametrized_plane_arc_straightening D hloop alpha beta hne F A
  let P := planeEmbeddingOfCharts D hloop charts
  let Q := planeEmbeddingOfCharts A.drawing (by
    intro z
    cases z with
    | inl e => exact hloop e
    | inr _ => exact hne) augCharts
  let O : OuterArc P alpha beta := {
    face := F
    alpha_incident := ha
    beta_incident := hb
    unbounded := hu
    embedding := Q
    point_eq := A.point_eq
    curve_eq := A.curve_eq
    interior_in_face := A.interior_in_face }
  exact ⟨charts, O, rfl⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ChartExistence

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Ordinary compact separation supplies every trace-box field once an actual
parametrized arc has been straightened. No graph-topology result is assumed. -/
theorem edgeChart_of_straightening (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : OrientedChart)
    (hs : ∀ t : ArcParameter, c.map (D.curve e t) = (t.val, 0)) :
    Nonempty (EdgeChart D e) := by
  let tmid : ArcParameter := ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  let K : Set Plane := Set.range D.point ∪
    ⋃ f : {f : E // f ≠ e}, Set.range (D.curve f.val)
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    (Set.finite_range D.point).isCompact.union
      (isCompact_iUnion fun f : {f : E // f ≠ e} => isCompact_range (D.continuous f.val))
  have hmid : D.curve e tmid ∉ K := by
    rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | h)
    · exact D.avoids e tmid (by norm_num [tmid]) (by norm_num [tmid]) v hv.symm
    · obtain ⟨f, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
      have hi := (D.intersects e f.val (Ne.symm f.property) tmid t ht.symm).1
      norm_num [tmid] at hi
  have hq : (1/2, 0) ∉ c.map '' K := by
    rintro ⟨z, hz, he⟩
    apply hmid
    have heq : z = D.curve e tmid := c.map.injective (he.trans (hs tmid).symm)
    exact heq ▸ hz
  have hopen : IsOpen (c.map '' K)ᶜ := (hK.image c.map.continuous).isClosed.isOpen_compl
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen (1/2, 0) hq
  let r : ℝ := min (epsilon / 2) (1/8)
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (half_pos hepsilon) (by norm_num)
  have hsmall : r < 1/4 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
  have hrepsilon : r < epsilon := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨⟨c, r, hr, hsmall, fun t _ => hs t, ?_⟩⟩
  intro z hx hy
  have hzball : z ∈ Metric.ball (1/2, 0) epsilon := by
    change dist z (1/2, 0) < epsilon
    have hd : dist z (1/2, 0) < r := by
      simpa only [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using max_lt hx hy
    exact lt_trans hd hrepsilon
  have hzK : c.map.symm z ∉ K := by
    intro hz
    exact hball hzball ⟨c.map.symm z, hz, c.map.apply_symm_apply z⟩
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | h)
    · exact (hzK (Or.inl ⟨v, hv⟩)).elim
    · obtain ⟨f, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
      by_cases hfe : f = e
      · subst f
        have he : z = (t.val, 0) := by
          rw [← hs t, ht, c.map.apply_symm_apply]
        exact congrArg Prod.snd he
      · exact (hzK (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨f, hfe⟩, t, ht⟩))).elim
  · intro hz
    have ht : z.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have h := abs_lt.mp hx
      constructor <;> linarith [hsmall]
    let t : ArcParameter := ⟨z.1, ht⟩
    have he : D.curve e t = c.map.symm z := by
      apply c.map.injective
      rw [hs t, c.map.apply_symm_apply]
      exact Prod.ext rfl hz.symm
    exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, t, he⟩)

/-- Same original drawing and copy IDs; this packages EXISTING edge charts only. -/
def planeEmbeddingOfCharts (D : Drawing J) (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e)
    (charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart D e) : PlaneEmbedding J where
  drawing := D
  edge_injective := fun e => D.nonloop_curve_injective e (hloop e)
  edgeChart := charts

/-- Exact intended application of the proposed PURE parametrized-arc standard.
This is conditional on that unregistered standard, not source chart existence. -/
theorem consume_arc_straightening
    (straighten : ∀ gamma : ArcParameter → Plane,
      Continuous gamma → Function.Injective gamma →
        ∃ c : OrientedChart, ∀ t : ArcParameter, c.map (gamma t) = (t.val, 0))
    (D : Drawing J) (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Nonempty (∀ e, EdgeChart D e) := by
  have h : ∀ e, Nonempty (EdgeChart D e) := by
    intro e
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := straighten (D.curve e) (D.continuous e)
      (D.nonloop_curve_injective e (hloop e))
    exact edgeChart_of_straightening D e c hc
  exact ⟨fun e => Classical.choice (h e)⟩

/-- The same single pure standard applies to the ACTUAL auxiliary drawing,
including all original copies and the new alpha-to-beta arc. -/
theorem consume_auxiliary_straightening
    (straighten : ∀ gamma : ArcParameter → Plane,
      Continuous gamma → Function.Injective gamma →
        ∃ c : OrientedChart, ∀ t : ArcParameter, c.map (gamma t) = (t.val, 0))
    (D : Drawing J) (hloop : ∀ e, J.left e ≠ J.right e)
    (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (F : BSST.Face D)
    (A : BSST.AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) :
    Nonempty (∀ z : E ⊕ Unit, EdgeChart A.drawing z) := by
  apply consume_arc_straightening straighten A.drawing
  intro z
  cases z with
  | inl e => exact hloop e
  | inr _ => exact hne

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ChartExistence

/-- Classical intrinsic stream/square corollary of Brooks–Smith–Stone–Tutte (1940),
§§3.3 and 4.1–4.3, printed pp319–322, on the actual complement faces and original
copied wires. Auxiliary existence, every auxiliary arc, physical given-chart side
compatibility, unique signed-current stream, and original closed-square coverage
are included. No chart or cyclic-order existence, vertex-range bound, split,
logarithmic or moment conclusion is trusted. -/
axiom bsst_square_tiling :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (_hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (F : Face D) (_ha : incident D alpha F) (_hb : incident D beta F)
    (_houter : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (faceRegion D F)),
    let phi := voltage J alpha beta hc
    let M := mass J phi
    Nonempty (AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) ∧
    ∀ A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta,
    ∃ face0 face1 : E ⊕ Unit → Face A.drawing,
      (∀ z, edgeFaces A.drawing z = {face0 z,face1 z}) ∧
      (∀ z (c : Source.EdgeChart A.drawing z),
        negativeChartFace A.drawing z c = face0 z ∧
        positiveChartFace A.drawing z c = face1 z) ∧
      (∃! psi : Face A.drawing → ℝ,
        (∀ e, psi (face1 (.inl e))-psi (face0 (.inl e)) =
          phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
        psi (face0 (.inr ())) = 0 ∧ psi (face1 (.inr ())) = M) ∧
      ∀ psi : Face A.drawing → ℝ,
        ((∀ e, psi (face1 (.inl e))-psi (face0 (.inl e)) =
          phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
          psi (face0 (.inr ())) = 0 ∧ psi (face1 (.inr ())) = M) →
        (∀ F, 0 ≤ psi F ∧ psi F ≤ M) ∧
        (∀ e f : E, e ≠ f → Disjoint
          (interior (copiedSquare J phi psi (fun e => face0 (.inl e))
            (fun e => face1 (.inl e)) e))
          (interior (copiedSquare J phi psi (fun e => face0 (.inl e))
            (fun e => face1 (.inl e)) f))) ∧
        (⋃ e : E, copiedSquare J phi psi (fun e => face0 (.inl e))
          (fun e => face1 (.inl e)) e) = Set.Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 M

end FiniteAvalanches.External

/-- The classical face characterization immediately yields genuine original endpoint incidence. -/
theorem actual_copy_face_consumer {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta)
    (face0 face1 : E ⊕ Unit → Face A.drawing)
    (hfaces : ∀ z, edgeFaces A.drawing z = {face0 z,face1 z}) (e : E) :
    incident A.drawing (J.left e) (face0 (.inl e)) ∧
    incident A.drawing (J.right e) (face0 (.inl e)) ∧
    incident A.drawing (J.left e) (face1 (.inl e)) ∧
    incident A.drawing (J.right e) (face1 (.inl e)) := by
  have h0 : face0 (.inl e) ∈ edgeFaces A.drawing (.inl e) := by
    rw [hfaces (.inl e)]
    exact Set.mem_insert _ _
  have h1 : face1 (.inl e) ∈ edgeFaces A.drawing (.inl e) := by
    rw [hfaces (.inl e)]
    exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hi0 := edgeFaces_endpoints A.drawing (.inl e) (face0 (.inl e)) h0
  have hi1 := edgeFaces_endpoints A.drawing (.inl e) (face1 (.inl e)) h1
  exact ⟨hi0.1,hi0.2,hi1.1,hi1.2⟩

/-- Chart-compatible intrinsic face labels reconstruct the exact source stream equation. -/
theorem source_stream_consumer {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : Source.OuterArc D alpha beta)
    (face0 face1 : E ⊕ Unit → Face A.embedding.drawing)
    (psi : Face A.embedding.drawing → ℝ) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (hcharts : ∀ z (c : Source.EdgeChart A.embedding.drawing z),
      negativeChartFace A.embedding.drawing z c = face0 z ∧
      positiveChartFace A.embedding.drawing z c = face1 z)
    (hcurrent : ∀ e, psi (face1 (.inl e))-psi (face0 (.inl e)) =
      phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e))
    (h0 : psi (face0 (.inr ())) = 0) (h1 : psi (face1 (.inr ())) = mass J phi) :
    Source.stream_spec D alpha beta A phi psi := by
  have hf0 (z : E ⊕ Unit) : A.embedding.rightFace z = face0 z :=
    (hcharts z (A.embedding.edgeChart z)).1
  have hf1 (z : E ⊕ Unit) : A.embedding.leftFace z = face1 z :=
    (hcharts z (A.embedding.edgeChart z)).2
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro e
    rw [hf1,hf0]
    exact hcurrent e
  · rw [hf1,hf0,h1,h0,sub_zero]
  · rw [hf0]
    exact h0
  · rw [hf1]
    exact h1

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

/-- The uncharted physical-current characterization is exactly the existing source stream predicate. -/
theorem source_stream_spec_iff {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : Source.OuterArc D alpha beta)
    (face0 face1 : E ⊕ Unit → Face A.embedding.drawing)
    (psi : Face A.embedding.drawing → ℝ) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (hcharts : ∀ z (c : Source.EdgeChart A.embedding.drawing z),
      negativeChartFace A.embedding.drawing z c = face0 z ∧
      positiveChartFace A.embedding.drawing z c = face1 z) :
    Source.stream_spec D alpha beta A phi psi ↔
      (∀ e, psi (face1 (.inl e))-psi (face0 (.inl e)) =
        phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
      psi (face0 (.inr ())) = 0 ∧ psi (face1 (.inr ())) = mass J phi := by
  have hf0 (z : E ⊕ Unit) : A.embedding.rightFace z = face0 z :=
    (hcharts z (A.embedding.edgeChart z)).1
  have hf1 (z : E ⊕ Unit) : A.embedding.leftFace z = face1 z :=
    (hcharts z (A.embedding.edgeChart z)).2
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hcurrent,_,h0,h1⟩
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro e
      simpa only [hf0,hf1] using hcurrent e
    · simpa only [hf0] using h0
    · simpa only [hf1] using h1
  · rintro ⟨hcurrent,h0,h1⟩
    exact source_stream_consumer J D alpha beta A face0 face1 psi phi hcharts hcurrent h0 h1

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

/-- A copy with both original endpoints in D cannot be the marked boundary copy. -/
theorem internal_ne_marked (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (ha : originalA e ∈ D) (hb : originalB e ∈ D) : e ≠ marked.val := by
  intro he
  subst e
  rcases marked.property with h | h
  · exact ((project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h.1) ha
  · exact ((project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h.2) hb

/-- An original interior edge yields a walk after contraction, including collapsed loops. -/
theorem internal_copy_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (ha : originalA e ∈ D) (hb : originalB e ∈ D) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ
      (project D P (originalA e)) (project D P (originalB e)) := by
  by_cases heq : project D P (originalA e) = project D P (originalB e)
  · rw [heq]
    exact .refl
  · let c : Copy D P marked := ⟨e, (mem_retainedCopies D P marked e).mpr
        ⟨Or.inl ha, heq, internal_ne_marked D P marked e ha hb⟩⟩
    exact .single ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ c, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Both orientations of a physical lattice edge transport to actual copied walks. -/
theorem internal_adj_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x y : Site 2) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D)
    (hxy : (lattice 2).Adj x y) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ (project D P x) (project D P y) := by
  change ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i at hxy
  obtain ⟨i, h | h⟩ := hxy
  · subst y
    exact internal_copy_reaches D P marked (x, i) hx hy
  · subst x
    exact (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches_symm
      (internal_copy_reaches D P marked (y, i) hy hx)

/-- Connectedness of D gives complete actual copied walks between all its images. -/
theorem internal_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x y : D) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ
      (project D P x.val) (project D P y.val) := by
  have hr := (SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen x y).mp (hD x y)
  induction hr with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail u v _ huv ih =>
    exact ih.trans (internal_adj_reaches D P marked u.val v.val u.property v.property huv)

/-- Every D image reaches the actual one terminal without using the marked copy. -/
theorem internal_reaches_beta (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : D) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ (project D P x.val) (beta D P) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := P.property
  have hb : project D P p.val = beta D P :=
    (project_eq_beta_iff D P _).mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  simpa only [hb] using internal_reaches D P hD marked x p

/-- A perpendicular outward boundary copy survives deletion of the marked original ID. -/
theorem alpha_reaches_beta (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ (alpha D P) (beta D P) := by
  let j : Fin 2 := if marked.val.2 = 0 then 1 else 0
  have hj : j ≠ marked.val.2 := by
    have hi : marked.val.2 = 0 ∨ marked.val.2 = 1 := by omega
    rcases hi with hi | hi <;> simp [j, hi]
  obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := P.property
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := D.exists_max_image (fun x => x j) ⟨p.val, p.property⟩
  have hout : x + unit j ∉ D := by
    intro hy
    have hle := hmax (x + unit j) hy
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, unit, Pi.single_eq_same] at hle
    omega
  have houter : project D P (x + unit j) = alpha D P :=
    (project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mpr hout
  have hfree : project D P x ≠ alpha D P := by
    intro h
    exact ((project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h) hx
  have hmarked : (x, j) ≠ marked.val := by
    intro h
    exact hj (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  let c : Copy D P marked := ⟨(x, j), (mem_retainedCopies D P marked _).mpr
    ⟨Or.inl hx, by change project D P x ≠ project D P (x + unit j); rwa [houter], hmarked⟩⟩
  have hedge : (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ
      (project D P x) (alpha D P) :=
    .single ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ c, Or.inl ⟨rfl, houter⟩⟩
  exact ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches_symm hedge).trans
    (internal_reaches_beta D P hD marked ⟨x, hx⟩)

/-- Every actual terminal/free vertex reaches beta after deletion of one original copy. -/
theorem reaches_beta (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : Vertex D P) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ x (beta D P) := by
  cases x with
  | inl v => cases v with
    | false => exact alpha_reaches_beta D P hD marked
    | true => exact .refl
  | inr v => simpa only [project_free] using internal_reaches_beta D P hD marked v.val

/-- Full global copied connectivity, not a supplied reachability premise. -/
theorem graph_reaches (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x y : Vertex D P) :
    (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches Finset.univ x y :=
  (reaches_beta D P hD marked x).trans
    ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).reaches_symm (reaches_beta D P hD marked y))

/-- The positive-Laplacian supporting graph is genuinely connected. -/
theorem graph_connected (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    (supportGraph (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked)).Connected := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Vertex D P) := ⟨alpha D P⟩
  exact ⟨(StatementTypes.graph D P marked).supportGraph_preconnected_of_reaches
    (graph_reaches D P hD marked)⟩

/-- The exact original two-rooted-forest carrier is inhabited on every admitted D. -/
theorem forest_nonempty (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Nonempty ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).RootedForest
      ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))) :=
  (StatementTypes.graph D P marked).nonempty_rootedForest _
    ⟨alpha D P, by simp⟩ (graph_reaches D P hD marked)

/-- The denominator is the positive FULL original two-rooted-forest count. -/
theorem forest_card_pos (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    0 < Fintype.card ((StatementTypes.graph D P marked).RootedForest
      ({alpha D P, beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))) := by
  haveI := forest_nonempty D P hD marked
  exact Fintype.card_pos

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.Repair8
