import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.BSST
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.DenselyOrdered

/-! The actual complementary face traversed by a deleted copied arc. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DeletedArc
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DrawingContraction
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V E F : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F]
  {J : CopiedGraph V E} {K : CopiedGraph V F}

/-- The open interior of an omitted original copy avoids the restricted trace. -/
theorem omitted_interior_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (i : F → E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hl : ∀ f, J.left (i f) = K.left f)
    (hr : ∀ f, J.right (i f) = K.right f) (e : E) (he : ∀ f, i f ≠ e)
    (t : ArcParameter) (ht0 : 0 < t.val) (ht1 : t.val < 1) :
    D.curve e t ∉ drawingTrace (restrictDrawing D i hi hl hr) := by
  rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | h)
  · exact D.avoids e t ht0 ht1 v hv.symm
  · obtain ⟨f, s, hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
    have hb := (D.intersects e (i f) (Ne.symm (he f)) t s hs.symm).1
    exact hb.elim (ne_of_gt ht0) (ne_of_lt ht1)

/-- Each endpoint of a genuine parameter subinterval is approached by its
open parameter interval, including at zero and one of the original arc. -/
theorem parameter_interval_closure (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hab : a < b) (t : ArcParameter) (hta : a ≤ t.val) (htb : t.val ≤ b) :
    t ∈ closure {s : ArcParameter | a < s.val ∧ s.val < b} := by
  have himage : Subtype.val '' {s : ArcParameter | a < s.val ∧ s.val < b} =
      Set.Ioo a b := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact hs
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, ha.trans hx.1.le, hx.2.le.trans hb⟩, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [closure_subtype, himage, closure_Ioo hab.ne]
  exact ⟨hta, htb⟩

/-- The actual parametrized approach germs retain the two endpoint occurrences. -/
theorem endpoint_germs (gamma : ArcParameter → Plane) (hc : Continuous gamma)
    (epsilon : ℝ) (he0 : 0 < epsilon) (he1 : epsilon < 1) :
    gamma ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ ∈
      closure (gamma '' {t : ArcParameter | 0 < t.val ∧ t.val < epsilon}) ∧
    gamma ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ ∈
      closure (gamma '' {t : ArcParameter | 1 - epsilon < t.val ∧ t.val < 1}) := by
  constructor
  · exact mem_closure_image hc.continuousAt
      (parameter_interval_closure 0 epsilon le_rfl he1.le he0
        ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ le_rfl he0.le)
  · exact mem_closure_image hc.continuousAt
      (parameter_interval_closure (1 - epsilon) 1 (by linarith) le_rfl
        (by linarith) ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ (by linarith) le_rfl)

/-- A continuous open arc in the complement lies in one actual face, and its
closed arc lies in that face's closure. The face is uniquely determined. -/
theorem common_face (D : Drawing K) (gamma : ArcParameter → Plane)
    (hc : Continuous gamma)
    (hoff : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
      gamma t ∉ drawingTrace D) :
    ∃ face : Face D,
      (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → gamma t ∈ faceRegion D face) ∧
      Set.range gamma ⊆ closure (faceRegion D face) ∧
      (∀ face' : Face D,
        (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → gamma t ∈ faceRegion D face') →
        face' = face) := by
  let f (t : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D} :=
    ⟨gamma ⟨t.val, t.property.1.le, t.property.2.le⟩,
      hoff _ t.property.1 t.property.2⟩
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    (hc.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)).subtype_mk _
  let mid : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  let face : Face D := ConnectedComponents.mk (f mid)
  letI : PreconnectedSpace (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := Subtype.preconnectedSpace isPreconnected_Ioo
  have hconn : IsPreconnected (Set.range f) := isPreconnected_range hf
  have hface (t : ArcParameter) (ht0 : 0 < t.val) (ht1 : t.val < 1) :
      gamma t ∈ faceRegion D face := by
    let s : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨t.val, ht0, ht1⟩
    refine ⟨hoff t ht0 ht1, ?_⟩
    exact ConnectedComponents.coe_eq_coe'.mpr
      (hconn.subset_connectedComponent (Set.mem_range_self mid) (Set.mem_range_self s))
  let interior : Set ArcParameter := {t | 0 < t.val ∧ t.val < 1}
  have himage : Subtype.val '' interior = Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact hs
    · intro ht
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩, ht, rfl⟩
  have hdense (t : ArcParameter) : t ∈ closure interior := by
    rw [closure_subtype, himage, closure_Ioo (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
    exact t.property
  refine ⟨face, hface, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_closure hc (hdense t) (fun s hs => hface s hs.1 hs.2)
  · intro face' hface'
    obtain ⟨hz, he⟩ := hface' ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    exact he.symm

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DeletedArc

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DrawingContraction
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DrawingContraction
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def fiberStep {V E W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (p : V → W) (x y : V) : Prop :=
  p x = p y ∧ ∃ e, (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨ (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y)

def restrictDrawing {V E F : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F]
    {J : CopiedGraph V E} {K : CopiedGraph V F} (D : Drawing J)
    (i : F → E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hl : ∀ f, J.left (i f) = K.left f) (hr : ∀ f, J.right (i f) = K.right f) : Drawing K where
  point := D.point
  point_injective := D.point_injective
  curve := fun f => D.curve (i f)
  continuous := fun f => D.continuous (i f)
  injective := fun f => D.injective (i f)
  start := fun f => (D.start (i f)).trans (congrArg D.point (hl f))
  finish := fun f => (D.finish (i f)).trans (congrArg D.point (hr f))
  avoids := fun f => D.avoids (i f)
  intersects := fun f g hfg => D.intersects (i f) (i g) (fun h => hfg (hi h))

def merge {V : Type} (a b : V) (hne : a ≠ b) (x : V) : {v : V // v ≠ b} :=
  if hx : x = b then ⟨a, hne⟩ else ⟨x, hx⟩

theorem merge_coe {V : Type} (a b : V) (hne : a ≠ b) (x : {v : V // v ≠ b}) :
    merge a b hne x.val = x := by
  simp only [merge, dif_neg x.property]

theorem merge_surjective {V : Type} (a b : V) (hne : a ≠ b) :
    Function.Surjective (merge a b hne) := by
  intro x
  exact ⟨x.val, merge_coe a b hne x⟩

theorem merge_kernel {V : Type} (a b : V) (hne : a ≠ b) (x y : V) :
    merge a b hne x = merge a b hne y ↔
      x = y ∨ ((x = a ∨ x = b) ∧ (y = a ∨ y = b)) := by
  by_cases hx : x = b <;> by_cases hy : y = b
  all_goals simp only [merge, hx, hy, dite_true, dite_false, Subtype.mk.injEq]
  all_goals aesop

theorem merge_fiber {V W : Type} (p : V → W) (a b : V) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hab : p a = p b) (x : V) : p (merge a b hne x).val = p x := by
  by_cases hx : x = b
  · simp only [merge, dif_pos hx]
    exact hab.trans (congrArg p hx.symm)
  · simp only [merge, dif_neg hx]

private theorem quotient_induction (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {V E W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype W]
      (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J) (p : V → W),
      Fintype.card V = n → Function.Surjective p →
      (∀ x y, p x = p y → Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J p) x y) →
      ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (quotientGraph J p),
        (∀ v, Q.point (p v) = q (D.point v)) ∧
        (∀ f t, Q.curve f t = q (D.curve f.val t)) := by
  classical
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro V E W _ _ _ J D p hn hsurj hconn
    by_cases hinj : Function.Injective p
    · let point (w : W) := D.point (Classical.choose (hsurj w))
      have point_eq (v : V) : point (p v) = D.point v := by
        exact congrArg D.point (hinj (Classical.choose_spec (hsurj (p v))))
      have point_inj : Function.Injective point := by
        intro x y he
        have hv := D.point_injective he
        exact (Classical.choose_spec (hsurj x)).symm.trans
          ((congrArg p hv).trans (Classical.choose_spec (hsurj y)))
      let Q : Drawing (quotientGraph J p) := {
        point := point
        point_injective := point_inj
        curve := fun f => D.curve f.val
        continuous := fun f => D.continuous f.val
        injective := fun f => D.injective f.val
        start := fun f => (D.start f.val).trans (point_eq _).symm
        finish := fun f => (D.finish f.val).trans (point_eq _).symm
        avoids := fun f t ht0 ht1 w => D.avoids f.val t ht0 ht1 (Classical.choose (hsurj w))
        intersects := fun f g hfg => D.intersects f.val g.val (fun h => hfg (Subtype.ext h)) }
      exact ⟨id, continuous_id, Q, point_eq, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    · have edge_exists : ∃ e : E, J.left e ≠ J.right e ∧ p (J.left e) = p (J.right e) := by
        by_contra hh
        push Not at hh
        apply hinj
        intro x y hxy
        have hw := hconn x y hxy
        induction hw with
        | refl => rfl
        | @tail y z _ hstep hi =>
          obtain ⟨he, e, hor⟩ := hstep
          have ends : J.left e = J.right e := by
            by_contra hne
            apply hh e hne
            rcases hor with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
            · exact he
            · exact he.symm
          have hyz : y = z := by
            rcases hor with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hr, hl⟩
            · exact hl.symm.trans (ends.trans hr)
            · exact hr.symm.trans (ends.symm.trans hl)
          exact (hi (hxy.trans he.symm)).trans hyz
      obtain ⟨e, hne, he⟩ := edge_exists
      let m := merge (J.left e) (J.right e) hne
      let V' := {v : V // v ≠ J.right e}
      let E' := {f : E // m (J.left f) ≠ m (J.right f)}
      letI : Fintype E' := @Subtype.fintype E
        (fun f => m (J.left f) ≠ m (J.right f))
        (fun f => @instDecidableNot (m (J.left f) = m (J.right f))
          (Classical.propDecidable _)) inferInstance
      let J' : CopiedGraph V' E' := quotientGraph J m
      let p' : V' → W := fun v => p v.val
      have hpm (v : V) : p' (m v) = p v := merge_fiber p _ _ hne he v
      have hsurj' : Function.Surjective p' := by
        intro w
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj w
        exact ⟨m v, (hpm v).trans hv⟩
      have hconn' : ∀ x y, p' x = p' y → Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J' p') x y := by
        intro x y hxy
        have hw := hconn x.val y.val hxy
        have lift {a b : V} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J p) a b) :
            Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J' p') (m a) (m b) := by
          induction h with
          | refl => exact .refl
          | @tail b c _ hstep hi =>
            obtain ⟨hbc, f, hor⟩ := hstep
            by_cases hmc : m b = m c
            · exact hmc ▸ hi
            · have hf : m (J.left f) ≠ m (J.right f) := by
                rcases hor with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hr, hl⟩
                · rw [hl, hr]
                  exact hmc
                · rw [hr, hl]
                  exact Ne.symm hmc
              apply hi.tail
              refine ⟨(hpm b).trans (hbc.trans (hpm c).symm), ⟨f, hf⟩, ?_⟩
              rcases hor with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hr, hl⟩
              · exact Or.inl ⟨congrArg m hl, congrArg m hr⟩
              · exact Or.inr ⟨congrArg m hr, congrArg m hl⟩
        simpa only [m, merge_coe] using lift hw
      have hcard : Fintype.card V' < n := by
        rw [← hn]
        exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt (x := J.right e) (not_not.mpr rfl)
      obtain ⟨q0, hq0cont, _, D', hp0, hc0⟩ := contract_edge J D e hne m
        (merge_surjective _ _ hne) (merge_kernel _ _ hne)
      obtain ⟨q1, hq1cont, Q', hp1, hc1⟩ :=
        ih (Fintype.card V') hcard J' D' p' rfl hsurj' hconn'
      let i (f : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)}) :
          {g : E' // p' (J'.left g) ≠ p' (J'.right g)} :=
        ⟨⟨f.val, fun hh => f.property ((hpm _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg p' hh).trans (hpm _)))⟩,
          fun hh => f.property ((hpm _).symm.trans (hh.trans (hpm _)))⟩
      have hi : Function.Injective i := by
        intro f g h
        exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z => z.val.val) h)
      let Q : Drawing (quotientGraph J p) := restrictDrawing Q' i hi
        (fun f => hpm (J.left f.val)) (fun f => hpm (J.right f.val))
      refine ⟨q1 ∘ q0, hq1cont.comp hq0cont, Q, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro v
        change Q'.point (p v) = q1 (q0 (D.point v))
        rw [← hpm v, hp1, hp0]
      · intro f t
        change Q'.curve (i f) t = q1 (q0 (D.curve f.val t))
        rw [hc1, hc0]

theorem connected_quotient {V E W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype W]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J) (p : V → W)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective p)
    (hconn : ∀ x y, p x = p y → Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J p) x y) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (quotientGraph J p),
      (∀ v, Q.point (p v) = q (D.point v)) ∧
      (∀ f t, Q.curve f t = q (D.curve f.val t)) :=
  quotient_induction (Fintype.card V) J D p rfl hsurj hconn

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DrawingContraction

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.ArcCollapse

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DrawingContraction
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

def quotientGraph {V E W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (p : V → W) :
    CopiedGraph W {e : E // p (J.left e) ≠ p (J.right e)} :=
  ⟨fun e => p (J.left e.val), fun e => p (J.right e.val)⟩

theorem contract_edge {V E W : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype W]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) (p : V → W) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (hkernel : ∀ x y, p x = p y ↔ x = y ∨
      ((x = J.left e ∨ x = J.right e) ∧ (y = J.left e ∨ y = J.right e))) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧
      (∀ x y, q x = q y ↔ x = y ∨
        (x ∈ Set.range (D.curve e) ∧ y ∈ Set.range (D.curve e))) ∧
      ∃ Q : Drawing (quotientGraph J p),
        (∀ v, Q.point (p v) = q (D.point v)) ∧
        (∀ f t, Q.curve f t = q (D.curve f.val t)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hqcont, hq⟩ := ArcCollapse.exists_arc_collapse (D.curve e)
    (D.continuous e) (D.nonloop_curve_injective e hne)
  have point_range (v : V) : D.point v ∈ Set.range (D.curve e) ↔
      v = J.left e ∨ v = J.right e := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      rcases (D.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp ht with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv⟩
      · exact Or.inl hv.symm
      · exact Or.inr hv.symm
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, D.start e⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, D.finish e⟩
  have points (x y : V) : q (D.point x) = q (D.point y) ↔ p x = p y := by
    rw [hq, hkernel, point_range, point_range, D.point_injective.eq_iff]
  let point (w : W) : Plane := q (D.point (Classical.choose (hp w)))
  have point_eq (v : V) : point (p v) = q (D.point v) :=
    (points _ _).mpr (Classical.choose_spec (hp (p v)))
  have point_inj : Function.Injective point := by
    intro x y h
    have he := (points (Classical.choose (hp x)) (Classical.choose (hp y))).mp h
    rwa [Classical.choose_spec (hp x), Classical.choose_spec (hp y)] at he
  have pe : p (J.left e) = p (J.right e) :=
    (hkernel _ _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩)
  have survivor_ne (f : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)}) : f.val ≠ e := by
    intro h
    exact f.property (h.symm ▸ pe)
  have survivor_range (f : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)})
      (t : ArcParameter) (ht : D.curve f.val t ∈ Set.range (D.curve e)) :
      t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ht
    exact (D.intersects f.val e (survivor_ne f) t s hs.symm).1
  let curve (f : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)}) (t : ArcParameter) : Plane :=
    q (D.curve f.val t)
  have injective (f : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)}) :
      Set.InjOn (curve f) {t | t.val < 1} := by
    intro s hs t ht h
    rcases (hq _ _).mp h with he | ⟨hsr, htr⟩
    · exact D.injective f.val hs ht he
    · have hs0 : s.val = 0 := (survivor_range f s hsr).resolve_right (ne_of_lt hs)
      have ht0 : t.val = 0 := (survivor_range f t htr).resolve_right (ne_of_lt ht)
      exact Subtype.ext (hs0.trans ht0.symm)
  have avoids (f : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)})
      (t : ArcParameter) (ht0 : 0 < t.val) (ht1 : t.val < 1) (w : W) :
      curve f t ≠ point w := by
    intro h
    rcases (hq _ _).mp h with he | ⟨htr, _⟩
    · exact D.avoids f.val t ht0 ht1 (Classical.choose (hp w)) he
    · exact (survivor_range f t htr).elim (ne_of_gt ht0) (ne_of_lt ht1)
  have intersects (f g : {f : E // p (J.left f) ≠ p (J.right f)}) (hfg : f ≠ g)
      (s t : ArcParameter) (h : curve f s = curve g t) :
      (s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1) := by
    rcases (hq _ _).mp h with he | ⟨hsr, htr⟩
    · exact D.intersects f.val g.val (fun hv => hfg (Subtype.ext hv)) s t he
    · exact ⟨survivor_range f s hsr, survivor_range g t htr⟩
  let Q : Drawing (quotientGraph J p) := {
    point := point
    point_injective := point_inj
    curve := curve
    continuous := fun f => hqcont.comp (D.continuous f.val)
    injective := injective
    start := fun f => (congrArg q (D.start f.val)).trans (point_eq _).symm
    finish := fun f => (congrArg q (D.finish f.val)).trans (point_eq _).symm
    avoids := avoids
    intersects := intersects }
  exact ⟨q, hqcont, hq, Q, point_eq, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.DrawingContraction

import FiniteAvalanches.External.ArcStraightening
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ArcCollapse
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

def ramp (x : ℝ) : ℝ := min x 0 + max (x - 1) 0

def collapseSegment (z : Plane) : Plane := (ramp z.1 + |z.2| * z.1, z.2)

theorem ramp_mono : Monotone ramp := by
  intro x y h
  exact add_le_add (min_le_min_right 0 h) (max_le_max_right 0 (sub_le_sub_right h 1))

theorem ramp_zero (x : ℝ) : ramp x = 0 ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
  unfold ramp
  by_cases h0 : x ≤ 0
  · rw [min_eq_left h0, max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    constructor
    · intro h
      constructor <;> linarith
    · intro h
      linarith [h.1]
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h0))]
    by_cases h1 : x ≤ 1
    · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)]
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact ⟨le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h0), h1⟩
      · intro _
        norm_num
    · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      constructor
      · intro h
        constructor <;> linarith
      · intro h
        linarith [h.2]

theorem ramp_equal (x y : ℝ) (h : ramp x = ramp y) :
    x = y ∨ (x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  by_cases he : x = y
  · exact Or.inl he
  have aux (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hr : ramp a = ramp b) :
      a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
      by_contra h0
      have ha0 : a < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h0
      have hbm : a < min b 0 := lt_min hab ha0
      have ham : min a 0 = a := min_eq_left ha0.le
      have hamax : max (a - 1) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
      have hbmax : 0 ≤ max (b - 1) 0 := le_max_right _ _
      dsimp [ramp] at hr
      rw [ham, hamax] at hr
      linarith
    have hb : b ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra h1
      have hb1 : 1 < b := lt_of_not_ge h1
      have hbmin : min b 0 = 0 := min_eq_right (by linarith)
      have hbmax : max (b - 1) 0 = b - 1 := max_eq_left (by linarith)
      have hamax : max (a - 1) 0 < b - 1 := max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hamin : min a 0 ≤ 0 := min_le_right _ _
      dsimp [ramp] at hr
      rw [hbmin, hbmax] at hr
      linarith
    exact ⟨⟨ha, hab.le.trans hb⟩, ⟨ha.trans hab.le, hb⟩⟩
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne he with hxy | hyx
  · exact Or.inr (aux x y hxy h)
  · exact Or.inr (aux y x hyx h.symm).symm

theorem collapseSegment_continuous : Continuous collapseSegment := by
  unfold collapseSegment ramp
  fun_prop

theorem collapseSegment_equal (x y : Plane) :
    collapseSegment x = collapseSegment y ↔ x = y ∨
      (x ∈ Set.range (fun t : ArcParameter => (t.val, (0 : ℝ))) ∧
       y ∈ Set.range (fun t : ArcParameter => (t.val, (0 : ℝ)))) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hy := congrArg Prod.snd h
    change x.2 = y.2 at hy
    have hx := congrArg Prod.fst h
    change ramp x.1 + |x.2| * x.1 = ramp y.1 + |y.2| * y.1 at hx
    rw [← hy] at hx
    by_cases hz : x.2 = 0
    · rw [hz, abs_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, add_zero] at hx
      rcases ramp_equal x.1 y.1 hx with he | ⟨hxx, hyy⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext he hy)
      · right
        constructor
        · exact ⟨⟨x.1, hxx⟩, Prod.ext rfl hz.symm⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨y.1, hyy⟩, Prod.ext rfl (hy.symm.trans hz).symm⟩
    · have hp : 0 < |x.2| := abs_pos.mpr hz
      have he : x.1 = y.1 := by
        rcases lt_trichotomy x.1 y.1 with hlt | he | hgt
        · have hm := ramp_mono hlt.le
          have hs := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hp
          linarith
        · exact he
        · have hm := ramp_mono hgt.le
          have hs := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt hp
          linarith
      exact Or.inl (Prod.ext he hy)
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨⟨s, rfl⟩, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩)
    · rfl
    · simp only [collapseSegment, abs_zero, zero_mul, add_zero,
        (ramp_zero s.val).mpr s.property, (ramp_zero t.val).mpr t.property]

theorem exists_arc_collapse (gamma : ArcParameter → Plane)
    (hc : Continuous gamma) (hi : Function.Injective gamma) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∀ x y,
      q x = q y ↔ x = y ∨ (x ∈ Set.range gamma ∧ y ∈ Set.range gamma) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hs⟩ := FiniteAvalanches.External.parametrized_plane_arc_straightening gamma hc hi
  refine ⟨collapseSegment ∘ c.map, collapseSegment_continuous.comp c.map.continuous, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  have hr (z : Plane) : c.map z ∈ Set.range (fun t : ArcParameter => (t.val, (0 : ℝ))) ↔
      z ∈ Set.range gamma := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact ⟨t, c.map.injective ((hs t).trans ht)⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨t, (hs t).symm⟩
  change collapseSegment (c.map x) = collapseSegment (c.map y) ↔ _
  rw [collapseSegment_equal, c.map.injective.eq_iff, hr, hr]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ArcCollapse

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External

/-- Classical parametrized planar arc extension with a jointly continuous isotopy and inverse. -/
axiom parametrized_plane_arc_straightening :
∀ gamma : FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.ArcParameter →
    FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source.Plane,
  Continuous gamma → Function.Injective gamma →
    ∃ c : FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source.OrientedChart,
      ∀ t : FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry.ArcParameter,
        c.map (gamma t) = (t.val, 0)

end FiniteAvalanches.External

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.DiskDrawing
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Clopen
import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Proper plane drawings, actual complement faces, and oriented local edge charts. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
abbrev Plane := ℝ × ℝ

/-- An orientation-preserving plane chart, with its orientation witnessed by an isotopy. -/
structure OrientedChart where
  map : Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  isotopy : ArcParameter → Plane ≃ₜ Plane
  continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => isotopy p.1 p.2)
  inverse_continuous : Continuous (fun p : ArcParameter × Plane => (isotopy p.1).symm p.2)
  start : isotopy ⟨0,by norm_num⟩ = Homeomorph.refl Plane
  finish : isotopy ⟨1,by norm_num⟩ = map

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The whole embedded graph, retaining every original copied arc. -/
def drawingTrace (D : Drawing J) : Set Plane :=
  Set.range D.point ∪ ⋃ e, Set.range (D.curve e)

/-- A regular oriented neighborhood of an interior point of the actual edge arc. -/
structure EdgeChart (D : Drawing J) (e : E) where
  chart : OrientedChart
  radius : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < radius
  radius_small : radius < 1/4
  straight : ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val-1/2| < radius →
    chart.map (D.curve e t) = (t.val,0)
  trace_box : ∀ z : Plane, |z.1-1/2| < radius → |z.2| < radius →
    (chart.map.symm z ∈ drawingTrace D ↔ z.2 = 0)

/-- A finite proper plane embedding by simple arcs, with oriented regular edge charts.
All geometry concerns the actual curves; no rotation, face count or Euler identity is supplied. -/
structure PlaneEmbedding (J : CopiedGraph V E) where
  drawing : Drawing J
  edge_injective : ∀ e, Function.Injective (drawing.curve e)
  edgeChart : ∀ e, EdgeChart drawing e

namespace PlaneEmbedding
variable (D : PlaneEmbedding J)

/-- Faces are actual connected components of the complement of the embedded graph. -/
abbrev Face := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}

def faceRegion (F : D.Face) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing}) = F}

private theorem side_off_trace (e : E) (positive : Bool) :
    (D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm
      (1/2,if positive then (D.edgeChart e).radius/2 else -((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)) ∉
        drawingTrace D.drawing := by
  let c := D.edgeChart e
  have hr := c.radius_pos
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using hr
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hn : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hp
  cases positive
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
    change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hn).mp h)
  · change c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D.drawing
    exact fun h => (by linarith : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
      ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual face immediately to the left of the original oriented edge copy. -/
def leftFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,(D.edgeChart e).radius/2),D.side_off_trace e true⟩

/-- The actual face immediately to the right; bridges may have the same face on both sides. -/
def rightFace (e : E) : D.Face := ConnectedComponents.mk
  ⟨(D.edgeChart e).chart.map.symm (1/2,-((D.edgeChart e).radius/2)),D.side_off_trace e false⟩

/-- Literal geometric incidence, including repeated visits of a face at a vertex. -/
def incident (x : V) (F : D.Face) : Prop := D.drawing.point x ∈ closure (D.faceRegion F)
end PlaneEmbedding

/-- The auxiliary alpha-to-beta arc retains every original edge copy. -/
def augmentedGraph (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) : CopiedGraph V (E ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨Sum.elim J.left (fun _ => alpha),Sum.elim J.right (fun _ => beta)⟩

/-- An actual arc in the chosen common outer face, not a combinatorial face assumption. -/
structure OuterArc (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V) where
  face : D.Face
  alpha_incident : D.incident alpha face
  beta_incident : D.incident beta face
  unbounded : ¬Bornology.IsBounded (D.faceRegion face)
  embedding : PlaneEmbedding (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : embedding.drawing.point = D.drawing.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, embedding.drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.drawing.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    embedding.drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ D.faceRegion face

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.PathCopies
import Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.Basic
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Green.Grounded

/-! Literal geometric disk drawings and exact boundary-path statement types.
No probabilistic or electrical conclusion is included in the drawing data. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
open Trees


/-- A copied graph retains every original ID, including self-loops. -/
structure CopiedGraph (V E : Type) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V

namespace CopiedGraph
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Literal finite copied-walk reachability, including length-zero walks. -/
def reaches (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : Finset E) : V → V → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y => ∃ e ∈ T,
    (J.left e = x ∧ J.right e = y) ∨ (J.right e = x ∧ J.left e = y))

/-- Ordinary trees on the full original vertex set and original copied IDs. -/
abbrev SpanningTree (J : CopiedGraph V E) := {T : Finset E //
  (Set.univ : Set V).Nonempty ∧ (∀ x y, J.reaches T x y) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, ¬J.reaches (T.erase e) (J.left e) (J.right e)}

/-- The literal separation characterization of original-copy membership on the tree path. -/
noncomputable def pathIndicator (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (u v : V) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ T.val ∧ ¬J.reaches (T.val.erase e) u v then 1 else 0

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- An original loop remains a network copy and is excluded by the actual tree predicate. -/
theorem loop_not_mem (J : CopiedGraph V E) (T : J.SpanningTree)
    (e : E) (hloop : J.left e = J.right e) : e ∉ T.val := by
  intro he
  apply T.property.2.2 e he
  rw [hloop]
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

end CopiedGraph

abbrev ArcParameter := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- An actual plane drawing of the copied graph by simple continuous arcs. -/
structure Drawing {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : CopiedGraph V E) where
  point : V → ℝ × ℝ
  point_injective : Function.Injective point
  curve : E → ArcParameter → ℝ × ℝ
  continuous : ∀ e, Continuous (curve e)
  injective : ∀ e, Set.InjOn (curve e) {t | t.val < 1}
  start : ∀ e, curve e ⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.left e)
  finish : ∀ e, curve e ⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = point (G.right e)
  avoids : ∀ e t, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 → ∀ v, curve e t ≠ point v
  intersects : ∀ e f, e ≠ f → ∀ s t, curve e s = curve f t →
    (s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1)

/-- The Euclidean closed unit disk, in the literal two real coordinates. -/
def disk : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 ≤ 1}
def circle : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | z.1^2 + z.2^2 = 1}

namespace Drawing
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E} (drawing : Drawing J)

/-- An edge curve hits an original vertex exactly at one of its prescribed endpoints. -/
theorem curve_vertex_iff (e : E) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V) :
    drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v ↔
    (t.val = 0 ∧ J.left e = v) ∨ (t.val = 1 ∧ J.right e = v) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases ht0 : t.val = 0
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht0
      rw [he, drawing.start] at h
      exact Or.inl ⟨ht0, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    by_cases ht1 : t.val = 1
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht1
      rw [he, drawing.finish] at h
      exact Or.inr ⟨ht1, drawing.point_injective h⟩
    · exact (drawing.avoids e t (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm ht0))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht1) v h).elim
  · rintro (⟨ht, hv⟩ | ⟨ht, hv⟩)
    · have he : t = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.start, hv]
    · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
      rw [he, drawing.finish, hv]

/-- Restricting to a nonloop edge turns the literal half-open simplicity into full simplicity. -/
theorem nonloop_curve_injective (e : E) (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) :
    Function.Injective (drawing.curve e) := by
  intro s t h
  by_cases hs : s.val = 1
  · have he : s = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hs
    have hv : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [← h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t _).mp hv with ⟨ht, hn⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact Subtype.ext (hs.trans ht.symm)
  by_cases ht : t.val = 1
  · have he : t = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext ht
    have hv : drawing.curve e s = drawing.point (J.right e) := by
      rw [h, he, drawing.finish]
    rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e s _).mp hv with ⟨_, hn⟩ | ⟨hs', _⟩
    · exact (hne hn).elim
    · exact (hs hs').elim
  · exact drawing.injective e (lt_of_le_of_ne s.property.2 hs)
      (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 ht) h

/-- The literal geometric realization of a vertex set and its original copied edges. -/
def trace (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (drawing.point '' C) ∪ {z | ∃ e ∈ s, ∃ t, drawing.curve e t = z}

/-- Copied edges supported on C can hit only vertices in C. -/
theorem curve_vertex_mem {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ s) (t : ArcParameter) (v : V)
    (h : drawing.curve e t = drawing.point v) : v ∈ C := by
  rcases (drawing.curve_vertex_iff e t v).mp h with ⟨_, hv⟩ | ⟨_, hv⟩
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).1
  · exact hv ▸ (hs e he).2

/-- Distinct forest components have literally disjoint drawings, even with loops and parallels.
This supplies geometric disjointness to a Jordan argument; no no-crossing conclusion is assumed. -/
theorem traces_disjoint {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E} (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D) :
    Disjoint (drawing.trace C s) (drawing.trace D t) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzC hzD
  rcases hzC with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, he, q, hq⟩
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyx' := drawing.point_injective hyx
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (hyx' ▸ hy)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hx (drawing.curve_vertex_mem ht f hf r x hr)
  · rcases hzD with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ | ⟨f, hf, r, hr⟩
    · have hyC : y ∈ C := drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q y (hq.trans hyz.symm)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD hyC hy
    · by_cases hef : e = f
      · subst f
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (hs e he).1 (ht e hf).1
      · have hqr := drawing.intersects e f hef q r (hq.trans hr.symm)
        rcases hqr.2 with hr0 | hr1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr0
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.left f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.start]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).1
        · have hr' : r = ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ := Subtype.ext hr1
          have hv : drawing.curve e q = drawing.point (J.right f) := by
            rw [hq, ← hr, hr', drawing.finish]
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hCD (drawing.curve_vertex_mem hs e he q _ hv) (ht f hf).2

/-- A real finite copied walk supplies a compact connected geometric set in its component trace. -/
theorem reachable_continuum {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (_hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) (y : V) (hxy : J.reaches s x y) :
    ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K ⊆ drawing.trace C s ∧
      drawing.point x ∈ K ∧ drawing.point y ∈ K := by
  induction hxy with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨{drawing.point x}, isCompact_singleton, isConnected_singleton, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z = drawing.point x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    subst z
    exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  | @tail y z h hyz ih =>
    obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hxK, hyK⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e, he, heyz⟩ := hyz
    let A := Set.range (drawing.curve e)
    have hyA : drawing.point y ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.1]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.1]⟩
    have hzA : drawing.point z ∈ A := by
      rcases heyz with h | h
      · exact ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.finish, h.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, by rw [drawing.start, h.2]⟩
    refine ⟨K ∪ A, hKc.union (isCompact_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      hKconn.union ⟨drawing.point y, hyK, hyA⟩ (isConnected_range (drawing.continuous e)),
      ?_, Or.inl hxK, Or.inr hzA⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with hw | ⟨t, ht⟩
    · exact hKt hw
    · exact Or.inr ⟨e, he, t, ht⟩

/-- Two disjoint forest components give disjoint actual continua joining their terminals. -/
theorem disjoint_connecting_continua {C D : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hCD : Disjoint C D)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, J.left e ∈ C ∧ J.right e ∈ C)
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, J.left e ∈ D ∧ J.right e ∈ D)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : V) (hx : x₀ ∈ C) (hy : y₀ ∈ D)
    (hxx : J.reaches s x₀ x₁) (hyy : J.reaches t y₀ y₁)
    (hvertices : ∀ x, drawing.point x ∈ disk)
    (hedges : ∀ e q, drawing.curve e q ∈ disk) :
    ∃ K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ IsCompact L ∧ IsConnected L ∧
      K ⊆ disk ∧ L ⊆ disk ∧ Disjoint K L ∧
      drawing.point x₀ ∈ K ∧ drawing.point x₁ ∈ K ∧
      drawing.point y₀ ∈ L ∧ drawing.point y₁ ∈ L := by
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKconn, hKt, hx₀, hx₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum hs x₀ hx x₁ hxx
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLconn, hLt, hy₀, hy₁⟩ := drawing.reachable_continuum ht y₀ hy y₁ hyy
  have htrace (A : Set V) (F : Finset E) : drawing.trace A F ⊆ disk := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, _, q, hq⟩
    · exact hvertices v
    · exact hq ▸ hedges e q
  exact ⟨K, L, hKc, hKconn, hLc, hLconn, hKt.trans (htrace C s),
    hLt.trans (htrace D t), (drawing.traces_disjoint hCD hs ht).mono hKt hLt,
    hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩

end Drawing
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
