/-! Deleting one original tree copy deletes exactly its simple edge, because
copy-to-edge is injective on an actual forest. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E)

theorem toSimple_erase_tree (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val) :
    G.toSimple (t.val.erase f) = (G.toSimple t.val).deleteEdges {G.edge f} := by
  ext x y
  rw [SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, h⟩
    refine ⟨⟨e, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he, h⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro hxy
    have heq : G.edge e = G.edge f := by
      rcases h with h | h
      · simpa only [edge, h.1, h.2] using hxy
      · simpa only [edge, h.1, h.2, Sym2.eq_swap] using hxy
    exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp he).1
      (G.edge_injOn_of_is_forest t.property.2.2.2 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he) hf heq)
  · rintro ⟨⟨e, he, h⟩, hn⟩
    refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, he⟩, h⟩
    intro hef
    subst e
    apply hn
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rcases h with h | h
    · simp only [edge, h.1, h.2]
    · simp only [edge, h.1, h.2, Sym2.eq_swap]

/-- The full root-path dictionary retains original edge-copy membership explicitly. -/
theorem separates_iff_mem_path (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val)
    (o r : V) :
    ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r ↔
      G.edge f ∈ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges := by
  have hr : G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r ↔
      G.edge f ∉ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges := by
    rw [← G.toSimple_reachable, G.toSimple_erase_tree t f hf]
    change ((G.toSimple t.val).deleteEdges {s(G.left f, G.right f)}).Reachable o r ↔ _
    rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_deleteEdges_iff_exists_walk]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      have he := path_eq (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) p.toPath.val p.toPath.property
      rw [he]
      exact fun h => hp (p.edges_toPath_subset_edges h)
    · intro hp
      exact ⟨path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r, hp⟩
  exact (not_congr hr).trans not_not

/-- Literal original copies on the unique source-to-root path. -/
def rootPathCopies (t : G.SpanningTree) (o r : V) : Finset E :=
  t.val.filter fun f => G.edge f ∈ (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) o r).edges

theorem mem_rootPathCopies (t : G.SpanningTree) (o r : V) (f : E) :
    f ∈ G.rootPathCopies t o r ↔
      f ∈ t.val ∧ ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r := by
  simp only [rootPathCopies, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hf, (G.separates_iff_mem_path t f hf o r).mpr hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hf, (G.separates_iff_mem_path t f hf o r).mp hs⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Past
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-! Fixed original-copy insertion and deletion across all source supports.
This is finite graph infrastructure, without a tree-tail assertion. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
variable (G : Multigraph V E)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
/-- A finite copied path from the inside to the outside has a crossing copy. -/
theorem exists_crossing_of_reaches {F : Finset E} {C : Set V} {o y : V}
    (hp : G.reaches F o y) (ho : o ∈ C) (hy : y ∉ C) :
    ∃ f ∈ F, G.crosses C f := by
  by_contra hn
  have hs : ∀ f ∈ F, G.left f ∈ C ↔ G.right f ∈ C := by
    intro f hf
    have hc : ¬G.crosses C f := fun hc => hn ⟨f, hf, hc⟩
    constructor
    · intro hl
      by_contra hr
      exact hc (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩)
    · intro hr
      by_contra hl
      exact hc (Or.inr ⟨hl, hr⟩)
  exact hy ((G.reaches_mem_iff hs hp).mp ho)

/-- The literal deletion component recovers the complete designated support. -/
theorem componentAfter_eq_of_cut {C : Set V} {t : Finset E} {f : E} {o : V}
    (hc : G.cut_components C t f) (ho : o ∈ C) :
    G.componentAfter t f o = C := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (G.reaches_mem_iff hc.2.2.1 hx).mp ho
  · intro hx
    exact hc.2.2.2.1 o ho x hx

theorem cut_components_compl {C : Set V} {t : Finset E} {f : E}
    (hc : G.cut_components C t f) : G.cut_components Cᶜ t f := by
  refine ⟨hc.1, ?_, fun e he => not_congr (hc.2.2.1 e he), hc.2.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  · rcases hc.2.1 with h | h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] using h.1, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1, by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] using h.2⟩
  · simpa only [compl_compl] using hc.2.2.2.1

/-- Every actual tree copy has exactly two deletion components; the component
of any prescribed vertex is one of them, without selecting a new forest. -/
theorem cut_components_at_source (t : G.SpanningTree) (f : E) (hf : f ∈ t.val)
    (o : V) : G.cut_components (G.componentAfter t.val f o) t.val f := by
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val f (G.left f)
  have hc : G.cut_components C t.val f :=
    G.cut_components_componentAfter t f hf (G.left f) (G.right f) (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  by_cases ho : o ∈ C
  · rw [G.componentAfter_eq_of_cut hc ho]
    exact hc
  · have hd := G.cut_components_compl hc
    rw [G.componentAfter_eq_of_cut hd ho]
    exact hd

/-- All supports containing the source and excluding the sink, not only connected ones. -/
abbrev SourceCutSupport (o r : V) := {C : Set V // o ∈ C ∧ r ∉ C}

/-- Both actual component-tree subsets and a fixed original crossing copy. -/
abbrev FixedEdgeForest (o r : V) (f : E) :=
  (C : SourceCutSupport o r) ×
    {_p : G.ComponentTree C.val × G.ComponentTree C.valᶜ // G.crosses C.val f}

/-- Deletion separates source and sink. This is the literal tree-path edge criterion. -/
abbrev SeparatingTree (o r : V) (f : E) :=
  {t : G.SpanningTree // f ∈ t.val ∧ ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase f) o r}

def insertFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E) (p : G.FixedEdgeForest o r f) :
    G.SeparatingTree o r f := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨insert f (p.2.val.1.val ∪ p.2.val.2.val),
    G.is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses p.2.val.1.property p.2.val.2.property p.2.property⟩
  have hc := G.cut_components_insert_union p.2.val.1.property p.2.val.2.property p.2.property
  refine ⟨t, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact p.1.property.2 ((G.reaches_mem_iff hc.2.2.1 h).mp p.1.property.1)

theorem componentAfter_insertFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E)
    (p : G.FixedEdgeForest o r f) :
    G.componentAfter (G.insertFixedEdge o r f p).val.val f o = p.1.val :=
  G.componentAfter_eq_of_cut
    (G.cut_components_insert_union p.2.val.1.property p.2.val.2.property p.2.property)
    p.1.property.1

def deleteFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E) (t : G.SeparatingTree o r f) :
    G.FixedEdgeForest o r f := by
  let C : SourceCutSupport o r :=
    ⟨G.componentAfter t.val.val f o, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, t.property.2⟩
  let q : G.CutTree C.val := ⟨(t.val.val, f), t.val.property,
    G.cut_components_at_source t.val f t.property.1 o⟩
  let p := G.split C.val q
  exact ⟨C, ⟨(⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩, ⟨p.val.2.1, p.property.2.1⟩),
    p.property.2.2⟩⟩

theorem insertFixedEdge_injective (o r : V) (f : E) :
    Function.Injective (G.insertFixedEdge o r f) := by
  intro p q h
  have hC : p.1 = q.1 := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← G.componentAfter_insertFixedEdge o r f p,
      ← G.componentAfter_insertFixedEdge o r f q, h])
  rcases p with ⟨C, p⟩
  rcases q with ⟨D, q⟩
  dsimp only at hC
  subst D
  apply congrArg (Sigma.mk C)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hi := congrArg (fun t : G.SeparatingTree o r f => G.internalEdges C.val t.val.val) h
    simpa only [insertFixedEdge, G.internalEdges_insert_union
      p.val.1.property.2.1 p.val.2.property.2.1 p.property,
      G.internalEdges_insert_union q.val.1.property.2.1 q.val.2.property.2.1 q.property] using hi
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hi := congrArg (fun t : G.SeparatingTree o r f => G.internalEdges C.valᶜ t.val.val) h
    have hp : G.internalEdges C.valᶜ (insert f (p.val.1.val ∪ p.val.2.val)) = p.val.2.val := by
      rw [Finset.union_comm]
      exact G.internalEdges_insert_union p.val.2.property.2.1
        (by simpa only [compl_compl] using p.val.1.property.2.1)
        (G.cut_components_compl (G.cut_components_insert_union
          p.val.1.property p.val.2.property p.property)).2.1
    have hq : G.internalEdges C.valᶜ (insert f (q.val.1.val ∪ q.val.2.val)) = q.val.2.val := by
      rw [Finset.union_comm]
      exact G.internalEdges_insert_union q.val.2.property.2.1
        (by simpa only [compl_compl] using q.val.1.property.2.1)
        (G.cut_components_compl (G.cut_components_insert_union
          q.val.1.property q.val.2.property q.property)).2.1
    simpa only [insertFixedEdge, hp, hq] using hi

theorem insert_deleteFixedEdge (o r : V) (f : E) (t : G.SeparatingTree o r f) :
    G.insertFixedEdge o r f (G.deleteFixedEdge o r f t) = t := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  change insert f (G.internalEdges (G.componentAfter t.val.val f o) (t.val.val.erase f) ∪
    G.internalEdges (G.componentAfter t.val.val f o)ᶜ (t.val.val.erase f)) = t.val.val
  rw [G.internalEdges_union_compl
    (G.cut_components_at_source t.val f t.property.1 o).2.2.1,
    Finset.insert_erase t.property.1]

/-- Insertion and literal deletion are global inverses, preserving both copied subsets. -/
def fixedEdgeForestEquiv (o r : V) (f : E) :
    G.FixedEdgeForest o r f ≃ G.SeparatingTree o r f where
  toFun := G.insertFixedEdge o r f
  invFun := G.deleteFixedEdge o r f
  left_inv _ := G.insertFixedEdge_injective o r f (G.insert_deleteFixedEdge o r f _)
  right_inv := G.insert_deleteFixedEdge o r f

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Ancestors

@[expose] public section

/-! Every rooted descendant set is the actual component cut off by its outgoing edge copy. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- The literal connected component of a after deleting an individual edge copy. -/
def componentAfter (t : Finset E) (e : E) (a : V) : Set V :=
  {x | G.reaches (t.erase e) a x}

theorem cut_components_componentAfter (t : G.SpanningTree) (e : E) (he : e ∈ t.val)
    (a b : V) (hab : (G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = b) ∨
      (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = b)) :
    G.cut_components (G.componentAfter t.val e a) t.val e := by
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val e a
  have hsep : ¬G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a b := by
    intro h
    apply t.property.2.2.2 e he
    rcases hab with hab | hab
    · simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using h
    · exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using h)
  have ha : a ∈ C := Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hb : b ∉ C := hsep
  have hclass (x : V) : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a x ∨ G.reaches (t.val.erase e) b x := by
    have h := t.property.2.2.1 a (Set.mem_univ _) x (Set.mem_univ _)
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Or.inl .refl
    | @tail x y _ h ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hxy⟩ := h
      by_cases hfe : f = e
      · subst f
        rcases hxy with hxy | hxy <;> rcases hab with hab | hab
        · right; rw [← hxy.2, hab.2]; exact .refl
        · left; rw [← hxy.2, hab.1]; exact .refl
        · left; rw [← hxy.2, hab.1]; exact .refl
        · right; rw [← hxy.2, hab.2]; exact .refl
      · have hstep : G.adjacent (t.val.erase e) x y :=
          ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfe, hf⟩, hxy⟩
        exact ih.imp (fun h => h.tail hstep) (fun h => h.tail hstep)
  have hd (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C) : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) b x :=
    (hclass x).resolve_left hx
  refine ⟨he, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change G.crosses C e
    rcases hab with hab | hab
    · exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [hab.1]; exact ha, by rw [hab.2]; exact hb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [hab.2]; exact hb, by rw [hab.1]; exact ha⟩
  · intro f hf
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact h.tail ⟨f, hf, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · intro h
      exact h.tail ⟨f, hf, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (G.reaches_symm hx).trans hy
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (G.reaches_symm (hd x hx)).trans (hd y hy)

/-- A parent edge is an original tree copy from a to the next vertex on its root path. -/
def is_parent_edge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ t.val ∧
    ((G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) a r).snd) ∨
      (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = (path (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) a r).snd))

theorem existsUnique_parent_edge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    ∃! e, G.is_parent_edge t r a e := by
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree t.property
  have hp : ¬(path hT a r).Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_of_ne hne
  obtain ⟨e, he, hadj⟩ := (path hT a r).adj_snd hp
  have hep : G.is_parent_edge t r a e := ⟨he, hadj⟩
  refine ⟨e, hep, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  apply G.edge_injOn_of_is_forest t.property.2.2.2 hf.1 he
  have hedge {g : E} (hg : G.is_parent_edge t r a g) :
      G.edge g = s(a, (path hT a r).snd) := by
    rcases hg.2 with hg | hg
    · simp only [edge, hg.1, hg.2]
    · simp only [edge, hg.1, hg.2, Sym2.eq_swap]
  exact (hedge hf).trans (hedge hep).symm

/-- The unique outgoing original edge copy; chosen only after full uniqueness. -/
noncomputable def parentEdge (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) : E :=
  (G.existsUnique_parent_edge t r a hne).choose

theorem parentEdge_spec (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    G.is_parent_edge t r a (G.parentEdge t r a hne) :=
  (G.existsUnique_parent_edge t r a hne).choose_spec.1

/-- The source past on its exact nonroot carrier: the component after the outgoing copy. -/
noncomputable def past (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) : Set V :=
  G.componentAfter t.val (G.parentEdge t r a hne) a

theorem past_eq_descendants (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) (hne : a ≠ r) :
    G.past t r a hne = G.descendants t r a := by
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree t.property
  let e := G.parentEdge t r a hne
  have he := G.parentEdge_spec t r a hne
  let C := G.componentAfter t.val e a
  have hcut := G.cut_components_componentAfter t e he.1 a (path hT a r).snd he.2
  have hr : r ∉ C := by
    obtain ⟨b, hab, q, hp⟩ := SimpleGraph.Walk.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hne (path hT a r)
    have hq : q.IsPath ∧ a ∉ q.support := by
      have h := path_isPath hT a r
      rw [hp, SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at h
      exact h
    have hsnd : (path hT a r).snd = b := by simp [hp]
    have heab : (G.left e = a ∧ G.right e = b) ∨ (G.right e = a ∧ G.left e = b) := by
      simpa [hsnd] using he.2
    have hreach := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem
      (heab.imp (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1)) q hq.2
    intro h
    have hab' : G.reaches (t.val.erase e) a b := h.trans (G.reaches_symm hreach)
    apply t.property.2.2.2 e he.1
    rcases heab with h | h
    · simpa [h.1, h.2] using hab'
    · exact G.reaches_symm (by simpa [h.1, h.2] using hab')
  exact (G.descendants_eq_cut ⟨(t.val, e), t.property, hcut⟩ r a hr
    Relation.ReflTransGen.refl (he.2.imp (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1))).symm

/-- Every nonroot vertex has exactly its paper-defined outgoing-edge past. -/
theorem past_ancestor_eq_cut_iff {C S : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C) (r v : V)
    (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    ∃ hne : G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS ≠ r,
      (G.past ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r
        (G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS) hne = C ↔
          v ∈ G.span ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ S) := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  have hd := G.descendants_eq_cut p r v hr hv hve
  have hca := commonAncestor_spec (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r S hS
  have hcav : G.ancestorOf t r S hS ∈ C := by
    rw [← hd]
    exact hca.2 v (fun x hx => by change x ∈ G.descendants t r v; rw [hd]; exact hSC hx)
  have hne : G.ancestorOf t r S hS ≠ r := fun h => hr (h ▸ hcav)
  refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
  rw [G.past_eq_descendants]
  exact G.ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff p r v hr hv hSC hS hve

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef

/-! The grounded Green kernel of the actual positive copied Laplacian. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Arbitrary Poisson data have a unique zero-ground solution on a connected copied network. -/
theorem existsUnique_grounded_poisson (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) :
    ∃! f : V → ℝ, f v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b f x = r x := by
  let B : Finset V := {v}
  have hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y := fun x => ⟨v,by simp [B],hc x v⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB)
    (fun x => r x.val)
  have hspec : zeroExtend B u v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = r x := by
    constructor
    · simp [zeroExtend,B]
    · intro x hx
      exact congrFun hu ⟨x,by simpa [B] using hx⟩
  refine ⟨zeroExtend B u,hspec,?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hz : f-zeroExtend B u = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
    · intro x hx
      have h : x = v := by simpa [B] using hx
      subst x
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply,hf.1,hspec.1,sub_self]
    · intro x hx
      have h : x ≠ v := by simpa [B] using hx
      rw [laplacian_sub,hf.2 x h,hspec.2 x h,sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- Selected only after the Poisson existence and uniqueness theorem. -/
noncomputable def groundedPoisson (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose

theorem groundedPoisson_spec (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r : V → ℝ) :
    groundedPoisson a b v hc r v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b (groundedPoisson a b v hc r) x = r x :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose_spec.1

theorem groundedPoisson_eq (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (r f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : f v = 0 ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ v → laplacian a b f x = r x) : f = groundedPoisson a b v hc r :=
  (existsUnique_grounded_poisson a b v hc r).choose_spec.2 f hf

/-- Unit injection at x and grounding at v; injection at v gives the identically zero row. -/
noncomputable def groundedGreen (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  groundedPoisson a b v hc (fun z => if z = x then 1 else 0) y

theorem groundedGreen_ground (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) : groundedGreen a b v hc x v = 0 :=
  (groundedPoisson_spec a b v hc _).1

theorem groundedGreen_laplacian (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) (hy : y ≠ v) :
    laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) y = if y = x then 1 else 0 :=
  (groundedPoisson_spec a b v hc _).2 y hy

theorem groundedGreen_ground_source (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) : groundedGreen a b v hc v = 0 := by
  apply (groundedPoisson_eq a b v hc _ 0 ?_).symm
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [if_neg hx]
  change laplacian a b (fun _ => 0) x = 0
  exact laplacian_const a b 0 x

/-- Pairing with a zero-ground function removes only the actual ground term. -/
theorem groundedGreen_pairing (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f v = 0) :
    (∑ y, f y*laplacian a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) y) = f x := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ y, f y*(if y = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      by_cases hy : y = v
      · subst y; rw [hf,zero_mul,zero_mul]
      · rw [groundedGreen_laplacian a b v hc x y hy]
    _ = f x := by simp

/-- Reciprocity follows from the literal copied-edge incidence pairing. -/
theorem groundedGreen_symm (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x y : V) :
    groundedGreen a b v hc x y = groundedGreen a b v hc y x := by
  have hxy := groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc x (groundedGreen a b v hc y) (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc y)
  have hyx := groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc y (groundedGreen a b v hc x) (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc x)
  rw [incidence_sum] at hxy hyx
  have hs : (∑ e, (groundedGreen a b v hc x (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc x (b e))*
      (groundedGreen a b v hc y (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc y (b e))) =
      ∑ e, (groundedGreen a b v hc y (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc y (b e))*
        (groundedGreen a b v hc x (a e)-groundedGreen a b v hc x (b e)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    ring
  exact hyx.symm.trans (hs.symm.trans hxy)

/-- Unit-current energy equals the actual Green diagonal, with E counted once. -/
theorem energy_groundedGreen_eq (a b : E → V) (v : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) (x : V) :
    energy a b (groundedGreen a b v hc x) = groundedGreen a b v hc x x := by
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
  exact groundedGreen_pairing a b v hc x _ (groundedGreen_ground a b v hc x)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Network
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Basic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Connectivity.Connected
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Finite Dirichlet problems with individually indexed unit-conductance edges. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_nonneg (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) : 0 ≤ energy a b f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_eq_zero_iff (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b f = 0 ↔ ∀ e, f (a e) = f (b e) := by
  rw [energy, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_const, sq_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_add (a b : E → V) (f g : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (f + g) x = laplacian a b f x + laplacian a b g x := by
  simp only [laplacian, Pi.add_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_smul (a b : E → V) (r : ℝ) (f : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (r • f) x = r * laplacian a b f x := by
  simp only [laplacian, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_sub (a b : E → V) (f g : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (f - g) x = laplacian a b f x - laplacian a b g x := by
  simp only [laplacian, Pi.sub_apply, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
theorem eq_of_reachable (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ e, f (a e) = f (b e)) {x y : V}
    (hxy : (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) : f x = f y := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h p ih =>
    obtain ⟨_, e, he⟩ := h
    rcases he with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact (hf e).trans ih
    · exact (hf e).symm.trans ih

/-- A zero-boundary harmonic function vanishes when each component meets the boundary. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_harmonic (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (f : V → ℝ) (hfB : ∀ x ∈ B, f x = 0)
    (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0) : f = 0 := by
  have he : energy a b f = 0 := by
    rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · rw [hfB x hx, zero_mul]
    · rw [hf x hx, mul_zero]
  have hedge := (energy_eq_zero_iff a b f).mp he
  funext x
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hB x
  exact (eq_of_reachable a b f hedge hxy).trans (hfB y hy)

/-- Extend free-vertex data by zero at boundary vertices. -/
noncomputable def zeroExtend (B : Finset V) (u : {x // x ∉ B} → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ :=
  if hx : x ∈ B then 0 else u ⟨x, hx⟩

/-- The positive Dirichlet Laplacian on free vertices. -/
noncomputable def dirichletMap (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V) :
    ({x // x ∉ B} → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({x // x ∉ B} → ℝ) where
  toFun u x := laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x
  map_add' u w := by
    have h : zeroExtend B (u + w) = zeroExtend B u + zeroExtend B w := by
      funext x; simp only [zeroExtend, Pi.add_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
    funext x; rw [h, laplacian_add]; rfl
  map_smul' r u := by
    have h : zeroExtend B (r • u) = r • zeroExtend B u := by
      funext x; simp only [zeroExtend, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    funext x; rw [h, laplacian_smul]; rfl

theorem dirichletMap_injective (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) :
    Function.Injective (dirichletMap a b B) := by
  intro u w huw
  have hf : zeroExtend B u - zeroExtend B w = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, zeroExtend, dif_pos hx, sub_self]
    · intro x hx
      rw [laplacian_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (congrFun huw ⟨x, hx⟩)
  funext x
  have hx := congrFun hf x.val
  simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, zeroExtend, dif_neg x.property, Pi.zero_apply,
    sub_eq_zero] using hx

/-- Existence and uniqueness are proved before any harmonic extension is selected. -/
theorem existsUnique_harmonic_extension (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : V → ℝ) :
    ∃! f : V → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ B, f x = t x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0) := by
  let v : V → ℝ := fun x => if x ∈ B then t x else 0
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective
    (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB) (fun x => -laplacian a b v x)
  refine ⟨v + zeroExtend B u, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, v, if_pos hx, zeroExtend, dif_pos hx, add_zero]
  · intro x hx
    rw [laplacian_add]
    have hux := congrFun hu ⟨x, hx⟩
    change laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = -laplacian a b v x at hux
    rw [hux, add_neg_cancel]
  · intro f hf
    have hz : f - (v + zeroExtend B u) = 0 := by
      apply eq_zero_of_harmonic a b B hB
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, hf.1 x hx, Pi.add_apply, v, if_pos hx,
          zeroExtend, dif_pos hx, add_zero, sub_self]
      · intro x hx
        rw [laplacian_sub, hf.2 x hx, laplacian_add]
        have hux := congrFun hu ⟨x, hx⟩
        change laplacian a b (zeroExtend B u) x = -laplacian a b v x at hux
        rw [hux, add_neg_cancel, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- The harmonic extension of specified boundary values. -/
noncomputable def harmonicExtension (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (existsUnique_harmonic_extension a b B hB t).choose

theorem harmonicExtension_spec (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t : V → ℝ) :
    (∀ x ∈ B, harmonicExtension a b B hB t x = t x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b (harmonicExtension a b B hB t) x = 0) :=
  (existsUnique_harmonic_extension a b B hB t).choose_spec.1

theorem harmonicExtension_eq (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y) (t f : V → ℝ)
    (hf : (∀ x ∈ B, f x = t x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b f x = 0)) :
    f = harmonicExtension a b B hB t :=
  (existsUnique_harmonic_extension a b B hB t).choose_spec.2 f hf

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_const (a b : E → V) (r : ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (fun _ => r) x = 0 := by
  simp only [laplacian, sub_self, ite_self, add_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Exact quadratic expansion; its cross term is a finite incidence sum. -/
theorem energy_sub_expansion (a b : E → V) (f h : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b f = energy a b h + energy a b (f - h) +
      2 * ∑ x, (f x - h x) * laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [incidence_sum a b h (fun x => f x - h x)]
  unfold energy
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; ring

/-- Dirichlet minimization with the complete nonnegative error retained. -/
theorem energy_eq_add_energy_sub_of_harmonic (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (f h : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ B, f x = h x)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ∉ B → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b f = energy a b h + energy a b (f - h) := by
  rw [energy_sub_expansion]
  have hz : (∑ x, (f x - h x) * laplacian a b h x) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · rw [hf x hx, sub_self, zero_mul]
    · rw [hh x hx, mul_zero]
  rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero]

theorem energy_harmonicExtension_le (a b : E → V) (B : Finset V)
    (hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y)
    (t f : V → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ B, f x = t x) :
    energy a b (harmonicExtension a b B hB t) ≤ energy a b f := by
  have hs := harmonicExtension_spec a b B hB t
  rw [energy_eq_add_energy_sub_of_harmonic a b B f _
    (fun x hx => (hf x hx).trans (hs.1 x hx).symm) hs.2]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (energy_nonneg a b _)

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Energy
import LatticeProb.Network.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-! Aggregating electrical quantities while retaining the original edge-copy index. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators Classical

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Supporting simple graph of the nonloop edge copies. -/
def supportGraph (a b : E → V) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e, (a e = x ∧ b e = y) ∨ (b e = x ∧ a e = y)
  symm := ⟨by
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := h
    exact ⟨Ne.symm hne, e, he.elim (fun h => Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      (fun h => Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro x h; exact h.1 rfl⟩

/-- Conductance equal to edge-copy multiplicity, with loops removed. -/
noncomputable def conductance (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  if x = y then 0 else ∑ e,
    ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then 1 else 0) +
     (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then 1 else 0))

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_nonneg (a b : E → V) (x y : V) : 0 ≤ conductance a b x y := by
  unfold conductance
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun e _ => add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_symm (a b : E → V) (x y : V) :
    conductance a b x y = conductance a b y x := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y; rfl
  simp only [conductance, if_neg hxy, if_neg (Ne.symm hxy)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [and_comm]
  ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem isCond_conductance (a b : E → V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.IsCond (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) := by
  refine ⟨conductance_symm a b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := hxy
    rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro e _
      exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    · refine ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ e, ?_⟩
      rcases he with he | he
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
      · rw [if_pos he]
        positivity
  · intro x y hxy
    by_cases hne : x = y
    · simp only [conductance, if_pos hne]
    · rw [conductance, if_neg hne]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
      have h1 : ¬ (a e = x ∧ b e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inl he⟩
      have h2 : ¬ (b e = x ∧ a e = y) := fun he => hxy ⟨hne, e, Or.inr he⟩
      simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x y : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    conductance a b x y * f y = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x ∧ b e = y then f y else 0) +
       (if b e = x ∧ a e = y then f y else 0)) := by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    simp only [conductance, hf, mul_zero, ite_self, add_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · rw [conductance, if_neg hxy, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    simp only [add_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]

theorem sum_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) (hf : f x = 0) :
    (∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y) = ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x then f (b e) else 0) +
       (if b e = x then f (a e) else 0)) := by
  simp_rw [conductance_mul a b x _ f hf]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_and, Finset.sum_ite_irrel,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem sum_neighbor_conductance_mul (a b : E → V) (x : V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ y ∈ (supportGraph a b).neighborFinset x, conductance a b x y * f y) =
      ∑ y, conductance a b x y * f y := by
  apply LatticeProb.Network.sum_neighborFinset_eq_sum x Finset.univ
  · intro y hxy
    rw [(isCond_conductance a b).zero_of_not_adj hxy, zero_mul]
  · intro y _ _
    exact Finset.mem_univ y

theorem netLaplacian_eq_neg_laplacian (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) h x =
      -laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.netLaplacian, sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
    sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => h y - h x) (sub_self _)]
  unfold laplacian
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

theorem energyOn_eq_two_mul_energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    LatticeProb.Network.energyOn (supportGraph a b) (conductance a b) Finset.univ f =
      2 * energy a b f := by
  rw [LatticeProb.Network.energyOn_eq_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ e, ((if a e = x then (f x - f (b e)) ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if b e = x then (f x - f (a e)) ^ 2 else 0)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      rw [sum_neighbor_conductance_mul,
        sum_conductance_mul a b x (fun y => (f x - f y) ^ 2) (by simp)]
    _ = 2 * energy a b f := ordered_incidence_energy a b f

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Sigma
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Piecewise
public import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
public import Mathlib.Tactic.SplitIfs

@[expose] public section

/-! Finite energy and incidence identities for individually indexed edge copies. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

open scoped BigOperators

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

/-- Once-counted unit-conductance energy, retaining every edge copy. -/
noncomputable def energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, (f (a e) - f (b e)) ^ 2

/-- The edge energy weighted by the product of the endpoint values of `h`. -/
noncomputable def weightedEnergy (a b : E → V) (h g : V → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, h (a e) * h (b e) * (g (a e) - g (b e)) ^ 2

/-- Positive Laplacian as a literal incidence sum; both incidences of a loop vanish. -/
noncomputable def laplacian (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ e, ((if a e = x then h x - h (b e) else 0) +
    (if b e = x then h x - h (a e) else 0))

theorem edge_ground_identity (hx hy gx gy : ℝ) :
    (hx * gx - hy * gy) ^ 2 = hx * hy * (gx - gy) ^ 2 +
      (hx - hy) * (hx * gx ^ 2 - hy * gy ^ 2) := by
  ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_ground_edge_sum (a b : E → V) (h g : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => h x * g x) = weightedEnergy a b h g +
      ∑ e, (h (a e) - h (b e)) *
        (h (a e) * g (a e) ^ 2 - h (b e) * g (b e) ^ 2) := by
  unfold energy weightedEnergy
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ =>
    edge_ground_identity (h (a e)) (h (b e)) (g (a e)) (g (b e))

theorem incidence_sum (a b : E → V) (h w : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, w x * laplacian a b h x) =
      ∑ e, (h (a e) - h (b e)) * (w (a e) - w (b e)) := by
  classical
  simp only [laplacian, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  ring

theorem ground_identity (a b : E → V) (h g : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => h x * g x) = weightedEnergy a b h g +
      ∑ x, h x * g x ^ 2 * laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [incidence_sum a b h (fun x => h x * g x ^ 2)]
  exact energy_ground_edge_sum a b h g

theorem energy_eq_incidence_sum (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b h = ∑ x, h x * laplacian a b h x := by
  rw [incidence_sum a b h h]
  unfold energy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

/-- Unit boundary values turn energy into the sum of the two boundary fluxes. -/
theorem energy_eq_two_terminal_flux (a b : E → V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hh0 : h a0 = 1) (hh1 : h a1 = 1) (hhb : h beta = 0)
    (hharm : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b h = laplacian a b h a0 + laplacian a b h a1 := by
  classical
  rw [energy_eq_incidence_sum]
  have hpoint (x : V) : h x * laplacian a b h x =
      (if x = a0 then laplacian a b h a0 else 0) +
      (if x = a1 then laplacian a b h a1 else 0) := by
    by_cases hx0 : x = a0
    · subst x
      simp only [hh0, one_mul, ite_true, if_neg ha, add_zero]
    by_cases hx1 : x = a1
    · subst x
      simp only [hh1, one_mul, if_neg hx0, ite_true, zero_add]
    by_cases hxb : x = beta
    · subst x
      simp only [hhb, zero_mul, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
    · simp only [hharm x hx0 hx1 hxb, mul_zero, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hpoint x), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_add_const (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => c + f x) = energy a b f := by
  unfold energy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem energy_one_sub (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => 1 - f x) = energy a b f := by
  unfold energy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

omit [Fintype V] in
/-- Transport vertices while retaining the same edge-copy index. -/
theorem energy_pullback {W : Type*} (q : W → V) (a b : E → W) (f : V → ℝ) :
    energy a b (fun x => f (q x)) = energy (fun e => q (a e)) (fun e => q (b e)) f := by
  rfl

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem weightedEnergy_sub_const (a b : E → V) (h f : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    weightedEnergy a b h (fun x => f x - c) = weightedEnergy a b h f := by
  unfold weightedEnergy
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by ring

open scoped Classical in
/-- Counting the two endpoint incidences gives exactly twice the once-counted energy. -/
theorem ordered_incidence_energy (a b : E → V) (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, ∑ e,
      ((if a e = x then (f x - f (b e)) ^ 2 else 0) +
       (if b e = x then (f x - f (a e)) ^ 2 else 0))) = 2 * energy a b f := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ e, 2 * (f (a e) - f (b e)) ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      ring
    _ = 2 * energy a b f := by rw [energy, Finset.mul_sum]

/-- Energy of the ground-state trial function for explicit three-terminal Dirichlet data. -/
theorem ground_trial_energy (a b : E → V) (h f : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hh0 : h a0 = 1) (hh1 : h a1 = 1) (hhb : h beta = 0)
    (hf0 : f a0 = 0) (hf1 : f a1 = 1)
    (hharm : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) + h x * (f x - 1 / 2)) =
      (laplacian a b h a0 + laplacian a b h a1) / 4 +
        weightedEnergy a b h f := by
  classical
  rw [energy_add_const, ground_identity, weightedEnergy_sub_const]
  have hpoint (x : V) : h x * (f x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 * laplacian a b h x =
      (if x = a0 then laplacian a b h a0 / 4 else 0) +
      (if x = a1 then laplacian a b h a1 / 4 else 0) := by
    by_cases hx0 : x = a0
    · subst x
      simp only [hh0, hf0, ite_true, if_neg ha]
      ring
    by_cases hx1 : x = a1
    · subst x
      simp only [hh1, hf1, if_neg hx0, ite_true]
      ring
    by_cases hxb : x = beta
    · subst x
      simp only [hhb, zero_mul, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
    · simp only [hharm x hx0 hx1 hxb, mul_zero, if_neg hx0, if_neg hx1, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hpoint x), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  ring

/-- Background-energy form of the trial identity, without any response coefficients. -/
theorem ground_trial_energy_eq_background (a b : E → V) (h f : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hh0 : h a0 = 1) (hh1 : h a1 = 1) (hhb : h beta = 0)
    (hf0 : f a0 = 0) (hf1 : f a1 = 1)
    (hharm : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b h x = 0) :
    energy a b (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) + h x * (f x - 1 / 2)) =
      energy a b h / 4 + weightedEnergy a b h f := by
  rw [ground_trial_energy a b h f a0 a1 beta ha hh0 hh1 hhb hf0 hf1 hharm,
    energy_eq_two_terminal_flux a b h a0 a1 beta ha hh0 hh1 hhb hharm]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem laplacian_one_sub (a b : E → V) (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    laplacian a b (fun y => 1 - phi y) x = -laplacian a b phi x := by
  classical
  unfold laplacian
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- Trial-energy identity in voltage coordinates for explicit Dirichlet data. -/
theorem ground_trial_energy_of_voltage (a b : E → V) (phi f : V → ℝ)
    (a0 a1 beta : V) (ha : a0 ≠ a1)
    (hp0 : phi a0 = 0) (hp1 : phi a1 = 0) (hpb : phi beta = 1)
    (hf0 : f a0 = 0) (hf1 : f a1 = 1)
    (hph : ∀ x, x ≠ a0 → x ≠ a1 → x ≠ beta → laplacian a b phi x = 0) :
    energy a b (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (1 - phi x) * (f x - 1 / 2)) =
      energy a b phi / 4 + weightedEnergy a b (fun x => 1 - phi x) f := by
  have hh0 : 1 - phi a0 = 1 := by rw [hp0, sub_zero]
  have hh1 : 1 - phi a1 = 1 := by rw [hp1, sub_zero]
  have hhb : 1 - phi beta = 0 := by rw [hpb, sub_self]
  have hharm (x : V) (hx0 : x ≠ a0) (hx1 : x ≠ a1) (hxb : x ≠ beta) :
      laplacian a b (fun y => 1 - phi y) x = 0 := by
    rw [laplacian_one_sub, hph x hx0 hx1 hxb, neg_zero]
  rw [ground_trial_energy_eq_background a b (fun x => 1 - phi x) f
    a0 a1 beta ha hh0 hh1 hhb hf0 hf1 hharm, energy_one_sub]

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical

/-! Uncharted proper drawings, their literal complement faces, and original-copy coordinates. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source (Plane drawingTrace augmentedGraph voltage mass)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- Actual connected components of the complement of the full original drawn trace. -/
abbrev Face (D : Drawing J) := ConnectedComponents {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D}

/-- The actual plane region represented by a complement component. -/
def faceRegion (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) : Set Plane :=
  {z | ∃ hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D,
    ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨z,hz⟩ : {w // w ∉ drawingTrace D}) = F}

/-- Literal geometric vertex incidence, including repeated visits of the same face. -/
def incident (D : Drawing J) (x : V) (F : Face D) : Prop :=
  D.point x ∈ closure (faceRegion D F)

/-- Actual faces whose closed boundary contains the whole original copied edge arc. -/
def edgeFaces (D : Drawing J) (e : E) : Set (Face D) :=
  {F | Set.range (D.curve e) ⊆ closure (faceRegion D F)}

/-- A genuine auxiliary arc in the chosen face, retaining every original point and curve. -/
structure AuxiliaryArc (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V) where
  drawing : Drawing (augmentedGraph J alpha beta)
  point_eq : drawing.point = D.point
  curve_eq : ∀ e, drawing.curve (.inl e) = D.curve e
  interior_in_face : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
    drawing.curve (.inr ()) t ∈ faceRegion D F

/-- The source zero/one-voltage interval crossed with the actual dual-face voltage interval. -/
def copiedSquare (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    {W : Type} (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e)))
    (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
  Set.Icc (min (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))
    (max (psi (face0 e)) (psi (face1 e)))

/-- The literal positive-Laplacian Dirichlet characterization on the polar dual.
The dual retains the original E; the added arc determines its two boundary faces only. -/
def dualVoltageSpec {W : Type} (face0 face1 : E → W) (pole0 pole1 : W)
    (M : ℝ) (psi : W → ℝ) : Prop :=
  psi pole0 = 0 ∧ psi pole1 = M ∧
    ∀ F, F ≠ pole0 → F ≠ pole1 → laplacian face0 face1 psi F = 0

/-- All actual incident-face voltages, without a finite orbit or default extremum. -/
def incidentValues (D : Drawing J) (psi : Face D → ℝ) (x : V) : Set ℝ :=
  {y | ∃ F, incident D x F ∧ psi F = y}

/-- The source vertical segment with explicitly attained lower and upper face values. -/
def vertexSegment (phi : V → ℝ) (x : V) (lo hi : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
  {phi x} ×ˢ Set.Icc lo hi

/-- Whole-arc face incidence includes each prescribed endpoint, without charts. -/
theorem edgeFaces_endpoints (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (F : Face D)
    (hF : F ∈ edgeFaces D e) :
    incident D (J.left e) F ∧ incident D (J.right e) F := by
  constructor
  · exact hF ⟨⟨0,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.start e⟩
  · exact hF ⟨⟨1,by constructor <;> norm_num⟩,D.finish e⟩

/-- Erasing chart witnesses changes neither the actual complement nor vertex incidence. -/
theorem charted_incident_eq (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (x : V) (F : D.Face) :
    incident D.drawing x F ↔ D.incident x F := Iff.rfl

/-- An existing physical outer arc supplies the uncharted auxiliary-arc data. -/
def auxiliaryArcOfOuterArc (D : Source.PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : Source.OuterArc D alpha beta) : AuxiliaryArc D.drawing A.face alpha beta where
  drawing := A.embedding.drawing
  point_eq := A.point_eq
  curve_eq := A.curve_eq
  interior_in_face := A.interior_in_face

/-- The actual augmented trace adds precisely one curve to the full original trace. -/
theorem auxiliary_trace (D : Drawing J) (F : Face D) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : AuxiliaryArc D F alpha beta) :
    drawingTrace A.drawing = drawingTrace D ∪ Set.range (A.drawing.curve (.inr ())) := by
  ext z
  simp only [drawingTrace,Set.mem_union,Set.mem_range,Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩)
    · cases e with
      | inl e => exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩)
      | inr e => cases e; exact Or.inr ⟨t,ht⟩
  · rintro ((⟨x,hx⟩ | ⟨e,t,ht⟩) | ⟨t,ht⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x,by simpa only [A.point_eq] using hx⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inl e,t,by simpa only [A.curve_eq] using ht⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨.inr (),t,ht⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- A zero-current original copy becomes its actual common voltage/dual-voltage point. -/
theorem zero_current_square {W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ)
    (psi : W → ℝ) (face0 face1 : E → W) (e : E)
    (hp : phi (J.left e) = phi (J.right e))
    (hdual : |psi (face0 e)-psi (face1 e)| = |phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)|) :
    copiedSquare J phi psi face0 face1 e = {(phi (J.left e),psi (face0 e))} := by
  have hpsi : psi (face0 e) = psi (face1 e) := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply abs_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [hp,sub_self,abs_zero] using hdual
  simp only [copiedSquare,hp,hpsi,min_self,max_self,Set.Icc_self,
    Set.singleton_prod_singleton]


/-- A chart's positive side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem positive_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |c.radius/2| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : c.radius/2 ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- A chart's negative side point really belongs to the geometric complement. -/
theorem negative_chart_point_off_trace (D : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) :
    c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)) ∉ drawingTrace D := by
  have h0 : |(1/2 : ℝ)-1/2| < c.radius := by simpa using c.radius_pos
  have hp : |-(c.radius/2)| < c.radius := by
    rw [abs_neg,abs_of_pos (by linarith [c.radius_pos])]
    linarith [c.radius_pos]
  exact fun h => (by linarith [c.radius_pos] : -(c.radius/2) ≠ 0)
    ((c.trace_box _ h0 hp).mp h)

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's positive side point. -/
def positiveChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,c.radius/2),
    positive_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

/-- The actual complement component of an oriented chart's negative side point. -/
def negativeChartFace (D : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : Source.EdgeChart D e) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨c.chart.map.symm (1/2,-(c.radius/2)),
    negative_chart_point_off_trace D e c⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- Connectedness supplies the Dirichlet boundary condition before voltage choice. -/
theorem two_terminal_reachable (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) :
    ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ ({alpha,beta} : Finset V), (supportGraph J.left J.right).Reachable x y :=
  fun x => ⟨alpha,by simp,hc x alpha⟩

/-- The actual unique zero/one Dirichlet voltage of the original copied network. -/
def voltage (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) : V → ℝ :=
  harmonicExtension J.left J.right {alpha,beta} (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc)
    (fun x => if x = beta then 1 else 0)

theorem voltage_spec (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) :
    voltage J alpha beta hc alpha = 0 ∧ voltage J alpha beta hc beta = 1 ∧
      ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian J.left J.right (voltage J alpha beta hc) x = 0 := by
  have h := harmonicExtension_spec J.left J.right {alpha,beta}
    (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc) (fun x => if x = beta then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [voltage,if_neg hne] using h.1 alpha (by simp)
  · simpa [voltage] using h.1 beta (by simp)
  · intro x ha hb
    exact h.2 x (by simp [ha,hb])

/-- The full source characterization uniquely determines the chosen voltage. -/
theorem voltage_unique (J : CopiedGraph V E) (alpha beta : V) (hne : alpha ≠ beta)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (f : V → ℝ)
    (ha : f alpha = 0) (hb : f beta = 1)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha → x ≠ beta → laplacian J.left J.right f x = 0) :
    f = voltage J alpha beta hc := by
  apply harmonicExtension_eq J.left J.right {alpha,beta}
    (two_terminal_reachable J alpha beta hc) (fun x => if x = beta then 1 else 0)
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · rw [ha,if_neg hne]
    · rw [hb,if_pos rfl]
  · intro x hx
    have h : x ≠ alpha ∧ x ≠ beta := by simpa only
      [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] using hx
    exact hh x h.1 h.2

def mass (J : CopiedGraph V E) (phi : V → ℝ) : ℝ := energy J.left J.right phi

/-- Physical original-edge currents and closing-arc current +M; the arc is not an energy edge. -/
def stream_spec {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ) (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e, psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))-psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e)) =
    phi (J.left e)-phi (J.right e)) ∧
  psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ()))-psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())) = mass J phi ∧
  psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())) = 0 ∧
  psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ())) = mass J phi

/-- Each original copy's closed voltage/stream rectangle; zero-current copies are points. -/
def edgeSquare {J : CopiedGraph V E} (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (alpha beta : V)
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (phi : V → ℝ) (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ) (e : E) : Set Plane :=
  Set.Icc (min (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) (max (phi (J.left e)) (phi (J.right e))) ×ˢ
    Set.Icc (min (psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))) (psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e))))
      (max (psi (A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e))) (psi (A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e))))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

/-- The full drawn finite graph is compact, including every copied arc and vertex. -/
theorem drawingTrace_isCompact (D : Drawing J) : IsCompact (drawingTrace D) :=
  (Set.finite_range D.point).isCompact.union
    (isCompact_iUnion fun e => isCompact_range (D.continuous e))

/-- The actual face carrier is the complement of a closed embedded graph. -/
theorem drawingTrace_isClosed (D : Drawing J) : IsClosed (drawingTrace D) :=
  (drawingTrace_isCompact D).isClosed

theorem fiber_reaches_symm {V E W : Type} (J : CopiedGraph V E) (p : V → W)
    {x y : V} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J p) x y) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep J p) y x := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail y z _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨he, e, hor⟩ := hs
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.trans _ ih
    refine .single ⟨he.symm, e, ?_⟩
    exact hor.elim (fun h => Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩) (fun h => Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)

theorem lift_lattice_fiber {W : Type} (U : Finset (Site 2)) (p : U → W)
    (C : Set (Site 2)) (hCU : C ⊆ (↑U : Set (Site 2))) (w : W)
    (hp : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ C), p ⟨x, hCU hx⟩ = w)
    {x y : Site 2} (hx : x ∈ C) (hy : y ∈ C)
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => a ∈ C ∧ b ∈ C ∧ (lattice 2).Adj a b) x y) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep (finiteLatticeGraph U) p)
      ⟨x, hCU hx⟩ ⟨y, hCU hy⟩ := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail y z _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hy', hz, i, hor⟩ := hs
    apply (ih hy').tail
    refine ⟨(hp y hy').trans (hp z hz).symm, ?_⟩
    rcases hor with he | he
    · refine ⟨⟨(y, i), (mem_latticeCopies U (y, i)).mpr ⟨hCU hy', ?_⟩⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, ?_⟩⟩
      · change y + unit i ∈ U
        rw [← he]
        exact hCU hz
      · exact Subtype.ext he.symm
    · refine ⟨⟨(z, i), (mem_latticeCopies U (z, i)).mpr ⟨hCU hz, ?_⟩⟩, Or.inr ⟨?_, rfl⟩⟩
      · change z + unit i ∈ U
        rw [← he]
        exact hCU hy'
      · exact Subtype.ext he.symm

theorem source_primal_realization (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing
      (⟨fun e : ↥((domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
      project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e))) => project D P (originalA e.val),
      fun e => project D P (originalB e.val)⟩ :
      CopiedGraph (Vertex D P) ↥((domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
        project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e)))),
      (∀ v : D, Q.point (project D P v.val) = q (sitePoint v.val)) ∧
      (∀ e t, Q.curve e t = q (unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val)) := by
  let N := ((domainCopies D).image originalA ∪ (domainCopies D).image originalB).filter
    (fun x => x ∉ D)
  have hN : (↑N : Set (Site 2)) ⊆ (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ := by
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hex : ∃ r : Site 2, r ∉ D := by
    rcases marked.property with h | h
    · exact ⟨originalA marked.val, (project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h.1⟩
    · exact ⟨originalB marked.val, (project_eq_alpha_iff D P _).mp h.2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨C, hNC, hCD, hrC, hCr⟩ := finite_connected_span (lattice 2)
    (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ hDc N hN r hr
  let U : Finset (Site 2) := D ∪ C
  have hDU : (↑D : Set (Site 2)) ⊆ (↑U : Set (Site 2)) :=
    fun _ hx => Finset.mem_union_left _ hx
  have hCU : (↑C : Set (Site 2)) ⊆ (↑U : Set (Site 2)) :=
    fun _ hx => Finset.mem_union_right _ hx
  have hPU : (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2)) ⊆ (↑U : Set (Site 2)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact hDU v.property
  let p : U → Vertex D P := fun v => project D P v.val
  have halpha (x : Site 2) (hx : x ∈ C) : p ⟨x, hCU hx⟩ = alpha D P :=
    (project_eq_alpha_iff D P x).mpr (hCD hx)
  have hbeta (x : Site 2) (hx : x ∈ P.val.image Subtype.val) :
      p ⟨x, hPU hx⟩ = beta D P := (project_eq_beta_iff D P x).mpr hx
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective p := by
    intro w
    cases w with
    | inl b =>
      cases b with
      | false => exact ⟨⟨r, hCU hrC⟩, halpha r hrC⟩
      | true =>
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := P.property
        exact ⟨⟨x.val, hDU x.property⟩,
          (project_eq_beta_iff D P x.val).mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)⟩
    | inr x => exact ⟨⟨x.val.val, hDU x.val.property⟩, project_free D P x⟩
  have hconn : ∀ x y : U, p x = p y →
      Relation.ReflTransGen (fiberStep (finiteLatticeGraph U) p) x y := by
    intro x y hxy
    cases he : p x with
    | inl b =>
      have hey : p y = .inl b := hxy.symm.trans he
      cases b with
      | false =>
        have hxD : x.val ∉ D := (project_eq_alpha_iff D P x.val).mp he
        have hyD : y.val ∉ D := (project_eq_alpha_iff D P y.val).mp hey
        have hxC : x.val ∈ C := (Finset.mem_union.mp x.property).resolve_left hxD
        have hyC : y.val ∈ C := (Finset.mem_union.mp y.property).resolve_left hyD
        have hxR := lift_lattice_fiber U p (↑C : Set (Site 2)) hCU (alpha D P)
          halpha hrC hxC (hCr x.val hxC)
        have hyR := lift_lattice_fiber U p (↑C : Set (Site 2)) hCU (alpha D P)
          halpha hrC hyC (hCr y.val hyC)
        exact (fiber_reaches_symm _ _ hxR).trans hyR
      | true =>
        have hxP : x.val ∈ P.val.image Subtype.val := (project_eq_beta_iff D P x.val).mp he
        have hyP : y.val ∈ P.val.image Subtype.val := (project_eq_beta_iff D P y.val).mp hey
        exact lift_lattice_fiber U p (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2)) hPU
          (beta D P) hbeta hxP hyP
          (induced_reaches (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2)) hP _ _ hxP hyP)
    | inr v =>
      have hx : x.val = v.val.val := (project_eq_free_iff D P v x.val).mp he
      have hy : y.val = v.val.val := (project_eq_free_iff D P v y.val).mp (hxy.symm.trans he)
      have hv : x = y := Subtype.ext (hx.trans hy.symm)
      exact hv ▸ Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  obtain ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc⟩ := connected_quotient (finiteLatticeGraph U)
    (finiteLatticeDrawing U) p hsurj hconn
  letI : Fintype {f : ↥(latticeCopies U) //
      p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).left f) ≠ p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).right f)} :=
    @Subtype.fintype ↥(latticeCopies U)
      (fun f => p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).left f) ≠ p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).right f))
      (fun f => @instDecidableNot
        (p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).left f) = p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).right f))
        (Classical.propDecidable _)) inferInstance
  have endpoints (e : OriginalCopy) (he : e ∈ domainCopies D) :
      originalA e ∈ U ∧ originalB e ∈ U := by
    have incl (x : Site 2) (hx : x ∈ (domainCopies D).image originalA ∪
        (domainCopies D).image originalB) : x ∈ U := by
      by_cases hxD : x ∈ D
      · exact hDU hxD
      · exact hCU (hNC (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, hxD⟩))
    exact ⟨incl _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩)),
      incl _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩))⟩
  let i (e : ↥((domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
      project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e)))) :
      {f : ↥(latticeCopies U) //
        p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).left f) ≠ p ((finiteLatticeGraph U).right f)} :=
    ⟨⟨e.val, (mem_latticeCopies U e.val).mpr
      (endpoints e.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).1)⟩,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).2⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    intro e f h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z => z.val.val) h)
  refine ⟨q, hq, restrictDrawing Q i hi (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    exact hp ⟨v.val, hDU v.property⟩
  · intro e t
    exact hc (i e) t

theorem source_primal_drawing (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Nonempty (Drawing (⟨fun e : ↥((domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
      project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e))) => project D P (originalA e.val),
      fun e => project D P (originalB e.val)⟩ :
      CopiedGraph (Vertex D P) ↥((domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
        project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e))))) := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, Q, _, _⟩ := source_primal_realization D P hDc hP marked
  exact ⟨Q⟩

theorem source_H0_drawing (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Nonempty (Drawing (⟨copyA D P marked, copyB D P marked⟩ :
      CopiedGraph (Vertex D P) (Copy D P marked))) := by
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := source_primal_drawing D P hDc hP marked
  let i (e : Copy D P marked) : ↥((domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
      project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e))) :=
    ⟨e.val, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).1,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).2.1⟩⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    intro e f h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    exact Subtype.ext hv
  exact ⟨restrictDrawing Q i hi
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)⟩

theorem source_H0_planeEmbedding (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Nonempty (PlaneEmbedding (⟨copyA D P marked, copyB D P marked⟩ :
      CopiedGraph (Vertex D P) (Copy D P marked))) := by
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := source_H0_drawing D P hDc hP marked
  obtain ⟨charts⟩ := ChartExistence.consume_arc_straightening
    FiniteAvalanches.External.parametrized_plane_arc_straightening Q (copy_loopless D P marked)
  exact ⟨ChartExistence.planeEmbeddingOfCharts Q (copy_loopless D P marked) charts⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeDrawing
