import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Reference.Lattice
import Mathlib.Tactic.Rify

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeDrawing
open LatticeProb
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeCell
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem segment_injective (p : Site 2) (i : Fin 2) :
    Function.Injective (unitSegment p i) := by
  intro s t h
  have hi := congrArg (fun z : Plane => if i = 0 then z.1 else z.2) h
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [unitSegment, unit, Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff] at hi
  all_goals exact hi

theorem segment_start (p : Site 2) (i : Fin 2) : unitSegment p i 0 = sitePoint p := by
  simp only [unitSegment, sitePoint, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem segment_finish (p : Site 2) (i : Fin 2) :
    unitSegment p i 1 = sitePoint (p + unit i) := by
  simp only [unitSegment, sitePoint, one_mul, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add]

theorem segment_intersects (p q : Site 2) (i j : Fin 2) (s t : ArcParameter)
    (h : unitSegment p i s.val = unitSegment q j t.val) :
    (p = q ∧ i = j) ∨ ((s.val = 0 ∨ s.val = 1) ∧ (t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1)) := by
  have h0 := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.snd h
  have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
  have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
  obtain hp | hp | hp | hp :=
    unitSegment_intersection_shared p q i j s.val t.val s.property t.property h
  all_goals
    have hp0 := congrArg (fun z : Site 2 => (z 0 : ℝ)) hp
    have hp1 := congrArg (fun z : Site 2 => (z 1 : ℝ)) hp
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
  all_goals try exact Or.inl ⟨hp, rfl⟩
  all_goals try exact Or.inl ⟨add_right_cancel hp, rfl⟩
  all_goals norm_num [unitSegment, unit, Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff] at h0 h1 hp0 hp1
  all_goals try rify at hp0
  all_goals try rify at hp1
  all_goals
    right
    constructor
    · first | left; linarith [s.property.1, s.property.2, t.property.1, t.property.2]
            | right; linarith [s.property.1, s.property.2, t.property.1, t.property.2]
    · first | left; linarith [s.property.1, s.property.2, t.property.1, t.property.2]
            | right; linarith [s.property.1, s.property.2, t.property.1, t.property.2]

def latticeCopies (U : Finset (Site 2)) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (U ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))).filter (fun e => originalB e ∈ U)

theorem mem_latticeCopies (U : Finset (Site 2)) (e : OriginalCopy) :
    e ∈ latticeCopies U ↔ originalA e ∈ U ∧ originalB e ∈ U := by
  simp only [latticeCopies, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ,
    and_true, originalA]

def finiteLatticeGraph (U : Finset (Site 2)) : CopiedGraph U ↥(latticeCopies U) :=
  ⟨fun e => ⟨originalA e.val, ((mem_latticeCopies U e.val).mp e.property).1⟩,
    fun e => ⟨originalB e.val, ((mem_latticeCopies U e.val).mp e.property).2⟩⟩

def finiteLatticeDrawing (U : Finset (Site 2)) : Drawing (finiteLatticeGraph U) where
  point := fun v => sitePoint v.val
  point_injective := fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (sitePoint_injective h)
  curve := fun e t => unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val
  continuous := by
    intro e
    unfold unitSegment
    fun_prop
  injective := fun e _ _ _ _ h => Subtype.ext (segment_injective e.val.1 e.val.2 h)
  start := fun e => segment_start e.val.1 e.val.2
  finish := fun e => segment_finish e.val.1 e.val.2
  avoids := by
    intro e t ht0 ht1 v h
    obtain hp | hp := sitePoint_mem_unitSegment v.val e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val t.property h.symm
    · have he := segment_injective e.val.1 e.val.2
        (h.trans ((congrArg sitePoint hp).trans (segment_start e.val.1 e.val.2).symm))
      exact (ne_of_gt ht0) he
    · have he := segment_injective e.val.1 e.val.2
        (h.trans ((congrArg sitePoint hp).trans (segment_finish e.val.1 e.val.2).symm))
      exact (ne_of_lt ht1) he
  intersects := by
    intro e f hne s t h
    rcases segment_intersects e.val.1 f.val.1 e.val.2 f.val.2 s t h with he | he
    · exact (hne (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext he.1 he.2))).elim
    · exact he

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeDrawing

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.CellCases

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeCell
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- The literal straight drawing of the original positive unit copy (p,i). -/
def unitSegment (p : Site 2) (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  ((p 0 : ℝ) + t * (unit i 0 : ℝ), (p 1 : ℝ) + t * (unit i 1 : ℝ))
def sitePoint (p : Site 2) : ℝ × ℝ := ((p 0 : ℝ),(p 1 : ℝ))

theorem sitePoint_injective : Function.Injective sitePoint := by
  intro p q h
  apply funext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · have hf := congrArg Prod.fst h
    dsimp [sitePoint] at hf
    exact_mod_cast hf
  · have hf := congrArg Prod.snd h
    dsimp [sitePoint] at hf
    exact_mod_cast hf

/-- Integer unit-edge rectangles can overlap only at a shared endpoint. -/
theorem integer_rectangle_shared (p q : Site 2) (i j : Fin 2)
    (h0 : p 0 ≤ q 0 + unit j 0) (h1 : q 0 ≤ p 0 + unit i 0)
    (h2 : p 1 ≤ q 1 + unit j 1) (h3 : q 1 ≤ p 1 + unit i 1) :
    p = q ∨ p = q + unit j ∨ p + unit i = q ∨ p + unit i = q + unit j := by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals simp only [funext_iff,Fin.forall_fin_two,Pi.add_apply,unit,Pi.single_apply,Fin.ext_iff] at h0 h1 h2 h3 ⊢
  all_goals norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 ⊢
  all_goals omega

/-- A lattice vertex in the closed rectangle of a unit copy is one of its two endpoints. -/
theorem integer_rectangle_vertex (p q : Site 2) (j : Fin 2)
    (h0 : q 0 ≤ p 0) (h1 : p 0 ≤ q 0 + unit j 0)
    (h2 : q 1 ≤ p 1) (h3 : p 1 ≤ q 1 + unit j 1) :
    p = q ∨ p = q + unit j := by
  fin_cases j
  all_goals simp only [funext_iff,Fin.forall_fin_two,Pi.add_apply,unit,Pi.single_apply,Fin.ext_iff] at h0 h1 h2 h3 ⊢
  all_goals norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 ⊢
  all_goals omega

theorem unit_coord_nonneg (i j : Fin 2) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (unit i j : ℤ) := by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [unit]

theorem unitSegment_bounds (p : Site 2) (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (p 0 : ℝ) ≤ (unitSegment p i t).1 ∧
    (unitSegment p i t).1 ≤ (p 0 : ℝ) + (unit i 0 : ℝ) ∧
    (p 1 : ℝ) ≤ (unitSegment p i t).2 ∧
    (unitSegment p i t).2 ≤ (p 1 : ℝ) + (unit i 1 : ℝ) := by
  have h0 := unit_coord_nonneg i 0
  have h1 := unit_coord_nonneg i 1
  dsimp [unitSegment]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht.1 h0]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2 h0]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht.1 h1]
  · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2 h1]

theorem unitSegment_intersection_shared (p q : Site 2) (i j : Fin 2) (s t : ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (h : unitSegment p i s = unitSegment q j t) :
    p = q ∨ p = q + unit j ∨ p + unit i = q ∨ p + unit i = q + unit j := by
  obtain ⟨hp0,hp1,hp2,hp3⟩ := unitSegment_bounds p i s hs
  obtain ⟨hq0,hq1,hq2,hq3⟩ := unitSegment_bounds q j t ht
  rw [h] at hp0 hp1 hp2 hp3
  apply integer_rectangle_shared p q i j
  · exact_mod_cast hp0.trans hq1
  · exact_mod_cast hq0.trans hp1
  · exact_mod_cast hp2.trans hq3
  · exact_mod_cast hq2.trans hp3

theorem sitePoint_mem_unitSegment (p q : Site 2) (j : Fin 2) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (h : sitePoint p = unitSegment q j t) :
    p = q ∨ p = q + unit j := by
  obtain ⟨h0,h1,h2,h3⟩ := unitSegment_bounds q j t ht
  rw [← h] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  dsimp [sitePoint] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  apply integer_rectangle_vertex p q j
  · exact_mod_cast h0
  · exact_mod_cast h1
  · exact_mod_cast h2
  · exact_mod_cast h3

/-- The literal union of D vertices and all original positive unit copies with endpoints in D. -/
def latticeTrace (D : Set (Site 2)) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (sitePoint '' D) ∪ {z | ∃ p i, p ∈ D ∧ p + unit i ∈ D ∧
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, unitSegment p i t = z}

theorem latticeTrace_disjoint {D A : Set (Site 2)} (hDA : Disjoint D A) :
    Disjoint (latticeTrace D) (latticeTrace A) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzD hzA
  rcases hzD with ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨p,i,hp,hpi,s,hs,hps⟩
  · rcases hzA with ⟨q,hq,hqp⟩ | ⟨q,j,hq,hqj,t,ht,hqt⟩
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hp (sitePoint_injective hqp ▸ hq)
    · rcases sitePoint_mem_unitSegment p q j t ht hqt.symm with h | h
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hp (h.symm ▸ hq)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hp (h.symm ▸ hqj)
  · rcases hzA with ⟨q,hq,hqz⟩ | ⟨q,j,hq,hqj,t,ht,hqt⟩
    · rcases sitePoint_mem_unitSegment q p i s hs (hqz.trans hps.symm) with h | h
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hp (h ▸ hq)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hpi (h ▸ hq)
    · rcases unitSegment_intersection_shared p q i j s t hs ht (hps.trans hqt.symm) with h | h | h | h
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hp (h.symm ▸ hq)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hp (h.symm ▸ hqj)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hpi (h.symm ▸ hq)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDA hpi (h.symm ▸ hqj)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeCell

import FiniteAvalanches.Model.FiniteWired
import FiniteAvalanches.External.DiskAlternation
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeCell
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical

/-- Counterclockwise physical corners: southwest, southeast, northeast, northwest. -/
def corner (o : Site 2) (i : Fin 4) : Site 2 :=
  o + if i = 0 then 0 else if i = 1 then unit 0 else if i = 2 then unit 0 + unit 1 else unit 1

def NearWithin (D : Set (Site 2)) (o x y : Site 2) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ (lattice 2).Adj x y ∨
    ∃ w, w ∈ D ∧ (∃ k, w = corner o k) ∧ (lattice 2).Adj x w ∧ (lattice 2).Adj w y

/-- Literal alternating membership of the four translated lattice corners. -/
def Alternating (D : Set (Site 2)) (o : Site 2) : Prop :=
  (corner o 0 ∈ D ∧ corner o 2 ∈ D ∧ corner o 1 ∉ D ∧ corner o 3 ∉ D) ∨
  (corner o 1 ∈ D ∧ corner o 3 ∈ D ∧ corner o 0 ∉ D ∧ corner o 2 ∉ D)

theorem adjacent01 (o : Site 2) : (lattice 2).Adj (corner o 0) (corner o 1) := by
  change ∃ i : Fin 2, corner o 1 = corner o 0 + unit i ∨ corner o 0 = corner o 1 + unit i
  exact ⟨0,Or.inl (by simp [corner])⟩
theorem adjacent12 (o : Site 2) : (lattice 2).Adj (corner o 1) (corner o 2) := by
  change ∃ i : Fin 2, corner o 2 = corner o 1 + unit i ∨ corner o 1 = corner o 2 + unit i
  exact ⟨1,Or.inl (by simp [corner,add_assoc])⟩
theorem adjacent23 (o : Site 2) : (lattice 2).Adj (corner o 2) (corner o 3) := by
  change ∃ i : Fin 2, corner o 3 = corner o 2 + unit i ∨ corner o 2 = corner o 3 + unit i
  exact ⟨0,Or.inr (by simp [corner]; abel)⟩
theorem adjacent30 (o : Site 2) : (lattice 2).Adj (corner o 3) (corner o 0) := by
  change ∃ i : Fin 2, corner o 0 = corner o 3 + unit i ∨ corner o 3 = corner o 0 + unit i
  exact ⟨1,Or.inr (by simp [corner])⟩

theorem diagonal02 (D : Set (Site 2)) (o : Site 2)
    (h1 : corner o 1 ∈ D ∨ corner o 3 ∈ D) : NearWithin D o (corner o 0) (corner o 2) := by
  rcases h1 with h1 | h3
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨corner o 1,h1,⟨1,rfl⟩,adjacent01 o,adjacent12 o⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨corner o 3,h3,⟨3,rfl⟩,(adjacent30 o).symm,(adjacent23 o).symm⟩)

theorem diagonal13 (D : Set (Site 2)) (o : Site 2)
    (h0 : corner o 0 ∈ D ∨ corner o 2 ∈ D) : NearWithin D o (corner o 1) (corner o 3) := by
  rcases h0 with h0 | h2
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨corner o 0,h0,⟨0,rfl⟩,(adjacent01 o).symm,(adjacent30 o).symm⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨corner o 2,h2,⟨2,rfl⟩,adjacent12 o,adjacent23 o⟩)

theorem NearWithin.symm {D : Set (Site 2)} {o x y : Site 2} (h : NearWithin D o x y) :
    NearWithin D o y x := by
  rcases h with h | h | ⟨w,hw,hc,hx,hy⟩
  · exact Or.inl h.symm
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨w,hw,hc,hy.symm,hx.symm⟩)

/-- Exhaustive actual corner geometry: the sole failure of a two-step route is alternating color. -/
theorem near_or_alternating (D : Set (Site 2)) (o : Site 2) (i j : Fin 4)
    (hi : corner o i ∈ D) (hj : corner o j ∈ D) :
    NearWithin D o (corner o i) (corner o j) ∨ Alternating D o := by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals try first
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inl rfl)
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent01 o)))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent12 o)))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent23 o)))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent30 o)))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent01 o).symm))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent12 o).symm))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent23 o).symm))
    | solve | exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl (adjacent30 o).symm))
  · by_cases h1 : corner o 1 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal02 D o (Or.inl h1))
    by_cases h3 : corner o 3 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal02 D o (Or.inr h3))
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hi,hj,h1,h3⟩)
  · by_cases h0 : corner o 0 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal13 D o (Or.inl h0))
    by_cases h2 : corner o 2 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal13 D o (Or.inr h2))
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hi,hj,h0,h2⟩)
  · by_cases h1 : corner o 1 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal02 D o (Or.inl h1)).symm
    by_cases h3 : corner o 3 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal02 D o (Or.inr h3)).symm
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hj,hi,h1,h3⟩)
  · by_cases h0 : corner o 0 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal13 D o (Or.inl h0)).symm
    by_cases h2 : corner o 2 ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl (diagonal13 D o (Or.inr h2)).symm
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hj,hi,h0,h2⟩)

/-- Genuine literal induced connectedness supplies a finite walk on exactly D. -/
theorem induced_reaches (D : Set (Site 2))
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce D).Connected) (x y : Site 2) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun u v => u ∈ D ∧ v ∈ D ∧ (lattice 2).Adj u v) x y := by
  have h := (SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen (⟨x,hx⟩ : D) (⟨y,hy⟩ : D)).mp
    (hD ⟨x,hx⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩)
  have lift {u v : D} (hr : Relation.ReflTransGen ((lattice 2).induce D).Adj u v) :
      Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => a ∈ D ∧ b ∈ D ∧ (lattice 2).Adj a b) u.val v.val := by
    induction hr with
    | refl => exact .refl
    | @tail u v _ huv ih => exact ih.tail ⟨u.property,v.property,huv⟩
  exact lift h

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeCell

import LatticeProb.Site

/-!
Finite wired square boxes, with individual exit edge copies and forbidden-subset
recurrence. The counting law below is on the literal allowed-height subtype;
its identification with Markov recurrence is a separate literature result.
-/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

open LatticeProb MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open scoped Classical

noncomputable section

abbrev Active (N : ℕ) := Fin 2 → Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)

def site {N : ℕ} (x : Active N) : Site 2 := fun i => (x i).val

theorem site_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (@site N) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun h i)

def inBox (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) : Prop := ∀ i, -(N : ℤ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ N

def activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) : Active N :=
  fun i => ⟨x i, h i⟩

theorem site_activeOfSite (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) (h : inBox N x) :
    site (activeOfSite N x h) = x := rfl

theorem inBox_iff (N : ℕ) (x : Site 2) :
    inBox N x ↔ x ∈ box 2 N := by
  simp only [inBox, box, Set.mem_setOf_eq, abs_le]

abbrev Direction := Fin 2 × Bool

def step (d : Direction) : Site 2 := if d.2 then unit d.1 else -unit d.1

theorem step_injective : Function.Injective step := by
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨j, c⟩ h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals norm_num [step, unit, funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two] at h
  all_goals rfl

abbrev InteriorEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Active N // ∃ i : Fin 2, site p.2 = site p.1 + unit i}

abbrev ExitEdge (N : ℕ) :=
  {p : Active N × Direction // ¬inBox N (site p.1 + step p.2)}

/-- Each internal edge occurs in its positive-coordinate orientation once.
An exit copy remembers both its active endpoint and its outward direction. -/
abbrev Edge (N : ℕ) := InteriorEdge N ⊕ ExitEdge N

abbrev Vertex (N : ℕ) := Option (Active N)

def endpoints {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) : Vertex N × Vertex N :=
  match e with
  | .inl e => (some e.val.1, some e.val.2)
  | .inr e => (some e.val.1, none)

def conductance {N : ℕ} (_e : Edge N) : ℝ := 1

theorem endpoints_ne {N : ℕ} (e : Edge N) :
    (endpoints e).1 ≠ (endpoints e).2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl e =>
    intro h
    have he : e.val.1 = e.val.2 := Option.some.inj h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.property
    have hh := congrFun hi i
    rw [he] at hh
    simp [unit, site] at hh
  | inr e => simp [endpoints]

abbrev Heights (N : ℕ) := Active N → Fin 4

def internalDegree {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) : ℕ :=
  (nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site).card

theorem mem_neighbors_iff (x y : Site 2) :
    y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ (lattice 2).Adj x y := by
  change y ∈ nbrFinset x ↔ ∃ i : Fin 2, y = x + unit i ∨ x = y + unit i
  simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by rw [hi]; abel)⟩

theorem internalDegree_eq_adj_card {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (x : Active N) :
    internalDegree s x = (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).card := by
  classical
  have he : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site =
      (s.filter (fun y => (lattice 2).Adj (site x) (site y))).image site := by
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, mem_neighbors_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hz, ha⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ha, z, hz, rfl⟩
  rw [internalDegree, he, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (site_injective N)]

def forbidden {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) (s : Finset (Active N)) : Prop :=
  s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, (η x).val < internalDegree s x

def recurrent {N : ℕ} (η : Heights N) : Prop := ∀ s, ¬forbidden η s

def allThree (N : ℕ) : Heights N := fun _ => 3

private theorem card_neighbors (x : Site 2) : (nbrFinset x).card = 4 := by
  classical
  rw [nbrFinset, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 2, ({x + unit i, x - unit i} : Finset (Site 2)).card = 2 := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_singleton]
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
      intro h
      have hi := congrFun h i
      simp only [unit, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] at hi
      omega
    simp [hc]
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro a (rfl | rfl) (h | h) <;>
      have h1 := congrFun h i <;>
      have h2 := congrFun h j <;>
      simp [unit, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_of_ne, hij] at h1 h2

theorem exists_boundary_vertex {N : ℕ} (s : Finset (Active N)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, internalDegree s x ≤ 3 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun x => site x 0) hs
  have hout : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∉ s.image site := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hle := hmax y hy
    have he0 := congrFun he 0
    simp [unit] at he0
    omega
  have hsub : nbrFinset (site x) ∩ s.image site ⊂ nbrFinset (site x) := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨Finset.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
    intro he
    have hm : site x + unit (0 : Fin 2) ∈ nbrFinset (site x) := by
      simp only [nbrFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    rw [← he] at hm
    exact hout (Finset.mem_inter.mp hm).2
  have hc := Finset.card_lt_card hsub
  rw [card_neighbors] at hc
  exact ⟨x, hx, by dsimp [internalDegree]; omega⟩

theorem allThree_recurrent (N : ℕ) : recurrent (allThree N) := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdeg⟩ := exists_boundary_vertex s hs.1
  have hlt := hs.2 x hx
  change 3 < internalDegree s x at hlt
  omega

abbrev Recurrent (N : ℕ) := {η : Heights N // recurrent η}

instance recurrentNonempty (N : ℕ) : Nonempty (Recurrent N) :=
  ⟨⟨allThree N, allThree_recurrent N⟩⟩

instance recurrentFintype (N : ℕ) : Fintype (Recurrent N) := Fintype.ofFinite _

instance recurrentMeasurableSpace (N : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Recurrent N) := ⊤

instance recurrentMeasurableSingletonClass (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (Recurrent N) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Normalized counting measure on all stable fields with no forbidden subset. -/
def law (N : ℕ) : Measure (Recurrent N) :=
  (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

theorem law_singleton (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) :
    law N {η} = (Fintype.card (Recurrent N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  simp [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

instance lawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (law N) := by
  constructor
  simp only [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]
  simp [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem law_apply (N : ℕ) (s : Set (Recurrent N)) :
    law N s = s.encard / Fintype.card (Recurrent N) := by
  rw [law, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_apply s.toFinite.measurableSet]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

/-- Auxiliary zero extension of a finite input field, not an infinite-volume law. -/
def zeroExtend (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) : Site 2 → Fin 4 :=
  fun x => if h : inBox N x then η.val (activeOfSite N x h) else 0

theorem zeroExtend_site (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Active N) :
    zeroExtend N η (site x) = η.val x := by
  have h : inBox N (site x) := fun i => (x i).property
  rw [zeroExtend, dif_pos h]
  congr 1

theorem zeroExtend_outside (N : ℕ) (η : Recurrent N) (x : Site 2)
    (h : ¬inBox N x) : zeroExtend N η x = 0 := by
  simp only [zeroExtend, dif_neg h]

theorem zeroExtend_measurable (N : ℕ) : Measurable (zeroExtend N) :=
  measurable_of_countable _

/-- Push-forward of the finite recurrent counting law by the specified zero extension. -/
def finiteFieldLaw (N : ℕ) : Measure (Site 2 → Fin 4) :=
  Measure.map (zeroExtend N) (law N)

instance finiteFieldLawProbability (N : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteFieldLaw N) :=
  Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (zeroExtend_measurable N).aemeasurable




end

end FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired

/-! Audited classical disk-alternation input.
This derived standard result is registered against Thomassen1992 Lemma2.1 and Lemma2.13,
with an independent derivation covering arbitrary compact connected continua.
The registered input is pure topology. It supplies no graph-to-disk construction,
boundary-angle extraction, or manuscript electrical estimate. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

/-- Classical crosscut corollary of Thomassen1992 Lemma2.1(p118) and Lemma2.13(pp122–123).
Compact connected sets, without a path-connected assumption, are reduced to disjoint
polygonal crosscuts by inward scaling, connected open neighborhoods, radial extension
and finite polygonal loop pruning. Lemma2.13 excludes alternating crosscut endpoints.
No graph, path law, rotation, Euler, response or paper estimate occurs in this input. -/
axiom disk_alternation_impossible (θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ θ₄ : ℝ)
    (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (h₂₃ : θ₂ < θ₃) (h₃₄ : θ₃ < θ₄)
    (h₄₁ : θ₄ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)
    (K L : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : IsConnected K)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hLc : IsConnected L) (hKd : K ⊆ disk) (hLd : L ⊆ disk)
    (hKL : Disjoint K L)
    (h₁ : (Real.cos θ₁, Real.sin θ₁) ∈ K) (h₃ : (Real.cos θ₃, Real.sin θ₃) ∈ K)
    (h₂ : (Real.cos θ₂, Real.sin θ₂) ∈ L) (h₄ : (Real.cos θ₄, Real.sin θ₄) ∈ L) : False

end FiniteAvalanches.External

/-! Literal copied edges of a finite lattice domain with two contracted terminals.
The free incidence order uses the physical clockwise lattice directions. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice

open LatticeProb
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired (Direction step)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- Positive-coordinate orientation gives each physical lattice edge one ID. -/
abbrev OriginalCopy := Site 2 × Fin 2

def originalA (e : OriginalCopy) : Site 2 := e.1
def originalB (e : OriginalCopy) : Site 2 := e.1 + unit e.2

/-- The original edge ID incident to x in a specified physical direction. -/
def incidentID (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) : OriginalCopy :=
  (if d.2 then x else x - unit d.1, d.1)

def originalDart (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) : Dart OriginalCopy :=
  (incidentID x d, !d.2)

@[simp] theorem originalDart_tail (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) :
    tail originalA originalB (originalDart x d) = x := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [originalDart, incidentID, tail, originalA, originalB]

@[simp] theorem originalDart_head (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) :
    head originalA originalB (originalDart x d) = x + step d := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [originalDart, incidentID, head, reverse, tail,
    originalA, originalB, step, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- All original copies incident to D; there is no voltage-dependent deletion. -/
def domainCopies (D : Finset (Site 2)) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (D ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset Direction)).image (fun xd => incidentID xd.1 xd.2)

theorem mem_domainCopies (D : Finset (Site 2)) (e : OriginalCopy) :
    e ∈ domainCopies D ↔ originalA e ∈ D ∨ originalB e ∈ D := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨x,⟨i,b⟩⟩,hx,he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have hD := (Finset.mem_product.mp hx).1
    cases b
    · right
      rw [← he]
      simpa [incidentID, originalB] using hD
    · left
      rw [← he]
      simpa [incidentID, originalA] using hD
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      exact ⟨(originalA e,(e.2,true)), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h,Finset.mem_univ _⟩,
        by rcases e with ⟨x,i⟩; rfl⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨(originalB e,(e.2,false)), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h,Finset.mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      rcases e with ⟨x,i⟩
      simp [incidentID, originalB]

abbrev OneSet (D : Finset (Site 2)) := {P : Finset D // P.Nonempty}

variable (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)

/-- Zero and one are distinct terminals; the other vertices are exactly D minus P. -/
abbrev Vertex := Bool ⊕ {x : D // x ∉ P.val}

def alpha : Vertex D P := .inl false
def beta : Vertex D P := .inl true

def project (x : Site 2) : Vertex D P :=
  if hx : x ∈ D then
    if hp : (⟨x,hx⟩ : D) ∈ P.val then .inl true else .inr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hp⟩
  else .inl false

@[simp] theorem project_free (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    project D P x.val.val = .inr x := by
  simp [project, x.val.property, x.property]

theorem project_eq_free_iff (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (y : Site 2) :
    project D P y = .inr x ↔ y = x.val.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold project at h
    split at h
    · split at h
      · cases h
      · exact congrArg (fun z : {x : D // x ∉ P.val} => z.val.val) (Sum.inr.inj h)
    · cases h
  · rintro rfl
    exact project_free D P x

theorem project_eq_alpha_iff (x : Site 2) :
    project D P x = alpha D P ↔ x ∉ D := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D
  · simp only [project,dif_pos hx,alpha]
    split <;> simp [hx]
  · simp [project,hx,alpha]

theorem project_eq_beta_iff (x : Site 2) :
    project D P x = beta D P ↔ x ∈ P.val.image Subtype.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold project at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hx
      split at h
      · rename_i hp
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hp,rfl⟩
      · cases h
    · cases h
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    simp [project,y.property,hy,beta]

/-- The distinguished copy really joins the zero set to the one set. -/
abbrev MarkedCopy := {e : OriginalCopy //
  (project D P (originalA e) = alpha D P ∧ project D P (originalB e) = beta D P) ∨
  (project D P (originalA e) = beta D P ∧ project D P (originalB e) = alpha D P)}

/-- Delete exactly the distinguished ID and the copies whose endpoints become equal. -/
def retainedCopies (marked : MarkedCopy D P) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (domainCopies D).filter (fun e =>
    project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e) ∧ e ≠ marked.val)

abbrev Copy (marked : MarkedCopy D P) := ↥(retainedCopies D P marked)

def copyA (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : Copy D P marked) : Vertex D P :=
  project D P (originalA e.val)

def copyB (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : Copy D P marked) : Vertex D P :=
  project D P (originalB e.val)

theorem mem_retainedCopies (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy) :
    e ∈ retainedCopies D P marked ↔
    (originalA e ∈ D ∨ originalB e ∈ D) ∧
      project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e) ∧ e ≠ marked.val := by
  simp only [retainedCopies, Finset.mem_filter, mem_domainCopies]

theorem copy_loopless (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : Copy D P marked) :
    copyA D P marked e ≠ copyB D P marked e :=
  (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).2.1

/-- The physical clockwise order is east, south, west, north. -/
def clockwise (d : Direction) : Direction :=
  if d.1 = 0 then (1, !d.2) else (0,d.2)

def counterclockwise (d : Direction) : Direction :=
  if d.1 = 0 then (1,d.2) else (0,!d.2)

def clockwisePerm : Equiv.Perm Direction where
  toFun := clockwise
  invFun := counterclockwise
  left_inv d := by rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩; fin_cases i <;> cases b <;> rfl
  right_inv d := by rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩; fin_cases i <;> cases b <;> rfl

theorem original_endpoints_ne (e : OriginalCopy) : originalA e ≠ originalB e := by
  intro h
  have hi := congrFun h e.2
  simp [originalA, originalB, unit] at hi

theorem free_incident_survives (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (he : originalA e = x.val.val ∨ originalB e = x.val.val) :
    project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e) ∧ e ≠ marked.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases he with he | he
    · rw [he, project_free] at h
      have hb := (project_eq_free_iff D P x _).mp h.symm
      exact original_endpoints_ne e (he.trans hb.symm)
    · rw [he, project_free] at h
      have ha := (project_eq_free_iff D P x _).mp h
      exact original_endpoints_ne e (ha.trans he.symm)
  · intro h
    subst e
    rcases marked.property with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨ha,hb⟩
    all_goals rcases he with he | he
    · rw [he, project_free] at ha; cases ha
    · rw [he, project_free] at hb; cases hb
    · rw [he, project_free] at ha; cases ha
    · rw [he, project_free] at hb; cases hb

theorem incidentID_retained (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    incidentID x.val.val d ∈ retainedCopies D P marked := by
  have he : originalA (incidentID x.val.val d) = x.val.val ∨
      originalB (incidentID x.val.val d) = x.val.val := by
    rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
    cases b
    · right; simp [incidentID,originalB]
    · left; rfl
  apply (mem_retainedCopies D P marked _).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, free_incident_survives D P marked x _ he⟩
  rcases he with he | he
  · left; rw [he]; exact x.val.property
  · right; rw [he]; exact x.val.property

/-- The actual copied outgoing dart at a free site; its original ID is preserved. -/
def freeDart (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    Dart (Copy D P marked) :=
  (⟨incidentID x.val.val d, incidentID_retained D P marked x d⟩, !d.2)

@[simp] theorem freeDart_original (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    ((freeDart D P marked x d).1.val, (freeDart D P marked x d).2) =
      originalDart x.val.val d := rfl

theorem copy_tail_project (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (d : Dart (Copy D P marked)) :
    tail (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) d =
      project D P (tail originalA originalB (d.1.val,d.2)) := by
  rcases d with ⟨e,b⟩
  cases b <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem freeDart_tail (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    tail (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d) = .inr x := by
  rw [copy_tail_project, freeDart_original, originalDart_tail, project_free]

@[simp] theorem freeDart_head (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    head (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d) =
      project D P (x.val.val + step d) := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [freeDart, head, reverse, tail, copyA, copyB,
    incidentID,originalA,originalB,step,sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem originalDart_injective (x : Site 2) : Function.Injective (originalDart x) := by
  intro d d' h
  have hi := congrArg (fun z : Dart OriginalCopy => (z.1.2,!z.2)) h
  simpa [originalDart, incidentID] using hi

theorem originalDart_reconstruct (d : Dart OriginalCopy) :
    originalDart (tail originalA originalB d) (d.1.2,!d.2) = d := by
  rcases d with ⟨⟨x,i⟩,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [originalDart, incidentID, tail, originalA,originalB]

/-- Physical clockwise successor on the full lattice's original copied darts. -/
def latticeNext (d : Dart OriginalCopy) : Dart OriginalCopy :=
  originalDart (tail originalA originalB d) (clockwise (d.1.2,!d.2))

@[simp] theorem latticeNext_originalDart (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) :
    latticeNext (originalDart x d) = originalDart x (clockwise d) := by
  unfold latticeNext
  rw [originalDart_tail]
  simp only [originalDart,incidentID,Bool.not_not]

/-- The full four-direction incidence equivalence, including parallel neighbor images. -/
def freeIncidenceEquiv (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    Direction ≃ Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun d => ⟨freeDart D P marked x d, freeDart_tail D P marked x d⟩) (by
    constructor
    · intro d d' h
      apply originalDart_injective x.val.val
      exact congrArg (fun z : Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) =>
        (z.val.1.val,z.val.2)) h
    · intro d
      have ht : tail originalA originalB (d.val.1.val,d.val.2) = x.val.val := by
        apply (project_eq_free_iff D P x _).mp
        rw [← copy_tail_project]
        exact d.property
      refine ⟨(d.val.1.val.2,!d.val.2), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext
        have hh := congrArg Prod.fst (originalDart_reconstruct (d.val.1.val,d.val.2))
        rw [ht] at hh
        exact hh
      · simp [freeDart])

/-- Clockwise successor on the exact post-contraction free incidence fiber. -/
def freeClockwise (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    Equiv.Perm (Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x)) :=
  ((freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).symm.trans clockwisePerm).trans
    (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x)

theorem freeClockwise_original (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) (d : Direction) :
    (freeClockwise D P marked x (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x d)).val =
      freeDart D P marked x (clockwise d) := by
  simp only [freeClockwise,Equiv.trans_apply,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

/-- Contraction and deletion retain the literal physical successor at every free vertex. -/
theorem freeClockwise_transport (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (d : Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x)) :
    ((freeClockwise D P marked x d).val.1.val,(freeClockwise D P marked x d).val.2) =
      latticeNext (d.val.1.val,d.val.2) := by
  obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).surjective d
  rw [freeClockwise_original]
  change originalDart x.val.val (clockwise c) = latticeNext (originalDart x.val.val c)
  exact (latticeNext_originalDart x.val.val c).symm

theorem free_incidenceCount (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    incidenceCount (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) = 4 := by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Vertex D P) := Classical.decEq _
  unfold incidenceCount
  have h := Fintype.card_congr (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x)
  simpa [Direction] using h.symm

/-- The source degree bound counts each original edge copy once. -/
theorem free_degree (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val}) :
    Geometry.degree (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x) = 4 := by
  rw [← incidenceCount_eq_degree, free_incidenceCount]
  norm_num

theorem source_free_degree_bound (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : Vertex D P)
    (ha : x ≠ alpha D P) (hb : x ≠ beta D P) :
    Geometry.degree (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) x ≤ 4 := by
  cases x with
  | inl b => cases b
             · exact (ha rfl).elim
             · exact (hb rfl).elim
  | inr x => exact (free_degree D P marked x).le

theorem clockwise_reaches (d d' : Direction) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n < 4 ∧ (clockwisePerm ^ n) d = d' := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  rcases d' with ⟨j,c⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> cases b <;> cases c
  all_goals first
    | exact ⟨0, by decide, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨1, by decide, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨2, by decide, rfl⟩
    | exact ⟨3, by decide, rfl⟩

theorem freeClockwise_pow (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (n : ℕ) (d : Direction) :
    (freeClockwise D P marked x ^ n) (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x d) =
      freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x ((clockwisePerm ^ n) d) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ih]
    simp [freeClockwise, Equiv.trans_apply]

/-- Every surviving free incidence lies on this one physical clockwise cycle. -/
theorem freeClockwise_cyclic (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (d d' : Incidences (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (.inr x)) :
    (freeClockwise D P marked x).SameCycle d d' := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).surjective d
  obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).surjective d'
  obtain ⟨n,_,hn⟩ := clockwise_reaches a b
  have h := freeClockwise_pow D P marked x n a
  rw [hn] at h
  rw [← h]
  simpa only [Equiv.Perm.sameCycle_pow_right] using
    Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.refl (freeClockwise D P marked x) (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x a)

/-- Coincident contracted neighbors cannot identify distinct physical copied darts. -/
theorem parallel_free_copies (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (x : {x : D // x ∉ P.val})
    (d d' : Direction) (hne : d ≠ d')
    (hh : project D P (x.val.val + step d) = project D P (x.val.val + step d')) :
    freeDart D P marked x d ≠ freeDart D P marked x d' ∧
      head (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d) =
        head (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) (freeDart D P marked x d') := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hne
    apply (freeIncidenceEquiv D P marked x).injective
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · simpa only [freeDart_head] using hh

theorem root_copy_retained (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (e : OriginalCopy)
    (hd : originalA e ∈ D ∨ originalB e ∈ D) (hne : e ≠ marked.val)
    (ha : project D P (originalA e) = alpha D P)
    (hb : project D P (originalB e) = beta D P) :
    e ∈ retainedCopies D P marked := by
  apply (mem_retainedCopies D P marked e).mpr
  refine ⟨hd, ?_, hne⟩
  rw [ha,hb]
  intro h
  cases h

namespace SquareConsumer

def xy (x y : ℤ) : Site 2 := fun i => if i = 0 then x else y

def domain : Finset (Site 2) := {xy 0 0, xy 0 1, xy 1 0, xy 1 1}

/-- The two vertices in the left column are the one terminal. -/
def one : OneSet domain :=
  ⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun x => x.val 0 = 0), by
    refine ⟨⟨xy 0 0,by simp [domain]⟩,?_⟩
    simp [xy]⟩

def lower : {x : domain // x ∉ one.val} :=
  ⟨⟨xy 1 0, by simp [domain]⟩,by simp [one,xy]⟩

def upper : {x : domain // x ∉ one.val} :=
  ⟨⟨xy 1 1, by simp [domain]⟩,by simp [one,xy]⟩

/-- The single deleted copy goes from (0,-1) to (0,0). -/
def marked : MarkedCopy domain one :=
  ⟨(xy 0 (-1),1),by
    left
    constructor
    · simp [project,alpha,domain,originalA,xy,funext_iff,Fin.forall_fin_two]
    · have he : originalB (xy 0 (-1),1) = xy 0 0 := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> norm_num [originalB,xy,unit]
      rw [he]
      unfold project
      rw [dif_pos (by simp [domain])]
      rw [dif_pos (by simp only [one,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]; rfl)]
      rfl⟩

/-- Two different original copies reach the same zero terminal after contraction. -/
theorem east_south_parallel :
    (freeDart domain one marked lower (0,true)).1 ≠
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,false)).1 ∧
    head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (0,true)) = alpha domain one ∧
    head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,false)) = alpha domain one := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun e : Copy domain one marked => e.val.2) h
    norm_num [freeDart,incidentID] at he
  · constructor <;>
      simp [freeDart_head,project,lower,alpha,domain,one,xy,step,unit,
        funext_iff,Fin.forall_fin_two] <;> rfl

def potential (x : Vertex domain one) : ℝ :=
  match x with
  | .inl false => 0
  | .inl true => 1
  | .inr _ => 1/3

/-- The vertical free-to-free copy survives, even when its current is zero. -/
theorem zero_current_copy :
    head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,true)) = .inr upper ∧
    current (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked) potential
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,true)) = 0 := by
  have h : head (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked)
      (freeDart domain one marked lower (1,true)) = .inr upper := by
    rw [freeDart_head]
    have he : lower.val.val + step (1,true) = upper.val.val := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> norm_num [lower,upper,xy,step,unit]
    rw [he,project_free]
  refine ⟨h,?_⟩
  simp [current,freeDart_tail,h,potential]

theorem four_copied_incidents :
    incidenceCount (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked) (.inr lower) = 4 ∧
      Geometry.degree (copyA domain one marked) (copyB domain one marked) (.inr lower) = 4 :=
  ⟨free_incidenceCount domain one marked lower,free_degree domain one marked lower⟩

end SquareConsumer

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice.StatementTypes
open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical BigOperators
noncomputable section

/-- The actual copied source multigraph, with its proved looplessness. -/
def graph (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    Trees.Multigraph (Vertex D P) (Copy D P marked) :=
  ⟨copyA D P marked,copyB D P marked,copy_loopless D P marked⟩

-- Literal uniform averages over the actual rooted-forest sample carrier.
-- No theorem, axiom, measure replacement or second-moment premise is installed.
#check (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
  (_hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
  (_hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
  (_hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
  (marked : MarkedCopy D P) (phi : Vertex D P → ℝ)
  (_hp0 : phi (alpha D P) = 0) (_hp1 : phi (beta D P) = 1)
  (_hh : ∀ x, x ≠ alpha D P → x ≠ beta D P →
    laplacian (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked) phi x = 0),
  let a := copyA D P marked
  let b := copyB D P marked
  let G := graph D P marked
  let F := G.RootedForest ({alpha D P,beta D P} : Set (Vertex D P))
  let Y : F → ℝ := fun f => ∑ z : Dart (Copy D P marked),
    if tail a b z = alpha D P ∧ G.reaches f.val (head a b z) (beta D P) then 1 else 0
  let mean := (∑ f : F, Y f) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ)
  let variance := (∑ f : F, (Y f - mean)^2) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ)
  let M := energy a b phi
  let m := ((domainCopies D).filter fun e =>
    (originalA e ∈ D ∧ originalB e ∉ D) ∨
    (originalB e ∈ D ∧ originalA e ∉ D)).card - 1
  mean = M ∧ variance ≤ C * M * (1 + Real.log ((m : ℝ) * min 1 M / M)) : Prop)

#print axioms graph
end

/-! Deterministic component-color comparison for actual rooted copied forests.
The edge inclusions are local coupling inputs, not distributional conclusions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- An actual copied forest: acyclic individual copies and exactly one prescribed
root in every component, including isolated vertices. -/
def is_rooted_forest (R : Set V) (F : Finset E) : Prop :=
  G.is_forest F ∧ ∀ x, ∃ r ∈ R, G.reaches F x r ∧
    ∀ r' ∈ R, G.reaches F x r' → r' = r

abbrev RootedForest (R : Set V) := {F : Finset E // G.is_rooted_forest R F}

/-- Vertices connected by selected copies to `C`. On a rooted forest whose
roots contain `C`, these are precisely the vertices of roots labeled one. -/
def oneVertices (F : Finset E) (C : Set V) : Set V :=
  {v | ∃ r ∈ C, G.reaches F v r}

/-- The shared one roots and literal copied-edge inclusion suffice for this
deterministic step; no stochastic domination is assumed or concluded. -/
theorem oneVertices_subset_of_edges_subset (A A' C : Set V)
    (F : G.RootedForest (A ∪ C)) (F' : G.RootedForest (A' ∪ C)) (hF : F'.val ⊆ F.val) :
    G.oneVertices F'.val C ⊆ G.oneVertices F.val C := by
  rintro v ⟨r, hr, hvr⟩
  exact ⟨r, hr, G.reaches_mono hF hvr⟩

/-- Removing one roots reverses the copied-edge inclusion. The original zero
root in an old zero component stays a root of its containing new component. -/
theorem oneVertices_subset_of_one_roots_removed (A C C' : Set V) (hAC : Disjoint A C)
    (hC : C' ⊆ C) (F : G.RootedForest (A ∪ C)) (F' : G.RootedForest (A ∪ C'))
    (hF : F.val ⊆ F'.val) : G.oneVertices F'.val C' ⊆ G.oneVertices F.val C := by
  rintro v ⟨c, hc, hvc⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hvr, _⟩ := F.property.2 v
  rcases hr with hr | hr
  · obtain ⟨a, _, _, hu⟩ := F'.property.2 v
    have hra : r = a := hu r (Or.inl hr) (G.reaches_mono hF hvr)
    have hca : c = a := hu c (Or.inr hc) hvc
    have hrc : r = c := hra.trans hca.symm
    have hrC : r ∈ C := by rw [hrc]; exact hC hc
    exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hAC hr hrC)
  · exact ⟨r, hr, hvr⟩

theorem rootedForest_univ_empty (F : G.RootedForest Set.univ) : F.val = ∅ := by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨r, _, _, hu⟩ := F.property.2 (G.left e)
  have hl : G.left e = r := hu _ (Set.mem_univ _) Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  have hr : G.right e = r := hu _ (Set.mem_univ _)
    (Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  exact G.loopless e (hl.trans hr.symm)

/-- Parallel copies remain different: the two-copy circuit violates the actual
acyclicity predicate even though its underlying support graph has one edge. -/
theorem parallel_pair_not_rooted_forest (R : Set V) (e f : E) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (hl : G.left e = G.left f) (hr : G.right e = G.right f) :
    ¬G.is_rooted_forest R ({e, f} : Finset E) := by
  intro h
  apply h.1 e (by simp)
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨f, by simp [hef.symm], Or.inl ⟨hl.symm, hr.symm⟩⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

@[expose] public section

/-!
Internal elementary infrastructure for copied-edge joining. Edges are elements of a finite
carrier, not endpoint pairs. A forest is an edge subset in which deleting any edge separates
its endpoints (the ordinary undirected forest criterion, including parallel-edge cycles).
No sandpile, burning, ancestor, or probability conclusion is assumed here.
-/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees

structure Multigraph (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V
  loopless : ∀ e, left e ≠ right e

/-- Adapter for a literal finite edge-copy carrier with ordered endpoint pairs. -/
def Multigraph.ofEndpoints {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (ends : E → V × V) (hne : ∀ e, (ends e).1 ≠ (ends e).2) : Multigraph V E :=
  ⟨fun e => (ends e).1, fun e => (ends e).2, hne⟩

open scoped Classical

namespace Multigraph

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Undirected adjacency with the individual witnessing edge copy retained. -/
def adjacent (s : Finset E) (x y : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ s, (G.left e = x ∧ G.right e = y) ∨ (G.right e = x ∧ G.left e = y)

/-- Actual finite-walk reachability, including the walk of length zero. -/
def reaches (s : Finset E) : V → V → Prop := Relation.ReflTransGen (G.adjacent s)

/-- All edges of the subset have both endpoints in the indicated support. -/
def supported (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C

/-- A forest has no edge whose endpoints remain connected after its deletion. -/
def is_forest (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ s, ¬G.reaches (s.erase e) (G.left e) (G.right e)

/-- A tree on exactly the nonempty vertex support C; isolated singleton trees are included. -/
def is_tree (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Prop :=
  C.Nonempty ∧ G.supported C s ∧
    (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches s x y) ∧ G.is_forest s

/-- The unique tree on a singleton support has no edges. -/
theorem is_tree_singleton_empty (a : V) : G.is_tree {a} ∅ := by
  refine ⟨⟨a, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [supported]
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
    subst x; subst y
    exact .refl
  · simp [is_forest]

theorem eq_empty_of_is_tree_singleton {a : V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : G.is_tree {a} s) : s = ∅ := by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro e he
  have h := hs.2.1 e he
  apply G.loopless e
  exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h.1).trans (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h.2).symm

/-- A crossing edge copy, in either orientation. -/
def crosses (C : Set V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  (G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.left e ∉ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem adjacent_symm {s : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.adjacent s x y) :
    G.adjacent s y x := by
  rcases h with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inr ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_symm {s : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.reaches s x y) :
    G.reaches s y x := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ h ih => exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (G.adjacent_symm h)).trans ih

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : G.reaches t x y := by
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ h => ?_) _ _ h
  rcases h with ⟨e, he, h⟩
  exact ⟨e, hst he, h⟩

theorem is_forest_mono {s t : Finset E} (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : G.is_forest t) :
    G.is_forest s := by
  intro e he h
  apply ht e (hst he)
  exact G.reaches_mono (by intro f hf; simpa using
    (show f ≠ e ∧ f ∈ t from ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1, hst (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2⟩)) h

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_mem_iff {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : x ∈ C ↔ y ∈ C := by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ h ih =>
    rcases h with ⟨e, he, h | h⟩
    · exact ih.trans (by simpa [← h.1, ← h.2] using hs e he)
    · exact ih.trans (by simpa [← h.1, ← h.2] using (hs e he).symm)

/-- The two internal edge subsets contain no crossing copies. -/
theorem supported_union_same_side {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) :
    ∀ e ∈ s ∪ t, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C := by
  intro e he
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp he with he | he
  · exact iff_of_true (hs e he).1 (hs e he).2
  · exact iff_of_false (ht e he).1 (ht e he).2

theorem crosses_not_mem {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) {e : E} (he : G.crosses C e) :
    e ∉ s ∪ t := by
  intro h
  have hside := G.supported_union_same_side hs ht e h
  rcases he with h | h
  · exact h.2 (hside.mp h.1)
  · exact h.1 (hside.mpr h.2)

/-- Collapse the opposite component to the endpoint of the joining edge. -/
noncomputable def retract (C : Set V) (a : V) (x : V) : V := if x ∈ C then x else a

theorem reaches_retract {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e f : E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ C) (hr : G.right e ∉ C) {x y : V}
    (h : G.reaches ((insert e (s ∪ t)).erase f) x y) :
    G.reaches (s.erase f) (retract C (G.left e) x) (retract C (G.left e) y) := by
  classical
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (retract C (G.left e)) (fun _ _ h => ?_) _ _ h
  rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hxy⟩
  have haf := (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).1
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).2 with rfl | ha
  · rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
    · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
      simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hl, if_neg hr]
      exact .refl
    · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
      simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hl, if_neg hr]
      exact .refl
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp ha with ha | ha
    · have hc := hs a ha
      rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hc.1, if_pos hc.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨haf, ha⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_pos hc.1, if_pos hc.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
          ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨haf, ha⟩, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · have hc := ht a ha
      rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_neg hc.1, if_neg hc.2]
        exact .refl
      · rw [← hxy.1, ← hxy.2]
        simp only [Function.onFun, retract, if_neg hc.1, if_neg hc.2]
        exact .refl

/-- Joining two component trees with a crossing copy gives an ordinary spanning tree. -/
theorem is_tree_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ C) (hr : G.right e ∉ C) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (insert e (s ∪ t)) := by
  classical
  have he := G.crosses_not_mem hs.2.1 ht.2.1 (Or.inl ⟨hl, hr⟩)
  have hcross : G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) (G.left e) (G.right e) :=
    Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  have hleft (x : V) (hx : x ∈ C) :
      G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) x (G.left e) :=
    G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (hs.2.2.1 x hx _ hl)
  have hright (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C) :
      G.reaches (insert e (s ∪ t)) (G.right e) x :=
    G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (ht.2.2.1 _ hr x hx)
  refine ⟨⟨G.left e, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (by intro a ha; simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x _ y _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ C <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ C
    · exact G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (hs.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
    · exact ((hleft x hx).trans hcross).trans (hright y hy)
    · exact G.reaches_symm (((hleft y hy).trans hcross).trans (hright x hx))
    · exact G.reaches_mono (by intro a ha; simp [ha]) (ht.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
  · intro f hf h
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hf with rfl | hf
    · have hm := G.reaches_mem_iff (G.supported_union_same_side hs.2.1 ht.2.1)
        (by simpa [Finset.erase_insert, he] using h)
      exact hr (hm.mp hl)
    · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hf with hf | hf
      · have h' := G.reaches_retract hs.2.1 ht.2.1 hl hr h
        have hc := hs.2.1 f hf
        apply hs.2.2.2 f hf
        simpa [retract, hc.1, hc.2] using h'
      · -- Reverse the chosen edge orientation and exchange the components.
        let G' : Multigraph V E := ⟨G.right, G.left, fun a => (G.loopless a).symm⟩
        have hadj (u : Finset E) : G'.adjacent u = G.adjacent u := by
          funext x y; apply propext; simp only [adjacent]; aesop
        have hreach (u : Finset E) : G'.reaches u = G.reaches u := by
          simp only [reaches, hadj]
        have hs' : G'.supported Cᶜ t := by intro a ha; exact ⟨(ht.2.1 a ha).2, (ht.2.1 a ha).1⟩
        have ht' : G'.supported (Cᶜ)ᶜ s := by
          intro a ha
          simpa [G'] using And.intro (hs.2.1 a ha).2 (hs.2.1 a ha).1
        have h' := G'.reaches_retract hs' ht' hr (by simpa using hl)
          (by simpa [hreach, Finset.union_comm] using G.reaches_symm h)
        have hc := ht.2.1 f hf
        apply ht.2.2.2 f hf
        have h'' : G.reaches (t.erase f) (G.right f) (G.left f) := by
          simpa [hreach, retract, hc.1, hc.2, G'] using h'
        exact G.reaches_symm h''

/-- Restrict an actual edge subset to the induced graph on C. -/
noncomputable def internalEdges (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) : Finset E :=
  s.filter (fun e => G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem supported_internalEdges (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) :
    G.supported C (G.internalEdges C s) := by
  intro e he
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem reaches_internalEdges {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ C)
    (h : G.reaches s x y) : G.reaches (G.internalEdges C s) x y := by
  have h' : y ∈ C ∧ G.reaches (G.internalEdges C s) x y := by
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨hx, .refl⟩
    | @tail z y _ h ih =>
      rcases h with ⟨e, he, hxy⟩
      have heC : G.left e ∈ C ∧ G.right e ∈ C := by
        rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
        · have hl : G.left e ∈ C := hxy.1 ▸ ih.1
          exact ⟨hl, (hs e he).mp hl⟩
        · have hr : G.right e ∈ C := hxy.1 ▸ ih.1
          exact ⟨(hs e he).mpr hr, hr⟩
      have hy : y ∈ C := by rcases hxy with hxy | hxy; exact hxy.2 ▸ heC.2; exact hxy.2 ▸ heC.1
      exact ⟨hy, ih.2.tail ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, heC⟩, hxy⟩⟩
  exact h'.2

theorem is_tree_internalEdges {C : Set V} {s : Finset E} (hn : C.Nonempty)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches s x y) (hf : G.is_forest s) :
    G.is_tree C (G.internalEdges C s) := by
  refine ⟨hn, G.supported_internalEdges C s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact G.reaches_internalEdges hs hx (hc x hx y hy)
  · exact G.is_forest_mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hf

theorem internalEdges_union_compl {C : Set V} {s : Finset E}
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ s, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C) :
    G.internalEdges C s ∪ G.internalEdges Cᶜ s = s := by
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h) <;> exact h.1
  · intro he
    by_cases hl : G.left e ∈ C
    · exact Or.inl ⟨he, hl, (hs e he).mp hl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨he, hl, fun hr => hl ((hs e he).mpr hr)⟩

theorem internalEdges_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) :
    G.internalEdges C (s ∪ t) = s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf | hf, hl, _⟩
    · exact hf
    · exact ((ht f hf).1 hl).elim
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨Or.inl hf, hs f hf⟩

theorem internalEdges_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.supported C s) (ht : G.supported Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.internalEdges C (insert e (s ∪ t)) = s := by
  ext f
  simp only [internalEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hl, hr⟩
    rcases hf with rfl | hf | hf
    · rcases he with he | he
      · exact (he.2 hr).elim
      · exact (he.1 hl).elim
    · exact hf
    · exact ((ht f hf).1 hl).elim
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inl hf), hs f hf⟩

/-- Deleting the marked crossing copy leaves precisely the two indicated components.
The support separation and the two connectivity clauses are literal walk conditions. -/
def cut_components (C : Set V) (s : Finset E) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ s ∧ G.crosses C e ∧
    (∀ f ∈ s.erase e, G.left f ∈ C ↔ G.right f ∈ C) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, G.reaches (s.erase e) x y) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Cᶜ, ∀ y ∈ Cᶜ, G.reaches (s.erase e) x y)

/-- Ordinary spanning trees with a marked cut whose components have supports C and Cᶜ. -/
abbrev CutTree (C : Set V) :=
  {p : Finset E × E // G.is_tree Set.univ p.1 ∧ G.cut_components C p.1 p.2}

/-- Component-tree subsets, together with an individual admissible crossing copy. -/
abbrev Joining (C : Set V) :=
  {p : Finset E × Finset E × E //
    G.is_tree C p.1 ∧ G.is_tree Cᶜ p.2.1 ∧ G.crosses C p.2.2}

theorem is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.is_tree Set.univ (insert e (s ∪ t)) := by
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact G.is_tree_insert_union hs ht he.1 he.2
  · rw [Finset.union_comm s t]
    exact G.is_tree_insert_union ht (by simpa using hs) he.1 (by simpa using he.2)

theorem cut_components_insert_union {C : Set V} {s t : Finset E} {e : E}
    (hs : G.is_tree C s) (ht : G.is_tree Cᶜ t) (he : G.crosses C e) :
    G.cut_components C (insert e (s ∪ t)) e := by
  have hnot := G.crosses_not_mem hs.2.1 ht.2.1 he
  have herase : (insert e (s ∪ t)).erase e = s ∪ t := by simp [hnot]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [herase] using G.supported_union_same_side hs.2.1 ht.2.1
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [herase]
    exact G.reaches_mono Finset.subset_union_left (hs.2.2.1 x hx y hy)
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [herase]
    exact G.reaches_mono Finset.subset_union_right (ht.2.2.1 x hx y hy)

/-- Literal insertion of the marked edge copy, with connectivity and acyclicity proved. -/
def join (C : Set V) (p : G.Joining C) : G.CutTree C :=
  ⟨(insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1), p.val.2.2),
    G.is_tree_insert_union_of_crosses p.property.1 p.property.2.1 p.property.2.2,
    G.cut_components_insert_union p.property.1 p.property.2.1 p.property.2.2⟩

/-- Delete the marked copy and recover the two induced component edge subsets. -/
noncomputable def split (C : Set V) (p : G.CutTree C) : G.Joining C := by
  let s := p.val.1.erase p.val.2
  have hs : G.is_forest s := G.is_forest_mono (Finset.erase_subset _ _) p.property.1.2.2.2
  have hside := p.property.2.2.2.1
  have hcross := p.property.2.2.1
  have hC : C.Nonempty := by
    rcases hcross with h | h
    · exact ⟨G.left p.val.2, h.1⟩
    · exact ⟨G.right p.val.2, h.2⟩
  have hD : Cᶜ.Nonempty := by
    rcases hcross with h | h
    · exact ⟨G.right p.val.2, h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨G.left p.val.2, h.1⟩
  exact ⟨(G.internalEdges C s, G.internalEdges Cᶜ s, p.val.2),
    G.is_tree_internalEdges hC hside p.property.2.2.2.2.1 hs,
    G.is_tree_internalEdges hD (fun e he => not_congr (hside e he))
      p.property.2.2.2.2.2 hs, hcross⟩

theorem split_join (C : Set V) (p : G.Joining C) : G.split C (G.join C p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := G.crosses_not_mem p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1 p.property.2.2
  change (G.internalEdges C ((insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2),
    G.internalEdges Cᶜ ((insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2), p.val.2.2) = p.val
  have herase : (insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)).erase p.val.2.2 =
      p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1 := by simp [he]
  have hC := G.internalEdges_union p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1
  have hD : G.internalEdges Cᶜ (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1) = p.val.2.1 := by
    rw [Finset.union_comm]
    exact G.internalEdges_union p.property.2.1.2.1 (by simpa using p.property.1.2.1)
  simp only [herase, hC, hD]

theorem join_split (C : Set V) (p : G.CutTree C) : G.join C (G.split C p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (insert p.val.2 (G.internalEdges C (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) ∪
    G.internalEdges Cᶜ (p.val.1.erase p.val.2)), p.val.2) = p.val
  rw [G.internalEdges_union_compl p.property.2.2.2.1,
    Finset.insert_erase p.property.2.1]

/-- A proved copied-edge joining equivalence, not a supplied tree-bijection hypothesis. -/
noncomputable def joiningEquiv (C : Set V) : G.Joining C ≃ G.CutTree C where
  toFun := G.join C
  invFun := G.split C
  left_inv := G.split_join C
  right_inv := G.join_split C

/-- Forgetting the mark is injective for a prescribed cut support C. -/
theorem cutTree_edges_injective (C : Set V) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : G.CutTree C => p.val.1) := by
  intro p q hpq
  change p.val.1 = q.val.1 at hpq
  have he : p.val.2 = q.val.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : q.val.2 ∈ p.val.1.erase p.val.2 :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, (by rw [hpq]; exact q.property.2.1)⟩
    have hside := p.property.2.2.2.1 _ hmem
    rcases q.property.2.2.1 with h | h
    · exact h.2 (hside.mp h.1)
    · exact h.1 (hside.mpr h.2)
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext hpq he

/-- A spanning-tree subset of the induced component graph, including singleton trees. -/
abbrev ComponentTree (C : Set V) := {s : Finset E // G.is_tree C s}

/-- The C endpoint of a crossing edge is in the specified joining set K. -/
def admissible (C K : Set V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  (G.left e ∈ C ∩ K ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e ∈ C ∩ K ∧ G.left e ∉ C)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem admissible_iff_of_subset {C K : Set V} (hK : K ⊆ C) (e : E) :
    G.admissible C K e ↔
      (G.left e ∈ K ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e ∈ K ∧ G.left e ∉ C) := by
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hK h.1, h.1⟩, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hK h.1, h.1⟩, h.2⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem admissible_implies_crosses {C K : Set V} {e : E}
    (he : G.admissible C K e) : G.crosses C e := by
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact Or.inl ⟨he.1.1, he.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he.2, he.1.1⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem crosses_of_admissible {C K : Set V} (hK : K ⊆ C) {e : E}
    (he : G.admissible C K e) : G.crosses C e := by
  rcases (G.admissible_iff_of_subset hK e).mp he with he | he
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hK he.1, he.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he.2, hK he.1⟩

abbrev FixedJoining (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {p : G.Joining C // p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2.2}

/-- Completed ordinary spanning trees with the prescribed inside restriction and a
cut-edge endpoint in K. The mark is unique by cutTree_edges_injective. -/
abbrev FixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) :=
  {p : G.CutTree C // G.internalEdges C p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2}

noncomputable def fixedJoiningEquiv (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ × {e : E // G.admissible C K e}) ≃ G.FixedJoining C K t where
  toFun p := ⟨⟨(t.val, p.1.val, p.2.val), t.property, p.1.property,
    G.crosses_of_admissible hK p.2.property⟩, rfl, p.2.property⟩
  invFun p := (⟨p.val.val.2.1, p.val.property.2.1⟩, ⟨p.val.val.2.2, p.property.2⟩)
  left_inv p := by rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext p.property.1.symm rfl

noncomputable def fixedCutEquiv (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ × {e : E // G.admissible C K e}) ≃ G.FixedCutTree C K t :=
  (G.fixedJoiningEquiv C K t hK).trans
    ((G.joiningEquiv C).subtypeEquiv fun p => by
      have hi := G.internalEdges_insert_union p.property.1.2.1 p.property.2.1.2.1
        p.property.2.2
      change (p.val.1 = t.val ∧ G.admissible C K p.val.2.2) ↔
        (G.internalEdges C (insert p.val.2.2 (p.val.1 ∪ p.val.2.1)) = t.val ∧
          G.admissible C K p.val.2.2)
      rw [hi])

section Finite

/-- All admissible copies, explicitly enumerated in the edge carrier. -/
noncomputable def admissibleEdges (C K : Set V) : Finset E :=
  Finset.univ.filter (G.admissible C K)

/-- All individual copies joining v to the opposite side of C. -/
noncomputable def crossingAt (C : Set V) (v : V) : Finset E :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun e =>
    v ∈ C ∧ ((G.left e = v ∧ G.right e ∉ C) ∨ (G.right e = v ∧ G.left e ∉ C))

theorem admissibleEdges_eq_biUnion (C K : Set V) :
    G.admissibleEdges C K = K.toFinset.biUnion (G.crossingAt C) := by
  ext e
  simp only [admissibleEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_biUnion, Set.mem_toFinset, crossingAt, admissible, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨G.left e, h.1.2, h.1.1, Or.inl ⟨rfl, h.2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨G.right e, h.1.2, h.1.1, Or.inr ⟨rfl, h.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvC, h | h⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨h.1 ▸ hvC, h.1 ▸ hv⟩, h.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h.1 ▸ hvC, h.1 ▸ hv⟩, h.2⟩

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem admissible_empty (K : Set V) (e : E) :
    ¬G.admissible ∅ K e := by simp [admissible]

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem crossingAt_eq_empty_of_not_mem {C : Set V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ C) :
    G.crossingAt C v = ∅ := by simp [crossingAt, hv]

omit [DecidableEq E] in
@[simp] theorem crossingAt_empty (v : V) : G.crossingAt ∅ v = ∅ := by
  simp [crossingAt]

/-- The literal edge-copy fiber size is the sum of opposite-side degrees over K. -/
theorem card_admissibleEdges (C K : Set V) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    (G.admissibleEdges C K).card = ∑ v ∈ K.toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card := by
  classical
  rw [G.admissibleEdges_eq_biUnion]
  apply Finset.card_biUnion
  intro v hv w hw hvw
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro e hev hew
  have hvC := hK (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hv)
  have hwC := hK (Set.mem_toFinset.mp hw)
  have hve := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hev).2.2
  have hwe := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hew).2.2
  rcases hve with hve | hve <;> rcases hwe with hwe | hwe
  · exact hvw (hve.1.symm.trans hwe.1)
  · exact hwe.2 (hve.1 ▸ hvC)
  · exact hve.2 (hwe.1 ▸ hwC)
  · exact hvw (hve.1.symm.trans hwe.1)

/-- Exactly ell ordinary completions for each fixed pair of component trees. -/
theorem card_fixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C) :
    Fintype.card (G.FixedCutTree C K t) =
      Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) * (G.admissibleEdges C K).card := by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (G.fixedCutEquiv C K t hK), Fintype.card_prod]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.subtype_card _ (by intro e; simp)

/-- Reciprocal joining cancellation at fixed C and inside tree, retaining common mass c.
There are no completions when ell=0, so that branch contributes zero. -/
theorem reciprocal_fixedCutTree (C K : Set V) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hK : K ⊆ C)
    (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ _q : G.FixedCutTree C K t, c / (G.admissibleEdges C K).card) =
      if (G.admissibleEdges C K).Nonempty then c * Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, G.card_fixedCutTree C K t hK,
    Nat.cast_mul]
  by_cases h : (G.admissibleEdges C K).Nonempty
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hc : ((G.admissibleEdges C K).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr h
    field_simp
  · have hc : (G.admissibleEdges C K).card = 0 := Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
      (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h)
    simp [h, hc]

end Finite
