variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Actual connected copied graphs have an actual forest for every nonempty root set. -/
theorem nonempty_rootedForest (R : Set V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) : Nonempty (G.RootedForest R) := by
  let roots : Roots (V := V) := ⟨R, hR⟩
  have hquot := FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient.graph_connected G roots hconn
  haveI : Nonempty ((graph G roots).SpanningTree) :=
    (graph G roots).nonempty_spanning_tree hquot
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty ((graph G roots).SpanningTree))
  exact ⟨⟨liftCopies G roots t.val, rooted_forest_of_tree G roots t.property⟩⟩

/-- Uniform mass on original copied subsets, using the original rooted-forest count. -/
def uniformRootedForestMass (R : Set V) (_hR : R.Nonempty)
    (_hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (F : Finset E) : ℝ :=
  if G.is_rooted_forest R F then (Nat.card (G.RootedForest R) : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0

theorem uniformRootedForestMass_nonneg (R : Set V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (F : Finset E) :
    0 ≤ G.uniformRootedForestMass R hR hconn F := by
  unfold uniformRootedForestMass
  split_ifs <;> positivity

/-- The literal mass formula equals the sum of the actual uniform forest atoms over an edge event. -/
theorem sum_uniformRootedForestMass_event (R : Set V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (ev : Set (Finset E)) :
    ∑ F : Finset E, Set.indicator ev (G.uniformRootedForestMass R hR hconn) F =
      (Nat.card {F : G.RootedForest R // F.val ∈ ev} : ℝ) /
        Nat.card (G.RootedForest R) := by
  classical
  simp only [Set.indicator, uniformRootedForestMass]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.filter_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  congr 1
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have he : {F : G.RootedForest R // F.val ∈ ev} ≃
      {F : Finset E // F ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun F => F ∈ ev ∧ G.is_rooted_forest R F)} :=
    { toFun := fun F => ⟨F.val.val, by simp [F.val.property, F.property]⟩
      invFun := fun F => ⟨⟨F.val, (Finset.mem_filter.mp F.property).2.2⟩,
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp F.property).2.1⟩
      left_inv := fun F => rfl
      right_inv := fun F => rfl }
  rw [Fintype.card_congr he, Fintype.card_coe]

/-- The original normalizer is positive, not an assumed sampler-existence condition. -/
theorem rootedForest_count_pos (R : Set V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    0 < Nat.card (G.RootedForest R) := by
  haveI := G.nonempty_rootedForest R hR hconn
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Fintype.card_pos

theorem sum_uniformRootedForestMass (R : Set V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    ∑ F : Finset E, G.uniformRootedForestMass R hR hconn F = 1 := by
  have h := G.sum_uniformRootedForestMass_event R hR hconn Set.univ
  simp only [Set.indicator_univ] at h
  have he : {F : G.RootedForest R // F.val ∈ (Set.univ : Set (Finset E))} ≃
      G.RootedForest R := Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv (fun F => Set.mem_univ F.val)
  rw [Nat.card_congr he] at h
  rw [h, div_self]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (G.rootedForest_count_pos R hR hconn)

/-- Source connectivity supplies the support-graph premise used by the actual projection. -/
theorem supportGraph_preconnected_of_reaches
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected := by
  intro x y
  induction hconn x y with
  | refl => exact .rfl
  | @tail u v _ hadj ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, _, h | h⟩ := hadj
    · exact ih.trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ⟨by
        intro huv; exact G.loopless e (h.1.trans (huv.trans h.2.symm)), e, Or.inl h⟩)
    · exact ih.trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ⟨by
        intro huv; exact G.loopless e (h.2.trans (huv.symm.trans h.1.symm)), e, Or.inr h⟩)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Trees

/-! Actual rooted copied forests are bijective with trees after simultaneous nonempty root contraction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

theorem rooted_forest_lift_iff_tree (t : Finset (Copy G R)) :
    G.is_rooted_forest R.val (liftCopies G R t) ↔ (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ t := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [project_lift_copies] using tree_of_rooted_forest G R h
  · exact rooted_forest_of_tree G R

/-- For unrestricted original subsets the inverse equation also records absence of deleted root-root copies. -/
theorem rooted_forest_iff_tree_and_lift_project (F : Finset E) :
    G.is_rooted_forest R.val F ↔
      (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ (projectCopies G R F) ∧
        liftCopies G R (projectCopies G R F) = F := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨tree_of_rooted_forest G R h, lift_project_forest G R h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, he⟩
    rw [← he]
    exact rooted_forest_of_tree G R ht

/-- A copied rooted forest retains its original subset; only the quotient endpoints change. -/
def rootContractionEquiv : G.RootedForest R.val ≃ (graph G R).ComponentTree Set.univ where
  toFun F := ⟨projectCopies G R F.val, tree_of_rooted_forest G R F.property⟩
  invFun t := ⟨liftCopies G R t.val, rooted_forest_of_tree G R t.property⟩
  left_inv F := Subtype.ext (lift_project_forest G R F.property)
  right_inv t := Subtype.ext (project_lift_copies G R t.val)

@[simp] theorem rootContractionEquiv_copies (F : G.RootedForest R.val) :
    (rootContractionEquiv G R F).val = projectCopies G R F.val := rfl

@[simp] theorem rootContractionEquiv_symm_copies (t : (graph G R).ComponentTree Set.univ) :
    ((rootContractionEquiv G R).symm t).val = liftCopies G R t.val := rfl

/-- Original root labels, including mixed colors, are recovered on the original vertex carrier. -/
theorem oneVertices_lift_project (F : G.RootedForest R.val) (C : Set V) :
    G.oneVertices (liftCopies G R (rootContractionEquiv G R F).val) C =
      G.oneVertices F.val C := by
  rw [rootContractionEquiv_copies, lift_project_forest G R F.property]

theorem all_roots_empty_forest (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : G.is_rooted_forest R.val ∅ := by
  rw [hR]
  refine ⟨by simp [Multigraph.is_forest], ?_⟩
  intro x
  refine ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, .refl, ?_⟩
  intro y _ h
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ he _ => obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := he; simp at he

theorem all_roots_tree_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ ∅ := by
  simpa [projectCopies, all_roots_copy_empty G R hR] using
    tree_of_rooted_forest G R (all_roots_empty_forest G R hR)

theorem all_roots_forests_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) (F : G.RootedForest R.val) : F.val = ∅ := by
  exact G.rootedForest_univ_empty ⟨F.val, hR ▸ F.property⟩

theorem all_roots_trees_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) (t : (graph G R).ComponentTree Set.univ) :
    t.val = ∅ := by
  letI := all_roots_copy_empty G R hR
  exact Finset.eq_empty_of_isEmpty t.val

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Forests

/-! Lifting a copied quotient tree gives one prescribed original root per component. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

theorem root_cover_of_reaches (t : Finset (Copy G R)) {x : V}
    (h : (graph G R).reaches t (project R x) none) :
    ∃ r ∈ R.val, G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) x r := by
  have hall (z : Vertex R) (hz : (graph G R).reaches t none z) :
      ∀ v, project R v = z → ∃ r ∈ R.val, G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) v r := by
    induction hz with
    | refl =>
      intro v hv
      exact ⟨v, (project_eq_none R v).mp hv, .refl⟩
    | @tail a b _ he ih =>
      intro v hv
      by_cases hr : v ∈ R.val
      · exact ⟨v, hr, .refl⟩
      obtain ⟨e, he, h | h⟩ := he
      · have hva : v = G.right e.val :=
          ((project_eq_iff R v _).mp (hv.trans h.2.symm)).resolve_right (fun hh => hr hh.1)
        subst v
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := ih _ h.1
        have hstep : G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) (G.right e.val) (G.left e.val) :=
          .single ⟨e.val, (mem_liftCopies G R t e).mpr he, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, hstep.trans hp⟩
      · have hva : v = G.left e.val :=
          ((project_eq_iff R v _).mp (hv.trans h.2.symm)).resolve_right (fun hh => hr hh.1)
        subst v
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := ih _ h.1
        have hstep : G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) (G.left e.val) (G.right e.val) :=
          .single ⟨e.val, (mem_liftCopies G R t e).mpr he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, hstep.trans hp⟩
  exact hall _ ((graph G R).reaches_symm h) x rfl

theorem forest_of_quotient_forest {t : Finset (Copy G R)} (ht : (graph G R).is_forest t) :
    G.is_forest (liftCopies G R t) := by
  intro e he halt
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
  apply ht f hf
  exact (graph G R).reaches_mono (project_erase_lift_subset G R t f)
    (reaches_project_copies G R halt)

/-- Distinct prescribed roots cannot become connected when lifting a quotient forest. -/
theorem roots_eq_of_reaches {t : Finset (Copy G R)} (ht : (graph G R).is_forest t)
    {r s : V} (hr : r ∈ R.val) (hs : s ∈ R.val)
    (h : G.reaches (liftCopies G R t) r s) : r = s := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := (G.toSimple_reachable _ r s).mpr h
  have hp := p.toPath.property
  generalize hq : p.toPath.val = q at hp
  cases q with
  | nil => rfl
  | @cons r z s hadj q =>
    have hnot : r ∉ q.support := (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons_isPath_iff hadj q).mp hp |>.2
    obtain ⟨e, he, h | h⟩ := hadj
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
      have heincident : G.left e = r ∨ G.right e = r := by
        first | exact Or.inl h.1 | exact Or.inr h.1
      have htail := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem heincident q hnot
      have hproject := (graph G R).reaches_mono (project_erase_lift_subset G R t f)
        (by simpa only [hfe] using reaches_project_copies G R htail)
      apply False.elim
      apply ht f hf
      have hrp := (project_eq_none R r).mpr hr
      have hsp := (project_eq_none R s).mpr hs
      first
      | exact (graph G R).reaches_symm (by
          simpa only [graph, hfe, h.1, h.2, hrp, hsp] using hproject)
      | exact (by simpa only [graph, hfe, h.1, h.2, hrp, hsp] using hproject)

theorem rooted_forest_of_tree {t : Finset (Copy G R)} (ht : (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ t) :
    G.is_rooted_forest R.val (liftCopies G R t) := by
  refine ⟨forest_of_quotient_forest G R ht.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := root_cover_of_reaches G R t
    (ht.2.2.1 _ (Set.mem_univ _) none (Set.mem_univ _))
  refine ⟨r, hr, hxr, ?_⟩
  intro s hs hxs
  exact roots_eq_of_reaches G R ht.2.2.2 hs hr ((G.reaches_symm hxs).trans hxr)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.RootContraction.Subsets

/-! Simultaneous contraction sends an actual rooted copied forest to a copied tree. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

/-- The unique prescribed original root of the actual component. -/
def componentRoot {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (v : V) : V :=
  (hF.2 v).choose

theorem componentRoot_spec {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (v : V) :
    componentRoot G R hF v ∈ R.val ∧ G.reaches F v (componentRoot G R hF v) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ R.val, G.reaches F v r → r = componentRoot G R hF v := (hF.2 v).choose_spec

theorem componentRoot_eq_of_reachable {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F)
    {a b : V} (hab : G.reaches F a b) : componentRoot G R hF a = componentRoot G R hF b := by
  obtain ⟨hr, hb, _⟩ := componentRoot_spec G R hF b
  exact ((componentRoot_spec G R hF a).2.2 _ hr (hab.trans hb)).symm

theorem componentRoot_of_mem {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F)
    {r : V} (hr : r ∈ R.val) : componentRoot G R hF r = r :=
  ((componentRoot_spec G R hF r).2.2 r hr .refl).symm

/-- Retract the quotient to one original component; other components collapse to its root. -/
def componentRetract {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (r : V) : Vertex R → V
  | none => r
  | some v => if componentRoot G R hF v.val = r then v.val else r

theorem componentRetract_project {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) (r v : V) :
    componentRetract G R hF r (project R v) =
      if componentRoot G R hF v = r then v else r := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ R.val
  · simp only [project, dif_pos hv, componentRetract, componentRoot_of_mem G R hF hv]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp_all
  · simp [project, hv, componentRetract]

theorem tree_of_rooted_forest {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) :
    (graph G R).is_tree Set.univ (projectCopies G R F) := by
  have hc (v : Vertex R) : (graph G R).reaches (projectCopies G R F) v none := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := project_surjective R v
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hx, _⟩ := hF.2 x
    have h := reaches_project_copies G R hx
    simpa only [(project_eq_none R r).mpr hr] using h
  refine ⟨⟨none, Set.mem_univ _⟩, (by intro e he; simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x _ y _
    exact (hc x).trans ((graph G R).reaches_symm (hc y))
  · intro e he halt
    let a := G.left e.val
    let b := G.right e.val
    let r := componentRoot G R hF a
    have heF : e.val ∈ F := (mem_projectCopies G R F e).mp he
    have hab : G.reaches F a b := .single ⟨e.val, heF, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    have hba : componentRoot G R hF b = r := (componentRoot_eq_of_reachable G R hF hab).symm
    have hlift : G.reaches (F.erase e.val)
        (componentRetract G R hF r ((graph G R).left e))
        (componentRetract G R hF r ((graph G R).right e)) := by
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (componentRetract G R hF r) (fun u v hf => ?_) _ _ halt
      obtain ⟨f, hf, h | h⟩ := hf
      all_goals
        have hfe : f.val ≠ e.val := fun hval => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1 (Subtype.ext hval)
        have hfF : f.val ∈ F := (mem_projectCopies G R F f).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2
        have hfab : G.reaches F (G.left f.val) (G.right f.val) :=
          .single ⟨f.val, hfF, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        have hroots := componentRoot_eq_of_reachable G R hF hfab
        change project R _ = u ∧ project R _ = v at h
        change G.reaches (F.erase e.val) (componentRetract G R hF r u) (componentRetract G R hF r v)
        rw [← h.1, ← h.2, componentRetract_project, componentRetract_project]
        by_cases hl : componentRoot G R hF (G.left f.val) = r
        · have hr := hroots.symm.trans hl
          simp only [hl, hr, ↓reduceIte]
          exact .single ⟨f.val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfe, hfF⟩, by
            first | exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        · have hr : componentRoot G R hF (G.right f.val) ≠ r := fun hh => hl (hroots.trans hh)
          simp only [hl, hr, ↓reduceIte]
          exact .refl
    apply hF.1 e.val heF
    simpa [graph, componentRetract_project, a, b, r, hba] using hlift

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.NonemptyQuotient
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Ancestors

/-! Literal copied-edge subset projection and lifting through a nonempty root quotient. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)
  (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

/-- Select the surviving original copies in a prescribed family. -/
def projectCopies (F : Finset E) : Finset (Copy G R) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun e => e.val ∈ F)

/-- Lift copies by their individual original identities. -/
def liftCopies (t : Finset (Copy G R)) : Finset E := t.image Subtype.val

@[simp] theorem mem_projectCopies (F : Finset E) (e : Copy G R) :
    e ∈ projectCopies G R F ↔ e.val ∈ F := by simp [projectCopies]

@[simp] theorem mem_liftCopies (t : Finset (Copy G R)) (e : Copy G R) :
    e.val ∈ liftCopies G R t ↔ e ∈ t := by
  simp [liftCopies, Subtype.coe_injective.eq_iff]

@[simp] theorem project_lift_copies (t : Finset (Copy G R)) :
    projectCopies G R (liftCopies G R t) = t := by ext e; simp

theorem forest_copy_survives {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ F) : project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := (contracted_loop_iff G R e).mp h
  obtain ⟨r, _, _, hu⟩ := hF.2 (G.left e)
  have ha : G.left e = r := hu _ hl .refl
  have hb : G.right e = r := hu _ hr (.single ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  exact G.loopless e (ha.trans hb.symm)

theorem lift_project_forest {F : Finset E} (hF : G.is_rooted_forest R.val F) :
    liftCopies G R (projectCopies G R F) = F := by
  ext e
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    exact (mem_projectCopies G R F f).mp hf
  · intro he
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨e, forest_copy_survives G R hF e he⟩, by simpa using he, rfl⟩

theorem reaches_project_copies {F : Finset E} {x y : V} (h : G.reaches F x y) :
    (graph G R).reaches (projectCopies G R F) (project R x) (project R y) := by
  apply Relation.ReflTransGen.lift' (project R) (fun u v he => ?_) _ _ h
  obtain ⟨e, he, h | h⟩ := he
  all_goals
    by_cases hs : project R (G.left e) = project R (G.right e)
    · have huv : project R u = project R v := by
        first
        | exact (congrArg (project R) h.1).symm.trans (hs.trans (congrArg (project R) h.2))
        | exact (congrArg (project R) h.1).symm.trans (hs.symm.trans (congrArg (project R) h.2))
      change (graph G R).reaches _ (project R u) (project R v)
      rw [huv]; exact .refl
    · exact .single ⟨⟨e, hs⟩, (mem_projectCopies G R F _).mpr he, by
        first
        | exact Or.inl ⟨congrArg (project R) h.1, congrArg (project R) h.2⟩
        | exact Or.inr ⟨congrArg (project R) h.1, congrArg (project R) h.2⟩⟩

theorem project_erase_lift_subset (t : Finset (Copy G R)) (e : Copy G R) :
    projectCopies G R ((liftCopies G R t).erase e.val) ⊆ t.erase e := by
  intro f hf
  have hm := (mem_projectCopies G R _ f).mp hf
  exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hm).1 (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    (mem_liftCopies G R t f).mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hm).2⟩

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedWalk

/-! Literal contraction of nonempty root sets on a copied multigraph. This
implementation imports no unrestricted empty-root quotient. Copies retain E IDs;
only copies whose endpoints become equal are removed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

abbrev Vertex (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) := Option {v : V // v ∉ R.val}

def project (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v : V) : Vertex R :=
  if h : v ∈ R.val then none else some ⟨v, h⟩

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem project_eq_none (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v : V) :
    project R v = none ↔ v ∈ R.val := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ R.val <;> simp [project, hv]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem project_eq_iff (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v w : V) :
    project R v = project R w ↔ v = w ∨ (v ∈ R.val ∧ w ∈ R.val) := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ R.val <;> by_cases hw : w ∈ R.val
  · simp [project, hv, hw]
  · simp [project, hv, hw, show v ≠ w from fun h => hw (h ▸ hv)]
  · simp [project, hv, hw, show v ≠ w from fun h => hv (h.symm ▸ hw)]
  · simp [project, hv, hw, Subtype.ext_iff]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem project_surjective (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) : Function.Surjective (project R) := by
  intro v
  cases v with
  | none => obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := R.property; exact ⟨r, (project_eq_none R r).mpr hr⟩
  | some v => exact ⟨v.val, by simp [project, v.property]⟩

def rootSetoid (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) : Setoid V := Setoid.ker (project R)

/-- A genuine equivalence quotient, with surjectivity proved before forming the equivalence. -/
def quotientEquiv (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) : Quotient (rootSetoid R) ≃ Vertex R :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (Quotient.lift (project R) (fun _ _ h => h)) (by
    constructor
    · intro a b h
      induction a using Quotient.inductionOn
      induction b using Quotient.inductionOn
      exact Quotient.sound h
    · intro v
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := project_surjective R v
      exact ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩)

omit [Fintype V] in
@[simp] theorem quotientEquiv_mk (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V)) (v : V) :
    quotientEquiv R (Quotient.mk _ v) = project R v := rfl

variable (G : Multigraph V E) (R : CopiedNetwork.Roots (V := V))

abbrev Copy := {e : E // project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e)}

instance vertexFintype : Fintype (Vertex R) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Option {v : V // v ∉ R.val}))
instance copyFintype : Fintype (Copy G R) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype {e : E // project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e)})

def copyID : Copy G R ↪ E := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.coe_injective⟩

def graph : Multigraph (Vertex R) (Copy G R) :=
  ⟨fun e => project R (G.left e.val), fun e => project R (G.right e.val), fun e => e.property⟩

theorem contracted_loop_iff (e : E) :
    project R (G.left e) = project R (G.right e) ↔ G.left e ∈ R.val ∧ G.right e ∈ R.val := by
  rw [project_eq_iff]
  simp only [G.loopless e, false_or]

theorem nonroot_incident_survives (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) (e : Incident G v) :
    project R (G.left e.val) ≠ project R (G.right e.val) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := (contracted_loop_iff G R e.val).mp h
  rcases e.property with he | he
  · exact hv (he ▸ hl)
  · exact hv (he ▸ hr)

def projectIncident (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) (e : Incident G v) :
    Incident (graph G R) (project R v) :=
  ⟨⟨e.val, nonroot_incident_survives G R v hv e⟩, by
    rcases e.property with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (congrArg (project R) h)
    · exact Or.inr (congrArg (project R) h)⟩

theorem projectIncident_bijective (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) :
    Function.Bijective (projectIncident G R v hv) := by
  constructor
  · intro e f h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun a => a.val.val) h)
  · intro e
    have hl : G.left e.val.val = v ∨ G.right e.val.val = v := by
      rcases e.property with h | h
      · rcases (project_eq_iff R _ v).mp h with he | he
        · exact Or.inl he
        · exact False.elim (hv he.2)
      · rcases (project_eq_iff R _ v).mp h with he | he
        · exact Or.inr he
        · exact False.elim (hv he.2)
    refine ⟨⟨e.val.val, hl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

/-- The incident-copy bijection exists before its bundled equivalence is formed. -/
def nonrootIncidentEquiv (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) :
    Incident G v ≃ Incident (graph G R) (project R v) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (projectIncident G R v hv) (projectIncident_bijective G R v hv)

@[simp] theorem nonrootIncidentEquiv_copy (v : V) (hv : v ∉ R.val) (e : Incident G v) :
    (nonrootIncidentEquiv G R v hv e).val.val = e.val := rfl

theorem reaches_project {x y : V} (h : G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    (graph G R).reaches Finset.univ (project R x) (project R y) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail y z h he ih =>
    apply ih.trans
    by_cases hz : project R y = project R z
    · exact hz ▸ Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    · obtain ⟨e, _, he | he⟩ := he
      · have hs : project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e) := by rwa [he.1, he.2]
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨⟨e, hs⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Or.inl
          ⟨congrArg (project R) he.1, congrArg (project R) he.2⟩⟩
      · have hs : project R (G.left e) ≠ project R (G.right e) := by
          rw [he.1, he.2]; exact Ne.symm hz
        exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨⟨e, hs⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Or.inr
          ⟨congrArg (project R) he.1, congrArg (project R) he.2⟩⟩

theorem graph_connected (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) :
    ∀ x y, (graph G R).reaches Finset.univ x y := by
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := project_surjective R x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := project_surjective R y
  exact reaches_project G R (hconn a b)

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem all_roots_vertex_subsingleton (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : Subsingleton (Vertex R) := by
  have hall : ∀ v : V, v ∈ R.val := fun v => hR.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ v
  refine ⟨fun v w => ?_⟩
  have hz (z : Vertex R) : z = none := by
    cases z with
    | none => rfl
    | some v => exact False.elim (v.property (hall v.val))
  exact (hz v).trans (hz w).symm

theorem all_roots_copy_empty (hR : R.val = Set.univ) : IsEmpty (Copy G R) := by
  have hall : ∀ v : V, v ∈ R.val := fun v => hR.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ v
  refine ⟨fun e => e.property ?_⟩
  exact ((project_eq_none R _).mpr (hall (G.left e.val))).trans
    ((project_eq_none R _).mpr (hall (G.right e.val))).symm

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork.NonemptyQuotient

import FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.LoopErasure
import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Joining
import Mathlib.Probability.Independence.InfinitePi
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform

/-! Wilson exploration on individual copies of a finite loopless multigraph.
The walk continues by legal ordinary transitions at every vertex. Only first-hit
paths are attached, and complete paths remain separate from erased branches. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork
open Quiver MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped Classical ENNReal
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

abbrev Incident (v : V) := {e : E // G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v}
abbrev Letter := (v : V) → Incident G v
abbrev Driver := ℕ → Letter G

instance incidentFintype (v : V) : Fintype (Incident G v) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype {e : E // G.left e = v ∨ G.right e = v})
instance letterFintype : Fintype (Letter G) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype ((v : V) → Incident G v))
instance letterMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (Letter G) := ⊤
instance letterMeasurableSingletonClass : MeasurableSingletonClass (Letter G) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

def other (v : V) (e : Incident G v) : V :=
  if G.left e.val = v then G.right e.val else G.left e.val

theorem other_spec (v : V) (e : Incident G v) :
    (G.left e.val = v ∧ G.right e.val = other G v e) ∨
      (G.right e.val = v ∧ G.left e.val = other G v e) := by
  by_cases h : G.left e.val = v
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h, by simp [other, h]⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨e.property.resolve_left h, by simp [other, h]⟩

abbrev pathQuiver : Quiver (ULift.{0} V) :=
  copiedQuiver (fun e : E => (ULift.up (G.left e), ULift.up (G.right e)))
abbrev Trace (a b : V) := @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up a) (ULift.up b)

def arrow (v : V) (a : Letter G) :
    @Quiver.Hom (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) (ULift.up v) (ULift.up (other G v (a v))) :=
  ⟨(a v).val, by
    rcases other_spec G v (a v) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.1) (congrArg ULift.up h.2))
    · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext (congrArg ULift.up h.2) (congrArg ULift.up h.1))⟩

def position (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : ℕ → V
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => other G (position x ω n) (ω n (position x ω n))

def walkPath (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : (n : ℕ) → Trace G x (position G x ω n) :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun n => match n with
  | 0 => .nil
  | n + 1 => (walkPath x ω n).cons (arrow G (position G x ω n) (ω n))

def packedPath (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : Σ b : V, Trace G x b :=
  ⟨position G x ω n, walkPath G x ω n⟩

def pathCopies {a : ULift.{0} V} : {b : ULift.{0} V} → @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) a b → Finset E :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun p => match p with
  | .nil => ∅
  | .cons p e => insert e.val (pathCopies p)

def pathCopyList {a : ULift.{0} V} : {b : ULift.{0} V} → @Path (ULift.{0} V) (pathQuiver G) a b → List E :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  fun p => match p with
  | .nil => []
  | .cons p e => pathCopyList p ++ [e.val]

variable {I : Type}

abbrev Record := V × List V × List I
structure State where
  roots : Set V
  roots_nonempty : roots.Nonempty
  edges : Finset E
  history : List (Record (V := V) (I := I))

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
@[ext] theorem State.ext {s t : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)}
    (hr : s.roots = t.roots) (he : s.edges = t.edges) (hh : s.history = t.history) : s = t := by
  cases s; cases t; cases hr; cases he; cases hh; rfl

abbrev Roots := {R : Set V // R.Nonempty}

def initialState (R : Roots (V := V)) : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  ⟨R.val, R.property, ∅, []⟩

def hits (B : Set V) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : Prop := ∃ n, position G x ω n ∈ B

def attachAt (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) (n : ℕ) : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  letI := pathQuiver G
  let p := packedPath G x ω n
  { roots := s.roots ∪ {v | ULift.up v ∈ (loopErase p.2).vertices}
    roots_nonempty := s.roots_nonempty.mono Set.subset_union_left
    edges := s.edges ∪ pathCopies G (loopErase p.2)
    history := s.history ++ [(x, p.2.vertices.map ULift.down, (pathCopyList G p.2).map ι)] }

def query (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (x : V) (ω : Driver G) : Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :=
  if x ∈ s.roots then some s
  else if h : hits G s.roots x ω then some (attachAt G ι s x ω (Nat.find h)) else none

/-- Skips and repeated queries consume their own row, just as successful queries do. -/
def explore (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) :
    List V → (ℕ → Driver G) → Option (State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I))
  | [], _ => some s
  | x :: xs, ω => (query G ι s x (ω 0)).bind (fun t => explore ι t xs (fun i => ω (i + 1)))

/-- No walk alphabet or probability kernel is formed in the all-root case. -/
def allRootResult [Nonempty V] : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I) :=
  initialState ⟨Set.univ, by obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›; exact ⟨v, Set.mem_univ v⟩⟩

theorem explore_all_roots (ι : E ↪ I) (s : State (V := V) (E := E) (I := I)) (hs : s.roots = Set.univ)
    (order : List V) (ω : ℕ → Driver G) : explore G ι s order ω = some s := by
  induction order generalizing ω with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ∈ s.roots := hs ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [explore, query, if_pos hx, Option.bind_some]
    exact ih _

theorem incident_nonempty [Nontrivial V]
    (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (v : V) : Nonempty (Incident G v) := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne v
  rcases (hconn v w).cases_head with he | ⟨z, hz, _⟩
  · exact False.elim (hw he.symm)
  · obtain ⟨e, _, h | h⟩ := hz
    · exact ⟨⟨e, Or.inl h.1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨e, Or.inr h.1⟩⟩

/-- Each vertex receives an independent uniform incident-copy choice. Existence is
proved from connectedness and nontriviality before forming the uniform PMF. -/
def uniformLetterLaw [Nontrivial V] (hconn : ∀ x y, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) : Measure (Letter G) := by
  letI (v : V) : Nonempty (Incident G v) := incident_nonempty G hconn v
  exact (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Letter G)).toMeasure

/-- IID rows of IID legal letters. The letter law is explicit data; it is not a tree law. -/
def driversLaw (μ : Measure (Letter G)) : Measure (ℕ → Driver G) :=
  Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ))

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson.CopiedNetwork

import Mathlib.Combinatorics.Quiver.Path.Vertices
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Chronological loop erasure on endpoint-indexed walks. Quiver arrows are
retained, so a surviving edge keeps its original copy, even for parallel edges. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Wilson

open Quiver

variable {V : Type*} [Quiver V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Truncate at the last occurrence of a vertex. On a simple retained path
this is its unique occurrence. The output retains the original arrows. -/
def prefixTo {a : V} : {b : V} → (p : Path a b) → (v : V) → v ∈ p.vertices → Path a v
  | _, .nil, v, hv => by
      have h : v = a := by simpa using hv
      subst v
      exact .nil
  | b, .cons p e, v, hv =>
      if h : b = v then h ▸ p.cons e
      else prefixTo p v ((Quiver.Path.mem_vertices_cons p e).mp hv |>.resolve_right (Ne.symm h))

/-- Online chronological loop erasure: visit vertices in their original order,
retain new arrows, and erase the retained suffix whenever a vertex is revisited. -/
def loopErase {a : V} : {b : V} → Path a b → Path a b
  | _, .nil => .nil
  | b, .cons p e =>
      let q := loopErase p
      if h : b ∈ q.vertices then prefixTo q b h else q.cons e

theorem prefixTo_vertices_sublist {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    (prefixTo p v hv).vertices.Sublist p.vertices := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      have h : v = a := by simpa using hv
      subst v
      simp [prefixTo]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c = v
      · subst v
        simp [prefixTo]
      · simp only [prefixTo, dif_neg h]
        exact (ih _).trans (by simp [Quiver.Path.vertices_cons])

theorem prefixTo_vertices_nodup {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices)
    (hp : p.vertices.Nodup) : (prefixTo p v hv).vertices.Nodup :=
  hp.sublist (prefixTo_vertices_sublist p v hv)

theorem loopErase_vertices_sublist {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.Sublist p.vertices := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [loopErase]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c ∈ (loopErase p).vertices
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_pos h]
        exact (prefixTo_vertices_sublist _ _ h).trans
          (ih.trans (by simp [Quiver.Path.vertices_cons]))
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_neg h, Quiver.Path.vertices_cons, List.concat_eq_append]
        exact ih.append (List.Sublist.refl [c])

theorem loopErase_vertices_nodup {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : (loopErase p).vertices.Nodup := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [loopErase]
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      by_cases h : c ∈ (loopErase p).vertices
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_pos h]
        exact prefixTo_vertices_nodup _ _ h ih
      · simp only [loopErase, dif_neg h, Quiver.Path.vertices_cons]
        exact ih.concat h

theorem loopErase_eq_self {a b : V} (p : Path a b) (hp : p.vertices.Nodup) : loopErase p = p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | @cons b c p e ih =>
      have hpair : c ∉ p.vertices ∧ p.vertices.Nodup :=
        (List.nodup_concat p.vertices c).mp hp
      rw [loopErase, ih hpair.2, dif_neg hpair.1]


@[simp] theorem loopErase_head {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.head? = some a := Quiver.Path.vertices_head? _

@[simp] theorem loopErase_terminal {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    (loopErase p).vertices.getLast (Quiver.Path.vertices_ne_nil _) = b :=
  Quiver.Path.vertices_getLast _ _

theorem loopErase_length_le {a b : V} (p : Path a b) : (loopErase p).length ≤ p.length := by
  have h := (loopErase_vertices_sublist p).length_le
  simp only [Quiver.Path.vertices_length] at h
  omega

/-- The quiver of individual unoriented edge copies with their actual endpoints. -/
abbrev copiedQuiver {E : Type*} (ends : E → V × V) : Quiver V where
  Hom x y := {e : E // (ends e = (x, y)) ∨ (ends e = (y, x))}

end FiniteAvalanches.Wilson

module

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.CopiedEdges
public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths

@[expose] public section

/-! Rooted joining geometry on ordinary copied-edge spanning-tree subsets. -/
open scoped Classical
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedPaths
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- Ordinary spanning trees are actual subsets of the original edge-copy carrier. -/
abbrev SpanningTree := G.ComponentTree Set.univ

/-- Descendants, including the vertex itself, defined by the unique actual rooted path. -/
def descendants (t : G.SpanningTree) (r a : V) : Set V :=
  {x | ancestor (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r a x}

/-- The actual lowest common ancestor of a nonempty marked set in an ordinary tree. -/
noncomputable def ancestorOf (t : G.SpanningTree) (r : V) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Nonempty) : V :=
  commonAncestor (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) r S hS

/-- The actual connecting subtree, independent of the root. -/
def span (t : G.SpanningTree) (S : Set V) : Set V :=
  connectingSubtree (G.toSimple_isTree t.property) S

theorem walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem {t : Finset E} {e : E} {a x y : V}
    (hae : G.left e = a ∨ G.right e = a) (p : (G.toSimple t).Walk x y)
    (ha : a ∉ p.support) : G.reaches (t.erase e) x y := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact .refl
  | @cons x z y hxz q ih =>
    have haq : a ∉ q.support := fun h => ha (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    have hax : a ≠ x := fun h => ha (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
    have haz : a ≠ z := fun h => haq (h ▸ q.start_mem_support)
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.head _ (ih haq)
    rcases hxz with ⟨f, hf, h | h⟩
    · refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, Or.inl h⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      rcases hae with hae | hae
      · exact hax (hae.symm.trans h.1)
      · exact haz (hae.symm.trans h.2)
    · refine ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hf⟩, Or.inr h⟩
      intro hfe
      subst f
      rcases hae with hae | hae
      · exact haz (hae.symm.trans h.2)
      · exact hax (hae.symm.trans h.1)

omit [DecidableEq E] in
theorem walk_mem_side {C : Set V} {t : Finset E}
    (ht : ∀ e ∈ t, G.left e ∈ C ↔ G.right e ∈ C)
    {x y : V} (p : (G.toSimple t).Walk x y) (hx : x ∈ C) :
    ∀ z ∈ p.support, z ∈ C := by
  induction p with
  | nil => intro z hz; simpa using (List.mem_singleton.mp hz) ▸ hx
  | @cons x v y h q ih =>
    have hv : v ∈ C := (G.reaches_mem_iff ht (Relation.ReflTransGen.single h)).mp hx
    intro z hz
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
    · exact hx
    · exact ih hv z hz

/-- On a cut tree, the inside endpoint's descendants are exactly the cut component. -/
theorem descendants_eq_cut {C : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C) (r v : V)
    (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    G.descendants ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r v = C := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree p.property.1
  ext x
  change ancestor hT r v x ↔ x ∈ C
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hx
    have hd : G.reaches (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) r x := p.property.2.2.2.2.2 r hr x hx
    obtain ⟨q⟩ := (G.toSimple_reachable _ r x).mpr hd
    have hle : G.toSimple (p.val.1.erase p.val.2) ≤ G.toSimple p.val.1 := by
      intro a b hab
      rcases hab with ⟨e, he, h⟩
      exact ⟨e, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase he, h⟩
    let q' : (G.toSimple p.val.1).Walk r x := q.mapLe hle
    have hqp : path hT r x = q'.toPath.val := path_eq hT _ q'.toPath.property
    unfold ancestor at h
    rw [hqp] at h
    have hqv : v ∈ q'.support := q'.support_toPath_subset_support h
    have hqv' : v ∈ q.support := by
      change v ∈ (q.mapLe hle).support at hqv
      rwa [SimpleGraph.Walk.support_mapLe_eq_support] at hqv
    have hside := G.walk_mem_side (C := Cᶜ) (fun e he => not_congr (p.property.2.2.2.1 e he)) q hr v hqv'
    exact hside hv
  · intro hx
    by_contra hnot
    have hreach := G.walk_reaches_erase_of_not_mem hve (path hT r x) hnot
    have hsame := G.reaches_mem_iff p.property.2.2.2.1 hreach
    exact hr (hsame.mpr hx)

/-- The common-ancestor descendant set equals the cut support exactly for joins at the
actual minimal connecting subtree. This is the missing joining geometry. -/
theorem ancestor_descendants_eq_cut_iff {C S : Set V} (p : G.CutTree C)
    (r v : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hv : v ∈ C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hve : G.left p.val.2 = v ∨ G.right p.val.2 = v) :
    G.descendants ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r
        (G.ancestorOf ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ r S hS) = C ↔
      v ∈ G.span ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩ S := by
  let t : G.SpanningTree := ⟨p.val.1, p.property.1⟩
  let hT := G.toSimple_isTree p.property.1
  have hvdesc := G.descendants_eq_cut p r v hr hv hve
  have hvcommon : ∀ x ∈ S, ancestor hT r v x := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ G.descendants t r v
    rw [hvdesc]
    exact hSC hx
  have hca := commonAncestor_spec hT r S hS
  have heq : G.descendants t r (G.ancestorOf t r S hS) = C ↔
      G.ancestorOf t r S hS = v := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hav : ancestor hT r (commonAncestor hT r S hS) v := by
        change v ∈ G.descendants t r (G.ancestorOf t r S hS)
        rw [h]
        exact hv
      exact ancestor_antisymm hT hav (hca.2 v hvcommon)
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      exact hvdesc
  exact heq.trans (commonAncestor_eq_iff_mem_connectingSubtree hT r S hS hvcommon)

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.RootedForests
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.Incidence
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.PosDef
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Star.Real
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped Classical BigOperators Matrix
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E)

/-- The copied gradient of a potential extended by zero on the prescribed roots. -/
def rootGradientMap (R : Finset V) : ({v : V // v ∉ R} → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (E → ℝ) where
  toFun u := copyGradient G.left G.right (zeroExtend R u)
  map_add' u v := by
    funext e
    simp only [copyGradient, zeroExtend, Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  map_smul' c u := by
    funext e
    simp only [copyGradient, zeroExtend, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring

/-- The original copied incidence matrix, with only nonroot vertex columns. -/
def rootIncidence (R : Finset V) : Matrix E {v : V // v ∉ R} ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toMatrix' (G.rootGradientMap R)

theorem rootIncidence_mulVec (R : Finset V) (u : {v : V // v ∉ R} → ℝ) :
    G.rootIncidence R *ᵥ u = G.rootGradientMap R u :=
  LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec _ _

theorem rootIncidence_apply (R : Finset V) (e : E) (v : {v : V // v ∉ R}) :
    G.rootIncidence R e v =
      (if G.left e = v.val then 1 else 0) - (if G.right e = v.val then 1 else 0) := by
  have hsingle (x : V) : zeroExtend R (Pi.single v (1 : ℝ)) x =
      if x = v.val then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ R
    · have hne : x ≠ v.val := fun h => v.property (h ▸ hx)
      simp [zeroExtend, hx, hne]
    · simp only [zeroExtend, dif_neg hx, Pi.single_apply]
      have he : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {v : V // v ∉ R}) = v ↔ x = v.val := Subtype.ext_iff
      simp only [he]
  change copyGradient G.left G.right (zeroExtend R (Pi.single v 1)) e = _
  simp only [copyGradient, hsingle]

/-- All gradients of vertex potentials vanishing on the entire root set. -/
def rootGradientSpace (R : Finset V) : Submodule ℝ (E → ℝ) :=
  LinearMap.range (G.rootGradientMap R)

theorem mem_rootGradientSpace_iff (R : Finset V) (j : E → ℝ) :
    j ∈ G.rootGradientSpace R ↔
      ∃ q : V → ℝ, (∀ r ∈ R, q r = 0) ∧ copyGradient G.left G.right q = j := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨zeroExtend R u, (by intro r hr; simp [zeroExtend, hr]), rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hj⟩
    refine ⟨fun v => q v.val, ?_⟩
    have he : zeroExtend R (fun v : {v : V // v ∉ R} => q v.val) = q := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ R
      · simp [zeroExtend, hx, hq x hx]
      · simp [zeroExtend, hx]
    change copyGradient G.left G.right (zeroExtend R _) = j
    rw [he, hj]

/-- Adding roots shrinks the actual gradient subspace in the original edge coordinates. -/
theorem rootGradientSpace_antitone {R S : Finset V} (hRS : R ⊆ S) :
    G.rootGradientSpace S ≤ G.rootGradientSpace R := by
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hgrad⟩ := (G.mem_rootGradientSpace_iff S j).mp hj
  exact (G.mem_rootGradientSpace_iff R j).mpr ⟨q, fun r hr => hq r (hRS hr), hgrad⟩

theorem rootGradientMap_injective (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) :
    Function.Injective (G.rootGradientMap R) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hR
  intro u v huv
  apply dirichletMap_injective G.left G.right R (fun x => ⟨r, hr, hc x r⟩)
  funext x
  change laplacian G.left G.right (zeroExtend R u) x.val =
    laplacian G.left G.right (zeroExtend R v) x.val
  rw [← copyBoundary_gradient, ← copyBoundary_gradient]
  exact congrArg (fun j => copyBoundary G.left G.right j x.val) huv

/-- Positive Dirichlet Gram matrix, counting every original edge once. -/
def rootGram (R : Finset V) : Matrix {v : V // v ∉ R} {v : V // v ∉ R} ℝ :=
  (G.rootIncidence R).transpose * G.rootIncidence R

theorem rootIncidence_transpose_mulVec (R : Finset V) (j : E → ℝ) :
    (G.rootIncidence R).transpose *ᵥ j =
      fun v : {v : V // v ∉ R} => copyBoundary G.left G.right j v.val := by
  funext v
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    G.rootIncidence_apply, copyBoundary]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- The Gram matrix is exactly the positive Dirichlet Laplacian already used electrically. -/
theorem rootGram_eq_dirichletMatrix (R : Finset V) :
    G.rootGram R = LinearMap.toMatrix' (dirichletMap G.left G.right R) := by
  apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro u
  rw [Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
  change G.rootGram R *ᵥ u = dirichletMap G.left G.right R u
  rw [rootGram, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, G.rootIncidence_mulVec,
    G.rootIncidence_transpose_mulVec]
  funext v
  exact copyBoundary_gradient G.left G.right (zeroExtend R u) v.val

/-- Contracted root-root edges have zero rows, while they retain their original copy index. -/
theorem rootIncidence_root_root_zero (R : Finset V) (e : E)
    (hl : G.left e ∈ R) (hr : G.right e ∈ R) : G.rootIncidence R e = 0 := by
  funext v
  have hleft : G.left e ≠ v.val := fun h => v.property (h ▸ hl)
  have hright : G.right e ≠ v.val := fun h => v.property (h ▸ hr)
  simp only [G.rootIncidence_apply, if_neg hleft, if_neg hright, sub_self, Pi.zero_apply]

/-- Parallel copies have equal incidence rows but remain distinct coordinates. -/
theorem rootIncidence_parallel_rows (R : Finset V) (e f : E)
    (hl : G.left e = G.left f) (hr : G.right e = G.right f) :
    G.rootIncidence R e = G.rootIncidence R f := by
  funext v
  simp only [G.rootIncidence_apply, hl, hr]

theorem rootGram_posDef (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) : (G.rootGram R).PosDef := by
  have hi : Function.Injective (G.rootIncidence R).mulVec := by
    intro u v h
    apply G.rootGradientMap_injective R hR hc
    simpa only [G.rootIncidence_mulVec] using h
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, rootGram] using
    Matrix.PosDef.conjTranspose_mul_self (G.rootIncidence R) hi

theorem rootGram_det_pos (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) : 0 < (G.rootGram R).det :=
  (G.rootGram_posDef R hR hc).det_pos

/-- The projection onto gradients with zero values at a nonempty set of roots. -/
def rootProjection (R : Finset V) (_hR : R.Nonempty)
    (_hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) : Matrix E E ℝ :=
  G.rootIncidence R * (G.rootGram R)⁻¹ * (G.rootIncidence R).transpose

theorem rootProjection_fixes_gradient (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) (u : {v : V // v ∉ R} → ℝ) :
    G.rootProjection R hR hc *ᵥ G.rootGradientMap R u = G.rootGradientMap R u := by
  have hu : IsUnit (G.rootGram R).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (G.rootGram_det_pos R hR hc))
  rw [← G.rootIncidence_mulVec, rootProjection, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, show
      (G.rootIncidence R).transpose * G.rootIncidence R = G.rootGram R from rfl,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hu, Matrix.mul_one]

/-- The inverse formula has precisely the source gradient space as its image. -/
theorem range_rootProjection (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) :
    LinearMap.range (G.rootProjection R hR hc).mulVecLin = G.rootGradientSpace R := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro j ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(G.rootGram R)⁻¹ *ᵥ ((G.rootIncidence R).transpose *ᵥ x), ?_⟩
    change G.rootGradientMap R _ = G.rootProjection R hR hc *ᵥ x
    rw [← G.rootIncidence_mulVec, rootProjection, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  · rintro j ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨G.rootGradientMap R u, G.rootProjection_fixes_gradient R hR hc u⟩

theorem rootProjection_transpose (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) :
    (G.rootProjection R hR hc).transpose = G.rootProjection R hR hc := by
  have hg : (G.rootGram R).transpose = G.rootGram R := by
    simp only [rootGram, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
  simp only [rootProjection, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hg, Matrix.mul_assoc]

theorem rootProjection_idempotent (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) :
    G.rootProjection R hR hc * G.rootProjection R hR hc = G.rootProjection R hR hc := by
  apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (G.rootProjection R hR hc * G.rootProjection R hR hc) *ᵥ x = _
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have hx : G.rootProjection R hR hc *ᵥ x ∈ G.rootGradientSpace R := by
    rw [← G.range_rootProjection R hR hc]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hx
  rw [← hu, G.rootProjection_fixes_gradient]
  exact hu

/-- Orthogonality uses the Euclidean copied-edge pairing, summing each copy once. -/
theorem rootProjection_residual_orthogonal (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) (x j : E → ℝ)
    (hj : j ∈ G.rootGradientSpace R) :
    (x - G.rootProjection R hR hc *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ j = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hj
  have hj := G.rootProjection_fixes_gradient R hR hc u
  have hs := G.rootProjection_transpose R hR hc
  rw [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm (G.rootProjection R hR hc *ᵥ x)]
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hs, hj,
    dotProduct_comm, sub_self]

/-- Both source root changes give nested projection images on the same copied edges. -/
theorem range_rootProjection_antitone {R S : Finset V} (hRS : R ⊆ S)
    (hR : R.Nonempty) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) :
    LinearMap.range (G.rootProjection S hS hc).mulVecLin ≤
      LinearMap.range (G.rootProjection R hR hc).mulVecLin := by
  rw [G.range_rootProjection, G.range_rootProjection]
  exact G.rootGradientSpace_antitone hRS

/-- A full-size principal projection minor has the normalized squared incidence minor. -/
theorem rootProjection_minor_det (R : Finset V) (hR : R.Nonempty)
    (hc : (supportGraph G.left G.right).Preconnected) (i : {v : V // v ∉ R} → E) :
    ((G.rootProjection R hR hc).submatrix i i).det =
      ((G.rootIncidence R).submatrix i id).det ^ 2 / (G.rootGram R).det := by
  have hsub : (G.rootProjection R hR hc).submatrix i i =
      (G.rootIncidence R).submatrix i id * (G.rootGram R)⁻¹ *
        ((G.rootIncidence R).submatrix i id).transpose := by
    ext x y
    simp only [rootProjection, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply, id_eq]
  rw [hsub, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv]
  simp only [Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  ring

/-- The two root changes used in color comparison give opposite gradient inclusions. -/
theorem mixedRootGradientSpace_inclusions (A A' C C' : Finset V)
    (hA : A ⊆ A') (hC : C' ⊆ C) :
    G.rootGradientSpace (A' ∪ C) ≤ G.rootGradientSpace (A ∪ C) ∧
      G.rootGradientSpace (A ∪ C) ≤ G.rootGradientSpace (A ∪ C') := by
  exact ⟨G.rootGradientSpace_antitone (Finset.union_subset_union hA (by rfl)),
    G.rootGradientSpace_antitone (Finset.union_subset_union (by rfl) hC)⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Dirichlet

/-! Signed copy incidence and its anchored divergence. No plane conclusions are assumed. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane
open scoped Classical BigOperators

/-- Signed outgoing incidence of a once-oriented copied flow. Loops cancel. -/
noncomputable def copyBoundary {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V)
    (j : E → ℝ) (x : V) : ℝ :=
  ∑ e, ((if a e = x then j e else 0)-(if b e = x then j e else 0))

noncomputable def boundaryMap {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) :
    (E → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ) where
  toFun j := copyBoundary a b j
  map_add' j k := by
    funext x
    simp only [copyBoundary,Pi.add_apply,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring
  map_smul' r j := by
    funext x
    simp only [copyBoundary,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,RingHom.id_apply,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => by split_ifs <;> ring

/-- Restrict divergence to vertices other than the chosen root. -/
noncomputable def anchoredBoundary {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (root : V) :
    (E → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({x : V // x ≠ root} → ℝ) where
  toFun j x := copyBoundary a b j x.val
  map_add' j k := by funext x; exact congrFun ((boundaryMap a b).map_add j k) x
  map_smul' r j := by funext x; exact congrFun ((boundaryMap a b).map_smul r j) x

/-- Physical primal gradient, positive from the a endpoint to the b endpoint. -/
def copyGradient {V E : Type*} (a b : E → V) (q : V → ℝ) (e : E) : ℝ := q (a e)-q (b e)

theorem copyBoundary_gradient {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (a b : E → V) (q : V → ℝ) (x : V) :
    copyBoundary a b (copyGradient a b q) x = laplacian a b q x := by
  unfold copyBoundary copyGradient laplacian
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  split_ifs with ha hb <;> simp_all

theorem sum_copyBoundary {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (j : E → ℝ) : (∑ x, copyBoundary a b j x) = 0 := by
  unfold copyBoundary
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,if_true,
    sub_self,Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Omitting the root loses no zero-divergence equation, since total divergence is zero. -/
theorem anchoredBoundary_eq_zero_iff {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (root : V) (j : E → ℝ) :
    anchoredBoundary a b root j = 0 ↔ ∀ x, copyBoundary a b j x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    have hz (y : V) (hy : y ≠ root) : copyBoundary a b j y = 0 := congrFun h ⟨y,hy⟩
    by_cases hx : x = root
    · subst x
      have hs := sum_copyBoundary a b j
      have ht : ∀ y, copyBoundary a b j y = if y = root then copyBoundary a b j root else 0 := by
        intro y
        by_cases hy : y = root
        · simp [hy]
        · simp [hy,hz y hy]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ht y)] at hs
      simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,if_true] at hs
      exact hs
    · exact hz x hx
  · intro h
    funext x
    exact h x.val

/-- Every nonroot divergence prescription is attained on a connected copied graph. -/
theorem anchoredBoundary_surjective {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (a b : E → V) (root : V) (hc : (supportGraph a b).Preconnected) :
    Function.Surjective (anchoredBoundary a b root) := by
  let B : Finset V := {root}
  have hB : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ B, (supportGraph a b).Reachable x y :=
    fun x => ⟨root,Finset.mem_singleton_self root,hc x root⟩
  intro k
  let rhs : {x : V // x ∉ B} → ℝ := fun x => k ⟨x.val,by simpa only [B,Finset.mem_singleton] using x.property⟩
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := LinearMap.surjective_of_injective (dirichletMap_injective a b B hB) rhs
  refine ⟨copyGradient a b (zeroExtend B q),?_⟩
  funext x
  change copyBoundary a b (copyGradient a b (zeroExtend B q)) x.val = k x
  rw [copyBoundary_gradient]
  exact congrFun hq ⟨x.val,by simpa only [B,Finset.mem_singleton] using x.property⟩

end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane

import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Ancestors
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max

/-! A connected finite copied graph has an actual spanning tree. -/
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph
open scoped Classical
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
  (G : FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph V E)

/-- Individual parallel edge copies are retained in the spanning-tree carrier. -/
theorem nonempty_spanning_tree [Nonempty V]
    (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) : Nonempty G.SpanningTree := by
  let s : Finset (Finset E) := Finset.univ.filter (fun F => ∀ x y : V, G.reaches F x y)
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨Finset.univ, ?_⟩
    simp only [s, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact hconn
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hmin⟩ := s.exists_min_image Finset.card hs
  have hFc : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches F x y := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hF).2
  have hforest : G.is_forest F := by
    intro e he hcycle
    have hadj : ∀ x y, G.adjacent F x y → G.reaches (F.erase e) x y := by
      intro x y h
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hxy⟩ := h
      by_cases hfe : f = e
      · subst f
        rcases hxy with ⟨hl, hr⟩ | ⟨hr, hl⟩
        · simpa only [hl, hr] using hcycle
        · simpa only [hl, hr] using G.reaches_symm hcycle
      · exact .single ⟨f, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfe,hf⟩, hxy⟩
    have herase : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches (F.erase e) x y := by
      intro x y
      induction hFc x y with
      | refl => exact .refl
      | tail h hxy ih => exact ih.trans (hadj _ _ hxy)
    have hemem : F.erase e ∈ s := by
      simp only [s, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact herase
    have hm := hmin (F.erase e) hemem
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_lt (Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem he)) hm
  refine ⟨⟨F, Set.univ_nonempty, ?_, ?_, hforest⟩⟩
  · intro e he
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact hFc x y

end FiniteAvalanches.Trees.Multigraph

public import FiniteAvalanches.Trees.JoiningCounts

@[expose] public section

/-! Actual uniform finite measures on copied-edge tree subsets. -/
open scoped Classical ENNReal
open MeasureTheory
namespace FiniteAvalanches

noncomputable def uniformMeasure (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : Measure α :=
  (Nat.card α : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count

instance uniformMeasure_probability (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformMeasure α) := by
  constructor
  simp only [uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.count_univ]
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]
  simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, Fintype.card_ne_zero]

theorem uniformMeasure_apply (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (A : Set α) :
    uniformMeasure α A = (Nat.card A : ℝ≥0∞) / Nat.card α := by
  rw [uniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Measure.count_apply A.toFinite.measurableSet, Set.encard, ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]
  exact ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul.symm

theorem uniformMeasure_real_apply (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (A : Set α) :
    (uniformMeasure α).real A = (Nat.card A : ℝ) / Nat.card α := by
  simp [Measure.real, uniformMeasure_apply, ENNReal.toReal_div]

theorem integral_uniformMeasure (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂uniformMeasure α) = (∑ x, f x) / Nat.card α := by
  simp only [uniformMeasure, integral_smul_measure, integral_count, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    ENNReal.toReal_natCast, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

namespace Trees.Multigraph
variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] (G : Multigraph V E)

instance componentTreeMeasurableSpace (C : Set V) : MeasurableSpace (G.ComponentTree C) := ⊤
instance componentTreeMeasurableSingletonClass (C : Set V) :
    MeasurableSingletonClass (G.ComponentTree C) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

/-- Uniform probability on actual ordinary spanning-tree edge subsets. -/
noncomputable def treeLaw [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] : Measure G.SpanningTree :=
  uniformMeasure G.SpanningTree

instance treeLaw_probability [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] : IsProbabilityMeasure G.treeLaw :=
  uniformMeasure_probability _

theorem treeLaw_real_eq_counting [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] (A : Set G.SpanningTree) :
    G.treeLaw.real A = G.uniformTreeProbability A :=
  uniformMeasure_real_apply _ A

/-- The exact joining formula is an event probability of a real finite measure. -/
theorem treeLaw_real_ancestorPastTree [Nonempty G.SpanningTree] {C S : Set V}
    (r : V) (hr : r ∉ C) (hS : S.Nonempty) (t : G.ComponentTree C) (hSC : S ⊆ C) :
    G.treeLaw.real {u | G.descendants u r (G.ancestorOf u r S hS) = C ∧
      G.internalEdges C u.val = t.val} =
      (Fintype.card (G.ComponentTree Cᶜ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card G.SpanningTree *
        (∑ v ∈ (G.componentSpan t S hSC).toFinset, (G.crossingAt C v).card) := by
  rw [G.treeLaw_real_eq_counting]
  exact G.probability_ancestorPastTree_eq_sum r hr hS t hSC

end Trees.Multigraph
end FiniteAvalanches

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Reference.NoBridges

/-! Cut bounds and copied-edge deletion connectivity in the actual wired quotient. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice

open LatticeProb
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- H retains every original ID incident to D except contraction loops. -/
def primalCopies (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (domainCopies D).filter fun e =>
    project D P (originalA e) ≠ project D P (originalB e)

abbrev PrimalCopy (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) := ↥(primalCopies D P)

/-- The pre-marked-deletion multigraph H, on the same quotient vertices as H0. -/
def primalGraph (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) :
    Trees.Multigraph (Vertex D P) (PrimalCopy D P) where
  left e := project D P (originalA e.val)
  right e := project D P (originalB e.val)
  loopless e := (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.property).2

/-- Cut copies are indexed by original IDs, preserving parallel multiplicity. -/
def quotientCut (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (U : Finset (Vertex D P)) :
    Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (primalCopies D P).filter fun e =>
    (project D P (originalA e) ∈ U ∧ project D P (originalB e) ∉ U) ∨
    (project D P (originalB e) ∈ U ∧ project D P (originalA e) ∉ U)

/-- The finite lattice preimage of the side away from the exterior terminal. -/
def cutPreimage (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (U : Finset (Vertex D P)) :
    Finset (Site 2) := D.filter fun x => project D P x ∈ U

theorem mem_cutPreimage (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (U : Finset (Vertex D P)) (ha : alpha D P ∉ U) (x : Site 2) :
    x ∈ cutPreimage D P U ↔ project D P x ∈ U := by
  rw [cutPreimage, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨?_,hx⟩
    by_contra hn
    have he := (project_eq_alpha_iff D P x).mpr hn
    exact ha (he ▸ hx)

theorem cutPreimage_nonempty (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (U : Finset (Vertex D P)) (ha : alpha D P ∉ U) (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    (cutPreimage D P U).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hU
  cases v with
  | inl b => cases b with
    | false => exact (ha hv).elim
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := P.property
      have he : project D P p.val = beta D P :=
        (project_eq_beta_iff D P _).mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩)
      exact ⟨p.val, (mem_cutPreimage D P U ha _).mpr (he.symm ▸ hv)⟩
  | inr x =>
    exact ⟨x.val.val, (mem_cutPreimage D P U ha _).mpr
      ((project_free D P x).symm ▸ hv)⟩

/-- Every lifted exit crosses the quotient cut and therefore is not a loop. -/
theorem latticeExits_cutPreimage_subset (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (U : Finset (Vertex D P)) (ha : alpha D P ∉ U) :
    latticeExits (cutPreimage D P U) ⊆ quotientCut D P U := by
  intro e he
  have hex := (mem_latticeExits _ e).mp he
  rw [quotientCut, Finset.mem_filter]
  have hcross :
      (project D P (originalA e) ∈ U ∧ project D P (originalB e) ∉ U) ∨
      (project D P (originalB e) ∈ U ∧ project D P (originalA e) ∉ U) := by
    simpa only [mem_cutPreimage D P U ha] using hex
  refine ⟨?_,hcross⟩
  rw [primalCopies, Finset.mem_filter, mem_domainCopies]
  constructor
  · rcases hex with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mp h.1).1
    · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mp h.1).1
  · intro h
    rcases hcross with hcross | hcross
    · exact hcross.2 (h ▸ hcross.1)
    · exact hcross.2 (h.symm ▸ hcross.1)

/-- Every nonempty quotient cut away from alpha has at least four original copies. -/
theorem quotientCut_card_ge_four (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (U : Finset (Vertex D P)) (ha : alpha D P ∉ U) (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    4 ≤ (quotientCut D P U).card :=
  (latticeExits_card_ge_four _ (cutPreimage_nonempty D P U ha hU)).trans
    (Finset.card_le_card (latticeExits_cutPreimage_subset D P U ha))

/-- Delete original IDs, rather than undirected endpoint pairs. -/
def primalSurviving (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (deleted : Finset OriginalCopy) : Finset (PrimalCopy D P) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun e => e.val ∉ deleted

/-- Wiring any finite lattice set stays connected after deletion of at most three IDs. -/
theorem primal_reaches_of_deleted_card_le_three (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (deleted : Finset OriginalCopy) (hd : deleted.card ≤ 3) (x y : Vertex D P) :
    (primalGraph D P).reaches (primalSurviving D P deleted) x y := by
  let G := primalGraph D P
  let s := primalSurviving D P deleted
  have hr (v : Vertex D P) : G.reaches s (alpha D P) v := by
    by_contra hv
    let U : Finset (Vertex D P) := Finset.univ.filter fun v =>
      ¬G.reaches s (alpha D P) v
    have ha : alpha D P ∉ U := by
      simp only [U, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_not]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    have hU : U.Nonempty := ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hv⟩⟩
    have hsub : quotientCut D P U ⊆ deleted := by
      intro e he
      by_contra hed
      obtain ⟨hep,hcross⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp he
      let c : PrimalCopy D P := ⟨e,hep⟩
      have hc : c ∈ s := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hed⟩
      have hedge : G.reaches s (project D P (originalA e))
          (project D P (originalB e)) :=
        .single ⟨c,hc,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩
      have hu (z : Vertex D P) : z ∈ U ↔ ¬G.reaches s (alpha D P) z := by
        simp only [U, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      rcases hcross with ⟨hA,hB⟩ | ⟨hB,hA⟩
      · have hb : G.reaches s (alpha D P) (project D P (originalB e)) := by
          by_contra hh
          exact hB ((hu _).mpr hh)
        exact (hu _).mp hA (hb.trans (G.reaches_symm hedge))
      · have ha' : G.reaches s (alpha D P) (project D P (originalA e)) := by
          by_contra hh
          exact hA ((hu _).mpr hh)
        exact (hu _).mp hB (ha'.trans hedge)
    have hfour := quotientCut_card_ge_four D P U ha hU
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    omega
  exact (G.reaches_symm (hr x)).trans (hr y)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Reference.Connected

/-! Copy-preserving cut bounds for the actual finite wired lattice quotient. -/

namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice

open LatticeProb
open FiniteAvalanches.Sandpile.FiniteWired (Direction step)
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

/-- Original IDs crossing a finite set of lattice sites. -/
def latticeExits (S : Finset (Site 2)) : Finset OriginalCopy :=
  (domainCopies S).filter fun e =>
    (originalA e ∈ S ∧ originalB e ∉ S) ∨
    (originalB e ∈ S ∧ originalA e ∉ S)

theorem mem_latticeExits (S : Finset (Site 2)) (e : OriginalCopy) :
    e ∈ latticeExits S ↔
      (originalA e ∈ S ∧ originalB e ∉ S) ∨
      (originalB e ∈ S ∧ originalA e ∉ S) := by
  rw [latticeExits, Finset.mem_filter, mem_domainCopies]
  tauto

private theorem exists_direction_exit (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (d : Direction) : ∃ x ∈ S, x + step d ∉ S := by
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b with
  | false =>
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image (fun x => x i) hS
    refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
    intro h
    have hh := hmin (x + step (i,false)) h
    simp only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Pi.add_apply,
      Pi.neg_apply, unit, Pi.single_eq_same] at hh
    omega
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hmax⟩ := S.exists_max_image (fun x => x i) hS
    refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
    intro h
    have hh := hmax (x + step (i,true)) h
    simp only [step, if_true, Pi.add_apply, unit, Pi.single_eq_same] at hh
    omega

private theorem incidentID_mem_exits (S : Finset (Site 2))
    (x : Site 2) (d : Direction) (hx : x ∈ S) (hout : x + step d ∉ S) :
    incidentID x d ∈ latticeExits S := by
  rw [mem_latticeExits]
  rcases d with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b with
  | false =>
    right
    simpa only [incidentID, if_false, originalA, originalB, sub_add_cancel,
      step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using And.intro hx hout
  | true =>
    left
    exact ⟨hx,hout⟩

/-- Four extremal exits have distinct original IDs, even after wiring. -/
theorem latticeExits_card_ge_four (S : Finset (Site 2)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    4 ≤ (latticeExits S).card := by
  let x : Direction → Site 2 := fun d => (exists_direction_exit S hS d).choose
  have hx (d : Direction) : x d ∈ S ∧ x d + step d ∉ S :=
    (exists_direction_exit S hS d).choose_spec
  let f : Direction → ↥(latticeExits S) := fun d =>
    ⟨incidentID (x d) d, incidentID_mem_exits S (x d) d (hx d).1 (hx d).2⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    rintro ⟨i,b⟩ ⟨j,c⟩ h
    have he : incidentID (x (i,b)) (i,b) = incidentID (x (j,c)) (j,c) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hij : i = j := congrArg Prod.snd he
    subst j
    cases b <;> cases c
    · rfl
    · have hp := congrArg Prod.fst he
      have hout := (hx (i,false)).2
      apply False.elim
      apply hout
      change x (i,false) - unit i = x (i,true) at hp
      simpa only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← sub_eq_add_neg, hp] using (hx (i,true)).1
    · have hp := congrArg Prod.fst he
      have hout := (hx (i,false)).2
      apply False.elim
      apply hout
      change x (i,true) = x (i,false) - unit i at hp
      simpa only [step, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← hp] using (hx (i,true)).1
    · rfl
  have hh := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  simpa only [Direction, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool,
    Nat.reduceMul, Fintype.card_coe] using hh

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice
