/-! Classical geometric duality for finite connected plane multigraph drawings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open scoped Classical

/-- The dual retains every original edge copy, crosses it once, and its faces
correspond to the original vertices with reversed double-dual orientation. -/
axiom finite_plane_geometric_dual :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, Source.EdgeChart D e)
    (_hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected),
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype (Face D),
      letI : Fintype (Face D) := finiteFaces
      let dualGraph : CopiedGraph (Face D) E :=
        ⟨fun e => negativeChartFace D e (charts e),
          fun e => positiveChartFace D e (charts e)⟩
      ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing dualGraph,
      ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e : E, Source.EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
      ∃ vertexFaces : V ≃ Face dualDrawing,
        (∀ F : Face D, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion D F) ∧
        (∀ v : V, D.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
        (∀ (e f : E) (s t : ArcParameter),
          D.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
            e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
        (∀ (e : E) (t : ArcParameter),
          (t.val < 1 / 2 →
            dualDrawing.curve e t ∈ faceRegion D (dualGraph.left e)) ∧
          (1 / 2 < t.val →
            dualDrawing.curve e t ∈ faceRegion D (dualGraph.right e))) ∧
        (∀ e : E, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧ radius < (charts e).radius ∧
          ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
            (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
        (∀ e : E,
          positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces (J.left e) ∧
          negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces (J.right e))

end FiniteAvalanches.External

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.PolarDual

/-! Classical finite-plane two-pole topology, with every original copied edge.
The assertion concerns actual complementary regions of continuous embeddings.
Electrical consequences are ordinary proofs from this assertion and BSST. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane
open scoped Classical

/-- Actual finite faces, polar connectedness, copied tree complementation and
universal face-boundary telescoping for a given physical outer arc. -/
axiom finite_plane_two_pole_topology :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (_hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (_hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta),
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype A.embedding.Face,
      letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
      polarGround A ≠ polarSource A ∧
      (supportGraph (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).Preconnected ∧
      (∀ T : Finset (E ⊕ Unit),
        (∃ t : (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).SpanningTree, t.val = T) ↔
        (∃ t : (augmentedDual A).SpanningTree, t.val = Finset.univ \ T)) ∧
      (∀ (q : V → ℝ) (F : A.embedding.Face),
        copyBoundary (augmentedDual A).left (augmentedDual A).right
          (copyGradient (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).left
            (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).right q) F = 0)

end FiniteAvalanches.External

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.BSSTStream
import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.Incidence

/-! Polar dual copies on the actual complementary regions of a given outer arc. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open StatementGeometry
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section
variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The full geometric dual has one original-ID copy, including the added arc,
from the actual physical right face to the actual physical left face. -/
def augmentedDual {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    CopiedGraph A.embedding.Face (E ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨A.embedding.rightFace, A.embedding.leftFace⟩

/-- Removing ONLY the distinguished dual copy retains every original wire, even
when its two geometric face endpoints coincide. No coordinate or edge is chosen. -/
def polarDual {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    CopiedGraph A.embedding.Face E :=
  ⟨fun e => A.embedding.rightFace (.inl e), fun e => A.embedding.leftFace (.inl e)⟩

/-- Zero stream ground is on the right of the actual alpha-to-beta outer arc. -/
def polarGround {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    A.embedding.Face := A.embedding.rightFace (.inr ())

/-- Unit injection is on the left of the SAME actual outer arc. -/
def polarSource {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V} (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    A.embedding.Face := A.embedding.leftFace (.inr ())

/-- Both dual carriers preserve precisely the original E IDs and their incidence. -/
theorem polarDual_copy {D : PlaneEmbedding J} {alpha beta : V}
    (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) (e : E) :
    (polarDual A).left e = (augmentedDual A).left (.inl e) ∧
      (polarDual A).right e = (augmentedDual A).right (.inl e) := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

/-- The half-open Drawing's permissive loop carrier causes no extra hypothesis:
full source arc injectivity already excludes a loop in a PlaneEmbedding. -/
theorem PlaneEmbedding.endpoints_ne (D : PlaneEmbedding J) (e : E) : J.left e ≠ J.right e := by
  intro he
  have hc : D.drawing.curve e ⟨0,by norm_num⟩ = D.drawing.curve e ⟨1,by norm_num⟩ := by
    rw [D.drawing.start,D.drawing.finish,he]
  have ht := congrArg Subtype.val (D.edge_injective e hc)
  norm_num at ht

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source

import FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Geometry.SourceAlphaBond

/-! Exact transport between retained bond copies and the original H0 alpha star. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeDrawing
open LatticeProb
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Plane.SourceLattice
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

theorem alpha_cut_iff (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (e : PrimalCopy D P) :
    (((primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).right e ≠ alpha D P) ∨
      ((primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).left e ≠ alpha D P)) ↔
      ((primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∨ (primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P) := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.elim (fun h => Or.inl h.1) (fun h => Or.inr h.1)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h, fun he => primal_loopless D P e (h.trans he.symm)⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h, fun he => primal_loopless D P e (he.trans h.symm)⟩

/-- Changing singleton membership to endpoint equality preserves the original edge value. -/
def alphaSingletonCutEquiv (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    {e : PrimalCopy D P // e ≠ markedPrimal D P marked ∧
      (((primalGraph D P).left e ∈ ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P)) ∧
        (primalGraph D P).right e ∉ ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P))) ∨
      ((primalGraph D P).right e ∈ ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P)) ∧
        (primalGraph D P).left e ∉ ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P))))} ≃
    {e : PrimalCopy D P // e ≠ markedPrimal D P marked ∧
      (((primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).right e ≠ alpha D P) ∨
        ((primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).left e ≠ alpha D P))} where
  toFun e := ⟨e.val, by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using e.property⟩
  invFun e := ⟨e.val, by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using e.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The bijection is the actual unchanged original ID inclusion, restricted to the alpha cut. -/
def retainedAlphaEquiv (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D) (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    {e : PrimalCopy D P // e ≠ markedPrimal D P marked ∧
      (((primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).right e ≠ alpha D P) ∨
        ((primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).left e ≠ alpha D P))} ≃
    {e : Copy D P marked // copyA D P marked e = alpha D P ∨
      copyB D P marked e = alpha D P} where
  toFun e := ⟨⟨e.val.val, Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp e.val.property).1,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp e.val.property).2,
      fun h => e.property.1 (Subtype.ext h)⟩⟩,
    (alpha_cut_iff D P e.val).mp e.property.2⟩
  invFun e := ⟨retainedPrimal D P marked e.val,
    retainedPrimal_ne_marked D P marked e.val, (alpha_cut_iff D P _).mpr e.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem retainedAlphaEquiv_id (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P)
    (e : {e : PrimalCopy D P // e ≠ markedPrimal D P marked ∧
      (((primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).right e ≠ alpha D P) ∨
        ((primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).left e ≠ alpha D P))}) :
    retainedPrimal D P marked ((retainedAlphaEquiv D P marked e).val) = e.val := rfl

end

/-- The original H0 alpha copies form a simple path on the full H dual face carrier,
conditional only on the explicit generic bond-to-cycle proposition. -/
theorem source_deleted_dual_path_of_bond_cycle
    (hbond :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (Q : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, EdgeChart Q e) (A : Finset V),
  (∀ x y : V, x ∈ A → y ∈ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∈ A) x y) →
  (∀ x y : V, x ∉ A → y ∉ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∉ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) x y) →
  ∀ marked : E,
    ((J.left marked ∈ A ∧ J.right marked ∉ A) ∨
      (J.right marked ∈ A ∧ J.left marked ∉ A)) →
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
    Function.Injective vertices ∧
    ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : E // e ≠ marked ∧
      ((J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A))},
      m + 1 = (Finset.univ.filter fun e : E =>
        (J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A)).card ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        (negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ)) ∧
      ((negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices 0 ∧
          positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices 0 ∧
          negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m))))
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (primalGraph D P),
      (∀ v : D, Q.point (project D P v.val) = q (sitePoint v.val)) ∧
      (∀ e t, Q.curve e t = q (unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val)) ∧
      ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart Q e,
      ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype (Face Q),
        letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
        ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts),
        ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e, EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
        ∃ vertexFaces : Vertex D P ≃ Face dualDrawing,
          (∀ F : Face Q, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion Q F) ∧
          (∀ v : Vertex D P, Q.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
          (∀ (e f : PrimalCopy D P) (s t : ArcParameter),
            Q.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
              e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
          (∀ (e : PrimalCopy D P) (t : ArcParameter),
            (t.val < 1 / 2 → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left e)) ∧
            (1 / 2 < t.val → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right e))) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧
            radius < (charts e).radius ∧ ∀ t : ArcParameter,
              |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
              (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P,
            positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).left e) ∧
            negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).right e)) ∧
          ∃ Hstar : Drawing (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts),
            (∀ F : Face Q, Hstar.point F = dualDrawing.point F) ∧
            (∀ e t, Hstar.curve e t = dualDrawing.curve (retainedPrimal D P marked e) t) ∧
            ∃ m : ℕ, 3 ≤ m ∧ ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
              Function.Injective vertices ∧
              ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : Copy D P marked //
                copyA D P marked e = alpha D P ∨ copyB D P marked e = alpha D P},
                (∀ i : Fin m,
                  ((sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).left (copies i).val = vertices i.castSucc ∧
                    (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).right (copies i).val = vertices i.succ) ∨
                  ((sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).right (copies i).val = vertices i.castSucc ∧
                    (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).left (copies i).val = vertices i.succ)) ∧
                (((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices 0 ∧
                    (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨
                  ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices 0 ∧
                    (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices (Fin.last m))) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, hdual⟩ :=
    source_H_deleted_dual_realization D P hD hDc hP marked
  letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
  obtain ⟨dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces, hpoint, hvertex, hcross,
    hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc⟩ := hdual
  have hmark : ((primalGraph D P).left (markedPrimal D P marked) ∈
        ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P)) ∧
      (primalGraph D P).right (markedPrimal D P marked) ∉
        ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P))) ∨
      ((primalGraph D P).right (markedPrimal D P marked) ∈
        ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P)) ∧
      (primalGraph D P).left (markedPrimal D P marked) ∉
        ({alpha D P} : Finset (Vertex D P))) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
    apply (alpha_cut_iff D P _).mpr
    exact marked.property.elim (fun h => Or.inl h.1) (fun h => Or.inr h.2)
  obtain ⟨m, vertices, hinj, edges, hcard, hends, hmarked⟩ :=
    hbond (primalGraph D P) Q charts {alpha D P}
      (by
        intro x y hx hy
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy
        subst x
        subst y
        exact .refl)
      (by
        intro x y hx hy
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy ⊢
        exact primal_reaches_without_alpha D P hD x y hx hy)
      (markedPrimal D P marked) hmark
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hcard
  have hm : 3 ≤ m := by
    have hfour := alpha_star_card_ge_four D P
    have heq : (Finset.univ.filter fun e : PrimalCopy D P =>
        ((primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).right e ≠ alpha D P) ∨
        ((primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P ∧ (primalGraph D P).left e ≠ alpha D P)) =
        (Finset.univ.filter fun e : PrimalCopy D P =>
          (primalGraph D P).left e = alpha D P ∨ (primalGraph D P).right e = alpha D P) := by
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, alpha_cut_iff]
    rw [heq] at hcard
    omega
  let copies := (edges.trans (alphaSingletonCutEquiv D P marked)).trans
    (retainedAlphaEquiv D P marked)
  refine ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces,
    hpoint, hvertex, hcross, hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc,
    m, hm, vertices, hinj, copies, ?_, hmarked⟩
  intro i
  exact hends i

end

/-- The full source drawing places its marked common face outside, conditional
on the exact generic punctured-plane face placement assertion. -/
theorem actual_outer_arc_of_generic_face_placement
    (hplace :
  ∀ {V E E₀ : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype E₀]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (K : CopiedGraph V E₀) (D : Drawing J)
    (i : E₀ → E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hl : ∀ e, J.left (i e) = K.left e)
    (hr : ∀ e, J.right (i e) = K.right e)
    (F : Face (restrictDrawing D i hi hl hr)),
  let R := restrictDrawing D i hi hl hr
  ∃ p : Plane, ∃ hp : p ∉ drawingTrace D,
    p ∈ faceRegion R F ∧
    ∃ c : {z : Plane // z ≠ p} ≃ₜ {z : Plane // z ≠ (0, 0)},
      (∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
        (c z).val =
          ((z.val.1 - p.1) / ((z.val.1 - p.1)^2 + (z.val.2 - p.2)^2),
           -(z.val.2 - p.2) / ((z.val.1 - p.1)^2 + (z.val.2 - p.2)^2))) ∧
      ∃ D' : Drawing J,
        (∀ v, D'.point v = (c ⟨D.point v, by
          intro heq
          apply hp
          exact heq ▸ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self v) : D.point v ∈ drawingTrace D)⟩).val) ∧
        (∀ e t, D'.curve e t = (c ⟨D.curve e t, by
          intro heq
          apply hp
          exact heq ▸ (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, Set.mem_range_self t⟩) :
            D.curve e t ∈ drawingTrace D)⟩).val) ∧
        let R' := restrictDrawing D' i hi hl hr
        ∃ faces : Face R ≃ Face R',
          (∀ G : Face R, ∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
            z.val ∈ faceRegion R G ↔ (c z).val ∈ faceRegion R' (faces G)) ∧
          (∀ G : Face R, ∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
            z.val ∈ closure (faceRegion R G) ↔
              (c z).val ∈ closure (faceRegion R' (faces G))) ∧
          (∀ G : Face R, ∀ v : V, incident R v G ↔ incident R' v (faces G)) ∧
          (∀ e : E, ∀ S : Set ArcParameter, ∀ t : ArcParameter,
            D.curve e t ∈ closure (D.curve e '' S) ↔
              D'.curve e t ∈ closure (D'.curve e '' S)) ∧
          ¬Bornology.IsBounded (faceRegion R' (faces F)))
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (primalGraph D P),
      (∀ v : D, Q.point (project D P v.val) = q (sitePoint v.val)) ∧
      (∀ e t, Q.curve e t = q (unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val)) ∧
      let R := deleteMarkedDrawing D P marked Q
      ∃ F : Face R, ∃ p : Plane, ∃ hp : p ∉ drawingTrace Q,
        p ∈ faceRegion R F ∧
        ∃ c : {z : Plane // z ≠ p} ≃ₜ {z : Plane // z ≠ (0, 0)},
          (∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
            (c z).val =
              ((z.val.1 - p.1) / ((z.val.1 - p.1)^2 + (z.val.2 - p.2)^2),
               -(z.val.2 - p.2) / ((z.val.1 - p.1)^2 + (z.val.2 - p.2)^2))) ∧
          ∃ Q' : Drawing (primalGraph D P),
            (∀ v, Q'.point v = (c ⟨Q.point v, by
              intro heq
              apply hp
              exact heq ▸ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self v) :
                Q.point v ∈ drawingTrace Q)⟩).val) ∧
            (∀ e t, Q'.curve e t = (c ⟨Q.curve e t, by
              intro heq
              apply hp
              exact heq ▸ (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, Set.mem_range_self t⟩) :
                Q.curve e t ∈ drawingTrace Q)⟩).val) ∧
            let R' := deleteMarkedDrawing D P marked Q'
            ∃ faces : Face R ≃ Face R',
              (∀ G : Face R, ∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
                z.val ∈ faceRegion R G ↔ (c z).val ∈ faceRegion R' (faces G)) ∧
              (∀ G : Face R, ∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
                z.val ∈ closure (faceRegion R G) ↔
                  (c z).val ∈ closure (faceRegion R' (faces G))) ∧
              (∀ G : Face R, ∀ v : Vertex D P,
                incident R v G ↔ incident R' v (faces G)) ∧
              (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P, ∀ S : Set ArcParameter, ∀ t : ArcParameter,
                Q.curve e t ∈ closure (Q.curve e '' S) ↔
                  Q'.curve e t ∈ closure (Q'.curve e '' S)) ∧
              ¬Bornology.IsBounded (faceRegion R' (faces F)) ∧
              (∀ e t, R'.curve e t = Q'.curve (retainedPrimal D P marked e) t) ∧
              (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
                Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∉ drawingTrace R') ∧
              (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
                Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∈ faceRegion R' (faces F)) ∧
              Set.range (Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆
                closure (faceRegion R' (faces F)) ∧
              incident R' (alpha D P) (faces F) ∧ incident R' (beta D P) (faces F) ∧
              (∀ G : Face R',
                (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
                  Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∈ faceRegion R' G) →
                G = faces F) ∧
              (∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon → epsilon < 1 →
                Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ ∈
                  closure (Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
                    {t : ArcParameter | 0 < t.val ∧ t.val < epsilon}) ∧
                Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ ∈
                  closure (Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
                    {t : ArcParameter | 1 - epsilon < t.val ∧ t.val < 1}) ∧
                Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
                    {t : ArcParameter | 0 < t.val ∧ t.val < epsilon} ⊆
                  faceRegion R' (faces F) ∧
                Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
                    {t : ArcParameter | 1 - epsilon < t.val ∧ t.val < 1} ⊆
                  faceRegion R' (faces F)) ∧
              (supportGraph (copyA D P marked) (copyB D P marked)).Connected ∧
              ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart R' e,
                ∃ O : OuterArc (ChartExistence.planeEmbeddingOfCharts R'
                    (copy_loopless D P marked) charts) (alpha D P) (beta D P),
                  O.face = faces F := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, Q, hqp, hqc, Q0, hQ0, F0, _, hF0, hcl0, ha0, hb0, hu0, hg0⟩ :=
    source_marked_common_face D P hDc hP marked
  have original : ∃ F : Face Q0.drawing,
      (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
        Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∈ faceRegion Q0.drawing F) ∧
      Set.range (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆ closure (faceRegion Q0.drawing F) ∧
      incident Q0.drawing (alpha D P) F ∧ incident Q0.drawing (beta D P) F ∧
      (∀ G : Face Q0.drawing,
        (∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
          Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∈ faceRegion Q0.drawing G) → G = F) ∧
      (∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon → epsilon < 1 →
        Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ ∈
          closure (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
            {t : ArcParameter | 0 < t.val ∧ t.val < epsilon}) ∧
        Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ ∈
          closure (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
            {t : ArcParameter | 1 - epsilon < t.val ∧ t.val < 1}) ∧
        Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
            {t : ArcParameter | 0 < t.val ∧ t.val < epsilon} ⊆ faceRegion Q0.drawing F ∧
        Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) ''
            {t : ArcParameter | 1 - epsilon < t.val ∧ t.val < 1} ⊆ faceRegion Q0.drawing F) :=
    ⟨F0, hF0, hcl0, ha0, hb0, hu0, hg0⟩
  rw [hQ0] at original
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hcl, ha, hb, hunique, hg⟩ := original
  let R := deleteMarkedDrawing D P marked Q
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpF, c, hc, Q', hpoint, hcurve, faces, hregion, hclosure,
    hincident, hcurveClosure, hunbounded⟩ :=
    hplace (primalGraph D P)
      (⟨copyA D P marked, copyB D P marked⟩ :
        CopiedGraph (Vertex D P) (Copy D P marked)) Q
      (retainedPrimal D P marked) (retainedPrimal_injective D P marked)
      (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) F
  let R' := deleteMarkedDrawing D P marked Q'
  have curve_ne (e : PrimalCopy D P) (t : ArcParameter) : Q.curve e t ≠ p := by
    intro heq
    apply hp
    exact heq ▸ (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, Set.mem_range_self t⟩) :
      Q.curve e t ∈ drawingTrace Q)
  have hmarked (t : ArcParameter) (ht0 : 0 < t.val) (ht1 : t.val < 1) :
      Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∈ faceRegion R' (faces F) := by
    rw [hcurve]
    exact (hregion F ⟨Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t,
      curve_ne _ t⟩).mp (hF t ht0 ht1)
  have hmarkedClosure : Set.range (Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆
      closure (faceRegion R' (faces F)) := by
    rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
    rw [hcurve]
    exact (hclosure F ⟨Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t,
      curve_ne _ t⟩).mp (hcl (Set.mem_range_self t))
  have ha' : incident R' (alpha D P) (faces F) := (hincident F _).mp ha
  have hb' : incident R' (beta D P) (faces F) := (hincident F _).mp hb
  have hunique' (G : Face R')
      (hG : ∀ t : ArcParameter, 0 < t.val → t.val < 1 →
        Q'.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t ∈ faceRegion R' G) : G = faces F := by
    obtain ⟨G0, rfl⟩ := faces.surjective G
    apply congrArg faces
    apply hunique
    intro t ht0 ht1
    apply (hregion G0 ⟨Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t, curve_ne _ t⟩).mpr
    rw [← hcurve]
    exact hG t ht0 ht1
  have hconnected := Repair8.graph_connected D P hD marked
  have hne : alpha D P ≠ beta D P := Sum.inl_injective.ne (by decide)
  obtain ⟨charts, O, hO⟩ := ChartExistence.source_outer_arc_of_unbounded_face
    (⟨copyA D P marked, copyB D P marked⟩ :
      CopiedGraph (Vertex D P) (Copy D P marked)) R'
    (copy_loopless D P marked) hconnected.preconnected
    (alpha D P) (beta D P) hne (faces F) ha' hb' hunbounded
  refine ⟨q, hq, Q, hqp, hqc, F, p, hp, hpF, c, hc, Q', hpoint, hcurve,
    faces, hregion, hclosure, hincident, hcurveClosure, hunbounded,
    (fun _ _ => rfl), ?_, hmarked, hmarkedClosure, ha', hb', hunique', ?_,
    hconnected, charts, O, hO⟩
  · intro t ht0 ht1
    exact DeletedArc.omitted_interior_off_trace Q' (retainedPrimal D P marked)
      (retainedPrimal_injective D P marked) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
      (markedPrimal D P marked) (retainedPrimal_ne_marked D P marked) t ht0 ht1
  · intro epsilon he0 he1
    obtain ⟨hgStart, hgFinish, hgStartFace, hgFinishFace⟩ := hg epsilon he0 he1
    refine ⟨(hcurveClosure _ _ _).mp hgStart, (hcurveClosure _ _ _).mp hgFinish,
      ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      rw [hcurve]
      exact (hregion F ⟨Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) t, curve_ne _ t⟩).mp
        (hgStartFace ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)

        (hgFinishFace ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)

/-! Complement components under deletion, on the literal drawn plane regions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ComplementFaces
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open scoped Classical
noncomputable section

variable {V E W F : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype W] [Fintype F]
  {J : CopiedGraph V E} {K : CopiedGraph W F}

/-- The face at a point is its actual complement component. -/
def faceAt (D : Drawing J) (z : Plane) (hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D) : Face D :=
  ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨z, hz⟩

/-- A point belongs to its actual face. -/
theorem mem_faceAt (D : Drawing J) (z : Plane) (hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D) :
    z ∈ faceRegion D (faceAt D z hz) := ⟨hz, rfl⟩

/-- A complement point determines its face uniquely. -/
theorem face_eq_of_mem (D : Drawing J) (A B : Face D) (z : Plane)
    (ha : z ∈ faceRegion D A) (hb : z ∈ faceRegion D B) : A = B :=
  ha.2.symm.trans hb.2

/-- Deleting trace cannot separate two points of an original complement component. -/
theorem faceRegion_subset_of_trace_subset (D : Drawing J) (R : Drawing K)
    (htrace : drawingTrace R ⊆ drawingTrace D) (z : Plane)
    (hz : z ∉ drawingTrace D) :
    faceRegion D (faceAt D z hz) ⊆
      faceRegion R (faceAt R z (fun h => hz (htrace h))) := by
  let f : {x : Plane // x ∉ drawingTrace D} → {x : Plane // x ∉ drawingTrace R} :=
    fun x => ⟨x.val, fun h => x.property (htrace h)⟩
  have hf : Continuous f := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
  rintro x ⟨hx, he⟩
  refine ⟨fun h => hx (htrace h), ?_⟩
  apply ConnectedComponents.coe_eq_coe'.mpr
  exact hf.mapsTo_connectedComponent ⟨z, hz⟩ (ConnectedComponents.coe_eq_coe'.mp he)

/-- A whole continuous curve avoiding the trace stays in the face of its initial point. -/
theorem range_subset_faceAt (D : Drawing J) (gamma : ArcParameter → Plane)
    (hc : Continuous gamma) (hoff : ∀ t, gamma t ∉ drawingTrace D) :
    Set.range gamma ⊆ faceRegion D
      (faceAt D (gamma ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩) (hoff _)) := by
  let f : ArcParameter → {z : Plane // z ∉ drawingTrace D} :=
    fun t => ⟨gamma t, hoff t⟩
  have hf : Continuous f := hc.subtype_mk _
  have hconn : IsPreconnected (Set.range f) := isPreconnected_range hf
  rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨hoff t, ?_⟩
  apply ConnectedComponents.coe_eq_coe'.mpr
  exact hconn.subset_connectedComponent
    (Set.mem_range_self ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩) (Set.mem_range_self t)

end
end FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.ComplementFaces

/-! The actual retained source path and the complement face containing both primal poles. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.LatticeDrawing
open LatticeProb
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.Source
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST

/-- The actual simple retained path coexists with one uniquely determined complement
face containing both primal poles and the whole original marked primal arc.
The only open antecedent is the explicitly written closed bond-cycle formula. -/
theorem source_path_face_merger_of_bond_cycle
    (hbond :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (Q : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, EdgeChart Q e) (A : Finset V),
  (∀ x y : V, x ∈ A → y ∈ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∈ A) x y) →
  (∀ x y : V, x ∉ A → y ∉ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∉ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) x y) →
  ∀ marked : E,
    ((J.left marked ∈ A ∧ J.right marked ∉ A) ∨
      (J.right marked ∈ A ∧ J.left marked ∉ A)) →
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
    Function.Injective vertices ∧
    ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : E // e ≠ marked ∧
      ((J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A))},
      m + 1 = (Finset.univ.filter fun e : E =>
        (J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A)).card ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        (negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ)) ∧
      ((negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices 0 ∧
          positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices 0 ∧
          negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m))))
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (primalGraph D P),
      (∀ v : D, Q.point (project D P v.val) = q (sitePoint v.val)) ∧
      (∀ e t, Q.curve e t = q (unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val)) ∧
      ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart Q e,
      ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype (Face Q),
        letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
        ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts),
        ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e, EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
        ∃ vertexFaces : Vertex D P ≃ Face dualDrawing,
          (∀ F : Face Q, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion Q F) ∧
          (∀ v : Vertex D P, Q.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
          (∀ (e f : PrimalCopy D P) (s t : ArcParameter),
            Q.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
              e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
          (∀ (e : PrimalCopy D P) (t : ArcParameter),
            (t.val < 1 / 2 → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left e)) ∧
            (1 / 2 < t.val → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right e))) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧
            radius < (charts e).radius ∧ ∀ t : ArcParameter,
              |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
              (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P,
            positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).left e) ∧
            negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).right e)) ∧
          ∃ Hstar : Drawing (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts),
            (∀ F : Face Q, Hstar.point F = dualDrawing.point F) ∧
            (∀ e t, Hstar.curve e t = dualDrawing.curve (retainedPrimal D P marked e) t) ∧
            ∃ merged : Face Hstar,
              Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              Q.point (beta D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              Set.range (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (alpha D P)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (beta D P)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              (∀ face : Face Hstar,
                Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar face → face = merged) ∧
            ∃ m : ℕ, 3 ≤ m ∧ ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
              Function.Injective vertices ∧
              ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : Copy D P marked //
                copyA D P marked e = alpha D P ∨ copyB D P marked e = alpha D P},
                (∀ i : Fin m,
                  ((sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).left (copies i).val = vertices i.castSucc ∧
                    (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).right (copies i).val = vertices i.succ) ∨
                  ((sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).right (copies i).val = vertices i.castSucc ∧
                    (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).left (copies i).val = vertices i.succ)) ∧
                (((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices 0 ∧
                    (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨
                  ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices 0 ∧
                    (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices (Fin.last m))) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, hdual⟩ :=
    source_deleted_dual_path_of_bond_cycle hbond D P hD hDc hP marked
  letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
  obtain ⟨dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces, hpoint, hvertex, hcross,
    hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc,
    m, hm, vertices, hinj, copies, hends, hmarked⟩ := hdual
  have htrace : drawingTrace Hstar ⊆ drawingTrace dualDrawing := by
    rintro z (⟨v, hv⟩ | hz)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨v, (hsp v).symm.trans hv⟩
    · obtain ⟨e, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨retainedPrimal D P marked e, t, (hsc e t).symm.trans ht⟩)
  have hoff (s : ArcParameter) :
      Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) s ∉ drawingTrace Hstar := by
    rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | hz)
    · obtain ⟨ho, _⟩ := hpoint v
      apply ho
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨markedPrimal D P marked, s, hv.symm.trans (hsp v)⟩)
    · obtain ⟨e, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      have he := (hcross (markedPrimal D P marked)
        (retainedPrimal D P marked e) s t).mp
          (ht.symm.trans (hsc e t))
      exact retainedPrimal_ne_marked D P marked e he.1.symm
  obtain ⟨merged, hinside, _, _⟩ := DeletedArc.common_face Hstar
    (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) (Q.continuous _) (fun t _ _ => hoff t)
  have hall : Set.range (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆
      faceRegion Hstar merged := by
    have hwhole := range_subset_faceAt Hstar (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked))
      (Q.continuous _) hoff
    have hmid := hinside ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have heq := face_eq_of_mem Hstar _ merged _
      (hwhole (Set.mem_range_self ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩)) hmid
    exact heq ▸ hwhole
  have hab : Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
      Q.point (beta D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged := by
    have hs := hall ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, Q.start _⟩
    have ht := hall ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, Q.finish _⟩
    rcases marked.property with h | h
    · exact ⟨h.1 ▸ hs, h.2 ▸ ht⟩
    · exact ⟨h.2 ▸ ht, h.1 ▸ hs⟩
  have hregions (v : Vertex D P) (hv : Q.point v ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged) :
      faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged := by
    obtain ⟨ho, he⟩ := hvertex v
    have hsub := faceRegion_subset_of_trace_subset dualDrawing Hstar htrace
      (Q.point v) ho
    change faceAt dualDrawing (Q.point v) ho = vertexFaces v at he
    rw [he] at hsub
    have hmerge := face_eq_of_mem Hstar _ merged (Q.point v)
      (mem_faceAt Hstar _ (fun h => ho (htrace h))) hv
    exact hmerge ▸ hsub
  refine ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces,
    hpoint, hvertex, hcross, hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc,
    merged, hab.1, hab.2, hall, hregions _ hab.1, hregions _ hab.2, ?_,
    m, hm, vertices, hinj, copies, hends, hmarked⟩
  intro face hf
  exact face_eq_of_mem Hstar face merged (Q.point (alpha D P)) hf hab.1

/-- Deleting the original marked dual copy puts both primal poles, the whole marked
primal curve, and both corresponding full-dual face regions into one actual face.
This merger needs no bond-cycle antecedent. -/
theorem source_marked_dual_face_merger
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (primalGraph D P),
      (∀ v : D, Q.point (project D P v.val) = q (sitePoint v.val)) ∧
      (∀ e t, Q.curve e t = q (unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val)) ∧
      ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart Q e,
      ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype (Face Q),
        letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
        ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts),
        ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e, EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
        ∃ vertexFaces : Vertex D P ≃ Face dualDrawing,
          (∀ F : Face Q, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion Q F) ∧
          (∀ v : Vertex D P, Q.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
          (∀ (e f : PrimalCopy D P) (s t : ArcParameter),
            Q.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
              e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
          (∀ (e : PrimalCopy D P) (t : ArcParameter),
            (t.val < 1 / 2 → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left e)) ∧
            (1 / 2 < t.val → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right e))) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧
            radius < (charts e).radius ∧ ∀ t : ArcParameter,
              |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
              (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P,
            positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).left e) ∧
            negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).right e)) ∧
          ∃ Hstar : Drawing (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts),
            (∀ F : Face Q, Hstar.point F = dualDrawing.point F) ∧
            (∀ e t, Hstar.curve e t = dualDrawing.curve (retainedPrimal D P marked e) t) ∧
            ∃ merged : Face Hstar,
              Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              Q.point (beta D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              Set.range (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (alpha D P)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (beta D P)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              (∀ face : Face Hstar,
                Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar face → face = merged) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, hdual⟩ :=
    source_H_deleted_dual_realization D P hD hDc hP marked
  letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
  obtain ⟨dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces, hpoint, hvertex, hcross,
    hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc⟩ := hdual
  have htrace : drawingTrace Hstar ⊆ drawingTrace dualDrawing := by
    rintro z (⟨v, hv⟩ | hz)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨v, (hsp v).symm.trans hv⟩
    · obtain ⟨e, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨retainedPrimal D P marked e, t, (hsc e t).symm.trans ht⟩)
  have hoff (s : ArcParameter) :
      Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked) s ∉ drawingTrace Hstar := by
    rintro (⟨v, hv⟩ | hz)
    · obtain ⟨ho, _⟩ := hpoint v
      apply ho
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨markedPrimal D P marked, s, hv.symm.trans (hsp v)⟩)
    · obtain ⟨e, t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      have he := (hcross (markedPrimal D P marked)
        (retainedPrimal D P marked e) s t).mp
          (ht.symm.trans (hsc e t))
      exact retainedPrimal_ne_marked D P marked e he.1.symm
  obtain ⟨merged, hinside, _, _⟩ := DeletedArc.common_face Hstar
    (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) (Q.continuous _) (fun t _ _ => hoff t)
  have hall : Set.range (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆
      faceRegion Hstar merged := by
    have hwhole := range_subset_faceAt Hstar (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked))
      (Q.continuous _) hoff
    have hmid := hinside ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have heq := face_eq_of_mem Hstar _ merged _
      (hwhole (Set.mem_range_self ⟨1/2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩)) hmid
    exact heq ▸ hwhole
  have hab : Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
      Q.point (beta D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged := by
    have hs := hall ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, Q.start _⟩
    have ht := hall ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, Q.finish _⟩
    rcases marked.property with h | h
    · exact ⟨h.1 ▸ hs, h.2 ▸ ht⟩
    · exact ⟨h.2 ▸ ht, h.1 ▸ hs⟩
  have hregions (v : Vertex D P) (hv : Q.point v ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged) :
      faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged := by
    obtain ⟨ho, he⟩ := hvertex v
    have hsub := faceRegion_subset_of_trace_subset dualDrawing Hstar htrace
      (Q.point v) ho
    change faceAt dualDrawing (Q.point v) ho = vertexFaces v at he
    rw [he] at hsub
    have hmerge := face_eq_of_mem Hstar _ merged (Q.point v)
      (mem_faceAt Hstar _ (fun h => ho (htrace h))) hv
    exact hmerge ▸ hsub
  refine ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces,
    hpoint, hvertex, hcross, hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc,
    merged, hab.1, hab.2, hall, hregions _ hab.1, hregions _ hab.2, ?_⟩
  intro face hf
  exact face_eq_of_mem Hstar face merged (Q.point (alpha D P)) hf hab.1


end

/-! Ordinary consequences of whole-edge incidence in actual complement faces. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.IncidenceApplication
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] {J : CopiedGraph V E}

/-- The existing Drawing fields give a closed embedded arc for every nonloop copy. -/
theorem nonloop_curve_isClosedEmbedding (R : Drawing J) (e : E)
    (hne : J.left e ≠ J.right e) : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (R.curve e) :=
  (R.continuous e).isClosedEmbedding (R.nonloop_curve_injective e hne)

/-- A drawn point in a face closure lies on its frontier, since the face avoids the trace. -/
theorem mem_frontier_of_mem_trace (R : Drawing J) (F : Face R) (z : Plane)
    (hz : z ∈ drawingTrace R) (hc : z ∈ closure (faceRegion R F)) :
    z ∈ frontier (faceRegion R F) := by
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure]
  refine ⟨hc, subset_closure ?_⟩
  intro hf
  exact hf.1 hz

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
/-- A simple copied path has no loop edges; this is derived from its actual endpoints. -/
theorem path_copy_nonloop (m : ℕ) (vertices : Fin (m + 1) → V)
    (hinj : Function.Injective vertices) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i : Fin m,
      (J.left (copies i) = vertices i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = vertices i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = vertices i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = vertices i.succ))
    (i : Fin m) : J.left (copies i) ≠ J.right (copies i) := by
  intro he
  have hi : vertices i.castSucc = vertices i.succ := by
    rcases hends i with h | h
    · exact h.1.symm.trans (he.trans h.2)
    · exact h.1.symm.trans (he.symm.trans h.2)
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val (hinj hi)
  simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at hv
  omega

/-- Every vertex of a positive-length copied path is an endpoint of a path curve. -/
theorem path_vertices_mem_frontier (R : Drawing J) (F : Face R) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (vertices : Fin (m + 1) → V) (copies : Fin m → E)
    (hends : ∀ i : Fin m,
      (J.left (copies i) = vertices i.castSucc ∧ J.right (copies i) = vertices i.succ) ∨
      (J.right (copies i) = vertices i.castSucc ∧ J.left (copies i) = vertices i.succ))
    (hcurves : ∀ i, Set.range (R.curve (copies i)) ⊆ frontier (faceRegion R F)) :
    ∀ k, R.point (vertices k) ∈ frontier (faceRegion R F) := by
  have endpoints (i : Fin m) :
      R.point (vertices i.castSucc) ∈ frontier (faceRegion R F) ∧
      R.point (vertices i.succ) ∈ frontier (faceRegion R F) := by
    have hs := hcurves i ⟨⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, R.start _⟩
    have ht := hcurves i ⟨⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩, R.finish _⟩
    rcases hends i with h | h
    · exact ⟨h.1 ▸ hs, h.2 ▸ ht⟩
    · exact ⟨h.1 ▸ ht, h.2 ▸ hs⟩
  intro k
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => (endpoints i).2) k
  exact (endpoints ⟨0, hm⟩).1

/-- The actual retained alpha-star path lies in the frontier of the actual merged
Hstar face, conditional only on two explicit closed generic classical propositions.
Neither proposition is registered or asserted by this module. -/
theorem source_retained_path_frontier_of_classical_incidence
    (hbond :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (Q : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, EdgeChart Q e) (A : Finset V),
  (∀ x y : V, x ∈ A → y ∈ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∈ A) x y) →
  (∀ x y : V, x ∉ A → y ∉ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∉ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) x y) →
  ∀ marked : E,
    ((J.left marked ∈ A ∧ J.right marked ∉ A) ∨
      (J.right marked ∈ A ∧ J.left marked ∉ A)) →
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
    Function.Injective vertices ∧
    ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : E // e ≠ marked ∧
      ((J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A))},
      m + 1 = (Finset.univ.filter fun e : E =>
        (J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A)).card ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        (negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ)) ∧

          positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨

          negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m))))

∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (R : Drawing J) (e : E) (c : EdgeChart R e),
  J.left e ≠ J.right e →
  Set.range (R.curve e) ⊆ closure (faceRegion R (positiveChartFace R e c)) ∧
  Set.range (R.curve e) ⊆ closure (faceRegion R (negativeChartFace R e c)))
    (D : Finset (Site 2)) (P : OneSet D)
    (hD : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (hDc : ((lattice 2).induce (↑D : Set (Site 2))ᶜ).Connected)
    (hP : ((lattice 2).induce (↑(P.val.image Subtype.val) : Set (Site 2))).Connected)
    (marked : MarkedCopy D P) :
    ∃ q : Plane → Plane, Continuous q ∧ ∃ Q : Drawing (primalGraph D P),
      (∀ v : D, Q.point (project D P v.val) = q (sitePoint v.val)) ∧
      (∀ e t, Q.curve e t = q (unitSegment e.val.1 e.val.2 t.val)) ∧
      ∃ charts : ∀ e, EdgeChart Q e,

        letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
        ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts),
        ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e, EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
        ∃ vertexFaces : Vertex D P ≃ Face dualDrawing,
          (∀ F : Face Q, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion Q F) ∧
          (∀ v : Vertex D P, Q.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
          (∀ (e f : PrimalCopy D P) (s t : ArcParameter),
            Q.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
              e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
          (∀ (e : PrimalCopy D P) (t : ArcParameter),
            (t.val < 1 / 2 → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left e)) ∧
            (1 / 2 < t.val → dualDrawing.curve e t ∈
              faceRegion Q ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right e))) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧
            radius < (charts e).radius ∧ ∀ t : ArcParameter,
              |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
              (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
          (∀ e : PrimalCopy D P,
            positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).left e) ∧
            negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces ((primalGraph D P).right e)) ∧
          ∃ Hstar : Drawing (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts),
            (∀ F : Face Q, Hstar.point F = dualDrawing.point F) ∧
            (∀ e t, Hstar.curve e t = dualDrawing.curve (retainedPrimal D P marked e) t) ∧
            ∃ merged : Face Hstar,
              Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              Q.point (beta D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              Set.range (Q.curve (markedPrimal D P marked)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (alpha D P)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (beta D P)) ⊆ faceRegion Hstar merged ∧
              (∀ face : Face Hstar,
                Q.point (alpha D P) ∈ faceRegion Hstar face → face = merged) ∧
            ∃ m : ℕ, 3 ≤ m ∧ ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
              Function.Injective vertices ∧
              ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : Copy D P marked //
                copyA D P marked e = alpha D P ∨ copyB D P marked e = alpha D P},
                (∀ i : Fin m,
                  ((sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).left (copies i).val = vertices i.castSucc ∧
                    (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).right (copies i).val = vertices i.succ) ∨
                  ((sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).right (copies i).val = vertices i.castSucc ∧
                    (sourceDeletedDualGraph D P marked Q charts).left (copies i).val = vertices i.succ)) ∧
                (((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices 0 ∧
                    (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨
                  ((sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices 0 ∧
                    (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left (markedPrimal D P marked) = vertices (Fin.last m))) ∧
                (∀ i : Fin m, Set.range (Hstar.curve (copies i).val) ⊆
                  frontier (faceRegion Hstar merged)) ∧
                (∀ k : Fin (m + 1), Hstar.point (vertices k) ∈
                  frontier (faceRegion Hstar merged)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, hdual⟩ :=
    source_path_face_merger_of_bond_cycle hbond D P hD hDc hP marked
  letI : Fintype (Face Q) := finiteFaces
  obtain ⟨dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces, hpoint, hvertex, hcross,
    hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc,
    merged, halpha, hbeta, harc, hregionAlpha, hregionBeta, hunique,
    m, hm, vertices, hinj, copies, hends, hmarked⟩ := hdual
  have hboundary (i : Fin m) : Set.range (Hstar.curve (copies i).val) ⊆
      frontier (faceRegion Hstar merged) := by
    have hne := path_copy_nonloop m vertices hinj (fun j => (copies j).val) hends i
    have hnfull : (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).left
        (retainedPrimal D P marked (copies i).val) ≠
      (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts).right
        (retainedPrimal D P marked (copies i).val) := hne
    obtain ⟨hpositive, hnegative⟩ := hinc (sourceDualGraph D P Q charts) dualDrawing
      (retainedPrimal D P marked (copies i).val)
      (dualCharts (retainedPrimal D P marked (copies i).val)) hnfull
    have hwhole : Set.range (dualDrawing.curve
        (retainedPrimal D P marked (copies i).val)) ⊆
        closure (faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (alpha D P))) := by
      rcases (copies i).property with ha | hb
      · rw [(horient _).1] at hpositive
        change Set.range (dualDrawing.curve _) ⊆
          closure (faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (copyA D P marked (copies i).val)))
          at hpositive
        rw [ha] at hpositive
        exact hpositive
      · rw [(horient _).2] at hnegative
        change Set.range (dualDrawing.curve _) ⊆
          closure (faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces (copyB D P marked (copies i).val)))
          at hnegative
        rw [hb] at hnegative
        exact hnegative
    rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
    apply mem_frontier_of_mem_trace Hstar merged _
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(copies i).val, Set.mem_range_self t⟩)
    · rw [hsc]

  exact ⟨q, hq, Q, hp, hc, charts, finiteFaces, dualDrawing, dualCharts, vertexFaces,
    hpoint, hvertex, hcross, hparts, hlocal, horient, Hstar, hsp, hsc,
    merged, halpha, hbeta, harc, hregionAlpha, hregionBeta, hunique,
    m, hm, vertices, hinj, copies, hends, hmarked, hboundary, hvertices⟩

/-! Conditional consumption of the exact UNREGISTERED finite-plane topology
candidate. All electrical equalities below are proved from actual copied incidence,
Poisson uniqueness and REGISTERED BSST. No electrical identity is assumed. -/

variable {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]

private theorem polar_poisson_of_cycle_law (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (alpha beta : V)
    (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta)
    [Fintype A.embedding.Face] (psi : A.embedding.Face → ℝ)
    (hpsi : stream_spec D alpha beta A (voltage J alpha beta hc) psi)
    (hcycle : ∀ F : A.embedding.Face,
      copyBoundary (augmentedDual A).left (augmentedDual A).right
        (copyGradient (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).left
          (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).right (voltage J alpha beta hc)) F = 0)
    (F : A.embedding.Face) (hF : F ≠ polarGround A) :
    laplacian (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right psi F =
      if F = polarSource A then 1 else 0 := by
  let phi := voltage J alpha beta hc
  let j : E → ℝ := copyGradient J.left J.right phi
  have hphi := voltage_spec J alpha beta hne hc
  have hunit : ∀ u : Unit, u = () := fun u => Subsingleton.elim u ()
  have hc0 : copyBoundary (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right j F +
      ((if polarGround A = F then (-1 : ℝ) else 0) -
       (if polarSource A = F then (-1 : ℝ) else 0)) = 0 := by
    convert hcycle F using 1
    simp [copyBoundary,Fintype.sum_sum_type,
        augmentedDual,polarDual,copyGradient,augmentedGraph,
        polarGround,polarSource,hunit,hphi.1,hphi.2.1,phi,j]
    ring_nf
  have hg : copyGradient (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right psi = -j := by
    funext e
    have hs := hpsi.1 e
    change psi ((polarDual A).right e) - psi ((polarDual A).left e) = j e at hs
    change psi ((polarDual A).left e) - psi ((polarDual A).right e) = -(j e)
    linarith
  rw [← copyBoundary_gradient,hg]
  have hn := congrFun ((boundaryMap (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).map_neg j) F
  change copyBoundary (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right (-j) F =
      -copyBoundary (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right j F at hn
  rw [hn]
  by_cases hv : F = polarSource A
  · simp only [if_neg hF.symm,if_pos hv.symm,sub_neg_eq_add,zero_add] at hc0
    rw [if_pos hv]
    linarith
  · simp only [if_neg hF.symm,if_neg (Ne.symm hv),sub_self,add_zero] at hc0
    rw [if_neg hv,hc0,neg_zero]

/-- Complete polar Green/current/once-copy-energy correspondence. Only the exact
classical topology theorem is conditional; no requested electrical law or paper
estimate appears in that binder. The full actual face carrier is retained. -/
theorem polar_electrical_duality_of_classical
    (hclassical : ∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (_hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected)
    (alpha beta : V) (_hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta),
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype A.embedding.Face,
      letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
      polarGround A ≠ polarSource A ∧
      (supportGraph (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).Preconnected ∧
      (∀ T : Finset (E ⊕ Unit),
        (∃ t : (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).SpanningTree, t.val = T) ↔
        (∃ t : (augmentedDual A).SpanningTree, t.val = Finset.univ \ T)) ∧
      (∀ (q : V → ℝ) (F : A.embedding.Face),
        copyBoundary (augmentedDual A).left (augmentedDual A).right
          (copyGradient (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).left
            (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).right q) F = 0))
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : PlaneEmbedding J)
    (hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected) (alpha beta : V)
    (hne : alpha ≠ beta) (A : OuterArc D alpha beta) :
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype A.embedding.Face,
      letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
      polarGround A ≠ polarSource A ∧
      ∃ hd : (supportGraph (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right).Preconnected,
        (∀ T : Finset (E ⊕ Unit),
          (∃ t : (augmentedGraph J alpha beta).SpanningTree, t.val = T) ↔
          (∃ t : (augmentedDual A).SpanningTree, t.val = Finset.univ \ T)) ∧
        let g := groundedGreen (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right
          (polarGround A) hd (polarSource A)
        stream_spec D alpha beta A (voltage J alpha beta hc) g ∧
        g (polarSource A) = mass J (voltage J alpha beta hc) ∧
        (∀ e, g ((polarDual A).right e)-g ((polarDual A).left e) =
          voltage J alpha beta hc (J.left e)-voltage J alpha beta hc (J.right e)) ∧
        energy (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right g = mass J (voltage J alpha beta hc) := by
  obtain ⟨finiteFaces,hp,hd,htrees,hcycle⟩ := hclassical J D hc alpha beta hne A
  letI : Fintype A.embedding.Face := finiteFaces
  obtain ⟨psi,hpsi,_⟩ := existsUnique_polar_stream J D hc alpha beta hne A
  have hg : psi = groundedGreen (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right
      (polarGround A) hd (polarSource A) := by
    exact groundedPoisson_eq (polarDual A).left (polarDual A).right
      (polarGround A) hd (fun F => if F = polarSource A then 1 else 0) psi
      ⟨hpsi.2.2.1,fun F hF =>
      polar_poisson_of_cycle_law J D hc alpha beta hne A psi hpsi
        (hcycle (voltage J alpha beta hc)) F hF⟩
  refine ⟨finiteFaces,hp,hd,htrees,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [← hg]; exact hpsi
  · rw [← hg]; exact hpsi.2.2.2
  · intro e; rw [← hg]; exact hpsi.1 e
  · rw [energy_groundedGreen_eq,← hg]; exact hpsi.2.2.2


end

/-!
# Relation closures

This file defines the reflexive, symmetric, transitive, reflexive transitive and equivalence
closures of relations and proves some basic results on them.

Note that this is about unbundled relations, that is terms of types of the form `α → β → Prop`. For
the bundled version, see `Rel`.

## Definitions

* `Relation.ReflGen`: Reflexive closure. `ReflGen r` relates everything `r` related, plus for all
  `a` it relates `a` with itself. So `ReflGen r a b ↔ r a b ∨ a = b`.
* `Relation.SymmGen`: Symmetric closure. This is also the comparability relation,
  such that `SymmGen r a b` means that either `r a b` or `r b a` (see `Mathlib.Order.Comparable`)
* `Relation.TransGen`: Transitive closure. `TransGen r` relates everything `r` related
  transitively. So `TransGen r a b ↔ ∃ x₀ ... xₙ, r a x₀ ∧ r x₀ x₁ ∧ ... ∧ r xₙ b`.
* `Relation.ReflTransGen`: Reflexive transitive closure. `ReflTransGen r` relates everything
  `r` related transitively, plus for all `a` it relates `a` with itself. So
  `ReflTransGen r a b ↔ (∃ x₀ ... xₙ, r a x₀ ∧ r x₀ x₁ ∧ ... ∧ r xₙ b) ∨ a = b`. It is the same as
  the reflexive closure of the transitive closure, or the transitive closure of the reflexive
  closure. In terms of rewriting systems, this means that `a` can be rewritten to `b` in a number of
  rewrites.
* `Relation.EqvGen`: Equivalence closure. `EqvGen r` relates everything `ReflTransGen r` relates,
  plus for all related pairs it relates them in the opposite order.
* `Relation.Comp`:  Relation composition. We provide notation `∘r`. For `r : α → β → Prop` and
  `s : β → γ → Prop`, `r ∘r s` relates `a : α` and `c : γ` iff there exists `b : β` that's related
  to both.
* `Relation.Map`: Image of a relation under a pair of maps. For `r : α → β → Prop`, `f : α → γ`,
  `g : β → δ`, `Map r f g` is the relation `γ → δ → Prop` relating `f a` and `g b` for all `a`, `b`
  related by `r`.
* `Relation.Join`: Join of a relation. For `r : α → α → Prop`, `Join r a b ↔ ∃ c, r a c ∧ r b c`. In
  terms of rewriting systems, this means that `a` and `b` can be rewritten to the same term.
-/

@[expose] public section


open Function

variable {α β γ δ ε ζ : Type*}

theorem Subrelation.antisymm {r r' : α → α → Prop} (h1 : Subrelation r r') (h2 : Subrelation r' r) :
    r = r' :=
  funext₂ fun _ _ => propext ⟨h1, h2⟩

section NeImp

variable {r : α → α → Prop}

@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias Std.Refl.reflexive := refl

/-- To show a reflexive relation `r : α → α → Prop` holds over `x y : α`,
it suffices to show it holds when `x ≠ y`. -/
theorem Std.Refl.rel_of_ne_imp [Std.Refl r] {x y : α} (hr : x ≠ y → r x y) : r x y := by
  grind [Std.Refl]

@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias Reflexive.rel_of_ne_imp := Std.Refl.rel_of_ne_imp

/-- If a reflexive relation `r : α → α → Prop` holds over `x y : α`,
then it holds whether or not `x ≠ y`. -/
theorem Std.Refl.ne_imp_iff [Std.Refl r] {x y : α} : x ≠ y → r x y ↔ r x y :=
  ⟨Std.Refl.rel_of_ne_imp, fun hr _ ↦ hr⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias Reflexive.ne_imp_iff := Std.Refl.ne_imp_iff
@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias reflexive_ne_imp_iff := Std.Refl.ne_imp_iff

@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias reflexive_iff_subrelation_eq := refl_iff_eq_le

protected theorem Std.Symm.iff [Std.Symm r] (x y : α) : r x y ↔ r y x :=

namespace Relation

section Comp

variable {r : α → β → Prop} {p : β → γ → Prop} {q : γ → δ → Prop}

/-- The composition of two relations, yielding a new relation.  The result
relates a term of `α` and a term of `γ` if there is an intermediate
term of `β` related to both.
-/
def Comp (r : α → β → Prop) (p : β → γ → Prop) (a : α) (c : γ) : Prop :=
  ∃ b, r a b ∧ p b c

@[inherit_doc]
local infixr:80 " ∘r " => Relation.Comp

@[simp]
theorem comp_eq_fun (f : γ → β) : r ∘r (· = f ·) = (r · <| f ·) := by
  ext x y
  simp [Comp]

@[simp]
theorem comp_eq : r ∘r (· = ·) = r := comp_eq_fun ..

@[simp]
theorem fun_eq_comp (f : γ → α) : (f · = ·) ∘r r = (r <| f ·) := by
  ext x y
  simp [Comp]

@[simp]
theorem eq_comp : (· = ·) ∘r r = r := fun_eq_comp ..

@[simp]
theorem iff_comp {r : Prop → α → Prop} : (· ↔ ·) ∘r r = r := by
  grind [eq_comp]

@[simp]
theorem comp_iff {r : α → Prop → Prop} : r ∘r (· ↔ ·) = r := by
  grind [comp_eq]

theorem comp_assoc : (r ∘r p) ∘r q = r ∘r p ∘r q := by
  funext a d
  apply propext
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨c, ⟨b, hab, hbc⟩, hcd⟩ ↦ ⟨b, hab, c, hbc, hcd⟩
  · exact fun ⟨b, hab, c, hbc, hcd⟩ ↦ ⟨c, ⟨b, hab, hbc⟩, hcd⟩

theorem flip_comp : flip (r ∘r p) = flip p ∘r flip r := by
  funext c a
  apply propext
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨b, hab, hbc⟩ ↦ ⟨b, hbc, hab⟩
  · exact fun ⟨b, hbc, hab⟩ ↦ ⟨b, hab, hbc⟩

end Comp

section Fibration

variable (rα : α → α → Prop) (rβ : β → β → Prop) (f : α → β)

/-- A function `f : α → β` is a fibration between the relation `rα` and `rβ` if for all
  `a : α` and `b : β`, whenever `b : β` and `f a` are related by `rβ`, `b` is the image
  of some `a' : α` under `f`, and `a'` and `a` are related by `rα`. -/
def Fibration :=
  ∀ ⦃a b⦄, rβ b (f a) → ∃ a', rα a' a ∧ f a' = b

variable {rα rβ}

/-- If `f : α → β` is a fibration between relations `rα` and `rβ`, and `a : α` is
  accessible under `rα`, then `f a` is accessible under `rβ`. -/
theorem _root_.Acc.of_fibration (fib : Fibration rα rβ f) {a} (ha : Acc rα a) : Acc rβ (f a) := by
  induction ha with | intro a _ ih => ?_
  refine Acc.intro (f a) fun b hr ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a', hr', rfl⟩ := fib hr
  exact ih a' hr'

theorem _root_.Acc.of_downward_closed (dc : ∀ {a b}, rβ b (f a) → ∃ c, f c = b) (a : α)
    (ha : Acc (InvImage rβ f) a) : Acc rβ (f a) :=
  ha.of_fibration f fun a _ h ↦
    let ⟨a', he⟩ := dc h
    ⟨a', by simp_all [InvImage], he⟩

end Fibration

section Map
variable {r : α → β → Prop} {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} {c : γ} {d : δ}

/-- The map of a relation `r` through a pair of functions pushes the
relation to the codomains of the functions.  The resulting relation is
defined by having pairs of terms related if they have preimages
related by `r`.
-/
protected def Map (r : α → β → Prop) (f : α → γ) (g : β → δ) : γ → δ → Prop := fun c d ↦
  ∃ a b, r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d

lemma map_apply : Relation.Map r f g c d ↔ ∃ a b, r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d := Iff.rfl

@[simp] lemma map_map (r : α → β → Prop) (f₁ : α → γ) (g₁ : β → δ) (f₂ : γ → ε) (g₂ : δ → ζ) :
    Relation.Map (Relation.Map r f₁ g₁) f₂ g₂ = Relation.Map r (f₂ ∘ f₁) (g₂ ∘ g₁) := by
  grind [Relation.Map]

@[simp]
lemma map_apply_apply (hf : Injective f) (hg : Injective g) (r : α → β → Prop) (a : α) (b : β) :
    Relation.Map r f g (f a) (g b) ↔ r a b := by simp [Relation.Map, hf.eq_iff, hg.eq_iff]

@[simp] lemma map_id_id (r : α → β → Prop) : Relation.Map r id id = r := by ext; simp [Relation.Map]

instance [Decidable (∃ a b, r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d)] : Decidable (Relation.Map r f g c d) :=
  ‹Decidable _›

lemma _root_.Std.Refl.map {r : α → α → Prop} [Std.Refl r] {f : α → β} (hf : f.Surjective) :
    Std.Refl (Relation.Map r f f) where
  refl x := by
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf x
    exact ⟨y, y, refl y, rfl, rfl⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias map_reflexive := Std.Refl.map

instance _root_.Std.Symm.map {r : α → α → Prop} [Std.Symm r] (f : α → β) :
    Std.Symm (Relation.Map r f f) where
  symm _ _ := by
    rintro ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, x, symm hxy, rfl, rfl⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-06-10")] alias map_symmetric := Std.Symm.map

lemma _root_.IsTrans.map {r : α → α → Prop} [IsTrans α r] {f : α → β}
    (hf : ∀ x y, f x = f y → r x y) : IsTrans β (Relation.Map r f f) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ _ ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ ⟨y', z, hyz, hy', hz⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ⟨x, z, trans_of r hxy <| trans_of r (hf y y' <| hy' ▸ hy) hyz, hx, hz⟩

@[deprecated (since := "2026-03-27")] alias isTrans_map := IsTrans.map

@[deprecated (since := "2026-02-21")] alias map_transitive := isTrans_map

lemma map_equivalence {r : α → α → Prop} (hr : Equivalence r) (f : α → β) (hf : f.Surjective)
    (hf_ker : ∀ x y, f x = f y → r x y) : Equivalence (Relation.Map r f f) where
  refl := hr.stdRefl.map hf |>.refl
  symm := @(hr.stdSymm.map f |>.symm)
  trans := @(hr.isTrans.map hf_ker |>.trans)

lemma map_mono {r s : α → β → Prop} {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} (h : r ≤ s) :
    Relation.Map r f g ≤ Relation.Map s f g :=
  fun _ _ ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ => ⟨x, y, h _ _ hxy, hx, hy⟩

lemma le_onFun_map {r : α → α → Prop} (f : α → β) : r ≤ (Relation.Map r f f on f) := by
  unfold Pi.hasLe Prop.le
  grind [Relation.Map]

lemma onFun_map_eq_of_injective {r : α → α → Prop} {f : α → β} (hinj : f.Injective) :
    (Relation.Map r f f on f) = r := by
  ext x y
  exact ⟨fun ⟨x', y', hr, hx, hy⟩ ↦ hinj hx ▸ hinj hy ▸ hr, fun h ↦ ⟨x, y, h, rfl, rfl⟩⟩

lemma map_onFun_le {r : β → β → Prop} (f : α → β) : Relation.Map (r on f) f f ≤ r := by
  unfold Pi.hasLe Prop.le
  grind [Relation.Map]

lemma map_onFun_eq_of_surjective {r : β → β → Prop} {f : α → β} (hsurj : f.Surjective) :
    Relation.Map (r on f) f f = r := by
  ext x y
  have _ := hsurj x
  have _ := hsurj y
  grind [Relation.Map]

lemma map_onFun_map_eq_map {r : α → α → Prop} (f : α → β) :
    Relation.Map (Relation.Map r f f on f) f f = Relation.Map r f f := by
  grind [Relation.Map]

lemma onFun_map_onFun_eq_onFun {r : β → β → Prop} (f : α → β) :
    (Relation.Map (r on f) f f on f) = (r on f) := by
  grind [Relation.Map]

lemma onFun_map_onFun_iff_onFun {r : β → β → Prop} (f : α → β) (a₁ a₂ : α) :
    Relation.Map (r on f) f f (f a₁) (f a₂) ↔ r (f a₁) (f a₂) := by
  grind [Relation.Map]

end Map

variable {r : α → α → Prop} {a b c : α}

/-- `ReflTransGen r`: reflexive transitive closure of `r` -/
@[mk_iff ReflTransGen.cases_tail_iff, grind]
inductive ReflTransGen (r : α → α → Prop) (a : α) : α → Prop
  | refl : ReflTransGen r a a
  | tail {b c : α} : ReflTransGen r a b → r b c → ReflTransGen r a c

attribute [refl] ReflTransGen.refl

/-- `ReflGen r`: reflexive closure of `r` -/
@[mk_iff, grind]
inductive ReflGen (r : α → α → Prop) (a : α) : α → Prop
  | refl : ReflGen r a a
  | single {b : α} : r a b → ReflGen r a b

attribute [refl] ReflGen.refl
attribute [grind =] reflGen_iff

/-- `SymmGen r`: symmetric closure of `r`. This is also the comparability relation, such
  that `SymmGen r a b` means that either `r a b` or `r b a` (see `Mathlib.Order.Comparable`). -/
def SymmGen (r : α → α → Prop) (a b : α) : Prop :=
  r a b ∨ r b a

variable (r) in
/-- `EqvGen r`: equivalence closure of `r`. -/
@[mk_iff]
inductive EqvGen : α → α → Prop
  | rel x y : r x y → EqvGen x y
  | refl x : EqvGen x x
  | symm x y : EqvGen x y → EqvGen y x
  | trans x y z : EqvGen x y → EqvGen y z → EqvGen x z

attribute [mk_iff] TransGen
attribute [grind] TransGen

theorem reflGen_le_reflTransGen : ReflGen r ≤ ReflTransGen r
  | a, _, .refl => by rfl
  | _, _, .single h => ReflTransGen.tail ReflTransGen.refl h

namespace ReflGen

theorem to_reflTransGen {a b} : ReflGen r a b → ReflTransGen r a b :=
  reflGen_le_reflTransGen a b

theorem mono {p : α → α → Prop} (hp : r ≤ p) : ReflGen r ≤ ReflGen p
  | a, _, ReflGen.refl => by rfl
  | a, b, single h => single (hp a b h)

instance : Std.Refl (ReflGen r) :=
  ⟨@refl α r⟩

instance stdSymm [Std.Symm r] : Std.Symm (ReflGen r) where
  symm _ _
    | refl => refl
    | single h => single <| symm h

@[deprecated (since := "2026-06-10")] alias symmetric := stdSymm

instance [IsTrans α r] : IsPreorder α (ReflGen r) where
  trans a b c h₁ h₂ := by
    obtain (rfl | h₂) := h₂
    · exact h₁
    obtain (rfl | h₁) := h₁
    · exact single h₂
    exact single (trans_of r h₁ h₂)

theorem of_rel (h : r a b) : SymmGen r a b :=

theorem of_rel_symm (h : r b a) : SymmGen r a b :=

  | inl hba => exact of_rel hba
  | inr hab => exact of_rel_symm hab

@[simp, refl]
theorem refl (r : α → α → Prop) [Std.Refl r] (a : α) : SymmGen r a a :=

theorem rfl [Std.Refl r] : SymmGen r a a := .refl ..

instance [Std.Refl r] : Std.Refl (SymmGen r) where

@[symm]

instance : Std.Symm (SymmGen r) where

namespace ReflTransGen

@[trans]
theorem trans (hab : ReflTransGen r a b) (hbc : ReflTransGen r b c) : ReflTransGen r a c := by
  induction hbc with
  | refl => assumption
  | tail _ hcd hac => exact hac.tail hcd

theorem single (hab : r a b) : ReflTransGen r a b :=
  refl.tail hab

theorem le_reflTransGen : r ≤ ReflTransGen r :=
  fun _ _ ↦ single

theorem head (hab : r a b) (hbc : ReflTransGen r b c) : ReflTransGen r a c := by
  induction hbc with
  | refl => exact refl.tail hab
  | tail _ hcd hac => exact hac.tail hcd

instance stdSymm [Std.Symm r] : Std.Symm (ReflTransGen r) where
  symm x y h := by
    induction h with
    | refl => rfl
    | tail _ b c => apply c.head <| symm b

@[deprecated (since := "2026-06-10")] alias symmetric := stdSymm

theorem cases_tail : ReflTransGen r a b → b = a ∨ ∃ c, ReflTransGen r a c ∧ r c b :=
  (cases_tail_iff r a b).1

@[elab_as_elim]
theorem head_induction_on {motive : ∀ a : α, ReflTransGen r a b → Prop} {a : α}
    (h : ReflTransGen r a b) (refl : motive b refl)
    (head : ∀ {a c} (h' : r a c) (h : ReflTransGen r c b), motive c h → motive a (h.head h')) :
    motive a h := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact refl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
  apply ih
  · exact head hbc _ refl
  · exact fun h1 h2 ↦ head h1 (h2.tail hbc)

@[elab_as_elim]
theorem trans_induction_on {motive : ∀ {a b : α}, ReflTransGen r a b → Prop} {a b : α}
    (h : ReflTransGen r a b) (refl : ∀ a, @motive a a refl)
    (single : ∀ {a b} (h : r a b), motive (single h))
    (trans : ∀ {a b c} (h₁ : ReflTransGen r a b) (h₂ : ReflTransGen r b c), motive h₁ → motive h₂ →
      motive (h₁.trans h₂)) : motive h := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact refl a
  | tail hab hbc ih => exact trans hab (.single hbc) ih (single hbc)

theorem cases_head (h : ReflTransGen r a b) : a = b ∨ ∃ c, r a c ∧ ReflTransGen r c b := by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on <;> grind

theorem cases_head_iff : ReflTransGen r a b ↔ a = b ∨ ∃ c, r a c ∧ ReflTransGen r c b := by
  use cases_head
  rintro (rfl | ⟨c, hac, hcb⟩)
  · rfl
  · exact head hac hcb

theorem total_of_right_unique (U : Relator.RightUnique r) (ab : ReflTransGen r a b)
    (ac : ReflTransGen r a c) : ReflTransGen r b c ∨ ReflTransGen r c b := by
  induction ab with
  | refl => exact Or.inl ac
  | tail _ bd IH =>
    rcases IH with (IH | IH)
    · rcases cases_head IH with (rfl | ⟨e, be, ec⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (single bd)
      · cases U bd be
        exact Or.inl ec
    · exact Or.inr (IH.tail bd)

end ReflTransGen

theorem transGen_le_reflTransGen : TransGen r ≤ ReflTransGen r := by
  intro a _ h
  induction h with
  | single h => exact ReflTransGen.single h
  | tail _ bc ab => exact ReflTransGen.tail ab bc

theorem to_reflTransGen {a b} : TransGen r a b → ReflTransGen r a b :=
  transGen_le_reflTransGen a b

theorem trans_left (hab : TransGen r a b) (hbc : ReflTransGen r b c) : TransGen r a c := by
  induction hbc with
  | refl => assumption
  | tail _ hcd hac => exact hac.tail hcd

attribute [trans] trans

theorem head' (hab : r a b) (hbc : ReflTransGen r b c) : TransGen r a c :=
  trans_left (single hab) hbc

theorem tail' (hab : ReflTransGen r a b) (hbc : r b c) : TransGen r a c := by
  induction hab generalizing c with
  | refl => exact single hbc
  | tail _ hdb IH => exact tail (IH hdb) hbc

theorem head (hab : r a b) (hbc : TransGen r b c) : TransGen r a c :=
  head' hab hbc.to_reflTransGen

@[elab_as_elim]
theorem head_induction_on {motive : ∀ a : α, TransGen r a b → Prop} {a : α} (h : TransGen r a b)
    (single : ∀ {a} (h : r a b), motive a (single h))
    (head : ∀ {a c} (h' : r a c) (h : TransGen r c b), motive c h → motive a (h.head h')) :
    motive a h := by
  induction h with
  | single h => exact single h
  | @tail b c _ hbc h_ih =>
  apply h_ih
  · exact fun h ↦ head h (.single hbc) (single hbc)
  · exact fun hab hbc ↦ head hab _

@[elab_as_elim]
theorem trans_induction_on {motive : ∀ {a b : α}, TransGen r a b → Prop} {a b : α}
    (h : TransGen r a b) (single : ∀ {a b} (h : r a b), motive (single h))
    (trans : ∀ {a b c} (h₁ : TransGen r a b) (h₂ : TransGen r b c), motive h₁ → motive h₂ →
      motive (h₁.trans h₂)) :
    motive h := by
  induction h with
  | single h => exact single h
  | tail hab hbc h_ih => exact trans hab (.single hbc) h_ih (single hbc)

theorem trans_right (hab : ReflTransGen r a b) (hbc : TransGen r b c) : TransGen r a c := by
  induction hbc with
  | single hbc => exact tail' hab hbc
  | tail _ hcd hac => exact hac.tail hcd

theorem tail'_iff : TransGen r a c ↔ ∃ b, ReflTransGen r a b ∧ r b c := by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨b, hab, hbc⟩ ↦ tail' hab hbc⟩
  cases h with
  | single hac => exact ⟨_, by rfl, hac⟩
  | tail hab hbc => exact ⟨_, hab.to_reflTransGen, hbc⟩

theorem head'_iff : TransGen r a c ↔ ∃ b, r a b ∧ ReflTransGen r b c := by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨b, hab, hbc⟩ ↦ head' hab hbc⟩
  induction h with
  | single hac => exact ⟨_, hac, by rfl⟩
  | tail _ hbc IH =>
  rcases IH with ⟨d, had, hdb⟩
  exact ⟨_, had, hdb.tail hbc⟩

instance stdSymm [Std.Symm r] : Std.Symm (TransGen r) where
  symm x y h := by
    induction h with
    | single i => exact .single <| symm i
    | tail _ h₁ h₂ => exact .head (symm h₁) h₂
